===== FILE: react\AIInlineMenu.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface AIAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options?: string[];
}

export interface AIInlineMenuProps {
  actions?: AIAction[];
  loading?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  tone?: "neutral" | "brand";
  onAction?: (id: string, option?: string) => void;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const SPARKLE_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M10 2.5l1.4 4.1L15.5 8l-4.1 1.4L10 13.5 8.6 9.4 4.5 8l4.1-1.4L10 2.5Z" />
    <path d="M15.8 12.6l.7 2 2 .7-2 .7-.7 2-.7-2-2-.7 2-.7.7-2Z" opacity="0.7" />
  </svg>
);

const CARET_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m6 8 4 4 4-4" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

const CLOSE_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * AIInlineMenu - selection-anchored floating AI action pill with badge chip, dropdown actions and loading state.
 */
export default function AIInlineMenu({
  actions = [
    { id: "edit", label: "Edit" },
    { id: "tone", label: "Change tone", options: ["Professional", "Friendly", "Concise"] },
  ],
  loading = false,
  error,
  tone = "neutral",
  onAction,
  onDismiss,
  className = "",
}: AIInlineMenuProps) {
  const [openId, setOpenId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lastRun, setLastRun] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const run = (action: AIAction, option?: string) => {
    if (loading) return;
    setOpenId(null);
    setLastRun(`${action.id}${option ? `:${option}` : ""}`);
    onAction?.(action.id, option);
  };

  const brand = tone === "brand";

  return (
    <div
      data-ai-inline-menu
      className={`inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-full border bg-white py-1 pl-1.5 pr-1 shadow-lg dark:bg-zinc-900 ${
        error ? "border-red-300 dark:border-red-900" : "border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700"
      } ${className}`}
    >
      <span
        className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
          brand
            ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
            : "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300"
        }`}
      >
        <span className={loading ? "animate-pulse" : ""}>{SPARKLE_SVG}</span>
        AI
      </span>
      <span className="mx-0.5 h-4 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
      {actions.map((action) => (
        <div key={action.id} className="relative">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-ai-action={action.id}
            disabled={loading}
            onClick={() => {
              if (action.options?.length) setOpenId(openId === action.id ? null : action.id);
              else run(action);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/60"
          >
            {action.label}
            {action.options?.length ? CARET_SVG : null}
          </button>
          {openId === action.id ? (
            <div data-ai-menu className="absolute bottom-full left-0 z-10 mb-1 w-40 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
              {action.options!.map((option) => (
                <button
                  key={option}
                  type="button"
                  data-ai-option={option}
                  onClick={() => run(action, option)}
                  className="block w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-xs text-zinc-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:hover:text-indigo-300"
                >
                  {option}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ))}
      {lastRun && !loading && !error ? (
        <span data-ai-status className="max-w-[160px] truncate px-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400" title={lastRun}>
          {lastRun}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      {loading ? <span data-ai-loading className="px-1 text-[10px] text-indigo-500">Working…</span> : null}
      {error ? <span data-ai-error className="px-1 text-[10px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{error}</span> : null}
      <button
        type="button"
        data-ai-dismiss
        title="Dismiss"
        onClick={() => {
          setOpenId(null);
          onDismiss?.();
        }}
        className="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
      >
        {CLOSE_SVG}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\Accordion.tsx =====

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AccordionItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  content: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
}

export interface AccordionProps {
  items: AccordionItem[];
  /** Allow several panels open at once. Defaults to false (single-open). */
  allowMultiple?: boolean;
  defaultOpenIds?: string[];
  onToggle?: (id: string, open: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const Accordion: React.FC<AccordionProps> = ({
  items,
  allowMultiple = false,
  defaultOpenIds,
  onToggle,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [openIds, setOpenIds] = useState<string[]>(
    defaultOpenIds ?? items.filter((item) => item.defaultOpen).map((item) => item.id)
  );

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    const isOpen = openIds.includes(id);
    const next = isOpen
      ? openIds.filter((entry) => entry !== id)
      : allowMultiple
        ? [...openIds, id]
        : [id];
    setOpenIds(next);
    onToggle?.(id, !isOpen);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {items.map((item) => {
        const open = openIds.includes(item.id);
        return (
          <div key={item.id}>
            <h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                id={`accordion-trigger-${item.id}`}
                aria-expanded={open}
                aria-controls={`accordion-panel-${item.id}`}
                onClick={() => toggle(item.id)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50"
              >
                {item.icon && (
                  <span className="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
                    <UiIcon name={item.icon} size={14} />
                  </span>
                )}
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <span className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                    {item.title}
                  </span>
                  {item.description && (
                    <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {item.description}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span
                  className={`shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${
                    open ? "rotate-180" : ""
                  }`}
                >
                  <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={14} />
                </span>
              </button>
            </h3>
            {open && (
              <div
                id={`accordion-panel-${item.id}`}
                role="region"
                aria-labelledby={`accordion-trigger-${item.id}`}
                className="px-4 pb-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400"
              >
                {item.content}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Accordion;


===== FILE: react\AccountSecurityPanel.tsx =====

/**
 * AccountSecurityPanel - Account settings security tab: settings tabs,
 * Password row with edit CTA and a "Manage verified sessions" card with
 * per-device rows and remove buttons (Podia account security pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface AccountSession {
  id: string;
  device: string;
  detail: string;
}

export interface AccountSecurityPanelProps {
  tabs?: string[];
  passwordValue?: string;
  sessionsTitle?: string;
  sessionsDescription?: string;
  sessions?: AccountSession[];
  className?: string;
  onTabClick?: (tab: string) => void;
  onEditPassword?: () => void;
  onRemoveSession?: (session: AccountSession) => void;
}

export default function AccountSecurityPanel({
  tabs = ["Personal", "Notifications", "Security", "Billing"],
  passwordValue = "••••••••",
  sessionsTitle = "Manage verified sessions",
  sessionsDescription = "Each time you login to your account, a verification code is emailed to you to proceed. You may have up to 5 login sessions verified at any given time, each of which expire after 30 days.",
  sessions = [
    { id: "s1", device: "Chrome on Mac 10.15.7", detail: "Nov 12 at 4:52 AM EST" },
    { id: "s2", device: "Firefox on Windows 11", detail: "Nov 8 at 9:18 AM EST" },
  ],
  className = "",
  onTabClick,
  onEditPassword,
  onRemoveSession,
}: AccountSecurityPanelProps) {
  const [tab, setTab] = React.useState("Security");

  return (
    <div data-acctsec className={`w-full rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 sm:p-8 ${className}`}>
      <h2 data-acctsec-heading className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Account</h2>

      {/* tabs */}
      <div data-acctsec-tabs className="mt-4 flex gap-6 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t}
            type="button"
            data-acctsec-tab={t}
            onClick={() => {
              setTab(t);
              onTabClick?.(t);
            }}
            className={`-mb-px border-b-2 pb-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
              tab === t
                ? "border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-50"
                : "border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
          >
            {t}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {tab === "Security" ? (
        <div data-acctsec-panel className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 p-5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-acctsec-panel-title className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Security</p>

          {/* password row */}
          <div data-acctsec-password className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Password</span>
            <span data-acctsec-password-value className="font-mono text-sm tracking-widest text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{passwordValue}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-acctsec-edit-password
              onClick={() => onEditPassword?.()}
              className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              Edit
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* sessions card */}
          <div data-acctsec-sessions className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 p-5 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <p data-acctsec-sessions-title className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{sessionsTitle}</p>
            <p data-acctsec-sessions-desc className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{sessionsDescription}</p>
            <div data-acctsec-session-list className="mt-4 space-y-2">
              {sessions.map((s) => (
                <div
                  key={s.id}
                  data-acctsec-session={s.id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-3 dark:bg-zinc-800/60"
                >
                  <p className="text-sm text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                    <span data-acctsec-session-device className="font-semibold">{s.device}</span>
                    <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"> • {s.detail}</span>
                  </p>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-acctsec-remove={s.id}
                    onClick={() => onRemoveSession?.(s)}
                    aria-label={`Remove ${s.device}`}
                    className="text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-400"
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
              <button
                type="button"
                data-acctsec-done
                className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                Done
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p data-acctsec-placeholder className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-zinc-200 p-6 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {tab} settings are not part of this demo.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\AccountSwitcher.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface Account {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  /** Avatar image URL; falls back to initials. */
  avatar?: string;
  role?: string;
  plan?: string;
}

export interface AccountSwitcherProps {
  accounts?: Account[];
  currentId?: string;
  onSwitch?: (account: Account) => void;
  onAddAccount?: () => void;
  onSignOut?: () => void;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join("");

export const AccountSwitcher: React.FC<AccountSwitcherProps> = ({
  accounts = [],
  currentId,
  onSwitch,
  onAddAccount,
  onSignOut,
  onOpenChange,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const current = accounts.find((account) => account.id === currentId) || accounts[0];

  const setOpenState = (next: boolean) => {
    setOpen(next);
    onOpenChange?.(next);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined;
    const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpenState(false);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setOpenState(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [open]);

  if (!current) return null;

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`relative inline-block text-left ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpenState(!open)}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
      >
        <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400">
          {current.avatar ? (
            <img src={current.avatar} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            initials(current.name)
          )}
        </span>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{current.name}</span>
          {current.email && (
            <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{current.email}</span>
          )}
        </span>
        <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={12} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div
          role="menu"
          aria-label="Switch account"
          className="absolute left-0 z-30 mt-1 w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        >
          <ul className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto py-1">
            {accounts.map((account) => {
              const active = account.id === current.id;
              return (
                <li key={account.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="menuitemradio"
                    aria-checked={active}
                    onClick={() => {
                      onSwitch?.(account);
                      setOpenState(false);
                    }}
                    className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
                  >
                    <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                      {account.avatar ? (
                        <img src={account.avatar} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                      ) : (
                        initials(account.name)
                      )}
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {account.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                        {[account.role, account.plan].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || account.email}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    {active && <UiIcon name="check" size={12} className="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />}
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>

          <div className="border-t border-zinc-100 py-1 dark:border-zinc-800">
            {onAddAccount && (
              <button
                type="button"
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                  onAddAccount();
                  setOpenState(false);
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <UiIcon name="plus" size={12} className="text-zinc-400" />
                Add account
              </button>
            )}
            {onSignOut && (
              <button
                type="button"
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                  onSignOut();
                  setOpenState(false);
                }}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30"
              >
                <UiIcon name="arrow-right" size={12} />
                Sign out
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AccountSwitcher;


===== FILE: react\ActivityFeed.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export type ActivityFeedKind = "event" | "comment" | "merge" | "deploy" | "flag" | "alert";

export interface ActivityEntry {
  id: string;
  kind: ActivityFeedKind;
  actor: string;
  action: string;
  target?: string;
  time: string;
  detail?: string;
}

export interface ActivityFeedProps {
  entries: ActivityEntry[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const KIND: Record<ActivityFeedKind, { icon: UiIconName; iconClass: string }> = {
  event: { icon: "sparkles", iconClass: "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300" },
  comment: { icon: "user", iconClass: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-600 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300" },
  merge: { icon: "git-branch", iconClass: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300" },
  deploy: { icon: "zap", iconClass: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300" },
  flag: { icon: "star", iconClass: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300" },
  alert: { icon: "alert-triangle", iconClass: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300" },
};

export const ActivityFeed: React.FC<ActivityFeedProps> = ({ entries, title, className = "" }) => {
  return (
    <section className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {title && (
        <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</h3>
      )}
      <ol className="relative space-y-3.5 before:absolute before:bottom-2 before:left-[13px] before:top-2 before:w-px before:bg-zinc-100 dark:before:bg-zinc-800">
        {entries.map((entry) => {
          const kind = KIND[entry.kind] ?? KIND.event;
          return (
            <li key={entry.id} className="relative flex items-start gap-3">
              <span className={`z-10 flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900 ${kind.iconClass}`}>
                <UiIcon name={kind.icon} size={12} />
              </span>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{entry.actor}</span>{" "}
                  {entry.action}
                  {entry.target && (
                    <span className="ml-1 rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      {entry.target}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </p>
                {entry.detail && (
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10.5px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{entry.detail}</p>
                )}
              </div>
              <time className="shrink-0 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{entry.time}</time>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </section>
  );
};

export default ActivityFeed;

import React from "react";

export interface AddonOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  price?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  contactInstead?: boolean;
}

export interface AddonPickerProps {
  title?: string;
  options: AddonOption[];
  selectedIds?: string[];
  onChange?: (selectedIds: string[]) => void;
  totalLabel?: string;
  totalText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const CHECK_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m4.5 10.5 3.5 3.5 7.5-8" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * AddonPicker - User Interviews/Attio style add-on selector: checkbox rows with
 * price (or "Let's talk" contact link) and a running total row.
 */
export default function AddonPicker({
  title = "Add-ons",
  options,
  selectedIds = [],
  onChange,
  totalLabel = "Estimated total",
  totalText,
  className = "",
}: AddonPickerProps) {
  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    const next = selectedIds.includes(id) ? selectedIds.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...selectedIds, id];
    onChange?.(next);
  };
  return (
    <div data-addon-picker className={`rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
      <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {options.map((option) => {
          const checked = selectedIds.includes(option.id);
          return (
            <label
              key={option.id}
              data-addon-row={option.id}
              className={`flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-md border px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors ${
                checked
                  ? "border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/50"
                  : "border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
              } ${option.disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" : ""}`}
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span
                  data-addon-check
                  aria-checked={checked}
                  role="checkbox"
                  className={`flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors ${
                    checked
                      ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                      : "border-zinc-300 bg-white text-transparent dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800"
                  }`}
                >
                  {CHECK_SVG}
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{option.label}</span>
              </span>
              {option.contactInstead ? (
                <a href="#" data-addon-contact className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">Let's talk</a>
              ) : (
                <span data-addon-price className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{option.price}</span>
              )}
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="sr-only"
                checked={checked}
                disabled={option.disabled}
                onChange={() => !option.disabled && toggle(option.id)}
              />
            </label>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {totalText && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-sm dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span className="text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{totalLabel}</span>
          <span data-addon-total className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{totalText}</span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export interface AgentBuilderCardProps {

const NODE_STYLE: Record<string, { icon: string; chip: string }> = {
  trigger: { icon: "⚡", chip: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300" },

===== FILE: react\AgentEnvVarEditor.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface EnvVar {
  key: string;
  value: string;
  /** Secret values render masked with a reveal toggle */
  secret?: boolean;
}

export interface AgentEnvVarEditorProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  vars: EnvVar[];
  /** Called with the full list after any add/edit/delete */
  onChange?: (vars: EnvVar[]) => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * AgentEnvVarEditor - agent environment variable editor: key/value rows with
 * secret masking + reveal toggle, per-row delete and an add-row input.
 */
export default function AgentEnvVarEditor({
  title = "Environment variables",
  description = "Injected into every agent run. Secret values are masked.",
  vars,
  onChange,
  className = "",
}: AgentEnvVarEditorProps) {
  const [rows, setRows] = React.useState<EnvVar[]>(vars);
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [newKey, setNewKey] = React.useState("");
  const [newValue, setNewValue] = React.useState("");
  const [newSecret, setNewSecret] = React.useState(false);

  const commit = (next: EnvVar[]) => {
    setRows(next);
    onChange?.(next);
  };

  const update = (i: number, patch: Partial<EnvVar>) => {
    commit(rows.map((row, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...row, ...patch } : row)));
  };

  const remove = (i: number) => {
    commit(rows.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i));
  };

  const add = () => {
    const key = newKey.trim();
    if (!key) return;
    commit([...rows, { key, value: newValue, secret: newSecret }]);
    setNewKey("");
    setNewValue("");
    setNewSecret(false);
  };

  return (
    <div data-env-editor className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p data-env-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
      <p data-env-description className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>

      <div data-env-rows className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {rows.map((row, i) => {
          const revealedRow = !!revealed[row.key];
          return (
            <div key={i} data-env-row={row.key} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                data-env-key
                value={row.key}
                readOnly
                aria-label="Variable name"
                className="w-44 shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200"
              />
              <input
                data-env-value
                type={row.secret && !revealedRow ? "password" : "text"}
                value={row.value}
                onChange={(e) => update(i, { value: e.target.value })}
                aria-label="Variable value"
                className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
              />
              {row.secret && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-env-reveal
                  aria-pressed={revealedRow}
                  title={revealedRow ? "Hide value" : "Reveal value"}
                  onClick={() => setRevealed((r) => ({ ...r, [row.key]: !revealedRow }))}
                  className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                >
                  {revealedRow ? "Hide" : "Show"}
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                data-env-delete
                title="Delete variable"
                onClick={() => remove(i)}
                className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-transparent px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-400 hover:border-rose-200 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:border-rose-900 dark:hover:text-rose-400"
              >
                Delete
              </button>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {rows.length === 0 && (
          <p data-env-empty className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500">
            No environment variables yet
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div data-env-add className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <input
          data-env-new-key
          value={newKey}
          onChange={(e) => setNewKey(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="KEY_NAME"
          aria-label="New variable name"
          className="w-44 shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
        />
        <input
          data-env-new-value
          value={newValue}
          onChange={(e) => setNewValue(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="value"
          aria-label="New variable value"
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
        />
        <label data-env-new-secret className="flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={newSecret} onChange={(e) => setNewSecret(e.target.checked)} className="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300" />
          secret
        </label>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-env-add-btn
          onClick={add}
          disabled={!newKey.trim()}
          className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          Add
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: react\AgentGuardrailViolationCard.tsx =====

import React, { useState } from "react";

export type ViolationSeverity = "low" | "medium" | "high";

export interface AgentGuardrailViolationCardProps {
  /** rule that was violated, e.g. "PII disclosure" */
  rule: string;
  severity?: ViolationSeverity;
  /** agent / run that triggered it */
  runId?: string;
  time?: string;
  /** truncated input that triggered the violation */
  input?: string;
  /** matched snippet highlighted inside the input */
  match?: string;
  /** policy reference, e.g. "policy/security#pii-1" */
  policyRef?: string;
  proceedLabel?: string;
  blockLabel?: string;
  onProceed?: () => void;
  onBlock?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const SEVERITY_STYLE: Record<ViolationSeverity, { badge: string; label: string }> = {
  low: {
    badge: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400",
    label: "Low severity",
  },
  medium: {
    badge: "bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-500/10 dark:text-orange-400",
    label: "Medium severity",
  },
  high: {
    badge: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400",
    label: "High severity",
  },
};

export default function AgentGuardrailViolationCard({
  rule,
  severity = "medium",
  runId,
  time,
  input,
  match,
  policyRef,
  proceedLabel = "Proceed anyway",
  blockLabel = "Block run",
  onProceed,
  onBlock,
  className = "",
}: AgentGuardrailViolationCardProps) {
  const [resolved, setResolved] = useState<null | "proceeded" | "blocked">(null);
  const sev = SEVERITY_STYLE[severity];

  const act = (kind: "proceeded" | "blocked") => {
    setResolved(kind);
    (kind === "proceeded" ? onProceed : onBlock)?.();
  };

  const renderInput = () => {
    if (!input) return null;
    if (match && input.includes(match)) {
      const idx = input.indexOf(match);
      return (
        <>
          {input.slice(0, idx)}
          <mark data-violation-match className="rounded bg-rose-100 px-0.5 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/20 dark:text-rose-300">
            {match}
          </mark>
          {input.slice(idx + match.length)}
        </>
      );
    }
    return input;
  };

  return (
    <div
      data-guardrail-violation
      role="alert"
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <span data-violation-rule className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{rule}</span>
        <span data-violation-severity className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${sev.badge}`}>
          {sev.label}
        </span>
        {time ? <span data-violation-time className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{time}</span> : null}
      </div>

      {runId ? (
        <p className="mt-1.5">
          <code data-violation-run className="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
            {runId}
          </code>
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {input ? (
        <div data-violation-input className="mt-2.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-300">
          {renderInput()}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {policyRef ? (
        <p data-violation-policy className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          Policy: <code className="font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{policyRef}</code>
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {resolved ? (
        <p data-violation-resolved className="mt-3 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {resolved === "blocked" ? "Run blocked by reviewer." : "Marked reviewed — proceeding anyway."}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-violation-block
            onClick={() => act("blocked")}
            className="rounded-md bg-rose-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-rose-500"
          >
            {blockLabel}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-violation-proceed
            onClick={() => act("proceeded")}
            className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
          >
            {proceedLabel}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";

export type FallbackHealth = "healthy" | "degraded" | "down";

export interface FallbackEntry {

  model: string;

  health?: FallbackHealth;
  /** when this fallback takes over, e.g. "on rate limit" or "on error 5xx" */

  latency?: string;
}

export interface AgentModelFallbackListProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  entries?: FallbackEntry[];
  /** id of the currently primary entry */
  primaryId?: string;
  onReorder?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const HEALTH_DOT: Record<FallbackHealth, string> = {
  healthy: "bg-emerald-500",
  degraded: "bg-amber-500",
  down: "bg-rose-500",
};

const HEALTH_TEXT: Record<FallbackHealth, string> = {
  healthy: "Healthy",
  degraded: "Degraded",
  down: "Down",
};

export default function AgentModelFallbackList({
  title = "Model fallback chain",
  description = "Requests try the primary model first, then walk down the chain when a fallback condition triggers.",
  entries = [],
  primaryId,
  onReorder,
  className = "",
}: AgentModelFallbackListProps) {
  const [ids, setIds] = useState<string[]>(entries.map((e) => e.id));
  const [moveFlash, setMoveFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const ordered = ids
    .map((id) => entries.find((e) => e.id === id))
    .filter((e): e is FallbackEntry => Boolean(e));
  const activePrimary = primaryId ?? ordered[0]?.id;

  const move = (id: string, dir: -1 | 1) => {
    const idx = ids.indexOf(id);
    const next = idx + dir;
    if (idx < 0 || next < 0 || next >= ids.length) return;
    const list = [...ids];
    list.splice(idx, 1);
    list.splice(next, 0, id);
    setIds(list);
    setMoveFlash(id);
    window.setTimeout(() => setMoveFlash(null), 1200);
    onReorder?.(list);
  };

  return (
    <div data-fallback-list className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p data-fallback-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
      <p data-fallback-description className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>

      <div data-fallback-rows className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {ordered.map((entry, i) => {
          const isPrimary = entry.id === activePrimary;
          const health = entry.health ?? "healthy";
          return (
            <div
              key={entry.id}
              data-fallback-row={entry.id}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 ${
                isPrimary
                  ? "border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500/30 dark:bg-indigo-500/10"
                  : "border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700"
              }`}
            >
              <span data-fallback-rank className="w-4 text-center font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {i + 1}
              </span>
              <span className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${HEALTH_DOT[health]}`} title={HEALTH_TEXT[health]} />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span data-fallback-model className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{entry.model}</span>
                  {isPrimary ? (
                    <span data-fallback-primary className="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                      Primary
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                  {moveFlash === entry.id ? (
                    <span data-fallback-moved className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">order updated</span>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {entry.provider ? `${entry.provider} · ` : ""}
                  {entry.condition ?? "fallback"}
                  {entry.latency ? ` · ${entry.latency}` : ""}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-fallback-up
                  title="Promote"
                  aria-label={`Promote ${entry.model}`}
                  disabled={i === 0}
                  onClick={() => move(entry.id, -1)}
                  className="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1.5 text-[10px] leading-4 text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-30 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                >
                  ↑
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-fallback-down
                  title="Demote"
                  aria-label={`Demote ${entry.model}`}
                  disabled={i === ordered.length - 1}
                  onClick={() => move(entry.id, 1)}
                  className="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1.5 text-[10px] leading-4 text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-30 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                >
                  ↓
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {ordered.length === 0 ? (
          <p data-fallback-empty className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500">
            No models in the fallback chain
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface AgentNotificationItem {
  id: string;
  /** Notification kind controls the status dot color */
  kind: "started" | "completed" | "failed" | "info";
  /** Main title, e.g. the task/question being run */
  title: string;
  /** Highlighted tail appended to the title in the kind's tone color */
  statusText?: string;
  /** Secondary caption line, e.g. "From your manual entry" */
  caption?: string;
  /** Relative time label, e.g. "30 minutes ago" */
  time: string;
  /** Unread marker */
  unread?: boolean;
}

export interface AgentNotificationFeedProps {
  title?: string;
  items: AgentNotificationItem[];
  onOpen?: (item: AgentNotificationItem) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const KIND_DOT: Record<string, string> = {
  started: "bg-sky-500",
  completed: "bg-emerald-500",
  failed: "bg-rose-500",
  info: "bg-zinc-400",
};

const KIND_TEXT: Record<string, string> = {
  started: "text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400",
  completed: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
  failed: "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400",
  info: "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400",
};

/**
 * AgentNotificationFeed - agent run/training notification feed: status-dot
 * rows with title + highlighted status text, caption line, relative time and
 * unread markers, in the Delphi/Jira notifications style.
 */
export default function AgentNotificationFeed({
  title = "Notifications",
  items,
  onOpen,
  className = "",
}: AgentNotificationFeedProps) {
  const [read, setRead] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const isUnread = (item: AgentNotificationItem) => !!item.unread && !read[item.id];
  const unreadCount = items.filter(isUnread).length;

  return (
    <div data-agent-feed className={`overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p data-agent-feed-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        {unreadCount > 0 && (
          <span data-agent-feed-count className="rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
            {unreadCount} new
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div data-agent-feed-list className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const unread = isUnread(item);
          return (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              type="button"
              data-agent-feed-item={item.id}
              data-unread={unread ? "true" : "false"}
              onClick={() => { setRead((r) => ({ ...r, [item.id]: true })); onOpen?.(item); }}
              className="flex w-full items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50"
            >
              <span aria-hidden="true" className={`mt-1.5 h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${unread ? KIND_DOT[item.kind] || KIND_DOT.info : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600"}`}></span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                  {item.title}
                  {item.statusText && <span className={`font-semibold ${KIND_TEXT[item.kind] || KIND_TEXT.info}`}> {item.statusText}</span>}
                </span>
                {item.caption && <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{item.caption}</span>}
              </span>
              <span className="shrink-0 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{item.time}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
        {items.length === 0 && (
          <p data-agent-feed-empty className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No notifications yet</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\AgentRunLog.tsx =====

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export type AgentRunStatus = "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error";

export interface AgentRunStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  status: AgentRunStatus;
  detail?: string;
  durationMs?: number;
}

export interface AgentRunLogProps {
  steps: AgentRunStep[];
  title?: string;
  autoExpandRunning?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const statusIcon = (status: AgentRunStatus) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "running":
      return <UiIcon name="loader" size={14} className="animate-spin text-indigo-500" />;
    case "done":
      return <UiIcon name="check-circle" size={14} className="text-emerald-500" />;
    case "error":
      return <UiIcon name="circle-x" size={14} className="text-red-500" />;
    default:
      return <UiIcon name="clock" size={14} className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" />;
  }
};

const formatDuration = (ms?: number) => {
  if (typeof ms !== "number") return "";
  return ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`;
};

export const AgentRunLog: React.FC<AgentRunLogProps> = ({
  steps,
  title = "Execution log",
  autoExpandRunning = true,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Set<string>>(
    () => new Set(autoExpandRunning ? steps.filter((s) => s.status === "running" && s.detail).map((s) => s.id) : [])
  );

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    setExpanded((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
        <UiIcon name="terminal" size={14} className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" />
        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {steps.filter((s) => s.status === "done").length}/{steps.length}
        </span>
      </div>

      <ol className="px-4 py-3">
        {steps.map((step, index) => {
          const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
          const isOpen = expanded.has(step.id);
          return (
            <li key={step.id} className="relative pl-6">
              {!isLast && (
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className="absolute left-[6px] top-5 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                />
              )}
              <span className="absolute left-0 top-1">{statusIcon(step.status)}</span>

              <div className="pb-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => step.detail && toggle(step.id)}
                  aria-expanded={step.detail ? isOpen : undefined}
                  className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left ${
                    step.detail ? "cursor-pointer" : "cursor-default"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span
                    className={`text-xs ${
                      step.status === "pending"
                        ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
                        : "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {step.label}
                  </span>
                  {step.durationMs !== undefined && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                      {formatDuration(step.durationMs)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {step.detail && (
                    <span className="ml-auto text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                      <UiIcon name={isOpen ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down"} size={12} />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </button>

                {step.detail && isOpen && (
                  <pre className="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">
                    {step.detail}
                  </pre>
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AgentRunLog;


===== FILE: react\AgentScheduleEditor.tsx =====

import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface ScheduleFrequency {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** cron-like expression shown in the mono field when selected */
  expression: string;
}

export interface AgentScheduleEditorProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  frequencies?: ScheduleFrequency[];
  /** index into frequencies of the active one */
  activeId?: string;
  time?: string;
  nextRun?: string;
  timezone?: string;
  onSave?: (freq: ScheduleFrequency, time: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_FREQUENCIES: ScheduleFrequency[] = [
  { id: "hourly", label: "Every hour", expression: "0 * * * *" },
  { id: "daily", label: "Daily", expression: "0 9 * * *" },
  { id: "weekly", label: "Weekly", expression: "0 9 * * 1" },
];

export default function AgentScheduleEditor({
  title = "Run schedule",
  description = "Configure when the agent runs automatically. The cron expression is derived from your selection.",
  frequencies = DEFAULT_FREQUENCIES,
  activeId,
  time = "09:00",
  nextRun,
  timezone,
  onSave,
  className = "",
}: AgentScheduleEditorProps) {
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(activeId ?? frequencies[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [timeValue, setTimeValue] = useState(time);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);

  const selected = frequencies.find((f) => f.id === selectedId) ?? frequencies[0];

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    setSaved(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 1600);
    onSave?.(selected, timeValue);
  };

  return (
    <div data-schedule-editor className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p data-schedule-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
      <p data-schedule-description className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>

      <div data-schedule-frequencies className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
        {frequencies.map((f) => (
          <button
            key={f.id}
            type="button"
            data-schedule-frequency={f.id}
            aria-pressed={f.id === selectedId}
            onClick={() => setSelectedId(f.id)}
            className={
              f.id === selectedId
                ? "rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500"
                : "rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }
          >
            {f.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <label data-schedule-time-wrap className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Run at</span>
          <input
            data-schedule-time
            type="time"
            value={timeValue}
            onChange={(e) => setTimeValue(e.target.value)}
            className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
          />
        </label>
        {timezone ? (
          <span data-schedule-timezone className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{timezone}</span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
        <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Cron</span>
        <code data-schedule-cron className="ml-2 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{selected?.expression ?? "—"}</code>
        <span className="mx-2 text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">|</span>
        <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Next run</span>
        <span data-schedule-next className="ml-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{nextRun ?? "—"}</span>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
        {saved ? (
          <span data-schedule-saved className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">Schedule saved</span>
        ) : null}
        <button
          type="button"
          data-schedule-save
          onClick={handleSave}
          className="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500"
        >
          Save schedule
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

            {status}
          </span>
          <span data-agent-session-duration className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">⏱ {duration}</span>
          <span data-agent-session-steps-count className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">≡ {stepsCount} steps</span>
        </div>
        <div data-agent-session-strip className="mt-3 flex h-2 items-stretch gap-0.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full">

                  : s.kind === "reason"

                onClick={() => onStepClick?.(step)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <span data-agent-step-badge={step.kind} className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold tracking-wide ${KIND_STYLES[step.kind].badge}`}>
                  {step.kind}
                </span>
                <span data-agent-step-label className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{step.label}</span>

          ))}
        </ol>
        <div data-agent-requests className="divide-y divide-zinc-50 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">
          {requests.map((req) => (
            <div key={req.id} data-agent-request={req.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2">
              <span className="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-[9px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">
                ⌾
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span data-agent-request-url className="block truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{req.url}</span>
                <span data-agent-request-status className={`block truncate text-[10px] ${(req.ok ?? true) ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-red-500 dark:text-red-400"}`}>
                  {req.status}
                  {req.method ? ` · ${req.method}` : ""}
                </span>
              </span>
              <span data-agent-request-duration className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{req.duration}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

===== FILE: react\AgentStepTimeline.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AgentStep {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error";
  duration?: string;
}

export interface AgentStepTimelineProps {
  steps: AgentStep[];
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_META: Record<AgentStep["status"], { icon: UiIconName; cls: string; pulse?: boolean }> = {
  pending: { icon: "clock", cls: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" },
  running: { icon: "loader", cls: "text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60", pulse: true },
  done: { icon: "check-circle", cls: "text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60" },
  error: { icon: "circle-x", cls: "text-rose-500 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60" },
};

export const AgentStepTimeline: React.FC<AgentStepTimelineProps> = ({ steps = [], className = "" }) => {
  if (steps.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <ol className={`relative space-y-4 ${className}`}>
      {steps.map((step, i) => {
        const meta = STATUS_META[step.status] || STATUS_META.pending;
        const isLast = i === steps.length - 1;
        return (
          <li key={step.id} className="relative flex gap-3">
            {!isLast && (
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-[-16px] w-px ${
                  step.status === "done" ? "bg-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-800" : "bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                }`}
              />
            )}
            <span className={`relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full shrink-0 ${meta.cls}`}>
              <UiIcon name={meta.icon} size={15} className={meta.pulse ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
            </span>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span
                  className={`text-sm font-medium ${
                    meta === STATUS_META.pending ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
                  }`}
                >
                  {step.title}
                </span>
                {step.duration && <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">{step.duration}</span>}
              </div>
              {step.description && (
                <div className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{step.description}</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
};
export default AgentStepTimeline;


===== FILE: react\AgentTaskChecklist.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AgentTaskItem {
  id: string | number;
  label: string;
  status: "pending" | "active" | "done";
}

export interface AgentTaskChecklistProps {
  items: AgentTaskItem[];
  title?: string;
  onToggle?: (id: string | number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_ICON: Record<AgentTaskItem["status"], { icon: UiIconName; cls: string }> = {
  pending: { icon: "square", cls: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600" },
  active: { icon: "loader", cls: "text-indigo-500 animate-spin" },
  done: { icon: "check-circle", cls: "text-emerald-500" },
};

export const AgentTaskChecklist: React.FC<AgentTaskChecklistProps> = ({
  items = [],
  title = "Tasks",
  onToggle,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const doneCount = items.filter((i) => i.status === "done").length;

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
        <UiIcon name="layers" size={14} className="text-zinc-400" />
        {title}
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">
          {doneCount}/{items.length}
        </span>
      </div>
      <ul className="p-1.5 space-y-0.5">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const meta = STATUS_ICON[item.status] || STATUS_ICON.pending;
          const isDone = item.status === "done";
          return (
            <li key={item.id}>
              <div
                role={onToggle ? "button" : undefined}
                tabIndex={onToggle ? 0 : undefined}
                onClick={onToggle ? () => onToggle(item.id) : undefined}
                onKeyDown={
                  onToggle
                    ? (e) => {
                        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          onToggle(item.id);
                        }
                      }
                    : undefined
                }
                className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors ${
                  onToggle ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" : ""
                } ${isDone ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"}`}
              >
                <UiIcon name={meta.icon} size={15} className={`shrink-0 ${meta.cls}`} />
                <span className={`flex-1 min-w-0 truncate ${isDone ? "line-through" : ""}`}>{item.label}</span>
              </div>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
};
export default AgentTaskChecklist;

import React from "react";

export interface ProgressStep {
  label: string;
  state: "done" | "active" | "pending";
  substeps?: string[];
}

export interface AgentTaskProgressProps {
  title?: string;
  contextLabel?: string;
  contextText?: string;
  hint?: string;
  steps?: ProgressStep[];
  refineLabel?: string;
  nextLabel?: string;
  feedbackLabel?: string;
  onRefine?: () => void;
  onNext?: () => void;
}

/**
 * AgentTaskProgress - long-running AI job card with stacked step states and substep rail.
 */
export default function AgentTaskProgress({
  title,
  contextLabel,
  contextText,
  hint = "This may take a few minutes, you can come back later.",
  steps = [],
  refineLabel = "Refine",
  nextLabel = "Next",
  feedbackLabel = "Send feedback",
  onRefine,
  onNext,
}: AgentTaskProgressProps) {
  const stepIcon = (state: ProgressStep["state"]) => {
    if (state === "done")
      return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          <path d="M8 5v14l11-7z" />
        </svg>
      );
    if (state === "active")
      return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 animate-spin text-indigo-500">
          <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" />
        </svg>
      );
    return (
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
        <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" />
      </svg>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div data-agent-task-progress className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      {title ? <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p> : null}
      {contextText ? (
        <div className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          {contextLabel ? <p className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{contextLabel}</p> : null}
          <p className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{contextText}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {hint ? <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{hint}</p> : null}

      <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {steps.map((step, index) => (
          <li key={index} data-task-step={index} data-task-state={step.state} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-700">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {stepIcon(step.state)}
              {step.label}
            </div>
            {step.state === "active" && step.substeps?.length ? (
              <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1 border-l-2 border-zinc-200 pl-3 dark:border-zinc-700" data-task-substeps>
                {step.substeps.map((substep) => (
                  <li key={substep} className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {substep}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <a href="#" data-task-feedback className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">
          {feedbackLabel}
        </a>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button type="button" data-task-refine onClick={() => onRefine?.()} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            {refineLabel}
          </button>
          <button type="button" data-task-next onClick={() => onNext?.()} className="rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">
            {nextLabel}
          </button>
        </div>

===== FILE: react\AgentWorkspaceSettings.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface AgentSettingToggle {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  enabled: boolean;
}

export interface AgentSettingsSection {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  toggles: AgentSettingToggle[];
}

export interface AgentWorkspaceSettingsProps {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  tabs?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  sections: AgentSettingsSection[];
  onToggle?: (toggle: AgentSettingToggle, enabled: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * AgentWorkspaceSettings - agent workspace settings page body: optional
 * section tabs, titled groups with description and description-led toggle
 * rows (Uxcel/Contra settings style).
 */
export default function AgentWorkspaceSettings({
  title = "Settings",
  subtitle = "Manage and update your agent workspace.",
  tabs,
  sections,
  onToggle,
  className = "",
}: AgentWorkspaceSettingsProps) {
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(sections.flatMap((s) => s.toggles.map((t) => [t.id, t.enabled])))
  );

  const flip = (toggle: AgentSettingToggle) => {
    const next = !enabled[toggle.id];
    setEnabled((e) => ({ ...e, [toggle.id]: next }));
    onToggle?.(toggle, next);
  };

  return (
    <div data-agent-settings className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p data-agent-settings-title className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
      <p data-agent-settings-subtitle className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{subtitle}</p>

      {tabs && tabs.length > 0 && (
        <div data-agent-settings-tabs className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {tabs.map((tab, i) => (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              type="button"
              data-agent-settings-tab={tab.id}
              aria-selected={i === 0}
              className="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors aria-selected:border-transparent aria-selected:bg-zinc-900 aria-selected:text-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:aria-selected:bg-zinc-50 dark:aria-selected:text-zinc-900"
            >
              {tab.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div data-agent-settings-sections className="mt-5 space-y-6">
        {sections.map((section) => (
          <section key={section.id} data-agent-settings-section={section.id}>
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{section.title}</p>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {section.toggles.filter((t) => enabled[t.id]).length}/{section.toggles.length} on
              </span>
            </div>
            {section.description && <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{section.description}</p>}
            <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
              {section.toggles.map((toggle) => {
                const on = !!enabled[toggle.id];
                return (
                  <div key={toggle.id} data-agent-setting-row={toggle.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{toggle.label}</p>
                      {toggle.description && <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{toggle.description}</p>}
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      data-agent-setting-toggle
                      role="switch"
                      aria-checked={on}
                      aria-label={toggle.label}
                      onClick={() => flip(toggle)}
                      className={`relative h-5 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors ${on ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600"}`}
                    >
                      <span className={`absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all ${on ? "left-4" : "left-0.5"}`}></span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  sources = [],

  className = "",
  onPlay,
  onCopy,
  onSourceClick,
}: AiNoteAnswerProps) {

    : Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => 30 + Math.round(Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 1.7)) * 70));

        >
          ▶
        </button>
        <div data-note-answer-waveform className="flex h-6 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-[2px]" aria-hidden="true">

          </div>
