===== FILE: react\AmberEmbersBackdrop.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export interface AmberEmbersBackdropProps {
  /** Animation speed factor, default 1 */
  speed?: number;
  /** Number of floating embers, default 72 */
  density?: number;
  /** Base (top) CSS color, default #0d0d0d */
  baseColor?: string;
  /** Warm bloom / lower-field CSS color, default #6b5947 */
  bloomColor?: string;
  /** Ember glow CSS color, default #e6b745 */
  emberColor?: string;
  /** Pointer parallax on the bloom, default false */
  interactive?: boolean;
  /** Freeze animation on a single frame, default false */
  paused?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const numOr = (v: number | undefined, fallback: number, min: number, max: number) =>
  Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v as number)) : fallback;

const safeColor = (v: string | undefined, fallback: string) => {
  const s = (v ?? "").trim();
  if (/^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(s) || /^rgba?\(\s*[\d.%\s,]+\)$/i.test(s)) return s;
  return fallback;
};

const hexToRgb = (hex: string): [number, number, number] => {
  let h = hex.replace("#", "");
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("");
  const n = Number.parseInt(h, 16);
  return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
};

type Ember = {
  x: number; y: number; r: number; rise: number; sway: number;
  swayAmp: number; phase: number; twinkle: number; alpha: number;
};

const rand = (a: number, b: number) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

const AmberEmbersBackdrop: React.FC<AmberEmbersBackdropProps> = ({
  speed = 1,
  density = 72,
  baseColor = "#0d0d0d",
  bloomColor = "#6b5947",
  emberColor = "#e6b745",
  interactive = false,
  paused = false,
  className = "",
  style,
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const spd = numOr(speed, 1, 0, 4);
    const count = Math.round(numOr(density, 72, 1, 220));
    const base = safeColor(baseColor, "#0d0d0d");
    const bloom = safeColor(bloomColor, "#6b5947");
    const ember = safeColor(emberColor, "#e6b745");

    const sprite = document.createElement("canvas");
    const SP = 64;
    sprite.width = SP;
    sprite.height = SP;
    const sctx = sprite.getContext("2d");
    if (!sctx) return;
    const [er, eg, eb] = hexToRgb(ember);
    const sg = sctx.createRadialGradient(SP / 2, SP / 2, 0, SP / 2, SP / 2, SP / 2);
    sg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},1)`);
    sg.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},0.55)`);
    sg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},0)`);
    sctx.fillStyle = sg;
    sctx.fillRect(0, 0, SP, SP);

    const embers: Ember[] = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
      x: rand(0, 1), y: rand(-0.1, 1.1), r: rand(1.5, 6.5),
      rise: rand(0.008, 0.032), sway: rand(0.002, 0.012),
      swayAmp: rand(0.004, 0.03), phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      twinkle: rand(0.5, 1.8), alpha: rand(0.35, 0.95),
    }));

    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    let W = 1;
    let H = 1;
    const pointer = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, tx: 0.5, ty: 0.5 };

    const resize = () => {
      W = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth) * dpr));
      H = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight) * dpr));
      if (canvas.width !== W || canvas.height !== H) {
        canvas.width = W;
        canvas.height = H;
      }
    };

    const drawField = (t: number) => {
      const field = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      field.addColorStop(0, base);
      field.addColorStop(0.55, "#23241b");
      field.addColorStop(1, bloom);
      ctx.fillStyle = field;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      const bx = (0.5 + (pointer.x - 0.5) * 0.12) * W;
      const by = (0.92 + (pointer.y - 0.5) * 0.06) * H;
      const [br, bg, bb] = hexToRgb(bloom);
      const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, 0, bx, by, Math.max(W, H) * 0.8);
      glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.55)`);
      glow.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.18)`);
      glow.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0)`);
      ctx.fillStyle = glow;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      for (const e of embers) {
        const ex = (e.x + Math.sin(t * e.sway + e.phase) * e.swayAmp) * W;
        const ey = e.y * H;
        const tw = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * e.twinkle + e.phase);
        const size = e.r * dpr * 6;
        ctx.globalAlpha = e.alpha * tw;
        ctx.drawImage(sprite, ex - size / 2, ey - size / 2, size, size);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

      const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        W / 2, H * 0.45, Math.min(W, H) * 0.2,
        W / 2, H * 0.45, Math.max(W, H) * 0.78,
      );
      vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.62)");
      ctx.fillStyle = vg;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    };

    const reduced =
      typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
        ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
        : false;

    let raf = 0;
    let last = 0;
    let t = 0;
    let stopped = paused;

    const frame = (now: number) => {
      if (stopped) return;
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
      last = now;
      t += dt * spd;
      pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.05;
      pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.05;
      for (const e of embers) {
        e.y -= e.rise * dt * spd;
        if (e.y < -0.1) { e.y = 1.1; e.x = Math.random(); }
      }
      drawField(t);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };

    const start = () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      last = performance.now();
      if (reduced) drawField(t);
      else { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
    };
    const stop = () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; };
    const onVisibility = () => { if (document.hidden) stop(); else start(); };
    const onResize = () => { resize(); if (stopped || reduced) drawField(t); };
    const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!interactive) return;
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      pointer.tx = (e.clientX - rect.left) / (rect.width || 1);
      pointer.ty = (e.clientY - rect.top) / (rect.height || 1);
    };

    resize();
    if (interactive) window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    start();

    return () => {
      stop();
      if (interactive) window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    };
  }, [speed, density, baseColor, bloomColor, emberColor, interactive, paused]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={`fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0 ${className}`}
      style={style}
    />
  );
};

export default AmberEmbersBackdrop;


===== FILE: react\AnimatedCounter.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export interface AnimatedCounterProps {
  /** Target final value to count up to */
  target: number;
  /** Initial starting value, default 0 */
  start?: number;
  /** Duration in milliseconds, default 1500 */
  duration?: number;
  /** Delay in milliseconds before animation starts, default 0 */
  delay?: number;
  /** Suffix string attached to the number (e.g. "+", "%", "k") */
  suffix?: string;
  /** Prefix string attached to the number (e.g. "$", "¥") */
  prefix?: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const easeOutCubic = (t: number) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

export const AnimatedCounter: React.FC<AnimatedCounterProps> = ({
  target,
  start = 0,
  duration = 1500,
  delay = 0,
  suffix = "",
  prefix = "",
  className = "",
  style,
}) => {
  const [displayValue, setDisplayValue] = useState<number>(start);
  const elRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement | null>(null);
  const animatedRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = elRef.current;
    if (!el || animatedRef.current) return;

    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      setDisplayValue(target);
      animatedRef.current = true;
      return;
    }

    // Respect prefers-reduced-motion: jump straight to the final value.
    if (
      typeof window.matchMedia === "function" &&
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
    ) {
      setDisplayValue(target);
      animatedRef.current = true;
      return;
    }

    let rafId = 0;
    let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting || animatedRef.current) return;
          animatedRef.current = true;
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);

          timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
            const startTime = performance.now();
            const range = target - start;

            const tick = (now: number) => {
              const elapsed = now - startTime;
              const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, elapsed / duration));
              const current = Math.round(start + easeOutCubic(progress) * range);
              setDisplayValue(current);

              if (progress < 1) {
                rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
              } else {
                setDisplayValue(target);
              }
            };

            rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          }, delay);
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.2 }
    );

    observer.observe(el);

    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, [target, start, duration, delay]);

  return (
    <span
      ref={elRef}
      className={`font-mono tabular-nums select-none ${className}`}
      style={style}
    >
      {prefix}
      {displayValue}
      {suffix}
    </span>
  );
};

===== FILE: react\ApiReferenceViewer.tsx =====

/**
 * ApiReferenceViewer - API reference section: method-badge endpoint header,
 * query parameter definitions with type/meta/description rows, collapsible
 * responses list, and a right code panel with language select, sample
 * request and highlighted JSON response
 * (GitBook API Reference pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface ApiParam {
  name: string;
  type: string;
  meta?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  description: string;
}

export interface ApiResponse {
  status: string;
  tone?: "success" | "error" | "warning";
  label: string;
  schema: string;
  body: string;
}

export interface ApiLanguage {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  sample: string;
}

export interface ApiReferenceViewerProps {
  title?: string;
  method?: string;
  endpoint?: string;
  paramsTitle?: string;
  params?: ApiParam[];
  responsesTitle?: string;
  responses?: ApiResponse[];
  languages?: ApiLanguage[];
  activeLanguageId?: string;
  responseTitle?: string;
  className?: string;
  onParamClick?: (param: ApiParam) => void;
  onLanguageChange?: (language: ApiLanguage) => void;
}

const METHOD_STYLES: Record<string, string> = {
  GET: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300",
  POST: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/70 dark:text-sky-300",
  PUT: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300",
  PATCH: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/70 dark:text-violet-300",
  DELETE: "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/70 dark:text-red-300",
};

const TONE_STYLES: Record<string, string> = {
  success: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300",
  error: "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/70 dark:text-red-300",
  warning: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300",
};

export default function ApiReferenceViewer({
  title = "List all pets",
  method = "GET",
  endpoint = "https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets",
  paramsTitle = "Query parameters",
  params = [
    { name: "limit", type: "integer", meta: "max: 100", required: false, description: "Max items to return (100 default)" },
    { name: "status", type: "string", meta: "enum", required: false, description: "Filter by pet status: available, pending, sold" },
  ],
  responsesTitle = "Responses",
  responses = [
    {
      status: "200",
      tone: "success",
      label: "A paged array of pets",
      schema: "Response object[]",
      body: '[\n  {\n    "id": 1,\n    "name": "Fluffy",\n    "tag": "dog",\n    "status": "available"\n  }\n]',
    },
    {
      status: "404",
      tone: "error",
      label: "Pets not found",
      schema: "Error object",
      body: '{\n  "error": "not_found",\n  "message": "No pets matched the query."\n}',
    },
  ],
  languages = [
    { id: "cli", label: "CLI", sample: "curl -L https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets" },
    { id: "js", label: "JS", sample: 'fetch("https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets")' },
  ],
  activeLanguageId = "cli",
  responseTitle = "A paged array of pets",
  className = "",
  onParamClick,
  onLanguageChange,
}: ApiReferenceViewerProps) {
  const [openStatuses, setOpenStatuses] = React.useState<string[]>([responses[0]?.status ?? ""]);
  const [activeLang, setActiveLang] = React.useState(activeLanguageId);

  const toggle = (status: string) =>
    setOpenStatuses((prev) => (prev.includes(status) ? prev.filter((s) => s !== status) : [...prev, status]));

  const lang = languages.find((l) => l.id === activeLang) ?? languages[0];
  const activeResponse = responses.find((r) => r.status === (openStatuses[0] ?? "")) ?? responses[0];
  const methodCls = METHOD_STYLES[method.toUpperCase()] ?? METHOD_STYLES.GET;

  return (
    <div data-api-viewer className={`grid w-full gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2 ${className}`}>
      {/* left: definition */}
      <div data-api-definition className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <h2 data-api-title className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h2>
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
          <span data-api-method className={`rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold ${methodCls}`}>{method.toUpperCase()}</span>
          <code data-api-endpoint className="truncate font-mono text-sm text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{endpoint}</code>
        </div>

        <p data-api-params-title className="mt-6 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50">{paramsTitle}</p>
        <div data-api-params className="mt-4 space-y-4">
          {params.map((param) => (
            <button
              key={param.name}
              data-api-param={param.name}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onParamClick?.(param)}
              className="block w-full text-left"
            >
              <p className="font-mono text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {param.name} <span className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{param.type}{param.meta ? ` · ${param.meta}` : ""}</span>{" "}
                {!param.required && <span className="text-red-500">optional</span>}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{param.description}</p>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <p data-api-responses-title className="mt-6 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50">{responsesTitle}</p>
        <div data-api-responses className="mt-4 space-y-2">
          {responses.map((response) => {
            const open = openStatuses.includes(response.status);
            const toneCls = TONE_STYLES[response.tone ?? "success"] ?? TONE_STYLES.success;
            return (
              <div key={response.status} data-api-response={response.status} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <button
                  data-api-response-toggle
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggle(response.status)}
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left"
                >
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{open ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
                  <span className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-bold ${toneCls}`}>{response.status}</span>
                  <span className="text-sm text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{response.label}</span>
                </button>
                {open && (
                  <div data-api-response-schema className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    <code className="font-mono text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{response.schema}</code>
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Show properties ＋</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* right: code panel */}
      <div data-api-code-panel className="flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className={`rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold ${methodCls}`}>{method.toUpperCase()}</span>
            <code data-api-code-path className="font-mono text-sm text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">/pets</code>
          </div>
          <select
            data-api-language-select
            value={activeLang}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setActiveLang(e.target.value);
              const next = languages.find((l) => l.id === e.target.value);
              if (next) onLanguageChange?.(next);
            }}
            className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
          >
            {languages.map((l) => (
              <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>{l.label}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <pre data-api-sample className="overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-3 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 dark:text-zinc-200">{lang?.sample}</pre>
        <button data-api-test type="button" className="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">Test it ▸</button>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5">
          <span className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-bold ${TONE_STYLES.success}`}>{activeResponse?.status ?? "200"}</span>
          <span className="text-sm text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{responseTitle}</span>
        </div>
        <pre data-api-json className="flex-1 overflow-auto px-4 pb-4 font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300">{activeResponse?.body}</pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ApprovalApprover {
  initials: string;
  tone?: "indigo" | "emerald" | "rose" | "amber";
}

export interface ApprovalCardProps {
  title: string;
  approvers: ApprovalApprover[];
  approvedCount?: number;

  decision?: "approved" | "rejected" | "pending";
  note?: string;
  onRequestChange?: () => void;
  onApprove?: () => void;
  onReject?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_AVATAR: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-600",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-600",
  rose: "bg-rose-600",
  amber: "bg-amber-500",
};

const DECISION_TONE: Record<string, { icon: UiIconName; className: string }> = {
  approved: { icon: "check-circle", className: "text-emerald-600" },
  rejected: { icon: "circle-x", className: "text-rose-600" },
  pending: { icon: "clock", className: "text-zinc-400" },
};

export const ApprovalCard: React.FC<ApprovalCardProps> = ({
  title,
  approvers,
  approvedCount = 0,
  dueDate,
  decision = "pending",
  note,
  onRequestChange,
  onApprove,
  onReject,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const decisionTone = DECISION_TONE[decision] || DECISION_TONE.pending;

  return (
    <section
      data-approval-card
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <h3 className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
          <UiIcon name="check-circle" size={14} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
          <span className="truncate">{title}</span>
        </h3>
        <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">
          {approvedCount}/{approvers.length}
        </span>
      </div>

      <dl className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <dt className="w-20 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">Approvers</dt>
          <dd className="flex items-center -space-x-1">
            {approvers.map((approver, index) => (
              <span
                key={`${approver.initials}-${index}`}
                title={approver.initials}
                className={`flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-white text-[9px] font-bold text-white ring-2 ring-white dark:border-zinc-900 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${TONE_AVATAR[approver.tone || "indigo"]}`}
              >
                {approver.initials}
              </span>
            ))}
            {onRequestChange ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onRequestChange}
                aria-label="Add approver"
                className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-dashed border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600"
              >
                <UiIcon name="plus" size={11} />
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </dd>
        </div>
        {dueDate ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <dt className="w-20 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">Due date</dt>
            <dd className="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
              <UiIcon name="calendar" size={12} className="text-zinc-400" />
              {dueDate}

          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <dt className="w-20 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">Decision</dt>
          <dd
            data-approval-decision
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 font-medium capitalize ${decisionTone.className}`}
          >
            <UiIcon name={decisionTone.icon} size={12} />
            {decision}
          </dd>
        </div>
      </dl>

      {note ? (
        <p className="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {note}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {onApprove || onReject ? (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
          {onReject ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              data-approval-reject
              onClick={onReject}

  title?: string;
  code: string;
  language?: "html" | "svg" | "react" | "javascript" | string;
  isOpen?: boolean;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const ArtifactCanvas: React.FC<ArtifactCanvasProps> = ({
  title = "Artifact Preview",
  code,
  language = "html",
  isOpen = true,
  onClose,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"preview" | "code">("preview");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-full sm:w-[500px] md:w-[680px] z-40 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border-l border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl flex flex-col transition-transform duration-300 ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate max-w-[240px]">
            {title}
          </span>
          {/* Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 p-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTab("preview")}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${
                tab === "preview"
                  ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs"
                  : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
              }`}
            >
              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Preview</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTab("code")}
              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${
                tab === "code"
                  ? "bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs"
                  : "hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
              }`}
            >
              <Code2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Code</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCopy}
            className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors"
            title="Copy Code"
          >
            {copied ? (
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
            ) : (
              <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
          </button>
          {onClose && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              title="Close Panel"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Content Body */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative">
        {tab === "preview" ? (
          <iframe
            srcDoc={
              language === "svg"
                ? `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;margin:0;background:#09090b;">${code}</div>`
                : language === "html"
                ? `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script><style>body { margin: 0; padding: 1rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }</style></head><body>${code}</body></html>`
                : code
            }
            sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals"
            title="Artifact Preview Frame"
            className="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white"
          />
        ) : (
          <pre className="w-full h-full p-4 m-0 overflow-auto bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100 text-xs font-mono leading-relaxed">
            <code>{code}</code>
          </pre>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from "react";

export interface AttachmentChipProps {
  name: string;
  kind?: "pdf" | "doc" | "csv" | "image";
  size?: string;
  meta?: string;
  onRemove?: () => void;
}

const KIND_TONE: Record<string, { badge: string; glyph: string }> = {
  pdf: { badge: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300", glyph: "PDF" },
  doc: { badge: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300", glyph: "DOC" },
  csv: { badge: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300", glyph: "CSV" },
  image: { badge: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300", glyph: "IMG" },
};

/**
 * AttachmentChip - compact file chip with kind badge, size and remove button.
 */
export default function AttachmentChip({ name, kind = "doc", size, meta, onRemove }: AttachmentChipProps) {
  const tone = KIND_TONE[kind] || KIND_TONE.doc;
  return (
    <span data-attachment-chip className="inline-flex max-w-xs items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1.5 pl-2.5 pr-7 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900" title={name}>
      <span className={`flex h-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded px-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold ${tone.badge}`}>{tone.glyph}</span>
      <span className="min-w-0">
        <span className="block max-w-[160px] truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{name}</span>
        {size || meta ? <span className="block text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{[size, meta].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</span> : null}
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-attachment-remove
        aria-label={`Remove ${name}`}
        onClick={onRemove}
        className="relative -ml-5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" className="mx-auto h-2.5 w-2.5">
          <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" />
        </svg>
      </button>
    </span>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface AudioNotePlayerProps {
  title?: string;
  duration?: string;
  playing?: boolean;
  waveform?: number[];
  className?: string;
  onTogglePlay?: () => void;
}

/**
 * AudioNotePlayer - Voicenotes audio note player card: a play/pause button,
 * a waveform bar strip and the note title / duration metadata row.
 */
export default function AudioNotePlayer({
  title = "Homepage walkthrough notes",
  duration = "00:47",
  playing = false,
  waveform = [],
  className = "",
  onTogglePlay,
}: AudioNotePlayerProps) {
  const bars = waveform.length
    ? waveform
    : Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => 25 + Math.round(Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 1.3)) * 75));
  return (
    <div
      data-audio-note-player
      className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-audio-note-toggle
          aria-label={playing ? "Pause note" : "Play note"}
          onClick={() => onTogglePlay?.()}
          className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-xs text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300"
        >
          {playing ? "❚❚" : "▶"}
        </button>
        <div data-audio-note-waveform className="flex h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-[2px]" aria-hidden="true">
          {bars.map((h, i) => (
            <span
              key={i}
              className={`w-[3px] shrink-0 rounded-full ${playing && i < bars.length / 2 ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600"}`}
              style={{ height: `${Math.max(15, Math.min(100, h))}%` }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        <span data-audio-note-duration className="shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {duration}
        </span>
      </div>
      <p data-audio-note-title className="mt-3 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
        {title}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

                  <button data-audioplaylist-like-track={track.id} type="button" aria-label={isLiked ? "Unlike" : "Like"} onClick={() => { setLiked((prev) => { const next = new Set(prev); if (next.has(track.id)) next.delete(track.id); else next.add(track.id); return next; }); onLike?.(track); }} className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-base ${isLiked ?                 <span className="min-w-0 flex-1"><span className="block truncate text-xs font-semibold">{track.title}</span><span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{track.artist}</span></span>
                <span className="text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{track.duration}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-6 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 p-3 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">Drag songs here to build your queue</p>
        </aside>
      </div>

      <div data-audioplaylist-player className="flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button data-audioplaylist-player-toggle type="button" onClick={() => setIsPlaying((v) => !v)} className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-xs text-zinc-900">{isPlaying ? "❚❚" : "▶"}</button>
        <div className="min-w-0 w-36 sm:w-48"><p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold">{active?.title ?? "Nothing playing"}</p><p className="truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{active?.artist ?? "Choose a track"}</p></div>
        <div className="hidden flex-1 items-center gap-3 sm:flex"><span className="text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">0:42</span><div className="h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-700"><div className="h-full w-1/4 rounded-full bg-indigo-400" /></div><span className="text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{active?.duration ?? "0:00"}</span></div>
        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-300"><button type="button" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-zinc-800">↶</button><button type="button" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-zinc-800">↷</button><button type="button" className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-zinc-800">🔊</button></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\AudioWaveVisualizer.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export interface AudioWaveVisualizerProps {
  isActive?: boolean;
  barCount?: number;
  color?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export const AudioWaveVisualizer: React.FC<AudioWaveVisualizerProps> = ({
  isActive = false,
  barCount = 16,
  color = "bg-amber-500",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const bars = Array.from({ length: barCount }, (_, i) => i);

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 h-8 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 select-none ${className}`}
      role="status"
      aria-label={isActive ? "Audio active" : "Audio idle"}
    >
      {bars.map((idx) => {
        // Pseudo-random animation delays and scales for a natural voice waveform
        const delay = (idx * 0.08) % 0.8;
        const duration = 0.6 + ((idx % 4) * 0.15);

        return (
          <span
            key={idx}
            style={{
              animationDelay: `${delay}s`,
              animationDuration: `${duration}s`,
            }}
            className={`w-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${color} ${
              isActive
                ? "h-full animate-[audio-pulse_0.8s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate]"
                : "h-1.5 opacity-40"
            }`}
          />
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AuthProvider {
  name: string;
  icon?: string;
}

export interface AuthSubmitPayload {
  name?: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

export interface AuthFormProps {
  mode?: "signin" | "signup";
  providers?: AuthProvider[];
  loading?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  submitText?: string;
  footerText?: string;
  onSubmit?: (payload: AuthSubmitPayload) => void;
  onProviderClick?: (provider: AuthProvider) => void;
  onFooterClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const providerFallback = (name: string) => (name || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

export const AuthForm: React.FC<AuthFormProps> = ({
  mode = "signin",
  providers = [],
  loading = false,
  error,
  title,
  subtitle,
  submitText,
  footerText,
  onSubmit,
  onProviderClick,
  onFooterClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const isSignup = mode === "signup";

  const handleSubmit = (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (loading) return;
    onSubmit?.({ ...(isSignup ? { name } : {}), email, password });
  };

  const inputClass =
    "w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:border-indigo-500 transition-colors";

  return (
    <div
      className={`w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-6 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
        {title || (isSignup ? "Create your account" : "Welcome back")}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        {subtitle || (isSignup ? "Start free, no card required." : "Sign in to continue to your workspace.")}
      </div>

      {providers.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-2">
          {providers.map((provider) => (
            <button
              key={provider.name}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onProviderClick?.(provider)}
              className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
            >
              {provider.icon ? (
                <img src={provider.icon} alt="" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <span className="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {providerFallback(provider.name)}
                </span>
              )}
              <span>Continue with {provider.name}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {providers.length > 0 && (
        <div className="my-5 flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" />
          <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">or</span>
          <span className="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" />
        </div>
      )}

      <form className={providers.length > 0 ? "space-y-3" : "mt-5 space-y-3"} onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
        {isSignup && (
          <label className="block">
            <span className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Name</span>
            <input
              type="text"
              name="name"
              autoComplete="name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Ada Lovelace"
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </label>
        )}

        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Email</span>
          <input
            type="email"
            name="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="you@company.com"
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </label>

        <label className="block">
          <span className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Password</span>
          <input
            type="password"
            name="password"
            autoComplete={isSignup ? "new-password" : "current-password"}
            value={password}
            onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="••••••••"
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </label>

        {error && (
          <div role="alert" className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 px-3 py-2">
            <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" size={14} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
            <span className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
        >
          {loading && <UiIcon name="loader" size={14} className="animate-spin" />}
          {submitText || (isSignup ? "Create account" : "Sign in")}
        </button>
      </form>

      {footerText && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onFooterClick?.()}
          className="mt-4 w-full text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
        >
          {footerText}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AuthForm;

===== FILE: react\AutoScrollAnchor.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowDown } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AutoScrollAnchorProps {
  isStreaming?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const AutoScrollAnchor: React.FC<AutoScrollAnchorProps> = ({
  isStreaming = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isAtBottom, setIsAtBottom] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
      const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
      const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      const distanceFromBottom = documentHeight - (scrollTop + windowHeight);

      // Within 80px is considered at bottom
      setIsAtBottom(distanceFromBottom < 80);
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, []);

  // Auto follow scroll during streaming only if user is already at bottom
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isStreaming && isAtBottom) {
      bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  }, [isStreaming, isAtBottom]);

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div ref={bottomRef} className={`h-px w-full pointer-events-none ${className}`} />

      {/* Floating "Back to Bottom" Button */}
      {!isAtBottom && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={scrollToBottom}
          className="fixed bottom-24 right-8 z-30 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
          title="Scroll to bottom"
        >
          <ArrowDown className="w-4 h-4" />
          {isStreaming && (
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-ping" />
          )}
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  );
};


===== FILE: react\AvatarGroup.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export type AvatarStatus = "online" | "away" | "offline";

export interface AvatarMember {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  src?: string;
  status?: AvatarStatus;
}

export interface AvatarGroupProps {
  members: AvatarMember[];
  /** How many avatars to show before collapsing into a +N chip. Defaults to 4. */
  max?: number;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  onMemberClick?: (member: AvatarMember) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<NonNullable<AvatarGroupProps["size"]>, string> = {
  sm: "h-7 w-7 text-[10px]",
  md: "h-9 w-9 text-xs",
  lg: "h-11 w-11 text-sm",
};

const DOT_CLASS: Record<AvatarStatus, string> = {
  online: "bg-emerald-500",
  away: "bg-amber-400",
  offline: "bg-zinc-400",
};

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join("");

export const AvatarGroup: React.FC<AvatarGroupProps> = ({
  members,
  max = 4,
  size = "md",
  onMemberClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const visible = members.slice(0, Math.max(0, max));
  const overflow = members.length - visible.length;
  const sizeClass = SIZE_CLASS[size];

  return (
    <div className={`flex items-center -space-x-2 ${className}`}>
      {visible.map((member) => (
        <button
          key={member.id}
          type="button"
          title={member.name}
          aria-label={member.name}
          onClick={onMemberClick ? () => onMemberClick(member) : undefined}
          className={`relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold text-zinc-600 ring-2 ring-white transition-transform hover:z-10 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:z-10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}`}
        >
          {member.src ? (
            <img src={member.src} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
          ) : member.name.trim() ? (
            <span aria-hidden="true">{initials(member.name)}</span>
          ) : (
            <UiIcon name="user" size={size === "sm" ? 12 : size === "lg" ? 18 : 14} />
          )}
          {member.status && (
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className={`absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900 ${DOT_CLASS[member.status]}`}
            />
          )}
        </button>
      ))}
      {overflow > 0 && (
        <span
          title={`${overflow} more`}
          className={`relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-500 ring-2 ring-white dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}`}
        >
          +{overflow}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AvatarGroup;

/**
 * BentoFeatureGrid - Marketing bento grid: mixed-span feature tiles with
 * icon / title / description and optional embedded media slot, laid out
 * with CSS grid (Krea AI / Magnific bento pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface BentoTile {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  span?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  media?: string;

import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface BillingAddress {
  country: string;
  address1: string;
  address2?: string;
  city: string;
  state?: string;
  zip: string;
}

export interface BillingAddressFormProps {
  title?: string;
  countries?: string[];
  labels?: { address1?: string; address2?: string; city?: string; state?: string; zip?: string };
  /** initial values (all optional; controlled-ish via defaultValue) */
  defaultValue?: Partial<BillingAddress>;
  submitLabel?: string;
  showOptional?: boolean;
  onSubmit?: (address: BillingAddress) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_COUNTRIES = ["United States", "Singapore", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "Japan"];

export default function BillingAddressForm({
  title = "Billing details",
  countries = DEFAULT_COUNTRIES,
  labels = {},
  defaultValue = {},
  submitLabel = "Continue to next step",
  showOptional = true,
  onSubmit,
  className = "",
}: BillingAddressFormProps) {
  const [country, setCountry] = useState(defaultValue.country ?? countries[0] ?? "");
  const [address1, setAddress1] = useState(defaultValue.address1 ?? "");
  const [address2, setAddress2] = useState(defaultValue.address2 ?? "");
  const [city, setCity] = useState(defaultValue.city ?? "");
  const [state, setState] = useState(defaultValue.state ?? "");
  const [zip, setZip] = useState(defaultValue.zip ?? "");
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState<BillingAddress | null>(null);

  const valid = address1.trim() !== "" && city.trim() !== "" && zip.trim() !== "";

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!valid) return;
    const address: BillingAddress = { country, address1, address2: address2 || undefined, city, state: state || undefined, zip };
    setSubmitted(address);
    onSubmit?.(address);
  };

  return (
    <div data-billing-address-form className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p data-billing-address-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>

      <label data-billing-country-wrap className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="w-24 shrink-0 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Country</span>
        <select
          data-billing-country
          value={country}
          onChange={(e) => setCountry(e.target.value)}
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
        >
          {countries.map((c) => (
            <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>

      <label data-billing-field-wrap className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="w-24 shrink-0 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{labels.address1 ?? "Address line 1"}</span>
        <input
          data-billing-address1
          value={address1}
          onChange={(e) => setAddress1(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Street address"
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
        />
      </label>

      {showOptional ? (
        <label data-billing-field-wrap className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-24 shrink-0 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{labels.address2 ?? "Address line 2"}</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">optional</span>
          <input
            data-billing-address2
            value={address2}
            onChange={(e) => setAddress2(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Apt, suite, unit"
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
          />
        </label>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <label data-billing-city-wrap className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{labels.city ?? "City"}</span>
          <input
            data-billing-city
            value={city}
            onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
          />
        </label>
        <label data-billing-zip-wrap className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{labels.zip ?? "ZIP"}</span>
          <input
            data-billing-zip
            value={zip}
            onChange={(e) => setZip(e.target.value)}
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      {showOptional ? (
        <label data-billing-state-wrap className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-24 shrink-0 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{labels.state ?? "State"}</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">optional</span>
          <input
            data-billing-state
            value={state}
            onChange={(e) => setState(e.target.value)}
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
          />
        </label>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between">
        {submitted ? (
          <span data-billing-address-saved className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
            Saved {submitted.city}, {submitted.country}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span data-billing-address-hint className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Address, city and ZIP are required.</span>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          data-billing-address-submit
          disabled={!valid}
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          className="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          {submitLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface BillingLineItem {
  label: string;
  /** Pre-formatted amount, e.g. "$207.00". */
  amount: string;
  /** Emphasized rows (subtotal/total) render bolder with a top border. */
  emphasized?: boolean;
}

export interface BillingPanelProps {
  planName: string;
  /** "Monthly" | "Annual" — toggles via onPeriodChange. */
  period?: "monthly" | "annual";
  onPeriodChange?: (period: "monthly" | "annual") => void;
  price: string;
  /** Small text after the price, e.g. "Per month". */
  priceSuffix?: string;
  features?: string[];
  lineItems?: BillingLineItem[];
  ctaLabel: string;
  onCta?: () => void;
  /** Optional note rendered under the CTA, e.g. trial reminder. */
  note?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export const BillingPanel: React.FC<BillingPanelProps> = ({
  planName,
  period = "monthly",
  onPeriodChange,
  price,
  priceSuffix,
  features = [],
  lineItems = [],
  ctaLabel,
  onCta,
  note,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const periods: { id: "monthly" | "annual"; label: string }[] = [
    { id: "monthly", label: "Monthly" },
    { id: "annual", label: "Annual" },
  ];

  return (
    <div
      className={`w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">Upgrade to</p>
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{planName}</h3>
        </div>
        {onPeriodChange && (
          <div
            role="group"
            aria-label="Billing period"
            className="flex shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-0.5 dark:border-zinc-700"
          >
            {periods.map((p) => (
              <button
                key={p.id}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={period === p.id}
                onClick={() => onPeriodChange?.(p.id)}
                className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                  period === p.id
                    ? "bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900"
                    : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                {p.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <p className="mt-3 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
        <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{price}</span>
        {priceSuffix && <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{priceSuffix}</span>}
      </p>

      {features.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
          {features.map((feature) => (
            <li key={feature} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              <UiIcon name="check" size={13} className="shrink-0 text-emerald-500" />
              {feature}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {lineItems.length > 0 && (
        <dl className="mt-4 space-y-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          {lineItems.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.label}
              className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-4 ${
                item.emphasized
                  ? "border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50"
                  : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
              }`}
            >
              <dt className="text-xs">{item.label}</dt>
              <dd className="text-xs font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{item.amount}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onCta}
        className="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
      >
        {ctaLabel}
      </button>

      {note && (
        <p className="mt-2.5 flex items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-sky-50 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300">
          <UiIcon name="info" size={12} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          {note}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
export default BillingPanel;

/**

 * "On this page" nav highlight, article body with headings, paragraphs,

 */
import React from "react";

export interface ArticleHeading {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  level?: 2 | 3;
}

export interface ArticleCodeBlock {
  language: string;
  code: string;
}

export type ArticleBlock =
  | { type: "paragraph"; text: string }
  | { type: "heading"; text: string; id: string; level?: 2 | 3 }
  | { type: "list"; items: string[] }
  | { type: "code"; language: string; code: string };

export interface BlogPostArticleProps {
  siteName?: string;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  meta?: string;
  blocks?: ArticleBlock[];
  toc?: ArticleHeading[];
  activeHeadingId?: string;
  codeLabel?: string;
  copiedLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
  onHeadingClick?: (heading: ArticleHeading) => void;
  onCopyCode?: () => void;
}

export default function BlogPostArticle({
  siteName = "SLMobbin",

  subtitle = "What is Front-End Development?",
  meta = "8 min read · Nov 14, 2026",

    { type: "paragraph", text: "Front-end development primarily relies on three core technologies: HTML, CSS and JavaScript." },
    { type: "list", items: ["HTML provides the basic structure of a webpage.", "CSS controls the presentation and layout.", "JavaScript adds interactivity and dynamic behavior."] },
    { type: "heading", text: "1. HTML (HyperText Markup Language)", id: "html", level: 3 },
    { type: "paragraph", text: "HTML provides the basic structure of a webpage. It defines elements such as headings, paragraphs, images, links, and forms." },
    {
      type: "code",
      language: "html",
      code: '<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html>\n  <head>\n    <title>My First Web Page</title>\n  </head>\n  <body>\n    <h1>Welcome to Front-End Development</h1>\n    <p>This is an example of HTML structure.</p>\n  </body>\n</html>',

  toc = [
    { id: "key-technologies", text: "Key Technologies in Front-End Development", level: 2 },

  onHeadingClick,

                  } ${
                    active
                      ? "bg-sky-50 font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/50 dark:text-sky-300"
                      : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                  }`}
                >
                  {h.text}

            })}
          </div>

            <span aria-hidden="true">⇥</span> Collapse
            <kbd className="ml-auto rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] dark:border-zinc-700">⌘ \</kbd>
          </p>

                  >
                    {block.text}
                  </Tag>
                );
              }
              if (block.type === "list") {
                return (
                  <ul key={i} className="list-disc space-y-1.5 pl-6 text-[15px] leading-7 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">

                      <li key={j}>{item}</li>
                    ))}

                );

                <div key={i} data-blogpost-code className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-zinc-950 dark:bg-black">

                    <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500">{block.language}</span>

                      data-blogpost-code-copy

                    >
                      <span aria-hidden="true">⧉</span> {copied ? copiedLabel : codeLabel}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <pre className="overflow-x-auto px-4 pb-4 pt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-200"><code>{block.code}</code></pre>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * BottomTabBar - Mobile-style bottom navigation bar: icon + label tabs,
 * active indicator, optional badge count and safe-area padding
 * (mobile web navigation pattern).
 */
import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface BottomTab {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  badge?: number;
}

export interface BottomTabBarProps {
  tabs?: BottomTab[];
  active?: string;
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_TABS: BottomTab[] = [
  { id: "home", label: "Home", icon: "⌂" },
  { id: "search", label: "Search", icon: "⌕", badge: 3 },
  { id: "create", label: "Create", icon: "+" },
  { id: "inbox", label: "Inbox", icon: "✉", badge: 12 },
  { id: "profile", label: "Profile", icon: "◉" },
];

export const BottomTabBar: React.FC<BottomTabBarProps> = ({
  tabs = DEFAULT_TABS,
  active: activeProp,
  label = "Primary navigation",
  className = "",
  onChange,
}) => {
  const list = Array.isArray(tabs) ? tabs : [];
  const [internalActive, setInternalActive] = useState(activeProp || list[0]?.id || "home");
  const active = activeProp ?? internalActive;

  return (
    <nav data-bottomtab-bar aria-label={label} className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-bottomtab-items className="flex items-stretch px-2 pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]">
        {list.map((tab) => {
          const isActive = tab.id === active;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              type="button"
              data-bottomtab-item={tab.id}
              aria-current={isActive ? "page" : "false"}
              onClick={() => { setInternalActive(tab.id); onChange?.(tab.id); }}
              className={`relative flex flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-0.5 py-2 transition-colors ${
                isActive
                  ? "text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400"
                  : "text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-500 dark:hover:text-zinc-300"
              }`}
            >
              <span data-bottomtab-icon={tab.id} aria-hidden="true" className="text-lg leading-5">{tab.icon || ""}</span>
              <span data-bottomtab-label={tab.id} className="text-[10px] font-medium">{tab.label}</span>
              {tab.badge ? (
                <span data-bottomtab-badge={tab.id} className="absolute -right-2 -top-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold leading-4 text-white">{tab.badge}</span>
              ) : null}
              <span data-bottomtab-indicator={tab.id} aria-hidden="true" className={`${isActive ? "block" : "hidden"} absolute -top-px inset-x-4 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-400`}></span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
};

export default BottomTabBar;

===== FILE: react\Breadcrumb.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
}

export interface BreadcrumbProps {
  items: BreadcrumbItem[];
  /** Collapse the middle into an ellipsis when the trail is longer than this. 0 disables. */
  maxItems?: number;
  onNavigate?: (item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number) => void;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const collapse = (items: BreadcrumbItem[], maxItems: number): (BreadcrumbItem | null)[] => {
  if (maxItems <= 0 || items.length <= maxItems) return items;
  const tail = Math.max(1, maxItems - 1);
  return [items[0], null, ...items.slice(items.length - tail)];
};

export const Breadcrumb: React.FC<BreadcrumbProps> = ({
  items,
  maxItems = 0,
  onNavigate,
  ariaLabel = "Breadcrumb",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const trail = collapse(items, maxItems);

  return (
    <nav aria-label={ariaLabel} className={className}>
      <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
        {trail.map((item, index) => {
          const last = index === trail.length - 1;
          const content = (
            <>
              {item?.icon && <UiIcon name={item.icon} size={12} />}
              <span>{item ? item.label : "…"}</span>
            </>
          );
          const base = "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1 py-0.5 transition-colors";
          return (
            <li key={item ? item.id ?? `${item.label}-${index}` : `ellipsis-${index}`} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {index > 0 && (
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
                  <UiIcon name="chevron-right" size={11} />
                </span>
              )}
              {!item ? (
                <span className="px-1 text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">
                  …
                </span>
              ) : last ? (
                <span aria-current="page" className={`${base} font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100`}>
                  {content}
                </span>
              ) : item.href ? (
                <a
                  href={item.href}
                  onClick={(event) => {
                    if (!onNavigate) return;
                    event.preventDefault();
                    onNavigate(item, index);
                  }}
                  className={`${base} text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100`}
                >
                  {content}
                </a>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onNavigate?.(item, index)}
                  className={`${base} text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100`}
                >
                  {content}
                </button>
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
};

export default Breadcrumb;

/**
 * CampsiteHandoff - Campsite design handoff panel: checklist entries with
 * done state, assignee initials avatar and due date, plus an AI summary
 * block recapping the handoff.
 */
import React from "react";

export interface CampsiteHandoffItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  done?: boolean;
  assignee?: string;
  due?: string;
}

export interface CampsiteHandoffProps {
  items?: CampsiteHandoffItem[];
  summary?: string;
  className?: string;
  onToggle?: (item: CampsiteHandoffItem) => void;
}

export default function CampsiteHandoff({
  items = [
    { id: "h1", label: "Redlines attached for spacing scale", done: true, assignee: "Alex Smith", due: "Nov 12" },
    { id: "h2", label: "Empty states exported to Lottie", done: true, assignee: "Brook Taylor", due: "Nov 13" },
    { id: "h3", label: "Motion spec review with eng", done: false, assignee: "Casey Morgan", due: "Nov 15" },
  ],
  summary = "3 handoff tasks, 2 done. Motion spec review is still open and due Nov 15 — the only blocker for a clean handoff.",
  className = "",
  onToggle,
}: CampsiteHandoffProps) {
  const initialsFor = (name: string) =>
    name
      .split(/\s+/)
      .map((part) => part[0] ?? "")
      .join("")
      .slice(0, 2)
      .toUpperCase();
  return (
    <div data-campsite-handoff className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>

          {items.filter((i) => i.done).length}/{items.length} done
        </span>
      </div>
      <div data-campsite-handoff-items className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {items.map((item) => (
          <label
            key={item.id}
            data-campsite-handoff-item={item.id}
            className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-2 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          >
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              data-campsite-handoff-check
              checked={Boolean(item.done)}
              onChange={() => onToggle?.(item)}
              className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded accent-indigo-500"
            />
            <span className={`min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs ${item.done ? "text-zinc-400 line-through dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"}`}>
              {item.label}

            {item.assignee ? (
              <span data-campsite-handoff-assignee title={item.assignee} className="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-[9px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
                {initialsFor(item.assignee)}
              </span>
            ) : null}
            {item.due ? (
              <span data-campsite-handoff-due className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {item.due}
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>
      {summary ? (
        <div data-campsite-handoff-summary className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 p-3 dark:bg-indigo-950/40">
