import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ContextUsageTokenBreakdown {
  label: string;
  count: number;
  colorClass?: string;
}

export interface ContextUsageProps {
  usedTokens: number;
  maxTokens: number;
  modelName?: string;
  contextWindow?: number;
  breakdown?: ContextUsageTokenBreakdown[];
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const formatNumber = (num: number): string => {
  if (num >= 1_000_000) return `${(num / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (num >= 1_000) return `${(num / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(num);
};

export const ContextUsageBadge: React.FC<ContextUsageProps> = ({
  usedTokens,
  maxTokens,
  modelName,
  breakdown = [],
  compact = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [showPopover, setShowPopover] = useState(false);

  const safeMax = Math.max(1, maxTokens);
  const safeUsed = Math.max(0, usedTokens);
  const percentage = Math.min(100, Math.round((safeUsed / safeMax) * 100));

  let statusColor = "bg-emerald-500 text-emerald-500 border-emerald-500/20";
  let barColor = "bg-emerald-500";
  if (percentage >= 90) {
    statusColor = "bg-rose-500 text-rose-500 border-rose-500/20";
    barColor = "bg-rose-500";
  } else if (percentage >= 70) {
    statusColor = "bg-amber-500 text-amber-500 border-amber-500/20";
    barColor = "bg-amber-500";
  }

  return (
    <div className={`relative inline-block text-xs font-sans select-none ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setShowPopover(!showPopover)}
        onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setShowPopover(false), 200)}
        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-colors shadow-sm"
        aria-label="Context Window Usage"
        aria-expanded={showPopover}
      >
        <UiIcon name="cpu" size={14} className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
        {modelName && !compact && (
          <span className="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium truncate max-w-[120px]">
            {modelName}
          </span>
        )}
        <div className="w-16 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
          <div
            className={`h-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}`}
            style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
          {percentage}%
        </span>
      </button>

      {showPopover && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 w-64 p-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-xl z-30 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">Context Window</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
              {formatNumber(safeUsed)} / {formatNumber(safeMax)}
            </span>
          </div>

          {modelName && (
            <div className="pt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 flex justify-between">
              <span>Model</span>
              <span className="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium">{modelName}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {breakdown.length > 0 && (
            <div className="pt-2.5 space-y-1.5">
              <div className="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-zinc-400 tracking-wider">Breakdown</div>
              {breakdown.map((item, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${item.colorClass || 'bg-zinc-400'}`} />
                    {item.label}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    {formatNumber(item.count)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
export default ContextUsageBadge;

export interface ConsentCategory {

  description?: string;
  alwaysActive?: boolean;

}

export interface CookieConsentProps {
  title?: string;

  policyLabel?: string;
  categories?: ConsentCategory[];
  acceptLabel?: string;
  rejectLabel?: string;
  saveLabel?: string;
  onConfirm?: (accepted: string[]) => void;
}

/**
 * CookieConsent - granular cookie preference dialog with collapsible categories and bulk actions.
 */
export default function CookieConsent({
  title = "Choose how we use your personal information",
  description = "We use cookies to personalize content, run analytics and improve your experience.",
  policyLabel = "Privacy Policy",
  categories = [],
  acceptLabel = "Accept All",
  rejectLabel = "Reject All",
  saveLabel = "Confirm",
  onConfirm,
}: CookieConsentProps) {
  const optional = categories.filter((category) => !category.alwaysActive);
  const always = categories.filter((category) => category.alwaysActive);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900" data-cookie-consent role="dialog" aria-label={title}>
      <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h2>
      <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        {description}{" "}
        <a href="#" className="font-medium text-indigo-600 underline underline-offset-2 dark:text-indigo-400">
          {policyLabel}
        </a>
      </p>

      <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
        {[...always, ...optional].map((category) => (
          <details key={category.id} className="group rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/50" data-consent-category={category.id}>
            <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform group-open:rotate-180">
                <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
              </svg>
              {category.label}
              <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">
                {category.alwaysActive ? "Always Active" : ""}
              </span>
              {!category.alwaysActive ? (
                <span className="flex h-4 w-7 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-0.5" data-consent-toggle aria-hidden="true">
                  <span className="ml-auto flex h-3 w-3 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" className="h-2 w-2 text-indigo-600">
                      <path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" />
                    </svg>
                  </span>
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </summary>
            <div className="border-t border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">
              {category.description || "Used to deliver core functionality."}
              {category.cookies?.length ? (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">{category.cookies.join(", ")}</p>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </details>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-end gap-2" data-consent-actions>
        {rejectLabel ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            data-consent-reject
            onClick={() => onConfirm?.(categories.filter((category) => category.alwaysActive).map((category) => category.id))}
            className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            {rejectLabel}
          </button>
        ) : null}
        <button
          type="button"
          data-consent-accept
          onClick={() => onConfirm?.(categories.map((category) => category.id))}
          className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
        >
          {acceptLabel}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-consent-save
          onClick={() => onConfirm?.(categories.filter((category) => category.alwaysActive).map((category) => category.id))}
          className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          {saveLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

                : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
            }`}
          >
            Image Assist
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className={`inline-block h-3.5 w-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${
                imageAssist ? "bg-white/80" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600"
              }`}
            >
              <span
                className={`block h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform dark:bg-zinc-200 ${

          className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300"
        >
          {resolutions.map((r) => (
            <option key={r} value={r}>{r}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="creation-count">Count</label>
        <select
          id="creation-count"
          data-creation-count
          value={count}
          onChange={(e) => onCountChange?.(Number(e.target.value))}
          className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300"
        >
          {counts.map((c) => (
            <option key={c} value={c}>{c}×</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-creation-submit
          onClick={() => {
            const input = (document.querySelector('[data-creation-input]') as HTMLTextAreaElement | null)?.value ?? "";
            onSubmit?.({ prompt: input, imageAssist, resolution, count });
          }}
          className="rounded-md bg-violet-600 px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-violet-500"
        >
          Create
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface CreditBalanceCardProps {
  /** headline balance value, e.g. 6.68 */
  balance?: number;
  /** currency/unit label shown next to the balance */
  unit?: string;
  /** plan label shown in the status badge */
  plan?: string;
  /** mono currency prefix like $ or credits symbol */
  currency?: string;
  /** under this balance the card flips into a low-balance warning */
  warnBelow?: number;
  buyLabel?: string;
  couponLabel?: string;
  onBuy?: () => void;
  onCoupon?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export default function CreditBalanceCard({
  balance = 0,
  unit = "credits",
  plan = "Current plan",
  currency = "",
  warnBelow,
  buyLabel = "Buy More Credits",
  couponLabel = "Apply Coupon",
  onBuy,
  onCoupon,
  className = "",
}: CreditBalanceCardProps) {
  const [pulse, setPulse] = useState(false);

  const low = typeof warnBelow === "number" && balance < warnBelow;
  const formatted = balance.toFixed(2);

  const handle = (fn?: () => void) => () => {
    setPulse(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => setPulse(false), 600);
    fn?.();
  };

  return (
    <div
      data-credit-balance-card
      className={`rounded-xl border bg-white p-4 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${
        low ? "border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/60" : "border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
      } ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p data-credit-balance-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          Credit Balance
        </p>
        <span
          data-credit-balance-plan
          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
            low
              ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400"
              : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300"
          }`}
        >
          <span
            className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${low ? "bg-amber-500" : "bg-emerald-500"}`}
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          {plan}
        </span>
      </div>

      <p className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-2">
        <span
          data-credit-balance-value
          className={`font-mono text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight ${
            low ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" : "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
          }`}
        >
          {currency}
          {formatted}
        </span>
        <span data-credit-balance-unit className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{unit}</span>
      </p>

      {low ? (
        <p data-credit-balance-warning className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
          Balance is running low — top up to avoid interruptions.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-credit-balance-buy
          onClick={handle(onBuy)}
          className={`rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:bg-emerald-500 ${
            pulse ? "ring-2 ring-emerald-300 ring-offset-1" : ""
          }`}
        >
          {buyLabel}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-credit-balance-coupon
          onClick={handle(onCoupon)}
          className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          {couponLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\DataTable.tsx =====

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface DataTableColumn {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  align?: "left" | "center" | "right";
  width?: string;
}

export type DataTableRow = Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;

export interface DataTableAction {
  label: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  onClick: (row: DataTableRow) => void;
}

export interface DataTableProps {
  columns: DataTableColumn[];
  rows: DataTableRow[];
  selectable?: boolean;
  onSort?: (key: string, direction: "asc" | "desc") => void;
  actions?: DataTableAction[];
  emptyText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const alignClass = (align?: DataTableColumn["align"]) =>
  align === "right" ? "text-right" : align === "center" ? "text-center" : "text-left";

export const DataTable: React.FC<DataTableProps> = ({
  columns,
  rows,
  selectable = false,
  onSort,
  actions = [],
  emptyText = "No results",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<"asc" | "desc">("asc");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());

  const sortedRows = useMemo(() => {
    if (onSort || !sortKey) return rows;
    return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
      const av = a[sortKey];
      const bv = b[sortKey];
      if (av === bv) return 0;
      const result = String(av ?? "") > String(bv ?? "") ? 1 : -1;
      return sortDir === "asc" ? result : -result;
    });
  }, [rows, sortKey, sortDir, onSort]);

  const toggleSort = (key: string) => {
    const nextDir = sortKey === key && sortDir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
    setSortKey(key);
    setSortDir(nextDir);
    onSort?.(key, nextDir);
  };

  const allSelected = sortedRows.length > 0 && selected.size === sortedRows.length;
  const toggleAll = () => {
    setSelected(allSelected ? new Set() : new Set(sortedRows.map((_, index) => index)));
  };
  const toggleRow = (index: number) => {
    setSelected((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.has(index) ? next.delete(index) : next.add(index);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className={`relative ${className}`}>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <table className="w-full text-xs">
          <thead className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60">
            <tr>
              {selectable && (
                <th className="w-10 px-3 py-2">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={allSelected}
                    onChange={toggleAll}
                    aria-label="Select all rows"
                    className="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600"
                  />
                </th>
              )}
              {columns.map((column) => (
                <th
                  key={column.key}
                  style={column.width ? { width: column.width } : undefined}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${alignClass(column.align)}`}
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleSort(column.key)}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
                  >
                    {column.label}
                    <span className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
                      <UiIcon
                        name={sortKey === column.key ? (sortDir === "asc" ? "arrow-up" : "arrow-down") : "chevron-down"}
                        size={11}
                      />
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </th>
              ))}
              {actions.length > 0 && <th className="w-20 px-3 py-2" />}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {sortedRows.length === 0 && (
              <tr>
                <td
                  colSpan={columns.length + (selectable ? 1 : 0) + (actions.length ? 1 : 0)}
                  className="px-3 py-10 text-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
                >
                  {emptyText}
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
            {sortedRows.map((row, index) => (
              <tr
                key={index}
                className="group hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors"
              >
                {selectable && (
                  <td className="px-3 py-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={selected.has(index)}
                      onChange={() => toggleRow(index)}
                      aria-label={`Select row ${index + 1}`}
                      className="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600"
                    />
                  </td>
                )}
                {columns.map((column) => (
                  <td
                    key={column.key}
                    className={`px-3 py-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 ${alignClass(column.align)} ${
                      column.align === "right" ? "tabular-nums" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    {String(row[column.key] ?? "—")}
                  </td>
                ))}
                {actions.length > 0 && (
                  <td className="px-3 py-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                      {actions.map((action) => (
                        <button
                          key={action.label}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => action.onClick(row)}
                          aria-label={action.label}
                          title={action.label}
                          className="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <UiIcon name={action.icon || "more-horizontal"} size={14} />
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {selectable && selected.size > 0 && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-20 flex -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-2 shadow-lg">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{selected.size} selected</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            {actions.map((action) => (
              <button
                key={action.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  selected.forEach((index) => action.onClick(sortedRows[index]));
                  setSelected(new Set());
                }}
                className="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors"
              >
                {action.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelected(new Set())}
            aria-label="Clear selection"
            className="rounded-full p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
          >
            <UiIcon name="x" size={13} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DataTable;


===== FILE: react\DatePicker.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface DatePickerProps {
  /** Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD. */
  value?: string;
  /** Earliest selectable date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. */
  min?: string;
  /** Latest selectable date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. */
  max?: string;
  /** 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday. */
  weekStartsOn?: 0 | 1;
  showToday?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (isoDate: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const MONTHS = [
  "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December",
];
const WEEKDAYS = ["Su", "Mo", "Tu", "We", "Th", "Fr", "Sa"];

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
export const toIso = (year: number, month: number, day: number) => `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(day)}`;

export const parseIso = (iso?: string): { year: number; month: number; day: number } | null => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso || "");
  if (!match) return null;
  return { year: Number(match[1]), month: Number(match[2]) - 1, day: Number(match[3]) };
};

const todayIso = () => {
  const now = new Date();
  return toIso(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
};

export const DatePicker: React.FC<DatePickerProps> = ({
  value,
  min,
  max,
  weekStartsOn = 1,
  showToday = true,
  disabled = false,
  onChange,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const selected = parseIso(value);
  const today = todayIso();

  const [view, setView] = useState(() => {
    const base = selected || parseIso(today)!;
    return { year: base.year, month: base.month };
  });

  // Follow an externally controlled value.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selected) setView({ year: selected.year, month: selected.month });
  }, [value]);

  const cells = useMemo(() => {
    const first = new Date(view.year, view.month, 1).getDay();
    const lead = (first - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    const total = new Date(view.year, view.month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const out: Array<number | null> = Array.from({ length: lead }, () => null);
    for (let day = 1; day <= total; day += 1) out.push(day);
    while (out.length % 7 !== 0) out.push(null);
    return out;
  }, [view, weekStartsOn]);

  const weekdays = useMemo(
    () => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => WEEKDAYS[(i + weekStartsOn) % 7]),
    [weekStartsOn]
  );

  const shift = (delta: number) => {
    const next = new Date(view.year, view.month + delta, 1);
    setView({ year: next.getFullYear(), month: next.getMonth() });
  };

  const isDisabled = (day: number) => {
    if (disabled) return true;
    const iso = toIso(view.year, view.month, day);
    if (min && iso < min) return true;
    if (max && iso > max) return true;
    return false;
  };

  const selectDay = (day: number) => {
    if (isDisabled(day)) return;
    onChange?.(toIso(view.year, view.month, day));
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`w-full max-w-[17rem] rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-3 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => shift(-1)}
          aria-label="Previous month"
          className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        >
          <UiIcon name="chevron-left" size={14} />
        </button>
        <span className="flex-1 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          {MONTHS[view.month]} {view.year}
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => shift(1)}
          aria-label="Next month"
          className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        >
          <UiIcon name="chevron-right" size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-7 gap-0.5">
        {weekdays.map((label) => (
          <span key={label} className="py-1 text-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400">
            {label}
          </span>
        ))}

        {cells.map((day, index) => {
          if (day === null) return <span key={`blank-${index}`} />;
          const iso = toIso(view.year, view.month, day);
          const isSelected = value === iso;
          const isToday = iso === today;
          const blocked = isDisabled(day);
          return (
            <button
              key={iso}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => selectDay(day)}
              disabled={blocked}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              aria-label={iso}
              className={`relative flex h-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[11px] tabular-nums transition-colors ${
                isSelected
                  ? "bg-indigo-600 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500"
                  : isToday
                    ? "font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40"
                    : "text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              } disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 disabled:hover:bg-transparent dark:disabled:text-zinc-600`}
            >
              {day}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {showToday && (
        <div className="mt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (disabled) return;
              const iso = today;
              if ((min && iso < min) || (max && iso > max)) return;
              onChange?.(iso);
            }}
            className="w-full rounded-md py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40"
          >
            Today
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DatePicker;

export default function DeliveryTrackingPanel({

import React from "react";

export interface DeployCommit {
  sha: string;
  message?: string;
  branch?: string;
  author?: string;
}

export interface DeploymentCardProps {
  deployId: string;
  status: "queued" | "building" | "live" | "failed" | "canceled";
  commit: DeployCommit;
  createdAt: string;
  source?: string;
  url?: string;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  onVisit?: (url: string) => void;
}

const STATUS_TONE: Record<string, { pill: string; dot: string; label: string }> = {
  queued: { pill: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300", dot: "bg-zinc-400", label: "Queued" },
  building: { pill: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300", dot: "bg-sky-500 animate-pulse", label: "Building" },
  live: { pill: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300", dot: "bg-emerald-500", label: "Live" },
  failed: { pill: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300", dot: "bg-rose-500", label: "Failed" },
  canceled: { pill: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400", dot: "bg-zinc-400", label: "Canceled" },
};

/**
 * DeploymentCard - single deployment record with status pill, commit info and actions.
 */
export default function DeploymentCard({ deployId, status, commit, createdAt, source, url, onCancel, onVisit }: DeploymentCardProps) {
  const tone = STATUS_TONE[status] || STATUS_TONE.queued;
  const terminal = status === "live" || status === "failed" || status === "canceled";
  return (
    <div data-deployment-card className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{deployId}</p>
            <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium ${tone.pill}`}>
              <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${tone.dot}`} />
              {tone.label}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {commit.sha}
            {commit.message ? <span className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"> {commit.message}</span> : null}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            {[source, createdAt].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
          {!terminal && onCancel ? (
            <button type="button" data-deploy-cancel onClick={onCancel} className="rounded-lg border border-rose-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 transition-colors hover:bg-rose-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-rose-500 dark:border-rose-500/60 dark:text-rose-400 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40">
              Cancel deploy
            </button>
          ) : null}
          {terminal && url && onVisit ? (
            <button type="button" data-deploy-visit onClick={() => onVisit(url)} className="rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">
              Visit ↗
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\DiffViewer.tsx =====

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface DiffLine {
  type: "add" | "remove" | "context";
  content: string;
}

export interface DiffFile {
  filename: string;
  language?: string;
  lines: DiffLine[];
}

export interface DiffViewerProps {
  /** Legacy single-diff API (kept for backward compatibility). */
  lines?: DiffLine[];
  filename?: string;
  language?: string;
  /** Multi-file API: renders a tab bar when 1+ files are provided. */
  files?: DiffFile[];
  /** Context lines kept visible around each collapsed gap (default 3). */
  contextSize?: number;
  showLineNumbers?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const LINE_STYLE: Record<DiffLine["type"], { row: string; gutter: string; sign: string }> = {
  add: { row: "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300", gutter: "text-emerald-500", sign: "+" },
  remove: { row: "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300", gutter: "text-rose-500", sign: "-" },
  context: { row: "text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400", gutter: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600", sign: " " },
};

interface HiddenLine {
  line: DiffLine;
  oldNo: number;
  newNo: number;
}

interface RenderRow {
  kind: "line" | "collapsed";
  line?: DiffLine;
  oldNo?: number | "";
  newNo?: number | "";
  /** For "collapsed": number of hidden context lines. */
  count?: number;
  /** For "collapsed": the hidden context lines, revealed on expand. */
  hidden?: HiddenLine[];
  /** Stable key so expanding one gap doesn't open its neighbours. */
  key: string;
}

/**
 * Walks the diff once and produces render rows. Long runs of context lines
 * (> contextSize*2) become a collapsible gap that keeps `contextSize` lines
 * visible on each side; the hidden middle travels with the row so expanding
 * needs no second pass over the source.
 */
const buildRows = (lines: DiffLine[], contextSize: number): RenderRow[] => {
  const rows: RenderRow[] = [];
  let oldNo = 0;
  let newNo = 0;
  let contextRun: HiddenLine[] = [];

  const flushContext = (isTail: boolean) => {
    if (contextRun.length <= contextSize * 2) {
      contextRun.forEach((entry) => rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` }));
    } else {
      const head = contextRun.slice(0, contextSize);
      const hiddenStart = isTail ? contextSize : contextSize;
      const hiddenEnd = isTail ? contextRun.length : contextRun.length - contextSize;
      const hidden = contextRun.slice(hiddenStart, hiddenEnd);
      head.forEach((entry) => rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` }));
      rows.push({ kind: "collapsed", count: hidden.length, hidden, key: `gap-${rows.length}-${hidden.length}` });
      if (!isTail) {
        contextRun.slice(contextRun.length - contextSize).forEach((entry) =>
          rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` })
        );
      }
    }
    contextRun = [];
  };

  lines.forEach((line) => {
    if (line.type !== "add") oldNo += 1;
    if (line.type !== "remove") newNo += 1;

    if (line.type === "context") {
      contextRun.push({ line, oldNo, newNo });
      return;
    }
    flushContext(false);
    rows.push({ kind: "line", line, oldNo: line.type !== "add" ? oldNo : "", newNo: line.type !== "remove" ? newNo : "", key: `c-${rows.length}` });
  });

  flushContext(true);
  return rows;
};

export const DiffViewer: React.FC<DiffViewerProps> = ({
  lines = [],
  filename,
  language,
  files = [],
  contextSize = 3,
  showLineNumbers = true,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const multiFile = files.length > 0;
  const [activeFileIdx, setActiveFileIdx] = useState(0);
  const [expandedGaps, setExpandedGaps] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());

  const safeIdx = multiFile ? Math.min(activeFileIdx, files.length - 1) : 0;
  const active = multiFile ? files[safeIdx] : null;
  const activeLines = active ? active.lines : lines;
  const activeFilename = active ? active.filename : filename;
  const activeLanguage = active ? active.language : language;

  const rows = useMemo(() => buildRows(activeLines, contextSize), [activeLines, contextSize]);

  const added = activeLines.filter((l) => l.type === "add").length;
  const removed = activeLines.filter((l) => l.type === "remove").length;

  const toggleGap = (key: string) => {
    setExpandedGaps((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key);
      else next.add(key);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden ${className}`}>
      {/* Multi-file tab bar */}
      {multiFile && (
        <div role="tablist" className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 px-1.5 pt-1.5">
          {files.map((file, idx) => {
            const isActive = idx === safeIdx;
            const fileAdded = file.lines.filter((l) => l.type === "add").length;
            const fileRemoved = file.lines.filter((l) => l.type === "remove").length;
            return (
              <button
                key={file.filename}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={isActive}
                onClick={() => setActiveFileIdx(idx)}
                className={`flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-t-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] transition-colors ${
                  isActive
                    ? "border border-b-0 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
                    : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                <span className="max-w-[10rem] truncate">{file.filename}</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{fileAdded}</span>
                <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-{fileRemoved}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Active file header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs">
        <UiIcon name="git-branch" size={14} className="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
        {activeFilename && <span className="font-mono font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate">{activeFilename}</span>}
        {activeLanguage && (
          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700/70 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {activeLanguage}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
          <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{added}</span>
          <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-{removed}</span>
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto text-[13px] font-mono leading-relaxed">
        {activeLines.length === 0 && <div className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No changes</div>}

        {rows.map((row) => {
          if (row.kind === "collapsed") {
            const isExpanded = expandedGaps.has(row.key);
            if (!isExpanded) {
              return (
                <button
                  key={row.key}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggleGap(row.key)}
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none"
                >
                  <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={12} />
                  <span className="font-mono">⋯ {row.count} unchanged lines</span>
                </button>
              );
            }
            return (
              <React.Fragment key={row.key}>
                {(row.hidden || []).map((entry, i) => (
                  <div key={`${row.key}-${i}`} className={`flex ${LINE_STYLE.context.row}`}>
                    {showLineNumbers && (
                      <span className="w-16 shrink-0 select-none px-2 text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 tabular-nums">
                        {entry.oldNo} {entry.newNo}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="w-5 shrink-0 select-none text-center text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">{" "}</span>
                    <span className="flex-1 min-w-0 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words pr-3">{entry.line.content}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggleGap(row.key)}
                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none"
                >
                  <UiIcon name="minus" size={12} />
                  <span className="font-mono">Collapse unchanged lines</span>
                </button>
              </React.Fragment>
            );
          }

          const meta = LINE_STYLE[row.line!.type] || LINE_STYLE.context;
          return (
            <div key={row.key} className={`flex ${meta.row}`}>
              {showLineNumbers && (
                <span className="w-16 shrink-0 select-none px-2 text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 tabular-nums">
                  {row.oldNo === "" ? "" : row.oldNo} {row.newNo === "" ? "" : row.newNo}
                </span>
              )}
              <span className={`w-5 shrink-0 select-none text-center ${meta.gutter}`}>{meta.sign}</span>
              <span className="flex-1 min-w-0 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words pr-3">{row.line!.content}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DiffViewer;

/**
 * DocsPageLayout - Documentation page shell: left nav with top links and
 * grouped sections, center article with title, Copy page button, callout,
 * cards grid and code examples, right "On this page" table of contents
 * with active highlight (Mintlify docs pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface DocsNavItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  badge?: string;
}

export interface DocsNavGroup {
  label: string;
  items: DocsNavItem[];
}

export interface DocsCard {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon?: string;
  href?: string;
}

export interface DocsCodeExample {
  filename: string;
  language: string;
  code: string;
}

export type DocsBlock =
  | { type: "paragraph"; text: string }
  | { type: "callout"; tone?: "info" | "success" | "warning"; title?: string; text: string }
  | { type: "heading"; text: string; anchor: string }
  | { type: "cards"; cards: DocsCard[] }
  | { type: "code"; example: DocsCodeExample };

export interface DocsTocItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface DocsPageLayoutProps {
  topLinks?: DocsNavItem[];
  navGroups?: DocsNavGroup[];
  title?: string;
  copyLabel?: string;
  blocks?: DocsBlock[];
  toc?: DocsTocItem[];
  activeTocId?: string;
  className?: string;
  onNavClick?: (item: DocsNavItem) => void;
  onTocClick?: (item: DocsTocItem) => void;
  onCopyPage?: () => void;
}

export default function DocsPageLayout({
  topLinks = [
    { id: "documentation", label: "Documentation", icon: "📘" },
    { id: "blog", label: "Blog", icon: "📰" },
  ],
  navGroups = [
    {
      label: "Getting Started",
      items: [
        { id: "introduction", label: "Introduction" },
        { id: "quickstart", label: "Quickstart", badge: "Start here" },
        { id: "development", label: "Development" },
      ],
    },
    {
      label: "Essentials",
      items: [

  title = "Quickstart",

  blocks = [

  className = "",
  onNavClick,

  const [activeId, setActiveId] = React.useState(activeTocId || toc[0]?.id || "");
  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);

  const calloutStyles: Record<string, string> = {
    info: "border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-900 dark:border-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/50 dark:text-sky-200",
    success: "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-200",

  };
  const calloutIcon: Record<string, string> = { info: "ℹ️", success: "✅", warning: "⚠️" };

  const renderBlock = (block: DocsBlock, index: number) => {

    }

        </div>
      );
    }
    if (block.type === "heading") {
      return (
        <h2 key={index} id={block.anchor} data-docspage-heading={block.anchor} className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          {block.text}
        </h2>
      );
    }
    if (block.type === "cards") {

                {card.title}

                key={item.id}

                    : "border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >

===== FILE: react\DriftEmbersBackdrop.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export interface DriftEmbersBackdropProps {
  /** Animation speed factor, default 1 */
  speed?: number;
  /** Number of drifting motes, default 120 */
  density?: number;
  /** Base (top) CSS color, default #151c20 */
  baseColor?: string;
  /** Mid-left glow CSS color, default #4a4430 */
  bloomColor?: string;
  /** Warm ember mote CSS color, default #b9af39 */
  emberColor?: string;
  /** Neutral ash mote CSS color, default #c8c9ca */
  ashColor?: string;
  /** Pointer parallax on the glow, default false */
  interactive?: boolean;
  /** Freeze animation on a single frame, default false */
  paused?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const numOr = (v: number | undefined, fallback: number, min: number, max: number) =>
  Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v as number)) : fallback;

const safeColor = (v: string | undefined, fallback: string) => {
  const s = (v ?? "").trim();
  if (/^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(s) || /^rgba?\(\s*[\d.%\s,]+\)$/i.test(s)) return s;
  return fallback;
};

const hexToRgb = (hex: string): [number, number, number] => {
  let h = hex.replace("#", "");
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("");
  const n = Number.parseInt(h, 16);
  return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
};

type Mote = {
  x: number; y: number; r: number; fall: number; sway: number;
  swayAmp: number; phase: number; twinkle: number; alpha: number; ash: boolean;
};

const rand = (a: number, b: number) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const biasedX = () => Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.45) * 1.06 - 0.03;

const makeSprite = (color: string, coreAlpha: number): HTMLCanvasElement | null => {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  const SP = 64;
  c.width = SP;
  c.height = SP;
  const sc = c.getContext("2d");
  if (!sc) return null;
  const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(color);
  const grd = sc.createRadialGradient(SP / 2, SP / 2, 0, SP / 2, SP / 2, SP / 2);
  grd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${coreAlpha})`);
  grd.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${coreAlpha * 0.4})`);
  grd.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},0)`);
  sc.fillStyle = grd;
  sc.fillRect(0, 0, SP, SP);
  return c;
};

const DriftEmbersBackdrop: React.FC<DriftEmbersBackdropProps> = ({
  speed = 1,
  density = 120,
  baseColor = "#0d1113",
  bloomColor = "#4a4430",
  emberColor = "#b9af39",
  ashColor = "#c8c9ca",
  interactive = false,
  paused = false,
  className = "",
  style,
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const spd = numOr(speed, 1, 0, 4);
    const count = Math.round(numOr(density, 120, 1, 260));
    const base = safeColor(baseColor, "#0d1113");
    const bloom = safeColor(bloomColor, "#4a4430");
    const ember = safeColor(emberColor, "#b9af39");
    const ash = safeColor(ashColor, "#c8c9ca");

    const goldSprite = makeSprite(ember, 0.95);
    const ashSprite = makeSprite(ash, 0.55);
    if (!goldSprite || !ashSprite) return;

    const motes: Mote[] = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
      x: biasedX(), y: rand(-0.1, 1.1), r: rand(1.6, 6.2),
      fall: rand(0.004, 0.018), sway: rand(0.002, 0.01),
      swayAmp: rand(0.006, 0.035), phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      twinkle: rand(0.4, 1.4), alpha: rand(0.3, 0.85),
      ash: Math.random() < 0.46,
    }));

    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    let W = 1;
    let H = 1;
    const pointer = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, tx: 0.5, ty: 0.5 };

    const resize = () => {
      W = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth) * dpr));
      H = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight) * dpr));
      if (canvas.width !== W || canvas.height !== H) {
        canvas.width = W;
        canvas.height = H;
      }
    };

    // Fine grain, tiled once.
    let grain: CanvasPattern | null = null;
    const tile = document.createElement("canvas");
    tile.width = 64;
    tile.height = 64;
    const tc = tile.getContext("2d");
    if (tc && typeof tc.createImageData === "function") {
      const img = tc.createImageData(64, 64);
      for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
        const v = 120 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 135);
        img.data[i] = img.data[i + 1] = img.data[i + 2] = v;
        img.data[i + 3] = 14;
      }
      tc.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
      grain = ctx.createPattern(tile, "repeat");
    }

    const drawField = (t: number) => {
      const field = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      field.addColorStop(0, base);
      field.addColorStop(0.42, "#2a2923");
      field.addColorStop(1, "#090b0a");
      ctx.fillStyle = field;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      const wash = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, 0);
      wash.addColorStop(0, "rgba(72,64,42,0.18)");
      wash.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      wash.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.26)");
      ctx.fillStyle = wash;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      const bx = (0.13 + (pointer.x - 0.5) * 0.1) * W;
      const by = (0.45 + (pointer.y - 0.5) * 0.05) * H;
      const [br, bg, bb] = hexToRgb(bloom);
      const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, 0, bx, by, Math.max(W, H) * 0.62);
      glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.42)`);
      glow.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.1)`);
      glow.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0)`);
      ctx.fillStyle = glow;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      for (const p of motes) {
        const px = (p.x + Math.sin(t * p.sway + p.phase) * p.swayAmp) * W;
        const py = p.y * H;
        const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * p.twinkle + p.phase);
        const size = p.r * dpr * 5;
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha * tw;
        ctx.drawImage(p.ash ? ashSprite : goldSprite, px - size / 2, py - size / 2, size, size);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

      if (grain) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = grain;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }

      const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.3,
        W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.82,
      );
      vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)");
      ctx.fillStyle = vg;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    };

    const reduced =
      typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
        ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
        : false;

    let raf = 0;
    let last = 0;
    let t = 0;
    let stopped = paused;

    const frame = (now: number) => {
      if (stopped) return;
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
      last = now;
      t += dt * spd;
      pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.05;
      pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.05;
      for (const p of motes) {
        p.y += p.fall * dt * spd;
        if (p.y > 1.1) { p.y = -0.1; p.x = biasedX(); }
      }
      drawField(t);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };

    const start = () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      last = performance.now();
      if (reduced) drawField(t);
      else { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
    };
    const stop = () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; };
    const onVisibility = () => { if (document.hidden) stop(); else start(); };
    const onResize = () => { resize(); if (stopped || reduced) drawField(t); };
    const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!interactive) return;
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      pointer.tx = (e.clientX - rect.left) / (rect.width || 1);
      pointer.ty = (e.clientY - rect.top) / (rect.height || 1);
    };

    resize();
    if (interactive) window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    start();

    return () => {
      stop();
      if (interactive) window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    };
  }, [speed, density, baseColor, bloomColor, emberColor, ashColor, interactive, paused]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={`fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0 ${className}`}
      style={style}
    />
  );
};

export default DriftEmbersBackdrop;


===== FILE: react\EditableHeading.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface EditableHeadingProps {
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  breadcrumb?: React.ReactNode;
  meta?: React.ReactNode;
  size?: "md" | "lg";
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * EditableHeading - inline-editable object title: heading when idle, highlighted input on click; Enter/blur commits, Esc cancels.
 */
export default function EditableHeading({
  value,
  defaultValue = "Untitled",
  breadcrumb,
  meta,
  size = "lg",
  onChange,
  className = "",
}: EditableHeadingProps) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = React.useState(value ?? defaultValue);
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(current);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (value !== undefined) setCurrent(value);
  }, [value]);

  const commit = () => {
    const next = draft.trim() || current;
    setCurrent(next);
    setEditing(false);
    if (next !== current) onChange?.(next);
  };

  const cancel = () => {
    setDraft(current);
    setEditing(false);
  };

  const sizeClass = size === "lg" ? "text-2xl" : "text-base";

  return (
    <div data-editable-heading className={className}>
      {breadcrumb ? <div className="mb-1 text-xs text-zinc-400">{breadcrumb}</div> : null}
      {editing ? (
        <input
          data-heading-input
          type="text"
          autoFocus
          value={draft}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={commit}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") commit();
            else if (e.key === "Escape") cancel();
          }}
          className={`w-full rounded-md border-2 border-teal-500 bg-yellow-50 px-2 py-1 font-semibold text-zinc-900 outline-none dark:bg-yellow-950/40 dark:text-zinc-50 ${sizeClass}`}
        />
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          data-heading-display
          title="Click to rename"
          onClick={() => {
            setDraft(current);
            setEditing(true);
          }}
          className={`-mx-2 w-full rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-left font-semibold text-zinc-900 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-500 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 ${sizeClass}`}
        >
          {current}
        </button>
      )}
      {meta ? <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{meta}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface PaletteTool {
  id: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  kbd?: string;
  badge?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface EditorToolPaletteProps {
  tools: PaletteTool[];
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
  activeId?: string | null;
  activeCount?: number;
  showKbdHints?: boolean;
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * EditorToolPalette - floating canvas tool picker with keyboard hints, active-tool highlight and count badge.
 */
export default function EditorToolPalette({
  tools,
  orientation = "horizontal",
  activeId = null,
  activeCount,
  showKbdHints = true,
  onSelect,
  className = "",
}: EditorToolPaletteProps) {
  const vertical = orientation === "vertical";
  const containerClass = vertical
    ? "inline-flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
    : "inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900";

  return (
    <div data-tool-palette className={`${containerClass} ${className}`} role="toolbar" aria-orientation={orientation}>
      {tools.map((tool) => {
        const active = tool.id === activeId;
        return (
          <button
            key={tool.id}
            type="button"
            data-tool={tool.id}
            title={tool.label}
            disabled={tool.disabled}
            onClick={() => {
              if (!tool.disabled) onSelect?.(tool.id);
            }}
            className={`relative flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${
              active
                ? "bg-blue-500 text-white dark:bg-blue-500"
                : "text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-50"
            }`}
          >
            <span className="pointer-events-none flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center [&>svg]:h-5 [&>svg]:w-5">{tool.icon}</span>
            {showKbdHints && tool.kbd ? (
              <span
                className={`absolute -right-0.5 -top-0.5 rounded px-1 text-[9px] font-semibold leading-tight ${
                  active ? "bg-white/90 text-blue-600" : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500"
                }`}
              >
                {tool.kbd}
              </span>
            ) : null}
            {active && activeCount != null && activeCount > 0 ? (
              <span data-tool-badge className="absolute -bottom-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-blue-600 px-1.5 text-[9px] font-semibold leading-tight text-white">
                {activeCount}
              </span>
            ) : null}
            <span className="sr-only">{tool.label}</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface EmptyStateStarterProps {
  illustration?: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  onAction?: () => void;
  variant?: "plain" | "dashed" | "card";
  size?: "md" | "sm";
  actionVariant?: "solid" | "outline" | "link";
  className?: string;
}

const ACTION_CLASS: Record<string, string> = {
  solid: "rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300",
  outline: "rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800",
  link: "text-sm font-medium text-blue-600 hover:underline dark:text-blue-400",
};

/**
 * EmptyStateStarter - first-run "nothing here yet" starter block with illustration slot, dashed-card variant and flexible action styling.
 */
export default function EmptyStateStarter({
  illustration,
  title,
  description,
  actionLabel,
  onAction,
  variant = "plain",
  size = "md",
  actionVariant = "solid",
  className = "",
}: EmptyStateStarterProps) {
  const sm = size === "sm";
  const shell =
    variant === "dashed"
      ? "rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700"
      : variant === "card"
        ? "rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        : "";
  const pad = shell ? (sm ? "p-5" : "p-8") : "";

  return (
    <div
      data-empty-starter
      className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center ${shell} ${pad} ${className}`}
    >
      {illustration ? (
        <div data-empty-illustration className={`mb-3 flex items-center justify-center ${sm ? "text-3xl" : "text-5xl"}`} aria-hidden="true">
          {illustration}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <p data-empty-title className={`${sm ? "text-sm" : "text-xl"} font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50`}>
        {title}
      </p>
      {description ? (
        <p className={`mt-1 max-w-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${sm ? "text-xs" : "text-sm"}`}>
          {description}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {actionLabel ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          data-empty-action
          onClick={() => onAction?.()}
          className={`mt-4 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${ACTION_CLASS[actionVariant] || ACTION_CLASS.solid}`}
        >
          {actionLabel}
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\EntityMultiSelectPicker.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface PickerOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  avatar?: string;
  initials?: string;
  system?: boolean;
}

export interface EntityMultiSelectPickerProps {
  options: PickerOption[];
  selected?: string[];
  searchable?: boolean;
  emptyMessage?: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  onSelect?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  onSearch?: (query: string) => void;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
}

const AVATAR_TONES = [
  "bg-violet-500",
  "bg-sky-500",
  "bg-emerald-500",
  "bg-amber-500",
  "bg-rose-500",
  "bg-indigo-500",
];

const initialsOf = (label: string) =>
  label
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || "").toUpperCase())
    .join("");

/**
 * EntityMultiSelectPicker - searchable checkbox list with avatar rows for multi-picking people/entities.
 */
export default function EntityMultiSelectPicker({
  options,
  selected = [],
  searchable = true,
  emptyMessage = "No matches found.",
  confirmLabel = "Insert results",
  cancelLabel = "Cancel",
  onSelect,
  onSearch,
  onDismiss,
}: EntityMultiSelectPickerProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [picked, setPicked] = React.useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(selected));

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setPicked(new Set(selected));
  }, [selected]);

  const filtered = query
    ? options.filter((option) => option.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
    : options;

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    setPicked((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div data-entity-picker className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      {searchable ? (
        <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 p-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div className="relative">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">
              <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
            </svg>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={query}
              data-picker-search
              placeholder="Search people…"
              onChange={(event) => { setQuery(event.target.value); onSearch?.(event.target.value); }}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 py-1.5 pl-8 pr-2 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <ul className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto p-1.5">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <li data-picker-empty className="px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{emptyMessage}</li>
        ) : (
          filtered.map((option, index) => {
            const checked = picked.has(option.id);
            return (
              <li key={option.id}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-picker-option={option.id}
                  aria-pressed={checked}
                  onClick={() => toggle(option.id)}
                  className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                    checked ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40" : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span
                    data-picker-checkbox
                    className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors ${
                      checked ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white" : "border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {checked ? <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" className="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg> : null}
                  </span>
                  {option.avatar ? (
                    <img src={option.avatar} alt="" className="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
                  ) : option.system ? (
                    <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700">
                      <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-sky-500" />
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${AVATAR_TONES[index % AVATAR_TONES.length]}`}>
                      {option.initials || initialsOf(option.label)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{option.label}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })
        )}
      </ul>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button type="button" data-picker-cancel onClick={() => onDismiss?.()} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          {cancelLabel}
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-picker-confirm onClick={() => onSelect?.([...picked])} className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
          {confirmLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: react\EvalScoreTable.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export type EvalScoreTone = "pass" | "warn" | "fail";

export interface EvalRun {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  score: number;
  grader?: string;
  tone?: EvalScoreTone;
}

export interface EvalCriteria {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface EvalScoreTableProps {
  runs: EvalRun[];
  criteria?: EvalCriteria[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onRunSelect?: (run: EvalRun) => void;
  onAddCriteria?: () => void;
}

const toneClasses = (tone?: EvalScoreTone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case "warn":
      return "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300";
    case "fail":
      return "bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300";
    default:
      return "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300";
  }
};

const toneBar = (tone?: EvalScoreTone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case "warn":
      return "bg-amber-500";
    case "fail":
      return "bg-red-500";
    default:
      return "bg-emerald-500";
  }
};

/**
 * EvalScoreTable - evaluation runs report with score bars and test criteria
 * cards (OpenAI Evals / Braintrust experiments pattern).
 */
export default function EvalScoreTable({
  runs,
  criteria = [],
  title = "Evaluation report",
  className = "",
  onRunSelect,
  onAddCriteria,
}: EvalScoreTableProps) {
  return (
    <div
      data-eval-score-table
      className={`w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {runs.length} runs
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="px-4 py-3">
        <table data-eval-runs className="w-full text-left">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <th className="py-1.5 pr-3 font-medium">Run</th>
              <th className="py-1.5 pr-3 font-medium">Score</th>
              <th className="py-1.5 font-medium">Grader</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {runs.map((run) => (
              <tr
                key={run.id}
                data-eval-run={run.id}
                onClick={() => onRunSelect?.(run)}
                className={`border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${
                  onRunSelect ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" : ""
                }`}
              >
                <td className="py-2 pr-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{run.name}</td>
                <td className="py-2 pr-3">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span data-eval-score className={`rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums ${toneClasses(run.tone)}`}>
                      {run.score}%
                    </span>
                    <span className="h-1.5 w-20 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                      <span
                        data-eval-score-bar
                        className={`block h-full rounded-full ${toneBar(run.tone)}`}
                        style={{ width: `${Math.min(Math.max(run.score, 0), 100)}%` }}
                      />
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="py-2 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{run.grader ?? "—"}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>

        {criteria.length > 0 && (
          <div data-eval-criteria className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {criteria.map((c) => (
              <div
                key={c.id}
                data-eval-criterion={c.id}
                className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-700"
              >
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{c.title}</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {c.description}
                </p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {onAddCriteria && (
          <button
            type="button"
            data-eval-add-criteria
            onClick={() => onAddCriteria()}
            className="mt-3 flex w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 py-3 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          >
            <span className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-sm dark:bg-zinc-800">+</span>
            Add criteria
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * EvalTurnBuilder - Evaluation scenario builder: role-tagged conversation
 * turns (system / user / assistant / tool response) with per-turn mock
 * content and an add-turn footer (Vapi Evals pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export type EvalTurnRole = "system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool";

export interface EvalTurn {
  id: string;
  role: EvalTurnRole;
  turn: number;
  content: string;
  mock?: boolean;
}

export interface EvalTurnBuilderProps {
  turns?: EvalTurn[];
  className?: string;
  onTurnRemove?: (turn: EvalTurn) => void;
  onAddTurn?: (role: EvalTurnRole) => void;
}

const ROLE_STYLES: Record<EvalTurnRole, { label: string; badge: string; icon: string }> = {
  system: { label: "SYSTEM", badge: "bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-950/60 dark:text-purple-300", icon: ">" },
  user: { label: "USER", badge: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300", icon: "?" },
  assistant: { label: "ASSISTANT", badge: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300", icon: "A" },
  tool: { label: "TOOL RESPONSE", badge: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300", icon: "T" },
};

const DEFAULT_TURNS: EvalTurn[] = [
  {
    id: "t1",
    role: "system",
    turn: 0,
    content: "# Appointment Scheduling Agent Prompt\n\nYou are Riley, an appointment scheduling voice assistant for Wellness Partners, a multi-specialty health clinic.",
    mock: false,
  },
  { id: "t2", role: "user", turn: 1, content: "Hi, can I reschedule my appointment to another time this week?", mock: true },
  { id: "t3", role: "assistant", turn: 2, content: "Sure, I can help with that. What day and time would you like to reschedule your appointment to?", mock: true },
  { id: "t4", role: "tool", turn: 3, content: 'reschedule_appointment \u2192 { "status": "success", "new_time": "Thursday at 2 PM" }', mock: true },
];

export default function EvalTurnBuilder({
  turns = DEFAULT_TURNS,
  className = "",
  onTurnRemove,
  onAddTurn,
}: EvalTurnBuilderProps) {
  return (
    <div data-eval-turn-builder className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-eval-turns className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {turns.map((t) => {
          const style = ROLE_STYLES[t.role];
          return (
            <div key={t.id} data-eval-turn={t.id} data-eval-role={t.role} className="p-4">
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span data-eval-turn-badge className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider ${style.badge}`}>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">{style.icon}</span> {style.label}
                  </span>
                  {t.mock && (
                    <span data-eval-turn-mock className="rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      Mock
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {t.turn > 0 && (
                    <span data-eval-turn-number className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Turn {t.turn}</span>
                  )}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-eval-turn-remove
                    aria-label={`Remove ${style.label.toLowerCase()} turn`}
                    className="text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:text-red-500 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-red-400"
                    onClick={() => onTurnRemove?.(t)}
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                </span>
              </div>
              <pre
                data-eval-turn-content
                className="max-h-40 overflow-y-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg border border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-300"
              >
                {t.content}
              </pre>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div data-eval-turn-add className="grid grid-cols-3 divide-x divide-zinc-100 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800">
        {(["user", "assistant", "tool"] as const).map((role) => (
          <button
            key={role}
            type="button"
            data-eval-add-turn={role}
            className="py-2.5 text-center text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
            onClick={() => onAddTurn?.(role)}
          >
            + Add {role === "tool" ? "Tool Response" : role.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + role.slice(1)}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
