/**
 * EventStreamPanel - Audit event stream: filter input, two-column event list
 * (event name / date and time), right metadata panel with actor info and
 * "View event" button, event details JSON block with line numbers and
 * Previous/Next pager
 * (WorkOS Events pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface StreamEvent {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  date: string;
  metadata: { label: string; value: string }[];
  details: string;
}

export interface EventStreamPanelProps {
  filterPlaceholder?: string;
  eventColumnLabel?: string;
  dateColumnLabel?: string;
  events?: StreamEvent[];
  metadataTitle?: string;
  detailsTitle?: string;
  detailsLines?: number;
  className?: string;
  onFilterChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onEventSelect?: (event: StreamEvent) => void;
  onViewEvent?: (event: StreamEvent) => void;
}

export default function EventStreamPanel({
  filterPlaceholder = "Filter by event name, data, or date range",
  eventColumnLabel = "Event",
  dateColumnLabel = "Date and time",
  events = [
    {
      id: "ev1",
      name: "user.updated",
      date: "Nov 14, 2026 3:12 PM",
      metadata: [
        { label: "User", value: "Sama Lee" },
        { label: "Email", value: "sama@example.com" },
        { label: "Environment", value: "Production" },
      ],
      details:
        '{\n  "event": "user.updated",\n  "user": {\n    "id": "user_01H9",\n    "email": "sama@example.com",\n    "first_name": "Sama",\n    "last_name": "Lee",\n    "email_verified": true\n  }\n}',
    },
    {
      id: "ev2",
      name: "organization_membership.updated",
      date: "Nov 14, 2026 2:48 PM",
      metadata: [
        { label: "Organization", value: "Acme Inc" },
        { label: "Role", value: "admin" },
      ],
      details: '{\n  "event": "organization_membership.updated",\n  "role": "admin"\n}',
    },
    {
      id: "ev3",
      name: "invitation.created",
      date: "Nov 14, 2026 11:05 AM",
      metadata: [{ label: "Email", value: "new hire" }],
      details: '{\n  "event": "invitation.created"\n}',
    },
    {
      id: "ev4",
      name: "connection.activated",
      date: "Nov 13, 2026 5:30 PM",
      metadata: [{ label: "Connection", value: "Okta SSO" }],
      details: '{\n  "event": "connection.activated"\n}',
    },
    {
      id: "ev5",
      name: "session.created",
      date: "Nov 13, 2026 9:02 AM",
      metadata: [{ label: "User", value: "Sama Lee" }],
      details: '{\n  "event": "session.created"\n}',
    },
  ],
  metadataTitle = "Metadata",
  detailsTitle = "Event Details",
  detailsLines = 10,
  className = "",
  onFilterChange,
  onEventSelect,
  onViewEvent,
}: EventStreamPanelProps) {
  const [filter, setFilter] = React.useState("");
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = React.useState(events[0]?.id ?? "");

  const filtered = filter
    ? events.filter((ev) => ev.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase()))
    : events;
  const active = events.find((ev) => ev.id === activeId) ?? events[0];
  const detailLineCount = Math.max(
    detailsLines,
    active ? active.details.split("\n").length : 1
  );

  const select = (ev: StreamEvent) => {
    setActiveId(ev.id);
    onEventSelect?.(ev);
  };

  return (
    <div data-stream-panel className={`grid w-full gap-4 lg:grid-cols-5 ${className}`}>
      {/* left: list */}
      <div data-stream-list className="lg:col-span-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <input
            data-stream-filter
            type="text"
            value={filter}
            placeholder={filterPlaceholder}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setFilter(e.target.value);
              onFilterChange?.(e.target.value);
            }}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 outline-none focus:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 dark:text-zinc-100 dark:placeholder-zinc-500"
          />
        </div>
        <div data-stream-columns className="grid grid-cols-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span>{eventColumnLabel}</span>
          <span>{dateColumnLabel}</span>
        </div>
        <ul data-stream-items>
          {filtered.map((ev) => (
            <li key={ev.id}>
              <button
                data-stream-event={ev.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => select(ev)}
                className={`grid w-full grid-cols-2 items-center px-4 py-3 text-left text-sm transition-colors ${
                  ev.id === active?.id
                    ? "bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60"
                    : "hover:bg-zinc-50/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40"
                }`}
              >
                <span className="truncate font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{ev.name}</span>
                <span className="truncate text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{ev.date}</span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
          {filtered.length === 0 && (
            <li className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No events match this filter</li>
          )}
        </ul>
      </div>

      {/* right: details */}
      <div data-stream-details className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4">
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <p data-stream-metadata-title className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{metadataTitle}</p>
          <dl data-stream-metadata className="mt-3 space-y-2">
            {(active?.metadata ?? []).map((m) => (
              <div key={m.label} className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
                <dt className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{m.label}</dt>
                <dd className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{m.value}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
          <button
            data-stream-view-event
            type="button"
            onClick={() => active && onViewEvent?.(active)}
            className="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200"
          >
            View event
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <p data-stream-details-title className="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50">{detailsTitle}</p>
          <div data-stream-json className="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[11px] leading-5">
            <span data-stream-json-lines aria-hidden="true" className="select-none text-right text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
              {Array.from({ length: detailLineCount }, (_, i) => i + 1).join("\n")}
            </span>
            <pre className="whitespace-pre text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300">{active?.details}</pre>
          </div>
          <div data-stream-pager className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <button type="button" className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">← Previous</button>
            <button type="button" className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">Next →</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface EventTagGridProps {

    ],
  },
  {
    id: "right",

    tags: [
      { key: "mechanism", value: "auto.browser.global_handlers.onunhandledrejection" },

    ],

export default function EventTagGrid({
  title = "Tags",
  scopes = ["All", "Custom", "Application", "Client", "Other"],
  activeScope = "All",
  groups = DEFAULT_GROUPS,
  className = "",
  onTagClick,
}: EventTagGridProps) {
  return (
    <div data-tag-grid className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>

                data-tag-scope={scope}
                aria-pressed={active}
                onClick={() => onTagClick?.({ key: scope, value: scope }, { id: "scope", title: scope, tags: [] })}
                className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                  active
                    ? "bg-white text-zinc-800 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-100"
                    : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                {scope}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div data-tag-grid-body className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 px-4 py-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        {groups.map((group) => (
          <dl key={group.id} data-tag-group={group.id} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            {group.tags.map((tag) => (
              <div key={tag.key} data-tag-row className="grid grid-cols-[9rem_1fr] items-baseline gap-2 text-xs">
                <dt data-tag-key className="truncate font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" title={tag.key}>{tag.key}</dt>
                <dd className="min-w-0">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-tag-value={tag.value}
                    onClick={() => onTagClick?.(tag, group)}
                    className={`block max-w-full truncate rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-left transition-colors ${
                      tag.link
                        ? "bg-zinc-50 text-sky-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-sky-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                        : "text-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
                    }`}
                    title={tag.value}
                  >
                    {tag.value}
                  </button>
                </dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: react\FederatedSearchResultsPanel.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface FederatedResult {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  snippet: string;
  source?: string;
}

export interface FederatedSearchResultsPanelProps {
  query?: string;
  results: FederatedResult[];
  sourceFilters?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  selectedSources?: string[];
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  showKeyboardLegend?: boolean;
  askAiLabel?: string;
  onQueryChange?: (query: string) => void;
  onSourceChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  onResultSelect?: (result: FederatedResult) => void;
}

const LEGEND = "↑↓ Navigate · ⏎ Select · ESC Close · ⇧⏎ Open in new tab";

/**
 * FederatedSearchResultsPanel - full-text search overlay with source filter chips, snippet results and a keyboard legend.
 */
export default function FederatedSearchResultsPanel({
  query = "",
  results,
  sourceFilters = [],
  selectedSources = [],
  searchPlaceholder = "Search everything…",
  showKeyboardLegend = true,
  askAiLabel = "Press Tab to Ask AI",
  onQueryChange,
  onSourceChange,
  onResultSelect,
}: FederatedSearchResultsPanelProps) {
  const [term, setTerm] = React.useState(query);
  const [scopes, setScopes] = React.useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(selectedSources));

  React.useEffect(() => setTerm(query), [query]);

  const highlight = (snippet: string) => {
    if (!term.trim()) return snippet;
    const parts = snippet.split(new RegExp(`(${term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")})`, "gi"));
    return parts.map((part, index) =>
      part.toLowerCase() === term.toLowerCase() ? (
        <mark key={index} className="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">{part}</mark>
      ) : (
        <React.Fragment key={index}>{part}</React.Fragment>
      ),
    );
  };

  const toggleSource = (id: string) => {
    setScopes((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      onSourceChange?.([...next]);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const filtered = scopes.size
    ? results.filter((result) => !result.source || scopes.has(result.source))
    : results;

  return (
    <div data-federated-search className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div className="relative">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
          </svg>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={term}
            data-federated-input
            placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
            onChange={(event) => { setTerm(event.target.value); onQueryChange?.(event.target.value); }}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
          />
        </div>
        {sourceFilters.length ? (
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {sourceFilters.map((filter) => {
              const active = scopes.has(filter.id);
              return (
                <button
                  key={filter.id}
                  type="button"
                  data-source-chip={filter.id}
                  aria-pressed={active}
                  onClick={() => toggleSource(filter.id)}
                  className={`rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                    active
                      ? "border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300"
                      : "border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                  }`}
                >
                  {filter.label}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <ul className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto p-2">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <li data-federated-empty className="px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No results match your filters.</li>
        ) : (
          filtered.map((result) => (
            <li key={result.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-federated-result={result.id}
                onClick={() => onResultSelect?.(result)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {result.icon ? <span aria-hidden="true">{result.icon}</span> : null}
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{result.title}</span>
                  {result.source ? <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{result.source}</span> : null}
                </span>
                {result.subtitle ? <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{result.subtitle}</span> : null}
                <span className="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{highlight(result.snippet)}</span>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))
        )}
      </ul>
      {showKeyboardLegend ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <p data-federated-legend className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{LEGEND}</p>
          {askAiLabel ? (
            <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">{askAiLabel}</span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface AttachmentItem {
  id: string | number;
  name: string;
  size?: number;
  type?: string;
}

export interface FileAttachmentListProps {
  files: AttachmentItem[];
  onRemove?: (id: string | number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const formatFileSize = (bytes?: number): string => {
  if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null || Number.isNaN(bytes)) return "";
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
};

const iconForType = (type?: string, name?: string): UiIconName => {
  if (type?.startsWith("image/")) return "image";
  const ext = name?.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
  if (["js", "ts", "tsx", "jsx", "py", "java", "go", "rs", "vue", "html", "css", "json", "sh"].includes(ext)) return "code";
  return "paperclip";
};

export const FileAttachmentList: React.FC<FileAttachmentListProps> = ({ files = [], onRemove, className = "" }) => {
  if (files.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-wrap gap-2 ${className}`}>
      {files.map((f) => {
        const sizeText = formatFileSize(f.size);
        return (
          <div
            key={f.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 pr-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
          >
            <UiIcon name={iconForType(f.type, f.name)} size={14} className="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="max-w-40 truncate font-medium">{f.name}</span>
            {sizeText && <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 shrink-0">{sizeText}</span>}
            {onRemove && (
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={`Remove ${f.name}`}
                onClick={() => onRemove(f.id)}
                className="p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-colors shrink-0"
              >
                <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};
export default FileAttachmentList;


===== FILE: react\FileDropzone.tsx =====

import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface DropzoneFile {
  /** Stable key; falls back to name+index. */
  id?: string | number;
  name: string;
  /** Bytes. */
  size: number;
  type?: string;
}

export interface RejectedFile {
  name: string;
  reason: "type" | "size";
}

export interface FileDropzoneProps {
  files?: DropzoneFile[];
  /** Comma separated extensions or MIME wildcards, e.g. ".png,image/*". */
  accept?: string;
  multiple?: boolean;
  /** Reject files larger than this. */
  maxSizeMb?: number;
  hint?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onFiles?: (accepted: File[]) => void;
  onReject?: (rejected: RejectedFile[]) => void;
  onRemove?: (file: DropzoneFile, index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
  if (!bytes) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
  const exp = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exp;
  return `${value >= 10 || exp === 0 ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[exp]}`;
};

export const matchesAccept = (file: { name: string; type?: string }, accept?: string) => {
  if (!accept) return true;
  return accept
    .split(",")
    .map((token) => token.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .some((token) => {
      if (token.startsWith(".")) return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(token);
      if (token.endsWith("/*")) return Boolean(file.type && file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith(token.slice(0, -1)));
      return file.type?.toLowerCase() === token;
    });
};

const fileIcon = (file: DropzoneFile) => {
  if (file.type?.startsWith("image/")) return "image" as const;
  if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|rs|json|css|html)$/i.test(file.name)) return "code" as const;
  return "paperclip" as const;
};

export const FileDropzone: React.FC<FileDropzoneProps> = ({
  files = [],
  accept,
  multiple = true,
  maxSizeMb,
  hint,
  disabled = false,
  onFiles,
  onReject,
  onRemove,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleFiles = (incoming: FileList | File[] | null) => {
    const list = Array.from(incoming || []);
    if (list.length === 0) return;

    const rejected: RejectedFile[] = [];
    const accepted = list.filter((file) => {
      if (!matchesAccept(file, accept)) {
        rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: "type" });
        return false;
      }
      if (maxSizeMb && file.size > maxSizeMb * 1024 * 1024) {
        rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: "size" });
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    if (rejected.length) {
      const first = rejected[0];
      setError(
        first.reason === "size"
          ? `${first.name} is larger than ${maxSizeMb} MB`
          : `${first.name} is not an accepted file type`
      );
      onReject?.(rejected);
    } else {
      setError(null);
    }

    if (accepted.length) onFiles?.(multiple ? accepted : accepted.slice(0, 1));
  };

  const openPicker = () => {
    if (!disabled) inputRef.current?.click();
  };

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div
        role="button"
        tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
        aria-label={hint || "Drop files here or browse"}
        aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
        onClick={openPicker}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
            e.preventDefault();
            openPicker();
          }
        }}
        onDragOver={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (!disabled) setDragging(true);
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
        onDrop={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragging(false);
          if (!disabled) handleFiles(e.dataTransfer?.files ?? null);
        }}
        className={`flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-7 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          dragging
            ? "border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30"
            : "border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600"
        } ${disabled ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" : ""}`}
      >
        <span className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <UiIcon name="upload" size={16} />
        </span>
        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          Drag & drop {multiple ? "files" : "a file"} here, or <span className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">browse</span>
        </p>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
          {hint || [accept ? `Accepts ${accept}` : null, maxSizeMb ? `up to ${maxSizeMb} MB` : null].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || "Any file type"}
        </p>
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="file"
          hidden
          accept={accept}
          multiple={multiple}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => {
            handleFiles(e.target.files);
            e.target.value = "";
          }}
        />
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">
          <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" size={12} />
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      {files.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
          {files.map((file, index) => (
            <li
              key={file.id ?? `${file.name}-${index}`}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1.5"
            >
              <span className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
                <UiIcon name={fileIcon(file)} size={14} />
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{file.name}</span>
                <span className="block text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{formatBytes(file.size)}</span>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={`Remove ${file.name}`}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  onRemove?.(file, index);
                }}
                className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              >
                <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FileDropzone;


===== FILE: react\FilterBar.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface FilterOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

export interface FilterDefinition {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options: FilterOption[];
}

export interface FilterBarProps {
  filters: FilterDefinition[];
  /** Controlled selection map: filter id -> selected option values. */
  selected?: Record<string, string[]>;
  onChange?: (selected: Record<string, string[]>) => void;
  onClear?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const FilterBar: React.FC<FilterBarProps> = ({
  filters,
  selected,
  onChange,
  onClear,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const current = selected ?? internal;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!openId) return;
    const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpenId(null);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setOpenId(null);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [openId]);

  const commit = (next: Record<string, string[]>) => {
    if (selected === undefined) setInternal(next);
    onChange?.(next);
  };

  const toggleOption = (filterId: string, value: string) => {
    const values = current[filterId] ?? [];
    const nextValues = values.includes(value)
      ? values.filter((entry) => entry !== value)
      : [...values, value];
    const next = { ...current };
    if (nextValues.length > 0) next[filterId] = nextValues;
    else delete next[filterId];
    commit(next);
  };

  const clearAll = () => {
    commit({});
    onClear?.();
  };

  const activeCount = Object.values(current).reduce((total, values) => total + values.length, 0);

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
      {filters.map((filter) => {
        const values = current[filter.id] ?? [];
        const active = values.length > 0;
        const open = openId === filter.id;
        return (
          <div key={filter.id} className="relative">
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-expanded={open}
              aria-haspopup="true"
              onClick={() => setOpenId(open ? null : filter.id)}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                active
                  ? "border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300"
                  : "border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600"
              }`}
            >
              <span>{filter.label}</span>
              {active && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1 text-[9px] tabular-nums text-white">
                  {values.length}
                </span>
              )}
              <UiIcon name="chevron-down" size={11} className={open ? "rotate-180 transition-transform" : "transition-transform"} />
            </button>

            {open && (
              <div className="absolute left-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-48 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                {filter.options.map((option) => {
                  const checked = values.includes(option.value);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={option.value}
                      type="button"
                      aria-pressed={checked}
                      onClick={() => toggleOption(filter.id, option.value)}
                      className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                    >
                      <span
                        className={`flex h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border ${
                          checked
                            ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                            : "border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {checked && <UiIcon name="check" size={9} strokeWidth={3} />}
                      </span>
                      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{option.label}</span>
                      {option.count !== undefined && (
                        <span className="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                          {option.count}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {activeCount > 0 && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={clearAll}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={11} />
          Clear all
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FilterBar;

import React from "react";

export interface QueryFilterField {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  operators?: string[];
}

export interface QueryFilterRow {
  id: string;
  conjunction: "where" | "and" | "or";
  field: string;
  operator: string;
  value: string;
}

export interface FilterQueryBuilderProps {
  fields?: QueryFilterField[];
  rows?: QueryFilterRow[];
  addLabel?: string;
  clearLabel?: string;
  maxRows?: number;
  onChange?: (rows: QueryFilterRow[]) => void;
  onApply?: (rows: QueryFilterRow[]) => void;
  onClear?: () => void;
}

const OPERATORS = ["equals", "not-equals", "greater", "less", "contains", "gte", "lte"];
const OPERATOR_GLYPH: Record<string, string> = {
  equals: "=",
  "not-equals": "<>",
  greater: ">",
  less: "<",
  contains: "~",
  gte: ">=",
  lte: "<=",
};

/**
 * FilterQueryBuilder - compositional field/operator/value filter rows with conjunction chips.
 */
export default function FilterQueryBuilder({
  fields = [],
  rows = [],
  addLabel = "+ Add filter",
  clearLabel = "Clear filters",
  maxRows = 8,
  onChange,
  onApply,
  onClear,
}: FilterQueryBuilderProps) {
  const fieldFor = (name: string) => fields.find((field) => field.name === name);
  const operatorsFor = (name: string) => fieldFor(name)?.operators || OPERATORS;

  const update = (next: QueryFilterRow[]) => {
    onChange?.(next);
    onApply?.(next);
  };

  return (
    <div data-filter-query-builder className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {rows.map((row, index) => (
          <div key={row.id} data-filter-row={row.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className={`rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${index === 0 ? "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300"}`}>
              {row.conjunction}
            </span>
            <select
              data-filter-field
              value={row.field}
              onChange={(event) => update(rows.map((item) => (item.id === row.id ? { ...item, field: event.target.value, operator: "equals" } : item)))}
              className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
            >
              {fields.map((field) => (
                <option key={field.name} value={field.name}>{field.label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <select
              data-filter-operator
              value={row.operator}
              onChange={(event) => update(rows.map((item) => (item.id === row.id ? { ...item, operator: event.target.value } : item)))}
              className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
            >
              {operatorsFor(row.field).map((op) => (
                <option key={op} value={op}>{OPERATOR_GLYPH[op] || op}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <input
              type="text"
              data-filter-value
              value={row.value}
              placeholder="Value"
              onChange={(event) => update(rows.map((item) => (item.id === row.id ? { ...item, value: event.target.value } : item)))}
              className="min-w-[100px] flex-1 rounded-md border border-transparent bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:border-indigo-400 focus-visible:outline-none dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              data-filter-remove
              aria-label="Remove filter"
              onClick={() => update(rows.filter((item) => item.id !== row.id))}
              className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 rounded-full text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="mx-auto h-3 w-3"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
        {rows.length === 0 ? <p data-filter-empty className="py-1 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No filters applied.</p> : null}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-filter-add
          disabled={rows.length >= maxRows}
          onClick={() =>
            update([
              ...rows,
              { id: `f${Date.now()}`, conjunction: rows.length === 0 ? "where" : "and", field: fields[0]?.name || "", operator: "equals", value: "" },
            ])
          }
          className="rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40"
        >
          {addLabel}
        </button>
        {rows.length ? (
          <button type="button" data-filter-clear onClick={() => { onChange?.([]); onClear?.(); }} className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 hover:underline dark:text-zinc-400">
            {clearLabel}
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface FilterChip {

  onSearch?: (value: string) => void;
  onAction?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

};

export const FilterToolbar: React.FC<FilterToolbarProps> = ({
  chips,

  className = "",

                </p>
              )}
              {job.status === "training" && (

                  <div data-finetune-progress className="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                    <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-all" style={{ width: `${job.progress ?? 0}%` }}></div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="w-8 text-right font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{job.progress ?? 0}%</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {active && (
                <div className="mt-2 flex justify-end">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-finetune-cancel
                    onClick={() => onCancel?.(job)}
                    className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-600 hover:underline dark:text-red-400"
                  >
                    Cancel job
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {jobs.length === 0 && (
          <div data-finetune-empty className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">
            No fine-tuning jobs yet.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\FluidContourBackdrop.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export interface FluidContourBackdropProps {
  /** Ink RGB normalized [0-1], default [0.17, 0.23, 0.19] */
  inkColor?: [number, number, number];
  /** Paper RGB normalized [0-1], default [0.98, 0.98, 0.96] */
  paperColor?: [number, number, number];
  /** Animation time delta factor, default 0.035 */
  speed?: number;
  /** Whether the contour line reacts to pointer / cursor gravity */
  interactive?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const VERT = `
attribute vec2 a_pos;
void main() { gl_Position = vec4(a_pos, 0.0, 1.0); }
`;

const FRAG = `
#extension GL_OES_standard_derivatives : enable
precision highp float;
uniform vec2 u_res;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_mouse;
uniform vec3 u_ink;
uniform vec3 u_paper;

vec3 mod289(vec3 x) { return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0; }
vec4 mod289(vec4 x) { return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0; }
vec4 permute(vec4 x) { return mod289(((x * 34.0) + 1.0) * x); }
vec4 taylorInvSqrt(vec4 r) { return 1.79284291400159 - 0.85373472095314 * r; }

float snoise(vec3 v) {
  const vec2 C = vec2(1.0 / 6.0, 1.0 / 3.0);
  const vec4 D = vec4(0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0);
  vec3 i = floor(v + dot(v, C.yyy));
  vec3 x0 = v - i + dot(i, C.xxx);
  vec3 g = step(x0.yzx, x0.xyz);
  vec3 l = 1.0 - g;
  vec3 i1 = min(g.xyz, l.zxy);
  vec3 i2 = max(g.xyz, l.zxy);
  vec3 x1 = x0 - i1 + C.xxx;
  vec3 x2 = x0 - i2 + C.yyy;
  vec3 x3 = x0 - D.yyy;
  i = mod289(i);
  vec4 p = permute(permute(permute(
    i.z + vec4(0.0, i1.z, i2.z, 1.0)) +
    i.y + vec4(0.0, i1.y, i2.y, 1.0)) +
    i.x + vec4(0.0, i1.x, i2.x, 1.0));
  float n_ = 0.142857142857;
  vec3 ns = n_ * D.wyz - D.xzx;
  vec4 j = p - 49.0 * floor(p * ns.z * ns.z);
  vec4 x_ = floor(j * ns.z);
  vec4 y_ = floor(j - 7.0 * x_);
  vec4 x = x_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;
  vec4 y = y_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;
  vec4 h = 1.0 - abs(x) - abs(y);
  vec4 b0 = vec4(x.xy, y.xy);
  vec4 b1 = vec4(x.zw, y.zw);
  vec4 s0 = floor(b0) * 2.0 + 1.0;
  vec4 s1 = floor(b1) * 2.0 + 1.0;
  vec4 sh = -step(h, vec4(0.0));
  vec4 a0 = b0.xzyw + s0.xzyw * sh.xxyy;
  vec4 a1 = b1.xzyw + s1.xzyw * sh.zzww;
  vec3 p0 = vec3(a0.xy, h.x);
  vec3 p1 = vec3(a0.zw, h.y);
  vec3 p2 = vec3(a1.xy, h.z);
  vec3 p3 = vec3(a1.zw, h.w);
  vec4 norm = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(p0, p0), dot(p1, p1), dot(p2, p2), dot(p3, p3)));
  p0 *= norm.x; p1 *= norm.y; p2 *= norm.z; p3 *= norm.w;
  vec4 m = max(0.6 - vec4(dot(x0, x0), dot(x1, x1), dot(x2, x2), dot(x3, x3)), 0.0);
  m = m * m;
  return 42.0 * dot(m * m, vec4(dot(p0, x0), dot(p1, x1), dot(p2, x2), dot(p3, x3)));
}

float cursorHill(vec2 frag, float radius) {
  vec2 d = (frag - u_mouse) / u_res.y;
  return exp(-dot(d, d) / (2.0 * radius * radius));
}

vec4 inkAt(float a) {
  float n = fract(sin(dot(gl_FragCoord.xy, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
  a = max(0.0, a + (n - 0.5) / 255.0);
  return vec4(u_ink * a, a);
}

void main() {
  vec2 p = gl_FragCoord.xy / u_res.y;
  float f = snoise(vec3(p * 1.6, u_time)) + 0.5 * snoise(vec3(p * 3.4, u_time * 1.3));
  f += 0.45 * cursorHill(gl_FragCoord.xy, 0.16);
  float bands = f * 6.0;
  float line = abs(fract(bands) - 0.5) / fwidth(bands);
  float a = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, line);
  float index = 1.0 - step(0.5, mod(floor(bands + 0.5), 4.0));
  a *= mix(0.045, 0.08, index);
  gl_FragColor = inkAt(a);
}
`;

// Module-level defaults: a fresh array literal per render would change the
// effect deps identity every parent render and rebuild the WebGL context.
const DEFAULT_INK_COLOR: [number, number, number] = [0.17, 0.23, 0.19];
const DEFAULT_PAPER_COLOR: [number, number, number] = [0.98, 0.98, 0.96];

export const FluidContourBackdrop: React.FC<FluidContourBackdropProps> = ({
  inkColor = DEFAULT_INK_COLOR,
  paperColor = DEFAULT_PAPER_COLOR,
  speed = 0.035,
  interactive = true,
  className = "",
  style,
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;

    const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl", {
      alpha: true,
      antialias: false,
      premultipliedAlpha: true,
      powerPreference: "low-power",
    });
    if (!gl) return;

    gl.getExtension("OES_standard_derivatives");

    function compile(type: number, src: string) {
      const s = gl!.createShader(type);
      if (!s) throw new Error("Failed to create shader");
      gl!.shaderSource(s, src);
      gl!.compileShader(s);
      if (!gl!.getShaderParameter(s, gl!.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
        const info = gl!.getShaderInfoLog(s);
        gl!.deleteShader(s);
        throw new Error(info || "Shader compilation failed");
      }
      return s;
    }

    let prog: WebGLProgram | null = null;
    let vs: WebGLShader | null = null;
    let fs: WebGLShader | null = null;
    let buf: WebGLBuffer | null = null;

    try {
      vs = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, VERT);
      fs = compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, FRAG);
      prog = gl.createProgram();
      if (!prog) return;

      gl.attachShader(prog, vs);
      gl.attachShader(prog, fs);
      gl.linkProgram(prog);
      gl.useProgram(prog);

      buf = gl.createBuffer();
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
      gl.bufferData(
        gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,
        new Float32Array([-1, -1, 3, -1, -1, 3]),
        gl.STATIC_DRAW
      );

      const aPos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, "a_pos");
      gl.enableVertexAttribArray(aPos);
      gl.vertexAttribPointer(aPos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);

      const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_res");
      const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_time");
      const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_mouse");
      const uInk = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_ink");
      const uPaper = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_paper");

      gl.uniform3fv(uInk, inkColor);
      gl.uniform3fv(uPaper, paperColor);

      const dpr = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.devicePixelRatio || 1 : 1;
      const scale = Math.min(dpr, 2) * 0.75;

      const resize = () => {
        if (!canvas) return;
        const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(window.innerWidth * scale));
        const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(window.innerHeight * scale));
        if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
          canvas.width = w;
          canvas.height = h;
          gl.viewport(0, 0, w, h);
          gl.uniform2f(uRes, w, h);
        }
      };

      const mouse = { x: -1e4, y: -1e4, tx: -1e4, ty: -1e4 };

      const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!interactive) return;
        mouse.tx = e.clientX * scale;
        mouse.ty = (window.innerHeight - e.clientY) * scale;
        if (mouse.x < -1e3) {
          mouse.x = mouse.tx;
          mouse.y = mouse.ty;
        }
      };

      const onPointerLeave = () => {
        mouse.tx = -1e4;
        mouse.ty = -1e4;
      };

      window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
      document.documentElement.addEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);

      // Guard matchMedia (absent in jsdom); resolve before any listener is
      // registered so a throw here cannot leak the handlers below.
      const reducedQuery =
        typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
          ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
          : { matches: false };
      let t = 17;
      let last = performance.now();
      let raf = 0;

      const draw = () => {
        mouse.x += (mouse.tx - mouse.x) * 0.06;
        mouse.y += (mouse.ty - mouse.y) * 0.06;
        gl.uniform1f(uTime, t);
        gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
        gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
      };

      const loop = (now: number) => {
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        t += Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000) * speed;
        last = now;
        draw();
      };

      const start = () => {
        last = performance.now();
        if (reducedQuery.matches) {
          draw();
        } else {
          raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }
      };

      const stop = () => {
        if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      };

      const onVisibility = () => {
        if (document.hidden) stop();
        else start();
      };

      const onResize = () => {
        resize();
        if (reducedQuery.matches) draw();
      };

      window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

      resize();
      start();

      return () => {
        stop();
        window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
        document.documentElement.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);
        window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
        document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

        if (buf) gl.deleteBuffer(buf);
        if (prog) {
          if (vs) gl.deleteShader(vs);
          if (fs) gl.deleteShader(fs);
          gl.deleteProgram(prog);
        }
      };
    } catch {
      // Graceful fallback if WebGL is unavailable
    }
  }, [inkColor, paperColor, speed, interactive]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={`fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0 ${className}`}
      style={style}
    />
  );
};

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ForecastPoint {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  /** true renders the dashed/striped forecast column instead of the solid actual bar. */
  forecast?: boolean;
}

export interface ForecastTrendChartProps {
  headline: string | number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  deltaTone?: "emerald" | "rose" | "zinc";
  note?: string;
  points: ForecastPoint[];
  unit?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_TEXT: Record<NonNullable<ForecastTrendChartProps["deltaTone"]>, string> = {
  emerald: "text-emerald-600",
  rose: "text-rose-600",
  zinc: "text-zinc-400",
};

export const ForecastTrendChart: React.FC<ForecastTrendChartProps> = ({
  headline,
  deltaLabel,
  deltaTone = "emerald",
  note,
  points,
  unit,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const max = Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.value), 0.0001);
  const deltaIcon = deltaTone === "emerald" ? "trending-up" : deltaTone === "rose" ? "trending-down" : "minus";
  return (
    <div
      data-forecast-trend
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
        <p className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          {headline}
          {unit ? <span className="ml-1 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400">{unit}</span> : null}
        </p>
        {deltaLabel ? (
          <span className={`flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${TONE_TEXT[deltaTone]}`}>
            <UiIcon name={deltaIcon} size={12} />
            {deltaLabel}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {note ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400">{note}</p> : null}
      <div className="mt-4 flex h-28 items-end gap-1" role="img" aria-label="Trend with forecast">
        {points.map((point, index) => {
          const height = Math.max(4, Math.round((point.value / max) * 100));
          return (
            <div key={`${point.label}-${index}`} data-point-index={index} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <div className="relative flex h-full w-full items-end justify-center">
                {point.forecast ? (
                  <div
                    className="w-full max-w-6 rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-sky-400 bg-sky-100/50 dark:border-sky-500 dark:bg-sky-900/40"
                    style={{ height: `${height}%` }}
                    title={`${point.label}: ${point.value}${unit ?? ""} (forecast)`}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div
                    className="w-full max-w-6 rounded-md bg-sky-500 transition-all duration-300 dark:bg-sky-400"
                    style={{ height: `${height}%` }}
                    title={`${point.label}: ${point.value}${unit ?? ""}`}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
              <span className="truncate text-[9px] text-zinc-400">{point.label}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-4 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm bg-sky-500" /> Actual
        </span>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm border border-dashed border-sky-400 bg-sky-100/50" /> Forecast
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ForecastTrendChart;

        <div className="mt-2 grid gap-x-8 gap-y-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 p-4 sm:grid-cols-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
          {details.map((d) => (
            <div key={d.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
              <span className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{d.label}</span>
              <span className="font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{d.value}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* requests table */}
      <div data-formtrack-table className="mt-6">
        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Client form requests</p>

              <tr className="border-b border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/50 dark:text-zinc-500">
                <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold">Client</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold">Submitted</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold">Service</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold">Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>

                const meta = STATUS_META[r.status];
                return (
                  <tr
                    key={r.id}
                    data-formtrack-row={r.id}
                    onClick={() => onRequestClick?.(r)}
                    className="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-100 transition-colors last:border-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40"
                  >
                    <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <span className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:text-indigo-300">
                          {r.avatarUrl ? <img src={r.avatarUrl} alt={r.name} className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full object-cover" /> : r.initials ?? r.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{r.name}</span>
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{r.submitted}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{r.service}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                      <span data-formtrack-status={r.status} className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${meta.cls}`}>
                        {meta.label}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

===== FILE: react\GanttTimeline.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface GanttTask {
  label: string;
  start: number;
  span: number;
  progress?: number;
  tone?: "indigo" | "emerald" | "amber" | "sky";
  depth?: number;
}

export interface GanttTimelineProps {
  tasks: GanttTask[];
  columns?: number;
  today?: number;
  columnLabel?: string;
  rowLabel?: string;
  emptyText?: string;
  onTaskClick?: (task: GanttTask, index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_CLASS: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-500",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  sky: "bg-sky-500",
};

export const GanttTimeline: React.FC<GanttTimelineProps> = ({
  tasks,
  columns = 10,
  today,
  columnLabel = "Timeline",
  rowLabel = "Name",
  emptyText = "No tasks scheduled",
  onTaskClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const cells = Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, index) => index);

  return (
    <div
      data-gantt-timeline
      role="table"
      aria-label={columnLabel}
      aria-rowcount={tasks.length}
      className={`overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div
        role="row"
        className="flex items-center border-b border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40"
      >
        <span
          role="columnheader"
          className="w-44 shrink-0 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400"
        >
          {rowLabel}
        </span>
        <div className="relative flex min-w-0 flex-1">
          {cells.map((cell) => (
            <span
              key={cell}
              role="columnheader"
              className="min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 px-1 py-2 text-center text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800"
            >
              {cell + 1}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {tasks.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">{emptyText}</p>
      ) : (
        tasks.map((task, index) => {
          const tone = TONE_CLASS[task.tone || "indigo"];
          const offset = Math.min(Math.max(task.start, 0), columns) / columns;
          const width = Math.min(Math.max(task.span, 0), columns - Math.min(Math.max(task.start, 0), columns)) / columns;
          return (
            <div
              key={`${task.label}-${index}`}
              role="row"
              data-task-index={index}
              onClick={() => onTaskClick?.(task, index)}
              className={`flex items-stretch border-b border-zinc-50 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${
                onTaskClick ? "cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <span
                role="cell"
                className="flex w-44 shrink-0 items-center px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
                style={{ paddingLeft: `${1 + (task.depth || 0) * 1.25}rem` }}
              >
                <span className="truncate">{task.label}</span>
              </span>
              <div role="cell" className="relative min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                {cells.map((cell) => (
                  <span
                    key={cell}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="absolute inset-y-0 border-l border-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60"
                    style={{ left: `${(cell / columns) * 100}%` }}
                  />
                ))}
                {today !== undefined ? (
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="absolute inset-y-0 w-px bg-rose-400"
                    style={{ left: `${(Math.min(Math.max(today, 0), columns) / columns) * 100}%` }}
                  />
                ) : null}
                <div
                  data-task-bar
                  className="absolute top-1/2 flex h-4 -translate-y-1/2 items-center overflow-hidden rounded"
                  style={{
                    left: `${offset * 100}%`,
                    width: `calc(${width * 100}% - 4px)`,
                  }}
                >
                  <div className={`relative h-full ${tone}`}>
                    {task.progress !== undefined ? (
                      <span
                        className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-white/30"
                        style={{ width: `${Math.min(Math.max(task.progress, 0), 100)}%` }}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <span className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white">
                    {task.progress !== undefined ? `${task.progress}%` : ""}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GanttTimeline;


===== FILE: react\GroupedBarCompare.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface GroupedBarRow {
  name: string;
  estimated: number;
  actual: number;
  unit?: string;
}

export interface GroupedBarCompareProps {
  rows: GroupedBarRow[];
  title?: string;
  legendEstimated?: string;
  legendActual?: string;
  unit?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export const GroupedBarCompare: React.FC<GroupedBarCompareProps> = ({
  rows,
  title = "Estimated vs actual",
  legendEstimated = "Estimated",
  legendActual = "Actual",
  unit = "h",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const max = Math.max(...rows.flatMap((row) => [row.estimated, row.actual]), 0.0001);
  return (
    <div
      data-grouped-bar-compare
      role="table"
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-violet-400" />
            {legendEstimated}
          </span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-lime-400" />
            {legendActual}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-3" aria-label="Grouped bar chart">
        {rows.map((row, index) => {
          const estimatedHeight = Math.max(4, Math.round((row.estimated / max) * 100));
          const actualHeight = Math.max(4, Math.round((row.actual / max) * 100));
          return (
            <div key={`${row.name}-${index}`} data-bar-row={index} role="row" className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
              <div className="flex h-28 w-full items-end justify-center gap-1">
                <div className="flex h-full w-1/3 flex-col items-center justify-end">
                  <span className="mb-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    {row.estimated}
                    {row.unit ?? unit}
                  </span>
                  <div
                    className="w-full rounded-t-md bg-violet-400 transition-all duration-300"
                    style={{ height: `${estimatedHeight}%` }}
                    title={`${legendEstimated}: ${row.estimated}${row.unit ?? unit}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex h-full w-1/3 flex-col items-center justify-end">
                  <span className="mb-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    {row.actual}
                    {row.unit ?? unit}
                  </span>
                  <div
                    className="w-full rounded-t-md bg-lime-400 transition-all duration-300"
                    style={{ height: `${actualHeight}%` }}
                    title={`${legendActual}: ${row.actual}${row.unit ?? unit}`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className="w-full truncate text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{row.name}</span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GroupedBarCompare;
