/**
 * GroupedTaskList - Grouped task list with a split detail pane: left list
 * with collapsible sections (To Do / In Progress / Done), task rows with
 * completion circle, due date, subtask count and assignee avatar, "Add
 * task…" inline rows; right detail pane with completion badge, title,
 * assignee row, due date row, project chip, fields grid (estimated/actual
 * time, duration, summary, priority, tags) and a comment composer
 * (Asana list view pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface GroupedTask {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  due: string;
  done: boolean;
  subtasks?: number;
  likes?: number;
  comments?: number;
  assignee: string;
}

export interface TaskSection {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  tasks: GroupedTask[];
}

export interface TaskDetail {
  completedLabel?: string;
  title: string;
  assignee: string;
  due: string;
  project: string;
  projectStatus?: string;
  fields: { label: string; value: string; tone?: "rose" | "emerald" | "zinc" }[];
  tags?: string[];
  description?: string;
}

export interface GroupedTaskListProps {
  sections?: TaskSection[];
  detail?: TaskDetail;
  addTaskLabel?: string;
  commentPlaceholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  onTaskClick?: (task: GroupedTask) => void;
  onSectionToggle?: (sectionId: string, open: boolean) => void;
  onCommentSubmit?: (text: string) => void;
}

export default function GroupedTaskList({
  sections = [
    {
      id: "todo",
      label: "To Do",
      tasks: [
        { id: "t1", title: "Prepare Demo Materials", due: "", done: false, subtasks: 1, assignee: "JM" },
        { id: "t2", title: "Align Schedule with Other Divisions", due: "Jan 2, 2026", done: false, assignee: "JM" },
        { id: "t3", title: "Schedule a meeting to define Demo Scope & Key Features", due: "Tuesday", done: false, assignee: "AK" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "inprogress",
      label: "In Progress",
      tasks: [
        { id: "t4", title: "Define Product Demo Goal", due: "Tomorrow 3:30pm", done: false, likes: 1, comments: 2, subtasks: 1, assignee: "AK" },
        { id: "t5", title: "Scheduling a quick call with Product Owner", due: "Friday", done: false, assignee: "AK" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "done",
      label: "Done",
      tasks: [
        { id: "t6", title: "Scheduling a KickOff Meeting", due: "Dec 19", done: false, assignee: "JM" },
        { id: "t7", title: "Create a Template for Demo Script", due: "Dec 22", done: true, assignee: "AK" },
      ],
    },
  ],
  detail = {
    completedLabel: "Completed",
    title: "Define Product Demo Goal",
    assignee: "Alex Smith",
    due: "Tomorrow 3:30pm",
    project: "Product Demo – A",
    projectStatus: "In Progress",
    fields: [
      { label: "Estimated time", value: "3h 45m" },
      { label: "Actual time", value: "1h 36m" },
      { label: "Duration", value: "-1d 2h" },
      { label: "Task summary", value: "Documented Product Demo A goal including target audience, value message, success criteria & feature scope. Review requested by 8AM." },
      { label: "Priority", value: "High", tone: "rose" },
      { label: "Percent allocation", value: "–" },
    ],
    tags: ["documentation"],
    description: "Document the goal of Product Demo A, including target audience, primary value message, success criteria, and feature scope.",
  },
  addTaskLabel = "Add task…",
  commentPlaceholder = "Add a comment",
  className = "",
  onTaskClick,
  onSectionToggle,
  onCommentSubmit,
}: GroupedTaskListProps) {
  const [openSections, setOpenSections] = React.useState<string[]>([sections[0]?.id ?? "", sections[1]?.id ?? "", sections[2]?.id ?? ""]);
  const [activeTaskId, setActiveTaskId] = React.useState("t4");
  const [comment, setComment] = React.useState("");

  const toggle = (sectionId: string) => {
    setOpenSections((prev) => (prev.includes(sectionId) ? prev.filter((s) => s !== sectionId) : [...prev, sectionId]));
    onSectionToggle?.(sectionId, !openSections.includes(sectionId));
  };

  const valueCls = (tone?: string) =>
    tone === "rose"
      ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/70 dark:text-red-300"
      : tone === "emerald"
        ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300"
        : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100";

  return (
    <div data-tasklist className={`grid w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm lg:grid-cols-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {/* left: grouped list */}
      <div data-tasklist-list className="lg:col-span-3 border-r border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div data-tasklist-toolbar className="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button data-tasklist-add type="button" className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            ＋ Add task
          </button>
        </div>
        <div data-tasklist-name-header className="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
          Name
        </div>
        {sections.map((section) => {
          const open = openSections.includes(section.id);
          return (
            <div key={section.id} data-tasklist-section={section.id}>
              <button
                data-tasklist-section-toggle={section.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggle(section.id)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-left"
              >
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{open ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{section.label}</span>
              </button>
              {open && (
                <ul data-tasklist-items>
                  {section.tasks.map((task) => {
                    const active = task.id === activeTaskId;
                    return (
                      <li key={task.id}>
                        <button
                          data-tasklist-task={task.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setActiveTaskId(task.id);
                            onTaskClick?.(task);
                          }}
                          className={`flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition-colors ${
                            active ? "bg-sky-50 dark:bg-sky-950/40" : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span
                            aria-hidden="true"
                            className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[9px] ${
                              task.done
                                ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white"
                                : "border-zinc-300 text-transparent dark:border-zinc-600"
                            }`}
                          >
                            ✓
                          </span>
                          <span className={`flex-1 truncate ${task.done ? "text-zinc-400 line-through dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"}`}>{task.title}</span>
                          {task.likes ? <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">👍 {task.likes}</span> : null}
                          {task.comments ? <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">💬 {task.comments}</span> : null}
                          {task.subtasks ? <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">⑂ {task.subtasks}</span> : null}
                          <span className="w-24 shrink-0 truncate text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{task.due}</span>
                          <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-400 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-950">{task.assignee}</span>
                        </button>
                      </li>
                    );
                  })}
                  <li data-tasklist-add-inline className="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{addTaskLabel}</li>
                </ul>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* right: detail pane */}
      <div data-tasklist-detail className="space-y-4 lg:col-span-2 p-5">
        {detail.completedLabel && (
          <span data-tasklist-completed className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300">
            ✓ {detail.completedLabel}
          </span>
        )}
        <h2 data-tasklist-title className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{detail.title}</h2>

        <div data-tasklist-meta className="space-y-2.5 text-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="w-20 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Assignee</span>
            <span className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-400 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-950">{detail.assignee.split(" ").map((p) => p[0]).join("")}</span>
            <span className="text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{detail.assignee}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="w-20 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Due date</span>
            <span className="text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">🗓 {detail.due}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="w-20 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Projects</span>
            <span data-tasklist-project-chip className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-1 text-xs dark:bg-zinc-800">
              <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-sky-500"></span>
              <span className="font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{detail.project}</span>
              {detail.projectStatus && <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{detail.projectStatus}</span>}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div data-tasklist-fields className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
          {detail.fields.map((field, i) => (
            <div key={field.label} className={`grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs ${i > 0 ? "border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800" : ""}`}>
              <span className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{field.label}</span>
              <span className={`col-span-2 ${field.tone ? "rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium " + valueCls(field.tone) : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"}`}>{field.value}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          {detail.tags && detail.tags.length > 0 && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs dark:border-zinc-800">
              <span className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Tags</span>
              <span className="col-span-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {detail.tags.map((tag) => (
                  <span key={tag} className="rounded bg-emerald-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300">{tag} ✕</span>
                ))}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {detail.description && (
          <p data-tasklist-description className="text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{detail.description}</p>
        )}

        <div data-tasklist-comment className="flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-xs dark:bg-zinc-700">👤</span>
          <input
            data-tasklist-comment-input
            type="text"
            value={comment}
            placeholder={commentPlaceholder}
            onChange={(e) => setComment(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter" && comment.trim()) {
                onCommentSubmit?.(comment);
                setComment("");
              }
            }}
            className="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 outline-none focus:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 dark:text-zinc-100"
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\GuardrailReviewQueue.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export type GuardrailVerdict = "pending" | "approved" | "rejected";

export interface GuardrailItem {
  id: string;
  author: string;
  content: string;
  reasons: string[];
  rule?: string;
  confidence?: number;
  verdict?: GuardrailVerdict;
}

export interface GuardrailReviewQueueProps {
  items: GuardrailItem[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onApprove?: (item: GuardrailItem) => void;
  onReject?: (item: GuardrailItem) => void;
}

/**
 * GuardrailReviewQueue - moderation review queue for AI-flagged content:
 * cards with reason chips, rule hit and confidence, approve/reject actions
 * that collapse the card (Circle moderation / X moderation log pattern).
 */
export default function GuardrailReviewQueue({
  items,
  title = "Moderation queue",
  className = "",
  onApprove,
  onReject,
}: GuardrailReviewQueueProps) {
  const pending = items.filter((i) => (i.verdict ?? "pending") === "pending");

  return (
    <div
      data-guardrail-queue
      className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span
          data-guardrail-count
          className="ml-auto rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
        >
          {pending.length} flagged
        </span>
      </div>

      <div data-guardrail-list className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const verdict = item.verdict ?? "pending";
          if (verdict !== "pending") {
            return (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                data-guardrail-resolved={item.id}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
              >
                <span
                  className={`inline rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium ${
                    verdict === "approved"
                      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
                      : "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  {verdict === "approved" ? "✓ Approved" : "✕ Rejected"}
                </span>
                <span data-guardrail-resolved-author>{item.author}</span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{item.content}</span>
              </div>
            );
          }
          return (
            <div key={item.id} data-guardrail-card={item.id} className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span data-guardrail-author className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {item.author}
                </span>
                {typeof item.confidence === "number" && (
                  <span
                    data-guardrail-confidence
                    className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tabular-nums ${
                      item.confidence >= 0.9
                        ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
                        : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {Math.round(item.confidence * 100)}% confidence
                  </span>
                )}
                {item.rule && (
                  <span data-guardrail-rule className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {item.rule}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p
                data-guardrail-content
                className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200"
              >
                {item.content}
              </p>
              {item.reasons.length > 0 && (
                <div data-guardrail-reasons className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {item.reasons.map((reason) => (
                    <span
                      key={reason}
                      data-guardrail-reason
                      className="inline rounded bg-amber-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300"
                    >
                      {reason}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-guardrail-approve
                  onClick={() => onApprove?.(item)}
                  className="flex-1 rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500"
                >
                  Approve
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-guardrail-reject
                  onClick={() => onReject?.(item)}
                  className="flex-1 rounded-md bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-red-500"
                >
                  Reject
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {items.length === 0 && (
          <p data-guardrail-empty className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            No flagged content in the queue.
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\HealthDonutStats.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface HealthDonutSlice {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  tone: "indigo" | "amber" | "zinc" | "emerald" | "rose";
}

export interface HealthDonutStatsProps {
  cards: {
    title: string;
    caption?: string;
    slices: HealthDonutSlice[];
    action?: { label: string; onClick?: () => void };
  }[];
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_SLICE: Record<NonNullable<HealthDonutSlice["tone"]>, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  zinc: "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
  rose: "bg-rose-500",
};

const TONE_DOT: Record<NonNullable<HealthDonutSlice["tone"]>, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  zinc: "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
  rose: "bg-rose-500",
};

const donutStyle = (slices: HealthDonutSlice[]): React.CSSProperties => {
  const total = slices.reduce((sum, slice) => sum + Math.max(0, slice.value), 0) || 1;
  let cursor = 0;
  const stops: string[] = [];
  slices.forEach((slice) => {
    const start = (cursor / total) * 360;
    cursor += Math.max(0, slice.value);
    const end = (cursor / total) * 360;
    stops.push(`${TONE_SLICE[slice.tone].split(" ")[0]} ${start}deg ${end}deg`);
  });
  return { background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(", ")})` };
};

export const HealthDonutStats: React.FC<HealthDonutStatsProps> = ({ cards, className = "" }) => {
  if (!cards.length) return null;
  return (
    <div
      data-health-donut-stats
      className={`grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 ${className}`}
    >
      {cards.map((card, index) => {
        const total = card.slices.reduce((sum, slice) => sum + Math.max(0, slice.value), 0);
        const primary = card.slices.reduce(
          (best, slice) => (slice.value > best.value ? slice : best),
          card.slices[0] || { label: "", value: 0, tone: "indigo" as const },
        );
        const percent = total ? Math.round((primary.value / total) * 100) : 0;
        return (
          <div
            key={`${card.title}-${index}`}
            data-donut-card={index}
            className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className="relative h-16 w-16 shrink-0">
                <div className="h-16 w-16 rounded-full" style={donutStyle(card.slices)} />
                <div className="absolute inset-[10px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" data-donut-center>
                    {percent}%
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{card.title}</p>
                {card.caption ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{card.caption}</p> : null}
                <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                  {card.slices.map((slice, sliceIndex) => {
                    const share = total ? Math.round((slice.value / total) * 100) : 0;
                    return (
                      <li key={`${slice.label}-${sliceIndex}`} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                        <span className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${TONE_DOT[slice.tone]}`} />
                        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{slice.label}</span>
                        <span className="shrink-0 font-medium tabular-nums">{share}%</span>
                      </li>
                    );
                  })}
                </ul>
              </div>
            </div>
            {card.action ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                data-donut-action
                onClick={card.action.onClick}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                {card.action.label}
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default HealthDonutStats;

/**

 * submit button, "browse by topic" rows with chevrons and optional expanded

 */
import React from "react";

export interface HelpTopic {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  articles?: string[];
}

export interface HelpCenterHomeProps {
  title?: string;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  topics?: HelpTopic[];
  className?: string;
  onSearchSubmit?: (query: string) => void;
  onTopicClick?: (topic: HelpTopic) => void;
  onArticleClick?: (topic: HelpTopic, article: string) => void;
}

export default function HelpCenterHome({
  title = "Welcome to the Help Center",
  searchPlaceholder = "Cancellation, meeting point, etc.",
  topics = [
    { id: "plan", label: "Plan, search and book" },
    { id: "activity", label: "Activity information" },
    { id: "voucher", label: "Booking confirmation, voucher and tickets" },
    { id: "pickup", label: "Meeting point and pickup" },
    { id: "day", label: "On the day of the activity" },
    { id: "management", label: "Booking management", articles: ["Change the date or time", "Cancel your booking", "Refund policy"] },
    { id: "cancellation", label: "Cancellation" },
    { id: "payment", label: "Payment and refunds" },
  ],
  className = "",
  onSearchSubmit,
  onTopicClick,
  onArticleClick,
}: HelpCenterHomeProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [openId, setOpenId] = React.useState<string | null>("management");

  return (
    <div data-helpct className={`w-full rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-5 py-8 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 sm:px-8 ${className}`}>
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center">
        <h2 data-helpct-title className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h2>
        <p data-helpct-label className="mt-6 text-left text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">Search for a topic</p>
        <form
          data-helpct-form
          className="mt-2 flex overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 focus-within:border-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            onSearchSubmit?.(query);
          }}
        >
          <input
            type="search"
            data-helpct-input
            value={query}
            placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-zinc-700 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
          />
          <button type="submit" data-helpct-submit className="bg-indigo-600 px-5 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-indigo-400" aria-label="Search">
            🔍
          </button>
        </form>

        <p data-helpct-browse className="mt-8 text-left text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">Or browse by topic</p>
        <div data-helpct-topics className="mt-2 text-left">
          {topics.map((topic) => {
            const open = openId === topic.id;
            const expandable = Array.isArray(topic.articles) && topic.articles.length > 0;
            return (
              <div key={topic.id} data-helpct-topic={topic.id} className="border-b border-zinc-200 last:border-0 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-helpct-topic-btn={topic.id}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (expandable) {
                      setOpenId(open ? null : topic.id);
                    }
                    onTopicClick?.(topic);
                  }}
                  className="flex w-full items-center justify-between py-4 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:text-indigo-300"
                >
                  <span>{topic.label}</span>
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{expandable ? (open ? "▾" : "›") : "›"}</span>
                </button>
                {expandable && open ? (
                  <div data-helpct-articles={topic.id} className="pb-4">
                    {topic.articles!.map((a) => (
                      <button
                        key={a}
                        type="button"
                        data-helpct-article={a}
                        onClick={() => onArticleClick?.(topic, a)}
                        className="block py-1.5 text-left text-sm text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:underline dark:text-indigo-300"
                      >
                        {a}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface HeroSectionProps {

  title: string;

  secondaryCta?: string;

export const HeroSection: React.FC<HeroSectionProps> = ({

  title,

  onPrimary,
  onSecondary,
  className = "",

  return (
    <section
      className={`flex flex-col ${centered ? "items-center text-center" : "items-start text-left"} ${className}`}
    >
      {eyebrow && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300">
          <UiIcon name="sparkles" size={12} />
          {eyebrow}
        </span>
      )}

      <h1 className="mt-4 max-w-2xl text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 sm:text-4xl dark:text-zinc-50">
        {title}
      </h1>

      {description && (
        <p className={`mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${centered ? "mx-auto" : ""}`}>
          {description}
        </p>
      )}

      {(primaryCta || secondaryCta) && (
        <div className={`mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 ${centered ? "justify-center" : ""}`}>
          {primaryCta && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onPrimary}
              className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-950"
            >
              {primaryCta}
            </button>
          )}
          {secondaryCta && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onSecondary}
              className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              {secondaryCta}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {highlights.length > 0 && (
        <ul className={`mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-2 ${centered ? "justify-center" : ""}`}>
          {highlights.map((item) => (
            <li key={item} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              <UiIcon name="check" size={13} className="shrink-0 text-emerald-500" />
              {item}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

export default HeroSection;

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

/**
 * HomepageDashboard — React
 * A copy-paste, zero-backbox single-file homelab dashboard with the iconic
 * gethomepage/homepage look: header (title + live clock + search) + responsive
 * grouped service cards with status dots/pills + version footer.
 *
 * ORIGINAL implementation of the visual design language of
 * https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage (GPL-3.0). No GPL source copied.
 */
export type HomepageStatus = "online" | "up" | "down" | "offline" | "warn" | "error" | "unknown";

export interface HomepageService {
  /** Optional stable key — used for React reconciliation; falls back to name+index */
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  /** URL, data-URI, relative path, single-emoji, or omitted (letter monogram fallback) */
  icon?: string;
  /** Only http(s), mailto, protocol-relative, root-relative and dot-relative URLs are rendered as a link */
  href?: string;
  /** fallback/pill label, e.g. "12ms" */
  pingText?: string;
  status?: HomepageStatus;
}

export interface HomepageGroup {
  name: string;
  icon?: string;
  services: HomepageService[];
}

export interface HomepageDashboardProps {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  version?: string;
  groups?: HomepageGroup[];
  headerStyle?: "underlined" | "boxed" | "clean";
  statusStyle?: "pill" | "dot" | "none";
  showClock?: boolean;
  showSearch?: boolean;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  collapsible?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  /** Emitted when a group is collapsed/expanded (parity with Vue `group-toggle` emit and Vanilla CustomEvent) */
  onToggleGroup?: (group: string, collapsed: boolean) => void;
}

export const statusConfig = (
  status?: HomepageStatus
): { dot: string; pill: string; label: string } => {
  switch (status) {
    case "online":
    case "up":
      return { dot: "bg-emerald-500", pill: "text-emerald-500/90", label: "UP" };
    case "down":
    case "offline":
      return { dot: "bg-rose-500", pill: "text-rose-500/90", label: "DOWN" };
    case "warn":
      return { dot: "bg-amber-500", pill: "text-amber-500", label: "WARN" };
    case "error":
      return { dot: "bg-orange-500", pill: "text-orange-500", label: "ERROR" };
    default:
      return { dot: "bg-zinc-400/60 dark:bg-zinc-500/60", pill: "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400", label: "—" };
  }
};

const STATUS_STYLES = ["pill", "dot", "none"] as const;
export type HomepageStatusStyle = (typeof STATUS_STYLES)[number];

/** Unknown values quietly fall back to "pill" (they must never silently hide all status UI). */
const resolveStatusStyle = (value?: string): HomepageStatusStyle =>
  STATUS_STYLES.includes(value as HomepageStatusStyle) ? (value as HomepageStatusStyle) : "pill";

/** Only allow safe URL protocols into the anchor. Blocks javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file: … */
export const isSafeHref = (href?: string): boolean => {
  if (typeof href !== "string") return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith("//") || t.startsWith("/") || t.startsWith("./") || t.startsWith("../")) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

const ServiceIcon: React.FC<{ service: HomepageService }> = ({ service }) => {
  const monogram = (service.name || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  const wrap =
    "shrink-0 my-1.5 ml-1.5 w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-white/10";
  if (!service.icon) {
    return (
      <div className={wrap}>
        <span className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300">{monogram}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (/^(https?:|data:|\.|\/)/i.test(service.icon)) {
    return (
      <div className={wrap}>
        <img
          src={service.icon}
          alt=""
          loading="lazy"
          width={32}
          height={32}
          className="w-8 h-8 object-contain"
          onError={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.display = "none")}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={wrap}>
      <span className="text-xl leading-none">{service.icon}</span>
    </div>
  );
};

/** Self-contained ticking clock — isolates re-render storms to this subtree only. */
const Clock: React.FC = () => {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => new Date());
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setNow(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);
  return (
    <div className="text-right shrink-0 min-w-28">
      <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 leading-tight">
        {now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}
      </div>
      <div className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        {now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export const HomepageDashboard: React.FC<HomepageDashboardProps> = ({
  title = "Homepage",
  subtitle = "A highly customizable homelab dashboard",
  version = "Homepage · awesome-ui",
  groups = [],
  headerStyle = "underlined",
  statusStyle = "pill",
  showClock = true,
  showSearch = false,
  searchPlaceholder = "Search services…",
  collapsible = true,
  className = "",
  onToggleGroup,
}) => {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const effectiveStatusStyle = resolveStatusStyle(statusStyle);

  const trimmedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!trimmedQuery) return groups;
    return groups
      .map((g) => ({
        ...g,
        services: (g.services || []).filter(
          (s) =>
            (s.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(trimmedQuery) ||
            (s.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(trimmedQuery)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((g) => g.services.length > 0);
  }, [groups, trimmedQuery]);

  const toggleGroup = (name: string) => {
    if (!collapsible) return;
    setCollapsed((prev) => {
      const next = !prev[name];
      onToggleGroup?.(name, next);
      return { ...prev, [name]: next };
    });
  };

  const headerCls =
    headerStyle === "boxed"
      ? "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-0 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-white/5 shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 p-4"
      : headerStyle === "clean"
        ? "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-0"
        : "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-1 border-b-2 border-zinc-300/70 dark:border-zinc-700 pb-4";

  const searching = trimmedQuery.length > 0;
  const emptyMessage = groups.length === 0
    ? "No services configured yet."
    : searching
      ? `No matching services for “${trimmedQuery}”.`
      : "No services configured yet.";

  return (
    <div
      className={`homepage-dashboard relative w-full rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 overflow-hidden ${className}`}
      style={{ fontFamily: "'Manrope', 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" }}
    >
      <header className={headerCls}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-4">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h1>
            {subtitle && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{subtitle}</p>}
          </div>
          {(showSearch || showClock) && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
              {showSearch && (
                <div className="relative w-full sm:w-64">
                  <svg
                    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                    viewBox="0 0 20 20"
                    fill="currentColor"
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  >
                    <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M9 3.5a5.5 5.5 0 1 0 0 11 5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-11ZM2 9a7 7 0 1 1 12.452 4.391l2.328 2.328a.75.75 0 1 1-1.06 1.06l-2.328-2.328A7 7 0 0 1 2 9Z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                  </svg>
                  <input
                    type="search"
                    value={query}
                    onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
                    aria-label="Search services"
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-white/5 px-9 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-400 dark:focus:ring-zinc-500"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
              {showClock && <Clock />}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="flex flex-wrap items-start px-3 sm:px-5 pb-4">
        {filteredGroups.length === 0 && <p className="p-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">{emptyMessage}</p>}
        {filteredGroups.map((group, groupIndex) => {
          const isCollapsed = Boolean(collapsed[group.name]);
          return (
            <div key={`${group.name}-${groupIndex}`} className="services-group w-full md:w-1/2 lg:w-1/3 xl:w-1/4 p-1 pb-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleGroup(group.name)}
                aria-expanded={!isCollapsed}
                className={`group-header flex w-full select-none items-center gap-1 py-0.5 ${collapsible ? "" : "cursor-default"}`}
              >
                {group.icon && (
                  <span className="mr-2 inline-flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-white/10 text-sm leading-none">
                    {group.icon}
                  </span>
                )}
                <h2 className="text-xl font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">{group.name}</h2>
                {collapsible && (
                  <svg
                    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="2"
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className={`w-5 h-5 ml-auto transition-transform duration-200 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 ${isCollapsed ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}
                  >
                    <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
                  </svg>
                )}
              </button>
              {!isCollapsed && (
                <ul className="mt-2">
                  {group.services.map((service, i) => {
                    const cfg = statusConfig(service.status);
                    const safeHref = isSafeHref(service.href) ? service.href : undefined;
                    const statusLabel = service.pingText || cfg.label;
                    const key = service.id ?? `${group.name}-${service.name}-${i}`;
                    const content = (
                      <>
                        <ServiceIcon service={service} />
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 px-2 py-2.5 text-sm text-left">
                          <div className="truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                            {service.name}
                          </div>
                          {service.description && (
                            <div className="truncate mt-0.5 text-xs font-light text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300">
                              {service.description}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    );
                    return (
                      <li
                        key={key}
                        data-name={service.name || ""}
                        className="service-card relative overflow-clip rounded-md shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 dark:shadow-zinc-900/20 bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-white/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-all mb-2 p-0.5"
                      >
                        {safeHref ? (
                          <a href={safeHref} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="flex select-none items-center">
                            {content}
                          </a>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex select-none items-center">{content}</div>
                        )}
                        {effectiveStatusStyle === "dot" && (
                          <span
                            title={statusLabel}
                            role="img"
                            aria-label={statusLabel}
                            className={`absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 h-3 w-3 rounded-full ${cfg.dot}`}
                          />
                        )}
                        {effectiveStatusStyle === "pill" && (
                          <span
                            role="img"
                            aria-label={statusLabel}
                            className={`absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-1.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-500/10 dark:bg-zinc-400/10 ${cfg.pill}`}
                          >
                            {statusLabel}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </li>
                    );
                  })}
                </ul>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </main>

      <footer className="px-5 py-6 text-right">
        <a
          href="https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage"
          target="_blank"
          rel="noreferrer"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
        >
          <span>{version}</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </a>
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
};

export default HomepageDashboard;

import React from "react";

export interface ImageMenuAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  danger?: boolean;
}

export interface ImageActionMenuProps {
  open?: boolean;
  actions?: ImageMenuAction[];
  className?: string;
  onAction?: (action: ImageMenuAction) => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

/**
 * ImageActionMenu - Krea generated-image context menu: Fullscreen / Vary /
 * Edit / Upscale & enhance / Make video / Download actions anchored to an
 * image card, with optional danger styling and per-action icons.
 */
export default function ImageActionMenu({
  open = true,
  actions = [],
  className = "",
  onAction,
  onClose,
}: ImageActionMenuProps) {
  if (!open) return null;
  const iconFor = (action: ImageMenuAction) =>
    action.icon ?? { Fullscreen: "⛶", Vary: "↻", Edit: "✎", "Make video": "▶", Download: "↓" }[action.label] ?? "•";
  return (
    <div
      data-image-action-menu
      className={`w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {actions.length === 0 ? (
        <p data-image-action-empty className="px-3 py-3 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          No actions available.
        </p>
      ) : (
        actions.map((action, i) => (
          <React.Fragment key={action.id}>
            {i > 0 && action.id === "download" && (
              <div className="my-1 h-px bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" />
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              data-image-action={action.id}
              onClick={() => onAction?.(action)}
              className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs transition-colors ${
                action.danger
                  ? "text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"
                  : "text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              }`}
            >
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="w-4 shrink-0 text-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {iconFor(action)}
              </span>
              <span data-image-action-label>{action.label}</span>
            </button>
          </React.Fragment>
        ))
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface ImageGenTile {
  id: string;
  alt: string;
  url?: string;
  aspect?: "square" | "portrait" | "landscape";
  status?: "done" | "generating";
  model?: string;
}

export interface ImageGenGalleryProps {
  title?: string;
  prompt?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  generateText?: string;
  images: ImageGenTile[];
  onGenerate?: (prompt: string) => void;
  onTileAction?: (id: string, action: "download" | "variant" | "delete") => void;
  className?: string;
}

const ASPECT_CLASS: Record<string, string> = {
  square: "aspect-square",
  portrait: "aspect-[3/4]",
  landscape: "aspect-[4/3]",
};

const GRADIENTS = [
  "from-indigo-400 via-purple-400 to-pink-300",
  "from-sky-400 via-cyan-300 to-emerald-300",
  "from-amber-300 via-orange-400 to-rose-400",
  "from-violet-400 via-fuchsia-400 to-indigo-300",
];

/**
 * ImageGenGallery - AI image studio: prompt bar with Generate CTA and a tile
 * grid where each tile can be done (hover actions) or generating (skeleton).
 */
export default function ImageGenGallery({
  title = "Image studio",
  prompt: promptProp = "",
  placeholder = "Describe an image…",
  generateText = "Generate",
  images,
  onGenerate,
  onTileAction,
  className = "",
}: ImageGenGalleryProps) {
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = React.useState(promptProp);
  return (
    <div data-image-gen className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-1.5 focus-within:border-indigo-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <input
          data-gen-input
          value={prompt}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter" && prompt.trim()) onGenerate?.(prompt.trim());
          }}
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          data-gen-generate
          disabled={!prompt.trim()}
          onClick={() => prompt.trim() && onGenerate?.(prompt.trim())}
          className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          {generateText}
        </button>
      </div>
      {images.length === 0 ? (
        <div data-gen-empty className="mt-3 flex aspect-[4/3] items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">
          No images yet — describe one above
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
          {images.map((img, i) => {
            const generating = img.status === "generating";
            return (
              <figure
                key={img.id}
                data-gen-tile={img.id}
                className="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
              >
                <div
                  data-gen-status={generating ? "generating" : "done"}
                  className={`${ASPECT_CLASS[img.aspect || "square"]} flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br ${GRADIENTS[i % GRADIENTS.length]} ${
                    generating ? "animate-pulse" : ""
                  }`}
                >
                  {img.url ? (
                    <img src={img.url} alt={img.alt} className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                  ) : generating ? (
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-white/70 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-700">Generating…</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="max-w-full truncate px-2 text-[10px] font-semibold text-white/90">{img.alt}</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                {!generating && (
                  <div className="absolute inset-x-1.5 bottom-1.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-black/55 px-1.5 py-1 opacity-0 backdrop-blur transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100">
                    <button type="button" data-gen-action="download" aria-label="Download" onClick={() => onTileAction?.(img.id, "download")} className="rounded p-1 text-white/90 hover:bg-white/20">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3.5a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v6.19l2.22-2.22a.75.75 0 1 1 1.06 1.06l-3.5 3.5a.75.75 0 0 1-1.06 0l-3.5-3.5a.75.75 0 1 1 1.06-1.06l2.22 2.22V4.25A.75.75 0 0 1 10 3.5Zm-5.5 9.25a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v1c0 .14.11.25.25.25h9a.25.25 0 0 0 .25-.25v-1a.75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0v1A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 14.5 16h-9A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 3.75 14.25v-1a.75.75 0 0 1 .75-.75Z"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" data-gen-action="variant" aria-label="Make variant" onClick={() => onTileAction?.(img.id, "variant")} className="rounded p-1 text-white/90 hover:bg-white/20">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3.75a.75.75 0 0 1 .53.22l2 2a.75.75 0 1 1-1.06 1.06l-.72-.72v4.94a.75.75 0 0 1-1.5 0V6.31l-.72.72a.75.75 0 0 1-1.06-1.06l2-2a.75.75 0 0 1 .53-.22ZM4.25 11.5a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v1.5c0 .14.11.25.25.25h9.5a.25.25 0 0 0 .25-.25v-1.5a.75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0v1.5A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 14.75 15h-9.5A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 3.5 13.25v-1.5a.75.75 0 0 1 .75-.75Z"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" data-gen-action="delete" aria-label="Delete" onClick={() => onTileAction?.(img.id, "delete")} className="rounded p-1 text-white/90 hover:bg-white/20">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3.25h4a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h1.75a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5H6.25a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5H8Zm-2.75 4.5h9.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h-.5l-.4 5.6A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 12.1 16.3H7.9a1.75 1.75 0 0 1-1.75-1.62l-.4-5.68h-.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5Z"/></svg>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                {img.model && !generating && (
                  <figcaption className="absolute left-1.5 top-1.5 rounded bg-black/55 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white/90 backdrop-blur">{img.model}</figcaption>
                )}
              </figure>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: react\InboxList.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface InboxMessage {
  id: string | number;
  sender: string;
  /** Number appended after the sender, e.g. thread count. */
  count?: number;
  subject: string;
  /** Preview text after the subject. */
  snippet?: string;
  /** Date label, e.g. "Aug 26". */
  dateLabel: string;
  unread?: boolean;
  /** Optional tag pill, e.g. "pitch" or "Draft". */
  tag?: string;
  tagTone?: "rose" | "emerald" | "indigo";
}

export interface InboxListProps {
  messages: InboxMessage[];
  activeId?: string | number | null;
  onSelect?: (message: InboxMessage) => void;
  /** Group boundary labels rendered between rows when the value changes. */
  emptyText?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const TAG_TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  rose: "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  indigo: "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300",
};

export const InboxList: React.FC<InboxListProps> = ({
  messages = [],
  activeId = null,
  onSelect,
  emptyText = "Inbox zero — enjoy your day",
  className = "",
}) => {
  if (messages.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
        {emptyText}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={`divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {messages.map((message) => {
        const active = String(message.id) === String(activeId);
        return (
          <div
            key={message.id}
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            aria-current={active ? "true" : undefined}
            onClick={() => onSelect?.(message)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                event.preventDefault();
                onSelect?.(message);
              }
            }}
            className={`flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors ${
              active
                ? "bg-indigo-50/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/40"
                : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
            }`}
          >
            {/* Unread dot column */}
            <span className="flex w-2 shrink-0 pt-1.5">
              {message.unread && (
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" aria-label="Unread" />
              )}
            </span>

            <span className="w-36 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
              {message.sender}
              {message.count ? <span className="ml-1 font-normal text-zinc-400">{message.count}</span> : null}
            </span>

            <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {message.tag && (
                <span
                  className={`mr-1.5 inline-block rounded px-1.5 py-px align-middle font-mono text-[9.5px] font-medium ${
                    TAG_TONE[message.tagTone || "rose"]
                  }`}
                >
                  {message.tag}
                </span>
              )}
              <span className={`font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 ${message.unread ? "" : "font-normal"}`}>
                {message.subject}
              </span>
              {message.snippet && <span className="text-zinc-400"> — {message.snippet}</span>}
            </span>

            <span className="shrink-0 pt-px font-mono text-[10px] uppercase text-zinc-400">{message.dateLabel}</span>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};
export default InboxList;

/**
 * IntegrationConnectGrid - Settings integrations: category filter tabs and
 * a responsive grid of service cards with logo placeholder, connected
 * badge and Connect / Disconnect action (integration settings pattern).
 */
import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface IntegrationService {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category?: string;
  connected?: boolean;
}

export interface IntegrationConnectGridProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  integrations?: IntegrationService[];
  connectLabel?: string;
  disconnectLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
  onToggle?: (integration: IntegrationService, connected: boolean) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_INTEGRATIONS: IntegrationService[] = [
  { id: "gh", name: "GitHub", category: "Code", connected: true },
  { id: "sl", name: "Slack", category: "Chat", connected: true },
  { id: "li", name: "Linear", category: "Code", connected: false },
  { id: "no", name: "Notion", category: "Docs", connected: false },
  { id: "fg", name: "Figma", category: "Design", connected: false },
  { id: "sn", name: "Sentry", category: "Monitoring", connected: true },
];

const CATEGORY_ALL = "All";

export const IntegrationConnectGrid: React.FC<IntegrationConnectGridProps> = ({
  title = "Integrations",
  description = "Connect third-party services to extend your workspace.",
  integrations = DEFAULT_INTEGRATIONS,
  connectLabel = "Connect",
  disconnectLabel = "Disconnect",
  className = "",
  onToggle,
}) => {
  const all = Array.isArray(integrations) ? integrations : [];
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(CATEGORY_ALL);
  const categories = [CATEGORY_ALL, ...new Set(all.map((it) => it.category).filter((c): c is string => Boolean(c)))];
  const visible = category === CATEGORY_ALL ? all : all.filter((it) => it.category === category);

  return (
    <div data-integration-grid className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-integration-header className="mb-4">
        <p data-integration-title className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        <p data-integration-description className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>
        <div data-integration-tabs className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {categories.map((cat) => (
            <button
              key={cat}
              type="button"
              data-integration-tab={cat}
              onClick={() => setCategory(cat)}
              className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                cat === category
                  ? "border-violet-500 bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:border-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-950/40 dark:text-violet-300"
                  : "border-zinc-200 text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              }`}
            >
              {cat}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div data-integration-cards className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {visible.map((it) => (
          <div key={it.id} data-integration-card={it.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 transition-shadow hover:shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span data-integration-logo={it.name} aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">{(it.name || "?").slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}</span>
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p data-integration-name={it.name} className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{it.name}</p>
                <p data-integration-category={it.category || ""} className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{it.category || ""}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              {it.connected ? (
                <span data-integration-state="connected" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400"><span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" aria-hidden="true"></span>Connected</span>
              ) : (
                <span data-integration-state="not-connected" className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">Not connected</span>
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                data-integration-action={it.id}
                onClick={() => onToggle?.(it, !it.connected)}
                className={`rounded-md border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                  it.connected
                    ? "border-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                    : "border-violet-300 bg-violet-600 text-white hover:bg-violet-500 dark:border-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-600 dark:hover:bg-violet-500"
                }`}
              >
                {it.connected ? disconnectLabel : connectLabel}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default IntegrationConnectGrid;

/**
 * InvoiceHistoryTable - Billing invoice history: header with title and
 * currency note, table of invoices (period / invoice id / amount / status
 * badge / date / download action) with a paid-total footer
 * (Contractbook / Remote billing history pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export type InvoiceStatus = "paid" | "pending" | "failed";

export interface Invoice {
  id: string;
  period: string;
  amount: string;
  status: InvoiceStatus;
  date: string;
}

export interface InvoiceHistoryTableProps {
  title?: string;
  currency?: string;
  downloadLabel?: string;
  invoices?: Invoice[];
  className?: string;
  onDownload?: (invoice: Invoice) => void;
}

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<InvoiceStatus, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  paid: { label: "Paid", cls: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400" },
  pending: { label: "Pending", cls: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-400" },
  failed: { label: "Failed", cls: "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400" },
};

const DEFAULT_INVOICES: Invoice[] = [
  { id: "INV-2026-011", period: "November 2026", amount: "148.00", status: "paid", date: "Nov 1, 2026" },
  { id: "INV-2026-010", period: "October 2026", amount: "148.00", status: "paid", date: "Oct 1, 2026" },
  { id: "INV-2026-009", period: "September 2026", amount: "96.00", status: "pending", date: "Sep 1, 2026" },
  { id: "INV-2026-008", period: "August 2026", amount: "148.00", status: "failed", date: "Aug 1, 2026" },
];

const amountNumber = (invoice: Invoice) => {
  const n = Number.parseFloat(String(invoice.amount ?? "0").replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, ""));
  return Number.isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
};

export const InvoiceHistoryTable: React.FC<InvoiceHistoryTableProps> = ({
  title = "Invoice history",
  currency = "USD",
  downloadLabel = "Download",
  invoices = DEFAULT_INVOICES,
  className = "",
  onDownload,
}) => {
  const list = Array.isArray(invoices) ? invoices : [];
  const paidTotal = list
    .filter((inv) => inv.status === "paid")
    .reduce((sum, inv) => sum + amountNumber(inv), 0)
    .toFixed(2);

  return (
    <div data-invoice-table className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-invoice-header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p data-invoice-title className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        <span data-invoice-currency className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{currency}</span>
      </div>
      <table data-invoice-table-body className="w-full text-left text-xs">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <th className="px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold">Billing period</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Invoice</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Amount</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Status</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Date</th>
            <th className="px-5 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold"><span className="sr-only">Actions</span></th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {list.map((inv) => {
            const style = STATUS_STYLES[inv.status] ?? STATUS_STYLES.pending;
            return (
              <tr key={inv.id} data-invoice-row={inv.id} className="border-b border-zinc-50 transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
                <td data-invoice-period={inv.period} className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{inv.period}</td>
                <td data-invoice-id={inv.id} className="px-2 py-3 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{inv.id}</td>
                <td data-invoice-amount={inv.amount} className="px-2 py-3 text-right font-mono text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{currency} {inv.amount}</td>
                <td data-invoice-status={inv.status} className="px-2 py-3"><span className={`inline-block rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${style.cls}`}>{style.label}</span></td>
                <td data-invoice-date={inv.date} className="whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-3 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{inv.date}</td>
                <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    data-invoice-download={inv.id}
                    onClick={() => onDownload?.(inv)}
                    className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                  >
                    {downloadLabel}
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div data-invoice-footer className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 px-5 py-3 text-sm dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span data-invoice-total-label className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Paid total</span>
        <span data-invoice-total-value className="font-mono font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{currency} {paidTotal}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default InvoiceHistoryTable;

/**
 * IterationActionBar - Generation iteration action bar: Show More / Brainstorm
 * / Reply pills, an overflow slot and prev/next page arrows (Luma).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface IterationActionBarProps {
  page?: number;
  totalPages?: number;
  className?: string;
  onAction?: (action: string) => void;
  onPageChange?: (page: number) => void;
}

export default function IterationActionBar({
  page = 1,
  totalPages = 4,
  className = "",
  onAction,
  onPageChange,
}: IterationActionBarProps) {
  const pill =
    "rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500";
  return (
    <div data-iteration-action-bar className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-iteration-action="show-more"
        onClick={() => onAction?.("show-more")}
        className={`${pill} border border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800`}
      >
        ↻ Show More
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-iteration-action="brainstorm"
        onClick={() => onAction?.("brainstorm")}
        className={`${pill} border border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800`}
      >
        ✦ Brainstorm
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-iteration-action="reply"
        onClick={() => onAction?.("reply")}
        className={`${pill} border border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800`}
      >
        ❝ Reply
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-iteration-action="more"
        aria-label="More actions"
        onClick={() => onAction?.("more")}
        className={`${pill} border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800`}
      >
        ···
      </button>
      <span data-iteration-pager className="ml-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-iteration-prev
          aria-label="Previous page"
          disabled={page <= 1}
          onClick={() => onPageChange?.(page - 1)}
          className="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          ‹
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-iteration-next
          aria-label="Next page"
          disabled={page >= totalPages}
          onClick={() => onPageChange?.(page + 1)}
          className="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          ›
        </button>
        <span data-iteration-page-label className="ml-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {page}/{totalPages}
        </span>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
