===== FILE: react\KanbanBoard.tsx =====

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface KanbanColumn {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** Tailwind background class for the column accent dot, e.g. "bg-indigo-500". */
  accent?: string;
  /** Soft cap shown as "n/limit" in the header. */
  limit?: number;
}

export interface KanbanCard {
  id: string;
  columnId: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  assignee?: string;
  priority?: "low" | "medium" | "high";
}

export interface KanbanBoardProps {
  columns?: KanbanColumn[];
  cards?: KanbanCard[];
  onMoveCard?: (cardId: string, toColumnId: string) => void;
  onCardClick?: (card: KanbanCard) => void;
  onAddCard?: (columnId: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const PRIORITY_META: Record<NonNullable<KanbanCard["priority"]>, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  low: { label: "Low", cls: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400" },
  medium: { label: "Medium", cls: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400" },
  high: { label: "High", cls: "bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400" },
};

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join("");

export const KanbanBoard: React.FC<KanbanBoardProps> = ({
  columns = [],
  cards = [],
  onMoveCard,
  onCardClick,
  onAddCard,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [draggingId, setDraggingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [overColumn, setOverColumn] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const move = (cardId: string, toColumnId: string) => {
    const card = cards.find((entry) => entry.id === cardId);
    if (!card || card.columnId === toColumnId) return;
    onMoveCard?.(cardId, toColumnId);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>, card: KanbanCard) => {
    if (event.key !== "ArrowLeft" && event.key !== "ArrowRight") return;
    const index = columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === card.columnId);
    const next = columns[index + (event.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : -1)];
    if (!next) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    move(card.id, next.id);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 ${className}`}>
      {columns.map((column) => {
        const columnCards = cards.filter((card) => card.columnId === column.id);
        const isOver = overColumn === column.id;
        return (
          <section
            key={column.id}
            aria-label={column.title}
            onDragOver={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              if (overColumn !== column.id) setOverColumn(column.id);
            }}
            onDragLeave={() => setOverColumn((current) => (current === column.id ? null : current))}
            onDrop={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              const cardId = event.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain") || draggingId;
              if (cardId) move(cardId, column.id);
              setDraggingId(null);
              setOverColumn(null);
            }}
            className={`flex w-64 shrink-0 flex-col rounded-xl border bg-zinc-50/60 p-2 transition-colors dark:bg-zinc-900/40 ${
              isOver
                ? "border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/20"
                : "border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800"
            }`}
          >
            <header className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1">
              <span className={`h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${column.accent || "bg-zinc-400"}`} aria-hidden="true" />
              <h3 className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {column.title}
              </h3>
              <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-200/70 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {column.limit ? `${columnCards.length}/${column.limit}` : columnCards.length}
              </span>
              {onAddCard && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onAddCard(column.id)}
                  aria-label={`Add card to ${column.title}`}
                  className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                >
                  <UiIcon name="plus" size={12} />
                </button>
              )}
            </header>

            <div className="flex min-h-[3rem] flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
              {columnCards.length === 0 && (
                <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-2 py-4 text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">
                  Drop cards here
                </p>
              )}
              {columnCards.map((card) => {
                const priority = card.priority ? PRIORITY_META[card.priority] : null;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={card.id}
                    role="button"
                    tabIndex={0}
                    draggable
                    onDragStart={(event) => {
                      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", card.id);
                      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
                      setDraggingId(card.id);
                    }}
                    onDragEnd={() => {
                      setDraggingId(null);
                      setOverColumn(null);
                    }}
                    onClick={() => onCardClick?.(card)}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        onCardClick?.(card);
                        return;
                      }
                      handleKeyDown(event, card);
                    }}
                    className={`cursor-grab rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-left shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 active:cursor-grabbing dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 ${
                      draggingId === card.id ? "opacity-40" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <p className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[11px] font-medium leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {card.title}
                      </p>
                      {priority && (
                        <span className={`shrink-0 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium ${priority.cls}`}>
                          {priority.label}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {card.description && (
                      <p className="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                        {card.description}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    {(card.tags?.length || card.assignee) && (
                      <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
                        {card.tags?.slice(0, 2).map((tag) => (
                          <span
                            key={tag}
                            className="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400"
                          >
                            {tag}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                        {card.assignee && (
                          <span
                            title={card.assignee}
                            className="ml-auto flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[8px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
                          >
                            {initials(card.assignee)}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </section>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default KanbanBoard;

===== FILE: react\LiquidGlass.tsx =====

import React, { useRef } from "react";

export interface LiquidGlassProps {
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  /**
   * Visual preset variant:
   * - 'capsule': Rounded-full floating pill / toolbar dock
   * - 'card': Rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl content card / modal pane
   * - 'sidebar': Edge-anchored translucent navigation panel
   */
  variant?: "capsule" | "card" | "sidebar";
  /**
   * Material density / blur intensity:
   * - 'light': Subtle sheer frosting (backdrop-blur-md)
   * - 'regular': Apple standard Liquid Glass (backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-180%)
   * - 'thick': Heavy frosted glass for high-contrast backdrops (backdrop-blur-2xl)
   */
  intensity?: "light" | "regular" | "thick";
  /**
   * Enable dynamic pointer-tracking refractive specular highlight
   */
  interactive?: boolean;
  /**
   * Enable subtle 3D tilt transformation on pointer move
   */
  enableTilt?: boolean;
  /**
   * Max tilt degrees (default 4)
   */
  maxTilt?: number;
  /**
   * Custom specular glare opacity (0 - 1, default 0.35)
   */
  glareOpacity?: number;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  onClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
}

function numOr(v: unknown, fallback: number, min = -Infinity, max = Infinity): number {
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number.parseFloat(String(v));
  if (Number.isNaN(n)) return fallback;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n));
}

export const LiquidGlass: React.FC<LiquidGlassProps> = ({
  children,
  variant = "card",
  intensity = "regular",
  interactive = true,
  enableTilt = false,
  maxTilt: maxTiltProp = 4,
  glareOpacity: glareOpacityProp = 0.35,
  className = "",
  style,
  onClick,
}) => {
  // Sanitize numeric props (TS types are compile-time only; plain-JS callers
  // could pass strings that would land inside CSS values).
  const glareOpacity = numOr(glareOpacityProp, 0.35, 0, 1);
  const maxTilt = numOr(maxTiltProp, 4, 0, 90);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const glareRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!interactive && !enableTilt) return;
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height || rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return;

    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const gxPercent = ((x / rect.width) * 100).toFixed(1);
    const gyPercent = ((y / rect.height) * 100).toFixed(1);

    if (interactive && glareRef.current) {
      glareRef.current.style.opacity = glareOpacity.toString();
      glareRef.current.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at ${gxPercent}% ${gyPercent}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 35%, transparent 65%)`;
    }

    if (enableTilt && variant !== "sidebar") {
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      const ry = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * maxTilt;
      const rx = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * maxTilt;
      el.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rx.toFixed(2)}deg) rotateY(${ry.toFixed(2)}deg) translateY(-1px)`;
      el.style.transition = "transform 0.1s ease-out";
    }
  };

  const handlePointerLeave = () => {
    if (glareRef.current) {
      glareRef.current.style.opacity = "0";
    }
    const el = containerRef.current;
    if (el) {
      el.style.transform = "";
      el.style.transition = "transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)";
    }
  };

  // Variant geometry
  const variantClasses = {
    capsule: "rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 inline-flex items-center",
    card: "rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-6 block",
    sidebar: "rounded-none border-r h-full block",
  }[variant];

  // Material blur & vibrancy density
  const intensityClasses = {
    light: "backdrop-blur-md backdrop-saturate-150",
    regular: "backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-[180%]",
    thick: "backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-[200%]",
  }[intensity];

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerLeave={handlePointerLeave}
      onClick={onClick}
      style={style}
      className={`liquid-glass-pane group relative overflow-hidden text-[#1d1d1f] dark:text-[#f5f5f7] select-none transition-all duration-300 ${variantClasses} ${intensityClasses}
        bg-white/65 dark:bg-[#16181d]/65
        contrast-more:bg-white contrast-more:dark:bg-[#16181d] contrast-more:backdrop-blur-none
        motion-reduce:transform-none motion-reduce:transition-none
        border border-white/50 dark:border-white/10
        shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.7),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]
        dark:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.18),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.4),0_12px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.35)]
        hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.85),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_14px_44px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]
        dark:hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.25),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.45),0_16px_48px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)]
        ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Specular refractive rim caustics sheen layer */}
      {interactive && (
        <div
          ref={glareRef}
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="liquid-glass-glare pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-300"
          style={{
            mixBlendMode: "overlay",
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Micro-frost edge reflection ring */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 rounded-[inherit] ring-1 ring-inset ring-white/30 dark:ring-white/10"
      />

      {/* Content wrapper */}
      <div className="relative z-0 h-full w-full">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
};


===== FILE: react\LiveTailLogConsole.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface TailLogLine {
  ts?: string;
  level: "info" | "warn" | "error" | "success";
  message: string;
  source?: string;
}

export interface LiveTailLogConsoleProps {
  lines: TailLogLine[];
  sources?: string[];
  liveTail?: boolean;
  searchPlaceholder?: string;
  timezone?: string;
  maxLines?: number;
  onSearch?: (query: string) => void;
  onLiveTailChange?: (enabled: boolean) => void;
}

const LEVEL_DOT: Record<string, string> = {
  info: "bg-sky-500",
  warn: "bg-amber-500",
  error: "bg-rose-500",
  success: "bg-emerald-500",
};

/**
 * LiveTailLogConsole - dark streaming log terminal with toolbar (source filter, search, live tail, timezone).
 */
export default function LiveTailLogConsole({
  lines,
  sources = [],
  liveTail = true,
  searchPlaceholder = "Search logs…",
  timezone = "GMT+7",
  maxLines = 200,
  onSearch,
  onLiveTailChange,
}: LiveTailLogConsoleProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [follow, setFollow] = React.useState(liveTail);

  const filtered = React.useMemo(() => {
    const base = query
      ? lines.filter((line) => line.message.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) || (line.source || "").toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()))
      : lines;
    return maxLines > 0 ? base.slice(-maxLines) : base;
  }, [lines, query, maxLines]);

  return (
    <div data-live-tail-console className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-neutral-800 px-3 py-2">
        {sources.length ? (
          <select
            data-tail-source
            className="rounded-md border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-neutral-200 focus-visible:outline-none"
            onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value === "all" ? "" : event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="all">All sources</option>
            {sources.map((source) => (
              <option key={source} value={source}>{source}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        ) : null}
        <div className="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-neutral-500">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" />
          </svg>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={query}
            placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
            data-tail-search
            onChange={(event) => { setQuery(event.target.value); onSearch?.(event.target.value); }}
            className="w-full rounded-md border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 py-1 pl-7 pr-2 text-xs text-neutral-200 placeholder:text-neutral-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-neutral-500"
          />
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-tail-follow
          onClick={() => { setFollow(!follow); onLiveTailChange?.(!follow); }}
          className={`inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-neutral-500 ${
            follow ? "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40" : "border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-300"
          }`}
        >
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" className="h-3 w-3"><path d="M13 2 3 14h7l-1 8 10-12h-7l1-8z" /></svg>
          Live tail
        </button>
        {timezone ? <span className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-neutral-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-neutral-400">{timezone}</span> : null}
      </div>
      <div data-tail-lines className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-neutral-300">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-4 text-center text-neutral-500">No log lines match.</p>
        ) : (
          filtered.map((line, index) => (
            <div key={index} data-tail-line className="flex items-start gap-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
              {line.ts ? <span className="shrink-0 text-neutral-500">{line.ts}</span> : null}
              <span className={`mt-1.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${LEVEL_DOT[line.level] || LEVEL_DOT.info}`} />
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-neutral-300">{line.message}</span>
              {line.source ? <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-neutral-800 px-1 text-[10px] text-neutral-400">{line.source}</span> : null}
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: react\MarqueeWall.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface MarqueeCard {
  name: string;
  handle?: string;
  text: string;
  /** Renders an anonymous NPS-style card (initials avatar, no handle link). */
  anonymous?: boolean;
}

export interface MarqueeWallProps {
  rows: MarqueeCard[][];
  speedSeconds?: number;
  paused?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const initialsOf = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
    .join("");

const AVATAR_TONES = [
  "bg-indigo-500",
  "bg-emerald-500",
  "bg-rose-500",
  "bg-amber-500",
  "bg-sky-500",
  "bg-violet-500",
];

export const MarqueeWall: React.FC<MarqueeWallProps> = ({ rows, speedSeconds = 40, paused, className = "" }) => {
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  return (
    <div
      data-marquee-wall
      className={`space-y-3 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-950 via-zinc-950 to-zinc-950 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 ${className}`}
    >
      {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => {
        const reverse = rowIndex % 2 === 1;
        return (
          <div
            key={rowIndex}
            data-marquee-row={rowIndex}
            className="group flex overflow-hidden"
            style={
              paused
                ? { animationPlayState: "paused" }
                : undefined
            }
          >
            <div
              className={`flex min-w-full shrink-0 gap-3 marquee-track${reverse ? " marquee-track-reverse" : ""}`}
              style={{
                animation: `marquee-scroll ${speedSeconds}s linear infinite${reverse ? " reverse" : ""}`,
                animationPlayState: paused ? "paused" : "running",
              }}
            >
              {[...row, ...row].map((card, index) => (
                <figure
                  key={`${card.name}-${index}`}
                  data-marquee-card={index}
                  className="w-64 shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 dark:bg-zinc-900"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span
                      className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${
                        AVATAR_TONES[index % AVATAR_TONES.length]
                      }`}
                    >
                      {initialsOf(card.name)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="block truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{card.name}</span>
                      {card.handle && !card.anonymous ? (
                        <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-indigo-500">@{card.handle}</span>
                      ) : null}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <blockquote className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    {card.text}
                  </blockquote>
                </figure>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
      <style>{`@keyframes marquee-scroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } } .marquee-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused !important; }`}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MarqueeWall;

    { id: "m8", url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1434030216411-0b793f4b4173?w=400&q=60", alt: "Writing", span: 2 },
  ],
  columns = 4,
  padding = 12,
  className = "",
  onItemClick,
  onClose,
}: MasonryDensityControlsProps) {
  const [size, setSize] = React.useState(columns);
  const [gap, setGap] = React.useState(padding);
  const [close, setClose] = React.useState(false);

  if (close) return null;

  return (
    <div data-masn className={`relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-zinc-950 dark:bg-black ${className}`}>
      {/* floating control bar */}
      <div data-masn-controls className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-around gap-6 bg-black/80 px-6 py-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
        <label data-masn-size-group className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-sm text-zinc-200">
          <span>Size</span>
          <input
            type="range"
            data-masn-size
            min={2}
            max={6}
            step={1}
            value={size}
            onChange={(e) => setSize(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="h-1 flex-1 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded bg-zinc-600 accent-white"
          />
        </label>
        <label data-masn-padding-group className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-sm text-zinc-200">
          <span>Padding</span>
          <input
            type="range"
            data-masn-padding
            min={4}
            max={32}
            step={2}
            value={gap}
            onChange={(e) => setGap(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="h-1 flex-1 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded bg-zinc-600 accent-white"
          />
        </label>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-masn-close
          onClick={() => {
            setClose(true);
            onClose?.();
          }}
          aria-label="Close gallery"
          className="text-lg text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:text-white"
        >
          ✕
        </button>
      </div>

      <p data-masn-title className="absolute left-5 top-16 z-10 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500">{title}</p>
      <p data-masn-meta className="absolute right-5 top-16 z-10 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500">
        {size} cols · {gap}px
      </p>

      {/* masonry via CSS columns */}
      <div
        data-masn-grid
        className="pt-28"
        style={{ columnCount: size, columnGap: `${gap}px` }}
      >
        {items.map((item) => (
          <button
            key={item.id}
            type="button"
            data-masn-item={item.id}
            onClick={() => onItemClick?.(item)}
            className="mb-[var(--masn-gap)] block w-full break-inside-avoid overflow-hidden rounded-sm bg-zinc-900"
            style={{ ["--masn-gap" as string]: `${gap}px` }}
          >
            <img
              src={item.url}
              alt={item.alt}
              loading="lazy"
              style={{ aspectRatio: item.span === 3 ? "3 / 4" : item.span === 2 ? "4 / 5" : "1 / 1" }}
              className="w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 hover:scale-105"
            />
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface McpClientTab {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Client logo emoji or short mark shown in the tab */
  mark?: string;
  /** Connection steps shown for this client */
  steps: string[];
  /** Optional config snippet (JSON/YAML) rendered in a dark code block */
  snippet?: string;
}

export interface McpConnectPanelProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  clients: McpClientTab[];
  /** Called when the user copies the config snippet */
  onCopy?: (client: McpClientTab) => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * McpConnectPanel - MCP (Model Context Protocol) server connection guide:
 * per-client tabs (ChatGPT / Claude Desktop / Cursor), numbered setup steps
 * and a copyable config snippet block.
 */
export default function McpConnectPanel({
  title = "Connection guide",
  description = "Connect to the MCP server to access workspace data directly from your preferred AI assistant.",
  clients,
  onCopy,
  className = "",
}: McpConnectPanelProps) {
  const [active, setActive] = React.useState(clients[0]?.id ?? "");
  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);
  const client = clients.find((c) => c.id === active) ?? clients[0];

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!copied) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [copied]);

  if (!client) return null;

  return (
    <div data-mcp-panel className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <p data-mcp-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
      <p data-mcp-description className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>

      <div data-mcp-tabs className="mt-3 flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        {clients.map((c) => (
          <button
            key={c.id}
            type="button"
            data-mcp-tab={c.id}
            aria-selected={c.id === client.id}
            onClick={() => { setActive(c.id); setCopied(false); }}
            className={`-mb-px flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
              c.id === client.id
                ? "border-teal-600 text-teal-700 dark:border-teal-400 dark:text-teal-300"
                : "border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
          >
            {c.mark && <span aria-hidden="true">{c.mark}</span>}
            {c.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <ol data-mcp-steps className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {client.steps.map((step, i) => (
          <li key={i} data-mcp-step className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
            <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-teal-50 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-teal-700 dark:bg-teal-950/60 dark:text-teal-300">{i + 1}</span>
            <span className="min-w-0">{step}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      {client.snippet && (
        <div data-mcp-snippet className="mt-3">
          <div className="relative">
            <pre className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 p-3 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-200"><code>{client.snippet}</code></pre>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-mcp-copy
              onClick={() => { setCopied(true); onCopy?.(client); }}
              className="absolute right-2 top-2 rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900/90 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 hover:border-teal-500 hover:text-teal-300"
            >
              {copied ? "Copied!" : "Copy"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: react\MemoryPanel.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface MemoryItem {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  source?: string;
}

export interface MemoryPanelProps {
  title?: string;
  note?: string;
  items: MemoryItem[];
  addPlaceholder?: string;
  addText?: string;
  onAdd?: (text: string) => void;
  onEdit?: (id: string, text: string) => void;
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
  onClearAll?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * MemoryPanel - ChatGPT-style "Memory" manager: remembered facts with source
 * captions, inline editing, delete per row, add input and a clear-all action.
 */
export default function MemoryPanel({
  title = "Memory",
  note = "Facts the assistant remembers across conversations.",
  items,
  addPlaceholder = "Add a memory…",
  addText = "Add",
  onAdd,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onClearAll,
  className = "",
}: MemoryPanelProps) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState("");
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editDraft, setEditDraft] = React.useState("");

  const submitAdd = () => {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    onAdd?.(text);
    setDraft("");
  };
  const startEdit = (item: MemoryItem) => {
    setEditingId(item.id);
    setEditDraft(item.text);
  };
  const submitEdit = () => {
    if (!editingId) return;
    const text = editDraft.trim();
    if (text) onEdit?.(editingId, text);
    setEditingId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div data-memory-panel className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        {items.length > 0 && (
          <button type="button" data-memory-clear onClick={() => onClearAll?.()} className="text-xs font-medium text-red-600 hover:underline dark:text-red-400">
            Clear all
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{note}</p>
      <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {items.map((item) => (
          <li key={item.id} data-memory-item={item.id} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
            {editingId === item.id ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  data-memory-edit-input
                  value={editDraft}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditDraft(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Enter") submitEdit();
                    if (e.key === "Escape") setEditingId(null);
                  }}
                  autoFocus
                  className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/60 px-2 py-1 text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-zinc-100"
                />
                <button type="button" data-memory-save onClick={submitEdit} className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500">Save</button>
                <button type="button" data-memory-cancel onClick={() => setEditingId(null)} className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Cancel</button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <p data-memory-text className="text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{item.text}</p>
                  <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                    <button type="button" data-memory-edit aria-label="Edit memory" onClick={() => startEdit(item)} className="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12.7 3.3a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 2.12 0l1.88 1.88a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 0 2.12l-8.37 8.37a2 2 0 0 1-1.02.55l-2.9.65a.6.6 0 0 1-.7-.71l.64-2.9a2 2 0 0 1 .55-1.02L12.7 3.3Z"/></svg>
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" data-memory-delete aria-label="Forget memory" onClick={() => onDelete?.(item.id)} className="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40">
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3.25h4a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h1.75a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5H6.25a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5H8Zm-2.75 4.5h9.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h-.5l-.4 5.6A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 12.1 16.3H7.9a1.75 1.75 0 0 1-1.75-1.62l-.4-5.68h-.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5Z"/></svg>
                    </button>
                  </span>
                </div>
                {item.source && <p data-memory-source className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{item.source}</p>}
              </>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
        {items.length === 0 && (
          <li data-memory-empty className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">
            No memories yet.
          </li>
        )}
      </ul>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        <input
          data-memory-add-input
          value={draft}
          placeholder={addPlaceholder}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") submitAdd();
          }}
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
        />
        <button type="button" data-memory-add onClick={submitAdd} disabled={!draft.trim()} className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900">
          {addText}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\MessageActionToolbar.tsx =====

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Copy, Check, RotateCcw, ThumbsUp, ThumbsDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "./UiIcon";

export interface MessageActionToolbarProps {
  content: string;
  role?: "assistant" | "user" | string;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  onFeedback?: (type: "up" | "down") => void;
  branchIndex?: number;
  totalBranches?: number;
  onBranchChange?: (nextIndex: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const MessageActionToolbar: React.FC<MessageActionToolbarProps> = ({
  content,
  role = "assistant",
  onRetry,
  onFeedback,
  branchIndex,
  totalBranches,
  onBranchChange,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<"up" | "down" | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleThumb = (type: "up" | "down") => {
    const next = feedback === type ? null : type;
    setFeedback(next);
    if (onFeedback && next) onFeedback(next);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-1.5 select-none ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Branch Navigator (if multiple versions exist) */}
      {totalBranches && totalBranches > 1 && branchIndex !== undefined && onBranchChange && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 mr-2 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={branchIndex <= 0}
            onClick={() => onBranchChange(branchIndex - 1)}
            className="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"
            title="Previous version"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
          <span>
            {branchIndex + 1}/{totalBranches}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={branchIndex >= totalBranches - 1}
            onClick={() => onBranchChange(branchIndex + 1)}
            className="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5"
            title="Next version"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Copy */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleCopy}
        className="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
        title="Copy response"
      >
        {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
      </button>

      {/* Retry / Regenerate */}
      {onRetry && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors"
          title="Regenerate response"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Thumbs Up / Down */}
      {role === "assistant" && (
        <>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleThumb("up")}
            className={`p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors ${
              feedback === "up" ? "text-blue-500" : "hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
            title="Good response"
          >
            <ThumbsUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleThumb("down")}
            className={`p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors ${
              feedback === "down" ? "text-rose-500" : "hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
            title="Bad response"
          >
            <ThumbsDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};


===== FILE: react\MetricStrip.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface MetricStripItem {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  delta?: number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
}

export interface MetricStripProps {
  metrics: MetricStripItem[];
  activeIndex?: number;
  onMetricClick?: (index: number, metric: MetricStripItem) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const toneOf = (delta: number | undefined) => {
  if (delta === undefined) return "text-zinc-400";
  return delta > 0 ? "text-emerald-600" : delta < 0 ? "text-rose-600" : "text-zinc-400";
};

export const MetricStrip: React.FC<MetricStripProps> = ({
  metrics,
  activeIndex,
  onMetricClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  if (!metrics.length) return null;
  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      data-metric-strip
      className={`flex flex-wrap items-stretch divide-x divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {metrics.map((metric, index) => {
        const active = index === activeIndex;
        const deltaTone = toneOf(metric.delta);
        const deltaIcon = metric.delta === undefined ? null : metric.delta > 0 ? "trending-up" : metric.delta < 0 ? "trending-down" : "minus";
        return (
          <div
            key={`${metric.label}-${index}`}
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            data-metric-index={index}
            aria-current={active ? "true" : undefined}
            onClick={() => onMetricClick?.(index, metric)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                event.preventDefault();
                onMetricClick?.(index, metric);
              }
            }}
            className={`group flex min-w-[140px] flex-1 cursor-pointer flex-col gap-0.5 px-4 py-3 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              active ? "bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60" : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40"
            }`}
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              {metric.icon ? <UiIcon name={metric.icon} size={12} className="text-zinc-400" /> : null}
              {metric.label}
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{metric.value}</span>
              {metric.delta !== undefined ? (
                <span className={`flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${deltaTone}`}>
                  {deltaIcon ? <UiIcon name={deltaIcon} size={11} /> : null}
                  {metric.delta > 0 ? "+" : ""}
                  {metric.delta}
                  {metric.deltaLabel ? ` ${metric.deltaLabel}` : "%"}
                </span>
              ) : metric.deltaLabel ? (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">{metric.deltaLabel}</span>
              ) : null}
            </span>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default MetricStrip;


===== FILE: react\Modal.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Close on backdrop click / Escape. Defaults to true. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Close button in the header. Defaults to true. */
  showClose?: boolean;
  /** Footer actions; rendered right-aligned. */
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  onClose?: () => void;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export const Modal: React.FC<ModalProps> = ({
  open,
  title,
  description,
  dismissible = true,
  showClose = true,
  footer,
  onClose,
  children,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && dismissible) onClose?.();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [open, dismissible, onClose]);

  if (!open) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 ${className}`}
      onMouseDown={(event) => {
        if (dismissible && panelRef.current && !panelRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) onClose?.();
      }}
    >
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/50 backdrop-blur-[2px]" />
      <div
        ref={panelRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title}
        className="relative w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
      >
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-5 pt-4">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h2>
            {description && (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          {showClose && (
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Close"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              <UiIcon name="x" size={14} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {children && <div className="px-5 py-4 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">{children}</div>}
        {footer && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950/50">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Modal;

import React from "react";

export type CompareStatus = "done" | "streaming" | "error";

export interface ModelComparePaneProps {
  prompt?: string;
  modelA?: string;
  modelB?: string;
  outputA?: string;
  outputB?: string;
  statusA?: CompareStatus;
  statusB?: CompareStatus;
  voteLabelA?: string;
  voteLabelB?: string;
  voteLabelTie?: string;
  onVote?: (choice: "A" | "B" | "tie") => void;
  className?: string;
}

const ERROR_TEXT = "Generation failed — try again.";

/**
 * ModelComparePane - LMArena style side-by-side model comparison: one shared
 * prompt, two anonymous model outputs and a vote bar (A / Tie / B).
 */
export default function ModelComparePane({
  prompt = "",
  modelA = "Model A",
  modelB = "Model B",
  outputA = "",
  outputB = "",
  statusA = "done",
  statusB = "done",
  voteLabelA = "A is better",
  voteLabelB = "B is better",
  voteLabelTie = "Tie",
  onVote,
  className = "",
}: ModelComparePaneProps) {
  const column = (side: "a" | "b") => {
    const model = side === "a" ? modelA : modelB;
    const output = side === "a" ? outputA : outputB;
    const status = side === "a" ? statusA : statusB;
    return (
      <div
        data-compare-col={side}
        className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <span data-compare-model={side} className="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900">{model}</span>
          {status === "streaming" && (
            <span data-compare-status={side} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
              streaming
              <span className="flex gap-0.5" aria-hidden="true">
                <span className="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:0ms]" />
                <span className="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:150ms]" />
                <span className="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:300ms]" />
              </span>
            </span>
          )}
          {status === "error" && <span data-compare-status={side} className="text-[11px] font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">error</span>}
        </div>
        <p
          data-compare-output={side}
          className={`mt-2 min-h-16 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-relaxed ${
            status === "error" ? "text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
          }`}
        >
          {status === "error" ? ERROR_TEXT : output}
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div data-model-compare className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {prompt && (
        <p data-compare-prompt className="mb-3 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-zinc-100">
          <span className="mr-1.5 font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">Prompt</span>
          {prompt}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        {column("a")}
        {column("b")}
      </div>
      <div data-compare-votebar className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
        <button type="button" data-compare-vote="A" onClick={() => onVote?.("A")} className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          👈 {voteLabelA}
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-compare-vote="tie" onClick={() => onVote?.("tie")} className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          🤝 {voteLabelTie}
        </button>
        <button type="button" data-compare-vote="B" onClick={() => onVote?.("B")} className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          👉 {voteLabelB}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: react\ModelSelector.tsx =====

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ModelOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  provider?: string;
  description?: string;
  contextLength?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

export interface ModelSelectorProps {
  models: ModelOption[];
  selectedId: string;
  onSelect?: (model: ModelOption) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  showSearch?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const ModelSelector: React.FC<ModelSelectorProps> = ({
  models = [],
  selectedId,
  onSelect,
  placeholder = "Select model...",
  showSearch = true,
  disabled = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const selectedModel = useMemo(
    () => models.find((m) => m.id === selectedId) || null,
    [models, selectedId]
  );

  const filteredModels = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return models;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return models.filter(
      (m) =>
        m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (m.provider && m.provider.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.description && m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.tags && m.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    );
  }, [models, searchQuery]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (
        containerRef.current &&
        !containerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)
      ) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSelect = (model: ModelOption) => {
    onSelect?.(model);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setSearchQuery("");
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`relative inline-block text-xs font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 ${className}`}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-all shadow-sm ${
          disabled ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : "cursor-pointer"
        }`}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <div className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 shrink-0">
            <UiIcon name="sparkles" size={14} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col text-left truncate">
            <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 truncate">
              {selectedModel ? selectedModel.name : placeholder}
            </span>
            {selectedModel?.provider && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                {selectedModel.provider}
                {selectedModel.contextLength ? ` · ${selectedModel.contextLength}` : ""}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <UiIcon
          name="chevron-down"
          size={14}
          className={`text-zinc-400 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 mt-1.5 w-72 max-h-80 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl z-40 flex flex-col animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          {showSearch && (
            <div className="p-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100/80 dark:bg-zinc-800/80">
                <UiIcon name="search" size={13} className="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search models..."
                  className="w-full bg-transparent border-none text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="overflow-y-auto p-1.5 space-y-1 max-h-60" role="listbox">
            {filteredModels.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-3 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">No models found</div>
            ) : (
              filteredModels.map((model) => {
                const isSelected = model.id === selectedId;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={model.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelect(model)}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={isSelected}
                    className={`w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
                        : "hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">
                          {model.name}
                        </span>
                        {model.contextLength && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">
                            {model.contextLength}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {model.tags?.map((tag) => (
                          <span
                            key={tag}
                            className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/50"
                          >
                            {tag}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      {model.description && (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">
                          {model.description}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {isSelected && (
                      <UiIcon
                        name="check"
                        size={14}
                        className="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5"
                      />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
export default ModelSelector;


===== FILE: react\MonitorRunList.tsx =====

/**
 * MonitorRunList - LLM monitor run history: filter + time-range pills over a
 * mini request histogram, then run rows with success icon, timestamp, name
 * and latency (Adaline Monitor pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface RunRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  startedAt: string;
  latencyMs: number;
  ok?: boolean;
}

export interface HistogramBar {
  label: string;
  value: number;
}

export interface MonitorRunListProps {
  runs?: RunRow[];
  histogram?: HistogramBar[];
  ranges?: string[];
  activeRange?: string;
  className?: string;
  onRunClick?: (run: RunRow) => void;
  onRangeChange?: (range: string) => void;
}

export const formatLatency = (ms: number) => {
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms} ms`;
  const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const rem = ms % 1000;
  return rem === 0 ? `${s} s` : `${s} s ${rem} ms`;
};

const DEFAULT_RUNS: RunRow[] = [
  { id: "r1", name: "Product Performance Metrics", startedAt: "Oct 14, 1:00 AM", latencyMs: 7000, ok: true },
  { id: "r2", name: "Q2 Financial Overview", startedAt: "Oct 14, 12:59 AM", latencyMs: 6688, ok: true },
  { id: "r3", name: "Customer Retention Strategy", startedAt: "Oct 14, 12:37 AM", latencyMs: 1819, ok: true },
  { id: "r4", name: "Employee Satisfaction Survey 2025", startedAt: "Oct 13, 10:44 PM", latencyMs: 903, ok: true },
];

const DEFAULT_HISTOGRAM: HistogramBar[] = [
  { label: "13:00", value: 40 },
  { label: "15:00", value: 25 },
  { label: "17:00", value: 55 },
  { label: "19:00", value: 30 },
  { label: "21:00", value: 70 },
  { label: "23:00", value: 45 },
  { label: "01:00", value: 60 },
  { label: "03:00", value: 35 },
  { label: "05:00", value: 80 },
  { label: "07:00", value: 50 },
  { label: "09:00", value: 65 },
  { label: "11:00", value: 20 },
];

export default function MonitorRunList({
  runs = DEFAULT_RUNS,
  histogram = DEFAULT_HISTOGRAM,
  ranges = ["24 hrs", "7 days", "30 days", "6 months"],
  activeRange = "24 hrs",
  className = "",
  onRunClick,
  onRangeChange,
}: MonitorRunListProps) {
  const max = Math.max(1, ...histogram.map((b) => b.value));
  return (
    <div data-monitor-run-list className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-monitor-toolbar className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-monitor-filter
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          <span aria-hidden="true">⏳</span> Filter
        </button>
        <div data-monitor-ranges className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          {ranges.map((range) => (
            <button
              key={range}
              type="button"
              data-monitor-range={range}
              aria-pressed={range === activeRange}
              className={`rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                range === activeRange
                  ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white"
                  : "text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              }`}
              onClick={() => onRangeChange?.(range)}
            >
              {range}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div data-monitor-histogram className="flex h-20 items-end gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        {histogram.map((bar) => (
          <div key={bar.label} data-monitor-bar={bar.label} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1">
            <div
              className="w-full rounded-sm bg-emerald-600/85 transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500"
              style={{ height: `${Math.max(4, (bar.value / max) * 56)}px` }}
              title={`${bar.label} · ${bar.value}`}
            />
            <span className="w-full truncate text-center text-[9px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{bar.label}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <table data-monitor-runs className="w-full">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 text-left text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
            <th className="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Started At</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 font-medium">Name</th>
            <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right font-medium">Latency</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {runs.map((run) => (
            <tr
              key={run.id}
              data-monitor-run={run.id}
              tabIndex={0}
              onClick={() => onRunClick?.(run)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") onRunClick?.(run); }}
              className="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
            >
              <td data-monitor-run-time className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                <span className="mr-1.5 inline-flex items-center" aria-hidden="true">
                  {run.ok !== false ? "✅" : "⚠️"}
                </span>
                {run.startedAt}
              </td>
              <td data-monitor-run-name className="max-w-0 truncate px-2 py-2.5 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{run.name}</td>
              <td data-monitor-run-latency className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {formatLatency(run.latencyMs)}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\Navbar.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface NavbarLink {
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  badge?: string | number;
}

export interface NavbarMenu {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  columns: { heading?: string; links: NavbarLink[] }[];
}

export interface NavbarProps {
  brand: string;
  links?: NavbarLink[];
  menus?: NavbarMenu[];
  ctaText?: string;
  onCtaClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const Chevron: React.FC<{ open: boolean }> = ({ open }) => (
  <UiIcon
    name="chevron-down"
    size={12}
    className={`shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${open ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}
  />
);

export const Navbar: React.FC<NavbarProps> = ({ brand, links = [], menus = [], ctaText, onCtaClick, className = "" }) => {
  const [openMenu, setOpenMenu] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const rootRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const onDocMouseDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpenMenu(null);
    };
    const onDocKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") setOpenMenu(null);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDocMouseDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onDocKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDocMouseDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onDocKeyDown);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`relative ${className}`}>
      <nav className="flex items-center gap-6 border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <span className="text-sm font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{brand}</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          {menus.map((menu) => {
            const open = openMenu === menu.id;
            return (
              <div key={menu.id} className="relative">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-expanded={open}
                  aria-haspopup="true"
                  onClick={() => setOpenMenu(open ? null : menu.id)}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                    open
                      ? "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50"
                      : "text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  {menu.label}
                  <Chevron open={open} />
                </button>
                {open && (
                  <div className="absolute left-0 top-full z-30 mt-2 flex gap-6 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                    {menu.columns.map((column, columnIndex) => (
                      <div key={column.heading ?? columnIndex} className="min-w-36 space-y-1">
                        {column.heading && (
                          <p className="px-2 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{column.heading}</p>
                        )}
                        {column.links.map((link) => (
                          <a
                            key={link.id ?? link.label}
                            href={link.href ?? "#"}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
                          >
                            {link.icon && <UiIcon name={link.icon} size={13} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />}
                            <span className="flex-1">{link.label}</span>
                            {link.badge != null && (
                              <span className="rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
                                {link.badge}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </a>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
          {links.map((link) => (
            <a
              key={link.id ?? link.label}
              href={link.href ?? "#"}
              className="rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
            >
              {link.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">
          {ctaText && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onCtaClick}
              className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
            >
              {ctaText}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </nav>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Navbar;
