/**
 * NoResultsState - Search no-results empty state: illustration slot, the
 * original query in quotes, suggestion chips that re-run the search and a
 * clear-filters ghost action (search zero-results pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface NoResultsStateProps {
  query?: string;
  suggestions?: string[];
  clearLabel?: string;
  didYouMeanLabel?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  onSuggestion?: (suggestion: string) => void;
  onClearFilters?: () => void;
}

export const NoResultsState: React.FC<NoResultsStateProps> = ({
  query = "",
  suggestions = [],
  clearLabel = "Clear all filters",
  didYouMeanLabel = "Did you mean",
  children,
  className = "",
  onSuggestion,
  onClearFilters,
}) => {
  const list = Array.isArray(suggestions) ? suggestions : [];

  return (
    <div data-noresults-state className={`flex w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-14 text-center shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {children || (
        <div data-noresults-illustration aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 text-3xl dark:bg-zinc-800">🔍</div>
      )}
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <p data-noresults-title className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          No results for {query ? <span data-noresults-query className="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">“{query}”</span> : null}
        </p>
        <p data-noresults-description className="mx-auto max-w-md text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Try a different keyword or remove some filters to widen your search.</p>
      </div>
      {list.length ? (
        <div data-noresults-suggestions className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{didYouMeanLabel}</span>
          {list.map((s) => (
            <button
              key={s}
              type="button"
              data-noresults-suggestion={s}
              onClick={() => onSuggestion?.(s)}
              className="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:border-violet-300 hover:text-violet-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-violet-700 dark:hover:text-violet-400"
            >
              {s}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <button type="button" data-noresults-clear onClick={() => onClearFilters?.()} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">{clearLabel}</button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default NoResultsState;


===== FILE: react\NotificationCenter.tsx =====

import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface NotificationItem {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Pre-formatted relative time, e.g. "2m ago". */
  time?: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  unread?: boolean;
  type?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error";
}

export interface NotificationCenterProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  notifications?: NotificationItem[];
  title?: string;
  emptyText?: string;
  /** Show the All / Unread filter row. */
  showFilter?: boolean;
  /** Render a gear button that emits onOpenPreferences. */
  showPrefsButton?: boolean;
  onSelect?: (notification: NotificationItem) => void;
  onMarkRead?: (ids: Array<string | number>) => void;
  onMarkAllRead?: () => void;
  onOpenPreferences?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TYPE_META = {
  info: { chip: "bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400", icon: "info" as UiIconName },
  success: { chip: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400", icon: "check-circle" as UiIconName },
  warning: { chip: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400", icon: "alert-triangle" as UiIconName },
  error: { chip: "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400", icon: "circle-x" as UiIconName },
};

export const NotificationCenter: React.FC<NotificationCenterProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  notifications = [],
  title = "Notifications",
  emptyText = "You're all caught up",
  showFilter = true,
  showPrefsButton = false,
  onSelect,
  onMarkRead,
  onMarkAllRead,
  onOpenPreferences,
  onClose,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<"all" | "unread">("all");

  const unreadIds = useMemo(
    () => notifications.filter((item) => item.unread).map((item) => item.id),
    [notifications]
  );
  const visible = filter === "unread" ? notifications.filter((item) => item.unread) : notifications;

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className={`w-full max-w-sm overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg ${className}`}
      role="region"
      aria-label={title}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-2.5">
        <UiIcon name="bell" size={14} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
        <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</h3>
        {unreadIds.length > 0 && (
          <span className="rounded-full bg-indigo-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400">
            {unreadIds.length} new
          </span>
        )}
        {showPrefsButton ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onOpenPreferences?.()}
            aria-label="Notification preferences"
            className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          >
            <UiIcon name={"settings" as UiIconName} size={12} />
          </button>
        ) : null}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onMarkAllRead?.()}
          disabled={unreadIds.length === 0}
          className="ml-auto text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:disabled:text-zinc-600"
        >
          Mark all read
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onClose?.()}
          aria-label="Close notifications"
          className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {showFilter && (
        <div className="flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-1.5">
          {(["all", "unread"] as const).map((key) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={filter === key}
              onClick={() => setFilter(key)}
              className={`rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium capitalize transition-colors ${
                filter === key
                  ? "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
                  : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              }`}
            >
              {key}
              <span className="ml-1 tabular-nums text-zinc-400">
                {key === "all" ? notifications.length : unreadIds.length}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
        {visible.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="px-3 py-8 text-center">
            <UiIcon name="check-circle" size={20} className="mx-auto mb-1.5 text-emerald-500" />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{emptyText}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {visible.map((item) => {
              const meta = TYPE_META[item.type || "info"];
              return (
                <li key={item.id}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (item.unread) onMarkRead?.([item.id]);
                      onSelect?.(item);
                    }}
                    className="flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50"
                  >
                    <span className={`mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${meta.chip}`}>
                      <UiIcon name={item.icon || meta.icon} size={13} />
                    </span>
                    <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{item.title}</span>
                        {item.unread && <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" aria-label="Unread" />}
                      </span>
                      {item.description && (
                        <span className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 block text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                          {item.description}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {item.time && <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{item.time}</span>}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default NotificationCenter;


===== FILE: react\NotificationPrefsMatrix.tsx =====

/**
 * NotificationPrefsMatrix - Notification preference matrix: rows are event
 * types, columns are channels (In-app / Email / Push) rendered as
 * checkboxes, with per-row channel quick toggles (notification settings
 * pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface NotificationPrefEvent {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  channels: { inapp?: boolean; email?: boolean; push?: boolean } & Record<string, boolean | undefined>;
}

export interface NotificationPrefColumn {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface NotificationPrefsMatrixProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  events?: NotificationPrefEvent[];
  columns?: NotificationPrefColumn[];
  className?: string;
  onChange?: (event: NotificationPrefEvent, channel: string, enabled: boolean) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_COLUMNS: NotificationPrefColumn[] = [
  { key: "inapp", label: "In-app" },
  { key: "email", label: "Email" },
  { key: "push", label: "Push" },
];

const DEFAULT_EVENTS: NotificationPrefEvent[] = [
  { id: "mentions", label: "Mentions & replies", channels: { inapp: true, email: true, push: false } },
  { id: "assigns", label: "Assigned to me", channels: { inapp: true, email: false, push: true } },
  { id: "comments", label: "Thread comments", channels: { inapp: true, email: true, push: false } },
  { id: "digest", label: "Weekly digest", channels: { inapp: false, email: true, push: false } },
];

export const NotificationPrefsMatrix: React.FC<NotificationPrefsMatrixProps> = ({
  title = "Notification preferences",
  description = "Choose which events reach you and through which channels.",
  events = DEFAULT_EVENTS,
  columns = DEFAULT_COLUMNS,
  className = "",
  onChange,
}) => {
  const list = Array.isArray(events) ? events : [];
  const cols = Array.isArray(columns) ? columns : [];

  return (
    <div data-pref-matrix className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-pref-header className="border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p data-pref-title className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        <p data-pref-description className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>
      </div>
      <table data-pref-table-body className="w-full text-left text-xs">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <th className="px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold">Event</th>
            {cols.map((col) => (
              <th key={col.key} data-pref-col={col.key} className="w-20 px-2 py-2.5 text-center font-semibold">{col.label}</th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {list.map((ev) => (
            <tr key={ev.id} data-pref-row={ev.id} className="border-b border-zinc-50 transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
              <td data-pref-label={ev.label} className="px-5 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{ev.label}</td>
              {cols.map((col) => (
                <td key={col.key} data-pref-cell-state={`${ev.id}|${col.key}`} className="px-2 py-3 text-center">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    data-pref-cell={`${ev.id}|${col.key}`}
                    checked={Boolean(ev.channels && ev.channels[col.key])}
                    onChange={(e) => onChange?.(ev, col.key, e.target.checked)}
                    className="h-4 w-4 accent-violet-600"
                    aria-label={`${ev.label} via ${col.label}`}
                  />
                </td>
              ))}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
};

export default NotificationPrefsMatrix;


===== FILE: react\OnboardingChecklist.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface OnboardingTask {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  done: boolean;
  actionText?: string;
}

export interface OnboardingChecklistProps {
  tasks: OnboardingTask[];
  title?: string;
  onToggle?: (task: OnboardingTask) => void;
  onTaskAction?: (task: OnboardingTask) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const OnboardingChecklist: React.FC<OnboardingChecklistProps> = ({
  tasks,
  title = "Get started",
  onToggle,
  onTaskAction,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const doneCount = tasks.filter((task) => task.done).length;
  const total = tasks.length;
  const percent = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneCount / total) * 100);
  const allDone = total > 0 && doneCount === total;

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</span>
          <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            {doneCount}/{total}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-all duration-300"
            style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {allDone ? (
            <>
              <UiIcon name="check-circle" size={12} className="text-emerald-500" />
              <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">All set — nothing left to do.</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <span>
              {percent}% complete · {total - doneCount} left
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <ul className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {tasks.map((task) => (
          <li key={task.id} className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onToggle?.(task)}
              aria-pressed={task.done}
              aria-label={task.done ? `Mark ${task.title} as not done` : `Mark ${task.title} as done`}
              className={`mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                task.done
                  ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white"
                  : "border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 text-transparent hover:border-indigo-500"
              }`}
            >
              <UiIcon name="check" size={10} />
            </button>

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div
                className={`text-xs ${
                  task.done
                    ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 line-through"
                    : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                {task.title}
              </div>
              {task.description && (
                <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{task.description}</div>
              )}
            </div>

            {!task.done && task.actionText && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onTaskAction?.(task)}
                className="shrink-0 rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                {task.actionText}
              </button>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OnboardingChecklist;

import React from "react";

export interface StepperSegment {
  label: string;
  description: string;
  /** Optional example rows shown inside the description card. */
  examples?: { label: string; value: string }[];
}

export interface OnboardingStepperProps {
  steps: string[];
  current?: number;
  segments?: StepperSegment[];
  title?: string;
  continueLabel?: string;
  onContinue?: () => void;
  onStepClick?: (index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const OnboardingStepper: React.FC<OnboardingStepperProps> = ({
  steps,
  current = 0,
  segments = [],
  title = "Transaction types",
  continueLabel = "Continue",
  onContinue,
  onStepClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [activeSegment, setActiveSegment] = React.useState(0);
  const total = steps.length;
  const active = Math.min(Math.max(current, 0), total - 1);
  const segment = segments[Math.min(activeSegment, segments.length - 1)];

  return (
    <div
      data-onboarding-stepper
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Horizontal step chain */}
      <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs" aria-label="Setup steps">
        {steps.map((step, index) => {
          const done = index < active;
          const isCurrent = index === active;
          return (
            <li key={step} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {index > 0 ? (
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">
                  &gt;
                </span>
              ) : null}
              <button
                type="button"
                data-step-index={index}
                aria-current={isCurrent ? "step" : undefined}
                onClick={() => onStepClick?.(index)}
                className={`rounded-md px-2 py-1 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  isCurrent
                    ? "border-b-2 border-indigo-500 font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                    : done
                      ? "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
                      : "text-zinc-400"
                }`}
              >
                {step}
              </button>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      <div className="mt-2 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div
          data-stepper-progress
          className="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-500 transition-all duration-300"
          style={{ width: `${((active + 1) / total) * 100}%` }}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Segmented control + description card */}
      {segments.length ? (
        <div className="mt-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
          <div
            role="tablist"
            aria-label={title}
            className="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            {segments.map((seg, index) => (
              <button
                key={seg.label}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={index === activeSegment}
                data-segment-index={index}
                onClick={() => setActiveSegment(index)}
                className={`rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  index === activeSegment
                    ? "bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                    : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                {seg.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {segment ? (
            <div data-segment-description className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{segment.description}</p>
              {segment.examples?.length ? (
                <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                  {segment.examples.map((example, index) => (
                    <li
                      key={`${example.label}-${index}`}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs"
                    >
                      <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                        <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
                          {index + 1}
                        </span>
                        <span className="truncate">{example.label}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="shrink-0 font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                        {example.value}
                      </span>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <button
        type="button"
        data-stepper-continue
        onClick={onContinue}
        className="mt-5 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
      >
        {continueLabel}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OnboardingStepper;

import React from "react";

export interface SummaryRow {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  kind?: "item" | "discount" | "tax" | "fee" | "subtotal" | "total";
  strikeValue?: string;
  note?: string;
}

export interface OrderSummaryPanelProps {
  rows: SummaryRow[];
  heading?: string;
  ctaLabel?: string;
  ctaAmount?: string;
  promoPlaceholder?: string;
  appliedPromos?: string[];
  trustFooter?: string;
  onCta?: () => void;
  onApplyPromo?: (code: string) => void;
  onRemovePromo?: (code: string) => void;
}

const KIND_TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  discount: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
  fee: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
  total: "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50",
};

/**
 * OrderSummaryPanel - price breakdown with line rows, discounts, bold total, promo entry and primary CTA.
 */
export default function OrderSummaryPanel({
  rows,
  heading = "Order summary",
  ctaLabel = "Place your order",
  ctaAmount,
  promoPlaceholder = "Add a promo code",
  appliedPromos = [],
  trustFooter,
  onCta,
  onApplyPromo,
  onRemovePromo,
}: OrderSummaryPanelProps) {
  const [code, setCode] = React.useState("");

  const submitPromo = () => {
    if (!code.trim()) return;
    onApplyPromo?.(code.trim());
    setCode("");
  };

  return (
    <div data-order-summary className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{heading}</p>
      <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {rows.map((row, index) => {
          const isTotal = row.kind === "total";
          const isLast = index === rows.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={row.id} data-summary-row={row.id} className={`flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 ${isTotal ? "border-t border-zinc-200 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-700" : ""}`}>
              <span className={`text-xs ${isTotal ? "font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"}`}>
                {row.label}
                {row.note ? <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">({row.note})</span> : null}
              </span>
              <span className={`shrink-0 text-xs font-medium ${KIND_TONE[row.kind || ""] || "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"}`}>
                {row.strikeValue ? <span className="mr-1.5 font-normal text-zinc-400 line-through">{row.strikeValue}</span> : null}
                {row.value}
              </span>
              {isLast && !isTotal ? null : null}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      <div data-promo-block className="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">

              <li key={promo} data-promo-applied className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 dark:bg-emerald-950/40">

              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : null}
        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
          <input
            type="text"
            data-promo-input
            value={code}
            placeholder={promoPlaceholder}
            onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === "Enter") submitPromo(); }}
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
          />

        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" data-summary-cta onClick={() => onCta?.()} className="mt-3 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">

          {trustFooter}
        </p>

import React from "react";

export interface TrackerStage {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  timestamp?: string;
}

export interface OrderTrackerProps {
  stages: TrackerStage[];
  current: number | "canceled";
  variant?: "dots" | "bar";
  eta?: string;
  trackingNumber?: string;
  trackingUrl?: string;
  canceledReason?: string;
  onTrack?: () => void;
}

/**
 * OrderTracker - horizontal fulfillment progress tracker (dot connector or continuous bar) with canceled state.
 */
export default function OrderTracker({
  stages,
  current,
  variant = "dots",
  eta,
  trackingNumber,
  trackingUrl,
  canceledReason,
  onTrack,
}: OrderTrackerProps) {
  const canceled = current === "canceled";
  const currentIndex = canceled ? -1 : (current as number);
  const progress = canceled ? 0 : Math.round(((currentIndex + 1) / stages.length) * 100);

  if (variant === "bar") {
    return (
      <div data-order-tracker className="w-full">
        <div className="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div
            data-tracker-fill
            className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${canceled ? "bg-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-600" : "bg-emerald-600"}`}
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between">
          {stages.map((stage, index) => {
            const reached = !canceled && index <= currentIndex;
            const isCurrent = !canceled && index === currentIndex;
            return (
              <span
                key={stage.id}
                data-tracker-stage={stage.id}
                className={`text-[10px] font-medium ${isCurrent ? "font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" : reached ? "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600"}`}
              >
                {stage.label}
              </span>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {canceled && canceledReason ? <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{canceledReason}</p> : null}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div data-order-tracker className="w-full">
      {eta && !canceled ? (
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          {eta}
          {trackingNumber ? <span className="ml-2 font-normal text-zinc-400">· {trackingNumber}</span> : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {canceled ? <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Canceled{canceledReason ? ` — ${canceledReason}` : ""}</p> : null}
      <ol className="flex items-start">
        {stages.map((stage, index) => {
          const reached = !canceled && index <= currentIndex;
          const isCurrent = !canceled && index === currentIndex;
          const last = index === stages.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={stage.id} data-tracker-stage={stage.id} className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start">
              <span className="flex flex-col items-center">
                <span
                  className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${
                    isCurrent
                      ? "ring-2 ring-zinc-900 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-white dark:ring-zinc-100 dark:ring-offset-zinc-900"
                      : ""
                  } ${reached ? "bg-emerald-600" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700"}`}
                >
                  {reached ? <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" strokeWidth="3" className="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg> : null}
                </span>
                <span className={`mt-1 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] font-medium ${isCurrent ? "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" : reached ? "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600"}`}>{stage.label}</span>
                {stage.timestamp ? <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600">{stage.timestamp}</span> : null}
              </span>
              {!last ? <span className={`mx-1 mt-2 h-0.5 flex-1 ${reached && index < currentIndex ? "bg-emerald-600" : "bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"}`} /> : null}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      {trackingUrl ? (
        <button type="button" data-tracker-track onClick={() => onTrack?.()} className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">
          Track shipment &gt;
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\OtpInput.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { useRef } from "react";

export interface OtpInputProps {
  length?: number;
  value?: string;
  heading?: string;
  subtext?: string;
  status?: "idle" | "error";
  errorText?: string;
  continueLabel?: string;
  resendHint?: string;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onComplete?: (value: string) => void;
}

/**
 * OtpInput - verification code entry with per-cell auto-advance and error state.
 */
export default function OtpInput({
  length = 6,
  value = "",
  heading,
  subtext,
  status = "idle",
  errorText,
  continueLabel = "Continue",
  resendHint,
  onChange,
  onComplete,
}: OtpInputProps) {
  const chars = Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => value[i] ?? "");
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLInputElement | null)[]>([]);
  const errored = status === "error";

  const commit = (next: string) => {
    onChange?.(next);
    if (next.length >= length) onComplete?.(next.slice(0, length));
  };

  const setAt = (index: number, char: string) => {
    const digits = chars.slice();
    digits[index] = char;
    commit(digits.join("").slice(0, length));
  };

  const cellClass = (filled: boolean) =>
    `h-12 w-11 rounded-lg border text-center text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
      errored
        ? "border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/60 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-500/70 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-200"
        : filled
          ? "border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50"
          : "border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-400 placeholder:text-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-500"
    }`;

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm" data-otp-input>
      {heading ? <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{heading}</h2> : null}
      {subtext ? <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{subtext}</p> : null}

      <div className={`flex gap-1.5 ${heading || subtext ? "mt-4" : ""}`} data-otp-cells>
        {chars.map((char, index) => (
          <input
            key={index}
            ref={(node) => {
              refs.current[index] = node;
            }}
            type="text"
            inputMode="numeric"
            maxLength={1}
            value={char}
            aria-label={`Digit ${index + 1}`}
            data-otp-cell={index}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const char = event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-1);
              if (!char) return;
              setAt(index, char);
              refs.current[Math.min(index + 1, length - 1)]?.focus();
            }}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key === "Backspace") {
                if (chars[index]) {
                  setAt(index, "");
                } else if (index > 0) {
                  setAt(index - 1, "");
                  refs.current[index - 1]?.focus();
                }
              }
            }}
            onPaste={(event) => {
              const pasted = event.clipboardData.getData("text").replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, length);
              if (pasted.length > 1) {
                event.preventDefault();
                commit(pasted);
                refs.current[Math.min(pasted.length, length - 1)]?.focus();
              }
            }}
            className={cellClass(Boolean(char))}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {errored && errorText ? (
        <p data-otp-error className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5">
            <path d="m10.29 3.86 1.58-2.75a1 1 0 0 1 1.74 0l1.58 2.75 3.18.55a1 1 0 0 1 .6 1.62l-2.2 2.5 2.2 2.5a1 1 0 0 1-.6 1.62l-3.18.55-1.58 2.75a1 1 0 0 1-1.74 0l-1.58-2.75-3.18-.55a1 1 0 0 1-.6-1.62l2.2-2.5-2.2-2.5a1 1 0 0 1 .6-1.62Z" />
            <path d="M12 9v4M12 17h.01" />
          </svg>
          {errorText}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <button
        type="button"
        data-otp-continue
        className="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
      >
        {continueLabel}
      </button>

      {resendHint ? (
        <p className="mt-3 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <a href="#" data-otp-resend className="font-medium text-indigo-600 underline-offset-2 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">
            Resend code
          </a>{" "}
          · {resendHint}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: react\Pagination.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface PaginationProps {
  /** Current page, 1-based. */
  page: number;
  pageCount: number;
  onChange?: (page: number) => void;
  /** How many page numbers to show on each side of the current page. Defaults to 1. */
  siblingCount?: number;
  /** Show first/last page jump buttons. Defaults to true. */
  showEdges?: boolean;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export type PaginationSlot = number | "gap";

export const paginationSlots = (page: number, pageCount: number, siblingCount = 1): PaginationSlot[] => {
  if (pageCount <= 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set<number>([1, pageCount, page]);
  for (let offset = 1; offset <= siblingCount; offset += 1) {
    seen.add(page - offset);
    seen.add(page + offset);
  }
  const sorted = Array.from(seen)
    .filter((entry) => entry >= 1 && entry <= pageCount)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const slots: PaginationSlot[] = [];
  let previous = 0;
  for (const entry of sorted) {
    if (previous > 0 && entry - previous > 1) slots.push("gap");
    slots.push(entry);
    previous = entry;
  }
  return slots;
};

const BASE =
  "inline-flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40";

export const Pagination: React.FC<PaginationProps> = ({
  page,
  pageCount,
  onChange,
  siblingCount = 1,
  showEdges = true,
  ariaLabel = "Pagination",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const slots = paginationSlots(page, pageCount, siblingCount);
  const go = (next: number) => {
    if (next < 1 || next > pageCount || next === page) return;
    onChange?.(next);
  };

  const edge = (target: number, label: string, icon: "chevron-left" | "chevron-right") => (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={label}
      disabled={target < 1 || target > pageCount}
      onClick={() => go(target)}
      className={`${BASE} text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100`}
    >
      <UiIcon name={icon} size={13} />
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <nav aria-label={ariaLabel} className={`flex items-center gap-1 ${className}`}>
      {showEdges && edge(1, "First page", "chevron-left")}
      {edge(page - 1, "Previous page", "chevron-left")}
      {slots.map((slot, index) =>
        slot === "gap" ? (
          <span key={`gap-${index}`} aria-hidden="true" className="px-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
            …
          </span>
        ) : (
          <button
            key={slot}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`Page ${slot}`}
            aria-current={slot === page ? "page" : undefined}
            onClick={() => go(slot)}
            className={`${BASE} tabular-nums ${
              slot === page
                ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white"
                : "text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100"
            }`}
          >
            {slot}
          </button>
        )
      )}
      {edge(page + 1, "Next page", "chevron-right")}
      {showEdges && edge(pageCount, "Last page", "chevron-right")}
    </nav>
  );
};

export default Pagination;

===== FILE: react\PipelineStageList.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface PipelineStage {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  status: "pending" | "running" | "success" | "failed";
  durationMs?: number;
}

export interface PipelineGroup {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  currentStep?: string;
  stages: PipelineStage[];
}

export interface PipelineStageListProps {
  groups: PipelineGroup[];
  defaultExpanded?: string[];
  showDuration?: boolean;
  collapsible?: boolean;
  onStageClick?: (stage: PipelineStage) => void;
}

const STAGE_STATUS: Record<string, { text: string; tone: string }> = {
  pending: { text: "Pending", tone: "text-zinc-400" },
  running: { text: "Running", tone: "text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" },
  success: { text: "Completed", tone: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" },
  failed: { text: "Failed", tone: "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" },
};

const durationLabel = (ms?: number) => {
  if (ms == null) return "";
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  if (ms < 60000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(ms % 1000 === 0 ? 0 : 1)}s`;
  return `${Math.floor(ms / 60000)}m ${Math.round((ms % 60000) / 1000)}s`;
};

/**
 * PipelineStageList - grouped CI pipeline accordion with per-stage status, durations and chevron expansion.
 */
export default function PipelineStageList({ groups, defaultExpanded = [], showDuration = true, collapsible = true, onStageClick }: PipelineStageListProps) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = React.useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set(defaultExpanded));
  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    if (!collapsible) return;
    setExpanded((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div data-pipeline-list className="w-full divide-y divide-zinc-200 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      {groups.map((group) => {
        const open = expanded.has(group.id);
        const running = group.stages.some((stage) => stage.status === "running");
        return (
          <div key={group.id} data-pipeline-group={group.id}>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-pipeline-group-header
              onClick={() => toggle(group.id)}
              className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
            >
              {running ? (
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 animate-spin text-sky-500"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" /></svg>
              ) : (
                <span className="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-dashed border-zinc-400" />
              )}
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span className="block text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{group.title}</span>
                {group.currentStep ? <span className="block truncate text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{group.currentStep}</span> : null}
              </span>
              {showDuration ? (
                <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {durationLabel(group.stages.reduce((sum, stage) => sum + (stage.durationMs || 0), 0) || undefined)}
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {collapsible ? (
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${open ? "rotate-90" : ""}`}>
                  <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" />
                </svg>
              ) : null}
            </button>
            {open ? (
              <div className="mx-3 mb-3 rounded-md bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-1.5 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
                {group.stages.map((stage) => {
                  const tone = STAGE_STATUS[stage.status] || STAGE_STATUS.pending;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={stage.id}
                      type="button"
                      data-pipeline-stage={stage.id}
                      data-stage-status={stage.status}
                      onClick={() => onStageClick?.(stage)}
                      className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-200 py-2 text-left last:border-b-0 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700/60"
                    >
                      <span className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{stage.label}</span>
                      <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
                        {showDuration && stage.durationMs != null ? <span className="text-zinc-400">{durationLabel(stage.durationMs)}</span> : null}
                        <span className={tone.tone}>{tone.text}</span>
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
