/**
 * PromptTunerResult - Prompt tuner output: an "optimized prompt" dark code
 * panel with a copy action, a completion selector and the completion text
 * viewer (Cohere Prompt Tuner pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface PromptCompletion {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface PromptTunerResultProps {
  optimizedPrompt?: string;
  completions?: PromptCompletion[];
  activeCompletionId?: string;
  className?: string;
  onCopyPrompt?: () => void;
  onCompletionChange?: (completion: PromptCompletion) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_COMPLETIONS: PromptCompletion[] = [
  {
    id: "c1",
    label: "Completion #1",
    text: "I have reviewed the comments left by John's colleagues and can report that his performance has been very well received by his team. Overall, John is regarded as a great team player, who is both knowledgeable and a strong communicator, particularly when it comes to offering advice and guidance to more junior members of the team.",
  },
  {
    id: "c2",
    label: "Completion #2",
    text: "John's colleagues describe him as a knowledgeable, communicative engineer who consistently supports newer team members. The main improvement area flagged across reviews is proactive outreach — teammates note that projects move faster when John initiates status updates himself.",
  },
];

export default function PromptTunerResult({
  optimizedPrompt = "Your optimized prompt will appear here.",
  completions = DEFAULT_COMPLETIONS,
  activeCompletionId = "c1",
  className = "",
  onCopyPrompt,
  onCompletionChange,
}: PromptTunerResultProps) {
  const active = completions.find((c) => c.id === activeCompletionId) ?? completions[0];
  return (
    <div data-prompt-tuner className={`w-full space-y-3 ${className}`}>
      <div data-tuner-prompt-panel className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:ring-1 dark:ring-zinc-800">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 pb-2 pt-3">
          <p data-tuner-prompt-label className="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400">OPTIMIZED PROMPT</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-tuner-copy
            onClick={() => onCopyPrompt?.()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-700 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            <span aria-hidden="true">⧉</span> Copy
          </button>
        </div>
        <pre data-tuner-prompt-text className="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto px-4 pb-4 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-100">{optimizedPrompt}</pre>
      </div>
      <div data-tuner-completions className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-tuner-completions-header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-tuner-completions-label className="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">COMPLETIONS</p>
          <select
            data-tuner-completion-select
            value={active?.id}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const picked = completions.find((c) => c.id === event.target.value);
              if (picked) onCompletionChange?.(picked);
            }}
            className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
          >
            {completions.map((completion) => (
              <option key={completion.id} value={completion.id}>{completion.label}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <p data-tuner-completion-text className="whitespace-pre-wrap px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{active?.text}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\PromptVariantDiff.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface PromptVariant {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface PromptVariantDiffProps {
  variants: PromptVariant[];
  variables?: string[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onApply?: (variant: PromptVariant) => void;
}

const VAR_CHIP =
  "inline rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300";

/** Render prompt text with {{var}} tokens as chips. */
const renderText = (text: string) =>
  text.split(/(\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\})/g).map((part, i) =>
    /^\{\{/.test(part) ? (
      <span key={i} className={VAR_CHIP}>
        {part.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, "")}
      </span>
    ) : (
      <React.Fragment key={i}>{part}</React.Fragment>
    )
  );

/**
 * PromptVariantDiff - side-by-side prompt version A/B comparison with
 * variable-chip highlighting and change stats (Braintrust playground /
 * LangSmith compare pattern).
 */
export default function PromptVariantDiff({
  variants,
  variables = [],
  title = "Prompt variants",
  className = "",
  onApply,
}: PromptVariantDiffProps) {
  const [base, compare] = variants;
  if (!base || !compare) return null;

  const baseVars = (base.text.match(/\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).map((v) => v.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, ""));
  const cmpVars = (compare.text.match(/\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).map((v) => v.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, ""));
  const addedVars = cmpVars.filter((v) => !baseVars.includes(v));
  const removedVars = baseVars.filter((v) => !cmpVars.includes(v));
  const changedText = base.text !== compare.text;

  return (
    <div
      data-prompt-variant-diff
      className={`w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          <span data-diff-added className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{addedVars.length}</span>
          <span data-diff-removed className="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400">−{removedVars.length}</span>
          {changedText && <span data-diff-text className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">~text</span>}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-0 divide-x divide-zinc-100 sm:grid-cols-2 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {variants.map((variant, index) => (
          <div key={variant.id} data-variant-panel={variant.id} className="flex flex-col p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2">
              <span
                className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${index === 0 ? "bg-zinc-400" : "bg-violet-500"}`}
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <span data-variant-label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {variant.label}
              </span>
              {index === 0 && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  Base
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p
              data-variant-text
              className="min-h-16 flex-1 whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200"
            >
              {renderText(variant.text)}
            </p>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-variant-apply
              onClick={() => onApply?.(variant)}
              className="mt-3 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              Use this version
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {(addedVars.length > 0 || removedVars.length > 0) && (
        <div data-variant-varlist className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          {addedVars.map((v) => (
            <span key={`add-${v}`} data-var-added className="inline rounded bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300">
              + {v}
            </span>
          ))}
          {removedVars.map((v) => (
            <span key={`rm-${v}`} data-var-removed className="inline rounded bg-red-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300">
              − {v}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\QaTestTable.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export type QaRating = "good" | "acceptable" | "poor";

export interface QaTestRow {
  id: string;
  question: string;
  answered?: boolean;
  rating?: QaRating;
}

export interface QaTestTableProps {
  rows: QaTestRow[];
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
  onRowCheck?: (row: QaTestRow, checked: boolean) => void;
  onRowSelect?: (row: QaTestRow) => void;
}

const RATING_CHIP: Record<QaRating, string> = {
  good: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  acceptable: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
  poor: "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300",
};

const RATING_LABEL: Record<QaRating, string> = {
  good: "Good",
  acceptable: "Acceptable",
  poor: "Poor",
};

/**
 * QaTestTable - AI answer QA test table (Intercom Fin "Test" pattern):
 * checkbox + question + answer status icon + tone-colored rating chip.
 */
export default function QaTestTable({
  rows,
  title = "QA tests",
  className = "",
  onRowCheck,
  onRowSelect,
}: QaTestTableProps) {
  const [checked, setChecked] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const toggle = (row: QaTestRow) => {
    const next = !checked[row.id];
    setChecked((c) => ({ ...c, [row.id]: next }));
    onRowCheck?.(row, next);
  };

  const answeredCount = rows.filter((r) => r.answered !== false).length;

  return (
    <div
      data-qa-test-table
      className={`w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          {rows.length} questions
        </span>
        <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
          {answeredCount} answered
        </span>
      </div>
      <table data-qa-rows className="w-full text-left">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
            <th className="w-10 py-2 pl-4 font-medium"></th>
            <th className="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">Question</th>
            <th className="py-2 pr-3 text-center font-medium">Answer status</th>
            <th className="py-2 pr-4 font-medium">Answer rating</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <tr
              key={row.id}
              data-qa-row={row.id}
              onClick={() => onRowSelect?.(row)}
              className={`border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${
                onRowSelect ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <td className="py-2.5 pl-4">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  data-qa-check
                  aria-label={`Select ${row.question}`}
                  checked={!!checked[row.id]}
                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  onChange={() => toggle(row)}
                  className="h-3.5 w-3.5 cursor-pointer accent-emerald-600"
                />
              </td>
              <td data-qa-question className="max-w-72 truncate py-2.5 pr-3 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {row.question}
              </td>
              <td className="py-2.5 pr-3 text-center">
                {row.answered !== false ? (
                  <span data-qa-status className="text-emerald-500">✓</span>
                ) : (
                  <span data-qa-status className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">—</span>
                )}
              </td>
              <td className="py-2.5 pr-4">
                {row.rating && (
                  <span
                    data-qa-rating={row.rating}
                    className={`inline rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${RATING_CHIP[row.rating]}`}
                  >
                    {RATING_LABEL[row.rating]}
                  </span>
                )}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface QuoteCard {
  quote: string;
  name: string;
  role?: string;
  company?: string;
  /** Shows a decorative quote mark above the text when true (default true). */
  marked?: boolean;
}

export interface QuoteMasonryProps {
  quotes: QuoteCard[];
  columns?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  className?: string;
}

export const QuoteMasonry: React.FC<QuoteMasonryProps> = ({ quotes, columns = 3, className = "" }) => {
  if (!quotes.length) return null;
  const columnClass = { 2: "sm:columns-2", 3: "sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3", 4: "sm:columns-2 lg:columns-4" }[columns];
  return (
    <div
      data-quote-masonry
      className={`gap-4 ${columnClass} columns-1 [column-fill:balance] ${className}`}
    >
      {quotes.map((card, index) => (
        <figure
          key={`${card.name}-${index}`}
          data-quote-index={index}
          className="mb-4 break-inside-avoid rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        >
          {card.marked !== false ? (
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="block text-3xl font-black leading-none text-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-700">
              &ldquo;
            </span>
          ) : null}
          <blockquote
            className={`text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 ${card.marked !== false ? "-mt-2" : ""}`}
          >
            {card.quote}
          </blockquote>
          <figcaption className="mt-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <span className="min-w-0">
              <span className="block truncate text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                {card.name}
              </span>
              {card.role || card.company ? (
                <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                  {[card.role, card.company].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </span>
            {card.company ? (
              <span className="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {card.company}
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </figcaption>
        </figure>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

===== FILE: react\RankList.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface RankListItem {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  ratio?: number;
  icon?: UiIconName;
}

export interface RankListProps {
  items: RankListItem[];
  title?: string;
  valueHeader?: string;
  showRatio?: boolean;
  maxItems?: number;
  emptyText?: string;
  onSelect?: (index: number, item: RankListItem) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const RankList: React.FC<RankListProps> = ({
  items,
  title,
  valueHeader = "Value",
  showRatio = false,
  maxItems,
  emptyText = "No data yet",
  onSelect,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const visible = typeof maxItems === "number" ? items.slice(0, maxItems) : items;
  const peak = Math.max(...visible.map((item) => Number(item.ratio ?? item.value) || 0), 1);

  return (
    <section
      data-rank-list
      className={`overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {title || valueHeader ? (
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          {title ? <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</h3> : <span />}
          {valueHeader ? (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{valueHeader}</span>
          ) : null}
        </header>
      ) : null}
      {visible.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">{emptyText}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="divide-y divide-zinc-50 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">
          {visible.map((item, index) => {
            const ratio = Math.max(4, Math.min(100, ((Number(item.ratio ?? item.value) || 0) / peak) * 100));
            return (
              <li
                key={`${item.label}-${index}`}
                role={onSelect ? "button" : undefined}
                tabIndex={onSelect ? 0 : undefined}
                data-rank-index={index}
                onClick={() => onSelect?.(index, item)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (onSelect && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    onSelect(index, item);
                  }
                }}
                className={`relative flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  onSelect ? "cursor-pointer" : ""
                }`}
              >
                {showRatio ? (
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="absolute inset-y-1 left-2 rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"
                    style={{ width: `calc((100% - 1rem) * ${ratio / 100})` }}
                  />
                ) : null}
                <span
                  className={`relative z-10 flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 ${
                    showRatio ? "px-1.5 py-0.5" : ""
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.icon ? <UiIcon name={item.icon} size={13} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" /> : null}
                  <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>
                </span>
                <span className="relative z-10 shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  {item.value}
                </span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

export default RankList;

                ) : null}
              </span>
              {item.timeLabel ? (
                <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{item.timeLabel}</span>
              ) : null}
              {item.kind ? (
                <span
                  className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-px text-[10px] font-medium ${
                    KIND_TONE[item.kindTone || "zinc"]
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.kind}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

export default ResourceList;

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface RichToolbarItem {
  id: string;
  /** Accessible name, also used as the tooltip. */
  label: string;
  /** UiIcon name; ignored when `text` is set. */
  icon?: UiIconName;
  /** Short glyph rendered instead of an icon (e.g. "B", "I", "U"). */
  text?: string;
  /** Keyboard hint shown in the tooltip, e.g. "⌘B". */
  shortcut?: string;
  active?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface RichToolbarGroup {
  id: string;
  label?: string;
  items: RichToolbarItem[];
}

export interface RichToolbarProps {
  groups?: RichToolbarGroup[];
  onAction?: (id: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const BASE_BUTTON =
  "flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40";

export const RichToolbar: React.FC<RichToolbarProps> = ({ groups = [], onAction, className = "" }) => {
  return (
    <div
      role="toolbar"
      aria-label="Formatting"
      className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {groups.map((group, groupIndex) => (
        <React.Fragment key={group.id}>
          {groupIndex > 0 && (
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="mx-0.5 h-5 w-px shrink-0 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
          )}
          <div role="group" aria-label={group.label || group.id} className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
            {group.items.map((item) => {
              const tone = item.active
                ? "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400"
                : "text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800";
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={item.label}
                  aria-pressed={item.active ? true : undefined}
                  title={item.shortcut ? `${item.label} (${item.shortcut})` : item.label}
                  disabled={item.disabled}
                  onClick={() => onAction?.(item.id)}
                  className={`${BASE_BUTTON} ${tone}`}
                >
                  {item.text ? (
                    <span className="font-semibold leading-none">{item.text}</span>
                  ) : (
                    <UiIcon name={item.icon || "square"} size={15} />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </React.Fragment>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default RichToolbar;

===== FILE: react\SchedulerSlots.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SchedulerSlot {
  id: string;
  /** Start time in 24h "HH:MM". */
  time: string;
  available?: boolean;
  note?: string;
}

export interface SchedulerSlotsProps {
  /** ISO date shown in the header, e.g. "2026-11-20". */
  date: string;
  slots?: SchedulerSlot[];
  selectedId?: string;
  timezone?: string;
  onSelect?: (slot: SchedulerSlot) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const PERIODS = [
  { key: "morning", label: "Morning", range: [6, 12] },
  { key: "afternoon", label: "Afternoon", range: [12, 17] },
  { key: "evening", label: "Evening", range: [17, 24] },
] as const;

const humanDate = (iso: string) => {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  if (!year || !month || !day) return iso;
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "short",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
  });
};

const hourOf = (time: string) => {
  const [hour] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  return Number.isFinite(hour) ? hour : -1;
};

const AM_PM = (time: string) => {
  const [hour, minute] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return time;
  const suffix = hour >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM";
  const display = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
  return `${display}:${String(minute).padStart(2, "0")} ${suffix}`;
};

export const SchedulerSlots: React.FC<SchedulerSlotsProps> = ({
  date,
  slots = [],
  selectedId,
  timezone,
  onSelect,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const groups = PERIODS.map((period) => ({
    period,
    slots: slots.filter((slot) => {
      const hour = hourOf(slot.time);
      return hour >= period.range[0] && hour < period.range[1];
    }),
  })).filter((group) => group.slots.length > 0);

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <header className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400">
          <UiIcon name="calendar" size={14} />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{humanDate(date)}</h3>
          {timezone && <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">All times in {timezone}</p>}
        </div>
        <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {slots.filter((slot) => slot.available !== false).length} open
        </span>
      </header>

      {groups.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">No slots available for this day.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-3">
          {groups.map(({ period, slots: periodSlots }) => (
            <fieldset key={period.key}>
              <legend className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">
                {period.label}
              </legend>
              <div className="mt-1 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                {periodSlots.map((slot) => {
                  const disabled = slot.available === false;
                  const selected = slot.id === selectedId;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={slot.id}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={disabled}
                      aria-pressed={selected}
                      onClick={() => onSelect?.(slot)}
                      className={`flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                        selected
                          ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 font-medium text-white"
                          : disabled
                            ? "cursor-not-allowed border-zinc-100 text-zinc-300 line-through dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-600"
                            : "border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="tabular-nums">{AM_PM(slot.time)}</span>
                      {selected && <UiIcon name="check" size={11} />}
                      {!selected && disabled && <UiIcon name="lock" size={11} />}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
              {periodSlots.some((slot) => slot.note) && (
                <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                  {periodSlots.filter((slot) => slot.note).map((slot) => slot.note).join(" · ")}
                </p>
              )}
            </fieldset>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SchedulerSlots;


===== FILE: react\SearchInput.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SearchInputProps {
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Show ⌘K-style hint chip on the right. */
  shortcut?: string;
  loading?: boolean;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onSearch?: (value: string) => void;
  onClear?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const SearchInput: React.FC<SearchInputProps> = ({
  value,
  defaultValue = "",
  placeholder = "Search…",
  shortcut,
  loading = false,
  autoFocus = false,
  onChange,
  onSearch,
  onClear,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [inner, setInner] = React.useState(defaultValue);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? value : inner;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoFocus) inputRef.current?.focus();
  }, [autoFocus]);

  const update = (next: string) => {
    if (!controlled) setInner(next);
    onChange?.(next);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-within:border-indigo-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-indigo-500/20 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 ${className}`}
    >
      <UiIcon name="search" size={13} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        type="text"
        role="searchbox"
        aria-label={placeholder}
        value={current}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        onChange={(event) => update(event.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter") onSearch?.(current);
          if (event.key === "Escape" && current) {
            update("");
            onClear?.();
          }
        }}
        className="w-full bg-transparent text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100"
      />
      {loading ? (
        <UiIcon name="loader" size={13} className="shrink-0 animate-spin text-zinc-400" />
      ) : current ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Clear search"
          onClick={() => {
            update("");
            onClear?.();
            inputRef.current?.focus();
          }}
          className="shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
        </button>
      ) : shortcut ? (
        <kbd className="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9.5px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          {shortcut}
        </kbd>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SearchInput;

import React from "react";
export interface TypeaheadSuggestion {
  label: string;
  type?: string;
  meta?: string;
  icon?: string;
}

export interface TypeaheadResult {
  title: string;
  badge?: string;
}

export interface SearchTypeaheadProps {
  query?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  suggestions?: TypeaheadSuggestion[];
  results?: TypeaheadResult[];
  resultsHeading?: string;
  footerHint?: string;
  highlight?: string;
  onSelect?: (label: string) => void;
  onSubmit?: (query: string) => void;
}

const escapeRegExp = (value: string) => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

/**
 * SearchTypeahead - page-level search with match highlighting, type badges and grouped results.
 */
export default function SearchTypeahead({
  query = "",
  placeholder = "Search…",
  suggestions = [],
  results = [],
  resultsHeading = "Top results",
  footerHint,
  highlight = "",
  onSelect,
  onSubmit,
}: SearchTypeaheadProps) {
  const markMatches = (label: string) => {
    if (!highlight.trim()) return label;
    const parts = label.split(new RegExp(`(${escapeRegExp(highlight.trim())})`, "ig"));
    return parts.map((part, i) =>
      part.toLowerCase() === highlight.trim().toLowerCase() ? (
        <mark key={i} className="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">
          {part}
        </mark>
      ) : (
        part
      ),
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full" data-search-typeahead>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-zinc-200 pb-3 dark:border-zinc-700">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
          <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" />
          <path d="m21 21-4-4" />
        </svg>
        <input
          type="text"
          value={query}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          data-typeahead-input
          onChange={(event) => onSubmit?.(event.target.value)}
          className="w-full bg-transparent text-2xl font-semibold text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none dark:text-zinc-50 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-600"
        />
        {query ? (
          <button type="button" data-typeahead-clear aria-label="Clear search" onClick={() => onSubmit?.("")} className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-4 w-4">
              <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {suggestions.length ? (
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-1" data-typeahead-suggestions>
          {suggestions.map((suggestion, index) => (
            <li key={index}>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-typeahead-suggestion={index}
                onClick={() => onSelect?.(suggestion.label)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-sm text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
                  <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" />
                  <path d="m21 21-4-4" />
                </svg>
                <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{markMatches(suggestion.label)}</span>
                {suggestion.type ? (
                  <span className="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {suggestion.type}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}

      {results.length ? (
        <div className="mt-5" data-typeahead-results>
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{resultsHeading}</p>
          <ul className="mt-2 divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {results.map((result, index) => (
              <li key={index} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-typeahead-result={index}
                  onClick={() => onSelect?.(result.title)}
                  className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-left text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 focus-visible:outline-none dark:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:text-indigo-400"
                >
                  {markMatches(result.title)}
                </button>
                {result.badge ? (
                  <span className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    {result.badge}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {footerHint ? (
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span>{footerHint}</span>
          <a href="#" className="font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400" data-typeahead-help>
            Help Center
          </a>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface SeatRow {
  id: string;
  user: string;
  email?: string;
  /** seat type, e.g. "Admin" / "Member" / "Guest" */
  seat?: string;
  /** monthly cost for this seat */
  cost?: number;
  /** usage snapshot, e.g. "1.2 credits" */
  usage?: string;
  status?: "active" | "invited" | "suspended";
}

export interface SeatBillingTableProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  rows?: SeatRow[];
  /** billing period label, e.g. "Monthly · Nov 2026" */
  period?: string;
  currency?: string;
  /** searchable */
  searchable?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_BADGE: Record<NonNullable<SeatRow["status"]>, string> = {
  active: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400",
  invited: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-500/10 dark:text-sky-400",
  suspended: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400",
};

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<NonNullable<SeatRow["status"]>, string> = {
  active: "Active",
  invited: "Invited",
  suspended: "Suspended",
};

export default function SeatBillingTable({
  title = "Usage by User",
  description = "Per-seat costs and credit consumption for the current billing period.",
  rows = [],
  period = "Monthly",
  currency = "$",
  searchable = true,
  className = "",
}: SeatBillingTableProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filtered = q
    ? rows.filter((r) => r.user.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (r.email ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q))
    : rows;

  const billedSeats = rows.filter((r) => r.status !== "suspended");
  const totalCost = billedSeats.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.cost ?? 0), 0);

  return (
    <div data-seat-table className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p data-seat-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        {period ? <span data-seat-period className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{period}</span> : null}
      </div>
      <p data-seat-description className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>

      {searchable ? (
        <input
          data-seat-search
          type="search"
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Search for a user…"
          className="mt-3 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
        />
      ) : null}

      <table data-seat-rows className="mt-2 w-full text-left text-xs">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-zinc-200 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">
            <th className="py-1.5 pr-2 font-semibold">Name</th>
            <th className="py-1.5 pr-2 font-semibold">Seat</th>
            <th className="py-1.5 pr-2 font-semibold">Usage</th>
            <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-semibold">Cost</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {filtered.map((r) => (
            <tr key={r.id} data-seat-row={r.id} className="border-b border-zinc-100 last:border-0 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <td className="py-2 pr-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span data-seat-user className="truncate font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{r.user}</span>
                  {r.status && r.status !== "active" ? (
                    <span data-seat-status className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${STATUS_BADGE[r.status]}`}>
                      {STATUS_LABEL[r.status]}
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                {r.email ? <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{r.email}</p> : null}
              </td>
              <td className="py-2 pr-2 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{r.seat ?? "Member"}</td>
              <td className="py-2 pr-2 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{r.usage ?? "—"}</td>
              <td data-seat-cost className="py-2 text-right font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                {r.cost != null ? `${currency}${r.cost.toFixed(2)}` : "—"}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={4} data-seat-empty className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {q ? "No users match your search" : "No seats billed this period"}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ) : null}
        </tbody>
        {billedSeats.length > 0 ? (
          <tfoot>
            <tr data-seat-total className="border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">
              <td className="py-2 pr-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {billedSeats.length} billed seat{billedSeats.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
              </td>
              <td colSpan={2}></td>
              <td data-seat-total-cost className="py-2 text-right font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {currency}{totalCost.toFixed(2)}
              </td>
            </tr>
          </tfoot>
        ) : null}
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\SegmentBreakdownBars.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SegmentBreakdownItem {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  unit?: string;
  delta?: number;
  deltaUnit?: string;
  tone?: "indigo" | "emerald" | "amber" | "sky" | "rose";
}

export interface SegmentBreakdownBarsProps {
  headline: string | number;
  headlineUnit?: string;
  caption?: string;
  items: SegmentBreakdownItem[];
  unit?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE_BAR: Record<NonNullable<SegmentBreakdownItem["tone"]>, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-500",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  sky: "bg-sky-500",
  rose: "bg-rose-500",
};

export const SegmentBreakdownBars: React.FC<SegmentBreakdownBarsProps> = ({
  headline,
  headlineUnit = "%",
  caption,
  items,
  unit,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const total = Math.round(items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Math.max(0, item.value), 0) * 100) / 100 || 1;
  const max = Math.max(...items.map((item) => Math.max(0, item.value)), 0.0001);
  return (
    <div
      data-segment-breakdown
      role="table"
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <p className="border-l-2 border-zinc-900 pl-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-50">
        {headline}
        <span className="ml-1 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400">{headlineUnit}</span>
      </p>
      {caption ? <p className="mt-1 pl-3 text-xs text-zinc-400">{caption}</p> : null}
      <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
        {items.map((item, index) => {
          const share = Math.max(0, item.value);
          const width = Math.min(100, Math.round((share / max) * 100));
          const tone = TONE_BAR[item.tone || "indigo"];
          return (
            <div key={`${item.label}-${index}`} role="row" data-segment-index={index} className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="w-28 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{item.label}</span>
              <span className="relative h-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                <span
                  data-segment-bar
                  className={`absolute inset-y-0 left-0 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${tone}`}
                  style={{ width: `${width}%` }}
                />
              </span>
              <span className="w-14 shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                {share}
                {item.unit ?? unit ?? ""}
              </span>
              {item.delta !== undefined ? (
                <span
                  className={`w-16 shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-medium tabular-nums ${
                    item.delta > 0 ? "text-emerald-600" : item.delta < 0 ? "text-rose-600" : "text-zinc-400"
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.delta > 0 ? "+" : ""}
                  {item.delta}
                  {item.deltaUnit ?? "pp"}
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="w-16 shrink-0" />
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-4 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">
        Share of {total}
        {unit ?? ""} across {items.length} segments
      </p>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SegmentBreakdownBars;

import React from "react";

export interface DevService {
  name: string;
  command: string;
  status: "running" | "stopped" | "failed" | "starting";
  url?: string;
}

export interface DevCheck {
  label: string;
  passed: boolean;
  detail?: string;
}

export interface ServiceStatusListProps {
  services: DevService[];
  checks?: DevCheck[];
  durationLabel?: string;
  onServiceClick?: (service: DevService) => void;
}

const SERVICE_STATUS: Record<string, { icon: React.ReactNode; text: string; tone: string }> = {
  running: {
    icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>,
    text: "Running on",
    tone: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
  },
  starting: {
    icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-sky-500"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" /></svg>,
    text: "Starting…",
    tone: "text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400",
  },
  stopped: {
    icon: <span className="block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-400" />,
    text: "Stopped",
    tone: "text-zinc-500",
  },
  failed: {
    icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-500"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" /></svg>,
    text: "Failed",
    tone: "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400",
  },
};

/**
 * ServiceStatusList - dev-environment service table (command chips + status + URL) with a verification checklist.
 */
export default function ServiceStatusList({ services, checks = [], durationLabel, onServiceClick }: ServiceStatusListProps) {
  return (
    <div data-service-status className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Services</p>
      <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
        {services.map((service) => {
          const tone = SERVICE_STATUS[service.status] || SERVICE_STATUS.stopped;
          return (
            <li key={service.name} data-service-row={service.name} data-service-status={service.status}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onServiceClick?.(service)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <span className="w-28 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{service.name}</span>
                <code className="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{service.command}</code>
                <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                  {tone.icon}
                  <span className={`truncate text-[11px] font-medium ${tone.tone}`}>{tone.text}</span>
                  {service.url ? (
                    <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-900 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">{service.url}</span>
                  ) : null}
                </span>
              </button>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      {checks.length ? (
        <div className="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <ul className="space-y-1">
            {checks.map((check) => (
              <li key={check.label} data-check-row className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {check.passed ? (
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" className="mt-0.5 h-3 w-3 shrink-0 text-emerald-500"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>
                ) : (
                  <span className="mt-1 block h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-400" />
                )}
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <code className="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 font-mono text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{check.label}</code>
                  {check.detail ? <span className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"> {check.detail}</span> : null}
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {durationLabel ? <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{durationLabel}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * SessionDeviceTable - Login sessions / devices list: header with helper
 * text and a "log out all" action, six-column sessions table (OS /
 * application / location / IP / last active / status) with Current and
 * Logged-out badges, pager and rows-per-page control
 * (Airwallex Login Sessions pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export type SessionStatus = "current" | "active" | "logged-out";

export interface SessionDevice {
  id: string;
  os: string;
  application: string;
  location: string;
  ip: string;
  lastActive: string;
  status: SessionStatus;
}

export interface SessionDeviceTableProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  learnMoreLabel?: string;
  logoutAllLabel?: string;
  pageLabel?: string;
  page?: number;
  rowsPerPageLabel?: string;
  rowsPerPage?: number;
  sessions?: SessionDevice[];
  className?: string;
  onSessionClick?: (session: SessionDevice) => void;
  onLogoutAll?: () => void;
}

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<SessionStatus, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  current: { label: "Current", cls: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/70 dark:text-violet-300" },
  active: { label: "Active", cls: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400" },
  "logged-out": { label: "Logged out", cls: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400" },
};

const OS_ICON: Record<string, string> = { mac: "🖥", windows: "🪟", linux: "🐧", mobile: "📱" };
const iconFor = (os: string) => {
  const key = Object.keys(OS_ICON).find((k) => os.toLowerCase().includes(k));
  return key ? OS_ICON[key] : "🖥";
};

const DEFAULT_SESSIONS: SessionDevice[] = [
  { id: "s1", os: "Mac OS X", application: "Chrome 141", location: "Singapore, Singapore", ip: "116.14.152.165", lastActive: "4 minutes ago", status: "current" },
  { id: "s2", os: "Mac OS X", application: "Chrome 141", location: "Singapore, Singapore", ip: "103.224.164.31", lastActive: "6 days ago", status: "logged-out" },
  { id: "s3", os: "Windows 11", application: "Edge 140", location: "Tokyo, Japan", ip: "203.0.113.42", lastActive: "2 days ago", status: "active" },
  { id: "s4", os: "iOS 18", application: "Airwallex iOS", location: "Singapore, Singapore", ip: "116.14.152.198", lastActive: "10 days ago", status: "logged-out" },
];

export default function SessionDeviceTable({
  title = "Login sessions",
  description = "View your login sessions from the past 28 days. If you notice any suspicious logins, log out of those sessions and change your password immediately.",
  learnMoreLabel = "Learn more",
  logoutAllLabel = "Log out of all other sessions",
  pageLabel = "Page",
  page = 1,
  rowsPerPageLabel = "Rows per page:",
  rowsPerPage = 10,
  sessions = DEFAULT_SESSIONS,
  className = "",
  onSessionClick,
  onLogoutAll,
}: SessionDeviceTableProps) {
  return (
    <div data-session-table className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-session-header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <p data-session-title className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
          <p data-session-description className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {description}{" "}
            <a data-session-learn-more href="#" onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()} className="font-medium text-violet-600 hover:underline dark:text-violet-400">{learnMoreLabel}</a>
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          data-session-logout-all
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onLogoutAll?.()}

          {logoutAllLabel}

            <th className="px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold">Operating system</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Application</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Location</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">IP address</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Last active</th>
            <th className="px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold">Status</th>

              <tr
                key={session.id}
                data-session-row={session.id}
                tabIndex={0}
                onClick={() => onSessionClick?.(session)}
                className="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <td data-session-row-os={session.os} className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">

                  {session.os}
                </td>
                <td data-session-row-app={session.application} className="px-2 py-3 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{session.application}</td>

                  <span className={`inline-block rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${style.cls}`}>{style.label}</span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div data-session-footer className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div data-session-pager className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          <button type="button" data-session-pager-prev aria-label="Previous page" className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">‹</button>
          <span data-session-page>{pageLabel} {page}</span>
          <button type="button" data-session-pager-next aria-label="Next page" className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">›</button>
        </div>
        <label data-session-rows-per-page className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {rowsPerPageLabel}
          <select data-session-rows-select defaultValue={String(rowsPerPage)} className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200">
            {[10, 25, 50].map((n) => (
              <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * SessionDiagnosticsPanel - Connection diagnostics: Browser / OS info cards,
 * media quality timeline bars (Camera / Microphone / Screenshare / Poor
 * network) and a searchable event log table (Whereby insights pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface SessionDevice {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  emoji: string;
}

export interface QualityTrack {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  emoji: string;
  /** 0-1 relative quality windows: { start, width, level } */
  windows: { start: number; width: number; level: "good" | "poor" | "bad" }[];
}

export interface DiagEvent {
  id: string;
  no: number;
  message: string;
  time: string;
}

export interface SessionDiagnosticsPanelProps {
  title?: string;
  devices?: SessionDevice[];
  tracks?: QualityTrack[];
  events?: DiagEvent[];
  className?: string;
  onEventClick?: (event: DiagEvent) => void;
  onSearch?: (query: string) => void;
}

const LEVEL_CLS: Record<string, string> = {
  good: "bg-emerald-400 dark:bg-emerald-500",
  poor: "bg-amber-400 dark:bg-amber-500",
  bad: "bg-rose-400 dark:bg-rose-500",
};

export default function SessionDiagnosticsPanel({
  title = "Events Timeline",
  devices = [
    { label: "Browser", value: "Chrome 126.0.0.0", emoji: "🌐" },
    { label: "Operating system", value: "Mac OS", emoji: "💻" },
  ],
  tracks = [
    { id: "camera", label: "Camera", emoji: "📷", windows: [{ start: 0, width: 100, level: "good" }] },
    { id: "microphone", label: "Microphone", emoji: "🎙", windows: [{ start: 0, width: 100, level: "good" }] },
    { id: "screenshare", label: "Screenshare", emoji: "🖥", windows: [{ start: 0, width: 100, level: "good" }] },
    { id: "network", label: "Poor Network", emoji: "📶", windows: [{ start: 20, width: 12, level: "bad" }, { start: 55, width: 8, level: "poor" }] },
  ],
  events = [
    { id: "e1", no: 1, message: 'organizationId: "244198"', time: "6/25/2024, 4:10:24 PM" },
    { id: "e2", no: 2, message: 'clientId: "c43b3dfc-62e9-43f6-887f-d07c6ac9eddb"', time: "6/25/2024, 4:10:26 PM" },
    { id: "e3", no: 3, message: 'roomSessionId: "bdc6cb01-24a4-4132-b23a-8ad28d049a76"', time: "6/25/2024, 4:16:23 PM" },
    { id: "e4", no: 4, message: 'displayName: "Alex Smith"', time: "6/25/2024, 4:10:24 PM" },
    { id: "e5", no: 5, message: 'userRole: "owner"', time: "6/25/2024, 4:10:26 PM" },
  ],
  className = "",
  onEventClick,
  onSearch,
}: SessionDiagnosticsPanelProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");

  const filtered = events.filter((e) => e.message.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));

  return (
    <div data-sdiag className={`w-full rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 sm:p-6 ${className}`}>
      {/* device cards */}
      <div data-sdiag-devices className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        {devices.map((d) => (
          <div key={d.label} data-sdiag-device={d.label} className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <p className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{d.label}</p>
            <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              <span aria-hidden="true">{d.emoji}</span>
              {d.value}
            </p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <h3 data-sdiag-title className="mt-6 text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h3>

      {/* quality tracks */}
      <div data-sdiag-tracks className="mt-4 space-y-2.5">
        {tracks.map((t) => (
          <div key={t.id} data-sdiag-track={t.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="flex w-40 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              <span aria-hidden="true">{t.emoji}</span>
              {t.label}
            </span>
            <div className="relative h-6 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
              {t.windows.map((w, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  data-sdiag-window={w.level}
                  className={`absolute inset-y-0 rounded-sm ${LEVEL_CLS[w.level] ?? LEVEL_CLS.good}`}
                  style={{ left: `${w.start}%`, width: `${w.width}%` }}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* event log */}
      <div data-sdiag-log className="mt-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="grid flex-1 gap-1 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 sm:grid-cols-[60px_1fr]">
          <span>Event no.</span>
          <span>Event message</span>
        </div>
        <input
          type="search"
          data-sdiag-search
          value={query}
          placeholder="Search for an event"
          onChange={(e) => {
            setQuery(e.target.value);
            onSearch?.(e.target.value);
          }}
          className="w-56 rounded-full border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-4 py-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-700 outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:border-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
        />
      </div>
      <div data-sdiag-events className="mt-2 divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">
        {filtered.length === 0 ? (
          <p data-sdiag-empty className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No events match your search.</p>
        ) : (
          filtered.map((e) => (
            <button
              key={e.id}
              type="button"
              data-sdiag-event={e.no}
              onClick={() => onEventClick?.(e)}
              className="grid w-full grid-cols-[60px_1fr_auto] items-center gap-2 py-3 text-left text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40 sm:text-[13px]"
            >
              <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{e.no}</span>
              <span className="truncate font-mono text-[13px] text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{e.message}</span>
              <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{e.time}</span>
            </button>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\SettingsPanel.tsx =====

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SettingsItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  value?: string;
  actionText?: string;
}

export interface SettingsSection {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  description?: string;
  items: SettingsItem[];
}

export interface SettingsPanelProps {
  sections: SettingsSection[];
  activeId?: string;
  saving?: boolean;
  saveText?: string;
  onSectionChange?: (id: string) => void;
  onItemAction?: (sectionId: string, item: SettingsItem) => void;
  onSave?: (sectionId: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const SettingsPanel: React.FC<SettingsPanelProps> = ({
  sections,
  activeId,
  saving = false,
  saveText = "Save changes",
  onSectionChange,
  onItemAction,
  onSave,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [currentId, setCurrentId] = useState(() => activeId || sections[0]?.id || "");
  const section = sections.find((item) => item.id === currentId) || sections[0];

  const select = (id: string) => {
    setCurrentId(id);
    onSectionChange?.(id);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`md:flex md:gap-6 ${className}`}>
      <nav className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-2 md:w-44 md:shrink-0 md:flex-col md:overflow-visible md:pb-0">
        {sections.map((item) => {
          const active = item.id === section?.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => select(item.id)}
              aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
              className={`flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                active
                  ? "bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
                  : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              }`}
            >
              {item.icon && <UiIcon name={item.icon} size={14} className="shrink-0" />}
              <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{item.title}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      {section && (
        <div className="mt-3 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 md:mt-0">
          <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
            <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{section.title}</div>
            {section.description && (
              <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{section.description}</div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
            {section.items.map((item) => (
              <div key={item.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{item.label}</div>
                  {item.description && (
                    <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{item.description}</div>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                  {item.value && (
                    <span className="max-w-[12rem] truncate text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      {item.value}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {item.actionText && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onItemAction?.(section.id, item)}
                      className="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
                    >
                      {item.actionText}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {onSave && (
            <div className="flex justify-end border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSave(section.id)}
                disabled={saving}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
              >
                {saving && <UiIcon name="loader" size={12} className="animate-spin" />}
                {saveText}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SettingsPanel;


===== FILE: react\SettingsSideDrawer.tsx =====

import React from "react";
export interface SettingsRow {
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  control?: "toggle" | "select" | "button" | "none";
  value?: string;
  options?: string[];
  buttonLabel?: string;
  buttonTone?: "indigo" | "danger" | "outline";
  enabled?: boolean;
}

export interface SettingsSection {
  title?: string;
  rows: SettingsRow[];
}

export interface SideDrawerProps {
  /** Render the fixed overlay; closed by default (inset-0 would blanket the page). */
  isOpen?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  side?: "right" | "left";
  tabs?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  activeTab?: string;
  sections?: SettingsSection[];
  footerPrimary?: string;
  footerSecondary?: string;
  onTabChange?: (id: string) => void;
  onRowToggle?: (label: string, enabled: boolean) => void;
  onRowAction?: (label: string) => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  onFooterPrimary?: () => void;
}

const BUTTON_TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: "bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500",
  danger: "border border-rose-300 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-500/50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40",
  outline:
    "border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800",
};

/**
 * SettingsSideDrawer - side-anchored settings panel with tabs, setting rows and a sticky footer.
 */
export default function SettingsSideDrawer({
  title = "Settings",
  side = "right",
  tabs = [],
  activeTab = "",
  sections = [],
  footerPrimary = "",
  footerSecondary = "",
  onTabChange,
  onRowToggle,
  onRowAction,
  onClose,
  isOpen = false,
  onFooterPrimary,
}: SideDrawerProps) {
  const sideClass = side === "left" ? "left-0 rounded-r-2xl" : "right-0 rounded-l-2xl";

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40" data-side-drawer data-side={side}>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/50" data-drawer-overlay onClick={() => onClose?.()} />
      <aside
        className={`absolute top-0 flex h-full w-full max-w-md flex-col border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${sideClass}`}
        data-drawer-panel
        role="dialog"
        aria-label={title}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-200 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-drawer-close
            aria-label="Close settings"
            onClick={() => onClose?.()}
            className="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="h-4 w-4">
              <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        {tabs.length ? (
          <div className="flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-200 px-5 pt-1 dark:border-zinc-800" role="tablist" data-drawer-tabs>
            {tabs.map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={tab.id === activeTab}
                data-drawer-tab={tab.id}
                onClick={() => onTabChange?.(tab.id)}
                className={`-mb-px border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  tab.id === activeTab
                    ? "border-indigo-500 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                    : "border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                }`}
              >
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4" data-drawer-body>
          {sections.map((section, sectionIndex) => (
            <section key={sectionIndex} className={sectionIndex > 0 ? "mt-5 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-4 dark:border-zinc-800" : ""}>
              {section.title ? <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{section.title}</h3> : null}
              <ul className={section.title ? "mt-2 space-y-3" : "space-y-3"}>
                {section.rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
                  <li key={rowIndex} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4" data-settings-row={row.label}>
                    <span className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{row.label}</span>
                      {row.description ? <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{row.description}</span> : null}
                    </span>
                    {row.control === "toggle" ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        role="switch"
                        aria-checked={Boolean(row.enabled)}
                        data-row-toggle
                        onClick={() => onRowToggle?.(row.label, !row.enabled)}
                        className={`flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full px-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                          row.enabled ? "bg-indigo-600" : "bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span className={`h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${row.enabled ? "translate-x-4" : ""}`} />
                      </button>
                    ) : null}
                    {row.control === "select" ? (
                      <select
                        data-row-select
                        value={row.value}
                        onChange={() => {}}
                        className="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
                      >
                        {(row.options || []).map((option) => (
                          <option key={option}>{option}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    ) : null}
                    {row.control === "button" ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        data-row-button
                        onClick={() => onRowAction?.(row.label)}
                        className={`shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${BUTTON_TONE[row.buttonTone || "outline"]}`}
                      >
                        {row.buttonLabel || "Open"}
                      </button>
                    ) : null}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>

        {footerPrimary || footerSecondary ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-200 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800" data-drawer-footer>
            {footerSecondary ? (
              <button type="button" data-drawer-secondary className="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">
                {footerSecondary}
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {footerPrimary ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                data-drawer-primary
                onClick={() => onFooterPrimary?.()}
                className="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
              >
                {footerPrimary}
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface AccessPerson {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role?: string;
