===== FILE: react\ShortcutCheatSheet.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface ShortcutEntry {
  id: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  keys: string[];
  section?: string;
}

export interface ShortcutCheatSheetProps {
  shortcuts: ShortcutEntry[];
  columns?: 1 | 2;
  title?: string;
  searchable?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const KbdChip: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => (
  <kbd className="inline-flex min-w-[24px] items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 bg-zinc-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 shadow-[0_1px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
    {children}
  </kbd>
);

/**
 * ShortcutCheatSheet - two-column editor shortcut list with icons, markdown hints and keycap chips.
 */
export default function ShortcutCheatSheet({
  shortcuts,
  columns = 2,
  title = "Shortcuts",
  searchable = false,
  className = "",
}: ShortcutCheatSheetProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();

  const sections = React.useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = needle
      ? shortcuts.filter((entry) => `${entry.label} ${entry.hint || ""} ${entry.keys.join(" ")}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
      : shortcuts;
    const map = new Map<string, ShortcutEntry[]>();
    for (const entry of filtered) {
      const key = entry.section || "";
      if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);
      map.get(key)!.push(entry);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries());
  }, [shortcuts, needle]);

  return (
    <div data-shortcut-sheet className={`w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        {searchable ? (
          <input
            data-shortcut-search
            type="text"
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search…"
            className="w-32 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <div className={`mt-2 grid gap-x-6 ${columns === 2 ? "grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2" : "grid-cols-1"}`}>
        {sections.map(([section, entries]) => (
          <div key={section || "default"} data-shortcut-section={section || undefined} className={columns === 2 ? "sm:col-span-1" : ""}>
            {section ? <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{section}</p> : null}
            <ul className="mt-1 space-y-0.5">
              {entries.map((entry) => (
                <li
                  key={entry.id}
                  data-shortcut-row={entry.id}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                >
                  {entry.icon ? <span className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400 [&>svg]:h-4 [&>svg]:w-4">{entry.icon}</span> : null}
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                    {entry.label}
                    {entry.hint ? <code className="ml-1 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">{entry.hint}</code> : null}
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                    {entry.keys.map((key, i) => (
                      <KbdChip key={`${entry.id}-${i}`}>{key}</KbdChip>
                    ))}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {!sections.length ? <p data-shortcut-empty className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No shortcuts match “{query}”.</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export { KbdChip };


===== FILE: react\ShortcutsOverlay.tsx =====

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface ShortcutItem {
  /** Individual keycaps, e.g. ["⌘", "K"] or ["↑", "↓"]. */
  keys: string[];
  label: string;
  /** Optional grouping override; falls back to the parent group. */
  group?: string;
}

export interface ShortcutGroup {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  items: ShortcutItem[];
}

export interface ShortcutsOverlayProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  /** Either grouped shortcuts, or a flat list that is bucketed by item.group. */
  groups?: ShortcutGroup[];
  shortcuts?: ShortcutItem[];
  title?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const Kbd: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => (
  <kbd className="inline-flex min-w-[1.4rem] items-center justify-center rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
    {children}
  </kbd>
);

export const ShortcutsOverlay: React.FC<ShortcutsOverlayProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  groups = [],
  shortcuts = [],
  title = "Keyboard shortcuts",
  placeholder = "Search shortcuts...",
  onClose,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) setQuery("");
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose?.();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  // Normalize: flat list → groups by item.group (or "General").
  const normalized = useMemo<ShortcutGroup[]>(() => {
    if (groups.length > 0) return groups;
    const buckets: ShortcutGroup[] = [];
    shortcuts.forEach((item) => {
      const label = item.group || "General";
      const bucket = buckets.find((g) => g.label === label);
      if (bucket) bucket.items.push(item);
      else buckets.push({ id: label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-"), label, items: [item] });
    });
    return buckets;
  }, [groups, shortcuts]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return normalized;
    return normalized
      .map((group) => ({
        ...group,
        items: group.items.filter(
          (item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.keys.join("").toLowerCase().includes(q)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
  }, [normalized, query]);

  const total = useMemo(() => normalized.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.items.length, 0), [normalized]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center bg-black/40 p-4 pt-[10vh] backdrop-blur-sm"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={title}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className={`flex max-h-[75vh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl ${className}`}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
          <UiIcon name="terminal" size={16} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{title}</h2>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">{total}</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onClose?.()}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="ml-auto rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          >
            <UiIcon name="x" size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 px-2.5 py-1.5">
            <UiIcon name="search" size={13} className="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={placeholder}
              autoFocus
              className="w-full border-none bg-transparent text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          {filtered.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No shortcuts match “{query}”</div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {filtered.map((group) => (
                <section key={group.id}>
                  <h3 className="mb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400">{group.label}</h3>
                  <ul className="space-y-1.5">
                    {group.items.map((item, idx) => (
                      <li key={`${group.id}-${idx}`} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{item.label}</span>
                        <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5">
                          {item.keys.map((key, i) => (
                            <Kbd key={`${key}-${i}`}>{key}</Kbd>
                          ))}
                        </span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </section>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Kbd>esc</Kbd>
            <span>Close</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ShortcutsOverlay;

import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface SideDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  /** Which edge the panel slides in from. */
  side?: "left" | "right";
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  onClose?: () => void;
  /** Optional sticky footer row. */
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<NonNullable<SideDrawerProps["size"]>, string> = {
  sm: "max-w-xs",
  md: "max-w-md",
  lg: "max-w-xl",
};

export const SideDrawer: React.FC<SideDrawerProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  title,
  description,
  side = "right",
  size = "md",
  onClose,
  footer,
  children,
  className = "",
}) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return undefined;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        event.preventDefault();
        onClose?.();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex ${className}`}>
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]"
        aria-hidden="true"
        onClick={() => onClose?.()}
      />
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title}
        className={`relative z-10 flex h-full w-full ${SIZE_CLASS[size]} flex-col border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${
          side === "right" ? "ml-auto border-l" : "mr-auto border-r"
        }`}
      >
        <header className="flex items-start gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h2 className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</h2>
            {description && (
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onClose?.()}
            aria-label="Close drawer"
            className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          >
            <UiIcon name="x" size={14} />
          </button>
        </header>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          {children}
        </div>

        {footer && (
          <footer className="border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">{footer}</footer>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SideDrawer;

  heading,
  onNavigate,

        key={entry.id}

        }`}
      >
        {entry.icon ? (
          <UiIcon
            name={entry.icon}
            size={14}
            className={active ? "text-indigo-500" : "text-zinc-400"}
          />

        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{entry.label}</span>
        {entry.count !== undefined ? (

            className={`rounded-full px-1.5 py-px font-mono text-[9.5px] font-semibold ${

                ? "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300"
                : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400"
            }`}
          >
            {entry.count}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </button>
    );
  };

  return (
    <nav
      data-side-nav
      aria-label={heading || "Side navigation"}
      className={`flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      {heading ? (
        <p className="px-2.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{heading}</p>
      ) : null}
      {groups.map((group, groupIndex) => (
        <div key={group.title || groupIndex} className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
          {group.title ? (
            <p className="px-2.5 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{group.title}</p>
          ) : null}
          {group.items.map(renderEntry)}
        </div>
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
};

  siteName?: string;
  favicon?: string;

export interface SourcesCitationProps {
  sources: SourceItem[];
  className?: string;

export const SourcesCitation: React.FC<SourcesCitationProps> = ({
  sources,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [activeHoverId, setActiveHoverId] = useState<string | number | null>(null);

  if (!sources || sources.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className={`my-3 space-y-2 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">

            <a
              key={item.id || idx}

===== FILE: react\SpendTrendChart.tsx =====

import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface SpendPoint {
  /** x label, e.g. a date like 2026-03-13 */
  label: string;
  value: number;
}

export interface SpendTrendChartProps {
  headline?: string;
  unit?: string;
  granularities?: string[];
  defaultGranularity?: string;
  /** data points per granularity; key must match one of granularities */
  points?: Record<string, SpendPoint[]>;
  /** deterministic max, otherwise derived from data */
  maxY?: number;
  yTicks?: number;
  onGranularityChange?: (granularity: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const PALETTE = { bar: "#14b8a6", grid: "#3f3f46", text: "#a1a1aa" };

export default function SpendTrendChart({
  headline = "Spend",
  unit = "$",
  granularities = ["Daily", "Weekly"],
  defaultGranularity,
  points = {},
  maxY,
  yTicks = 4,
  onGranularityChange,
  className = "",
}: SpendTrendChartProps) {
  const granularitiesList = granularities.length ? granularities : ["Daily"];
  const [granularity, setGranularity] = useState(
    defaultGranularity && granularitiesList.includes(defaultGranularity) ? defaultGranularity : granularitiesList[0],
  );

  const data = points[granularity] ?? [];
  const total = data.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.value, 0);
  const max = maxY ?? Math.max(...data.map((p) => p.value), 1);

  const height = 180;
  const padLeft = 34;
  const padBottom = 26;
  const plotW = 100; // normalized; bars spread via percentage

  const ticks = Array.from({ length: yTicks + 1 }, (_, i) => (max / yTicks) * (yTicks - i));

  const switchGranularity = (next: string) => {
    if (next === granularity || !granularitiesList.includes(next)) return;
    setGranularity(next);
    onGranularityChange?.(next);
  };

  return (
    <div
      data-spend-trend-chart
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p data-spend-trend-title className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{headline}</p>
        <div
          data-spend-trend-granularity
          role="tablist"
          aria-label="Granularity"
          className="flex items-center rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-0.5 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          {granularitiesList.map((g) => (
            <button
              key={g}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={g === granularity}
              data-spend-trend-granularity-option={g}
              onClick={() => switchGranularity(g)}
              className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
                g === granularity
                  ? "bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                  : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              }`}
            >
              {g}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <p data-spend-trend-total className="mt-1 font-mono text-2xl font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
        {unit}
        {total.toFixed(2)}
        <span className="ml-1.5 font-sans text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{granularity}</span>
      </p>

      <div className="mt-3" style={{ position: "relative" }}>
        <svg
          data-spend-trend-svg
          width="100%"
          height={height}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${padLeft + plotW} ${height}`}
          preserveAspectRatio="none"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${headline} ${granularity} bar chart`}
        >
          {/* y axis ticks */}
          {ticks.map((t, i) => {
            const y = 8 + ((height - padBottom - 16) * i) / yTicks;
            return (
              <g key={i}>
                <line
                  x1={padLeft}
                  x2={padLeft + plotW}
                  y1={y}
                  y2={y}
                  stroke={PALETTE.grid}
                  strokeOpacity={0.35}
                  strokeDasharray="3 4"
                />
                <text x={padLeft - 6} y={y + 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize="8" fill={PALETTE.text}>
                  {Math.round(t)}
                </text>
              </g>
            );
          })}

          {/* bars */}
          {data.map((p, i) => {
            const n = data.length;
            const slot = plotW / n;
            const bw = Math.min(slot * 0.45, 8);
            const x = padLeft + slot * i + (slot - bw) / 2;
            const h = Math.max((p.value / max) * (height - padBottom - 16), p.value > 0 ? 3 : 0);
            const y = height - padBottom - h;
            return (
              <g key={p.label + i}>
                <rect
                  data-spend-trend-bar={p.label}
                  x={x}
                  y={y}
                  width={bw}
                  height={h}
                  rx={2}
                  fill={PALETTE.bar}
                  opacity={p.value > 0 ? 0.9 : 0.25}
                />
                {n <= 14 ? (
                  <text
                    x={x + bw / 2}
                    y={height - padBottom + 11}
                    textAnchor="middle"
                    fontSize="7"
                    fill={PALETTE.text}
                  >
                    {p.label.slice(5)}
                  </text>
                ) : i % Math.ceil(n / 8) === 0 ? (
                  <text
                    x={x + bw / 2}
                    y={height - padBottom + 11}
                    textAnchor="middle"
                    fontSize="7"
                    fill={PALETTE.text}
                  >
                    {p.label.slice(5)}
                  </text>
                ) : null}
              </g>
            );
          })}
          {data.length === 0 ? (
            <text x={padLeft + plotW / 2} y={height / 2} textAnchor="middle" fontSize="10" fill={PALETTE.text}>
              No spend recorded
            </text>
          ) : null}
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\SpotlightGlareCard.tsx =====

import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";

export interface SpotlightGlareCardProps {
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Glare highlight intensity (0-1), default 0.45 */
  glareOpacity?: number;
  /** Glare gradient radius in percentage, default 55% */
  glareRadius?: number;
  /** Enable subtle 3D tilt transformation */
  enableTilt?: boolean;
  /** Max tilt degrees, default 5 */
  maxTilt?: number;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
  onClick?: (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
}

// Sanitize numeric props: TS types are compile-time only, so a plain-JS
// caller could pass arbitrary strings that would land inside CSS values.
const numOr = (v: unknown, fallback: number, min = -Infinity, max = Infinity): number => {
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number.parseFloat(String(v));
  if (Number.isNaN(n)) return fallback;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n));
};

export const SpotlightGlareCard: React.FC<SpotlightGlareCardProps> = ({
  children,
  glareOpacity: glareOpacityProp = 0.45,
  glareRadius: glareRadiusProp = 55,
  enableTilt = false,
  maxTilt: maxTiltProp = 5,
  className = "",
  style,
  onClick,
}) => {
  const glareOpacity = numOr(glareOpacityProp, 0.45, 0, 1);
  const glareRadius = numOr(glareRadiusProp, 55, 0, 100);
  const maxTilt = numOr(maxTiltProp, 5, 0, 90);
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [coords, setCoords] = useState<{ gx: string; gy: string; rx: number; ry: number; isHovered: boolean }>({
    gx: "50%",
    gy: "50%",
    rx: 0,
    ry: 0,
    isHovered: false,
  });

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const card = cardRef.current;
    if (!card) return;
    const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const gxPercent = (x / rect.width) * 100;
    const gyPercent = (y / rect.height) * 100;

    let rx = 0;
    let ry = 0;
    if (enableTilt) {
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      ry = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * maxTilt;
      rx = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * maxTilt;
    }

    setCoords({
      gx: `${gxPercent.toFixed(1)}%`,
      gy: `${gyPercent.toFixed(1)}%`,
      rx,
      ry,
      isHovered: true,
    });
  };

  const handlePointerLeave = () => {
    setCoords((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      rx: 0,
      ry: 0,
      isHovered: false,
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={cardRef}
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerLeave={handlePointerLeave}
      onClick={onClick}
      style={{
        ...style,
        transform: enableTilt && coords.isHovered
          ? `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${coords.rx}deg) rotateY(${coords.ry}deg) translateY(-2px)`
          : undefined,
        transition: coords.isHovered ? "transform 0.1s ease-out" : "transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)",
      }}
      className={`group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#faf8f1] dark:bg-[#1a1d24] border border-[#d6d2c2]/80 dark:border-[#2b3038]/80 text-[#22262d] dark:text-[#e9e6db] shadow-[0_1px_0_rgba(34,38,45,0.07),0_5px_16px_rgba(34,38,45,0.07)] dark:shadow-[0_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.4),0_8px_22px_rgba(0,0,0,0.42)] transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_2px_0_rgba(34,38,45,0.08),0_12px_28px_rgba(34,38,45,0.12)] select-none ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Specular glare reflection layer */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 transition-opacity duration-300"
        style={{
          opacity: coords.isHovered ? glareOpacity : 0,
          background: `radial-gradient(circle at ${coords.gx} ${coords.gy}, rgba(255,255,255,0.85) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 30%, transparent ${glareRadius}%)`,
          mixBlendMode: "overlay",
        }}
      />

      {/* Content wrapper */}
      <div className="relative z-0 h-full w-full">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
};


===== FILE: react\StatCard.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface StatCardProps {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  delta?: number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  trend?: number[];
  icon?: UiIconName;
  className?: string;
}

const Sparkline: React.FC<{ data: number[]; positive: boolean }> = ({ data, positive }) => {
  if (data.length < 2) return null;
  const width = 96;
  const height = 28;
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  const points = data
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = (index / (data.length - 1)) * width;
      const y = height - ((value - min) / span) * (height - 4) - 2;
      return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(" ");
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} className="h-7 w-24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <polyline
        points={points}
        strokeWidth="1.5"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
        className={positive ? "stroke-emerald-500" : "stroke-red-500"}
      />
    </svg>
  );
};

export const StatCard: React.FC<StatCardProps> = ({
  label,
  value,
  delta,
  deltaLabel,
  trend,
  icon,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const positive = (delta ?? 0) >= 0;
  return (
    <div
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{label}</span>
        {icon && (
          <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            <UiIcon name={icon} size={16} />
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{value}</div>
          {typeof delta === "number" && (
            <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
              <UiIcon
                name={positive ? "trending-up" : "trending-down"}
                size={13}
                className={positive ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-red-500"}
              />
              <span className={`text-[11px] font-medium ${positive ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500" : "text-red-600 dark:text-red-500"}`}>
                {positive ? "+" : ""}
                {delta}%
              </span>
              {deltaLabel && (
                <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{deltaLabel}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {trend && trend.length > 1 && <Sparkline data={trend} positive={positive} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StatCard;

import React from "react";

export type StatusType = "online" | "offline" | "busy" | "connecting" | "error";

export interface StatusIndicatorProps {
  status: StatusType;
  label?: string;
  pingMs?: number;
  showDot?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const StatusIndicator: React.FC<StatusIndicatorProps> = ({
  status,
  label,
  pingMs,
  showDot = true,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const getStatusConfig = () => {
    switch (status) {
      case "online":
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-emerald-500",
          pingBg: "bg-emerald-400",
          text: "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-200/80 dark:border-emerald-800/60",
          defaultLabel: "Online",
        };
      case "connecting":
      case "busy":
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-amber-500",
          pingBg: "bg-amber-400",
          text: "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/60",
          defaultLabel: status === "busy" ? "Busy" : "Connecting",
        };
      case "error":
      case "offline":
      default:
        return {
          dotBg: "bg-rose-500",
          pingBg: "bg-rose-400",
          text: "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400",
          badgeBg: "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800/60",
          defaultLabel: status === "error" ? "Error" : "Offline",
        };
    }
  };

  const config = getStatusConfig();
  const displayLabel = label || config.defaultLabel;

  return (
    <div
      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border text-xs font-medium ${config.badgeBg} ${config.text} ${className}`}
    >
      {showDot && (
        <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
          {status === "online" && (
            <span
              className={`animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 ${config.pingBg}`}
            />
          )}
          <span className={`relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 ${config.dotBg}`} />
        </span>
      )}
      <span className="font-semibold">{displayLabel}</span>
      {pingMs !== undefined && (
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-75 ml-0.5">
          ({pingMs}ms)
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};


===== FILE: react\StepSlider.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface StepSliderProps {
  /** Discrete stops, e.g. ["+0k", "+1k", "+5k"]. */
  steps: string[];
  /** Zero-based selected index. */
  value?: number;
  onChange?: (index: number, step: string) => void;
  /** Marks steps from index+1 as emphasized (paid tiers). */
  highlightFrom?: number;
  label?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const StepSlider: React.FC<StepSliderProps> = ({
  steps,
  value = 0,
  onChange,
  highlightFrom,
  label,
  disabled = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const count = steps.length;
  const lastIndex = count - 1;
  const ratio = count > 1 ? value / lastIndex : 0;
  const highlightIndex = highlightFrom === undefined ? lastIndex + 1 : highlightFrom;

  return (
    <div className={`w-full ${className}`}>
      {label && (
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{label}</p>
      )}
      <div
        role="slider"
        tabIndex={disabled ? -1 : 0}
        aria-label={label || "Step slider"}
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={lastIndex}
        aria-valuenow={value}
        aria-valuetext={steps[value]}
        aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (disabled) return;
          if (event.key === "ArrowRight" && value < lastIndex) onChange?.(value + 1, steps[value + 1]);
          if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" && value > 0) onChange?.(value - 1, steps[value - 1]);
          if (event.key === "Home") onChange?.(0, steps[0]);
          if (event.key === "End") onChange?.(lastIndex, steps[lastIndex]);
        }}
        className="group relative flex cursor-pointer items-center pb-1 focus-visible:outline-none"
      >
        {/* Track */}
        <span className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        {/* Filled portion */}
        <span
          className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-[width] duration-150"
          style={{ width: `${ratio * 100}%` }}
        />
        {/* Click targets + stops */}
        {steps.map((step, index) => {
          const reached = index <= value;
          const highlighted = index >= highlightIndex;
          return (
            <button
              key={step + index}
              type="button"
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-label={step}
              aria-pressed={index === value}
              onClick={(event) => {
                event.stopPropagation();
                onChange?.(index, step);
              }}
              className="relative z-10 flex flex-1 flex-col items-center focus-visible:outline-none"
            >
              <span
                className={`h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 transition-colors ${
                  reached
                    ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600"
                    : highlighted
                      ? "border-indigo-300 bg-white dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
                      : "border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-900"
                } ${disabled ? "opacity-50" : ""}`}
              />
              <span
                className={`mt-1.5 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10px] ${
                  index === value
                    ? "font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"
                    : "text-zinc-400"
                }`}
              >
                {step}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
export default StepSlider;


===== FILE: react\Stepper.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export type StepperStatus = "complete" | "current" | "upcoming" | "error";

export interface StepperStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  status?: StepperStatus;
}

export interface StepperProps {
  steps: StepperStep[];
  /** 1-based index of the current step; steps before it render complete unless status overrides. */
  current?: number;
  onStepClick?: (step: StepperStep, index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const statusFor = (step: StepperStep, index: number, current: number): StepperStatus =>
  step.status ?? (index + 1 < current ? "complete" : index + 1 === current ? "current" : "upcoming");

const CIRCLE: Record<StepperStatus, { cls: string; icon?: UiIconName }> = {
  complete: { cls: "bg-indigo-600 text-white", icon: "check" },
  current: { cls: "border-2 border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" },
  upcoming: { cls: "border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700" },
  error: { cls: "bg-rose-500 text-white", icon: "x" },
};

export const Stepper: React.FC<StepperProps> = ({ steps, current = 1, onStepClick, className = "" }) => {
  return (
    <ol className={`flex items-start ${className}`}>
      {steps.map((step, index) => {
        const status = statusFor(step, index, current);
        const styles = CIRCLE[status];
        const last = index === steps.length - 1;
        const clickable = onStepClick && status !== "upcoming";
        return (
          <li key={step.id} className={`flex min-w-0 ${last ? "flex-none" : "flex-1"}`}>
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 text-center">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={!clickable}
                onClick={() => clickable && onStepClick?.(step, index)}
                aria-current={status === "current" ? "step" : undefined}
                className={`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-default ${styles.cls}`}
              >
                {styles.icon ? <UiIcon name={styles.icon} size={12} /> : index + 1}
              </button>
              <div className="max-w-28">
                <p
                  className={`text-[11px] font-medium leading-tight ${
                    status === "upcoming"
                      ? "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
                      : "text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  {step.label}
                </p>
                {step.description && (
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-tight text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{step.description}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            {!last && (
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`mt-3.5 h-0.5 flex-1 rounded ${
                  status === "complete" ? "bg-indigo-600" : "bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800"
                } ${index === 0 ? "ml-2" : "ml-2"} mr-2`}
              />
            )}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
};

export default Stepper;

    { id: "p1", url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1441974231531-c6227db76b6e?w=600&q=60", alt: "Sunlit forest path", author: "Casey Horner", span: 2 },

===== FILE: react\StreamMarkdown.tsx =====

import React, { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { marked } from "marked";
import Prism from "prismjs";
import "prismjs/themes/prism-tomorrow.css";
import { Check, Copy } from "./UiIcon";

const escapeAttribute = (value: string): string =>
  String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;");

// Lightweight sanitizer for marked output — keeps gfm/code-fence rendering intact
// while stripping the dangerous surface: script containers, sandbox-escape tags,
// on* event handlers (tag-scoped, so prose text like "online=1" survives) and
// javascript:/vbscript:/non-image data: URLs. No external dependencies.
const unsafeUrl = (value: string): boolean =>
  /^\s*(javascript|vbscript):/i.test(value) || /^\s*data:(?!image\/)/i.test(value);

const sanitizeTag = (tag: string): string =>
  tag
    .replace(/\son\w+\s*=\s*(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/gi, "")
    .replace(
      /(\s(?:href|src|srcset|action|formaction)\s*=\s*)("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/gi,
      (m: string, pre: string, lit: string) => {
        const value = lit[0] === '"' || lit[0] === "'" ? lit.slice(1, -1) : lit;
        return unsafeUrl(value) ? `${pre}""` : m;
      }
    );

const sanitizeMarkdownHtml = (html: string): string =>
  String(html)
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script\s*>/gi, "")
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*\/?>/gi, "")
    .replace(/<(iframe|object|embed|base|form)\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1\s*>/gi, "")
    .replace(/<(iframe|object|embed|base|form)\b[^>]*\/?>/gi, "")
    .replace(/<[a-z][^>]*>/gi, (tag: string) => sanitizeTag(tag));

export interface StreamMarkdownProps {
  content: string;
  isStreaming?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const StreamMarkdown: React.FC<StreamMarkdownProps> = ({
  content,
  isStreaming = false,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Configure marked renderer for syntax highlighting & clean markup
  const htmlContent = useMemo(() => {
    const renderer = new marked.Renderer();

    renderer.code = function ({ text, lang }: { text: string; lang?: string }) {
      const language = lang && Prism.languages[lang] ? lang : "javascript";
      let highlighted = text;
      try {
        if (Prism.languages[language]) {
          highlighted = Prism.highlight(text, Prism.languages[language], language);
        }
      } catch {
        highlighted = text;
      }

      return `
        <div class="relative group my-4 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
            <span>${escapeAttribute(lang || "code")}</span>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              data-code="${encodeURIComponent(text)}" 
              class="copy-btn hover:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
            >
              Copy
            </button>
          </div>
          <pre class="p-4 overflow-x-auto text-sm text-zinc-100 font-mono leading-normal m-0 bg-transparent"><code>${highlighted}</code></pre>
        </div>
      `;
    };

    return sanitizeMarkdownHtml(
      marked.parse(content || "", { renderer, breaks: true, gfm: true }) as string
    );
  }, [content]);

  // Delegated safe copy handler (CSP safe, avoids inline onclick)
  const handleContainerClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest(".copy-btn");
    if (!target) return;
    const rawCode = target.getAttribute("data-code");
    if (rawCode) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(decodeURIComponent(rawCode));
      target.textContent = "Copied";
      setTimeout(() => {
        target.textContent = "Copy";
      }, 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onClick={handleContainerClick}
      className={`prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert max-w-none text-sm leading-relaxed ${className}`}
    >
      <div
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: htmlContent }}
        className="inline-block w-full"
      />
      {isStreaming && (
        <span className="inline-block w-2 h-4 ml-1 -mb-0.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 animate-pulse rounded-sm" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from "react";

export interface StreamingProgressBarProps {
  value?: number | null;
  label?: string;
  status?: "streaming" | "done" | "error";
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_BAR: Record<string, string> = {
  streaming: "bg-indigo-500",
  done: "bg-emerald-500",
  error: "bg-rose-500",
};

export const StreamingProgressBar: React.FC<StreamingProgressBarProps> = ({
  value = null,
  label,
  status = "streaming",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const clamped = value === null || value === undefined ? null : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));
  const indeterminate = clamped === null;
  const barColor = STATUS_BAR[status] || STATUS_BAR.streaming;

  return (
    <div className={`w-full ${className}`}>
      {(label || !indeterminate) && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
          <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
          {!indeterminate && <span className="tabular-nums shrink-0">{Math.round(clamped)}%</span>}
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={100}
        aria-valuenow={indeterminate ? undefined : Math.round(clamped)}
        aria-label={label || "Progress"}
        className="h-1 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden"
      >
        {indeterminate ? (
          <div className={`h-full w-1/3 rounded-full ${barColor} animate-pulse`} />
        ) : (
          <div className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}`} style={{ width: `${clamped}%` }} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
export default StreamingProgressBar;

import React from "react";

export interface SuccessToastProps {
  message: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  onClose?: () => void;
  duration?: number;
  position?: "top-right" | "bottom-right";
  className?: string;
}

const CHECK_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M10 18a8 8 0 1 1 0-16 8 8 0 0 1 0 16Zm-1.2-5.4 5-5-1.13-1.13L8.8 10.34 7.33 8.87 6.2 10l2.6 2.6Z" />
  </svg>
);

const CLOSE_SVG = (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * SuccessToast - self-dismissing mint confirmation toast with check icon and close button for copy/success feedback.
 */
export default function SuccessToast({
  message,
  icon,
  onClose,
  duration = 3000,
  position = "top-right",
  className = "",
}: SuccessToastProps) {
  const [visible, setVisible] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setVisible(true);
    if (duration > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setVisible(false), duration);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [message, duration]);

  if (!visible) return null;
  const posClass = position === "bottom-right" ? "bottom-4" : "top-4";

  return (
    <div
      data-success-toast
      className={`fixed right-4 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 px-4 py-2.5 shadow-sm dark:bg-emerald-950 ${posClass} ${className}`}
      role="status"
    >
      <span className="shrink-0 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">{icon || CHECK_SVG}</span>
      <span className="text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{message}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-toast-close
        title="Dismiss"
        onClick={() => {
          setVisible(false);
          onClose?.();
        }}
        className="ml-1 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-emerald-800/70 hover:bg-emerald-200 hover:text-emerald-900 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900"
      >
        {CLOSE_SVG}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

export interface SystemPromptEditorProps {
  title?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  version?: string;
  savedValue?: string;
  variables?: string[];
  temperature?: number;
  onSave?: (text: string) => void;
  onReset?: () => void;
  onTemperatureChange?: (value: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TOKENS_PER_CHAR = 0.25;

/**
 * SystemPromptEditor - Agent studio prompt editor: textarea with live token
 * estimate, {{variable}} chips, temperature slider and save/reset actions.
 */
export default function SystemPromptEditor({
  title = "System prompt",
  value: valueProp = "",
  placeholder = "You are a helpful assistant that…",
  version = "v3",
  savedValue,
  variables = [],
  temperature,
  onSave,
  onReset,
  onTemperatureChange,
  className = "",
}: SystemPromptEditorProps) {
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState(valueProp);
  const dirty = savedValue !== undefined ? draft !== savedValue : draft !== valueProp;
  const tokens = Math.max(1, Math.round(draft.length * TOKENS_PER_CHAR));

  return (
    <div data-prompt-editor className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          {title}
          <span data-editor-version className="ml-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">{version}</span>
        </p>
        <span data-editor-state className={`text-[11px] font-semibold ${dirty ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"}`}>
          {dirty ? "Unsaved changes" : "Saved"}
        </span>
      </div>
      <textarea
        data-editor-textarea
        value={draft}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        rows={6}
        onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
        className="mt-3 w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-800 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"
      />
      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <span data-editor-tokens>~{tokens} tokens · {draft.length} chars</span>
        {variables.length > 0 && (
          <span data-editor-variables className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            {variables.map((v) => (
              <code key={v} className="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">{`{{${v}}}`}</code>
            ))}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      {typeof temperature === "number" && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
          <label className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300" htmlFor="prompt-editor-temp">Temperature</label>
          <input
            id="prompt-editor-temp"
            data-editor-temperature
            type="range"
            min={0}
            max={2}
            step={0.1}
            value={temperature}
            onChange={(e) => onTemperatureChange?.(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="h-1 flex-1 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded bg-zinc-200 accent-indigo-600 dark:bg-zinc-700"
          />
          <span data-editor-temp-value className="w-8 text-right font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{temperature.toFixed(1)}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          data-editor-reset
          onClick={() => {
            setDraft(savedValue ?? valueProp);
            onReset?.();
          }}
          className="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
        >
          Reset
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-editor-save
          disabled={!dirty}
          onClick={() => onSave?.(draft)}
          className="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          Save prompt
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * TableSavedViews - Data-table saved views bar: view tabs (default +
 * user-saved), active-view filter chips, and Save view / Share actions
 * (Attio / Rows table views pattern).
 */
import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface SavedView {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  filters?: string[];
}

export interface TableSavedViewsProps {
  views?: SavedView[];
  active?: string;
  saveLabel?: string;
  shareLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
  onViewChange?: (view: SavedView) => void;
  onSaveView?: (id: string) => void;
  onShareView?: (id: string) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_VIEWS: SavedView[] = [
  { id: "all", label: "All records", filters: [] },
  { id: "mine", label: "Assigned to me", filters: ["assignee: me"] },
  { id: "stale", label: "Stale 30d+", filters: ["updated < 30d", "status: open"] },
];

export const TableSavedViews: React.FC<TableSavedViewsProps> = ({
  views = DEFAULT_VIEWS,
  active: activeProp,
  saveLabel = "Save view",
  shareLabel = "Share",
  className = "",
  onViewChange,
  onSaveView,
  onShareView,
}) => {
  const list = Array.isArray(views) ? views : [];
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState(activeProp || list[0]?.id || "all");
  const activeIdResolved = activeProp ?? activeId;
  const active = list.find((v) => v.id === activeIdResolved) ?? list[0] ?? { id: "all", label: "All records", filters: [] };

  return (
    <div data-savedviews-bar className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-savedviews-tabs className="flex items-center gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        {list.map((view) => {
          const isActive = view.id === active.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={view.id}
              type="button"
              data-savedview-tab={view.id}
              onClick={() => { setActiveId(view.id); onViewChange?.(view); }}
              className={`whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors ${
                isActive
                  ? "border-b-2 border-violet-600 font-semibold text-violet-700 dark:border-violet-500 dark:text-violet-300"
                  : "border-b-2 border-transparent font-medium text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              }`}
            >
              {view.label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div data-savedviews-body className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3">
        <span data-savedview-filters className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {(active.filters || []).length ? (
            (active.filters || []).map((f) => (
              <span key={f} data-savedview-filter={f} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">{f}</span>
            ))
          ) : (
            <span data-savedview-nofilters className="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No filters</span>
          )}
        </span>
        <span className="flex-1"></span>
        <button type="button" data-savedview-share onClick={() => onShareView?.(active.id)} className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">{shareLabel}</button>

===== FILE: react\Tabs.tsx =====

import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  badge?: string | number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface TabsProps {
  tabs: TabItem[];
  /** Controlled active tab id. Omit for uncontrolled behavior. */
  activeId?: string;
  defaultActiveId?: string;
  variant?: "underline" | "pills";
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const BASE_TAB =
  "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40";

export const Tabs: React.FC<TabsProps> = ({
  tabs,
  activeId,
  defaultActiveId,
  variant = "underline",
  onChange,
  ariaLabel = "Tabs",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const [internalId, setInternalId] = useState(defaultActiveId ?? tabs[0]?.id ?? "");
  const current = activeId ?? internalId;
  const refs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLButtonElement | null>>({});
  const isPills = variant === "pills";

  const select = (tab: TabItem) => {
    if (tab.disabled) return;
    if (activeId === undefined) setInternalId(tab.id);
    onChange?.(tab.id);
  };

  const move = (event: React.KeyboardEvent, index: number) => {
    const keys = ["ArrowRight", "ArrowLeft", "Home", "End"];
    if (!keys.includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const enabled = tabs.map((tab, i) => ({ tab, i })).filter((entry) => !entry.tab.disabled);
    if (enabled.length === 0) return;
    const position = enabled.findIndex((entry) => entry.i === index);
    let next = position;
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight") next = (position + 1) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") next = (position - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
    if (event.key === "End") next = enabled.length - 1;
    const target = enabled[next];
    if (target) {
      select(target.tab);
      refs.current[target.tab.id]?.focus();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="tablist"
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      className={
        isPills
          ? `inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800 ${className}`
          : `flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 ${className}`
      }
    >
      {tabs.map((tab, index) => {
        const active = tab.id === current;
        const tone = isPills
          ? active
            ? "bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100"
            : "text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          : active
            ? "-mb-px border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400"
            : "-mb-px border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200";
        const shape = isPills ? "rounded-md px-3 py-1.5" : "border-b-2 px-3 py-2";
        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            ref={(node) => {
              refs.current[tab.id] = node;
            }}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            id={`tab-${tab.id}`}
            aria-selected={active}
            aria-controls={`panel-${tab.id}`}
            tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
            disabled={tab.disabled}
            onClick={() => select(tab)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => move(event, index)}
            className={`${BASE_TAB} ${shape} ${tone}`}
          >
            {tab.icon && <UiIcon name={tab.icon} size={13} />}
            <span>{tab.label}</span>
            {tab.badge !== undefined && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {tab.badge}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Tabs;


===== FILE: react\Tag.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon, type UiIconName } from "./UiIcon";

export type TagTone = "neutral" | "indigo" | "emerald" | "amber" | "rose" | "sky";
export type TagSize = "sm" | "md";

export interface TagProps {
  label: string;
  tone?: TagTone;
  size?: TagSize;
  icon?: UiIconName;
  removable?: boolean;
  onRemove?: () => void;
  onClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const TONE: Record<TagTone, string> = {
  neutral: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300",
  indigo: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300",
  amber: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
  rose: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300",
  sky: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300",
};

export const Tag: React.FC<TagProps> = ({ label, tone = "neutral", size = "md", icon, removable = false, onRemove, onClick, className = "" }) => {
  const sizing = size === "sm" ? "px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px]" : "px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px]";
  const content = (
    <>
      {icon && <UiIcon name={icon} size={size === "sm" ? 10 : 11} className="shrink-0 opacity-70" />}
      <span className="truncate">{label}</span>
      {removable && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`Remove ${label}`}
          onClick={(event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            onRemove?.();
          }}
          className="-mr-0.5 shrink-0 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors hover:bg-black/10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-current dark:hover:bg-white/10"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={size === "sm" ? 9 : 10} />
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  );

  const cls = `inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-full font-medium ${TONE[tone]} ${sizing} ${className}`;

  if (onClick) {
    return (
      <button type="button" onClick={onClick} className={`${cls} cursor-pointer transition-opacity hover:opacity-80 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500`}>
        {content}
      </button>
    );
  }
  return <span className={cls}>{content}</span>;
};

export default Tag;


===== FILE: react\TargetGauge.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface TargetGaugeZone {
  /** Raw start of the zone on the 0–100 scale. */
  from: number;
  tone: "rose" | "amber" | "emerald";
}

export interface TargetGaugeProps {
  value: number;
  target: number;
  label?: string;
  valuePrefix?: string;
  valueSuffix?: string;
  zones?: TargetGaugeZone[];
  remainingLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const ZONE_COLOR: Record<NonNullable<TargetGaugeZone["tone"]>, string> = {
  rose: "bg-rose-500",
  amber: "bg-amber-400",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-500",
};

const clamp01 = (value: number) => Math.min(100, Math.max(0, value));

export const TargetGauge: React.FC<TargetGaugeProps> = ({
  value,
  target,
  label = "Progress",
  valuePrefix = "",
  valueSuffix = "",
  zones = [
    { from: 0, tone: "rose" },
    { from: 60, tone: "amber" },
    { from: 85, tone: "emerald" },
  ],
  remainingLabel,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const percent = target > 0 ? (value / target) * 100 : 0;
  const angle = (clamp01(percent) / 100) * 180 - 90;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, target - value);
  const sorted = [...zones].sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from);
  const segments = sorted.map((zone, index) => {
    const end = index + 1 < sorted.length ? sorted[index + 1].from : 100;
    return { ...zone, width: `${Math.max(0, end - zone.from)}%` };
  });
  const currentTone = [...segments].reverse().find((zone) => clamp01(percent) >= zone.from)?.tone || "rose";

  return (
    <div
      data-target-gauge
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${label}: ${valuePrefix}${value}${valueSuffix} of ${valuePrefix}${target}${valueSuffix}`}
      className={`rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{label}</p>
      <div className="relative mx-auto mt-3 h-[70px] w-[140px] overflow-hidden">
        {/* Zone band (top half of a 140px circle) */}
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex h-[70px] w-[140px] overflow-hidden rounded-t-full">
          {segments.map((zone, index) => (
            <span key={index} className={`h-full ${ZONE_COLOR[zone.tone]}`} style={{ width: zone.width }} />
          ))}
        </div>
        {/* Inner cut-out to make it an arc */}
        <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-[18px] h-[52px] w-[104px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-t-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900" />
        {/* Needle */}
        <div
          data-gauge-needle
          className="absolute bottom-0 left-1/2 h-[54px] w-0.5 origin-bottom bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100"
          style={{ transform: `rotate(${angle}deg)` }}
        >
          <span className="absolute -top-[3px] left-1/2 h-2 w-2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100" />
        </div>
        <div className="absolute bottom-[-4px] left-1/2 h-3 w-3 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100" />
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">
        <span>
          {valuePrefix}0{valueSuffix}
        </span>
        <span
          className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white ${ZONE_COLOR[currentTone]}`}
          data-gauge-value
        >
          {valuePrefix}
          {value}
          {valueSuffix}
        </span>
        <span>
          {valuePrefix}
          {target}
          {valueSuffix}
        </span>
      </div>
      {remainingLabel ? (
        <p className="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {remaining > 0 ? `Remaining: ${valuePrefix}${remaining}${valueSuffix} — ` : ""}
          {remainingLabel}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <span className="hidden" data-gauge-percent>
        {Math.round(percent)}%
      </span>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TargetGauge;

/**
 * TaskCardModal - Task card modal overlay: backdrop with centered dialog,
 * header with completion checkbox and close button, Members/Labels/Dates
 * attribute rows, description textarea, link/file attachments, checklist
 * with progress bar, and a right activity column with comment composer
 * (Trello card modal pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface TaskCardMember {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  initials?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
}

export interface TaskCardLabel {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  color: string; // tailwind bg classes, e.g. "bg-emerald-500"
}

export interface TaskCardChecklistItem {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  done: boolean;
}

export interface TaskCardAttachment {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  meta: string;
  kind?: "link" | "file";
}

export interface TaskCardComment {
  id: string;
  author: string;
  initials?: string;
  text: string;
  time: string;
}

export interface TaskCardModalProps {
  /** Render the overlay; closed by default (fixed inset-0 would blanket the page). */
  isOpen?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  completed?: boolean;
  members?: TaskCardMember[];
  labels?: TaskCardLabel[];
  dates?: string;
  description?: string;
  attachments?: TaskCardAttachment[];
  checklist?: TaskCardChecklistItem[];
  comments?: TaskCardComment[];
  commentPlaceholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  onCardClose?: () => void;
  onCompleteToggle?: (completed: boolean) => void;
  onChecklistToggle?: (item: TaskCardChecklistItem) => void;
  onCommentSubmit?: (text: string) => void;
}

export default function TaskCardModal({
  /** Render the overlay; closed by default (fixed inset-0 would blanket the page). */
  isOpen = false,
  title = "Design landing page hero",
  completed = false,
  members = [
    { id: "m1", name: "Jane Smith", initials: "JS" },
    { id: "m2", name: "Omar Diallo", initials: "OD" },
  ],
  labels = [
    { id: "l1", label: "Design", color: "bg-violet-500" },
    { id: "l2", label: "Web", color: "bg-emerald-500" },
  ],
  dates = "Nov 10 – Nov 24",
  description = "Hero section with headline, product screenshot and a primary CTA. Keep it consistent with the brand palette.",
  attachments = [
    { id: "a1", name: "Brand guidelines", meta: "notion.so/brand", kind: "link" },
    { id: "a2", name: "hero-spec.pdf", meta: "1.2 MB · added Nov 12", kind: "file" },
  ],
  checklist = [
    { id: "c1", text: "Collect references", done: true },
    { id: "c2", text: "Wireframe variants", done: true },
    { id: "c3", text: "High-fidelity mockup", done: false },
    { id: "c4", text: "Dev handoff notes", done: false },
  ],
  comments = [
    { id: "k1", author: "Jane Smith", initials: "JS", text: "Draft uploaded, take a look at the spacing pass.", time: "2 hours ago" },
    { id: "k2", author: "Omar Diallo", initials: "OD", text: "Looks great — let's swap the CTA copy before handoff.", time: "1 hour ago" },
  ],
  commentPlaceholder = "Write a comment…",
  className = "",
  onCardClose,
  onCompleteToggle,
  onChecklistToggle,
  onCommentSubmit,
}: TaskCardModalProps) {
  const [isCompleted, setIsCompleted] = React.useState(completed);
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState(checklist);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState("");

  const doneCount = items.filter((i) => i.done).length;
  const pct = items.length === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneCount / items.length) * 100);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div data-taskcard className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-zinc-900/60 p-4 sm:p-8 ${className}`}>
      <div
        data-taskcard-dialog
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={title}
        className="w-full max-w-3xl rounded-xl bg-white shadow-2xl dark:bg-zinc-900"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-zinc-200 px-6 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <button
              data-taskcard-complete
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={isCompleted}
              onClick={() => {
                const next = !isCompleted;
                setIsCompleted(next);
                onCompleteToggle?.(next);
              }}
              className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md border text-xs font-bold transition-colors ${
                isCompleted
                  ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white"
                  : "border-zinc-300 text-transparent hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-600"
              }`}
            >
              ✓
            </button>
            <h2 data-taskcard-title className={`truncate text-lg font-bold ${isCompleted ? "text-zinc-400 line-through dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"}`}>
              {title}
            </h2>
          </div>
          <button
            data-taskcard-close
            type="button"
            aria-label="Close"
            onClick={() => onCardClose?.()}
            className="shrink-0 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-lg leading-none text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-6 px-6 py-5 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_240px]">
          {/* main column */}
          <div className="min-w-0 space-y-5">
            <div data-taskcard-attrs className="flex flex-wrap gap-6">
              <div data-taskcard-members>
                <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Members</p>
                <div className="mt-1.5 flex gap-1.5">
                  {members.map((m) => (
                    <span
                      key={m.id}
                      data-taskcard-member={m.id}
                      title={m.name}
                      className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:text-indigo-300"
                    >
                      {m.avatarUrl ? <img src={m.avatarUrl} alt={m.name} className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full object-cover" /> : m.initials ?? m.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              {labels.length > 0 && (
                <div data-taskcard-labels>
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Labels</p>
                  <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {labels.map((l) => (
                      <span
                        key={l.id}
                        data-taskcard-label={l.id}
                        className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white ${l.color}`}
                      >
                        {l.label}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              {dates && (
                <div data-taskcard-dates>
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Dates</p>
                  <p className="mt-1.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{dates}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div data-taskcard-description>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Description</p>
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{description}</p>
            </div>

            {attachments.length > 0 && (
              <div data-taskcard-attachments>
                <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Attachments</p>
                <div className="mt-1.5 space-y-1.5">
                  {attachments.map((a) => (
                    <div
                      key={a.id}
                      data-taskcard-attachment={a.id}
                      className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800"
                    >
                      <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-sm">{a.kind === "file" ? "📄" : "🔗"}</span>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{a.name}</p>
                        <p className="truncate text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{a.meta}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div data-taskcard-checklist>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Checklist</p>
                <span data-taskcard-checklist-count className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{pct}%</span>
              </div>
              <div data-taskcard-checklist-bar className="mt-1.5 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-emerald-500 transition-all" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                {items.map((item) => (
                  <button
                    key={item.id}
                    data-taskcard-checkitem={item.id}
                    data-taskcard-checkitem-done={item.done ? "true" : "false"}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setItems((prev) => prev.map((i) => (i.id === item.id ? { ...i, done: !i.done } : i)));
                      onChecklistToggle?.(item);
                    }}
                    className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border text-[10px] font-bold ${
                        item.done ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white" : "border-zinc-300 text-transparent dark:border-zinc-600"
                      }`}
                    >
                      ✓
                    </span>
                    <span className={`text-sm ${item.done ? "text-zinc-400 line-through dark:text-zinc-500" : "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"}`}>{item.text}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* activity column */}
          <aside data-taskcard-activity className="md:border-l md:border-zinc-200 md:pl-6 dark:md:border-zinc-800">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Comments &amp; activity</p>
            <form
              data-taskcard-composer
              className="mt-3"
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const text = draft.trim();
                if (!text) return;
                onCommentSubmit?.(text);
                setDraft("");
              }}
            >
              <textarea

              />

                data-taskcard-send

                disabled={draft.trim() === ""}
              >
                Comment
              </button>
            </form>

                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{c.text}</p>

 */

  value: string;

  tag?: boolean;
}

  id: string;
  icon: string;

}

  activity?: TaskActivityItem[];

  onCommentSubmit?: (text: string) => void;
}

                {action.label}

          </div>

          <span className="text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">🔔 1 🔍 ≡</span>
        </div>

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
