/**
 * UsagePricingBreakdown - Metered usage pricing: tiered unit-price table
 * (range / usage / unit price / subtotal) with the current tier highlighted
 * and an estimated total footer (usage-based billing pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface UsageTier {
  range: string;
  unit?: string;
  usage: number;
  unitPrice: number;
}

export interface UsagePricingBreakdownProps {
  title?: string;
  currency?: string;
  tiers?: UsageTier[];
  footerNote?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_TIERS: UsageTier[] = [
  { range: "First 10,000", unit: "requests", usage: 9420, unitPrice: 0.002 },
  { range: "10,001 – 50,000", unit: "requests", usage: 18340, unitPrice: 0.0012 },
  { range: "50,001 – 200,000", unit: "requests", usage: 0, unitPrice: 0.0008 },
];

const toNumber = (value: unknown, fallback = 0) => {
  const n = Number.parseFloat(String(value ?? ""));
  return Number.isNaN(n) ? fallback : n;
};

export const UsagePricingBreakdown: React.FC<UsagePricingBreakdownProps> = ({
  title = "Usage this cycle",
  currency = "USD",
  tiers = DEFAULT_TIERS,
  footerNote = "Estimated charges based on metered usage to date.",
  className = "",
}) => {
  const list = Array.isArray(tiers) ? tiers : [];
  let total = 0;
  const rows = list.map((tier, index) => {
    const usage = Math.max(0, toNumber(tier.usage));
    const unitPrice = Math.max(0, toNumber(tier.unitPrice));
    const subtotal = usage * unitPrice;
    total += subtotal;
    return { tier, index, usage, unitPrice, subtotal, current: usage > 0 };
  });

  return (
    <div data-pricing-breakdown className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-pricing-header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p data-pricing-title className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        <span data-pricing-currency className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{currency}</span>
      </div>
      <table data-pricing-table-body className="w-full text-left text-xs">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <th className="px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold">Tier</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Usage</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Unit price</th>
            <th className="px-5 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Subtotal</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map(({ tier, index, usage, unitPrice, subtotal, current }) => (
            <tr
              key={index}
              data-pricing-tier={index}
              className={`border-b border-zinc-50 transition-colors last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${current ? "bg-violet-50/60 dark:bg-violet-950/30" : ""}`}
            >
              <td data-pricing-range={tier.range} className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {tier.range} <span className="ml-1 text-[11px] font-normal text-zinc-400">{tier.unit || ""}</span>
              </td>
              <td data-pricing-usage={usage} className="px-2 py-3 text-right font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{usage.toLocaleString()}</td>
              <td data-pricing-unit-price={unitPrice} className="px-2 py-3 text-right font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{currency} {unitPrice.toFixed(4)}</td>
              <td data-pricing-subtotal={subtotal.toFixed(2)} className={`px-5 py-3 text-right font-mono font-semibold ${current ? "text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300" : "text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"}`}>
                {currency} {subtotal.toFixed(2)}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div data-pricing-footer className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <p data-pricing-total-label className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Estimated total</p>
          {footerNote ? <p data-pricing-note className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-4 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{footerNote}</p> : null}
        </div>
        <span data-pricing-total-value className="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{currency} {total.toFixed(2)}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default UsagePricingBreakdown;

/**
 * UsageQuotaCard - credit/quota meter card (or banner) with progress and upgrade CTA.
 */
export default function UsageQuotaCard({
  label = "Credits Remaining",
  used = 0,
  total = 0,
  unit = "",
  summary = "",
  upgradeLine = "Upgrade for unlimited use",
  ctaLabel = "Upgrade",
  ctaTone = "dark",
  banner = false,
  onCta,
}: UsageQuotaCardProps) {
  if (banner) {
    return (
      <div data-quota-banner className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 dark:border-emerald-500/40 dark:bg-emerald-950/40">

        >
          {ctaLabel}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const percent = total > 0 ? Math.round(((total - used) / total) * 100) : 0;
  const valueLabel = `${used}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ""}${total ? ` of ${total}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ""}` : ""}`;

  return (

      <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{summary || valueLabel}</p>
      {total ? (
        <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700">
          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-sky-500 transition-all" style={{ width: `${percent}%` }} />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {upgradeLine ? <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{upgradeLine}</p> : null}
      <button
        type="button"
        data-quota-cta
        onClick={() => onCta?.()}
        className={`mt-3 w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          ctaTone === "dark" ? "bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white" : "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500"
        }`}
      >
        {ctaLabel}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * VisionAnalysisCard - AI image-analysis structured reply block: key/value
 * attribute table rows and section headings like "Design Strengths" (Claude).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface VisionAnalysisSection {
  heading: string;
  rows: Array<{ key: string; value: string }>;
}

export interface VisionAnalysisCardProps {
  sections?: VisionAnalysisSection[];
  className?: string;
  onSectionClick?: (section: VisionAnalysisSection) => void;
}

export default function VisionAnalysisCard({
  sections = [
    {
      heading: "Image Details",
      rows: [
        { key: "Lighting", value: "Strong overhead sunlight creating sharp shadows on sand; excellent clarity suggests midday conditions" },
        { key: "Beach Activity", value: "Scattered groups of swimmers and sunbathers distributed across the sand and shallow water" },
        { key: "Wave Patterns", value: "Multiple rolling waves with consistent whitecaps indicate moderate, consistent swell" },
      ],
    },
  ],
  className = "",
  onSectionClick,
}: VisionAnalysisCardProps) {
  return (
    <div data-vision-analysis-card className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {sections.map((section) => (
        <div key={section.heading} data-vision-section className="mb-4 last:mb-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-vision-section-heading={section.heading}
            onClick={() => onSectionClick?.(section)}
            className="mb-2 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:hover:text-indigo-400"
          >
            {section.heading}
          </button>
          <dl data-vision-rows className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
            {section.rows.map((row) => (
              <div
                key={row.key}
                data-vision-row={row.key}
                className="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,9rem)_1fr] gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60"
              >
                <dt data-vision-row-key className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                  {row.key}
                </dt>
                <dd data-vision-row-value className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {row.value}
                </dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\VoiceModePanel.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export type VoiceModeState = "idle" | "listening" | "thinking" | "speaking";

export interface VoiceModePanelProps {
  state?: VoiceModeState;
  /** Live user transcript shown under the orb. */
  transcript?: string;
  /** Assistant reply shown while thinking/speaking. */
  reply?: string;
  /** Called when the orb is pressed (start/stop listening). */
  onToggle?: () => void;
  /** Called by the end-session button. */
  onEnd?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const STATE_META: Record<VoiceModeState, { label: string; hint: string; ring: string; orb: string }> = {
  idle: {
    label: "Tap to speak",
    hint: "Voice mode is ready",
    ring: "bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/40",
    orb: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300",
  },
  listening: {
    label: "Listening…",
    hint: "Speak now — tap again to stop",
    ring: "bg-indigo-400/40",
    orb: "bg-indigo-600 text-white",
  },
  thinking: {
    label: "Thinking…",
    hint: "Working on a response",
    ring: "bg-amber-400/40",
    orb: "bg-amber-500 text-white",
  },
  speaking: {
    label: "Speaking…",
    hint: "Tap to interrupt",
    ring: "bg-emerald-400/40",
    orb: "bg-emerald-500 text-white",
  },
};

const BAR_COUNT = 9;

export const VoiceModePanel: React.FC<VoiceModePanelProps> = ({
  state = "idle",
  transcript,
  reply,
  onToggle,
  onEnd,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const meta = STATE_META[state];
  const animated = state === "listening" || state === "speaking";

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex flex-col items-center rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-8 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="relative flex h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center">
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`absolute inset-0 rounded-full ${meta.ring} ${animated ? "animate-ping" : "opacity-0"}`}
        />
        <span aria-hidden="true" className={`absolute inset-3 rounded-full ${meta.ring} opacity-60`} />
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`absolute inset-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${
            state === "thinking"
              ? "animate-pulse bg-amber-400/50"
              : state === "listening"
                ? "bg-indigo-400/40"
                : state === "speaking"
                  ? "bg-emerald-400/40"
                  : "bg-zinc-200/50 dark:bg-zinc-700/40"
          }`}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggle}
          aria-label={state === "idle" ? "Start voice mode" : "Stop voice mode"}
          aria-pressed={state !== "idle"}
          className={`relative flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${meta.orb}`}
        >
          <UiIcon name={state === "idle" ? "mic" : "square"} size={24} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex h-6 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
        {Array.from({ length: BAR_COUNT }, (_, index) => (
          <span
            key={index}
            className={`w-1 rounded-full ${
              animated
                ? "animate-[voice-bar_0.9s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate] bg-indigo-500"
                : "h-1 bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700"
            }`}
            style={animated ? { animationDelay: `${(index * 0.07).toFixed(2)}s` } : undefined}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{meta.label}</p>
      <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{meta.hint}</p>

      {transcript && (
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          “{transcript}”
        </p>
      )}
      {reply && (
        <p className="mt-2 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
          {reply}
        </p>
      )}

      {onEnd && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onEnd}
          className="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" size={12} />
          End voice session
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default VoiceModePanel;


===== FILE: react\VoiceOrb.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export type VoiceOrbState = "listening" | "speaking" | "thinking" | "idle";

export interface VoiceOrbProps {
  state?: VoiceOrbState;
  label?: string;
  hint?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
  showControls?: boolean;
  muted?: boolean;
  onToggleMute?: () => void;
  onEnd?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const SIZE_CLASS = {
  sm: "h-20 w-20",
  md: "h-36 w-36",
  lg: "h-56 w-56",
} as const;

const STATE_RING = {
  listening: "bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-400 via-indigo-500 to-violet-600 animate-pulse",
  speaking: "bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-400 via-teal-500 to-cyan-600 animate-pulse",
  thinking: "bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-300 via-orange-400 to-rose-500 animate-pulse",
  idle: "bg-gradient-to-br from-zinc-300 to-zinc-400 dark:from-zinc-600 dark:to-zinc-700",
} as const;

const STATE_LABEL = {
  listening: "Listening…",
  speaking: "Speaking…",
  thinking: "Thinking…",
  idle: "Tap to talk",
} as const;

const BARS = [10, 18, 26, 34, 26, 18, 10] as const;

/**
 * VoiceOrb - ElevenLabs / Grok / Mindtrip style voice conversation orb: a
 * centered gradient disc whose color tracks the conversation state, with an
 * optional waveform readout and Mute / End controls beneath.
 */
export default function VoiceOrb({
  state = "idle",
  label,
  hint,
  size = "md",
  showControls = true,
  muted = false,
  onToggleMute,
  onEnd,
  className = "",
}: VoiceOrbProps) {
  return (
    <div data-voice-orb className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-4 ${className}`}>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
        <div
          data-voice-orb-disc
          data-orb-state={state}
          className={`${SIZE_CLASS[size]} rounded-full ${STATE_RING[state]} shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20`}
        />
        {state !== "idle" && (
          <div data-voice-orb-wave className="flex h-8 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
            {BARS.map((h, i) => (
              <span
                key={i}
                className="w-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-400"
                style={{ height: `${h}px` }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <p data-voice-orb-label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          {label ?? STATE_LABEL[state]}
        </p>
        {hint && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{hint}</p>}
      </div>
      {showControls && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-voice-orb-mute
            aria-pressed={muted}
            onClick={onToggleMute}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
              muted
                ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
                : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
            }`}
          >
            {muted ? "Unmute" : "Mute"}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-voice-orb-end
            onClick={onEnd}
            className="rounded-full bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-red-500"
          >
            End call
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\VoiceSessionHistory.tsx =====

import React from "react";

export interface VoiceSession {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  date?: string;
  duration?: string;
  status?: "completed" | "failed" | "in-progress";
}

export interface VoiceSessionHistoryProps {
  title?: string;
  sessions?: VoiceSession[];
  emptyLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
  onSelect?: (session: VoiceSession) => void;
  onPlay?: (session: VoiceSession) => void;
}

/**
 * VoiceSessionHistory - ElevenLabs Voice "History" sidebar: session rows with
 * title, date/duration metadata, status badge and a replay button.
 */
export default function VoiceSessionHistory({
  title = "History",
  sessions = [],
  emptyLabel = "No sessions yet.",
  className = "",
  onSelect,
  onPlay,
}: VoiceSessionHistoryProps) {
  const active = sessions.filter((s) => s.status !== "failed").length;
  return (
    <div
      data-voice-history
      className={`w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          {title}{" "}
          <span data-voice-history-count className="ml-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {active}
          </span>
        </h4>
      </div>
      <div data-voice-history-list className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        {sessions.length === 0 ? (
          <p data-voice-history-empty className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            {emptyLabel}
          </p>
        ) : (
          sessions.map((s) => {
            const failed = s.status === "failed";
            const running = s.status === "in-progress";
            return (
              <div key={s.id} data-voice-session={s.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p data-voice-session-title className="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                    {s.title}
                  </p>
                  <p data-voice-session-meta className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                    {[s.date, s.duration].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span
                  data-voice-session-status
                  className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
                    failed
                      ? "bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400"
                      : running
                        ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400"
                        : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400"
                  }`}
                >
                  {failed ? "Failed" : running ? "Running" : "Completed"}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-voice-session-play
                  aria-label={`Play ${s.title}`}
                  onClick={() => onPlay?.(s)}
                  className="shrink-0 rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300"
                >
                  ▶
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\WebhookConfigPanel.tsx =====

/**
 * WebhookConfigPanel - Webhook endpoint management: header, endpoint rows
 * with active toggle / mono URL / event chips / last-delivery status badge
 * and a Test action, plus an events legend (webhook settings pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface WebhookEndpoint {
  id: string;
  url: string;
  events: string[];
  lastStatus?: number | string;
  lastDelivery?: string;
  active?: boolean;
}

export interface WebhookConfigPanelProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  endpoints?: WebhookEndpoint[];
  events?: string[];
  testLabel?: string;
  eventsLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
  onTest?: (endpoint: WebhookEndpoint) => void;
  onToggle?: (endpoint: WebhookEndpoint, active: boolean) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS: WebhookEndpoint[] = [
  { id: "wh1", url: "https://api.example.com/hooks/deploy", events: ["build.finished", "deploy.failed"], lastStatus: 200, lastDelivery: "2 minutes ago", active: true },
  { id: "wh2", url: "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00/B00/XYZ", events: ["alert.triggered"], lastStatus: 503, lastDelivery: "1 hour ago", active: true },
  { id: "wh3", url: "https://staging.example.com/hooks", events: ["build.finished"], lastStatus: 404, lastDelivery: "3 days ago", active: false },
];

const DEFAULT_EVENTS: string[] = ["build.finished", "deploy.failed", "alert.triggered"];

const deliveryCls = (status: number | string | undefined) => {
  const code = Number.parseInt(String(status ?? ""), 10);
  if (Number.isNaN(code)) return "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400";
  if (code < 300) return "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400";
  if (code < 500) return "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-400";
  return "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400";
};

export const WebhookConfigPanel: React.FC<WebhookConfigPanelProps> = ({
  title = "Webhooks",
  description = "Send real-time event notifications to your own services.",
  endpoints = DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS,
  events = DEFAULT_EVENTS,
  testLabel = "Test",
  eventsLabel = "Available events",
  className = "",
  onTest,
  onToggle,
}) => {
  const list = Array.isArray(endpoints) ? endpoints : [];

  return (
    <div data-webhook-panel className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      <div data-webhook-header className="border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p data-webhook-title className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{title}</p>
        <p data-webhook-description className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{description}</p>
      </div>
      <div data-webhook-list>
        {list.map((ep) => (
          <div
            key={ep.id}
            data-webhook-endpoint={ep.id}
            className={`flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-b border-zinc-50 px-5 py-4 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${ep.active === false ? "opacity-50" : ""}`}
          >
            <label data-webhook-active-wrapper={ep.id} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                data-webhook-toggle={ep.id}
                checked={ep.active !== false}
                onChange={(e) => onToggle?.(ep, e.target.checked)}
                className="h-4 w-4 accent-violet-600"
                aria-label="Toggle endpoint"
              />
            </label>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p data-webhook-url={ep.url} className="truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{ep.url}</p>
              <div data-webhook-events={ep.id} className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {(Array.isArray(ep.events) ? ep.events : []).map((ev) => (
                  <span key={ev} data-webhook-event={ev} className="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">{ev}</span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span data-webhook-delivery={ep.id} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                <span className={`inline-block rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold ${deliveryCls(ep.lastStatus)}`}>{String(ep.lastStatus ?? "—")}</span>
                {ep.lastDelivery || ""}
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                data-webhook-test={ep.id}
                onClick={() => onTest?.(ep)}
                className="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              >
                {testLabel}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div data-webhook-footer className="border-t border-zinc-100 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p data-webhook-events-label className="mb-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{eventsLabel}</p>
        <div data-webhook-events-legend className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {(Array.isArray(events) ? events : []).map((ev) => (
            <span key={ev} className="rounded-md border border-dashed border-zinc-300 px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">{ev}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default WebhookConfigPanel;

/**
 * WeekCalendarGrid - Week-view calendar grid: hour gutter, day columns with
 * absolutely positioned event blocks (solid or dashed focus blocks), red
 * current-time line, Day/Week segmented toggle, timezone label, "Find time"
 * button and a "Schedule or reschedule…" composer input
 * (Clockwise week calendar pattern).
 */
import React from "react";

export interface WeekDay {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  date: string;
}

export interface WeekEvent {
  id: string;
  dayId: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  tone?: "solid" | "dashed";
  color?: "blue" | "green" | "amber";
}

export interface WeekCalendarGridProps {
  days?: WeekDay[];
  startHour?: number;
  endHour?: number;
  timeZone?: string;
  events?: WeekEvent[];
  view?: "week" | "day";
  activeDayId?: string;
  nowHour?: number;
  composerPlaceholder?: string;
  className?: string;
  onEventClick?: (event: WeekEvent) => void;
  onViewChange?: (view: "week" | "day") => void;
  onFindTime?: () => void;
}

const HOUR_HEIGHT = 56;

const EVENT_STYLES: Record<string, { solid: string; dashed: string }> = {
  blue: {
    solid: "bg-blue-500/90 text-white dark:bg-blue-500/80",
    dashed: "border border-dashed border-blue-400 bg-blue-50/60 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-300",
  },
  green: {
    solid: "bg-emerald-500/90 text-white dark:bg-emerald-500/80",
    dashed: "border border-dashed border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50/60 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300",
  },
  amber: {
    solid: "bg-amber-400/90 text-amber-950 dark:bg-amber-400/80",
    dashed: "border border-dashed border-amber-400 bg-amber-50/60 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300",
  },
};

const HOUR_LABELS = (h: number) => {
  const suffix = h < 12 ? "am" : "pm";
  const hour12 = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
  return `${hour12}${suffix}`;
};

export default function WeekCalendarGrid({
  days = [
    { id: "mon", label: "Mon", date: "16" },
    { id: "tue", label: "Tue", date: "17" },
    { id: "wed", label: "Wed", date: "18" },
    { id: "thu", label: "Thu", date: "19" },
    { id: "fri", label: "Fri", date: "20" },
  ],
  startHour = 6,
  endHour = 18,
  timeZone = "GMT+7",
  events = [
    { id: "e1", dayId: "mon", title: "Alex // Sam", start: 9, end: 10, tone: "solid", color: "blue" },
    { id: "e2", dayId: "mon", title: "Focus Time", start: 10, end: 12, tone: "dashed", color: "blue" },
    { id: "e3", dayId: "mon", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
    { id: "e4", dayId: "mon", title: "Focus Time", start: 13, end: 17, tone: "dashed", color: "blue" },
    { id: "e5", dayId: "tue", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
    { id: "e6", dayId: "wed", title: "Team Sync", start: 9, end: 10, tone: "solid", color: "green" },
    { id: "e7", dayId: "wed", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
    { id: "e8", dayId: "thu", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
    { id: "e9", dayId: "fri", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
  ],
  view = "week",
  activeDayId = "mon",
  nowHour = 15.83,
  composerPlaceholder = "Schedule or reschedule…",
  className = "",
  onEventClick,
  onViewChange,
  onFindTime,
}: WeekCalendarGridProps) {
  const hours: number[] = [];
  for (let h = startHour; h <= endHour; h++) hours.push(h);

  const visibleDays = view === "day" ? days.filter((d) => d.id === activeDayId) : days;
  const gridHeight = (endHour - startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT;

  return (
    <div data-week-grid className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>
      {/* toolbar */}
      <div data-week-toolbar className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div data-week-view-toggle className="flex overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">
            {(["day", "week"] as const).map((v) => (
              <button
                key={v}
                data-week-view={v}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onViewChange?.(v)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold capitalize transition-colors ${
                  view === v
                    ? "bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900"
                    : "bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                }`}
              >
                {v}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <span data-week-timezone className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{timeZone}</span>
        </div>
        <button
          data-week-find-time
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onFindTime?.()}
          className="rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200"
        >
          Find time
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* composer */}
      <input
        data-week-composer
        type="text"
        placeholder={composerPlaceholder}
        className="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 outline-none focus:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 dark:text-zinc-100 dark:placeholder-zinc-500"
      />

      {/* day header */}
      <div className="mt-4 grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `64px repeat(${visibleDays.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }}>
        <div></div>
        {visibleDays.map((day) => (
          <div
            key={day.id}
            data-week-day={day.id}
            className={`pb-2 text-center ${day.id === activeDayId ? "rounded-md bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60" : ""}`}
          >
            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{day.label}</p>
            <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${day.id === activeDayId ? "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" : "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"}`}>{day.date}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* grid body */}
      <div data-week-body className="relative grid overflow-hidden" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `64px repeat(${visibleDays.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }}>
        {/* gutter */}
        <div data-week-gutter className="relative" style={{ height: gridHeight }}>
          {hours.map((h, i) => (
            <span
              key={h}
              className="absolute -translate-y-1/2 pr-3 text-right text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"
              style={{ top: i * HOUR_HEIGHT }}
            >
              {HOUR_LABELS(h)}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* day columns */}
        {visibleDays.map((day) => (
          <div key={day.id} data-week-column={day.id} className="relative border-l border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800" style={{ height: gridHeight }}>
            {hours.map((h, i) => (
              <div key={h} className="absolute w-full border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800" style={{ top: i * HOUR_HEIGHT }}></div>
            ))}
            {events
              .filter((ev) => ev.dayId === day.id)
              .map((ev) => {
                const styles = EVENT_STYLES[ev.color ?? "blue"];
                const cls = (ev.tone ?? "solid") === "dashed" ? styles.dashed : styles.solid;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={ev.id}
                    data-week-event={ev.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onEventClick?.(ev)}
                    style={{ top: (ev.start - startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT, height: (ev.end - ev.start) * HOUR_HEIGHT - 4 }}
                    className={`absolute left-1 right-1.5 z-10 overflow-hidden rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-left text-xs font-semibold ${cls}`}
                  >
                    {ev.title}
                    {ev.subtitle && <span className="block truncate text-[10px] font-normal opacity-80">{ev.subtitle}</span>}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            {/* current-time line */}
            {nowHour >= startHour && nowHour <= endHour && (
              <div data-week-now className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 z-20 border-t-2 border-red-500" style={{ top: (nowHour - startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT }}>
                <span className="absolute -left-1 -top-[5px] h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: react\WizardSteps.tsx =====

import React from "react";
import { UiIcon } from "./UiIcon";

export interface WizardStep {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  optional?: boolean;
}

export interface WizardStepsProps {
  steps: WizardStep[];
  current: number;
  variant?: "vertical" | "bar";
  nextLabel?: string;
  onStepClick?: (index: number) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const WizardSteps: React.FC<WizardStepsProps> = ({
  steps,
  current,
  variant = "vertical",
  nextLabel,
  onStepClick,
  className = "",
}) => {
  const total = steps.length;
  const progress = total ? Math.round(((current + 1) / total) * 100) : 0;
  const nextStep = steps[current + 1];

  if (variant === "bar") {
    return (
      <div
        data-wizard-steps
        role="group"
        aria-label="Wizard progress"
        className={`flex flex-col gap-2 ${className}`}
      >
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
            {current + 1} of {total} steps
          </span>
          {nextStep ? (
            <>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">|</span>
              <span>Next: {nextStep.label}</span>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </p>
        <div
          role="progressbar"
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={total}
          aria-valuenow={current + 1}
          className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-950/50"
        >
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-violet-600 transition-all duration-300"
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ol data-wizard-steps className={`flex flex-col ${className}`}>
      {steps.map((step, index) => {
        const state = index < current ? "done" : index === current ? "active" : "todo";
        const isLast = index === total - 1;
        const interactive = typeof onStepClick === "function" && index <= current;
        return (
          <li
            key={`${step.label}-${index}`}
            className="relative flex gap-3 pb-4 last:pb-0"
          >
            {!isLast ? (
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-0 w-px ${
                  index < current ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                }`}
              />
            ) : null}
            <button
              type="button"
              data-step-index={index}
              disabled={!interactive}
              onClick={() => onStepClick?.(index)}
              aria-current={state === "active" ? "step" : undefined}
              className={`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                state === "done"
                  ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white"
                  : state === "active"
                    ? "border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:border-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900"
                    : "border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400"
              } ${interactive ? "cursor-pointer" : "cursor-default"}`}
            >
              {state === "done" ? <UiIcon name="check" size={13} /> : index + 1}
            </button>
            <span className="min-w-0 pt-1">
              <span
                className={`block truncate text-sm font-medium ${
                  state === "active"
                    ? "text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"
                    : state === "done"
                      ? "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300"
                      : "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
                }`}
              >
                {step.label}
                {step.optional ? (
                  <span className="ml-1.5 text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Optional)</span>
                ) : null}
              </span>
              {step.hint ? (
                <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-xs text-zinc-400">{step.hint}</span>
              ) : null}
            </span>
          </li>
        );
      })}
      {nextLabel ? (
        <li className="pt-1 pl-10 text-xs text-zinc-400">{nextLabel}</li>
      ) : null}
    </ol>
  );
};

export default WizardSteps;

              }`}

import React, { useState } from "react";

export interface WriterGuideEntry {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  minutes: number;
}

export interface WriterStyleGuideProps {
  entries?: WriterGuideEntry[];
  activeTab?: "company" | "team" | "my";
  className?: string;
  onTabChange?: (tab: "company" | "team" | "my") => void;
  onEntryClick?: (entry: WriterGuideEntry) => void;
}

const TABS: Array<{ id: "company" | "team" | "my"; label: string }> = [
  { id: "company", label: "Company" },
  { id: "team", label: "Team" },
  { id: "my", label: "My" },
];

export default function WriterStyleGuide({
  entries = [
    { id: "g1", title: "Don't use passive voice", description: "It dilutes meaning and bloats sentences.", minutes: 3 },
    { id: "g2", title: "Use contracted forms", description: "Write \"can't\" instead of \"cannot\" for a friendly tone.", minutes: 2 },
    { id: "g3", title: "Upper Kebab case for products", description: "Product names use Upper Kebab case.", minutes: 4 },
  ],
  activeTab: activeTabProp = "company",
  className = "",
  onTabChange,
  onEntryClick,
}: WriterStyleGuideProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"company" | "team" | "my">(activeTabProp);
  const current = activeTabProp ?? activeTab;
  return (
    <div data-writer-style-guide className={`w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`}>

        {TABS.map((tab) => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            type="button"
            data-writer-tab={tab.id}
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTab(tab.id);
              onTabChange?.(tab.id);
            }}
            className={`rounded-t-md px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
              current === tab.id
                ? "border-b-2 border-indigo-500 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"
                : "border-b-2 border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            }`}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="p-4">
        <div data-writer-entries className="space-y-3">
          {entries.map((entry, index) => (
            <button
              key={entry.id}
              type="button"
              data-writer-entry={entry.id}
              onClick={() => onEntryClick?.(entry)}
              className="flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-lg p-2 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
                {index + 1}
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span data-writer-entry-title className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
                  {entry.title}
                </span>
                <span data-writer-entry-desc className="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  {entry.description}
                </span>
              </span>
              <span data-writer-entry-minutes className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {entry.minutes} min
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <button type="button" data-writer-add className="mt-3 w-full rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-300 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:border-indigo-700 dark:hover:text-indigo-400">
          + Add guideline
        </button>

  );

  <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M3 6V3h3M17 6V3h-3M3 14v3h3M17 14v3h-3" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));

const iconButton =
  "flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100";

/**
 * ZoomControlBar - canvas viewport zoom control with stepper / dropdown / slider variants and optional undo-redo pair.
 */
export default function ZoomControlBar({
  value = 100,
  min = 10,
  max = 400,
  step = 10,
  variant = "stepper",
  presets = [25, 50, 75, 100, 200],
  showFit = false,
  showUndoRedo = false,
  onZoomChange,
  onFit,
  onUndo,
  onRedo,
  className = "",
}: ZoomControlBarProps) {
  const [zoom, setZoom] = React.useState(() => clamp(value, min, max));
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setZoom(value);
  }, [value]);

  const change = (next: number) => {
    const clamped = clamp(Math.round(next), min, max);
    setZoom(clamped);
    onZoomChange?.(clamped);
  };

  const container =
    "inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-1 py-0.5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900";
  const percent = (
    <button
      type="button"
      data-zoom-value
      onClick={() => variant === "dropdown" && setOpen((prev) => !prev)}
      className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 tabular-nums dark:text-zinc-200 ${variant === "dropdown" ? "hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" : ""}`}
    >
      {zoom}%{variant === "dropdown" ? <span aria-hidden="true"> ▾</span> : null}
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <div data-zoom-control className={`${container} ${className}`}>
      {showUndoRedo ? (
        <>
          <button type="button" data-zoom-undo title="Undo" onClick={() => onUndo?.()} className={iconButton}>{UNDO_SVG}</button>
          <button type="button" data-zoom-redo title="Redo" onClick={() => onRedo?.()} className={iconButton}>{REDO_SVG}</button>
          <span className="mx-0.5 h-4 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {variant === "stepper" ? (
        <>
          <button type="button" data-zoom-out title="Zoom out" disabled={zoom <= min} onClick={() => change(zoom - step)} className={iconButton}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 10h10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
          </button>
          {percent}
          <button type="button" data-zoom-in title="Zoom in" disabled={zoom >= max} onClick={() => change(zoom + step)} className={iconButton}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 5v10M5 10h10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
          </button>
        </>
      ) : null}
      {variant === "dropdown" ? (
        <div className="relative">
          {percent}
          {open ? (
            <div data-zoom-menu className="absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-1 w-24 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
              {presets.map((preset) => (
                <button
                  key={preset}
                  type="button"
                  data-zoom-preset={preset}
                  onClick={() => {
                    change(preset);
                    setOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className={`block w-full px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs tabular-nums hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 ${preset === zoom ? "font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" : "text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"}`}
                >
                  {preset}%
                </button>
              ))}
              {showFit ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-zoom-fit
                  onClick={() => {
                    onFit?.();
                    setOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className="block w-full border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                >
                  Fit
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {variant === "slider" ? (
        <>
          <input
            data-zoom-slider
            type="range"
            min={min}
            max={max}
            step={step}
            value={zoom}
            onChange={(e) => change(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="h-1.5 w-24 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded-full bg-zinc-200 accent-blue-600 dark:bg-zinc-700"
            aria-label="Zoom level"
          />
          {percent}
        </>
      ) : null}
      {showFit && variant !== "dropdown" ? (
        <button type="button" data-zoom-fit title="Fit to page" onClick={() => onFit?.()} className={iconButton}>{FIT_SVG}</button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * AIInlineMenu - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <ai-inline-menu actions='[...]' loading="false" tone="neutral|brand"></ai-inline-menu>
 * Attributes: actions (JSON [{id,label,options?[]}]), loading, error, tone
 * Properties: actions
 * Events: action (detail {id, option?}), dismiss
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SPARKLE_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 2.5l1.4 4.1L15.5 8l-4.1 1.4L10 13.5 8.6 9.4 4.5 8l4.1-1.4L10 2.5Z"/><path d="M15.8 12.6l.7 2 2 .7-2 .7-.7 2-.7-2-2-.7 2-.7.7-2Z" opacity="0.7"/></svg>';
const CARET_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="14" height="14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 8 4 4 4-4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
const CLOSE_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="12" height="12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';

export class AIInlineMenuElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['actions', 'loading', 'error', 'tone'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._actions = [];
    this._openId = null;
    this._lastRun = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._actions.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('actions');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._actions = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._actions = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const dismiss = event.target.closest('[data-ai-dismiss]');
        if (dismiss) {
          this._openId = null;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss'));
          return;
        }
        const optionButton = event.target.closest('[data-ai-option]');
        if (optionButton) {
          const option = optionButton.getAttribute('data-ai-option');
          const actionId = optionButton.closest('[data-ai-menu]').getAttribute('data-ai-menu');
          this._openId = null;
          this._lastRun = `${actionId}:${option}`;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { id: actionId, option } }));
          return;
        }
        const actionButton = event.target.closest('[data-ai-action]');
        if (actionButton && !this.getAttribute('loading')) {
          const id = actionButton.getAttribute('data-ai-action');
          const action = this._resolvedActions().find((a) => a.id === id);
          if (action && action.options && action.options.length) {
            this._openId = this._openId === id ? null : id;
            this.render();
          } else if (action) {
            this._openId = null;
            this._lastRun = id;
            this.render();
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { id } }));
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'actions') this._actions = [];
    if (name === 'loading') this.render();
    this.render();
  }

  get actions() { return this._actions; }
  set actions(v) {
    this._actions = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _resolvedActions() {
    return this._actions.length
      ? this._actions
      : [{ id: 'edit', label: 'Edit' }, { id: 'tone', label: 'Change tone', options: ['Professional', 'Friendly', 'Concise'] }];
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const loading = this.getAttribute('loading') === 'true';
    const error = this.getAttribute('error') || '';
    const brand = this.getAttribute('tone') === 'brand';
    const actions = this._resolvedActions();

    const hostClass = 'inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-full border bg-white py-1 pl-1.5 pr-1 shadow-lg dark:bg-zinc-900';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const chipClass = brand
      ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700'
      : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600';

    const actionButtons = actions
      .map((action) => {
        const menu = this._openId === action.id && action.options && action.options.length
          ? `<div data-ai-menu="${escapeAttribute(action.id)}" class="absolute bottom-full left-0 z-10 mb-1 w-40 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg">${action.options.map((option) => `<button type="button" data-ai-option="${escapeAttribute(option)}" class="block w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-xs text-zinc-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700">${escapeAttribute(option)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`
          : '';
        return `<div class="relative"><button type="button" data-ai-action="${escapeAttribute(action.id)}"${loading ? ' disabled' : ''} class="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50">${escapeAttribute(action.label)}${action.options && action.options.length ? CARET_SVG : ''}</button>${menu}</div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const status = this._lastRun && !loading && !error
      ? `<span data-ai-status class="max-w-[160px] truncate px-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400" title="${escapeAttribute(this._lastRun)}">${escapeAttribute(this._lastRun)}</span>`
      : '';
    const loadingLabel = loading ? '<span data-ai-loading class="px-1 text-[10px] text-indigo-500">Working…</span>' : '';
    const errorLabel = error ? `<span data-ai-error class="px-1 text-[10px] text-red-600">${escapeAttribute(error)}</span>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-ai-inline-menu class="${hostClass}">
  <span class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${chipClass}"><span style="display:inline-flex${loading ? ';animation:pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite' : ''}">${SPARKLE_SVG}</span>AI</span>
  <span class="mx-0.5 h-4 w-px bg-zinc-200"></span>
  ${actionButtons}
  ${status}${loadingLabel}${errorLabel}
  <button type="button" data-ai-dismiss title="Dismiss" class="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${CLOSE_SVG}</button>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('ai-inline-menu')) {
  customElements.define('ai-inline-menu', AIInlineMenuElement);
}

export default AIInlineMenuElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\Accordion.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * Accordion - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <accordion-list allow-multiple></accordion-list>
 * Properties: items (AccordionItem[])
 * Events: toggle (detail: { id, open })
 */
export class AccordionElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['allow-multiple', 'default-open-ids'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
    this._openIds = null;
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (this._openIds === null) {
      this._openIds = this._items.filter((item) => item.defaultOpen).map((item) => item.id);
    }
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _openList() {
    if (this._openIds !== null) return this._openIds;
    const raw = this.getAttribute('default-open-ids');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.map(String) : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  _toggle(id) {
    const openIds = this._openList();
    const wasOpen = openIds.includes(id);
    const allowMultiple = this.hasAttribute('allow-multiple');
    this._openIds = wasOpen
      ? openIds.filter((entry) => entry !== id)
      : allowMultiple
        ? [...openIds, id]
        : [id];
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id, open: !wasOpen } }));
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const openIds = this._openList();

    const rows = this._items
      .map((item) => {
        const open = openIds.includes(item.id);
        return `<div>
          <h3>
            <button type="button" data-accordion-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" aria-expanded="${open}"
              aria-controls="accordion-panel-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
              class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50">
              ${item.icon ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</span>
                ${item.description ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.description)}</span>` : ''}
              </span>
              <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 14 })}</span>
            </button>
          </h3>
          ${
            open
              ? `<div id="accordion-panel-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" role="region" aria-labelledby="accordion-trigger-${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
                  class="px-4 pb-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.content)}</div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${rows}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-accordion-id]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._toggle(node.getAttribute('data-accordion-id')));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('accordion-list')) {
  customElements.define('accordion-list', AccordionElement);
}
export default AccordionElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\AccountSecurityPanel.js =====

/**
 * AccountSecurityPanel - Account settings security tab: settings tabs,
 * Password row with edit CTA and a "Manage verified sessions" card with
 * per-device rows and remove buttons (Podia account security pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_TABS = () => ['Personal', 'Notifications', 'Security', 'Billing'];

const DEFAULT_SESSIONS = () => [
  { id: 's1', device: 'Chrome on Mac 10.15.7', detail: 'Nov 12 at 4:52 AM EST' },
  { id: 's2', device: 'Firefox on Windows 11', detail: 'Nov 8 at 9:18 AM EST' },
];

class AccountSecurityPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tabs', 'password-value', 'sessions-title', 'sessions-description', 'sessions'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._tab = 'Security';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const tabBtn = event.target.closest('[data-acctsec-tab]');
    if (tabBtn) {
      this._tab = tabBtn.getAttribute('data-acctsec-tab');
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tab-click', { detail: { tab: this._tab }, bubbles: true }));
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-acctsec-edit-password]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('edit-password', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const removeBtn = event.target.closest('[data-acctsec-remove]');
    if (removeBtn) {
      const id = removeBtn.getAttribute('data-acctsec-remove');
      const sessions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sessions'), DEFAULT_SESSIONS());
      const session = sessions.find((s) => s.id === id);
      if (session) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove-session', { detail: session, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const tabs = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('tabs'), DEFAULT_TABS());
    const passwordValue = this.getAttribute('password-value') || '••••••••';

        }">${escapeAttribute(t)}</button>`

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/**
 * AccountSwitcher - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <account-switcher current-id="a1"></account-switcher>
 * Properties: accounts (Account[])
 * Events: switch (detail: account), add-account, sign-out, open-change (detail: boolean)
 */
export class AccountSwitcherElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['current-id'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._accounts = [];
    this._open = false;
    this._onPointerDown = this._onPointerDown.bind(this);
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  get accounts() {
    return this._accounts;
  }

  set accounts(value) {
    this._accounts = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get open() {
    return this._open;
  }

  set open(value) {
    this._setOpen(Boolean(value));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this._detachGlobal();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _current() {
    const currentId = this.getAttribute('current-id');
    return this._accounts.find((account) => String(account.id) === String(currentId)) || this._accounts[0];
  }

  _setOpen(next) {
    if (this._open === next) return;
    this._open = next;
    if (next) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    } else {
      this._detachGlobal();
    }
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-change', { detail: next }));
  }

  _detachGlobal() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  _onPointerDown(event) {
    if (!this.contains(event.target)) this._setOpen(false);
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') this._setOpen(false);
  }

  _avatar(account, sizeClass) {
    const inner = account.avatar
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(account.avatar)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
      : escapeAttribute(initials(account.name));
    return `<span class="flex ${sizeClass} shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full ${sizeClass.includes('h-6') ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400' : 'bg-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200'} text-[10px] font-semibold">${inner}</span>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('inline-block');

    const current = this._current();
    if (!current) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const rows = this._accounts
      .map((account) => {
        const active = String(account.id) === String(current.id);
        const meta = [account.role, account.plan].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || account.email || '';
        return `<li>
          <button type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="${active}" data-account="${escapeAttribute(account.id)}"
            class="account-row flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
            ${this._avatar(account, 'h-6 w-6')}
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(account.name)}</span>
              <span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(meta)}</span>
            </span>
            ${active ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('check', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}
          </button>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="relative inline-block text-left">
        <button type="button" class="account-trigger flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="${this._open}">
          ${this._avatar(current, 'h-6 w-6')}
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(current.name)}</span>
            ${current.email ? `<span class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(current.email)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 12 })}</span>
        </button>

        ${
          this._open
            ? `<div role="menu" aria-label="Switch account" class="account-menu absolute left-0 z-30 mt-1 w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                <ul class="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto py-1">${rows}</ul>
                <div class="border-t border-zinc-100 py-1 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <button type="button" role="menuitem" class="account-add flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
                    <span class="text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('plus', { size: 12 })}</span>Add account
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" role="menuitem" class="account-signout flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30">
                    <span>${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 12 })}</span>Sign out
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.account-trigger').addEventListener('click', () => this._setOpen(!this._open));

    this.querySelectorAll('.account-row').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-account');
        const account = this._accounts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (!account) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('switch', { detail: account }));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    });

    const add = this.querySelector('.account-add');
    if (add) {
      add.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-account'));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    }

    const signOut = this.querySelector('.account-signout');
    if (signOut) {
      signOut.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sign-out'));
        this._setOpen(false);
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('account-switcher')) {
  customElements.define('account-switcher', AccountSwitcherElement);
}
export default AccountSwitcherElement;

===== FILE: vanilla\AddonPicker.js =====

/**
 * AddonPicker - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <addon-picker options='[{"id":"doc","label":"Document signing","price:"+$600 / year"}]' selected-ids='["doc"]'></addon-picker>
 * Attributes: title, options (JSON [{id,label,price?,disabled?,contactInstead?}]), selected-ids (JSON string[]), total-label, total-text
 * Property: options, selectedIds
 * Events: change (detail.selectedIds)
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CHECK_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="12" height="12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4.5 10.5 3.5 3.5 7.5-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';

export class AddonPickerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['options', 'selected-ids', 'title', 'total-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._options = [];
    this._selectedIds = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._options.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('options');
      if (raw) { try { this._options = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._options = []; } }
    }
    if (!this._selectedIds.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('selected-ids');
      if (raw) { try { this._selectedIds = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._selectedIds = []; } }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const row = event.target.closest('[data-addon-row]');
        if (!row) return;
        const id = row.getAttribute('data-addon-row');
        const option = this._options.find((o) => String(o.id) === id);
        if (!option || option.disabled) return;
        this._selectedIds = this._selectedIds.includes(id)
          ? this._selectedIds.filter((x) => x !== id)
          : [...this._selectedIds, id];
        this.render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { selectedIds: [...this._selectedIds] } }));
      });
    }
  }

  get options() { return this._options; }
  set options(v) {
    this._options = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get selectedIds() { return this._selectedIds; }
  set selectedIds(v) {
    this._selectedIds = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'options' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._options = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    if (name === 'selected-ids' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._selectedIds = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    if (this._options.length) this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Add-ons');
    const totalLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total-label') || 'Estimated total');
    const totalText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total-text') || '');

    const rows = this._options.map((option) => {
      const checked = this._selectedIds.includes(String(option.id));
      return `
      <div data-addon-row="${escapeAttribute(String(option.id))}" role="checkbox" aria-checked="${checked}" class="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-md border px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors ${checked ? 'border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50' : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300'} ${option.disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : ''}">
        <span class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span data-addon-check class="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors ${checked ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-transparent'}">${CHECK_SVG}</span>
          <span class="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(option.label)}</span>
        </span>
        ${option.contactInstead ? `<a href="#" data-addon-contact class="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline">Let's talk</a>` : `<span data-addon-price class="text-xs text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(option.price || '')}</span>`}
      </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-addon-picker class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4">
  <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">${title}</p>
  <div class="mt-3 space-y-2">${rows}
  </div>
  ${totalText ? `<div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-sm">
    <span class="text-zinc-600">${totalLabel}</span>
    <span data-addon-total class="font-semibold text-zinc-900">${totalText}</span>
  </div>` : ''}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('addon-picker')) {
  customElements.define('addon-picker', AddonPickerElement);
}

export default AddonPickerElement;

/**
 * AgentBuilderCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <agent-builder-card agent-name="Support triage" run-text="Run agent"></agent-builder-card>
 * Property: nodes ([{id, label, type: trigger|tool|llm|output, status?: idle|active|done|error}])
 * Attributes: title, agent-name, run-text, running
 * Events: run, edit
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AgentBuilderCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'agent-name', 'run-text', 'running'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._nodes = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-builder-run]')) {
          if ((this.getAttribute('running') || '') === 'true') return;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-builder-edit]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('edit'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get nodes() { return this._nodes; }
  set nodes(v) {
    this._nodes = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((n) => ({ ...n })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before nodes are captured.
    if (this._nodes.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Agent workflow');
    const agentName = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('agent-name') || 'Untitled agent');
    const runText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('run-text') || 'Run agent');
    const running = this.getAttribute('running') === 'true';
    const NODE_STYLE = {
      trigger: { icon: '⚡', chip: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300' },
      tool: { icon: '🔧', chip: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300' },
      llm: { icon: '🧠', chip: 'bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300' },
      output: { icon: '📤', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300' },

      active: 'bg-indigo-500 animate-pulse',
      done: 'bg-emerald-500',
      error: 'bg-red-500',
    };

    const rows = this._nodes.map((node, i) => {
      const style = NODE_STYLE[node.type] || NODE_STYLE.tool;
      const last = i === this._nodes.length - 1;
      return `
        <div data-builder-node="${escapeAttribute(node.id)}" class="relative flex items-center gap-3 pb-3">

          </span>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-agent-builder class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">

    <div class="min-w-0">

'cursor-wait bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'}">${running ? 'Running…' : runText}</button>

  }
