===== FILE: vanilla\AgentEnvVarEditor.js =====

/**
 * AgentEnvVarEditor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Agent environment variable editor: key/value rows with secret masking +
 * reveal toggle, per-row delete and an add-row input.
 *
 * Usage: <agent-env-var-editor title="Environment variables"></agent-env-var-editor>
 * Property: vars ([{key, value, secret?}])
 * Attributes: title, description
 * Events: change (detail {vars})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AgentEnvVarEditorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._vars = [];
    this._revealed = {};
    this._newKey = '';
    this._newValue = '';
    this._newSecret = false;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const revealBtn = event.target.closest('[data-env-reveal]');
        if (revealBtn) {
          const row = revealBtn.closest('[data-env-row]');
          const key = row?.getAttribute('data-env-row');
          if (key) {
            this._revealed[key] = !this._revealed[key];
            this.render();
          }
          return;
        }
        const deleteBtn = event.target.closest('[data-env-delete]');
        if (deleteBtn) {
          const row = deleteBtn.closest('[data-env-row]');
          const key = row?.getAttribute('data-env-row');
          const vars = this._vars.filter((v) => v.key !== key);
          this._vars = vars;
          delete this._revealed[key];
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { vars: vars.map((v) => ({ ...v })) } }));
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-env-add-btn]')) {
          this._addFromInputs();
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
        if (target.hasAttribute('data-env-new-key')) {
          this._newKey = target.value;
          const btn = this.querySelector('[data-env-add-btn]');
          if (btn) btn.disabled = !this._newKey.trim();
          return;
        }
        if (target.hasAttribute('data-env-new-value')) {
          this._newValue = target.value;
          return;
        }
        if (target.hasAttribute('data-env-new-secret')) {
          this._newSecret = target.checked || target.getAttribute('checked') === 'true';
          return;
        }
        const valueInput = target.closest('[data-env-value]');
        if (valueInput) {
          const row = valueInput.closest('[data-env-row]');
          const key = row?.getAttribute('data-env-row');
          const v = this._vars.find((it) => it.key === key);
          if (v) v.value = target.value;
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (target instanceof HTMLInputElement && target.hasAttribute('data-env-new-secret')) {
          this._newSecret = target.checked;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  _addFromInputs() {
    const key = this._newKey.trim();
    if (!key) return;
    if (this._vars.find((v) => v.key === key)) return;
    this._vars = [...this._vars, { key, value: this._newValue, secret: this._newSecret }];
    this._newKey = '';
    this._newValue = '';
    this._newSecret = false;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { vars: this._vars.map((v) => ({ ...v })) } }));
    this.render();
  }

  get vars() { return this._vars; }
  set vars(v) {
    this._vars = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((it) => ({ ...it })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before vars are captured.
    if (this._vars.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Environment variables');
    const description = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('description') || 'Injected into every agent run. Secret values are masked.');

    const rows = this._vars.map((row) => {
      const revealedRow = !!this._revealed[row.key];
      const type = row.secret && !revealedRow ? 'password' : 'text';
      const revealBtn = row.secret
        ? `<button type="button" data-env-reveal aria-pressed="${revealedRow}" title="${revealedRow ? 'Hide value' : 'Reveal value'}" class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">${revealedRow ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}</button>`
        : '';
      return `
        <div data-env-row="${escapeAttribute(row.key)}" class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input data-env-key value="${escapeAttribute(row.key)}" readonly aria-label="Variable name" class="w-44 shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200" />
          <input data-env-value type="${type}" value="${escapeAttribute(row.value)}" aria-label="Variable value" class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200" />
          ${revealBtn}
          <button type="button" data-env-delete title="Delete variable" class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-transparent px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-400 hover:border-rose-200 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:border-rose-900 dark:hover:text-rose-400">Delete</button>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    const empty = this._vars.length === 0
      ? '<p data-env-empty class="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500">No environment variables yet</p>'
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-env-editor class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <p data-env-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
  <p data-env-description class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${description}</p>
  <div data-env-rows class="mt-3 space-y-2">${rows}${empty}</div>
  <div data-env-add class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <input data-env-new-key value="${escapeAttribute(this._newKey)}" placeholder="KEY_NAME" aria-label="New variable name" class="w-44 shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200" />
    <input data-env-new-value value="${escapeAttribute(this._newValue)}" placeholder="value" aria-label="New variable value" class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200" />
    <label data-env-new-secret class="flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
      <input type="checkbox" data-env-new-secret ${this._newSecret ? 'checked' : ''} class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300" /> secret
    </label>
    <button type="button" data-env-add-btn ${this._newKey.trim() ? '' : 'disabled'} class="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">Add</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('agent-env-var-editor')) {
  customElements.define('agent-env-var-editor', AgentEnvVarEditorElement);
}

 * Agent run failure recovery state: error headline with an optional run id
 * chip, Retry / Start-over actions and a support line.
 *
 * Usage: <agent-error-recovery title="Oops!" description="..." run-id="run_9f2"></agent-error-recovery>
 * Attributes: title, description, run-id, retry-label, reset-label, support-text

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AgentErrorRecoveryElement extends HTMLElement {

    return ['title', 'description', 'run-id', 'retry-label', 'reset-label', 'support-text'];

===== FILE: vanilla\AgentGuardrailViolationCard.js =====

/**
 * AgentGuardrailViolationCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Single guardrail-violation detail card: severity badge, trigger input
 * summary with highlighted match, policy ref and Proceed/Block actions.
 *
 * Usage: <agent-guardrail-violation-card rule="PII disclosure"></agent-guardrail-violation-card>
 * Attributes: rule, severity (low|medium|high), run-id, time, input, match, policy-ref,
 *             proceed-label, block-label
 * Events: proceed, block
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SEVERITY_BADGE = {
  low: {
    badge: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400',
    label: 'Low severity',
  },
  medium: {
    badge: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-500/10 dark:text-orange-400',
    label: 'Medium severity',
  },
  high: {
    badge: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400',
    label: 'High severity',
  },
};

export class AgentGuardrailViolationCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['rule', 'severity', 'run-id', 'time', 'input', 'match', 'policy-ref', 'proceed-label', 'block-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._resolved = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const blockBtn = event.target.closest('[data-violation-block]');
        if (blockBtn) {
          this._resolved = 'blocked';
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('block'));
          return;
        }
        const proceedBtn = event.target.closest('[data-violation-proceed]');
        if (proceedBtn) {
          this._resolved = 'proceeded';
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('proceed'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  _renderInput() {
    const input = this.getAttribute('input') || '';
    if (!input) return '';
    const match = this.getAttribute('match') || '';
    const escaped = escapeAttribute(input);
    if (match && input.includes(match)) {
      const idx = input.indexOf(match);
      const head = escapeAttribute(input.slice(0, idx));
      const mark = escapeAttribute(match);
      const tail = escapeAttribute(input.slice(idx + match.length));
      return `${head}<mark data-violation-match class="rounded bg-rose-100 px-0.5 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-500/20 dark:text-rose-300">${mark}</mark>${tail}`;
    }
    return escaped;
  }

  render() {
    const rule = this.getAttribute('rule') || '';
    if (!rule && this.innerHTML === '') {
      // still render an empty shell so SSR/preview never collapses
    }
    const severity = ['low', 'medium', 'high'].includes(this.getAttribute('severity'))
      ? this.getAttribute('severity')
      : 'medium';
    const sev = SEVERITY_BADGE[severity];
    const runId = this.getAttribute('run-id') || '';
    const time = this.getAttribute('time') || '';
    const policyRef = this.getAttribute('policy-ref') || '';
    const proceedLabel = this.getAttribute('proceed-label') || 'Proceed anyway';
    const blockLabel = this.getAttribute('block-label') || 'Block run';
    const inputBlock = this.getAttribute('input')
      ? `<div data-violation-input class="mt-2.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-300">${this._renderInput()}</div>`
      : '';
    const resolvedText = this._resolved === 'blocked'
      ? 'Run blocked by reviewer.'
      : this._resolved === 'proceeded'
        ? 'Marked reviewed — proceeding anyway.'
        : '';
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-guardrail-violation role="alert" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span data-violation-rule class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(rule)}</span>
          <span data-violation-severity class="rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${sev.badge}">${sev.label}</span>
          ${time ? `<span data-violation-time class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(time)}</span>` : ''}
        </div>
        ${runId ? `<p class="mt-1.5"><code data-violation-run class="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(runId)}</code></p>` : ''}
        ${inputBlock}
        ${policyRef ? `<p data-violation-policy class="mt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Policy: <code class="font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(policyRef)}</code></p>` : ''}
        ${this._resolved
          ? `<p data-violation-resolved class="mt-3 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${resolvedText}</p>`
          : `<div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
              <button type="button" data-violation-block class="rounded-md bg-rose-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-rose-500">${escapeAttribute(blockLabel)}</button>
              <button type="button" data-violation-proceed class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(proceedLabel)}</button>
            </div>`}
      </div>`;
  }
}

export default AgentGuardrailViolationCardElement;

if (!customElements.get('agent-guardrail-violation-card')) {
  customElements.define('agent-guardrail-violation-card', AgentGuardrailViolationCardElement);
}

 *

    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

  healthy: 'bg-emerald-500',
  degraded: 'bg-amber-500',
  down: 'bg-rose-500',

export class AgentModelFallbackListElement extends HTMLElement {

    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const upBtn = event.target.closest('[data-fallback-up]');
        const downBtn = event.target.closest('[data-fallback-down]');
        if (!upBtn && !downBtn) return;
        const row = (upBtn || downBtn).closest('[data-fallback-row]');
        if (!row) return;
        const id = row.getAttribute('data-fallback-row');
        const dir = upBtn ? -1 : 1;
        const idx = this._ids.indexOf(id);
        const next = idx + dir;
        if (idx < 0 || next < 0 || next >= this._ids.length) return;
        const list = [...this._ids];
        list.splice(idx, 1);
        list.splice(next, 0, id);
        this._ids = list;
        this._moveFlash = id;
        this.render();
        if (this._flashTimer) clearTimeout(this._flashTimer);
        this._flashTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          this._moveFlash = null;
          this.render();
        }, 1200);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reorder', { detail: { ids: [...this._ids] } }));
      });
    }
  }

  _ordered() {
    return this._ids
      .map((id) => this._entries.find((e) => e.id === id))
      .filter((e) => Boolean(e));
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Model fallback chain';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') ||
      'Requests try the primary model first, then walk down the chain when a fallback condition triggers.';
    const ordered = this._ordered();
    const primary = this.primaryId;
    const rows = ordered.map((entry, i) => {
      const isPrimary = entry.id === primary;
      const health = HEALTH_DOT[entry.health] ? entry.health : 'healthy';
      const caption = [
        entry.provider,
        entry.condition || 'fallback',
        entry.latency,
      ].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      return `<div data-fallback-row="${escapeAttribute(entry.id)}"
        class="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 ${isPrimary
          ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500/30 dark:bg-indigo-500/10'
          : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700'}">
          <span data-fallback-rank class="w-4 text-center font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${i + 1}</span>
          <span class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${HEALTH_DOT[health]}" title="${HEALTH_TEXT[health]}"></span>
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span data-fallback-model class="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(entry.model)}</span>
              ${isPrimary ? '<span data-fallback-primary class="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-white">Primary</span>' : ''}
              ${this._moveFlash === entry.id ? '<span data-fallback-moved class="text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">order updated</span>' : ''}
            </div>
            <p class="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(caption)}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
            <button type="button" data-fallback-up title="Promote" aria-label="Promote ${escapeAttribute(entry.model)}" ${i === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}
              class="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1.5 text-[10px] leading-4 text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-30 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">↑</button>
            <button type="button" data-fallback-down title="Demote" aria-label="Demote ${escapeAttribute(entry.model)}" ${i === ordered.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}
              class="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1.5 text-[10px] leading-4 text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-30 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">↓</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-fallback-list class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <p data-fallback-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
        <p data-fallback-description class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>
        <div data-fallback-rows class="mt-3 space-y-2">
          ${rows || '<p data-fallback-empty class="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500">No models in the fallback chain</p>'}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

export default AgentModelFallbackListElement;

if (!customElements.get('agent-model-fallback-list')) {
  customElements.define('agent-model-fallback-list', AgentModelFallbackListElement);

===== FILE: vanilla\AgentNotificationFeed.js =====

/**
 * AgentNotificationFeed - Vanilla Web Component
 * Agent run/training notification feed: status-dot rows with title +
 * highlighted status text, caption, relative time and unread markers.
 *
 * Usage: <agent-notification-feed title="Notifications"></agent-notification-feed>
 * Property: items ([{id, kind, title, statusText?, caption?, time, unread?}])
 * Attributes: title
 * Events: open (detail {item})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const KIND_DOT = {
  started: 'bg-sky-500',
  completed: 'bg-emerald-500',
  failed: 'bg-rose-500',
  info: 'bg-zinc-400',
};
const KIND_TEXT = {
  started: 'text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400',
  completed: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
  failed: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400',
  info: 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400',
};

export class AgentNotificationFeedElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
    this._read = {};
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const row = event.target.closest('[data-agent-feed-item]');
        if (!row) return;
        const id = row.getAttribute('data-agent-feed-item');
        const item = this._items.find((it) => it.id === id);
        if (!item) return;
        this._read[id] = true;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open', { detail: { item } }));
        this.render();
      });
    }
  }

  get items() { return this._items; }
  set items(v) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((it) => ({ ...it })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before items are captured.
    if (this._items.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Notifications');
    const isUnread = (item) => !!item.unread && !this._read[item.id];
    const unreadCount = this._items.filter(isUnread).length;

    const rows = this._items.map((item) => {
      const unread = isUnread(item);
      const dot = unread ? (KIND_DOT[item.kind] || KIND_DOT.info) : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600';
      const statusText = item.statusText
        ? `<span class="font-semibold ${KIND_TEXT[item.kind] || KIND_TEXT.info}"> ${escapeAttribute(item.statusText)}</span>`
        : '';
      const caption = item.caption
        ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.caption)}</span>`
        : '';
      return `
        <button type="button" data-agent-feed-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" data-unread="${unread ? 'true' : 'false'}" class="flex w-full items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50">
          <span aria-hidden="true" class="mt-1.5 h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${dot}"></span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}${statusText}</span>
            ${caption}
          </span>
          <span class="shrink-0 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(item.time)}</span>
        </button>`;
    }).join('');

    const countBadge = unreadCount > 0
      ? `<span data-agent-feed-count class="rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">${unreadCount} new</span>`
      : '';
    const empty = this._items.length === 0
      ? '<p data-agent-feed-empty class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No notifications yet</p>'
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-agent-feed class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <p data-agent-feed-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
    ${countBadge}
  </div>
  <div data-agent-feed-list class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${rows}${empty}</div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('agent-notification-feed')) {
  customElements.define('agent-notification-feed', AgentNotificationFeedElement);

===== FILE: vanilla\AgentRunLog.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const statusIcon = (status) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'loader' : status === 'done' ? 'check-circle' : status === 'error' ? 'circle-x' : 'clock';

const statusClass = (status) =>
  status === 'running'
    ? 'animate-spin text-indigo-500'
    : status === 'done'
      ? 'text-emerald-500'
      : status === 'error'
        ? 'text-red-500'
        : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500';

const formatDuration = (ms) => (typeof ms !== 'number' ? '' : ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);

export class AgentRunLogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['steps', 'title', 'auto-expand-running'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
    this._expanded = new Set();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get steps() {
    if (this._steps.length) return this._steps;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('steps') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    const auto = this.getAttribute('auto-expand-running') !== 'false';
    this._expanded = new Set(
      auto ? this._steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'running' && s.detail).map((s) => s.id) : []
    );
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const steps = this.steps;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Execution log';
    const doneCount = steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'done').length;

    this._applyHostClass('rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900');

    const items = steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
        const isOpen = this._expanded.has(step.id);
        return `
          <li class="relative pl-6">
            ${isLast ? '' : '<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[6px] top-5 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>'}
            <span class="absolute left-0 top-1 ${statusClass(step.status)}">${uiIcon(statusIcon(step.status), { size: 14 })}</span>
            <div class="pb-3">
              <button type="button" data-step="${escapeAttribute(step.id)}" ${step.detail ? `aria-expanded="${isOpen}"` : ''} class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left ${step.detail ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}">
                <span class="text-xs ${step.status === 'pending' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</span>
                ${step.durationMs !== undefined ? `<span class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${formatDuration(step.durationMs)}</span>` : ''}
                ${step.detail ? `<span class="ml-auto text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon(isOpen ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}
              </button>
              ${step.detail && isOpen ? `<pre class="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(step.detail)}</pre>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">
        <span class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon('terminal', { size: 14 })}</span>
        <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</span>
        <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${doneCount}/${steps.length}</span>
      </div>
      <ol class="px-4 py-3">${items}</ol>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-step');
        const step = steps.find((s) => s.id === id);
        if (!step?.detail) return;
        this._expanded.has(id) ? this._expanded.delete(id) : this._expanded.add(id);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id, expanded: this._expanded.has(id) } }));
        this.render();
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('agent-run-log')) {
  customElements.define('agent-run-log', AgentRunLogElement);
}

===== FILE: vanilla\AgentScheduleEditor.js =====

/**
 * AgentScheduleEditor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Agent run schedule editor: frequency pills + time input + derived cron
 * expression with next-run preview and a save action.
 *
 * Usage: <agent-schedule-editor title="Run schedule"></agent-schedule-editor>
 * Properties: frequencies ([{id,label,expression}]), activeId, time, nextRun, timezone
 * Attributes: title, description
 * Events: save (detail {frequency, time})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AgentScheduleEditorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._frequencies = [];
    this._activeId = '';
    this._time = '09:00';
    this._nextRun = '';
    this._timezone = '';
    this._saved = false;
    this._savedTimer = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get frequencies() {
    return this._frequencies;
  }

  set frequencies(value) {
    this._frequencies = Array.isArray(value) ? value.map((f) => ({ ...f })) : [];
    if (!this._activeId && this._frequencies.length > 0) {
      this._activeId = this._frequencies[0].id;
    }
    this.render();
  }

  get activeId() {
    return this._activeId;
  }

  set activeId(value) {
    this._activeId = String(value || '');
    this.render();
  }

  get time() {
    return this._time;
  }

  set time(value) {
    this._time = String(value ?? '09:00');
    this.render();
  }

  get nextRun() {
    return this._nextRun;
  }

  set nextRun(value) {
    this._nextRun = String(value ?? '');
    this.render();
  }

  get timezone() {
    return this._timezone;
  }

  set timezone(value) {
    this._timezone = String(value ?? '');
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'title' || name === 'description') this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const freqBtn = event.target.closest('[data-schedule-frequency]');
        if (freqBtn) {
          this._activeId = freqBtn.getAttribute('data-schedule-frequency') || '';
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        const saveBtn = event.target.closest('[data-schedule-save]');
        if (saveBtn) {
          const freq = this._frequencies.find((f) => f.id === this._activeId) || this._frequencies[0];
          if (freq) {
            this._saved = true;
            this.render();
            if (this._savedTimer) clearTimeout(this._savedTimer);
            this._savedTimer = setTimeout(() => {
              this._saved = false;
              this.render();
            }, 1600);
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('save', {
              detail: { frequency: { ...freq }, time: this._time },
            }));
          }
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        if (event.target && event.target.matches('[data-schedule-time]')) {
          this._time = event.target.value;
          // keep label in sync without full re-render (input holds focus)
          const next = this.querySelector('[data-schedule-cron]');
          if (next) next.textContent = this._cronFor(this._activeId);
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        if (event.target && event.target.matches('[data-schedule-time]')) {
          this._time = event.target.value;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  _cronFor(id) {
    const freq = this._frequencies.find((f) => f.id === id) || this._frequencies[0];
    return freq ? freq.expression : '—';
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Run schedule';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') ||
      'Configure when the agent runs automatically. The cron expression is derived from your selection.';
    const freqPills = this._frequencies.map((f) => {
      const active = f.id === this._activeId;
      return `<button type="button" data-schedule-frequency="${escapeAttribute(f.id)}" aria-pressed="${active}"
        class="${active
          ? 'rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500'
          : 'rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(f.label)}</button>`;
    }).join('');
    const tz = this._timezone
      ? `<span data-schedule-timezone class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(this._timezone)}</span>`
      : '';
    const nextRun = this._nextRun || '—';
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-schedule-editor class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <p data-schedule-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
        <p data-schedule-description class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>
        <div data-schedule-frequencies class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">${freqPills}</div>
        <div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <label data-schedule-time-wrap class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Run at</span>
            <input data-schedule-time type="time" value="${escapeAttribute(this._time)}"
              class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200" />
          </label>
          ${tz}
        </div>
        <div class="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Cron</span>
          <code data-schedule-cron class="ml-2 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(this._cronFor(this._activeId))}</code>
          <span class="mx-2 text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">|</span>
          <span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Next run</span>
          <span data-schedule-next class="ml-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(nextRun)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
          ${this._saved ? '<span data-schedule-saved class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">Schedule saved</span>' : ''}
          <button type="button" data-schedule-save
            class="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500">Save schedule</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

export default AgentScheduleEditorElement;

if (!customElements.get('agent-schedule-editor')) {
  customElements.define('agent-schedule-editor', AgentScheduleEditorElement);

/**
 * AgentSessionTimeline - Agent browser-session timeline: summary header with

 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_STEPS = () => [

  { id: 's2', kind: 'reason', label: 'Plan fetch strategy', at: '0:03' },
  { id: 's3', kind: 'tool', label: 'HTTP probe', at: '0:03' },
  { id: 's4', kind: 'tool', label: 'Fetch API', at: '0:14' },
  { id: 's5', kind: 'reason', label: 'Need to actually fetch the pages', at: '0:14' },
  { id: 's6', kind: 'tool', label: 'Search HTML', at: '0:26' },
  { id: 's7', kind: 'tool', label: 'Run code', at: '0:31' },
];

const DEFAULT_REQUESTS = () => [
  { id: 'q1', url: 'techcrunch.com', method: 'HTTP probe', status: 'HTTP 200', duration: '0:03', ok: true },
  { id: 'q2', url: 'techcrunch.com/2026/08/02/sam-altman-an…', method: 'Fetch API', status: 'HTTP 200', duration: '0:50', ok: true },
  { id: 'q3', url: 'techcrunch.com/2026/08/01/inside-one-lond…', method: 'Fetch API', status: 'HTTP 200', duration: '0:50', ok: true },
  { id: 'q4', url: 'techcrunch.com/2026/08/02/the-global-me…', method: 'Fetch API', status: 'HTTP 429', duration: '0:50', ok: false },
];

class AgentSessionTimelineElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['steps', 'requests', 'title', 'status', 'duration', 'steps-count'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._steps = [];
    this._requests = [];
    this._title = 'Go to techcrunch.com and summarize the top 5 trending tech articles';
    this._status = 'Complete';
    this._duration = '1m 11s';
    this._stepsCount = 11;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._steps.length) this._steps = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('steps'), DEFAULT_STEPS());
    if (!this._requests.length) this._requests = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('requests'), DEFAULT_REQUESTS());
    this._title = this.getAttribute('title') || this._title;
    this._status = this.getAttribute('status') || this._status;
    this._duration = this.getAttribute('duration') || this._duration;
    const sc = this.getAttribute('steps-count');
    if (sc) this._stepsCount = Number(sc) || this._stepsCount;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'steps' && !this._steps.length) this._steps = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    if (name === 'requests' && !this._requests.length) this._requests = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'status') this._status = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'duration') this._duration = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'steps-count') this._stepsCount = Number(newValue) || 0;
    this._render();
  }

  get steps() { return this._steps; }
  set steps(value) { this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  get requests() { return this._requests; }
  set requests(value) { this._requests = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const stepEl = event.target.closest('[data-agent-step]');
    if (stepEl) {
      const step = this._steps.find((s) => s.id === stepEl.getAttribute('data-agent-step'));
      if (step) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('step-click', { detail: { step }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const stripHtml = this._steps
      .slice(0, 24)
      .map(
        (s) =>
          `<span title="${escapeAttribute(s.kind)} · ${escapeAttribute(s.label)}" class="flex-1 rounded-sm ${STRIP_COLORS[s.kind] || STRIP_COLORS.tool}"></span>`
      )
      .join('');

    const stepsHtml = this._steps
      .map(
        (step) => `
        <li>
          <button type="button" data-agent-step="${escapeAttribute(step.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
            <span data-agent-step-badge="${escapeAttribute(step.kind)}" class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold tracking-wide ${KIND_STYLES[step.kind] || KIND_STYLES.tool}">${escapeAttribute(step.kind)}</span>
            <span data-agent-step-label class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</span>
            <span data-agent-step-at class="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(step.at)}</span>
          </button>
        </li>`
      )
      .join('');

    const requestsHtml = this._requests
      .map(
        (req) => `
        <div data-agent-request="${escapeAttribute(req.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2">
          <span class="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-[9px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">⌾</span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span data-agent-request-url class="block truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(req.url)}</span>
            <span data-agent-request-status class="block truncate text-[10px] ${(req.ok ?? true) ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-red-500 dark:text-red-400'}">${escapeAttribute(req.status)}${req.method ? ' · ' + escapeAttribute(req.method) : ''}</span>
          </span>
          <span data-agent-request-duration class="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(req.duration)}</span>
        </div>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-agent-session-timeline class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-agent-session-header class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-agent-session-title class="mb-2 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span data-agent-session-status class="rounded-md bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300">${escapeAttribute(this._status)}</span>
            <span data-agent-session-duration class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">⏱ ${escapeAttribute(this._duration)}</span>
            <span data-agent-session-steps-count class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">≡ ${this._stepsCount} steps</span>
          </div>
          <div data-agent-session-strip class="mt-3 flex h-2 items-stretch gap-0.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full">${stripHtml}</div>
        </div>
        <div data-agent-session-body class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2">
          <ol data-agent-steps class="divide-y divide-zinc-50 border-b border-zinc-100 md:border-b-0 md:border-r dark:divide-zinc-800/60 dark:border-zinc-800">${stepsHtml}</ol>
          <div data-agent-requests class="divide-y divide-zinc-50 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">${requestsHtml}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STATUS_META = {
  pending: { icon: 'clock', cls: 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800' },
  running: { icon: 'loader', cls: 'text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60', pulse: true },
  done: { icon: 'check-circle', cls: 'text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60' },
  error: { icon: 'circle-x', cls: 'text-rose-500 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60' },
};

export class AgentStepTimelineElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(val) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    if (this._steps.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const items = this._steps
      .map((step, i) => {
        const meta = STATUS_META[step.status] || STATUS_META.pending;
        const isLast = i === this._steps.length - 1;
        return `
          <li class="relative flex gap-3">
            ${
              !isLast
                ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-[-16px] w-px ${
                    step.status === 'done' ? 'bg-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-800' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700'
                  }"></span>`
                : ''
            }
            <span class="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full shrink-0 ${meta.cls}">
              ${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 15, className: meta.pulse ? 'animate-spin' : '' })}
            </span>
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-1">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="text-sm font-medium ${
                  meta === STATUS_META.pending ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'
                }">${escapeAttribute(step.title)}</span>
                ${step.duration ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(step.duration)}</span>` : ''}
              </div>
              ${step.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(step.description)}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<ol class="relative space-y-4">${items}</ol>`;
  }
}

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

const STATUS_ICON = {
  pending: { icon: 'square', cls: 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600' },
  active: { icon: 'loader', cls: 'text-indigo-500 animate-spin' },
  done: { icon: 'check-circle', cls: 'text-emerald-500' },
};

export class AgentTaskChecklistElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(val) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Tasks';
    const doneCount = this._items.filter((i) => i.status === 'done').length;

    const itemsHtml = this._items
      .map((item) => {
        const meta = STATUS_ICON[item.status] || STATUS_ICON.pending;
        const isDone = item.status === 'done';
        return `
          <li>
            <div
              role="button"
              tabindex="0"
              data-task-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
              class="task-item flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 ${
                isDone ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
              }"
            >
              ${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 15, className: `shrink-0 ${meta.cls}` })}
              <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 truncate ${isDone ? 'line-through' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
            </div>
          </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('block rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden');
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
        ${uiIcon('layers', { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-400' })}
        ${escapeAttribute(title)}
        <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">${doneCount}/${this._items.length}</span>
      </div>
      <ul class="p-1.5 space-y-0.5">${itemsHtml}</ul>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.task-item').forEach((row) => {
      const id = row.getAttribute('data-task-id');
      const item = this._items.find((t) => String(t.id) === String(id));
      if (!item) return;
      const toggle = () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id: item.id } }));
      row.addEventListener('click', toggle);
      row.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggle();
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

/**
 * AgentTaskProgress - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <agent-task-progress title="..." steps='[{"label":"...","state":"done"}]'></agent-task-progress>
 * Attributes: title, context-label, context-text, hint, refine-label, next-label, feedback-label
 * Properties: steps (Array<{label, state: done|active|pending, substeps?}>)
 * Events: refine, next
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AgentTaskProgressElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'context-label', 'context-text', 'hint', 'refine-label', 'next-label', 'feedback-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(list) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._steps.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('steps');
      if (raw) {
        try {
          this._steps = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch {
          this._steps = [];
        }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-task-refine]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('refine'));
        if (event.target.closest('[data-task-next]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('next'));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const contextLabel = this.getAttribute('context-label') || '';
    const contextText = this.getAttribute('context-text') || '';
    const hint = this.getAttribute('hint') || 'This may take a few minutes, you can come back later.';
    const refineLabel = this.getAttribute('refine-label') || 'Refine';
    const nextLabel = this.getAttribute('next-label') || 'Next';
    const feedbackLabel = this.getAttribute('feedback-label') || 'Send feedback';
    const steps = Array.isArray(this._steps) ? this._steps : [];

    const iconFor = (state) => {
      if (state === 'done') return '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z" /></svg>';
      if (state === 'active') return '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 animate-spin text-indigo-500"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" /></svg>';
      return '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" /></svg>';
    };

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-agent-task-progress class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      ${title ? `<p class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>` : ''}
      ${
        contextText
          ? `<div class="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 dark:bg-zinc-800">
              ${contextLabel ? `<p class="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(contextLabel)}</p>` : ''}
              <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(contextText)}</p>
            </div>`
          : ''
      }
      ${hint ? `<p class="mt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(hint)}</p>` : ''}
      <ul class="mt-3 space-y-2">
        ${steps
          .map(
            (step, index) => `<li data-task-step="${index}" data-task-state="${escapeAttribute(step.state)}" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-700">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${iconFor(step.state)}${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</div>
              ${
                step.state === 'active' && Array.isArray(step.substeps) && step.substeps.length
                  ? `<ul data-task-substeps class="mt-2 space-y-1 border-l-2 border-zinc-200 pl-3 dark:border-zinc-700">
                      ${step.substeps.map((sub) => `<li class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(sub)}</li>`).join('')}
                    </ul>`
                  : ''
              }
            </li>`,
          )
          .join('')}
      </ul>
      <div class="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <a href="#" data-task-feedback class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 underline underline-offset-2 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(feedbackLabel)}</a>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button type="button" data-task-refine class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(refineLabel)}</button>
          <button type="button" data-task-next class="rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">${escapeAttribute(nextLabel)}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * AgentWorkspaceSettings - Vanilla Web Component
 * Agent workspace settings page body: optional section tabs, titled groups
 * with description and description-led toggle rows.
 *
 * Usage: <agent-workspace-settings title="Settings"></agent-workspace-settings>
 * Property: sections ([{id, title, description?, toggles: [{id, label, description?, enabled}]}])
 *           tabs ([{id, label}])
 * Attributes: title, subtitle
 * Events: toggle (detail {toggle, enabled})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AgentWorkspaceSettingsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'subtitle'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._sections = [];
    this._tabs = [];
    this._enabled = {};
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const btn = event.target.closest('[data-agent-setting-toggle]');
        if (!btn) return;
        const row = btn.closest('[data-agent-setting-row]');
        const id = row?.getAttribute('data-agent-setting-row');
        const toggle = this._sections.flatMap((s) => s.toggles).find((t) => t.id === id);
        if (!toggle) return;
        const next = !this._enabled[toggle.id];
        this._enabled[toggle.id] = next;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { toggle, enabled: next } }));
        this.render();
      });
    }
  }

  get sections() { return this._sections; }
  set sections(v) {
    this._sections = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((s) => ({ ...s, toggles: (s.toggles || []).map((t) => ({ ...t })) })) : [];
    this._syncEnabled();
    this.render();
  }

  get tabs() { return this._tabs; }
  set tabs(v) {
    this._tabs = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((t) => ({ ...t })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _syncEnabled() {
    const seen = {};
    for (const s of this._sections) {
      for (const t of s.toggles) {
        seen[t.id] = true;
        if (!(t.id in this._enabled)) this._enabled[t.id] = !!t.enabled;
      }
    }
    for (const id of Object.keys(this._enabled)) {
      if (!seen[id]) delete this._enabled[id];
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before sections are captured.
    if (this._sections.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Settings');
    const subtitle = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('subtitle') || 'Manage and update your agent workspace.');

    const tabs = this._tabs.map((tab, i) => `
      <button type="button" data-agent-settings-tab="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" aria-selected="${i === 0}" class="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors aria-selected:border-transparent aria-selected:bg-zinc-900 aria-selected:text-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:aria-selected:bg-zinc-50 dark:aria-selected:text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(tab.label)}</button>`
    ).join('');

    const sections = this._sections.map((section) => {
      const onCount = section.toggles.filter((t) => this._enabled[t.id]).length;
      const rows = section.toggles.map((toggle) => {
        const on = !!this._enabled[toggle.id];
        const desc = toggle.description
          ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(toggle.description)}</p>`
          : '';
        return `
          <div data-agent-setting-row="${escapeAttribute(toggle.id)}" class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div class="min-w-0">
              <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(toggle.label)}</p>
              ${desc}
            </div>
            <button type="button" data-agent-setting-toggle role="switch" aria-checked="${on}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(toggle.label)}" class="relative h-5 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors ${on ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600'}">
              <span class="absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all ${on ? 'left-4' : 'left-0.5'}"></span>
            </button>
          </div>`;
      }).join('');
      const desc = section.description
        ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(section.description)}</p>`
        : '';
      return `
        <section data-agent-settings-section="${escapeAttribute(section.id)}">
          <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between">
            <p class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(section.title)}</p>
            <span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${onCount}/${section.toggles.length} on</span>
          </div>
          ${desc}
          <div class="mt-3 space-y-3">${rows}</div>
        </section>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-agent-settings class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <p data-agent-settings-title class="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
  <p data-agent-settings-subtitle class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${subtitle}</p>
  ${this._tabs.length > 0 ? `<div data-agent-settings-tabs class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">${tabs}</div>` : ''}
  <div data-agent-settings-sections class="mt-5 space-y-6">${sections}</div>
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * AiNoteAnswer - Voicenotes "Ask AI" answer card: a waveform question row,
 * the answer paragraph, an "Other sources" link list and a Copy pill.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class AiNoteAnswerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['question', 'answer', 'sources', 'waveform'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._sources = [];
    this._waveform = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._sources.length) {
      this._sources = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sources'), []);
    }
    if (!this._waveform.length) {
      this._waveform = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('waveform'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'sources' && !this._sources.length) {
      this._sources = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sources'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'waveform' && !this._waveform.length) {
      this._waveform = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('waveform'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get question() {
    return this.getAttribute('question') ?? 'What improvements should I prioritize for Homepage?';
  }
  set question(value) {
    this.setAttribute('question', value);
  }

  get answer() {
    return this.getAttribute('answer') ?? '';
  }
  set answer(value) {
    this.setAttribute('answer', value);
  }

  get sources() {
    return this._sources;
  }
  set sources(value) {
    this._sources = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  get waveform() {
    return this._waveform;
  }
  set waveform(value) {
    this._waveform = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-note-answer-play]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('play', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-note-answer-copy]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('copy', { detail: { answer: this.answer }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const sourceEl = event.target.closest('[data-note-answer-source]');
    if (sourceEl) {
      const source = this._sources.find((s) => String(s) === sourceEl.getAttribute('data-note-answer-source-text'));
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('source-click', { detail: { source: source ?? sourceEl.textContent }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const bars = this._waveform.length
      ? this._waveform
      : Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => 30 + Math.round(Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 1.7)) * 70));
    const wave = bars
      .map((h) => `<span class="w-[3px] shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600" style="height:${Math.max(15, Math.min(100, h))}%"></span>`)
      .join('');
    const sources = this._sources.length
      ? `<div data-note-answer-sources class="mt-4">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Other sources</span>
            <span class="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></span>
          </div>
          ${this._sources
            .map(
              (s) => `
            <button type="button" data-note-answer-source data-note-answer-source-text="${escapeAttribute(s)}" class="mt-2 flex w-full items-center gap-1.5 truncate text-left text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">
              <span aria-hidden="true" class="shrink-0">↗</span>
              <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(s)}</span>
            </button>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-note-answer-card class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-note-answer-question class="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <button type="button" data-note-answer-play aria-label="Play question audio" class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-[10px] text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">▶</button>
          <div data-note-answer-waveform class="flex h-6 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-[2px]" aria-hidden="true">${wave}</div>
        </div>
        <p data-note-answer-question-text class="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this.question)}</p>
        <p data-note-answer-text class="mt-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(this.answer)}</p>
        ${sources}
        <div class="mt-4">
          <button type="button" data-note-answer-copy class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            <span aria-hidden="true">⧉</span>
            Copy
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('ai-note-answer')) {
  customElements.define('ai-note-answer', AiNoteAnswerElement);
}

export default AiNoteAnswerElement;

/**
 * AiResearchPanel - Apollo "Research with AI" slide-over: stacked research
 * template cards with Try it CTAs and a Run custom AI prompt footer action.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class AiResearchPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'templates', 'run-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._templates = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._templates.length) {
      this._templates = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('templates'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'templates' && !this._templates.length) {
      this._templates = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('templates'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'Research with AI';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get runLabel() {
    return this.getAttribute('run-label') ?? 'Run custom AI prompt';
  }
  set runLabel(value) {
    this.setAttribute('run-label', value);
  }

  get templates() {
    return this._templates;
  }
  set templates(value) {
    this._templates = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const run = event.target.closest('[data-research-run]');
    if (run) {
      const card = run.closest('[data-research-card]');
      const template = this._templates.find((t) => String(t.id) === card?.getAttribute('data-research-card'));
      if (template) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run', { detail: { template }, bubbles: true }));
      }
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-ai-research-custom]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-custom', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-ai-research-close]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close', { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const templates = this._templates;
    const cards = templates.length
      ? templates
          .map(
            (t) => `
        <div data-research-card="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:border-zinc-600">
          <p data-research-title class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(t.title)}</p>
          <p data-research-desc class="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(t.description)}</p>
          <button type="button" data-research-run class="mt-2.5 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Try it</button>
        </div>`
          )
          .join('')
      : `<p data-ai-research-empty class="py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No research templates yet.</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <aside data-ai-research-panel class="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <header class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h4 data-ai-research-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)}</h4>
          <button type="button" data-ai-research-close aria-label="Close research panel" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">✕</button>
        </header>
        <div data-ai-research-list class="flex-1 space-y-2.5 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3">${cards}</div>
        <footer class="border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button type="button" data-ai-research-custom class="w-full rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(this.runLabel)}</button>
        </footer>
      </aside>`;
  }
}

/**
 * AiRewriteMenu - Intercom composer AI rewrite menu: a trigger button that
 * opens a popover of writing-assistant actions (Expand, Rephrase, tone
 * variants, Fix grammar, Translate) with optional feature badges.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class AiRewriteMenuElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['trigger-label', 'actions', 'open'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._actions = [];
    this._open = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._actions.length) {
      this._actions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('actions'), []);
    }
    if (this._open === false && this.getAttribute('open') === 'true') {
      this._open = true;
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'actions' && !this._actions.length) {
      this._actions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('actions'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'open') {
      this._open = newValue === 'true';
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get triggerLabel() {
    return this.getAttribute('trigger-label') ?? 'Rewrite';
  }
  set triggerLabel(value) {
    this.setAttribute('trigger-label', value);
  }

  get open() {
    return this._open;
  }
  set open(value) {
    this._open = Boolean(value);
    this._render();
  }

  get actions() {
    return this._actions;
  }
  set actions(value) {
    this._actions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-rewrite-trigger]')) {
      this._open = !this._open;
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { open: this._open }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const itemEl = event.target.closest('[data-rewrite-item]');
    if (!itemEl) return;
    const action = this._actions.find((a) => String(a.id) === itemEl.getAttribute('data-rewrite-item'));
    if (!action) return;
    this._open = false;
    this._render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { action }, bubbles: true }));
  }

  _render() {
    const menu = this._open && this._actions.length
      ? `<div data-rewrite-menu class="absolute bottom-full left-0 z-10 mb-2 w-60 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">${this._actions
          .map((a) => {
            const badge = a.badge
              ? `<span data-rewrite-item-badge class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300"><span aria-hidden="true">↑</span>${escapeAttribute(a.badge)}</span>`
              : '';
            return `
            <button type="button" data-rewrite-item="${escapeAttribute(a.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
              <span data-rewrite-item-label>${escapeAttribute(a.label)}</span>
              ${badge}
            </button>`;
          })
          .join('')}</div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-rewrite-menu-root class="relative inline-block">
        <button type="button" data-rewrite-trigger aria-expanded="${this._open}" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-indigo-500">✦</span>
          ${escapeAttribute(this.triggerLabel)}
          <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-400">▾</span>
        </button>
        ${menu}
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('ai-rewrite-menu')) {
  customElements.define('ai-rewrite-menu', AiRewriteMenuElement);
}

export default AiRewriteMenuElement;
