/**
 * AiSuggestionCard - Proactive AI suggestion card: sparkle avatar, message
 * paragraph, follow-up action chips and a dismiss close button (Mindtrip).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_MESSAGE =
  'Looking ahead to tomorrow in Tokyo. Want a quick rundown of the plan and a weather check?';
const DEFAULT_CHIPS = () => [
  'Weather for tomorrow',
  'Summarize tomorrow',
  'View Senso-ji details',
];

class AiSuggestionCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['message', 'chips'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._message = DEFAULT_MESSAGE;
    this._chips = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._message || this._message === DEFAULT_MESSAGE) {
      this._message = this.getAttribute('message') || DEFAULT_MESSAGE;
    }
    if (!this._chips.length) {
      this._chips = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('chips'), DEFAULT_CHIPS());
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'message' && newValue) {
      this._message = newValue;
    }
    if (name === 'chips' && !this._chips.length) {
      this._chips = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('chips'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get message() {
    return this._message;
  }
  set message(value) {
    this._message = String(value ?? '');
    this.setAttribute('message', this._message);
    this._render();
  }

  get chips() {
    return this._chips;
  }
  set chips(value) {
    this._chips = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const closeEl = event.target.closest('[data-ai-suggestion-close]');
    if (closeEl) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const chipEl = event.target.closest('[data-ai-suggestion-chip]');
    if (chipEl) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('chip-click', { detail: { chip: chipEl.textContent.trim() }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const chipsHtml = this._chips
      .map(
        (chip) => `
        <button type="button" data-ai-suggestion-chip class="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(chip)}</button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-ai-suggestion-card class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-sm text-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900">✦</span>
          <p data-ai-suggestion-message class="flex-1 text-sm font-medium leading-relaxed text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._message)}</p>
          <button type="button" data-ai-suggestion-close aria-label="Dismiss suggestion" class="-mr-1 -mt-1 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">✕</button>
        </div>
        ${this._chips.length ? `<div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">${chipsHtml}</div>` : ''}
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('ai-suggestion-card')) {
  customElements.define('ai-suggestion-card', AiSuggestionCardElement);
}

export default AiSuggestionCardElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\AiTemplatePicker.js =====

/**
 * AiTemplatePicker - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <ai-template-picker title="AI Research templates"></ai-template-picker>
 * Attributes: open, title, active-category, categories (JSON), templates (JSON)
 * Events: category-change (detail {id}), try (detail {template}), run-custom, close
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

export class AiTemplatePickerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'active-category', 'categories', 'templates'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._templates = [];
    this._categories = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._templates.length) this._templates = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('templates'), []);
    if (!this._categories.length) this._categories = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('categories'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-ai-templates-close]')) {
          this.setAttribute('open', 'false');
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
          return;
        }
        const catEl = event.target.closest('[data-ai-templates-category]');
        if (catEl) {
          const id = catEl.getAttribute('data-ai-templates-category');
          this.setAttribute('active-category', id);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('category-change', { detail: { id } }));
          return;
        }
        const tryEl = event.target.closest('[data-ai-template-try]');
        if (tryEl) {
          const card = tryEl.closest('[data-ai-template-card]');
          const tpl = this._templates.find((t) => t.id === card?.getAttribute('data-ai-template-card'));
          if (tpl) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('try', { detail: { template: tpl } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-ai-templates-custom]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-custom'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'templates' && !this._templates.length) {
      this._templates = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('templates'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'categories' && !this._categories.length) {
      this._categories = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('categories'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get templates() { return this._templates; }
  set templates(v) {
    this._templates = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((t) => ({ ...t })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get categories() { return this._categories; }
  set categories(v) {
    this._categories = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((c) => ({ ...c })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if ((this.getAttribute('open') || 'true') === 'false') {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'AI Research templates');
    const active = this.getAttribute('active-category') || this._categories[0]?.id || '';
    const visible = active ? this._templates.filter((t) => !t.category || t.category === active) : this._templates;

    const rail = this._categories.length > 0 ? `
      <div data-ai-templates-rail class="w-52 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto border-r border-zinc-200 p-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
        ${this._categories.map((cat) => `
        <button type="button" data-ai-templates-category="${escapeAttribute(cat.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-md px-2.5 py-2 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${cat.id === active ? 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60'}">
          <span class="min-w-0 truncate">${escapeAttribute(cat.label)}</span>
          <span class="ml-2 shrink-0 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${cat.id === active ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-900/60 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400'}">${cat.count}</span>
        </button>`).join('')}
      </div>` : '';

    const grid = visible.length === 0
      ? '<p data-ai-templates-empty class="px-2 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">No templates in this category yet.</p>'
      : `<div data-ai-templates-grid class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
        ${visible.map((tpl) => `
        <div data-ai-template-card="${escapeAttribute(tpl.id)}" class="flex flex-col rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-700">
          <p class="text-xs font-semibold leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(tpl.name)}</p>
          <p class="mt-1.5 flex-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tpl.description)}</p>
          <button type="button" data-ai-template-try class="mt-3 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Try it</button>
        </div>`).join('')}
      </div>`;

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-ai-template-picker role="dialog" aria-modal="true" class="w-full max-w-3xl overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</h3>
    <button type="button" data-ai-templates-close aria-label="Close" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="flex max-h-[26rem]">${rail}<div class="min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3">${grid}</div></div>
  <div class="flex items-center justify-end border-t border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <button type="button" data-ai-templates-custom class="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Run custom AI prompt</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('ai-template-picker')) {
  customElements.define('ai-template-picker', AiTemplatePickerElement);
}

export default AiTemplatePickerElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE = {
  info: {
    icon: 'info',
    iconClass: 'text-indigo-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-900/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300',
    actionClass: 'text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:hover:text-indigo-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-500 dark:hover:text-indigo-300',
    role: 'status',
  },
  success: {
    icon: 'check-circle',
    iconClass: 'text-emerald-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 dark:border-emerald-900/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300',
    actionClass: 'text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:hover:text-emerald-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500 dark:hover:text-emerald-300',
    role: 'status',
  },
  warning: {
    icon: 'alert-triangle',
    iconClass: 'text-amber-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-900/60 dark:bg-amber-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300',
    actionClass: 'text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 dark:hover:text-amber-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-500 dark:hover:text-amber-300',
    role: 'alert',
  },
  danger: {
    icon: 'circle-x',
    iconClass: 'text-rose-500',
    wrapClass: 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-900/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40',
    titleClass: 'text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200',
    bodyClass: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300',
    actionClass: 'text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 dark:hover:text-rose-200',
    dismissClass: 'text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-500 dark:hover:text-rose-300',
    role: 'alert',
  },
};

/**
 * AlertBanner - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <alert-banner tone="warning" title="…" description="…"></alert-banner>
 * Properties: (none; driven by attributes)
 * Attributes: tone, title, description, action-text, dismissible
 * Events: action, dismiss
 */
export class AlertBannerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tone', 'title', 'description', 'action-text', 'dismissible'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._title = null;
    this._description = null;
    this._actionText = null;
  }

  get title() {
    return this._title ?? this.getAttribute('title') ?? '';
  }

  set title(value) {
    this._title = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get description() {
    return this._description ?? this.getAttribute('description') ?? '';
  }

  set description(value) {
    this._description = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get actionText() {
    return this._actionText ?? this.getAttribute('action-text') ?? '';
  }

  set actionText(value) {
    this._actionText = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get tone() {
    const value = this.getAttribute('tone') || 'info';
    return TONE[value] ? value : 'info';
  }

  get dismissible() {
    return this.hasAttribute('dismissible');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const styles = TONE[this.tone];
    const title = this.title;
    const description = this.description;
    const actionText = this.actionText;

    const actions = [
      actionText
        ? `<button type="button" data-alert-action class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors hover:underline focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${styles.actionClass}">${escapeAttribute(actionText)}</button>`
        : '',
      this.dismissible
        ? `<button type="button" data-alert-dismiss aria-label="Dismiss" class="rounded p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${styles.dismissClass}">${uiIcon('x', { size: 13 })}</button>`
        : '',
    ].join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div role="${styles.role}" class="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-3 ${styles.wrapClass}">
      ${uiIcon(styles.icon, { size: 16, className: `mt-0.5 shrink-0 ${styles.iconClass}` })}
      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <p class="text-[13px] font-semibold ${styles.titleClass}">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
        ${description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-[11.5px] leading-relaxed ${styles.bodyClass}">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${actions ? `<div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5">${actions}</div>` : ''}
    </div>`;

    const actionButton = this.querySelector('[data-alert-action]');
    if (actionButton) {
      actionButton.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action')));
    }
    const dismissButton = this.querySelector('[data-alert-dismiss]');
    if (dismissButton) {
      dismissButton.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss')));
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('alert-banner')) {
  customElements.define('alert-banner', AlertBannerElement);
}
export default AlertBannerElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\AmberEmbersBackdrop.js =====

/**
 * AmberEmbersBackdrop - Vanilla Web Component
 * Ambient backdrop inspired by a dark golden-hour valley: a warm olive/charcoal
 * vertical gradient, a soft amber bloom pooling toward the bottom-center, an
 * edge vignette and a field of sparse glowing embers that drift upward and
 * gently twinkle. Zero dependencies, Canvas 2D (works without WebGL).
 *
 * Usage: <amber-embers-backdrop speed="1" density="72" ember-color="#e6b745"></amber-embers-backdrop>
 */

const numOr = (value, fallback, min, max) => {
  const n = Number.parseFloat(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return fallback;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n));
};

// Canvas color stops throw on malformed values; only accept hex / rgb() strings
// so a hostile attribute cannot break the render loop (graceful fallback).
const safeColor = (value, fallback) => {
  const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (/^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(s)) return s;
  if (/^rgba?\(\s*[\d.%\s,]+\)$/i.test(s)) return s;
  return fallback;
};

const hexToRgb = (hex) => {
  let h = String(hex).replace("#", "");
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("");
  const n = Number.parseInt(h, 16);
  return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
};

class AmberEmbersBackdropElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["speed", "density", "base-color", "bloom-color", "ember-color", "interactive", "paused"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._cleanup = null;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.init();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._cleanup) {
      this._cleanup();
      this._cleanup = null;
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this.isConnected) {
      this.disconnectedCallback();
      this.init();
    }
  }

  init() {
    this.innerHTML = "";
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    canvas.className = "fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0";
    this.appendChild(canvas);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext && canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const speed = numOr(this.getAttribute("speed"), 1, 0, 4);
    const count = Math.round(numOr(this.getAttribute("density"), 72, 1, 220));
    const baseColor = safeColor(this.getAttribute("base-color"), "#0d0d0d");
    const bloomColor = safeColor(this.getAttribute("bloom-color"), "#6b5947");
    const emberColor = safeColor(this.getAttribute("ember-color"), "#e6b745");
    const interactive = this.getAttribute("interactive") === "true";
    const paused = this.getAttribute("paused") === "true";

    // Pre-render one soft ember sprite; drawImage-scaled per particle is far
    // cheaper than a radial gradient built from scratch every frame.
    const sprite = document.createElement("canvas");
    const SP = 64;
    sprite.width = SP;
    sprite.height = SP;
    const sctx = sprite.getContext("2d");
    const [er, eg, eb] = hexToRgb(emberColor);
    const sg = sctx.createRadialGradient(SP / 2, SP / 2, 0, SP / 2, SP / 2, SP / 2);
    sg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},1)`);
    sg.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},0.55)`);
    sg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},0)`);
    sctx.fillStyle = sg;
    sctx.fillRect(0, 0, SP, SP);

    const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
    const embers = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
      x: rand(0, 1),
      y: rand(-0.1, 1.1),
      r: rand(1.5, 6.5),
      rise: rand(0.008, 0.032),
      sway: rand(0.002, 0.012),
      swayAmp: rand(0.004, 0.03),
      phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      twinkle: rand(0.5, 1.8),
      alpha: rand(0.35, 0.95),
    }));

    const dpr = typeof window !== "undefined" ? Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2) : 1;
    let W = 1;
    let H = 1;
    const pointer = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, tx: 0.5, ty: 0.5 };

    const resize = () => {
      W = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth) * dpr));
      H = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight) * dpr));
      if (canvas.width !== W || canvas.height !== H) {
        canvas.width = W;
        canvas.height = H;
      }
    };

    const drawField = (t) => {
      // base: darkest at top, warm olive toward the lower field
      const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      bg.addColorStop(0, baseColor);
      bg.addColorStop(0.55, "#23241b");
      bg.addColorStop(1, bloomColor);
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      // warm bloom pooling at the bottom-center, nudged by pointer parallax
      const bx = (0.5 + (pointer.x - 0.5) * 0.12) * W;
      const by = (0.92 + (pointer.y - 0.5) * 0.06) * H;
      const [br, bg2, bb] = hexToRgb(bloomColor);
      const bloom = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, 0, bx, by, Math.max(W, H) * 0.8);
      bloom.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${br},${bg2},${bb},0.55)`);
      bloom.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(${br},${bg2},${bb},0.18)`);
      bloom.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${br},${bg2},${bb},0)`);
      ctx.fillStyle = bloom;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      // embers — soft additive-looking glow over the warm field
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      for (const e of embers) {
        const ex = (e.x + Math.sin(t * e.sway + e.phase) * e.swayAmp) * W;
        const ey = e.y * H;
        const tw = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * e.twinkle + e.phase);
        const size = e.r * dpr * 6;
        ctx.globalAlpha = e.alpha * tw;
        ctx.drawImage(sprite, ex - size / 2, ey - size / 2, size, size);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

      // vignette: darker edges focus the glow toward the center
      const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H * 0.45, Math.min(W, H) * 0.2, W / 2, H * 0.45, Math.max(W, H) * 0.78);
      vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.62)");
      ctx.fillStyle = vg;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    };

    const reducedQuery =
      typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
        ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
        : { matches: false };

    let raf = 0;
    let last = 0;
    let t = 0;
    let stopped = paused;

    const frame = (now) => {
      if (stopped) return;
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
      last = now;
      t += dt * speed;
      pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.05;
      pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.05;
      for (const e of embers) {
        e.y -= e.rise * dt * speed;
        if (e.y < -0.1) {
          e.y = 1.1;
          e.x = Math.random();
        }
      }
      drawField(t);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };

    const start = () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      last = performance.now();
      if (reducedQuery.matches) {
        drawField(t);
      } else {
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
    };

    const stop = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = 0;
    };

    const onVisibility = () => {
      if (document.hidden) stop();
      else start();
    };

    const onResize = () => {
      resize();
      if (stopped || reducedQuery.matches) drawField(t);
    };

    const onPointerMove = (e) => {
      if (!interactive) return;
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      pointer.tx = (e.clientX - rect.left) / (rect.width || 1);
      pointer.ty = (e.clientY - rect.top) / (rect.height || 1);
    };

    resize();
    if (interactive) window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    start();

    this._cleanup = () => {
      stop();
      if (interactive) window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    };
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("amber-embers-backdrop")) {
  customElements.define("amber-embers-backdrop", AmberEmbersBackdropElement);
}

export default AmberEmbersBackdropElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\AnimatedCounter.js =====

/**
 * AnimatedCounter - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <animated-counter target="270" suffix="+" duration="1500"></animated-counter>
 */

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

class AnimatedCounter extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["target", "start", "duration", "delay", "suffix", "prefix"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._animated = false;
    this._rafId = 0;
    this._timeoutId = null;
    this._observer = null;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.classList.add("font-mono", "tabular-nums", "select-none");
    this.renderInitial();
    this.initObserver();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._observer) {
      this._observer.disconnect();
      this._observer = null;
    }
    if (this._timeoutId) clearTimeout(this._timeoutId);
    if (this._rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(this._rafId);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this.isConnected && !this._animated) {
      this.renderInitial();
    }
  }

  renderInitial() {
    const start = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("start") || "0");
    const prefix = this.getAttribute("prefix") || "";
    const suffix = this.getAttribute("suffix") || "";
    this.textContent = `${prefix}${start}${suffix}`;
  }

  initObserver() {
    if (this._animated) return;

    const target = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("target") || "0");
    const start = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("start") || "0");
    const duration = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("duration") || "1500");
    const delay = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("delay") || "0");
    const prefix = this.getAttribute("prefix") || "";
    const suffix = this.getAttribute("suffix") || "";

    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      this.textContent = `${prefix}${target}${suffix}`;
      this._animated = true;
      return;
    }

    // Respect prefers-reduced-motion: jump straight to the final value
    // instead of running the count-up animation.
    if (
      typeof window.matchMedia === "function" &&
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
    ) {
      this.textContent = `${prefix}${target}${suffix}`;
      this._animated = true;
      return;
    }

    this._observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting || this._animated) return;
          this._animated = true;
          if (this._observer) this._observer.unobserve(entry.target);

          this._timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
            const startTime = performance.now();
            const range = target - start;

            const tick = (now) => {
              const elapsed = now - startTime;
              const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, elapsed / duration));
              const current = Math.round(start + easeOutCubic(progress) * range);
              this.textContent = `${prefix}${current}${suffix}`;

              if (progress < 1) {
                this._rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
              } else {
                this.textContent = `${prefix}${target}${suffix}`;
              }
            };

            this._rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          }, delay);
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.2 }
    );

    this._observer.observe(this);
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("animated-counter")) {
  customElements.define("animated-counter", AnimatedCounter);
}

/**
 * ApiKeyTable - OpenAI Platform "API keys" management table: rows with name,
 * masked key preview, created date and status badge, plus per-row Copy /
 * Revoke actions and a Create key CTA.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class ApiKeyTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'keys', 'create-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._keys = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._keys.length) {
      this._keys = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('keys'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'keys' && !this._keys.length) {
      this._keys = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('keys'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'API keys';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get createLabel() {
    return this.getAttribute('create-label') ?? 'Create new secret key';
  }
  set createLabel(value) {
    this.setAttribute('create-label', value);
  }

  get keys() {
    return this._keys;
  }
  set keys(value) {
    this._keys = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-api-key-row]');
    if (!rowEl) return;
    const row = this._keys.find((k) => String(k.id) === rowEl.getAttribute('data-api-key-row'));
    if (!row) return;
    if (event.target.closest('[data-api-key-copy]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('copy', { detail: { row }, bubbles: true }));
    } else if (event.target.closest('[data-api-key-revoke]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('revoke', { detail: { row }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const keys = this._keys;
    const active = keys.filter((k) => k.status !== 'revoked').length;
    const rows = keys.length
      ? keys
          .map((k) => {
            const revoked = k.status === 'revoked';
            const statusClass = revoked
              ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400'
              : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400';
            const meta = k.created ? `${k.preview} · created ${k.created}` : k.preview;
            const actions = revoked
              ? ''
              : `
            <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5">
              <button type="button" data-api-key-copy class="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Copy</button>
              <button type="button" data-api-key-revoke class="rounded border border-red-200 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-red-500 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 dark:border-red-900/60 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40">Revoke</button>
            </div>`;
            return `
          <div data-api-key-row="${escapeAttribute(k.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <p data-api-key-name class="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(k.name)}</p>
                <span data-api-key-status class="rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${statusClass}">${revoked ? 'Revoked' : 'Active'}</span>
              </div>
              <p data-api-key-preview class="mt-0.5 truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(meta)}</p>
            </div>
            ${actions}
          </div>`;
          })
          .join('')
      : `<p data-api-key-empty class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No API keys yet.</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-api-key-table class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h4 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)} <span data-api-key-count class="ml-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${active} active</span></h4>
          <button type="button" data-api-key-create class="rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500">+ ${escapeAttribute(this.createLabel)}</button>
        </div>
        <div data-api-key-list class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${rows}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('api-key-table')) {
  customElements.define('api-key-table', ApiKeyTableElement);
}

/**
 * ApiReferenceViewer - API reference section: method-badge endpoint header,
 * query parameter definitions with type/meta/description rows, collapsible
 * responses list, and a right code panel with language select, sample
 * request and highlighted JSON response
 * (GitBook API Reference pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_PARAMS = () => [
  { name: 'limit', type: 'integer', meta: 'max: 100', required: false, description: 'Max items to return (100 default)' },
  { name: 'status', type: 'string', meta: 'enum', required: false, description: 'Filter by pet status: available, pending, sold' },
];

const DEFAULT_RESPONSES = () => [
  {
    status: '200',
    tone: 'success',
    label: 'A paged array of pets',
    schema: 'Response object[]',
    body: '[\n  {\n    "id": 1,\n    "name": "Fluffy",\n    "tag": "dog",\n    "status": "available"\n  }\n]',
  },
  {
    status: '404',
    tone: 'error',
    label: 'Pets not found',
    schema: 'Error object',
    body: '{\n  "error": "not_found",\n  "message": "No pets matched the query."\n}',
  },
];

const DEFAULT_LANGUAGES = () => [
  { id: 'cli', label: 'CLI', sample: 'curl -L https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets' },
  { id: 'js', label: 'JS', sample: 'fetch("https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets")' },
];

const METHOD_STYLES = {
  GET: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300',
  POST: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/70 dark:text-sky-300',
  PUT: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300',
  PATCH: 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/70 dark:text-violet-300',
  DELETE: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/70 dark:text-red-300',
};

const TONE_STYLES = {
  success: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300',
  error: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/70 dark:text-red-300',
  warning: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300',
};

const methodCls = (method) => METHOD_STYLES[String(method || 'GET').toUpperCase()] ?? METHOD_STYLES.GET;
const toneCls = (tone) => TONE_STYLES[tone ?? 'success'] ?? TONE_STYLES.success;

class ApiReferenceViewerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'method', 'endpoint', 'params-title', 'params', 'responses-title', 'responses', 'languages', 'active-language-id', 'response-title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._openStatuses = ['200'];
    this._activeLanguageId = 'cli';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._openStatuses = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('open-statuses'), ['200']);
    this._activeLanguageId = this.getAttribute('active-language-id') || 'cli';
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.addEventListener('change', this._onChange);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.removeEventListener('change', this._onChange);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'open-statuses') this._openStatuses = parseJsonAttr(newValue, ['200']);
    if (name === 'active-language-id') this._activeLanguageId = newValue || 'cli';
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const toggle = event.target.closest('[data-api-response-toggle]');
    if (toggle) {
      const holder = toggle.closest('[data-api-response]');
      const status = holder ? holder.getAttribute('data-api-response') : '';
      this._openStatuses = this._openStatuses.includes(status)
        ? this._openStatuses.filter((s) => s !== status)
        : [...this._openStatuses, status];
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    const param = event.target.closest('[data-api-param]');
    if (param) {
      const found = this._params().find((p) => p.name === param.getAttribute('data-api-param'));
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('param-click', { detail: { param: found ?? { name: param.getAttribute('data-api-param') } }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _onChange(event) {
    const select = event.target.closest('[data-api-language-select]');
    if (select) {
      this._activeLanguageId = select.value;
      const lang = this._languages().find((l) => l.id === select.value);
      this._render();
      if (lang) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('language-change', { detail: { language: lang }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _params() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('params'), DEFAULT_PARAMS());
  }

  _responses() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('responses'), DEFAULT_RESPONSES());
  }

  _languages() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('languages'), DEFAULT_LANGUAGES());
  }

  _render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'List all pets';
    const method = this.getAttribute('method') || 'GET';
    const endpoint = this.getAttribute('endpoint') || 'https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets';
    const paramsTitle = this.getAttribute('params-title') || 'Query parameters';
    const responsesTitle = this.getAttribute('responses-title') || 'Responses';
    const responseTitle = this.getAttribute('response-title') || 'A paged array of pets';
    const params = this._params();
    const responses = this._responses();
    const languages = this._languages();
    const mCls = methodCls(method);

    const paramsHtml = params
      .map((param) => `<button data-api-param="${escapeAttribute(param.name)}" type="button" class="block w-full text-left">
            <p class="font-mono text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(param.name)} <span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(param.type)}${param.meta ? ' · ' + escapeAttribute(param.meta) : ''}</span>${param.required ? '' : ' <span class="text-red-500">optional</span>'}</p>
            <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(param.description)}</p>
          </button>`)
      .join('');

    const responsesHtml = responses
      .map((response) => {
        const open = this._openStatuses.includes(response.status);
        const tCls = toneCls(response.tone);
        return `<div data-api-response="${escapeAttribute(response.status)}" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <button data-api-response-toggle type="button" class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left">
              <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-xs text-zinc-400">${open ? '▾' : '▸'}</span>
              <span class="rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-bold ${tCls}">${escapeAttribute(response.status)}</span>
              <span class="text-sm text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(response.label)}</span>
            </button>
            ${open ? `<div data-api-response-schema class="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <code class="font-mono text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(response.schema)}</code>
              <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Show properties ＋</span>
            </div>` : ''}
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const lang = languages.find((l) => l.id === this._activeLanguageId) ?? languages[0] ?? { sample: '' };
    const activeResponse = responses.find((r) => r.status === (this._openStatuses[0] ?? '')) ?? responses[0] ?? { status: '200' };
    const langOptions = languages
      .map((l) => `<option value="${escapeAttribute(l.id)}"${l.id === this._activeLanguageId ? ' selected' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(l.label)}</option>`)
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `

        <div data-api-definition class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <h2 data-api-title class="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
          <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
            <span data-api-method class="rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold ${mCls}">${escapeAttribute(method.toUpperCase())}</span>
            <code data-api-endpoint class="truncate font-mono text-sm text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(endpoint)}</code>
          </div>
          <p data-api-params-title class="mt-6 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(paramsTitle)}</p>
          <div data-api-params class="mt-4 space-y-4">${paramsHtml}</div>
          <p data-api-responses-title class="mt-6 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(responsesTitle)}</p>

/**
 * AppealRestrictionDialog - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <appeal-restriction-dialog reason-title="..." reason-detail="..."></appeal-restriction-dialog>
 * Attributes: open, reason-title, reason-detail, policy-label, appeal-label, back-label
 * Events: appeal, close, back
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AppealRestrictionDialogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'reason-title', 'reason-detail', 'policy-label', 'appeal-label', 'back-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-appeal-submit]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('appeal'));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-appeal-close]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-appeal-back]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('back'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if (this.getAttribute('open') === 'false') {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const reasonTitle = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('reason-title') || 'Unsafe Conduct');
    const reasonDetail = escapeAttribute(
      this.getAttribute('reason-detail') ||
        'This content contains depictions, instructions for, or explanations of dangerous stunts by non-professionals.'
    );
    const policyLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('policy-label') || 'Content Policy');
    const appealLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('appeal-label') || 'Appeal');
    const backLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('back-label') || 'Request another review');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-appeal-dialog role="dialog" aria-label="Request another review" class="w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-5 pt-4">
    <button type="button" data-appeal-back aria-label="Go back" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">←</button>
    <button type="button" data-appeal-close aria-label="Close" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="px-5 pb-5 pt-2">
    <h3 data-appeal-title class="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${backLabel}</h3>
    <p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">If you disagree with the content restriction, you have 180 days to appeal.</p>
    <div data-appeal-reason class="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-3 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
      <span class="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Reason</span>
      <p data-appeal-reason-title class="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${reasonTitle}</p>
      <p data-appeal-reason-detail class="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${reasonDetail}</p>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between">
      <p class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Read our <a href="#" class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 underline dark:text-zinc-200">${policyLabel}</a></p>
      <button type="button" data-appeal-submit class="rounded-md bg-rose-500 px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-rose-400">${appealLabel}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }

/**
 * ApprovalCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <approval-card title="…" approved-count="1" due-date="3 Jun" decision="pending"></approval-card> with `approvers` property
 * Attributes: title, approved-count, due-date, decision (approved|rejected|pending), note
 * Properties: approvers ({ initials, tone? }[])
 * Events: approve, reject, request-change
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

export class ApprovalCardElement extends HTMLElement {

    this.render();
  }

    this.render();

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {

      </div>

                : ''
            }
          </dd>
        </div>

            ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <dt class="w-20 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">Due date</dt>
          <dd class="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${uiIcon('calendar', { size: 12, className: 'text-zinc-400' })}${escapeAttribute(dueDate)}</dd>

          <dt class="w-20 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">Decision</dt>
          <dd data-approval-decision class="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium capitalize ${tone.className}">
            ${uiIcon(tone.icon, { size: 12 })}${escapeAttribute(decision)}
          </dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      ${
        note
          ? `<p class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(note)}</p>`
          : ''
      }
      ${
        hasButtons
          ? `<div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
        ${
          hasButtons && decision !== 'rejected'
            ? '<button type="button" data-approval-reject class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Request change</button>'
            : ''
        }
        ${
          hasButtons && decision !== 'approved'
            ? '<button type="button" data-approval-approve class="rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500">Approve</button>'
            : ''
        }
      </div>`
          : ''
      }
    </section>`;

    const fire = (type, propName) => {
      if (typeof this[propName] === 'function') this[propName]();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(type));
    };
    const approveBtn = this.querySelector('[data-approval-approve]');
    if (approveBtn) approveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => fire('approve', 'onApprove'));
    const rejectBtn = this.querySelector('[data-approval-reject]');
    if (rejectBtn) rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => fire('reject', 'onReject'));
    const addBtn = this.querySelector('[data-request-change]');
    if (addBtn) addBtn.addEventListener('click', () => fire('request-change', 'onRequestChange'));

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

/**
 * ArtifactCanvas - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <artifact-canvas title="Preview" language="html" code="<h1>Hello</h1>"></artifact-canvas>
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

class ArtifactCanvas extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["title", "language", "code", "is-open"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.tab = "preview";
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isOpen = this.hasAttribute("is-open");
    if (!isOpen) {
      this.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    const title = this.getAttribute("title") || "Artifact Preview";
    const language = this.getAttribute("language") || "html";
    const code = this.getAttribute("code") || "";

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-full sm:w-[500px] md:w-[680px] z-40 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border-l border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl flex flex-col transition-transform duration-300">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span class="font-semibold text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate max-w-[240px]">${escapeAttribute(title)}</span>
            <div class="flex items-center bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-800 p-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
              <button type="button" id="tab-preview" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${this.tab === 'preview' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : ''}">Preview</button>
              <button type="button" id="tab-code" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors ${this.tab === 'code' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : ''}">Code</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button type="button" id="copy-btn" class="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors text-xs font-mono">Copy</button>
            <button type="button" id="close-btn" class="p-1.5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-200/50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-lg transition-colors" title="Close panel">${uiIcon('x', { size: 18 })}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative">
          <iframe id="preview-frame" class="w-full h-full border-0 bg-white ${this.tab === 'preview' ? '' : 'hidden'}" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals"></iframe>
          <pre id="code-view" class="w-full h-full p-4 m-0 overflow-auto bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100 text-xs font-mono leading-relaxed ${this.tab === 'code' ? '' : 'hidden'}"><code>${this.escapeHtml(code)}</code></pre>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    let sandboxedDoc = code;
    if (language === "svg") {
      sandboxedDoc = `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;margin:0;background:#09090b;">${code}</div>`;
    } else if (language === "html") {
      sandboxedDoc = `
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
          <head>
            <meta charset="utf-8">
            <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
            <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
            <style>body { margin: 0; padding: 1rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }</style>
          </head>
          <body>
            ${code}
          </body>
        </html>
      `;
    }

    // P1 修复：sandboxedDoc 此前从未赋给 iframe，Preview 恒空白。走 DOM property
    // 赋值 srcdoc（非 HTML 属性拼接，无需转义）；sandbox 无 allow-same-origin，
    // 文档脚本运行在独立 origin，无法触达宿主页。
    const frame = this.querySelector("#preview-frame");
    if (frame) frame.srcdoc = sandboxedDoc;

    this.querySelector("#tab-preview").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.tab = "preview";
      this.render();
    });

    this.querySelector("#tab-code").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.tab = "code";
      this.render();
    });

    this.querySelector("#copy-btn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
      const btn = this.querySelector("#copy-btn");
      btn.innerHTML = `${uiIcon('check', { size: 14 })} Copied`;
      if (this._copyTimer) clearTimeout(this._copyTimer);
      this._copyTimer = setTimeout(() => (btn.innerHTML = "Copy"), 2000);
    });

    this.querySelector("#close-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.removeAttribute("is-open");
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("close"));
    });
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._copyTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this._copyTimer);
      this._copyTimer = null;
    }
  }

  escapeHtml(str) {
    return str.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("artifact-canvas")) {
  customElements.define("artifact-canvas", ArtifactCanvas);
}
export default ArtifactCanvas;

/**
 * AttachmentChip - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <attachment-chip name="report.pdf" kind="pdf" size="2.4 MB" meta="Uploaded just now"></attachment-chip>
 * Attributes: name, kind (pdf|doc|csv|image), size, meta, removable (true|false)
 * Events: remove
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const KIND_TONE = {
  pdf: { badge: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300', glyph: 'PDF' },
  doc: { badge: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300', glyph: 'DOC' },
  csv: { badge: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300', glyph: 'CSV' },
  image: { badge: 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300', glyph: 'IMG' },
};

export class AttachmentChipElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['name', 'kind', 'size', 'meta', 'removable'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get removable() {
    return this.getAttribute('removable') !== 'false';
  }

  set removable(flag) {
    this.setAttribute('removable', flag ? 'true' : 'false');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-attachment-remove]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove', { detail: { name: this.getAttribute('name') || '' } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('inline-flex');
    const name = this.getAttribute('name') || '';
    const kind = this.getAttribute('kind') || 'doc';
    const size = this.getAttribute('size') || '';
    const meta = this.getAttribute('meta') || '';
    const removable = this.getAttribute('removable') !== 'false';
    const tone = KIND_TONE[kind] || KIND_TONE.doc;
    const sub = [size, meta].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');

    this.innerHTML = `<span data-attachment-chip class="inline-flex max-w-xs items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1.5 pl-2.5 pr-7 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900" title="${escapeAttribute(name)}">
      <span class="flex h-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded px-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold ${tone.badge}">${tone.glyph}</span>
      <span class="min-w-0">
        <span class="block max-w-[160px] truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(name)}</span>
        ${sub ? `<span class="block text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(sub)}</span>` : ''}
      </span>
      ${
        removable
          ? `<button type="button" data-attachment-remove aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(name)}" class="relative -ml-5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" class="mx-auto h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
            </button>`
          : ''
      }
    </span>`;
  }
}

===== FILE: vanilla\AudioNotePlayer.js =====

/**
 * AudioNotePlayer - Voicenotes audio note player card: a play/pause button,
 * a waveform bar strip and the note title / duration metadata row.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class AudioNotePlayerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'duration', 'playing', 'waveform'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._waveform = [];
    this._playing = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._waveform.length) {
      this._waveform = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('waveform'), []);
    }
    if (this.getAttribute('playing') === 'true') {
      this._playing = true;
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'waveform' && !this._waveform.length) {
      this._waveform = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('waveform'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'playing') {
      this._playing = newValue === 'true';
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'Homepage walkthrough notes';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get duration() {
    return this.getAttribute('duration') ?? '00:47';
  }
  set duration(value) {
    this.setAttribute('duration', value);
  }

  get playing() {
    return this._playing;
  }
  set playing(value) {
    this._playing = Boolean(value);
    this._render();
  }

  get waveform() {
    return this._waveform;
  }
  set waveform(value) {
    this._waveform = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-audio-note-toggle]')) {
      this._playing = !this._playing;
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle-play', { detail: { playing: this._playing }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const bars = this._waveform.length
      ? this._waveform
      : Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => 25 + Math.round(Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 1.3)) * 75));
    const wave = bars
      .map((h, i) => {
        const played = this._playing && i < bars.length / 2;
        return `<span class="w-[3px] shrink-0 rounded-full ${played ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600'}" style="height:${Math.max(15, Math.min(100, h))}%"></span>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-audio-note-player class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button type="button" data-audio-note-toggle aria-label="${this._playing ? 'Pause note' : 'Play note'}" class="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-xs text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-300">${this._playing ? '❚❚' : '▶'}</button>
          <div data-audio-note-waveform class="flex h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-[2px]" aria-hidden="true">${wave}</div>
          <span data-audio-note-duration class="shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(this.duration)}</span>
        </div>
        <p data-audio-note-title class="mt-3 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)}</p>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('audio-note-player')) {
  customElements.define('audio-note-player', AudioNotePlayerElement);
}

export default AudioNotePlayerElement;

/**
 * AudioPlaylistPage - Music playlist page with gradient cover, track rows,
 * version/remix controls, reactions, bottom player bar and a right Queue
 * panel (Suno audio workspace pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_TRACKS = () => [
  { id: 't1', title: 'Neon after rain', artist: 'Mira Sol', duration: '3:42', version: 'v5', liked: true },
  { id: 't2', title: 'Soft focus', artist: 'Mira Sol', duration: '2:58', version: 'v3' },
  { id: 't3', title: 'Signals in the dark', artist: 'Mira Sol', duration: '4:16', version: 'v2' },
  { id: 't4', title: 'Morning light', artist: 'Mira Sol', duration: '3:05', version: 'v1' },
];

const DEFAULT_QUEUE = () => [
  { id: 'q1', title: 'City windows', artist: 'Mira Sol', duration: '3:10' },
  { id: 'q2', title: 'Static bloom', artist: 'Theo Park', duration: '2:46' },
  { id: 'q3', title: 'Almost home', artist: 'Mira Sol', duration: '3:31' },
];

class AudioPlaylistPageElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'subtitle', 'cover-url', 'tracks', 'queue', 'active-track-id'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._playing = false;
    this._liked = new Set();
    this._likedInitialized = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _tracks() {
    const tracks = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('tracks'), DEFAULT_TRACKS());
    if (!this._likedInitialized) {
      this._liked = new Set(tracks.filter((t) => t.liked).map((t) => t.id));
      this._likedInitialized = true;
    }
    return tracks;
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const trackPlay = event.target.closest('[data-audioplaylist-track-play]');
    if (trackPlay) {
      const id = trackPlay.getAttribute('data-audioplaylist-track-play');
      const found = this._tracks().find((t) => t.id === id);
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('track-click', { detail: { track: found }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const remix = event.target.closest('[data-audioplaylist-remix]');
    if (remix) {
      const id = remix.getAttribute('data-audioplaylist-remix');
      const found = this._tracks().find((t) => t.id === id);
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remix', { detail: { track: found }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const like = event.target.closest('[data-audioplaylist-like-track]');
    if (like) {
      const id = like.getAttribute('data-audioplaylist-like-track');
      const found = this._tracks().find((t) => t.id === id);
      if (found) {
        if (this._liked.has(id)) this._liked.delete(id);
        else this._liked.add(id);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('like', { detail: { track: found }, bubbles: true }));
        this._render();
      }
      return;
    }
    const queueItem = event.target.closest('[data-audioplaylist-queue-item]');
    if (queueItem) {
      const id = queueItem.getAttribute('data-audioplaylist-queue-item');
      const found = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('queue'), DEFAULT_QUEUE()).find((t) => t.id === id);
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('queue-click', { detail: { track: found }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-audioplaylist-play]') || event.target.closest('[data-audioplaylist-player-toggle]')) {
      this._playing = !this._playing;
      this._render();
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Late night sketches';
    const subtitle = this.getAttribute('subtitle') || 'A collection of new ideas and alternate versions';
    const coverUrl = this.getAttribute('cover-url') || '';
    const tracks = this._tracks();
    const queue = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('queue'), DEFAULT_QUEUE());
    const activeId = this.getAttribute('active-track-id') || tracks[0]?.id || '';
    const active = tracks.find((t) => t.id === activeId) ?? tracks[0];

    const tracksHtml = tracks
      .map((track, index) => {
        const isActive = track.id === active?.id;
        const isLiked = this._liked.has(track.id);
        return `<div data-audioplaylist-track="${escapeAttribute(track.id)}" data-audioplaylist-active="${isActive ? 'true' : 'false'}" class="group flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3.5 transition-colors sm:px-7 ${isActive ? 'bg-indigo-50/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/30' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900'}">
            <button data-audioplaylist-track-play="${escapeAttribute(track.id)}" aria-label="Play ${escapeAttribute(track.title)}" type="button" class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-sm text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">${isActive && this._playing ? '<span class="text-xs">❚❚</span>' : `<span class="text-xs">${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>`}</button>
            <div class="h-10 w-10 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-200 to-fuchsia-200 dark:from-indigo-950 dark:to-fuchsia-950">${track.coverUrl ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(track.coverUrl)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />` : '<span class="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-lg">♫</span>'}</div>
            <button type="button" class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left" data-audioplaylist-track-play="${escapeAttribute(track.id)}">
              <p class="truncate text-sm font-semibold">${escapeAttribute(track.title)}</p>
              <p class="truncate text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(track.artist)}</p>
            </button>
            ${track.version ? `<span data-audioplaylist-version class="rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(track.version)}</span>` : ''}
            <span class="hidden text-xs tabular-nums text-zinc-400 sm:inline">${escapeAttribute(track.duration)}</span>
            <button data-audioplaylist-remix="${escapeAttribute(track.id)}" type="button" class="hidden rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 sm:inline dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Remix ▾</button>
            <button data-audioplaylist-like-track="${escapeAttribute(track.id)}" aria-label="${isLiked ? 'Unlike' : 'Like'}" type="button" class="rounded-md px-1.5 py-1 text-base ${isLiked ? 'text-rose-500' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-400'}">${isLiked ? '♥' : '♡'}</button>
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const queueHtml = queue
      .map(
        (track, index) => `<button data-audioplaylist-queue-item="${escapeAttribute(track.id)}" type="button" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg p-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            <span class="w-4 text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${index + 1}</span>
            <span class="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-200 to-indigo-200 text-sm dark:from-cyan-950 dark:to-indigo-950">♫</span>
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1"><span class="block truncate text-xs font-semibold">${escapeAttribute(track.title)}</span><span class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(track.artist)}</span></span>
            <span class="text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(track.duration)}</span>
          </button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-audioplaylist class="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-50">
        <div class="grid lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_240px]">
          <main data-audioplaylist-main class="min-w-0">
            <div class="flex flex-col gap-5 border-b border-zinc-200 p-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:p-7 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div data-audioplaylist-cover class="relative h-40 w-40 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-fuchsia-500 via-indigo-600 to-cyan-400 shadow-lg">${coverUrl ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(coverUrl)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />` : '<div class="absolute inset-0 opacity-40" style="background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 25% 25%, white 0 2px, transparent 3px), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 70%, white 0 1px, transparent 2px);background-size:22px 22px"></div>'}<span class="absolute bottom-3 left-3 text-3xl" aria-hidden="true">♫</span></div>
              <div class="min-w-0">
                <p class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Playlist</p>
                <h2 data-audioplaylist-title class="mt-1 truncate text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
                <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(subtitle)}</p>
                <div class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <button data-audioplaylist-play type="button" class="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200">${this._playing ? '❚❚ Pause' : '▶ Play'}</button>
                  <button data-audioplaylist-share type="button" class="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">↗ Share</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div data-audioplaylist-toolbar class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800/70">
              <p class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${tracks.length} songs · originals and versions</p>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button data-audioplaylist-like type="button" class="rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">♡ Like</button>
                <button data-audioplaylist-comment type="button" class="rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">◌ Comment</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div data-audioplaylist-tracks class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/70">${tracksHtml}</div>
          </main>
          <aside data-audioplaylist-queue class="border-t border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/80 p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/60 lg:border-l lg:border-t-0">

              <h3 class="text-sm font-bold">Queue</h3>
              <span class="text-xs text-zinc-400">${queue.length}</span>
            </div>

          </aside>

        <div data-audioplaylist-player class="flex items-center gap-3 border-t border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-3 text-white dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button data-audioplaylist-player-toggle type="button" class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-xs text-zinc-900">${this._playing ? '❚❚' : '▶'}</button>
          <div class="min-w-0 w-36 sm:w-48"><p class="truncate text-xs font-semibold">${escapeAttribute(active?.title ?? 'Nothing playing')}</p><p class="truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(active?.artist ?? 'Choose a track')}</p></div>

'0:00')}</span></div>

        </div>

/**
 * AudioWaveVisualizer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <audio-wave-visualizer is-active bar-count="16"></audio-wave-visualizer>
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

class AudioWaveVisualizer extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["is-active", "bar-count", "color"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isActive = this.hasAttribute("is-active");
    const barCount = parseInt(this.getAttribute("bar-count") || "16", 10);
    const rawColor = this.getAttribute("color") || "bg-amber-500";
    // color 进 class 属性：只允许 Tailwind 色类词法（字母数字连字符），防引号逃逸注入
    const color = /^[a-zA-Z0-9-_\/:\[\]()%.,\s]+$/.test(rawColor) ? rawColor.replace(/"/g, '') : "bg-amber-500";

    const bars = [];
    for (let idx = 0; idx < barCount; idx++) {
      const delay = ((idx * 0.08) % 0.8).toFixed(2);
      const duration = (0.6 + ((idx % 4) * 0.15)).toFixed(2);
      bars.push(`
        <span style="animation-delay:${delay}s; animation-duration:${duration}s;" class="w-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${color} ${isActive ? 'h-full animate-[audio-pulse_0.8s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate]' : 'h-1.5 opacity-40'}"></span>
      `);
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 h-8 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 select-none" role="status" aria-label="${isActive ? 'Audio active' : 'Audio idle'}">
        ${bars.join("")}
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("audio-wave-visualizer")) {
  customElements.define("audio-wave-visualizer", AudioWaveVisualizer);
}
export default AudioWaveVisualizer;
