/**
 * AuditLogTable - Audit log: filter bar, mini bar-chart trend, view
 * segmented switch and a four-column event table with status badges
 * (Okta System Log pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_TREND = () => [
  { label: 'Mon', value: 12 },
  { label: 'Tue', value: 28 },
  { label: 'Wed', value: 19 },
  { label: 'Thu', value: 41 },
  { label: 'Fri', value: 33 },
  { label: 'Sat', value: 9 },
  { label: 'Sun', value: 5 },
];

const DEFAULT_EVENTS = () => [
  { id: 'e1', time: '2026-11-16 09:41:22', actor: 'admin@mango.dev', event: 'user.session.login', status: 'success', target: 'Web session (Chrome 141, macOS)' },
  { id: 'e2', time: '2026-11-16 09:38:04', actor: 'svc-deploy@github', event: 'app.oauth2.token.grant', status: 'success', target: 'deploy-bot client' },
  { id: 'e3', time: '2026-11-16 08:57:51', actor: 'unknown@203.0.113.7', event: 'user.session.login', status: 'failure', target: 'Sign-in attempt — invalid password' },
  { id: 'e4', time: '2026-11-16 08:12:10', actor: 'admin@mango.dev', event: 'group.membership.add', status: 'success', target: 'engineering → sso-everyone' },
  { id: 'e5', time: '2026-11-16 07:44:36', actor: 'audit-daemon', event: 'policy.rule.evaluate', status: 'pending', target: 'mfa-required rule (draft)' },
];

const STATUS_STYLES = {
  success: { label: 'SUCCESS', cls: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  failure: { label: 'FAILURE', cls: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400' },
  pending: { label: 'PENDING', cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-400' },
};

class AuditLogTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'filters', 'trend', 'views', 'active-view', 'events'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._title = 'System Log';
    this._filters = [
      { label: 'Date range', value: 'Last 24 hours' },
      { label: 'Keyword', value: 'user.session' },
    ];
    this._trend = DEFAULT_TREND();
    this._views = ['Events', 'Raw export'];
    this._activeView = 'Events';
    this._events = DEFAULT_EVENTS();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const t = this.getAttribute('title');
    if (t) this._title = t;
    this._filters = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('filters'), this._filters);
    this._trend = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('trend'), DEFAULT_TREND());
    this._views = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('views'), this._views);
    const av = this.getAttribute('active-view');
    if (av) this._activeView = av;
    this._events = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('events'), DEFAULT_EVENTS());
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'System Log';
    if (name === 'filters') this._filters = parseJsonAttr(newValue, this._filters);
    if (name === 'trend') this._trend = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_TREND());
    if (name === 'views') this._views = parseJsonAttr(newValue, this._views);
    if (name === 'active-view') this._activeView = newValue || 'Events';
    if (name === 'events') this._events = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_EVENTS());
    this._render();
  }

  get events() { return this._events; }
  set events(value) { this._events = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const viewEl = event.target.closest('[data-audit-view]');
    if (viewEl) {
      this._activeView = viewEl.getAttribute('data-audit-view');
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('view-change', { detail: { view: this._activeView }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const row = event.target.closest('[data-audit-row]');
    if (row) {
      const item = this._events.find((e) => e.id === row.getAttribute('data-audit-row'));
      if (item) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('event-click', { detail: { event: item }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const max = Math.max(...this._trend.map((t) => t.value), 1);
    const trendHtml = this._trend
      .map((t) => {
        const h = Math.round((t.value / max) * 36) + 4;
        return `<span data-audit-trend-bar="${escapeAttribute(t.label)}" class="flex w-4 flex-col items-center gap-0.5"><span class="w-full rounded-sm bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" style="height:${h}px"></span><span class="text-[9px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(t.label)}</span></span>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const viewsHtml = this._views
      .map((v) => {
        const active = v === this._activeView;
        return `<button type="button" data-audit-view="${escapeAttribute(v)}" aria-pressed="${active}" class="${active ? 'rounded bg-white px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-100' : 'rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(v)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const filtersHtml = this._filters
      .map((f) => `<button type="button" data-audit-filter="${escapeAttribute(f.label)}" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"><span class="text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">◷</span><span class="font-medium">${escapeAttribute(f.label)}:</span> ${escapeAttribute(f.value)}<span class="text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></button>`)
      .join('');

    const rowsHtml = this._events
      .map((e) => {
        const style = STATUS_STYLES[e.status] ?? STATUS_STYLES.pending;
        return `<tr data-audit-row="${escapeAttribute(e.id)}" tabindex="0" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 align-top transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <td data-audit-row-time="${escapeAttribute(e.time)}" class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(e.time)}</td>
          <td data-audit-row-actor="${escapeAttribute(e.actor)}" class="px-2 py-2.5 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(e.actor)}</td>
          <td data-audit-row-event="${escapeAttribute(e.event)}" class="px-2 py-2.5"><span class="font-mono text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(e.event)}</span><span data-audit-row-status="${escapeAttribute(e.status)}" class="ml-2 inline-block rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold ${style.cls}">${style.label}</span></td>
          <td data-audit-row-target="${escapeAttribute(e.target)}" class="max-w-[18rem] truncate px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" title="${escapeAttribute(e.target)}">${escapeAttribute(e.target)}</td>
        </tr>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-audit-log class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-audit-header class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-audit-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <div data-audit-filters class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">${filtersHtml}</div>
        </div>
        <div data-audit-overview class="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3">
          <div data-audit-trend class="flex items-end gap-1.5" aria-hidden="true">${trendHtml}</div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <p data-audit-count class="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"><span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${this._events.length}</span> events</p>
            <div data-audit-views class="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 p-0.5 dark:bg-zinc-800">${viewsHtml}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <table data-audit-table class="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr class="border-y border-zinc-100 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <th class="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Time</th>
              <th class="px-2 py-2 font-medium">Actor</th>
              <th class="px-2 py-2 font-medium">Event info</th>
              <th class="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Targets</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('audit-log-table')) {
  customElements.define('audit-log-table', AuditLogTableElement);
}

export default AuditLogTableElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class AuthFormElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['mode', 'title', 'subtitle', 'submit-text', 'error', 'loading', 'footer-text', 'providers'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get providers() {
    if (this._providers) return this._providers;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('providers') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set providers(value) {
    this._providers = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get mode() {
    return this.getAttribute('mode') === 'signup' ? 'signup' : 'signin';
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const isSignup = this.mode === 'signup';
    const providers = this.providers;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || (isSignup ? 'Create your account' : 'Welcome back');
    const subtitle =
      this.getAttribute('subtitle') || (isSignup ? 'Start free, no card required.' : 'Sign in to continue to your workspace.');
    const error = this.getAttribute('error') || '';
    const loading = this.getAttribute('loading') === 'true';
    const submitText = this.getAttribute('submit-text') || (isSignup ? 'Create account' : 'Sign in');
    const footerText = this.getAttribute('footer-text');

    this._applyHostClass('block w-full max-w-sm');

    const providerButtons = providers
      .map((provider) => {

            class="auth-provider flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
            ${
              provider.icon
                ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(provider.icon)}" alt="" class="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />`
                : `<span class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(fallback)}</span>`
            }
            <span>Continue with ${escapeAttribute(provider.name)}</span>
          </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const providerBlock = providers.length
      ? `<div class="mt-5 space-y-2">${providerButtons}</div>
         <div class="my-5 flex items-center gap-3">
           <span class="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></span>
           <span class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">or</span>
           <span class="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></span>
         </div>`
      : '';

    const inputAttrs =
      'w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:border-indigo-500 transition-colors';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-6">
        <div class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</div>
        <div class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(subtitle)}</div>
        ${providerBlock}
        <form class="${providers.length ? 'space-y-3' : 'mt-5 space-y-3'}" novalidate>
          ${
            isSignup
              ? `<label class="block">
                   <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Name</span>
                   <input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Ada Lovelace" class="${inputAttrs}" />
                 </label>`
              : ''
          }
          <label class="block">
            <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Email</span>
            <input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@company.com" class="${inputAttrs}" />
          </label>
          <label class="block">
            <span class="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Password</span>
            <input type="password" name="password" autocomplete="${isSignup ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'}"
              placeholder="••••••••" class="${inputAttrs}" />
          </label>
          ${
            error
              ? `<div role="alert" class="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 px-3 py-2">
                   <span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-red-500">${uiIcon('alert-triangle', { size: 14 })}</span>
                   <span class="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">${escapeAttribute(error)}</span>
                 </div>`
              : ''
          }
          <button type="submit" ${loading ? 'disabled' : ''}
            class="auth-submit flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">
            ${loading ? `<span class="animate-spin inline-flex">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
            ${escapeAttribute(submitText)}
          </button>
        </form>
        ${
          footerText
            ? `<button type="button" class="auth-footer mt-4 w-full text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">${escapeAttribute(footerText)}</button>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.auth-provider').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const provider = providers.find((p) => p.name === btn.getAttribute('data-provider'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('provider', { detail: provider }));
      });
    });

    const form = this.querySelector('form');
    form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      // Keep the raw DOM event from bubbling to host listeners: hosts should
      // only ever observe the normalized `submit` CustomEvent below.
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (loading) return;
      const values = new FormData(form);
      const payload = {
        ...(isSignup ? { name: String(values.get('name') || '') } : {}),
        email: String(values.get('email') || ''),
        password: String(values.get('password') || ''),
      };
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('submit', { detail: payload }));
    });

    const footerBtn = this.querySelector('.auth-footer');
    if (footerBtn) footerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('footer')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('auth-form')) {
  customElements.define('auth-form', AuthFormElement);
}

/**
 * AuthGatePrompt - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <auth-gate-prompt title="Sign in to save" providers='[...]'></auth-gate-prompt>
 * Attributes: title, providers (JSON [{id,label,tone?}]), secondary-label, divider-text, skip-label
 * Properties: providers
 * Events: provider (detail {id}), secondary, skip
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE_CLASS = {
  white: 'border border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50',
  brand: 'bg-[#1877F2] text-white hover:bg-[#166fe0]',
  dark: 'bg-zinc-900 text-white hover:bg-zinc-700',
};

export class AuthGatePromptElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'providers', 'secondary-label', 'divider-text', 'skip-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._providers = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._providers.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('providers');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._providers = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._providers = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const provider = event.target.closest('[data-auth-provider]');
        if (provider) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('provider', { detail: { id: provider.getAttribute('data-auth-provider') } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-auth-secondary]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('secondary'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-auth-skip]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('skip'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'providers') this._providers = [];
    this.render();
  }

  get providers() { return this._providers; }
  set providers(v) {
    this._providers = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const dividerText = this.getAttribute('divider-text') || 'or';
    const skipLabel = this.getAttribute('skip-label') || 'Not now';
    const secondaryLabel = this.getAttribute('secondary-label') || '';
    const providers = this._providers.length
      ? this._providers
      : [
          { id: 'google', label: 'Continue with Google', tone: 'white' },
          { id: 'facebook', label: 'Continue with Facebook', tone: 'brand' },
          { id: 'apple', label: 'Continue with Apple', tone: 'dark' },
        ];

    const hostClass = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6 text-center shadow-sm';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const buttons = providers
      .map((provider) => `<button type="button" data-auth-provider="${escapeAttribute(provider.id)}" class="w-full rounded-full px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${TONE_CLASS[provider.tone || 'white']}">${escapeAttribute(provider.label)}</button>`)
      .join('');

    const secondary = secondaryLabel
      ? `<button type="button" data-auth-secondary class="w-full rounded-full border border-zinc-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(secondaryLabel)}</button>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-auth-gate class="${hostClass}">
  <p data-auth-gate-title class="text-lg font-semibold leading-snug text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
  <div class="mt-5 space-y-2.5">${buttons}</div>
  <div class="my-4 flex items-center gap-3"><span class="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-200"></span><span class="text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(dividerText)}</span><span class="h-px flex-1 bg-zinc-200"></span></div>
  ${secondary}
  <button type="button" data-auth-skip class="mt-4 text-sm text-zinc-500 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-800 hover:underline">${escapeAttribute(skipLabel)}</button>
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * AuthSplitPanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <auth-split-panel media-title="Welcome back" media-subtitle="..." media-side="left"></auth-split-panel>
 * Attributes: media-side (left|right), media-title, media-subtitle, media-background (tinted|cover), footer-links (JSON [{label,href}])
 * Slots: default children rendered in the auth column; media via property (HTML string)
 * Property: media, footerLinks
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

// Only allow safe URL protocols into <a href> (blocks javascript:/data:/vbscript:)
const isSafeHref = (href) => {
  if (typeof href !== 'string') return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith('//') || t.startsWith('/') || t.startsWith('./') || t.startsWith('../')) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

export class AuthSplitPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['media-side', 'media-title', 'media-subtitle', 'media-background', 'footer-links'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._media = '';
    this._footerLinks = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    // Capture light-DOM children before first render replaces innerHTML.
    if (this._contentHtml === undefined) this._contentHtml = this.innerHTML;
    const raw = this.getAttribute('footer-links');
    if (raw && !this._footerLinks.length) {
      try { this._footerLinks = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._footerLinks = []; }
    }
    this.render();
  }

  get media() {
    return this._media;
  }
  set media(v) {
    this._media = v || '';
    this.render();
  }

  get footerLinks() {
    return this._footerLinks;
  }
  set footerLinks(v) {
    this._footerLinks = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before _contentHtml is captured.
    if (this._contentHtml === undefined) return;
    if (name === 'footer-links' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._footerLinks = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _mediaPanel(side) {
    const background = this.getAttribute('media-background') || 'tinted';
    const title = this.getAttribute('media-title') || '';
    const subtitle = this.getAttribute('media-subtitle') || '';
    return `<div data-auth-media="${side}" class="relative hidden md:flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden ${background === 'cover' ? 'bg-zinc-900' : 'bg-zinc-100'}">
  ${this._media ? `<div class="mb-4 max-h-64 max-w-full">${this._media}</div>` : ''}
  ${title ? `<p class="px-8 text-center text-2xl font-bold ${background === 'cover' ? 'text-white' : 'text-zinc-900'}">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>` : ''}
  ${subtitle ? `<p class="mt-2 max-w-xs px-8 text-center text-sm leading-relaxed ${background === 'cover' ? 'text-zinc-300' : 'text-zinc-500'}">${escapeAttribute(subtitle)}</p>` : ''}
</div>`;
  }

  render() {
    const side = this.getAttribute('media-side') || 'left';
    const hostClass = 'grid min-h-[480px] md:grid-cols-2 contents';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const links = this._footerLinks
      .map((link) =>
        isSafeHref(link.href)
          ? `<a href="${escapeAttribute(link.href)}" class="hover:underline">${escapeAttribute(link.label)}</a>`
          : `<span class="hover:underline">${escapeAttribute(link.label)}</span>`
      )
      .join('');

    const mediaLeft = side === 'left' ? this._mediaPanel('left') : '';
    const mediaRight = side === 'right' ? this._mediaPanel('right') : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-auth-split class="grid min-h-[480px] md:grid-cols-2">
${mediaLeft}
<div class="flex flex-col justify-center px-6 py-10 sm:px-12">
  <div class="mx-auto w-full max-w-md">${this._contentHtml || ''}
    ${links ? `<div class="mt-8 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-blue-600">${links}</div>` : ''}
  </div>
</div>
${mediaRight}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('auth-split-panel')) {
  customElements.define('auth-split-panel', AuthSplitPanelElement);
}

export default AuthSplitPanelElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\AutoScrollAnchor.js =====

/**
 * AutoScrollAnchor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <auto-scroll-anchor is-streaming></auto-scroll-anchor>
 */
class AutoScrollAnchor extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["is-streaming"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.isAtBottom = true;
    this.render();
    this.bindEvents();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._scrollHandler) {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", this._scrollHandler);
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (name === "is-streaming" && newValue !== null && this.isAtBottom) {
      this.scrollToBottom();
    }
  }

  render() {
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div id="anchor" class="h-px w-full pointer-events-none"></div>
      <button type="button" id="back-to-bottom" class="hidden fixed bottom-24 right-8 z-30 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium" title="Scroll to bottom">
        <span>↓</span>
      </button>
    `;
  }

  bindEvents() {
    const btn = this.querySelector("#back-to-bottom");
    this._scrollHandler = () => {
      const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
      const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
      const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      const distanceFromBottom = documentHeight - (scrollTop + windowHeight);
      this.isAtBottom = distanceFromBottom < 80;

      btn.classList.toggle("hidden", this.isAtBottom);
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", this._scrollHandler, { passive: true });
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => this.scrollToBottom());
  }

  scrollToBottom() {
    this.querySelector("#anchor")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("auto-scroll-anchor")) {
  customElements.define("auto-scroll-anchor", AutoScrollAnchor);
}
export default AutoScrollAnchor;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',

  }[char]));

const SIZE_CLASS = {
  sm: 'h-7 w-7 text-[10px]',
  md: 'h-9 w-9 text-xs',
  lg: 'h-11 w-11 text-sm',
};

const DOT_CLASS = {
  online: 'bg-emerald-500',
  away: 'bg-amber-400',
  offline: 'bg-zinc-400',
};

const initials = (name) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/**
 * AvatarGroup - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <avatar-group max="4" size="md"></avatar-group>
 * Properties: members (AvatarMember[])
 * Events: member-click (detail: member)
 */
export class AvatarGroupElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['max', 'size'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._members = [];
  }

  get members() {
    return this._members;
  }

  set members(value) {
    this._members = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex items-center -space-x-2');

    const size = SIZE_CLASS[this.getAttribute('size')] ? this.getAttribute('size') : 'md';
    const rawMax = this.getAttribute('max');
    const max = rawMax !== null && Number.isFinite(Number(rawMax)) ? Math.max(0, Number(rawMax)) : 4;
    const visible = this._members.slice(0, max);
    const overflow = this._members.length - visible.length;
    const sizeClass = SIZE_CLASS[size];
    const iconSize = size === 'sm' ? 12 : size === 'lg' ? 18 : 14;

    const avatars = visible
      .map((member) => {
        const inner = member.src
          ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(member.src)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
          : member.name && member.name.trim()
            ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(initials(member.name))}</span>`
            : uiIcon('user', { size: iconSize });
        const dot = member.status && DOT_CLASS[member.status]
          ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900 ${DOT_CLASS[member.status]}"></span>`
          : '';
        return `<button type="button" data-member-id="${escapeAttribute(member.id)}" title="${escapeAttribute(member.name)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(member.name)}"
          class="avatar-member relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold text-zinc-600 ring-2 ring-white transition-transform hover:z-10 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:z-10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}">
          ${inner}${dot}
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `${avatars}${
      overflow > 0
        ? `<span title="${overflow} more" class="relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-500 ring-2 ring-white dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:ring-zinc-900 ${sizeClass}">+${overflow}</span>`
        : ''
    }`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.avatar-member').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const member = this._members.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === node.getAttribute('data-member-id'));
        if (member) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('member-click', { detail: member }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('avatar-group')) {
  customElements.define('avatar-group', AvatarGroupElement);

    this._title = 'Built for the AI era';
    this._description = 'A curated atomic library assembled from real product patterns.';
    this._tiles = DEFAULT_TILES();
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const t = this.getAttribute('title');
    if (t) this._title = t;
    const d = this.getAttribute('description');
    if (d) this._description = d;
    this._tiles = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('tiles'), DEFAULT_TILES());
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'Built for the AI era';
    if (name === 'description') this._description = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'tiles') this._tiles = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_TILES());
    this._render();
  }

  get tiles() { return this._tiles; }
  set tiles(value) { this._tiles = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const tile = event.target.closest('[data-bento-tile]');
    if (tile) {
      const item = this._tiles.find((t) => t.id === tile.getAttribute('data-bento-tile'));
      if (item) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tile-click', { detail: { tile: item }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const tiles = Array.isArray(this._tiles) ? this._tiles : [];
    const tilesHtml = tiles
      .map((tile) => {
        const spanCls = SPAN_CLASS[tile.span] ?? '';
        const media = tile.media
          ? `<div data-bento-media="${escapeAttribute(tile.id)}" class="mt-3 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800"><img src="${escapeAttribute(tile.media)}" alt="" class="h-28 w-full object-cover" loading="lazy" /></div>`
          : '';
        return `<div data-bento-tile="${escapeAttribute(tile.id)}" class="group cursor-pointer rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 transition-all hover:border-violet-300 hover:shadow-md dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-violet-700 ${spanCls}">
          ${tile.icon ? `<div data-bento-icon="${escapeAttribute(tile.id)}" aria-hidden="true" class="mb-3 flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-violet-50 text-lg dark:bg-violet-950/50">${escapeAttribute(tile.icon)}</div>` : ''}
          <p data-bento-title="${escapeAttribute(tile.title)}" class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(tile.title)}</p>
          <p data-bento-description="${escapeAttribute(tile.id)}" class="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tile.description || '')}</p>
          ${media}
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-bento-grid class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/60 p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/60">
        <div data-bento-header class="mb-5 text-center">
          <p data-bento-heading class="text-lg font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <p data-bento-subtitle class="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._description)}</p>
        </div>
        <div data-bento-tiles class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">${tilesHtml}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('bento-feature-grid')) {
  customElements.define('bento-feature-grid', BentoFeatureGridElement);
}

export default BentoFeatureGridElement;

/**
 * BillingAddressForm - Vanilla Web Component
 * Billing address form: country select, address lines, optional rows with
 * "optional" tags, required-field validation, submit + saved feedback.
 *
 * Usage: <billing-address-form title="Billing details"></billing-address-form>
 * Properties: defaultValue ({country?,address1?,address2?,city?,state?,zip?}), countries, labels
 * Attributes: title, submit-label, show-optional ("false" hides optional rows)
 * Events: billing-address-submit (detail {address})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const DEFAULT_COUNTRIES = ['United States', 'Singapore', 'United Kingdom', 'Germany', 'Japan'];

export class BillingAddressFormElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'submit-label', 'show-optional'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._defaultValue = {};
    this._countries = DEFAULT_COUNTRIES;
    this._labels = {};
    this._submitted = null;
    this._bound = false;
    this._values = { country: '', address1: '', address2: '', city: '', state: '', zip: '' };
  }

  get defaultValue() {
    return this._defaultValue;
  }

  set defaultValue(value) {
    this._defaultValue = value && typeof value === 'object' ? { ...value } : {};
    this._resetValues();
    this._skipPreserve = true;
    this.render();
  }

  get countries() {
    return this._countries;
  }

  set countries(value) {
    this._countries = Array.isArray(value) && value.length ? value.map(String) : DEFAULT_COUNTRIES;
    this.render();
  }

  get labels() {
    return this._labels;
  }

  set labels(value) {
    this._labels = value && typeof value === 'object' ? { ...value } : {};
    this.render();
  }

  _resetValues() {
    const d = this._defaultValue;
    this._values = {
      country: d.country || this._countries[0] || '',
      address1: d.address1 || '',
      address2: d.address2 || '',
      city: d.city || '',
      state: d.state || '',
      zip: d.zip || '',
    };
    this._submitted = null;
    this._skipPreserve = false;
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'show-optional' && newValue === null) return;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._resetValues();
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const input = event.target.closest('[data-billing-input]');
        if (!input) return;
        const key = input.getAttribute('data-billing-input');
        if (key in this._values) {
          this._values[key] = input.value;
        }
        this._refreshValidity();
      });
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        const select = event.target.closest('[data-billing-country]');
        if (!select) return;
        this._values.country = select.value;
      });
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const btn = event.target.closest('[data-billing-address-submit]');
        if (!btn) return;
        if (btn.disabled) return;
        this._submit();
      });
    }
  }

  get _valid() {
    return (
      this._values.address1.trim() !== '' &&
      this._values.city.trim() !== '' &&
      this._values.zip.trim() !== ''
    );
  }

  _refreshValidity() {
    const btn = this.querySelector('[data-billing-address-submit]');
    if (btn) btn.disabled = !this._valid;
    const hint = this.querySelector('[data-billing-address-hint]');
    if (hint && this._valid) {
      hint.textContent = 'All required fields filled.';
      hint.setAttribute('data-billing-ready', '');
    } else if (hint) {
      hint.removeAttribute('data-billing-ready');
    }
  }

  _submit() {
    if (!this._valid) return;
    const v = this._values;
    const address = {
      country: v.country,
      address1: v.address1,
      address2: v.address2 || undefined,
      city: v.city,
      state: v.state || undefined,
      zip: v.zip,
    };
    this._submitted = address;
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('billing-address-submit', { detail: { address: { ...address } } }));
  }

  render() {
    if (this._bound && !this._submitted && !this._skipPreserve) {
      // preserve live input state across re-renders
      const current = {};
      this.querySelectorAll('[data-billing-input]').forEach((el) => {
        const key = el.getAttribute('data-billing-input');
        current[key] = el.value;
      });
      Object.keys(current).forEach((key) => {
        if (current[key] !== undefined) this._values[key] = current[key];
      });
      const countryEl = this.querySelector('[data-billing-country]');
      if (countryEl) this._values.country = countryEl.value;
    }
    this._skipPreserve = false;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Billing details';
    const submitLabel = this.getAttribute('submit-label') || 'Continue to next step';
    const showOptional = this.getAttribute('show-optional') !== 'false';
    const labels = this._labels;
    const v = this._values;

    const inputClass =
      'min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200';
    const labelClass = 'w-24 shrink-0 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400';

    const optionalTag = '<span class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">optional</span>';

    const options = this._countries
      .map((c) => `<option value="${escapeAttribute(c)}" ${c === v.country ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(c)}</option>`)
      .join('');

    const feedback = this._submitted
      ? `<span data-billing-address-saved class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">Saved ${escapeAttribute(this._submitted.city)}, ${escapeAttribute(this._submitted.country)}</span>`
      : `<span data-billing-address-hint class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Address, city and ZIP are required.</span>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-billing-address-form class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <p data-billing-address-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>

        <label data-billing-country-wrap class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="${labelClass}">Country</span>
          <select data-billing-country class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200">${options}</select>
        </label>

        <label data-billing-field-wrap class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="${labelClass}">${escapeAttribute(labels.address1 || 'Address line 1')}</span>
          <input data-billing-input="address1" data-billing-address1 value="${escapeAttribute(v.address1)}" placeholder="Street address" class="${inputClass}" />
        </label>

        ${showOptional ? `
        <label data-billing-field-wrap class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="${labelClass}">${escapeAttribute(labels.address2 || 'Address line 2')}</span>
          ${optionalTag}
          <input data-billing-input="address2" data-billing-address2 value="${escapeAttribute(v.address2)}" placeholder="Apt, suite, unit" class="${inputClass}" />
        </label>` : ''}

        <div class="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <label data-billing-city-wrap class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(labels.city || 'City')}</span>
            <input data-billing-input="city" data-billing-city value="${escapeAttribute(v.city)}" class="${inputClass}" />
          </label>
          <label data-billing-zip-wrap class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(labels.zip || 'ZIP')}</span>
            <input data-billing-input="zip" data-billing-zip value="${escapeAttribute(v.zip)}" class="${inputClass}" />
          </label>
        </div>

        ${showOptional ? `
        <label data-billing-state-wrap class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
          <span class="${labelClass}">${escapeAttribute(labels.state || 'State')}</span>
          ${optionalTag}
          <input data-billing-input="state" data-billing-state value="${escapeAttribute(v.state)}" class="${inputClass}" />
        </label>` : ''}

        <div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          ${feedback}
          <button type="button" data-billing-address-submit ${this._valid ? '' : 'disabled'}
            class="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">${escapeAttribute(submitLabel)}</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

export default BillingAddressFormElement;

if (!customElements.get('billing-address-form')) {
  customElements.define('billing-address-form', BillingAddressFormElement);
}

/**
 * BillingPanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage:
 *   <billing-panel plan-name="Scale" price="$207" price-suffix="Per month" cta-label="Upgrade now"
 *     period="monthly" note="14-day trial." features="Unlimited models,Priority support"
 *     line-items='[{"label":"Subtotal","amount":"$207.00"},{"label":"Tax (15%)","amount":"$31.05"},{"label":"Total","amount":"$238.05","emphasized":true}]'></billing-panel>
 * Attributes: plan-name, period (monthly|annual), price, price-suffix, features (comma-separated),
 *             line-items (JSON array), cta-label, note
 * Events: period-change (detail: { period }), cta
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class BillingPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['plan-name', 'period', 'price', 'price-suffix', 'features', 'line-items', 'cta-label', 'note'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const planName = this.getAttribute('plan-name') || '';
    const period = this.getAttribute('period') === 'annual' ? 'annual' : 'monthly';
    const price = this.getAttribute('price') || '';
    const priceSuffix = this.getAttribute('price-suffix') || '';
    const ctaLabel = this.getAttribute('cta-label') || '';
    const note = this.getAttribute('note') || '';
    const features = (this.getAttribute('features') || '').split(',').map((f) => f.trim()).filter(Boolean);

    let lineItems = [];
    try {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('line-items');
      if (raw) lineItems = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch {
      lineItems = [];
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(lineItems)) lineItems = [];

    const check =
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>';
    const info =
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v5M12 8h.01"/></svg>';

    const periodToggle = `<div role="group" aria-label="Billing period"
      class="flex shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-0.5 dark:border-zinc-700">
      ${['monthly', 'annual']
        .map(
          (p) => `<button type="button" data-period="${p}" aria-pressed="${period === p}"
          class="rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${
            period === p
              ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900'
              : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
          }">${p === 'monthly' ? 'Monthly' : 'Annual'}</button>`
        )
        .join('')}
    </div>`;

    const featuresHtml = features.length
      ? `<ul class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">${features
          .map(
            (feature) =>
              `<li class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300"><span class="shrink-0 text-emerald-500">${check}</span>${escapeAttribute(feature)}</li>`
          )
          .join('')}</ul>`
      : '';

    const itemsHtml = lineItems.length
      ? `<dl class="mt-4 space-y-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">${lineItems
          .map(
            (item) => `<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 ${
              item.emphasized
                ? 'border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50'
                : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
            }">
              <dt class="text-xs">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</dt>
              <dd class="text-xs font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(item.amount)}</dd>
            </div>`
          )
          .join('')}</dl>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div class="min-w-0">
          <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">Upgrade to</p>
          <h3 class="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(planName)}</h3>
        </div>
        ${periodToggle}
      </div>
      <p class="mt-3 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
        <span class="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(price)}</span>
        ${priceSuffix ? `<span class="text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(priceSuffix)}</span>` : ''}
      </p>
      ${featuresHtml}
      ${itemsHtml}
      <button type="button" data-billing-cta
        class="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(ctaLabel)}</button>
      ${note ? `<p class="mt-2.5 flex items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-sky-50 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300"><span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0">${info}</span>${escapeAttribute(note)}</p>` : ''}
    </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-period]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.setAttribute('period', button.getAttribute('data-period'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('period-change', { detail: { period: button.getAttribute('data-period') } }));
      });
    });
    const cta = this.querySelector('[data-billing-cta]');
    if (cta) cta.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cta')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('billing-panel')) {
  customElements.define('billing-panel', BillingPanelElement);
}
export default BillingPanelElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\BlogPostArticle.js =====

/**
 * BlogPostArticle - Blog article page: top bar with logo and search, left
 * "On this page" nav highlight, article body with headings, paragraphs,
 * inline code, and a dark code block with Copy button (Hashnode article
 * pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_BLOCKS = () => [
  { type: 'paragraph', text: 'Front-end development is the process of designing and building the part of a website or web application that users interact with directly. It involves creating the structure, layout, and interactive features of a webpage, ensuring a seamless user experience.' },
  { type: 'heading', text: 'Key Technologies in Front-End Development', id: 'key-technologies', level: 2 },
  { type: 'paragraph', text: 'Front-end development primarily relies on three core technologies: HTML, CSS and JavaScript.' },
  { type: 'list', items: ['HTML provides the basic structure of a webpage.', 'CSS controls the presentation and layout.', 'JavaScript adds interactivity and dynamic behavior.'] },
  { type: 'heading', text: '1. HTML (HyperText Markup Language)', id: 'html', level: 3 },
  { type: 'paragraph', text: 'HTML provides the basic structure of a webpage. It defines elements such as headings, paragraphs, images, links, and forms.' },
  {
    type: 'code',
    language: 'html',
    code: '<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html>\n  <head>\n    <title>My First Web Page</title>\n  </head>\n  <body>\n    <h1>Welcome to Front-End Development</h1>\n    <p>This is an example of HTML structure.</p>\n  </body>\n</html>',
  },
];

const DEFAULT_TOC = () => [
  { id: 'key-technologies', text: 'Key Technologies in Front-End Development', level: 2 },
  { id: 'html', text: '1. HTML (HyperText Markup Language)', level: 3 },
];

class BlogPostArticleElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['site-name', 'title', 'subtitle', 'meta', 'blocks', 'toc', 'active-heading-id', 'code-label', 'copied-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._activeId = '';
    this._copied = false;
    this._copiedTimer = null;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    if (!this._activeId) {
      const toc = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('toc'), DEFAULT_TOC());
      this._activeId = this.getAttribute('active-heading-id') || toc[0]?.id || '';
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    if (this._copiedTimer) clearTimeout(this._copiedTimer);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const tocitem = event.target.closest('[data-blogpost-tocitem]');
    if (tocitem) {
      this._activeId = tocitem.getAttribute('data-blogpost-tocitem');
      const found = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('toc'), DEFAULT_TOC()).find((t) => t.id === this._activeId);
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('heading-click', { detail: { heading: found }, bubbles: true }));
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-blogpost-code-copy]')) {
      this._copied = true;
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('copy-code', { bubbles: true }));
      this._copiedTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this._copied = false;
        this._render();
      }, 1500);
    }
  }

  _blockHtml(block) {
    if (block.type === 'paragraph') {
      return `<p class="text-[15px] leading-7 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(block.text)}</p>`;
    }
    if (block.type === 'heading') {
      const isH3 = block.level === 3;
      return `<${isH3 ? 'h3' : 'h2'} id="${escapeAttribute(block.id)}" data-blogpost-heading="${escapeAttribute(block.id)}" class="font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50 ${isH3 ? 'mt-8 text-lg' : 'mt-10 text-xl'}">${escapeAttribute(block.text)}</${isH3 ? 'h3' : 'h2'}>`;
    }
    if (block.type === 'list') {

'true' : 'false'}" type="button" class="block w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-xs leading-5 transition-colors ${h.level === 3 ? 'pl-6' : ''} ${active ? 'bg-sky-50 font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/50 dark:text-sky-300' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(h.text)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const contentHtml = blocks.map((b) => this._blockHtml(b)).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-blogpost class="w-full border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950">

/**
 * BottomTabBar - Mobile-style bottom navigation bar: icon + label tabs,
 * active indicator, optional badge count and safe-area padding
 * (mobile web navigation pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_TABS = () => [
  { id: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: '⌂' },
  { id: 'search', label: 'Search', icon: '⌕', badge: 3 },
  { id: 'create', label: 'Create', icon: '+' },
  { id: 'inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: '✉', badge: 12 },
  { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: '◉' },
];

class BottomTabBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tabs', 'active', 'label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tabs = DEFAULT_TABS();
    this._active = 'home';
    this._label = 'Primary navigation';
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._tabs = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('tabs'), DEFAULT_TABS());
    const a = this.getAttribute('active');
    if (a) this._active = a;
    const l = this.getAttribute('label');
    if (l) this._label = l;
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'tabs') this._tabs = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_TABS());
    if (name === 'active') this._active = newValue || 'home';
    if (name === 'label') this._label = newValue || 'Primary navigation';
    this._render();
  }

  get tabs() { return this._tabs; }
  set tabs(value) { this._tabs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const tab = event.target.closest('[data-bottomtab-item]');
    if (!tab) return;
    this._active = tab.getAttribute('data-bottomtab-item') || 'home';
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tab-change', { detail: { id: this._active }, bubbles: true }));
    this._render();
  }

  _render() {
    const tabs = Array.isArray(this._tabs) ? this._tabs : [];
    const itemsHtml = tabs
      .map((tab) => {
        const isActive = tab.id === this._active;
        const itemCls = isActive
          ? 'flex flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-0.5 py-2 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400'
          : 'flex flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-0.5 py-2 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-500 dark:hover:text-zinc-300';
        const badge = tab.badge
          ? `<span data-bottomtab-badge="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" class="absolute -right-2 -top-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold leading-4 text-white">${escapeAttribute(String(tab.badge))}</span>`
          : '';
        return `<button type="button" data-bottomtab-item="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" aria-current="${isActive ? 'page' : 'false'}" class="relative ${itemCls}">
          <span data-bottomtab-icon="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" aria-hidden="true" class="text-lg leading-5">${escapeAttribute(tab.icon || '')}</span>
          <span data-bottomtab-label="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" class="text-[10px] font-medium">${escapeAttribute(tab.label || '')}</span>
          ${badge}
          <span data-bottomtab-indicator="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" aria-hidden="true" class="${isActive ? 'block' : 'hidden'} absolute -top-px inset-x-4 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-400"></span>
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <nav data-bottomtab-bar aria-label="${escapeAttribute(this._label)}" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-bottomtab-items class="flex items-stretch px-2 pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]">${itemsHtml}</div>
      </nav>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('bottom-tab-bar')) {
  customElements.define('bottom-tab-bar', BottomTabBarElement);
}

export default BottomTabBarElement;

/**
 * BrandPromptTable - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <brand-prompt-table title="Prompts" quota-used="49" quota-total="50"></brand-prompt-table>
 * Property: rows ([{id, prompt, topic?, visibility, sentiment, position, mentions?}])
 * Attributes: title, quota-used, quota-total
 * Events: add-prompt, row-click (detail {row})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class BrandPromptTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'quota-used', 'quota-total'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._rows = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-brand-add]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-prompt'));
          return;
        }
        const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-brand-row]');
        if (rowEl) {
          const row = this._rows.find((r) => r.id === rowEl.getAttribute('data-brand-row'));
          if (row) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-click', { detail: { row } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get rows() { return this._rows; }
  set rows(v) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((r) => ({ ...r })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this._rows.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Prompts');
    const quotaUsed = this.getAttribute('quota-used');
    const quotaTotal = this.getAttribute('quota-total');
    const hasQuota = quotaUsed !== null && quotaTotal !== null;
    const sentimentClass = (s) =>
      s >= 70 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : s >= 50 ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400';

    const body = this._rows.length === 0
      ? '<p data-brand-empty class="px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">No prompts tracked yet — add your first brand prompt.</p>'
      : `<table class="w-full text-left text-xs">
  <thead>
    <tr class="border-b border-zinc-200 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
      <th class="px-4 py-2 font-semibold">Prompt</th>
      <th class="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">Visibility</th>
      <th class="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">Sentiment</th>
      <th class="px-3 py-2 font-semibold">Position</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    ${this._rows.map((row) => `
    <tr data-brand-row="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-100 transition-colors last:border-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40">
      <td class="max-w-xs truncate px-4 py-2.5 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(row.prompt)}</td>
      <td data-brand-visibility class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${row.visibility}%</td>
      <td data-brand-sentiment class="px-3 py-2.5 font-semibold ${sentimentClass(row.sentiment)}">${row.sentiment}</td>
      <td data-brand-position class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">#${row.position}</td>
    </tr>`).join('')}
  </tbody>
</table>`;

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-brand-prompt-table class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
      <h3 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</h3>
      ${hasQuota ? `<span data-brand-quota class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(quotaUsed)} / ${escapeAttribute(quotaTotal)} prompts</span>` : ''}
    </div>
    <button type="button" data-brand-add class="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500">+ Add Prompt</button>
  </div>
  ${body}
</div>`;
  }
}

  customElements.define('brand-prompt-table', BrandPromptTableElement);

===== FILE: vanilla\Breadcrumb.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

// Only allow safe URL protocols into <a href> (blocks javascript:/data:/vbscript:)
const isSafeHref = (href) => {
  if (typeof href !== 'string') return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith('//') || t.startsWith('/') || t.startsWith('./') || t.startsWith('../')) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

const BASE = 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1 py-0.5 transition-colors';
const LINK_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';

/**
 * Breadcrumb - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <breadcrumb-trail max-items="4"></breadcrumb-trail>
 * Properties: items ({ id?, label, href?, icon? }[])
 * Attributes: max-items, aria-label
 * Events: navigate (detail: { item, index })
 */
export class BreadcrumbElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['max-items', 'aria-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = null;
  }

  get items() {
    if (this._items !== null) return this._items;
    const raw = this.getAttribute('items');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get maxItems() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('max-items');
    const value = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 0;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _trail() {
    const items = this.items;
    const maxItems = this.maxItems;
    if (maxItems <= 0 || items.length <= maxItems) return items;
    const tail = Math.max(1, maxItems - 1);
    return [items[0], null, ...items.slice(items.length - tail)];
  }

  _content(item) {
    return `${item.icon ? uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 12 }) : ''}<span>${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const trail = this._trail();
    const ariaLabel = this.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Breadcrumb';

    const rows = trail
      .map((item, index) => {
        const last = index === trail.length - 1;
        const separator =
          index > 0
            ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 11 })}</span>`
            : '';

        let body;
        if (!item) {
          body = '<span aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-zinc-400">…</span>';
        } else if (last) {
          body = `<span aria-current="page" class="${BASE} font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${this._content(item)}</span>`;
        } else if (item.href && isSafeHref(item.href)) {
          body = `<a href="${escapeAttribute(item.href)}" data-breadcrumb-index="${index}" class="${BASE} ${LINK_CLASS}">${this._content(item)}</a>`;
        } else {
          body = `<button type="button" data-breadcrumb-index="${index}" class="${BASE} ${LINK_CLASS}">${this._content(item)}</button>`;
        }

        return `<li class="flex items-center gap-1.5">${separator}${body}</li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<nav aria-label="${escapeAttribute(ariaLabel)}"><ol class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">${rows}</ol></nav>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-breadcrumb-index]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const index = Number(node.getAttribute('data-breadcrumb-index'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('navigate', { detail: { item: trail[index], index } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('breadcrumb-trail')) {
  customElements.define('breadcrumb-trail', BreadcrumbElement);
}
export default BreadcrumbElement;

    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class CampsiteHandoffElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['items', 'summary'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._items = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._items.length) {
      this._items = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('items'), [
        { id: 'h1', label: 'Redlines attached for spacing scale', done: true, assignee: 'Alex Smith', due: 'Nov 12' },
        { id: 'h2', label: 'Empty states exported to Lottie', done: true, assignee: 'Brook Taylor', due: 'Nov 13' },
        { id: 'h3', label: 'Motion spec review with eng', done: false, assignee: 'Casey Morgan', due: 'Nov 15' },
      ]);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'items' && !this._items.length) {
      this._items = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('items'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }
  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  get summary() {
    return this.getAttribute('summary') ?? '3 handoff tasks, 2 done. Motion spec review is still open and due Nov 15 — the only blocker for a clean handoff.';
  }
  set summary(value) {
    this.setAttribute('summary', value);
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const itemEl = event.target.closest('[data-campsite-handoff-item]');
    if (!itemEl) return;
    const item = this._items.find((i) => String(i.id) === itemEl.getAttribute('data-campsite-handoff-item'));
    if (item) {
      item.done = !item.done;
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { item }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const doneCount = this._items.filter((i) => i.done).length;
    const initialsFor = (name) =>
      String(name ?? '')
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((part) => part[0] ?? '')
        .join('')
        .slice(0, 2)
        .toUpperCase();
    const itemsHtml = this._items
      .map((item) => {
        const assignee = item.assignee
          ? `<span data-campsite-handoff-assignee title="${escapeAttribute(item.assignee)}" class="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-[9px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">${escapeAttribute(initialsFor(item.assignee))}</span>`
          : '';
        const due = item.due
          ? `<span data-campsite-handoff-due class="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(item.due)}</span>`
          : '';
        return `
        <label data-campsite-handoff-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-2 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <input type="checkbox" data-campsite-handoff-check ${item.done ? 'checked' : ''} class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded accent-indigo-500" />
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs ${item.done ? 'text-zinc-400 line-through dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
          ${assignee}
          ${due}
        </label>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-campsite-handoff class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 data-campsite-handoff-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Design handoff</h3>
          <span data-campsite-handoff-count class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${doneCount}/${this._items.length} done</span>
        </div>
        <div data-campsite-handoff-items class="mt-3 space-y-2">${itemsHtml}</div>
        <div data-campsite-handoff-summary class="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 p-3 dark:bg-indigo-950/40">
          <p class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-300">
            <span aria-hidden="true">✦</span>
            AI summary
          </p>
          <p class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-200">${escapeAttribute(this.summary)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

  customElements.define('campsite-handoff', CampsiteHandoffElement);
