export class ColumnVisibilityMenuElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['columns', 'visible-ids', 'show-reorder-handles', 'apply-mode', 'reset-label', 'apply-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._columns = [];
    this._visibleIds = [];
    this._draft = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._columns.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('columns');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._columns = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._columns = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._visibleIds.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('visible-ids');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._visibleIds = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._visibleIds = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const toggle = event.target.closest('[data-column-toggle]');
        if (toggle) {
          const rowEl = toggle.closest('[data-column-row]');
          const column = this._columns.find((item) => item.id === rowEl?.getAttribute('data-column-row'));
          if (column && !column.locked) this.toggleColumn(column);
          return;
        }
        const up = event.target.closest('[data-column-up]');
        if (up) {
          const rowEl = up.closest('[data-column-row]');
          const index = this._columns.findIndex((item) => item.id === rowEl?.getAttribute('data-column-row'));
          if (index > 0) {
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reorder', { detail: { from: index, to: index - 1 } }));
          }
          return;
        }
        const down = event.target.closest('[data-column-down]');
        if (down) {
          const rowEl = down.closest('[data-column-row]');
          const index = this._columns.findIndex((item) => item.id === rowEl?.getAttribute('data-column-row'));
          if (index >= 0 && index < this._columns.length - 1) {
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reorder', { detail: { from: index, to: index + 1 } }));
          }
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-column-reset]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reset'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-column-apply]')) {
          const ids = this.applyMode() === 'apply-button' ? [...(this._draft || this.defaultVisible())] : [...this.visibleIdsResolved()];
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apply', { detail: { visibleIds: ids } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get columns() {
    return this._columns;
  }

  set columns(value) {
    this._columns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._draft = null;
    this.render();
  }

  get visibleIds() {
    return this._visibleIds;
  }

  set visibleIds(value) {
    this._visibleIds = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._draft = null;
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  applyMode() {
    return this.getAttribute('apply-mode') || 'instant';
  }

  defaultVisible() {
    return this._columns.filter((column) => !column.hidden).map((column) => column.id);
  }

  visibleIdsResolved() {
    return this._visibleIds.length ? this._visibleIds : this.defaultVisible();
  }

  isVisible(column) {
    if (column.locked) return true;
    if (this.applyMode() === 'apply-button') {
      if (!this._draft) this._draft = new Set(this.visibleIdsResolved());
      return this._draft.has(column.id);
    }
    return this.visibleIdsResolved().includes(column.id);
  }

  toggleColumn(column) {
    const nextVisible = !this.isVisible(column);
    if (this.applyMode() === 'apply-button') {
      if (!this._draft) this._draft = new Set(this.visibleIdsResolved());
      if (nextVisible) this._draft.add(column.id);
      else this._draft.delete(column.id);
    } else {
      const current = this.visibleIdsResolved();
      this._visibleIds = nextVisible
        ? [...current, column.id]
        : current.filter((id) => id !== column.id);
    }
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id: column.id, visible: nextVisible } }));
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const showHandles = this.getAttribute('show-reorder-handles') !== 'false';
    const applyMode = this.applyMode();
    const resetLabel = this.getAttribute('reset-label') || 'Reset to default';
    const applyLabel = this.getAttribute('apply-label') || 'Apply';
    const visibleCount = this._columns.filter((column) => this.isVisible(column)).length;
    const rowsHtml = this._columns
      .map((column) => {
        const visible = this.isVisible(column);
        const rowClass = column.locked ? 'opacity-60' : '';
        const toggleClass = visible
          ? 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'
          : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-600';
        const handleColumn = showHandles && !column.locked
          ? `<span class="flex shrink-0 flex-col text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600" aria-hidden="true">${GRIP_SVG}</span>`
          : '<span class="w-3 shrink-0"></span>';
        const lockIcon = column.locked ? LOCK_SVG : '';
        const toggleButton = `<button type="button" data-column-toggle aria-label="${escapeAttribute(`${visible ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} ${column.label}`)}"${column.locked ? ' disabled' : ''} class="shrink-0 rounded p-1 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${toggleClass}">${visible ? EYE_OPEN_SVG : EYE_OFF_SVG}</button>`;
        const reorderColumn = showHandles && !column.locked
          ? `<span class="flex shrink-0 flex-col">
              <button type="button" data-column-up aria-label="Move ${escapeAttribute(column.label)} up" class="rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${UP_SVG}</button>
              <button type="button" data-column-down aria-label="Move ${escapeAttribute(column.label)} down" class="rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${DOWN_SVG}</button>
            </span>`
          : '<span class="w-2.5 shrink-0"></span>';
        return `<li data-column-row="${escapeAttribute(column.id)}" data-column-visible="${visible ? 'true' : 'false'}">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 ${rowClass}">
            ${handleColumn}
            ${lockIcon}
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(column.label)}</span>
            ${toggleButton}
            ${reorderColumn}
          </div>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');
    const footer =
      applyMode === 'apply-button'
        ? `<div class="border-t border-zinc-100 p-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <button type="button" data-column-apply class="w-full rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">${escapeAttribute(applyLabel)}</button>
          </div>`
        : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-column-visibility-menu class="w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <p data-column-count class="text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Showing <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${visibleCount}</span> of ${this._columns.length}</p>
        <button type="button" data-column-reset class="text-xs font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(resetLabel)}</button>
      </div>
      <ul class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto py-1">${rowsHtml}</ul>
      ${footer}
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('column-visibility-menu')) {
  customElements.define('column-visibility-menu', ColumnVisibilityMenuElement);
}

export default ColumnVisibilityMenuElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\ComboBox.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

let comboSeq = 0;

/**
 * ComboBox - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <combo-select placeholder="Search models…"></combo-select>
 * Properties: options ({ value, label, description?, icon? }[])
 * Attributes: placeholder, empty-text
 * Events: change (detail: { value })
 */
export class ComboBoxElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['placeholder', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._options = [];
    this._open = false;
    this._query = '';
    this._active = 0;
    this._selected = null;
    this._id = `combo-${++comboSeq}`;
    this._boundDocMouseDown = (event) => {
      if (!this.contains(event.target)) this._setOpen(false);
    };
    this._boundDocKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') this._setOpen(false);
    };
  }

  get options() {
    return this._options;
  }

  set options(value) {
    this._options = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get placeholder() {
    return this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Search…';
  }

  get emptyText() {
    return this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No matches found.';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._boundDocMouseDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._boundDocKeyDown);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._boundDocMouseDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._boundDocKeyDown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _filtered() {
    const q = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return this._options;
    return this._options.filter(
      (option) =>
        String(option.label).toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(option.description ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }

  _setOpen(open) {
    this._open = open;
    this.render();
  }

  _choose(option) {
    this._selected = option.value;
    this._query = option.label;
    this._open = false;
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { value: option.value } }));
  }

  _renderField() {
    const focused = this.contains(document.activeElement) && document.activeElement?.tagName === 'INPUT';
    return `<div class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs transition-colors dark:bg-zinc-900 ${
      this._open
        ? 'border-indigo-500 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20 dark:border-indigo-400'
        : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:border-zinc-600'
    }">
      <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
      <input data-combo-input role="combobox" aria-expanded="${this._open}" aria-controls="${this._id}-listbox"
        aria-autocomplete="list" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(this.placeholder)}" value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}"
        placeholder="${escapeAttribute(this.placeholder)}"
        class="w-full bg-transparent text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100" />
      ${
        this._query
          ? `<button type="button" data-combo-clear aria-label="Clear" class="shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 6 6 18"/><path d="m6 6 12 12"/></svg></button>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>`;
  }

  _renderListbox(filtered) {
    if (!this._open) return '';
    const items = filtered
      .map((option, index) => {
        const isActive = index === this._active;
        const isSelected = this._selected === option.value;
        return `<li data-combo-index="${index}" role="option" aria-selected="${isSelected}"
          class="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs ${isActive ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40' : ''}">
          ${option.icon ? `<span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon(option.icon, { size: 13 })}</span>` : ''}
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(option.label)}</span>
            ${option.description ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[10.5px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(option.description)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          ${isSelected ? `<span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('check', { size: 13 })}</span>` : ''}
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');
    const body = filtered.length
      ? items
      : `<li role="option" aria-disabled="true" class="px-2.5 py-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this.emptyText)}</li>`;
    return `<ul id="${this._id}-listbox" role="listbox" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(this.placeholder)}"
      class="absolute z-30 mt-1.5 max-h-64 w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">${body}</ul>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('relative block');
    const filtered = this._filtered();
    if (this._active >= filtered.length) this._active = Math.max(0, filtered.length - 1);

    this.innerHTML = `${this._renderField()}${this._renderListbox(filtered)}`;

    const input = this.querySelector('[data-combo-input]');
    if (input) {
      if (this.contains(document.activeElement) && document.activeElement?.tagName === 'INPUT') input.focus();
      input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        this._query = input.value;
        this._open = true;
        this._active = 0;
        this.render();
      });
      input.addEventListener('focus', () => this._setOpen(true));
      input.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
          event.preventDefault();
          this._open = true;
          this._active = Math.min(this._active + 1, this._filtered().length - 1);
          this.render();
        } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
          event.preventDefault();
          this._active = Math.max(this._active - 1, 0);
          this.render();
        } else if (event.key === 'Enter') {
          const option = this._filtered()[this._active];
          if (option && this._open) {
            event.preventDefault();
            this._choose(option);
          }
        }
      });
    }
    const clear = this.querySelector('[data-combo-clear]');
    if (clear) {
      clear.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._query = '';
        this._selected = null;
        this.render();
      });
    }
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-combo-index]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('mousedown', (event) => event.preventDefault());
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._choose(this._filtered()[Number(node.getAttribute('data-combo-index'))]));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('combo-select')) {
  customElements.define('combo-select', ComboBoxElement);
}
export default ComboBoxElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\CommandPalette.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class CommandPaletteElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'placeholder'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._activeIndex = 0;
    this._handleKey = this._handleKey.bind(this);
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(val) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get open() {
    return this.hasAttribute('open');
  }

  set open(val) {
    if (val) this.setAttribute('open', '');
    else this.removeAttribute('open');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._handleKey);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._handleKey);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldVal, newVal) {
    if (name === 'open' && this.open && oldVal !== newVal) {
      this._query = '';
      this._activeIndex = 0;
    }
    this.render();
    if (name === 'open' && this.open) {
      const input = this.querySelector('.cmd-input');
      if (input) input.focus();
    }
  }

  _getFiltered() {
    if (!this._query.trim()) return this._items;
    const q = this._query.toLowerCase();
    return this._items.filter(
      (i) =>
        (i.label && i.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (i.hint && i.hint.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (i.group && i.group.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }

  _handleKey(e) {
    if (!this.open) return;
    const filtered = this._getFiltered();
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._close();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._activeIndex = Math.min(filtered.length - 1, this._activeIndex + 1);
      this._renderList();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this._activeIndex = Math.max(0, this._activeIndex - 1);
      this._renderList();
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const item = filtered[this._activeIndex];
      if (item) this._select(item);
    }
  }

  _close() {
    this.open = false;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
  }

  _select(item) {
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: item }));
    this._close();
  }

  _itemHtml(item, idx, showGroup) {
    const isActive = idx === this._activeIndex;
    return `
      ${showGroup ? `<div class="px-2.5 pt-2.5 pb-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold tracking-wider text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.group)}</div>` : ''}
      <button
        type="button"
        data-item-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}"
        class="cmd-item w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-2.5 py-2 rounded-lg text-left text-sm transition-colors ${
          isActive ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
        }"
        role="option"
        aria-selected="${isActive}"
      >
        ${item.icon ? `<span class="p-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0">${uiIcon(item.icon, { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
        <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <span class="block truncate font-medium">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
          ${item.hint ? `<span class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.hint)}</span>` : ''}
        </span>
        ${item.shortcut ? `<kbd class="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shrink-0">${escapeAttribute(item.shortcut)}</kbd>` : ''}
      </button>
    `;
  }

  _renderList() {
    const listbox = this.querySelector('[role="listbox"]');
    if (!listbox) return;
    const filtered = this._getFiltered();
    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      listbox.innerHTML = '<div class="p-4 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400">No results found</div>';
      return;
    }
    let lastGroup;
    listbox.innerHTML = filtered
      .map((item, idx) => {
        const showGroup = item.group && item.group !== lastGroup;
        lastGroup = item.group;
        return this._itemHtml(item, idx, showGroup);
      })
      .join('');
    this._bindItems();
  }

  _bindItems() {
    this.querySelectorAll('.cmd-item').forEach((btn, idx) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const item = this._items.find((i) => i.id === btn.getAttribute('data-item-id'));
        if (item) this._select(item);
      });
      btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        this._activeIndex = idx;
        this.querySelectorAll('.cmd-item').forEach((b, i) => {
          b.classList.toggle('bg-zinc-100', i === idx);
          b.classList.toggle('dark:bg-zinc-800', i === idx);
        });
      });
    });
  }

  render() {
    if (!this.open) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Type a command or search...';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="cmd-backdrop fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-[15vh] bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Command palette">
        <div class="w-full max-w-lg mx-4 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
            ${uiIcon('search', { size: 16, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
            <input
              type="text"
              class="cmd-input w-full bg-transparent border-none text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
              placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}"
              value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}"
            />
            <kbd class="hidden sm:inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">ESC</kbd>
          </div>
          <div class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto p-1.5" role="listbox"></div>
          <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 px-4 py-2 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            ${[
              { keys: ['↑', '↓'], label: 'Navigate' },
              { keys: ['↵'], label: 'Select' },
              { keys: ['esc'], label: 'Close' },
            ]
              .map(
                ({ keys, label }) => `<span class="flex items-center gap-1">
                  ${keys.map((k) => `<kbd class="inline-flex min-w-[1.25rem] justify-center px-1 py-0.5 font-mono bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">${k}</kbd>`).join('')}
                  <span>${label}</span>
                </span>`
              )
              .join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    const backdrop = this.querySelector('.cmd-backdrop');
    const panel = backdrop?.querySelector('div');
    if (backdrop && panel) {
      backdrop.addEventListener('click', () => this._close());
      panel.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
    }

    const input = this.querySelector('.cmd-input');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        this._query = e.target.value;
        this._activeIndex = 0;
        this._renderList();
      });
    }

    this._renderList();
  }
}

  customElements.define('command-palette', CommandPaletteElement);

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/** Flat comments + parentId → depth-tagged render order (parents before children). */
const flattenComments = (comments) => {
  const children = new Map();
  const roots = [];
  comments.forEach((comment) => {
    if (comment.parentId == null) {
      roots.push(comment);
      return;
    }
    const key = String(comment.parentId);
    children.set(key, [...(children.get(key) || []), comment]);
  });
  const out = [];
  const walk = (list, depth) => {
    list.forEach((comment) => {
      out.push({ comment, depth });
      const replies = children.get(String(comment.id)) || [];
      if (depth < 2) walk(replies, depth + 1);
      else replies.forEach((child) => out.push({ comment: child, depth: depth + 1 }));
    });
  };
  walk(roots, 0);
  return out;
};

/**
 * CommentThread - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <comment-thread></comment-thread>
 * Properties: comments (CommentItem[], flat list linked by parentId)
 * Events: submit (detail: {text, parentId}), like (detail: comment), resolve (detail: comment)
 */
export class CommentThreadElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['placeholder', 'submit-text', 'allow-comment', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._comments = [];
    this._draft = '';
    this._replyTo = null;
    this._replyDraft = '';
  }

  get comments() {
    return this._comments;
  }

  set comments(value) {
    this._comments = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _submit(text, parentId) {
    const value = String(text || '').trim();
    if (!value) return;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('submit', { detail: { text: value, parentId } }));
    if (parentId == null) this._draft = '';
    else {
      this._replyDraft = '';
      this._replyTo = null;
    }
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Write a comment...';
    const submitText = this.getAttribute('submit-text') || 'Comment';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No comments yet. Start the conversation.';
    const allowComment = this.getAttribute('allow-comment') !== 'false';
    const rows = flattenComments(this._comments);

    const list = rows.length
      ? `<ul class="space-y-2.5">
          ${rows
            .map(({ comment, depth }) => {
              const replying = this._replyTo != null && String(this._replyTo) === String(comment.id);
              const avatar = comment.avatar
                ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(comment.avatar)}" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
                : escapeAttribute(initials(comment.author));
              return `<li class="${depth > 0 ? 'border-l border-zinc-200 pl-3 dark:border-zinc-700' : ''}" data-comment="${escapeAttribute(comment.id)}">
                <div class="flex items-start gap-2">
                  <span class="flex ${depth > 0 ? 'h-5 w-5' : 'h-6 w-6'} shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${avatar}</span>
                  <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5">
                      <span class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(comment.author)}</span>
                      ${comment.time ? `<span class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(comment.time)}</span>` : ''}
                      ${
                        comment.resolved
                          ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400">${uiIcon('check', { size: 9 })}Resolved</span>`
                          : ''
                      }
                    </div>
                    <p class="mt-0.5 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(comment.text)}</p>
                    <div class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                      <button type="button" class="comment-like inline-flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400" aria-label="Like comment by ${escapeAttribute(comment.author)}">${uiIcon('thumbs-up', { size: 11 })}<span class="tabular-nums">${comment.likes || 0}</span></button>
                      <button type="button" class="comment-reply transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400" aria-expanded="${replying}">Reply</button>
                      <button type="button" class="comment-resolve transition-colors hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-emerald-400">${comment.resolved ? 'Reopen' : 'Resolve'}</button>
                    </div>
                    ${
                      replying
                        ? `<div class="mt-2 flex items-end gap-1.5">
                            <textarea class="comment-reply-input flex-1 resize-none rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-200" rows="2" placeholder="Reply to ${escapeAttribute(comment.author)}..." aria-label="Reply to ${escapeAttribute(comment.author)}">${escapeAttribute(this._replyDraft)}</textarea>
                            <button type="button" class="comment-reply-send rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50" ${this._replyDraft.trim() ? '' : 'disabled'}>Reply</button>
                          </div>`
                        : ''
                    }
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : `<p class="py-4 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`;

    const composer = allowComment
      ? `<div class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <textarea class="comment-input w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-200" rows="2" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}">${escapeAttribute(this._draft)}</textarea>
          <div class="mt-1.5 flex justify-end">
            <button type="button" class="comment-send rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50" ${this._draft.trim() ? '' : 'disabled'}>${escapeAttribute(submitText)}</button>
          </div>
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = list + composer;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-comment]').forEach((node) => {
      const id = node.getAttribute('data-comment');
      const comment = this._comments.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
      if (!comment) return;

      node.querySelector('.comment-like').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('like', { detail: comment }));
      });

      node.querySelector('.comment-reply').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._replyTo = this._replyTo != null && String(this._replyTo) === String(id) ? null : comment.id;
        this._replyDraft = '';
        this.render();
      });

      node.querySelector('.comment-resolve').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('resolve', { detail: comment }));
      });

      const replyInput = node.querySelector('.comment-reply-input');
      if (replyInput) {
        replyInput.focus();
        replyInput.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
          this._replyDraft = event.target.value;
          node.querySelector('.comment-reply-send').disabled = !this._replyDraft.trim();
        });
        node.querySelector('.comment-reply-send').addEventListener('click', () => {
          this._submit(this._replyDraft, comment.id);
          this.render();
        });
      }
    });

    const input = this.querySelector('.comment-input');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        this._draft = event.target.value;
        this.querySelector('.comment-send').disabled = !this._draft.trim();
      });
      this.querySelector('.comment-send').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._submit(this._draft, null);
        this.render();
      });
    }
  }
}

  customElements.define('comment-thread', CommentThreadElement);

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE_META = {
  danger: {
    chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400',
    button: 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 focus-visible:ring-red-500',
    icon: 'alert-triangle',
  },
  warning: {
    chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400',
    button: 'bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 focus-visible:ring-amber-500',
    icon: 'alert-triangle',
  },
  default: {
    chip: 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400',
    button: 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
    icon: 'info',
  },
};

/**
 * ConfirmDialog - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <confirm-dialog open title="Delete project?" tone="danger"></confirm-dialog>
 * Events: confirm, cancel
 */
export class ConfirmDialogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'description', 'confirm-text', 'cancel-text', 'tone', 'require-text', 'loading'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._typed = '';
    this._onKeyDown = this._onKeyDown.bind(this);
  }

  get isOpen() {
    return this.hasAttribute('open');
  }

  set isOpen(value) {
    if (value) this.setAttribute('open', '');
    else this.removeAttribute('open');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Clear the type-to-confirm field whenever the dialog is (re)opened.
    if (this.isOpen) this._typed = '';
    this.render();
  }

  _onKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      // While a destructive action is in flight, Escape must not dismiss it.
      if (!this.hasAttribute('loading')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cancel'));
    }
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _closeEvent(name) {
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name));
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Are you sure?';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const confirmText = this.getAttribute('confirm-text') || 'Confirm';
    const cancelText = this.getAttribute('cancel-text') || 'Cancel';
    const requireText = this.getAttribute('require-text') || '';
    const loading = this.hasAttribute('loading');
    const tone = TONE_META[this.getAttribute('tone')] ? this.getAttribute('tone') : 'default';
    const meta = TONE_META[tone];

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (!this.isOpen) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
      return;
    }

    const blocked = requireText ? this._typed !== requireText : false;
    const canConfirm = !blocked && !loading;

    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="confirm-overlay fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}">
        <div class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-5 shadow-2xl">
          <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
            <span class="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${meta.chip}">${uiIcon(meta.icon, { size: 18 })}</span>
            <div class="min-w-0 pt-0.5">
              <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
              ${description ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>

          ${
            requireText
              ? `<div class="mt-4">
            <label class="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Type <span class="font-mono font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(requireText)}</span> to confirm</label>
            <input type="text" class="confirm-typed w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 px-2.5 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(requireText)}" value="${escapeAttribute(this._typed)}" />
          </div>`
              : ''
          }

          <div class="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2">
            <button type="button" class="confirm-cancel rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-50" ${loading ? 'disabled' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(cancelText)}</button>
            <button type="button" class="confirm-accept inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${meta.button}" ${canConfirm ? '' : 'disabled'}>
              ${loading ? `<span class="animate-spin">${uiIcon('loader', { size: 12 })}</span>` : ''}${escapeAttribute(confirmText)}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    const typedInput = this.querySelector('.confirm-typed');
    if (typedInput) {
      typedInput.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        this._typed = event.target.value;
        const accept = this.querySelector('.confirm-accept');
        if (accept) accept.disabled = this._typed !== requireText || loading;
      });
      typedInput.focus();
    }

    this.querySelector('.confirm-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!loading) this._closeEvent('cancel');
    });

    this.querySelector('.confirm-accept').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const blockedNow = requireText ? this._typed !== requireText : false;
      if (blockedNow || loading) return;
      this._closeEvent('confirm');
    });

    this.querySelector('.confirm-overlay').addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      if (event.target === event.currentTarget && !loading) this._closeEvent('cancel');
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('confirm-dialog')) {
  customElements.define('confirm-dialog', ConfirmDialogElement);
}
export default ConfirmDialogElement;

/**
 * ConnectorGrid - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <connector-grid title="Apps & Connectors"></connector-grid>
 * Properties: connectors ([{id, name, description?, icon?, connected?}])
 * Attributes: title, connect-text, connected-text
 * Events: toggle (detail {id, connected})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ConnectorGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'connect-text', 'connected-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._connectors = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const btn = event.target.closest('[data-connector-toggle]');
        if (btn) {
          const card = btn.closest('[data-connector]');
          if (card) {
            const id = card.getAttribute('data-connector');
            const current = this._connectors.find((c) => c.id === id);
            const connected = !current?.connected;
            // toggle local state so re-render shows the new label
            if (current) current.connected = connected;
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { id, connected } }));
            this.render();
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get connectors() { return this._connectors; }
  set connectors(v) {
    this._connectors = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((c) => ({ ...c })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before connectors are captured.
    if (this._connectors.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Apps & Connectors');
    const connectText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('connect-text') || 'Connect');
    const connectedText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('connected-text') || 'Connected');
    const connectedCount = this._connectors.filter((c) => c.connected).length;

    const cards = this._connectors.map((connector) => `
      <div data-connector="${escapeAttribute(connector.id)}" class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border px-3 py-3 transition-colors ${connector.connected ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-800 dark:bg-indigo-950/40' : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700'}">
        <div class="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-2.5">
          <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-zinc-100 text-base dark:bg-zinc-800" aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(connector.icon || '🔌')}</span>
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <p data-connector-name class="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(connector.name)}</p>
            ${connector.description ? `<p data-connector-desc class="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(connector.description)}</p>` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" data-connector-toggle class="shrink-0 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${connector.connected ? 'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200' : 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'}">${connector.connected ? `<span class="flex items-center gap-1"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" class="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4.5 10.5 3.5 3.5 7.5-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" /></svg>${connectedText}</span>` : connectText}</button>
      </div>`).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-connector-grid class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
    <span data-connector-count class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${connectedCount}/${this._connectors.length} connected</span>
  </div>
  <div class="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">${cards}</div>
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * ContentReviewTable - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <content-review-table title="Review content" rows='[...]'></content-review-table>
 * Attributes: title, rows (JSON: [{id,text,tags?,extraTags?,time?,status:'valid'|'error'}]),
 *             drafts-label, schedule-label
 * Events: row-select (detail {row}), save-drafts, schedule
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

export class ContentReviewTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'rows', 'drafts-label', 'schedule-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._rows = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._rows.length) this._rows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('rows'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const draftsBtn = event.target.closest('[data-review-drafts]');
        const scheduleBtn = event.target.closest('[data-review-schedule]');
        if (draftsBtn) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('save-drafts'));
          return;
        }
        if (scheduleBtn) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('schedule'));
          return;
        }
        const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-review-row]');
        if (!rowEl) return;
        const row = this._rows.find((r) => r.id === rowEl.getAttribute('data-review-row'));
        if (row) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-select', { detail: { row } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'rows' && !this._rows.length) {
      this._rows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('rows'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get rows() { return this._rows; }
  set rows(v) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((r) => ({ ...r })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const rows = this._rows;
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Review content');
    const draftsLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('drafts-label') || 'Save as Drafts');
    const scheduleLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('schedule-label') || 'Schedule Posts');
    const errors = rows.filter((r) => r.status === 'error').length;
    const valid = rows.length - errors;

    const body = rows.map((row, index) => {

      ).join('');

        ? `<span data-review-extra-tags class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">+${row.extraTags}</span>`

        <td data-review-text class="max-w-48 truncate py-2.5 pr-3 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(row.text)}</td>
        <td class="py-2.5 pr-3"><span class="flex items-center gap-1">${tags}${extra}</span></td>
        <td class="py-2.5 pr-3 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(row.time ?? 'Add to Queue')}</td>
        <td class="py-2.5 pr-4"><span aria-label="${escapeAttribute(row.status)}">${row.status === 'valid'
          ? '<span data-review-status class="text-emerald-500">✓</span>'
          : '<span data-review-status class="text-red-500">⚠</span>'}</span></td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-content-review class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${title}</span>
    <span class="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
      <span data-review-valid-count class="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">✓ ${valid} valid</span>
      <span data-review-error-count class="flex items-center gap-1 text-red-500 dark:text-red-400">⚠ ${errors} ${errors === 1 ? 'error' : 'errors'}</span>
    </span>
  </div>
  <table data-review-table class="w-full text-left">
    <thead>
      <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
        <th class="w-10 py-2 pl-4 font-medium">#</th>
        <th class="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">Text</th>
        <th class="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">Tags</th>
        <th class="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">Posting time</th>
        <th class="py-2 pr-4 font-medium">Status</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>

  </table>

  </div>
</div>`;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatNumber = (num) => {
  const n = Number(num) || 0;
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(n);
};

export class ContextUsageBadgeElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['used-tokens', 'max-tokens', 'model-name', 'compact'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._breakdown = [];
    this._isOpen = false;
  }

  get breakdown() {
    return this._breakdown;
  }

  set breakdown(val) {
    this._breakdown = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const used = Math.max(0, parseInt(this.getAttribute('used-tokens') || '0', 10) || 0);
    const max = Math.max(1, parseInt(this.getAttribute('max-tokens') || '1', 10) || 1);
    const model = this.getAttribute('model-name') || '';
    const compact = this.hasAttribute('compact');
    const percentage = Math.min(100, Math.round((used / max) * 100));

    let barColor = 'bg-emerald-500';
    if (percentage >= 90) barColor = 'bg-rose-500';
    else if (percentage >= 70) barColor = 'bg-amber-500';

    this._applyHostClass('relative inline-block text-xs font-sans select-none');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <button
        type="button"
        class="ctx-btn flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-colors shadow-sm"
        aria-label="Context Window Usage"
        aria-expanded="${this._isOpen}"
      >
        ${uiIcon('cpu', { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
        ${model && !compact ? `<span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium truncate max-w-[120px]">${escapeAttribute(model)}</span>` : ''}
        <div class="w-16 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
          <div class="h-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}" style="width: ${percentage}%"></div>
        </div>
        <span class="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">${percentage}%</span>
      </button>

      <div
        class="ctx-popover ${this._isOpen ? 'block' : 'hidden'} absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 w-64 p-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-xl z-30"
      >
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">Context Window</span>
          <span class="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500">${formatNumber(used)} / ${formatNumber(max)}</span>
        </div>
        ${model ? `
          <div class="pt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 flex justify-between">
            <span>Model</span>
            <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium">${escapeAttribute(model)}</span>
          </div>
        ` : ''}
        ${this._breakdown.length > 0 ? `
          <div class="pt-2.5 space-y-1.5">
            <div class="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-zinc-400 tracking-wider">Breakdown</div>
            ${this._breakdown.map((item) => `
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${escapeAttribute(item.colorClass || 'bg-zinc-400')}"></span>
                  ${escapeAttribute(item.label)}
                </span>
                <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">${formatNumber(item.count)}</span>
              </div>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        ` : ''}
      </div>
    `;

    const btn = this.querySelector('.ctx-btn');
    const pop = this.querySelector('.ctx-popover');
    if (btn && pop) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._isOpen = !this._isOpen;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(this._isOpen));
        if (this._isOpen) pop.classList.remove('hidden');
        else pop.classList.add('hidden');
      });
      btn.addEventListener('blur', () => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          this._isOpen = false;
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          pop.classList.add('hidden');
        }, 200);
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('context-usage-badge')) {
  customElements.define('context-usage-badge', ContextUsageBadgeElement);
}
export default ContextUsageBadgeElement;

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

export class CookieConsentElement extends HTMLElement {

    super();

  }

    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Choose how we use your personal information';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || 'We use cookies to personalize content, run analytics and improve your experience.';
    const policyLabel = this.getAttribute('policy-label') || 'Privacy Policy';
    const acceptLabel = this.getAttribute('accept-label') || 'Accept All';
    const rejectLabel = this.getAttribute('reject-label') || 'Reject All';
    const saveLabel = this.getAttribute('save-label') || 'Confirm';

    const optional = this._categories.filter((category) => !category.alwaysActive);

      <div class="mt-4 space-y-2">
        ${ordered
          .map(

    const acceptBtn = this.querySelector('[data-consent-accept]');
    if (acceptBtn) acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => emitConfirm(acceptedOf(this._categories.map((c) => c.id))));
    const rejectBtn = this.querySelector('[data-consent-reject]');
    if (rejectBtn) rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => emitConfirm(acceptedOf(always.map((c) => c.id))));
    const saveBtn = this.querySelector('[data-consent-save]');
    if (saveBtn) saveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => emitConfirm(acceptedOf(always.map((c) => c.id))));
  }

/**
 * CreationComposer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <creation-composer placeholder="..."></creation-composer>
 * Attributes: open, placeholder, image-assist, resolution, count,
 *             resolutions (JSON), counts (JSON)
 * Events: image-assist-change (detail {enabled}), resolution-change (detail {resolution}),
 *         count-change (detail {count}), submit (detail {prompt, imageAssist, resolution, count})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

export class CreationComposerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'placeholder', 'image-assist', 'resolution', 'count', 'resolutions', 'counts'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._resolutions = null;
    this._counts = null;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-creation-assist-toggle]')) {
          const enabled = this.getAttribute('image-assist') !== 'true';
          this.setAttribute('image-assist', String(enabled));
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('image-assist-change', { detail: { enabled } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-creation-submit]')) {
          const input = this.querySelector('[data-creation-input]');
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('submit', {
            detail: {
              prompt: input?.value ?? '',
              imageAssist: this.getAttribute('image-assist') === 'true',
              resolution: this.getAttribute('resolution') || '2K',
              count: Number(this.getAttribute('count') || '1'),
            },
          }));
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        const resEl = event.target.closest('[data-creation-resolution]');
        if (resEl) {
          this.setAttribute('resolution', resEl.value);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('resolution-change', { detail: { resolution: resEl.value } }));
          return;
        }
        const countEl = event.target.closest('[data-creation-count]');
        if (countEl) {
          this.setAttribute('count', countEl.value);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('count-change', { detail: { count: Number(countEl.value) } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'resolutions') this._resolutions = null;
    if (name === 'counts') this._counts = null;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get resolutions() {
    if (!this._resolutions) this._resolutions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('resolutions'), ['1K', '2K', '4K']);
    return this._resolutions;
  }
  set resolutions(v) {
    this._resolutions = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(String) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get counts() {
    if (!this._counts) this._counts = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('counts'), [1, 2, 4]);
    return this._counts;
  }
  set counts(v) {
    this._counts = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(Number) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if ((this.getAttribute('open') || 'true') === 'false') {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const placeholder = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Ad creative, product shot, social post…');
    const imageAssist = this.getAttribute('image-assist') === 'true';
    const resolution = this.getAttribute('resolution') || '2K';
    const count = this.getAttribute('count') || '1';

    const resOptions = this.resolutions.map((r) => `<option value="${escapeAttribute(r)}" ${r === resolution ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(r)}</option>`).join('');
    const countOptions = this.counts.map((c) => `<option value="${c}" ${String(c) === count ? 'selected' : ''}>${c}×</option>`).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-creation-composer class="w-full max-w-xl rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
      <button type="button" data-creation-image aria-label="Attach image" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 p-1.5 text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">🖼</button>
      <button type="button" data-creation-assist-toggle role="switch" aria-checked="${imageAssist}" class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${imageAssist ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700'}">
        Image Assist
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="inline-block h-3.5 w-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${imageAssist ? 'bg-white/80' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600'}">
          <span class="block h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full shadow transition-transform ${imageAssist ? 'translate-x-2.5 bg-indigo-600' : 'translate-x-0 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-200'}"></span>
        </span>
      </button>
    </div>
    <button type="button" data-creation-idea aria-label="Prompt ideas" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 p-1.5 text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">💡</button>
  </div>
  <textarea data-creation-input rows="3" placeholder="${placeholder}" aria-label="Creation prompt" class="mt-2 w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:border-indigo-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-500 dark:focus:border-indigo-500"></textarea>
  <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
    <select data-creation-resolution aria-label="Resolution" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300">${resOptions}</select>
    <select data-creation-count aria-label="Count" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300">${countOptions}</select>
    <button type="button" data-creation-submit class="rounded-md bg-violet-600 px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-violet-500">Create</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('creation-composer')) {

export class CreditBalanceCardElement extends HTMLElement {

    this._bound = false;
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (newValue === null && ['warn-below'].includes(name)) return;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-credit-balance-buy]')) {
          this._pulse();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('credit-buy'));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-credit-balance-coupon]')) {
          this._pulse();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('credit-coupon'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._pulseTimer) clearTimeout(this._pulseTimer);
  }

  _pulse() {
    const btn = this.querySelector('[data-credit-balance-buy]');
    if (!btn) return;
    btn.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-emerald-300', 'ring-offset-1');
    if (this._pulseTimer) clearTimeout(this._pulseTimer);
    this._pulseTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      btn.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-emerald-300', 'ring-offset-1');
    }, 600);
  }

  render() {
    const balance = Number.parseFloat(this.getAttribute('balance') || '0') || 0;
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || 'credits';
    const plan = this.getAttribute('plan') || 'Current plan';
    const currency = this.getAttribute('currency') || '';
    const warnRaw = this.getAttribute('warn-below');
    const warnBelow = warnRaw === null ? null : Number.parseFloat(warnRaw);
    const buyLabel = this.getAttribute('buy-label') || 'Buy More Credits';
    const couponLabel = this.getAttribute('coupon-label') || 'Apply Coupon';

    const low = typeof warnBelow === 'number' && balance < warnBelow;
    const formatted = balance.toFixed(2);

    const planBadge = low
      ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400'
      : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300';
    const dot = low ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-emerald-500';
    const valueColor = low ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50';
    const border = low ? 'border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/60' : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-credit-balance-card class="rounded-xl border bg-white p-4 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${border}">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <p data-credit-balance-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Credit Balance</p>
          <span data-credit-balance-plan class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${planBadge}">
            <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${dot}" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            ${escapeAttribute(plan)}
          </span>
        </div>

        <p class="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-2">
          <span data-credit-balance-value class="font-mono text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight ${valueColor}">${escapeAttribute(currency)}${formatted}</span>
          <span data-credit-balance-unit class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(unit)}</span>
        </p>

        ${low ? `<p data-credit-balance-warning class="mt-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">Balance is running low — top up to avoid interruptions.</p>` : ''}

        <div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button type="button" data-credit-balance-buy
            class="rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:bg-emerald-500">${escapeAttribute(buyLabel)}</button>
          <button type="button" data-credit-balance-coupon
            class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(couponLabel)}</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

export default CreditBalanceCardElement;

if (!customElements.get('credit-balance-card')) {
  customElements.define('credit-balance-card', CreditBalanceCardElement);
