===== FILE: vanilla\DataTable.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const alignClass = (align) => (align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : align === 'center' ? 'text-center' : 'text-left');

export class DataTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['columns', 'rows', 'selectable', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._columns = [];
    this._rows = [];
    this._sortKey = null;
    this._sortDir = 'asc';
    this._selected = new Set();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get columns() {
    if (this._columns.length) return this._columns;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('columns') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set columns(value) {
    this._columns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get rows() {
    if (this._rows.length) return this._rows;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('rows') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set rows(value) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._selected = new Set();
    this.render();
  }

  get actions() {
    return this._actions || [];
  }

  set actions(value) {
    this._actions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get selectable() {
    return this.hasAttribute('selectable') && this.getAttribute('selectable') !== 'false';
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _sortedRows() {
    const rows = this.rows;
    if (!this._sortKey) return rows;
    const dir = this._sortDir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
    return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
      const av = a[this._sortKey];
      const bv = b[this._sortKey];
      if (av === bv) return 0;
      return (String(av ?? '') > String(bv ?? '') ? 1 : -1) * dir;
    });
  }

  render() {
    const columns = this.columns;
    const rows = this._sortedRows();
    const actions = this.actions;
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No results';
    const selectable = this.selectable;
    const allSelected = rows.length > 0 && this._selected.size === rows.length;

    this._applyHostClass('relative');

    const headCells = columns
      .map((column) => {
        const icon = this._sortKey === column.key ? (this._sortDir === 'asc' ? 'arrow-up' : 'arrow-down') : 'chevron-down';
        return `<th style="${column.width ? `width:${escapeAttribute(column.width)}` : ''}" class="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${alignClass(column.align)}">
          <button type="button" data-sort="${escapeAttribute(column.key)}" class="sort-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">
            ${escapeAttribute(column.label)}<span class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">${uiIcon(icon, { size: 11 })}</span>
          </button>
        </th>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const bodyRows =
      rows.length === 0
        ? `<tr><td colspan="${columns.length + (selectable ? 1 : 0) + (actions.length ? 1 : 0)}" class="px-3 py-10 text-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</td></tr>`
        : rows
            .map((row, index) => {
              const cells = columns
                .map(
                  (column) =>
                    `<td class="px-3 py-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 ${alignClass(column.align)} ${column.align === 'right' ? 'tabular-nums' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(row[column.key] ?? '—')}</td>`
                )
                .join('');
              const checkbox = selectable
                ? `<td class="px-3 py-2"><input type="checkbox" data-row="${index}" ${this._selected.has(index) ? 'checked' : ''} aria-label="Select row ${index + 1}" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600" /></td>`
                : '';
              const actionCell = actions.length
                ? `<td class="px-3 py-2"><div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">${actions
                    .map(
                      (action, ai) =>
                        `<button type="button" data-action="${ai}" data-row="${index}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(action.label)}" title="${escapeAttribute(action.label)}" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">${uiIcon(action.icon || 'more-horizontal', { size: 14 })}</button>`
                    )
                    .join('')}</div></td>`
                : '';
              return `<tr class="group hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors">${checkbox}${cells}${actionCell}</tr>`;
            })
            .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <table class="w-full text-xs">
          <thead class="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60"><tr>
            ${selectable ? `<th class="w-10 px-3 py-2"><input type="checkbox" data-select-all ${allSelected ? 'checked' : ''} aria-label="Select all rows" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600" /></th>` : ''}
            ${headCells}
            ${actions.length ? '<th class="w-20 px-3 py-2"></th>' : ''}
          </tr></thead>
          <tbody class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${bodyRows}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      ${
        selectable && this._selected.size > 0
          ? `<div class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-20 flex -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-2 shadow-lg">
              <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${this._selected.size} selected</span>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-1">${actions
                .map(
                  (action, ai) =>
                    `<button type="button" data-batch="${ai}" class="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors">${escapeAttribute(action.label)}</button>`
                )
                .join('')}</div>
              <button type="button" data-clear aria-label="Clear selection" class="rounded-full p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700">${uiIcon('x', { size: 13 })}</button>
            </div>`
          : ''
      }`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const key = btn.getAttribute('data-sort');
        this._sortDir = this._sortKey === key && this._sortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
        this._sortKey = key;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sort', { detail: { key, direction: this._sortDir } }));
        this.render();
      });
    });

    const allBox = this.querySelector('[data-select-all]');
    if (allBox)
      allBox.addEventListener('change', () => {
        this._selected = allBox.checked ? new Set(rows.map((_, i) => i)) : new Set();
        this.render();
      });

    this.querySelectorAll('input[data-row]').forEach((box) => {
      box.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const index = Number(box.getAttribute('data-row'));
        box.checked ? this._selected.add(index) : this._selected.delete(index);
        this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const row = rows[Number(btn.getAttribute('data-row'))];
        const action = actions[Number(btn.getAttribute('data-action'))];
        action?.onClick?.(row);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { action, row } }));
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-batch]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const action = actions[Number(btn.getAttribute('data-batch'))];
        this._selected.forEach((index) => action?.onClick?.(rows[index]));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('batch', { detail: { action, rows: [...this._selected].map((i) => rows[i]) } }));
        this._selected = new Set();
        this.render();
      });
    });

    const clearBtn = this.querySelector('[data-clear]');
    if (clearBtn)
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._selected = new Set();
        this.render();
      });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('data-table')) {
  customElements.define('data-table', DataTableElement);
}
export default DataTableElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\DatePicker.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];
const WEEKDAYS = ['Su', 'Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa'];

const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const toIso = (year, month, day) => `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(day)}`;

const parseIso = (iso) => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso || '');
  if (!match) return null;
  return { year: Number(match[1]), month: Number(match[2]) - 1, day: Number(match[3]) };
};

const todayIso = () => {
  const now = new Date();
  return toIso(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
};

/**
 * DatePicker - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <date-picker value="2026-11-14" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31"></date-picker>
 * Events: change (detail: 'YYYY-MM-DD')
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

export class DatePickerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'min', 'max', 'week-starts-on', 'show-today', 'disabled'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    const initial = parseIso(this.getAttribute('value')) || parseIso(todayIso());
    this._view = { year: initial.year, month: initial.month };
  }

  get value() {
    return this.getAttribute('value') || '';
  }

  set value(next) {
    if (next) this.setAttribute('value', next);
    else this.removeAttribute('value');
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const selected = parseIso(this.getAttribute('value'));
    if (selected) this._view = { year: selected.year, month: selected.month };
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    const selected = parseIso(this.getAttribute('value'));
    if (selected) this._view = { year: selected.year, month: selected.month };
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _shift(delta) {
    const next = new Date(this._view.year, this._view.month + delta, 1);
    this._view = { year: next.getFullYear(), month: next.getMonth() };
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const value = this.getAttribute('value') || '';
    const min = this.getAttribute('min') || '';
    const max = this.getAttribute('max') || '';
    const weekStartsOn = Number(this.getAttribute('week-starts-on') || 1) === 0 ? 0 : 1;
    const showToday = this.getAttribute('show-today') !== 'false';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled') && this.getAttribute('disabled') !== 'false';
    const today = todayIso();

    const iso = (day) => toIso(this._view.year, this._view.month, day);
    const isDisabled = (day) => {
      if (disabled) return true;
      const candidate = iso(day);
      if (min && candidate < min) return true;
      if (max && candidate > max) return true;
      return false;
    };

    const first = new Date(this._view.year, this._view.month, 1).getDay();
    const lead = (first - weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
    const total = new Date(this._view.year, this._view.month + 1, 0).getDate();
    const cells = Array.from({ length: lead }, () => null);
    for (let day = 1; day <= total; day += 1) cells.push(day);
    while (cells.length % 7 !== 0) cells.push(null);

    const weekdays = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => WEEKDAYS[(i + weekStartsOn) % 7]);

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="w-full max-w-[17rem] rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-3">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button type="button" class="date-prev rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Previous month">${uiIcon('chevron-left', { size: 14 })}</button>
          <span class="flex-1 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${MONTHS[this._view.month]} ${this._view.year}</span>
          <button type="button" class="date-next rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Next month">${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 14 })}</button>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-2 grid grid-cols-7 gap-0.5">
          ${weekdays
            .map((label) => `<span class="py-1 text-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>`)
            .join('')}
          ${cells
            .map((day) => {
              if (day === null) return '<span></span>';
              const date = iso(day);
              const blocked = isDisabled(day);
              const selected = value === date;
              const isToday = date === today;
              const tone = selected
                ? 'bg-indigo-600 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'
                : isToday
                  ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
              return `<button type="button" class="date-day flex h-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[11px] tabular-nums transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 disabled:hover:bg-transparent dark:disabled:text-zinc-600 ${tone}"
                data-date="${date}" aria-label="${date}" aria-pressed="${selected}" ${blocked ? 'disabled' : ''}>${day}</button>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </div>

        ${
          showToday
            ? `<div class="mt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <button type="button" class="date-today w-full rounded-md py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40">Today</button>
              </div>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.date-prev').addEventListener('click', () => this._shift(-1));
    this.querySelector('.date-next').addEventListener('click', () => this._shift(1));

    this.querySelectorAll('.date-day').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (button.hasAttribute('disabled')) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: button.getAttribute('data-date') }));
      });
    });

    const todayButton = this.querySelector('.date-today');
    if (todayButton) {
      todayButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (disabled) return;
        if ((min && today < min) || (max && today > max)) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: today }));
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('date-picker')) {
  customElements.define('date-picker', DatePickerElement);
}
export default DatePickerElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\DeliveryTrackingPanel.js =====

/**
 * DeliveryTrackingPanel - Delivery tracking: map placeholder with floating
 * controls, right info column with ETA header, four-step progress stepper,
 * courier card with contact buttons, collapsible order details, gift share
 * block and copy-link / text-me actions
 * (DoorDash delivery tracking pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const STEP_ICONS = { store: '🏪', rider: '🛵', car: '🚗', home: '🏠', check: '✓' };
const stepIcon = (name) => STEP_ICONS[name] || '•';

const DEFAULT_STEPS = () => [
  { id: 'store', icon: 'store', label: 'Store', state: 'done' },
  { id: 'pickup', icon: 'rider', label: 'Pickup', state: 'done' },
  { id: 'enroute', icon: 'car', label: 'En route', state: 'active' },
  { id: 'delivered', icon: 'home', label: 'Delivered', state: 'pending' },
];

const DEFAULT_ITEMS = () => [
  { id: 'i1', name: 'Shack Stack', quantity: '2×', price: '$32.78' },
  { id: 'i2', name: 'Cheese Fries', quantity: '1×', price: '$7.49' },
];

class DeliveryTrackingPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'eta-prefix', 'eta', 'status-text', 'steps', 'courier-name', 'courier-role', 'order-name', 'order-summary', 'items', 'gift-recipient', 'gift-message', 'share-title', 'share-description', 'copy-link-label', 'text-link-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._detailsOpen = true;
    this._title = 'Heading to Sam Lee';
    this._etaPrefix = 'Arrives between';
    this._eta = '8:35 - 8:41 AM';
    this._statusText = 'Your Dasher is heading to Sam Lee with your order.';
    this._steps = DEFAULT_STEPS();
    this._courierName = 'JOSHUA L';
    this._courierRole = 'Your Dasher';
    this._orderName = 'Shake Shack';
    this._orderSummary = '3 Items';
    this._items = DEFAULT_ITEMS();
    this._giftRecipient = 'Sam Lee';
    this._giftMessage = 'Hey, sending over some dinner, hope you enjoy!';
    this._shareTitle = 'Share your digital card with Sam Lee';
    this._shareDescription = "Send a link to your recipient so they can view your digital card and track their gift. They don't need an account.";
    this._copyLinkLabel = 'Copy link';
    this._textLinkLabel = 'Text me the link';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const read = (attr, key) => {
      const v = this.getAttribute(attr);
      if (v !== null && v !== '') this[`_${key}`] = v;
    };
    const readJson = (attr, key, fallback) => {
      const v = this.getAttribute(attr);
      if (v) this[`_${key}`] = parseJsonAttr(v, fallback());
    };
    read('title', 'title');
    read('eta-prefix', 'etaPrefix');
    read('eta', 'eta');
    read('status-text', 'statusText');
    readJson('steps', 'steps', DEFAULT_STEPS);
    read('courier-name', 'courierName');
    read('courier-role', 'courierRole');
    read('order-name', 'orderName');
    read('order-summary', 'orderSummary');
    readJson('items', 'items', DEFAULT_ITEMS);
    read('gift-recipient', 'giftRecipient');
    read('gift-message', 'giftMessage');
    read('share-title', 'shareTitle');
    read('share-description', 'shareDescription');
    read('copy-link-label', 'copyLinkLabel');
    read('text-link-label', 'textLinkLabel');
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'Heading to Sam Lee';
    if (name === 'eta-prefix') this._etaPrefix = newValue || 'Arrives between';
    if (name === 'eta') this._eta = newValue || '8:35 - 8:41 AM';
    if (name === 'status-text') this._statusText = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'steps') this._steps = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_STEPS());
    if (name === 'courier-name') this._courierName = newValue || 'JOSHUA L';
    if (name === 'courier-role') this._courierRole = newValue || 'Your Dasher';
    if (name === 'order-name') this._orderName = newValue || 'Shake Shack';
    if (name === 'order-summary') this._orderSummary = newValue || '3 Items';
    if (name === 'items') this._items = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_ITEMS());
    if (name === 'gift-recipient') this._giftRecipient = newValue || 'Sam Lee';
    if (name === 'gift-message') this._giftMessage = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'share-title') this._shareTitle = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'share-description') this._shareDescription = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'copy-link-label') this._copyLinkLabel = newValue || 'Copy link';
    if (name === 'text-link-label') this._textLinkLabel = newValue || 'Text me the link';
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const dispatchIf = (attr, eventName) => {
      if (event.target.closest(`[${attr}]`)) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(eventName, { bubbles: true }));
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    };
    if (dispatchIf('data-delivery-call', 'courier-call')) return;
    if (dispatchIf('data-delivery-message', 'courier-message')) return;
    if (dispatchIf('data-delivery-copy-link', 'copy-link')) return;
    if (dispatchIf('data-delivery-text-link', 'text-link')) return;
    if (event.target.closest('[data-delivery-details-toggle]')) {
      this._detailsOpen = !this._detailsOpen;
      this._render();
    }
  }

          ? 'flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500'
          : 'flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-sm text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900';
        return `${connector}<div data-delivery-step="${escapeAttribute(step.id)}" data-delivery-step-state="${escapeAttribute(step.state)}" title="${escapeAttribute(step.label)}" class="${bubble}">${stepIcon(step.icon)}</div>`;
      })

      .map((item) => `<div data-delivery-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
          <span class="text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.quantity)} ${escapeAttribute(item.name)}</span>
          <span class="font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(item.price)}</span>
        </div>`)

    this.innerHTML = `

          <div data-delivery-pin-destination class="absolute left-[60%] top-[45%] flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-base text-white shadow-lg" aria-hidden="true">🏠</div>

/**
 * DeploymentCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <deployment-card deploy-id="Deploy #128" status="building" sha="2d300ac" commit-message="Add files via upload" created-at="Just now · 4s"></deployment-card>
 * Attributes: deploy-id, status (queued|building|live|failed|canceled), sha, commit-message, created-at, source, url, cancel-label, visit-label
 * Events: cancel, visit (detail {url})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STATUS_TONE = {
  queued: { pill: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300', dot: 'bg-zinc-400', label: 'Queued' },
  building: { pill: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300', dot: 'bg-sky-500 animate-pulse', label: 'Building' },
  live: { pill: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300', dot: 'bg-emerald-500', label: 'Live' },
  failed: { pill: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300', dot: 'bg-rose-500', label: 'Failed' },
  canceled: { pill: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400', dot: 'bg-zinc-400', label: 'Canceled' },
};

export class DeploymentCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['deploy-id', 'status', 'sha', 'commit-message', 'created-at', 'source', 'url', 'cancel-label', 'visit-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-deploy-cancel]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cancel'));
        if (event.target.closest('[data-deploy-visit]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('visit', { detail: { url: this.getAttribute('url') || '' } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const deployId = this.getAttribute('deploy-id') || '';
    const status = this.getAttribute('status') || 'queued';
    const sha = this.getAttribute('sha') || '';
    const commitMessage = this.getAttribute('commit-message') || '';
    const createdAt = this.getAttribute('created-at') || '';
    const source = this.getAttribute('source') || '';
    const url = this.getAttribute('url') || '';
    const cancelLabel = this.getAttribute('cancel-label') || 'Cancel deploy';
    const visitLabel = this.getAttribute('visit-label') || 'Visit';
    const tone = STATUS_TONE[status] || STATUS_TONE.queued;
    const terminal = status === 'live' || status === 'failed' || status === 'canceled';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-deployment-card class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div class="min-w-0">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <p class="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(deployId)}</p>
            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium ${tone.pill}">
              <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${tone.dot}"></span>
              ${tone.label}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p class="mt-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(sha)}${commitMessage ? `<span class="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"> ${escapeAttribute(commitMessage)}</span>` : ''}</p>
          <p class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute([source, createdAt].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</p>
        </div>
        <div class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
          ${!terminal ? `<button type="button" data-deploy-cancel class="rounded-lg border border-rose-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600 transition-colors hover:bg-rose-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-rose-500 dark:border-rose-500/60 dark:text-rose-400 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40">${escapeAttribute(cancelLabel)}</button>` : ''}
          ${terminal && url ? `<button type="button" data-deploy-visit class="rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">${escapeAttribute(visitLabel)} ↗</button>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('deployment-card')) {

===== FILE: vanilla\DiffViewer.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const LINE_STYLE = {
  add: { row: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300', gutter: 'text-emerald-500', sign: '+' },
  remove: { row: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300', gutter: 'text-rose-500', sign: '-' },
  context: { row: 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400', gutter: 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600', sign: ' ' },
};

/**
 * Walks the diff once and produces render rows. Long runs of context lines
 * (> contextSize*2) become a collapsible gap that keeps `contextSize` lines
 * visible on each side; the hidden middle travels with the row so expanding
 * needs no second pass over the source.
 */
const buildRows = (lines, contextSize) => {
  const rows = [];
  let oldNo = 0;
  let newNo = 0;
  let contextRun = [];

  const pushLine = (entry) => {
    rows.push({ kind: 'line', line: entry.line, meta: LINE_STYLE.context, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` });
  };

  const flushContext = (isTail) => {
    if (contextRun.length <= contextSize * 2) {
      contextRun.forEach(pushLine);
    } else {
      const hidden = isTail
        ? contextRun.slice(contextSize)
        : contextRun.slice(contextSize, contextRun.length - contextSize);
      contextRun.slice(0, contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
      rows.push({ kind: 'collapsed', count: hidden.length, hidden, key: `gap-${rows.length}-${hidden.length}` });
      if (!isTail) contextRun.slice(contextRun.length - contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
    }
    contextRun = [];
  };

  lines.forEach((line) => {
    if (line.type !== 'add') oldNo += 1;
    if (line.type !== 'remove') newNo += 1;

    if (line.type === 'context') {
      contextRun.push({ line, oldNo, newNo });
      return;
    }
    flushContext(false);
    rows.push({
      kind: 'line',
      line,
      meta: LINE_STYLE[line.type] || LINE_STYLE.context,
      oldNo: line.type !== 'add' ? oldNo : '',
      newNo: line.type !== 'remove' ? newNo : '',
      key: `c-${rows.length}`,
    });
  });

  flushContext(true);
  return rows;
};

/**
 * DiffViewer - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <diff-viewer filename="app.ts" language="ts"></diff-viewer>
 * Legacy: `lines` property/attr (JSON). Multi-file: `files` property
 * [{ filename, language?, lines }] renders a tab bar. Long unchanged context
 * runs fold into "⋯ N unchanged lines" rows that expand in place
 * (`context-size` attribute, default 3). Toggle state is internal view state.
 */
class DiffViewerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['filename', 'language', 'show-line-numbers', 'context-size', 'lines', 'files'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._lines = [];
    this._files = [];
    this._activeFileIdx = 0;
    this._expandedGaps = new Set();
  }

  get lines() {
    if (this._lines) return this._lines;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('lines') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set lines(val) {
    this._lines = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get files() {
    if (this._files) return this._files;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('files') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set files(val) {
    this._files = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this._activeFileIdx = 0;
    this._expandedGaps = new Set();
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (name === 'lines') this._lines = null; // re-read from attribute
    if (name === 'files') {
      this._files = null; // re-read from attribute
      this._activeFileIdx = 0;
      this._expandedGaps = new Set();
    }
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const multiFile = this.files.length > 0;
    const activeIdx = multiFile ? Math.min(this._activeFileIdx, this.files.length - 1) : 0;
    const active = multiFile ? this.files[activeIdx] : null;
    const activeLines = active ? active.lines || [] : this.lines;
    const activeFilename = active ? active.filename : this.getAttribute('filename') || '';
    const activeLanguage = active ? active.language : this.getAttribute('language') || '';
    const showLineNumbers = this.getAttribute('show-line-numbers') !== 'false';
    const contextSize = Math.max(0, parseInt(this.getAttribute('context-size') || '3', 10) || 0);

    const added = activeLines.filter((l) => l.type === 'add').length;
    const removed = activeLines.filter((l) => l.type === 'remove').length;

    // Multi-file tab bar
    const tabsHtml = multiFile
      ? `<div role="tablist" class="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 px-1.5 pt-1.5">
          ${this.files
            .map((file, idx) => {
              const isActive = idx === activeIdx;
              const fAdded = (file.lines || []).filter((l) => l.type === 'add').length;
              const fRemoved = (file.lines || []).filter((l) => l.type === 'remove').length;
              return `<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="${isActive}" data-file-idx="${idx}"
                  class="diff-tab flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-t-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] transition-colors ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'border border-b-0 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'
                      : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }">
                  <span class="max-w-[10rem] truncate">${escapeAttribute(file.filename)}</span>
                  <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+${fAdded}</span>
                  <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-${fRemoved}</span>
                </button>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    const headerHtml = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs">
        ${uiIcon('git-branch', { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
        ${activeFilename ? `<span class="font-mono font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 truncate">${escapeAttribute(activeFilename)}</span>` : ''}
        ${activeLanguage ? `<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-zinc-700/70 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(activeLanguage)}</span>` : ''}
        <span class="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
          <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+${added}</span>
          <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">-${removed}</span>
        </span>
      </div>`;

    const rows = buildRows(activeLines, contextSize);

    const lineRow = (line, meta, oldNo, newNo) => `
      <div class="flex ${meta.row}">
        ${
          showLineNumbers
            ? `<span class="w-16 shrink-0 select-none px-2 text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 tabular-nums">${oldNo} ${newNo}</span>`
            : ''
        }
        <span class="w-5 shrink-0 select-none text-center ${meta.gutter}">${meta.sign}</span>
        <span class="flex-1 min-w-0 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words pr-3">${escapeAttribute(line.content)}</span>
      </div>`;

    const rowsHtml = rows
      .map((row) => {
        if (row.kind === 'collapsed') {
          if (!this._expandedGaps.has(row.key)) {
            return `<button type="button" data-gap-key="${escapeAttribute(row.key)}"
                class="diff-gap-toggle flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none">
                ${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 12 })}
                <span class="font-mono">⋯ ${row.count} unchanged lines</span>
              </button>`;
          }
          return `${(row.hidden || [])
            .map((entry) => lineRow(entry.line, LINE_STYLE.context, entry.oldNo, entry.newNo))
            .join('')}
            <button type="button" data-gap-key="${escapeAttribute(row.key)}"
              class="diff-gap-toggle flex w-full items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors select-none">
              ${uiIcon('minus', { size: 12 })}
              <span class="font-mono">Collapse unchanged lines</span>
            </button>`;
        }
        return lineRow(row.line, row.meta, row.oldNo, row.newNo);
      })
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('block rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden');
    this.innerHTML = `
      ${tabsHtml}
      ${headerHtml}
      <div class="overflow-x-auto text-[13px] font-mono leading-relaxed">
        ${rowsHtml || '<div class="p-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No changes</div>'}
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.diff-tab').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._activeFileIdx = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-file-idx') || '0', 10);
        this._expandedGaps = new Set();
        this.render();
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.diff-gap-toggle').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const key = btn.getAttribute('data-gap-key');
        if (this._expandedGaps.has(key)) this._expandedGaps.delete(key);
        else this._expandedGaps.add(key);
        this.render();
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('diff-viewer')) {
  customElements.define('diff-viewer', DiffViewerElement);
}

/**
 * DocsPageLayout - Documentation page shell: left nav with top links and
 * grouped sections, center article with title, Copy page button, callout,
 * cards grid and code examples, right "On this page" table of contents
 * with active highlight (Mintlify docs pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

// Only allow safe URL protocols into <a href> (blocks javascript:/data:/vbscript:)
const isSafeHref = (href) => {
  if (typeof href !== 'string') return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith('//') || t.startsWith('/') || t.startsWith('./') || t.startsWith('../')) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_TOPLINKS = () => [
  { id: 'documentation', label: 'Documentation', icon: '📘' },
  { id: 'blog', label: 'Blog', icon: '📰' },
];

const DEFAULT_NAVGROUPS = () => [
  {
    label: 'Getting Started',
    items: [
      { id: 'introduction', label: 'Introduction' },
      { id: 'quickstart', label: 'Quickstart', badge: 'Start here' },
      { id: 'development', label: 'Development' },
    ],
  },
  {
    label: 'Essentials',
    items: [
      { id: 'routing', label: 'Routing' },
      { id: 'metadata', label: 'Metadata' },
      { id: 'images', label: 'Images' },
    ],
  },
];

const DEFAULT_BLOCKS = () => [
  { type: 'callout', tone: 'info', title: 'New to Mintlify?', text: 'Start here to learn how to build, preview and deploy your documentation.' },
  { type: 'paragraph', text: 'This guide walks you through setting up a local development environment, writing your first page and deploying to production.' },
  { type: 'heading', text: 'Create a new project', anchor: 'create-a-new-project' },
  { type: 'code', example: { filename: 'Terminal', language: 'bash', code: 'npx mintlify init && npx mintlify dev' } },
  { type: 'heading', text: 'Cards', anchor: 'cards' },
  {
    type: 'cards',
    cards: [
      { title: 'Quickstart', description: 'Get your docs running in minutes.', icon: '🚀', href: '/quickstart' },
      { title: 'Theming', description: 'Customize colors, fonts and layout.', icon: '🎨', href: '/theming' },
    ],
  },
];

const DEFAULT_TOC = () => [
  { id: 'create-a-new-project', label: 'Create a new project' },
  { id: 'cards', label: 'Cards' },
];

const CALLOUT_STYLES = {
  info: 'border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-900 dark:border-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/50 dark:text-sky-200',
  success: 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-200',
  warning: 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:text-amber-200',
};

const CALLOUT_ICONS = { info: 'ℹ️', success: '✅', warning: '⚠️' };

class DocsPageLayoutElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['top-links', 'nav-groups', 'title', 'copy-label', 'blocks', 'toc', 'active-toc-id'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._copied = false;
    this._copiedTimer = null;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    if (this._copiedTimer) clearTimeout(this._copiedTimer);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const toplink = event.target.closest('[data-docspage-toplink]');
    if (toplink) {
      const links = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('top-links'), DEFAULT_TOPLINKS());
      const found = links.find((l) => l.id === toplink.getAttribute('data-docspage-toplink'));
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('nav-click', { detail: { item: found }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const navitem = event.target.closest('[data-docspage-navitem]');
    if (navitem) {
      const groups = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('nav-groups'), DEFAULT_NAVGROUPS());
      const found = groups.flatMap((g) => g.items).find((i) => i.id === navitem.getAttribute('data-docspage-navitem'));
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('nav-click', { detail: { item: found }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-docspage-copy]')) {
      this._copied = true;
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('copy-page', { bubbles: true }));
      this._copiedTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this._copied = false;
        this._render();
      }, 1500);
      return;
    }
    const tocitem = event.target.closest('[data-docspage-tocitem]');
    if (tocitem) {
      const id = tocitem.getAttribute('data-docspage-tocitem');
      this.setAttribute('active-toc-id', id);
      const found = this._toc().find((t) => t.id === id);
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toc-click', { detail: { item: found }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _toc() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('toc'), DEFAULT_TOC());
  }

  _blockHtml(block) {
    if (block.type === 'paragraph') {
      return `<p class="text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(block.text)}</p>`;
    }
    if (block.type === 'callout') {
      const tone = block.tone ?? 'info';
      return `<div data-docspage-callout class="rounded-xl border p-4 ${CALLOUT_STYLES[tone] ?? CALLOUT_STYLES.info}">
          <p class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold"><span aria-hidden="true">${CALLOUT_ICONS[tone] ?? CALLOUT_ICONS.info}</span>${escapeAttribute(block.title ?? '')}</p>
          <p class="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 opacity-90">${escapeAttribute(block.text)}</p>
        </div>`;
    }
    if (block.type === 'heading') {
      return `<h2 id="${escapeAttribute(block.anchor)}" data-docspage-heading="${escapeAttribute(block.anchor)}" class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(block.text)}</h2>`;
    }
    if (block.type === 'cards') {
      return `<div data-docspage-cards class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">${(block.cards ?? [])
        .map(
          (card) => {
            const href = isSafeHref(card.href) ? escapeAttribute(card.href) : '';
            return `<a data-docspage-card="${escapeAttribute(card.title)}" ${href ? `href="${href}"` : 'role="link" aria-disabled="true"'} class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 p-4 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50">
              <p class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${card.icon ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(card.icon)}</span>` : ''}${escapeAttribute(card.title)}</p>
              <p class="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(card.description)}</p>
            </a>`;
          }
        )
        .join('')}</div>`;
    }
    return `<div data-docspage-code class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-950 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2">
          <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(block.example.filename)}</span>
          <span class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(block.example.language)}</span>
        </div>
        <pre class="overflow-x-auto px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-200"><code>${escapeAttribute(block.example.code)}</code></pre>
      </div>`;
  }

  _render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Quickstart';
    const copyLabel = this.getAttribute('copy-label') || 'Copy page';
    const topLinks = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('top-links'), DEFAULT_TOPLINKS());
    const navGroups = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('nav-groups'), DEFAULT_NAVGROUPS());
    const blocks = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('blocks'), DEFAULT_BLOCKS());
    const toc = this._toc();
    const activeId = this.getAttribute('active-toc-id') || toc[0]?.id || '';

    const toplinksHtml = topLinks
      .map(
        (link) => `<button data-docspage-toplink="${escapeAttribute(link.id)}" type="button" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${link.icon ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(link.icon)}</span>` : ''}${escapeAttribute(link.label)}</button>`
      )
      .join('');

    const groupsHtml = navGroups
      .map(
        (group) => `<div data-docspage-group="${escapeAttribute(group.label)}" class="mt-5">
          <p class="px-3 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(group.label)}</p>
          <div class="mt-1.5 space-y-0.5">${(group.items ?? [])
            .map(
              (item) => `<button data-docspage-navitem="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" type="button" class="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-sm text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">
                  <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
                  ${item.badge ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-emerald-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300">${escapeAttribute(item.badge)}</span>` : ''}
                </button>`
            )
            .join('')}</div>
        </div>`
      )
      .join('');

    const contentHtml = blocks.map((b) => this._blockHtml(b)).join('');

    const tocHtml = toc
      .map((item) => {
        const active = item.id === activeId;
        const cls = active
          ? 'border-zinc-900 font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-100'
          : 'border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200';
        return `<button data-docspage-tocitem="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" data-docspage-toc-active="${active ? 'true' : 'false'}" type="button" class="-ml-px block w-full border-l-2 px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs transition-colors ${cls}">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-docspage class="grid w-full gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[220px_minmax(0,1fr)_200px]">
        <nav data-docspage-nav class="hidden lg:block">
          <div class="space-y-1">${toplinksHtml}</div>
          ${groupsHtml}
        </nav>
        <article data-docspage-article class="min-w-0">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <h1 data-docspage-title class="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h1>
            <button data-docspage-copy type="button" class="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${this._copied ? '✓ Copied' : `⧉ ${escapeAttribute(copyLabel)}`}</button>
          </div>
          <div data-docspage-content class="mt-6 space-y-4">${contentHtml}</div>
        </article>
        <aside data-docspage-toc class="hidden lg:block">
          <p class="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">On this page</p>
          <div class="mt-3 space-y-1 border-l border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">${tocHtml}</div>
        </aside>
      </div>`;
  }
}

  customElements.define('docs-page-layout', DocsPageLayoutElement);

===== FILE: vanilla\DriftEmbersBackdrop.js =====

/**
 * DriftEmbersBackdrop - Vanilla Web Component
 * Ambient backdrop inspired by the moment a warm flower valley disperses after
 * login: a cool-to-charcoal vertical field with a warm olive band across the
 * middle, the glow pooled mid-left instead of the bottom, and a cloud of mixed
 * gold + ash motes slowly settling through it. Zero dependencies, Canvas 2D.
 *
 * Usage: <drift-embers-backdrop speed="1" density="120" ember-color="#b9af39" ash-color="#c8c9ca"></drift-embers-backdrop>
 */

const numOr = (value, fallback, min, max) => {
  const n = Number.parseFloat(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return fallback;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n));
};

// Canvas color stops throw on malformed values; only accept hex / rgb() strings
// so a hostile attribute cannot break the render loop (graceful fallback).
const safeColor = (value, fallback) => {
  const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (/^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(s)) return s;
  if (/^rgba?\(\s*[\d.%\s,]+\)$/i.test(s)) return s;
  return fallback;
};

const hexToRgb = (hex) => {
  let h = String(hex).replace("#", "");
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("");
  const n = Number.parseInt(h, 16);
  return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
};

class DriftEmbersBackdropElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["speed", "density", "base-color", "bloom-color", "ember-color", "ash-color", "interactive", "paused"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._cleanup = null;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.init();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._cleanup) {
      this._cleanup();
      this._cleanup = null;
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this.isConnected) {
      this.disconnectedCallback();
      this.init();
    }
  }

  init() {
    this.innerHTML = "";
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    canvas.className = "fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0";
    this.appendChild(canvas);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext && canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const speed = numOr(this.getAttribute("speed"), 1, 0, 4);
    const count = Math.round(numOr(this.getAttribute("density"), 120, 1, 260));
    const baseColor = safeColor(this.getAttribute("base-color"), "#0d1113");
    const bloomColor = safeColor(this.getAttribute("bloom-color"), "#4a4430");
    const emberColor = safeColor(this.getAttribute("ember-color"), "#b9af39");
    const ashColor = safeColor(this.getAttribute("ash-color"), "#c8c9ca");
    const interactive = this.getAttribute("interactive") === "true";
    const paused = this.getAttribute("paused") === "true";

    // One soft sprite per mote family (warm gold + neutral ash). Pre-rendering
    // avoids rebuilding a radial gradient for every particle each frame.
    const makeSprite = (color, coreAlpha) => {
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      const SP = 64;
      c.width = SP;
      c.height = SP;
      const sc = c.getContext("2d");
      const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(color);
      const grd = sc.createRadialGradient(SP / 2, SP / 2, 0, SP / 2, SP / 2, SP / 2);
      grd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${coreAlpha})`);
      grd.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${coreAlpha * 0.4})`);
      grd.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},0)`);
      sc.fillStyle = grd;
      sc.fillRect(0, 0, SP, SP);
      return c;
    };
    const goldSprite = makeSprite(emberColor, 0.95);
    const ashSprite = makeSprite(ashColor, 0.55);

    // Bias x toward the left, where the dispersed cloud is densest.
    const biasedX = () => Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.45) * 1.06 - 0.03;
    const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
    const motes = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
      x: biasedX(),
      y: rand(-0.1, 1.1),
      r: rand(1.6, 6.2),
      fall: rand(0.004, 0.018),
      sway: rand(0.002, 0.01),
      swayAmp: rand(0.006, 0.035),
      phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      twinkle: rand(0.4, 1.4),
      alpha: rand(0.3, 0.85),
      ash: Math.random() < 0.46,
    }));

    const dpr = typeof window !== "undefined" ? Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2) : 1;
    let W = 1;
    let H = 1;
    const pointer = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, tx: 0.5, ty: 0.5 };

    const resize = () => {
      W = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth) * dpr));
      H = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight) * dpr));
      if (canvas.width !== W || canvas.height !== H) {
        canvas.width = W;
        canvas.height = H;
      }
    };

    // Fine grain, pre-rendered once and tiled. Guarded so a minimal 2D context
    // (e.g. jsdom) simply skips it rather than throwing.
    let grain = null;
    if (typeof ctx.createPattern === "function" && typeof document.createElement("canvas").getContext === "function") {
      const tile = document.createElement("canvas");
      tile.width = 64;
      tile.height = 64;
      const tc = tile.getContext("2d");
      if (tc && typeof tc.createImageData === "function") {
        const img = tc.createImageData(64, 64);
        for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
          const v = 120 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 135);
          img.data[i] = img.data[i + 1] = img.data[i + 2] = v;
          img.data[i + 3] = 14;
        }
        tc.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
        grain = ctx.createPattern(tile, "repeat");
      }
    }

    const drawField = (t) => {
      // vertical field: cool top -> warm olive band -> dark base
      const field = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
      field.addColorStop(0, baseColor);
      field.addColorStop(0.42, "#2a2923");
      field.addColorStop(1, "#090b0a");
      ctx.fillStyle = field;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      // horizontal wash: warmer on the left, open dark pocket toward center-right
      const wash = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, 0);
      wash.addColorStop(0, "rgba(72,64,42,0.18)");
      wash.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      wash.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.26)");
      ctx.fillStyle = wash;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      // glow pooled mid-left (the warmth migrates up from the bottom after login)
      const bx = (0.13 + (pointer.x - 0.5) * 0.1) * W;
      const by = (0.45 + (pointer.y - 0.5) * 0.05) * H;
      const [br, bg, bb] = hexToRgb(bloomColor);
      const bloom = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, 0, bx, by, Math.max(W, H) * 0.62);
      bloom.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.42)`);
      bloom.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.1)`);
      bloom.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0)`);
      ctx.fillStyle = bloom;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

      // mixed gold + ash motes settling slowly through the field
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
      for (const p of motes) {
        const px = (p.x + Math.sin(t * p.sway + p.phase) * p.swayAmp) * W;
        const py = p.y * H;
        const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * p.twinkle + p.phase);
        const size = p.r * dpr * 5;
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha * tw;
        ctx.drawImage(p.ash ? ashSprite : goldSprite, px - size / 2, py - size / 2, size, size);
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

      if (grain) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
        ctx.fillStyle = grain;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }

      // very light vignette — the drift scene is flatter than the valley, so
      // corners stay close to the center brightness.
      const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.3, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.82);
      vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)");
      ctx.fillStyle = vg;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    };

    const reducedQuery =
      typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
        ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
        : { matches: false };

    let raf = 0;
    let last = 0;
    let t = 0;
    let stopped = paused;

    const frame = (now) => {
      if (stopped) return;
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
      last = now;
      t += dt * speed;
      pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.05;
      pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.05;
      for (const p of motes) {
        p.y += p.fall * dt * speed;
        if (p.y > 1.1) {
          p.y = -0.1;
          p.x = biasedX();
        }
      }
      drawField(t);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };

    const start = () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      last = performance.now();
      if (reducedQuery.matches) {
        drawField(t);
      } else {
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
    };

    const stop = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = 0;
    };

    const onVisibility = () => {
      if (document.hidden) stop();
      else start();
    };

    const onResize = () => {
      resize();
      if (stopped || reducedQuery.matches) drawField(t);
    };

    const onPointerMove = (e) => {
      if (!interactive) return;
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      pointer.tx = (e.clientX - rect.left) / (rect.width || 1);
      pointer.ty = (e.clientY - rect.top) / (rect.height || 1);
    };

    resize();
    if (interactive) window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    start();

    this._cleanup = () => {
      stop();
      if (interactive) window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    };
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("drift-embers-backdrop")) {
  customElements.define("drift-embers-backdrop", DriftEmbersBackdropElement);
}

export default DriftEmbersBackdropElement;

/**
 * EditableHeading - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <editable-heading value="My list" meta="<span>List · 42 members</span>"></editable-heading>
 * Attributes: value, size (md|lg), breadcrumb (HTML), meta (HTML)
 * Property: value
 * Events: change (detail {value}), cancel
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class EditableHeadingElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'size', 'breadcrumb', 'meta'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._editing = false;
    this._draft = '';
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const display = event.target.closest('[data-heading-display]');
        if (display) {
          this._draft = this.value;
          this._editing = true;
          this.render();
          const input = this.querySelector('[data-heading-input]');
          if (input) {
            input.focus();
            input.select();
          }
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        const input = event.target;
        if (!input || !input.hasAttribute || !input.hasAttribute('data-heading-input')) return;
        if (event.key === 'Enter') {
          this._commit(input.value);
        } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
          this._editing = false;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cancel'));
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('focusout', (event) => {
        const input = event.target;
        if (input && input.hasAttribute && input.hasAttribute('data-heading-input') && this._editing) {
          this._commit(input.value);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    this.render();
  }

  get value() {
    return this._value !== undefined ? this._value : this.getAttribute('value') || 'Untitled';
  }

  set value(v) {
    this._value = v;
    this.setAttribute('value', v || '');
    this.render();
  }

  _commit(raw) {
    const next = String(raw || '').trim() || this.value;
    const changed = next !== this.value;
    this._value = next;
    this.setAttribute('value', next);
    this._editing = false;
    this.render();
    if (changed) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { value: next } }));
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const size = this.getAttribute('size') || 'lg';
    const sizeClass = size === 'lg' ? 'text-2xl' : 'text-base';
    const breadcrumb = this.getAttribute('breadcrumb') || '';
    const meta = this.getAttribute('meta') || '';
    const hostClass = '';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const heading = this._editing
      ? `<input data-heading-input type="text" value="${escapeAttribute(this._draft)}" class="w-full rounded-md border-2 border-teal-500 bg-yellow-50 px-2 py-1 font-semibold text-zinc-900 outline-none ${sizeClass}"/>`
      : `<button type="button" data-heading-display title="Click to rename" class="-mx-2 w-full rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-left font-semibold text-zinc-900 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-500 ${sizeClass}">${escapeAttribute(this.value)}</button>`;

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-editable-heading>
${breadcrumb ? `<div class="mb-1 text-xs text-zinc-400">${breadcrumb}</div>` : ''}
${heading}
${meta ? `<div class="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-500">${meta}</div>` : ''}
</div>`;
  }
}

  customElements.define('editable-heading', EditableHeadingElement);
}

/**

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class EditorToolPaletteElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tools', 'active-id', 'orientation', 'active-count', 'show-kbd-hints'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tools = [];
    this._activeId = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._tools.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('tools');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._tools = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._tools = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const button = event.target.closest('[data-tool]');
        if (!button || button.disabled) return;
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-tool');
        if (id) {
          this._activeId = id;
          this.setAttribute('active-id', id);
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { id } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'tools') this._tools = [];
    if (name === 'active-id') this._activeId = null;
    this.render();
  }

  get tools() { return this._tools; }
  set tools(v) {
    this._tools = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get activeId() {
    if (this._activeId !== null) return this._activeId;
    return this.getAttribute('active-id');
  }

  set activeId(id) {
    this._activeId = id;
    this.setAttribute('active-id', id || '');
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const vertical = this.getAttribute('orientation') === 'vertical';
    const activeId = this.activeId;
    const activeCount = this.getAttribute('active-count');
    const showKbd = this.getAttribute('show-kbd-hints') !== 'false';
    const hostClass = `inline-flex gap-0.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${vertical ? 'flex-col items-center' : 'items-center'}`;
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const buttons = this._tools
      .map((tool) => {
        const active = tool.id === activeId;
        const stateClass = active
          ? 'bg-blue-500 text-white'
          : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-50';
        const kbd = showKbd && tool.kbd
          ? `<span class="absolute -right-0.5 -top-0.5 rounded px-1 text-[9px] font-semibold leading-tight ${active ? 'bg-white/90 text-blue-600' : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-400'}">${escapeAttribute(tool.kbd)}</span>`
          : '';
        const badge = active && activeCount != null && Number(activeCount) > 0
          ? `<span data-tool-badge class="absolute -bottom-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-blue-600 px-1.5 text-[9px] font-semibold leading-tight text-white">${escapeAttribute(activeCount)}</span>`
          : '';
        return `<button type="button" data-tool="${escapeAttribute(tool.id)}" title="${escapeAttribute(tool.label)}"${tool.disabled ? ' disabled' : ''} class="relative flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${stateClass}"><span class="pointer-events-none flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center [&>svg]:h-5 [&>svg]:w-5">${tool.icon || ''}</span>${kbd}${badge}<span class="sr-only">${escapeAttribute(tool.label)}</span></button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-tool-palette role="toolbar" aria-orientation="${vertical ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'}" class="${hostClass}">${buttons}</div>`;
  }
}

  String(label)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || '').toUpperCase())
    .join('');

export class EntityMultiSelectPickerElement extends HTMLElement {

    return ['options', 'selected', 'searchable', 'empty-message', 'confirm-label', 'cancel-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._options = [];
    this._selected = [];
    this._picked = null;
    this._query = '';
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._options.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('options');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._options = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._options = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._selected.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('selected');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._selected = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._selected = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const option = event.target.closest('[data-picker-option]');

          const id = option.getAttribute('data-picker-option');
          if (!this._picked) this._picked = new Set(this._selected);
          if (this._picked.has(id)) this._picked.delete(id);
          else this._picked.add(id);
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-picker-cancel]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-picker-confirm]')) {
          const ids = [...(this._picked || new Set(this._selected))];
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { ids } }));
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (target && target.tagName === 'INPUT' && target.hasAttribute('data-picker-search')) {
          this._query = target.value;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('search', { detail: { query: this._query } }));
          this.render();
        }
      });
    }
  }

    this.render();

    return this._options;

    this._options = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._picked = null;
    this.render();
  }

    return this._picked ? [...this._picked] : this._selected;

    this._selected = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];

    this.render();
  }

          </div>

      ? filtered
          .map((option, index) => {
            const checked = this._picked.has(option.id);
            const rowClass = checked ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60';
            const checkboxClass = checked ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800';

              avatarHtml = `<img src="${escapeAttribute(option.avatar)}" alt="" class="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-full" />`;
            } else if (option.system) {
              avatarHtml = '<span class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"><span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-sky-500"></span></span>';
            } else {
              avatarHtml = `<span class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${AVATAR_TONES[index % AVATAR_TONES.length]}">${escapeAttribute(option.initials || initialsOf(option.label))}</span>`;
            }
            return `<li>
              <button type="button" data-picker-option="${escapeAttribute(option.id)}" aria-pressed="${checked}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${rowClass}">
                <span data-picker-checkbox class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border transition-colors ${checkboxClass}">${checkSvg}</span>
                ${avatarHtml}
                <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(option.label)}</span>
              </button>
            </li>`;
          })
          .join('')
      : `<li data-picker-empty class="px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(emptyMessage)}</li>`;

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-entity-picker class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      ${searchHtml}
      <ul class="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto p-1.5">${listHtml}</ul>
      <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button type="button" data-picker-cancel class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(cancelLabel)}</button>
        <button type="button" data-picker-confirm class="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(confirmLabel)}</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * EvalRunResults - Evaluation run results: pass-rate header with counters,
 * status filter chip and per-evaluator result sections with status pills,
 * reason/response excerpts and variable chips (Adaline Evals pattern).

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};
