const STATUS_STYLES = {
  passed: { icon: '✓', label: 'Passed', cell: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  failed: { icon: '✕', label: 'Failed', cell: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400' },
  unknown: { icon: '⊘', label: 'Unknown', cell: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' },
};

class EvalRunResultsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['sections', 'pass-rate', 'pass-label', 'counters', 'filter-label', 'filter-value'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._sections = [];
    this._passRate = '64.00%';
    this._passLabel = 'Passed';
    this._counters = { passed: 64, unknown: 0, failed: 36, total: 100 };
    this._filterLabel = 'has any of';
    this._filterValue = 'Passed';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._sections.length) this._sections = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sections'), DEFAULT_SECTIONS());
    const pr = this.getAttribute('pass-rate');
    if (pr) this._passRate = pr;
    const pl = this.getAttribute('pass-label');
    if (pl) this._passLabel = pl;
    const counters = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('counters'), null);
    if (counters) this._counters = counters;
    const fl = this.getAttribute('filter-label');
    if (fl) this._filterLabel = fl;
    const fv = this.getAttribute('filter-value');
    if (fv) this._filterValue = fv;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'sections' && !this._sections.length) this._sections = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    if (name === 'pass-rate') this._passRate = newValue || '64.00%';
    if (name === 'pass-label') this._passLabel = newValue || 'Passed';
    if (name === 'counters') this._counters = parseJsonAttr(newValue, { passed: 64, unknown: 0, failed: 36, total: 100 });
    if (name === 'filter-label') this._filterLabel = newValue || 'has any of';
    if (name === 'filter-value') this._filterValue = newValue || 'Passed';
    this._render();
  }

  get sections() { return this._sections; }
  set sections(value) { this._sections = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-eval-row]');
    if (!rowEl) return;
    const sectionEl = rowEl.closest('[data-eval-section]');
    const section = this._sections.find((s) => s.id === sectionEl?.getAttribute('data-eval-section'));
    const result = section?.results.find((r) => r.id === rowEl.getAttribute('data-eval-row'));
    if (section && result) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('result-click', { detail: { result, section }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const c = this._counters;
    const sectionsHtml = this._sections
      .map((section) => {
        const rowsHtml = section.results
          .map((result) => {
            const style = STATUS_STYLES[result.status] ?? STATUS_STYLES.unknown;
            const varsHtml = (result.variables ?? [])
              .map(
                (v) => `<span data-eval-var="${escapeAttribute(v.name)}" class="max-w-[13rem] truncate rounded bg-violet-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9px] text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300" title="${escapeAttribute(v.name)}: ${escapeAttribute(v.value)}">${escapeAttribute(v.name)}: ${escapeAttribute(v.value)}</span>`
              )
              .join('');
            return `
            <tr data-eval-row="${escapeAttribute(result.id)}" tabindex="0" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 align-top text-xs transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
              <td data-eval-row-status="${escapeAttribute(result.status)}" class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2.5 font-medium ${style.cell}"><span class="mr-1 inline-flex" aria-hidden="true">${style.icon}</span>${style.label}</td>
              <td data-eval-row-reason class="max-w-[16rem] px-2 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(result.reason)}</td>
              <td data-eval-row-response class="max-w-[16rem] px-2 py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"><span class="line-clamp-2">${escapeAttribute(result.response)}</span></td>
              <td data-eval-row-variables class="px-4 py-2.5"><span class="flex max-w-[14rem] flex-wrap gap-1">${varsHtml}</span></td>
            </tr>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return `
        <div data-eval-section="${escapeAttribute(section.id)}" class="border-b border-zinc-100 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div data-eval-section-header class="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3">
            <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 text-sm dark:bg-zinc-800" aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(section.icon ?? '⚖️')}</span>
            <span>
              <span data-eval-section-name class="block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(section.name)}</span>
              <span data-eval-section-subtitle class="block text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(section.subtitle)}</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <table data-eval-section-results class="w-full">
            <thead>
              <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-left text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
                <th class="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Status</th>
                <th class="px-2 py-2 font-medium">Reason</th>
                <th class="px-2 py-2 font-medium">Response</th>
                <th class="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Variables</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-eval-run-results class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-eval-header class="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3 px-4 pb-3 pt-4">
          <p data-eval-score class="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">${escapeAttribute(this._passRate)} <span class="text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._passLabel)}</span></p>
          <div data-eval-counters class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs font-medium">
            <span data-eval-counter="passed" class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">✓ Passed ${c.passed}</span>
            <span data-eval-counter="unknown" class="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">⊘ Unknown ${c.unknown}</span>
            <span data-eval-counter="failed" class="text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">✕ Failed ${c.failed}</span>
            <span data-eval-counter="total" class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">≡ Total ${c.total}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 pb-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span data-eval-filter class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
            <span class="text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">⊙</span>
            <span class="font-medium">Status</span>

              <span class="text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">✕</span>

===== FILE: vanilla\EvalScoreTable.js =====

/**
 * EvalScoreTable - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <eval-score-table title="Evaluation report" runs='[...]' criteria='[...]'></eval-score-table>
 * Attributes: title, runs (JSON: [{id,name,score,grader?,tone?}]),
 *             criteria (JSON: [{id,title,description}]), add-criteria ("true"|"false")
 * Events: run-select (detail {run}), add-criteria
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const toneClasses = (tone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case 'warn':
      return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300';
    case 'fail':
      return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300';
    default:
      return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300';
  }
};

const toneBar = (tone) =>
  tone === 'warn' ? 'bg-amber-500' : tone === 'fail' ? 'bg-red-500' : 'bg-emerald-500';

export class EvalScoreTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'runs', 'criteria', 'add-criteria'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._runs = [];
    this._criteria = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._runs.length) this._runs = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('runs'), []);
    if (!this._criteria.length) this._criteria = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('criteria'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-eval-add-criteria]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-criteria'));
          return;
        }
        const row = event.target.closest('[data-eval-run]');
        if (row) {
          const run = this._runs.find((r) => r.id === row.getAttribute('data-eval-run'));
          if (run) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-select', { detail: { run } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'runs' && !this._runs.length) {
      this._runs = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('runs'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'criteria' && !this._criteria.length) {
      this._criteria = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('criteria'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get runs() { return this._runs; }
  set runs(v) {
    this._runs = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((r) => ({ ...r })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get criteria() { return this._criteria; }
  set criteria(v) {
    this._criteria = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((c) => ({ ...c })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const runs = this._runs;
    const criteria = this._criteria;
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Evaluation report');
    const showAdd = (this.getAttribute('add-criteria') || 'false') === 'true';

    const runRows = runs.map((run) => `
      <tr data-eval-run="${escapeAttribute(run.id)}" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
        <td class="py-2 pr-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(run.name)}</td>
        <td class="py-2 pr-3">
          <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span data-eval-score class="rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums ${toneClasses(run.tone)}">${run.score}%</span>
            <span class="h-1.5 w-20 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
              <span data-eval-score-bar class="block h-full rounded-full ${toneBar(run.tone)}" style="width: ${Math.min(Math.max(run.score, 0), 100)}%;"></span>
            </span>
          </span>
        </td>
        <td class="py-2 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(run.grader ?? '—')}</td>
      </tr>`).join('');

    const criteriaCards = criteria.map((c) => `
      <div data-eval-criterion="${escapeAttribute(c.id)}" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-700">
        <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(c.title)}</p>
        <p class="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(c.description)}</p>
      </div>`).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-eval-score-table class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${title}</span>
    <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${runs.length} runs</span>
  </div>
  <div class="px-4 py-3">
    <table data-eval-runs class="w-full text-left">
      <thead>
        <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
          <th class="py-1.5 pr-3 font-medium">Run</th>
          <th class="py-1.5 pr-3 font-medium">Score</th>
          <th class="py-1.5 font-medium">Grader</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>${runRows}</tbody>
    </table>
    ${criteria.length > 0 ? `<div data-eval-criteria class="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">${criteriaCards}</div>` : ''}
    ${showAdd ? `<button type="button" data-eval-add-criteria class="mt-3 flex w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 py-3 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
      <span class="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-sm dark:bg-zinc-800">+</span>
      Add criteria
    </button>` : ''}
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('eval-score-table')) {
  customElements.define('eval-score-table', EvalScoreTableElement);
}

export default EvalScoreTableElement;

/**
 * EvalTurnBuilder - Evaluation scenario builder: role-tagged conversation
 * turns (system / user / assistant / tool response) with per-turn mock
 * content and an add-turn footer (Vapi Evals pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const ROLE_STYLES = {
  system: { label: 'SYSTEM', badge: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-950/60 dark:text-purple-300', icon: '>' },
  user: { label: 'USER', badge: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300', icon: '?' },
  assistant: { label: 'ASSISTANT', badge: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300', icon: 'A' },
  tool: { label: 'TOOL RESPONSE', badge: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300', icon: 'T' },
};

const DEFAULT_TURNS = () => [
  {
    id: 't1',
    role: 'system',
    turn: 0,
    content: '# Appointment Scheduling Agent Prompt\n\nYou are Riley, an appointment scheduling voice assistant for Wellness Partners, a multi-specialty health clinic.',
    mock: false,
  },
  { id: 't2', role: 'user', turn: 1, content: 'Hi, can I reschedule my appointment to another time this week?', mock: true },
  { id: 't3', role: 'assistant', turn: 2, content: 'Sure, I can help with that. What day and time would you like to reschedule your appointment to?', mock: true },
  { id: 't4', role: 'tool', turn: 3, content: 'reschedule_appointment \u2192 { "status": "success", "new_time": "Thursday at 2 PM" }', mock: true },
];

class EvalTurnBuilderElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['turns'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._turns = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._turns.length) {
      this._turns = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('turns'), DEFAULT_TURNS());
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'turns' && !this._turns.length) {
      this._turns = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get turns() { return this._turns; }
  set turns(value) {
    this._turns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const removeEl = event.target.closest('[data-eval-turn-remove]');
    if (removeEl) {
      const turnEl = removeEl.closest('[data-eval-turn]');
      const turn = this._turns.find((t) => t.id === turnEl?.getAttribute('data-eval-turn'));
      if (turn) {
        this._turns = this._turns.filter((t) => t.id !== turn.id);
        this._render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('turn-remove', { detail: { turn }, bubbles: true }));
      }
      return;
    }
    const addEl = event.target.closest('[data-eval-add-turn]');
    if (addEl) {
      const role = addEl.getAttribute('data-eval-add-turn');
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-turn', { detail: { role }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const turnsHtml = this._turns
      .map((t) => {
        const style = ROLE_STYLES[t.role] || ROLE_STYLES.user;
        return `
        <div data-eval-turn="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" data-eval-role="${escapeAttribute(t.role)}" class="p-4">
          <div class="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span data-eval-turn-badge="${escapeAttribute(t.role)}" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider ${style.badge}"><span aria-hidden="true">${style.icon}</span> ${style.label}</span>
              ${t.mock ? '<span data-eval-turn-mock class="rounded-md bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">Mock</span>' : ''}
            </span>
            <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
              ${t.turn > 0 ? `<span data-eval-turn-number class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Turn ${t.turn}</span>` : ''}
              <button type="button" data-eval-turn-remove aria-label="Remove ${style.label.toLowerCase()} turn" class="text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:text-red-500 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-red-400">✕</button>
            </span>
          </div>
          <pre data-eval-turn-content class="max-h-40 overflow-y-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg border border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(t.content)}</pre>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const addLabels = { user: 'User', assistant: 'Assistant', tool: 'Tool Response' };
    const addHtml = Object.entries(addLabels)
      .map(
        ([role, label]) => `
        <button type="button" data-eval-add-turn="${role}" class="py-2.5 text-center text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">+ Add ${label}</button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-eval-turn-builder class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-eval-turns class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${turnsHtml}</div>
        <div data-eval-turn-add class="grid grid-cols-3 divide-x divide-zinc-100 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800">${addHtml}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

 * EventLogTable - Administrative event log: dropdown filter row (Type /
 * Source / Action / Target / date-range) with an Export CSV button, a
 * six-column log table (type / date-time / source with role / action /
 * targets / details) with muted-gray rows for older entries
 * (Vanta event log pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class EventLogTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description', 'filters', 'column-labels', 'entries', 'date-range-label', 'export-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const filter = event.target.closest('[data-eventlog-filter]');
    if (filter) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('filter-select', { detail: { filter: filter.getAttribute('data-eventlog-filter') }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-eventlog-export]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('export', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const entry = event.target.closest('[data-eventlog-entry]');
    if (entry) {
      const found = this._entries().find((e) => e.id === entry.getAttribute('data-eventlog-entry'));
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('entry-click', { detail: { entry: found }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _entries() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('entries'), DEFAULT_ENTRIES());
  }

  _render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Event log';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || 'Monitor and track a history of changes made by users within your workspace.';
    const dateRangeLabel = this.getAttribute('date-range-label') || 'Select date range';
    const exportLabel = this.getAttribute('export-label') || 'Export CSV';
    const filters = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('filters'), ['Type', 'Source', 'Action', 'Target']);
    const columnLabels = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('column-labels'), ['Type', 'Date', 'Source', 'Action', 'Targets', 'Details']);
    const entries = this._entries();

    const roleCls = (role) => {
      if (role === 'Admin') return 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100';
      if (role === 'Viewer') return 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500';
      return 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400';
    };

    const filtersHtml = filters
      .map((filter) => `<button data-eventlog-filter="${escapeAttribute(filter)}" type="button" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(filter)} <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-400">⌄</span></button>`)
      .join('');

    const columnsHtml = columnLabels
      .map((label) => `<th class="px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold">${escapeAttribute(label)}</th>`)
      .join('');

    const rowsHtml = entries
      .map((entry) => {
        const muted = Boolean(entry.muted);
        const rowCls = muted ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200';
        return `<tr data-eventlog-entry="${escapeAttribute(entry.id)}" data-eventlog-muted="${muted ? 'true' : 'false'}" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-100 transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40 ${rowCls}">
            <td class="px-6 py-3.5 font-semibold">${escapeAttribute(entry.type)}</td>
            <td class="px-6 py-3.5">
              <p class="font-medium">${escapeAttribute(entry.date)}</p>
              <p class="text-xs opacity-70">${escapeAttribute(entry.time)}</p>
            </td>
            <td class="px-6 py-3.5">
              <p class="font-medium ${muted ? '' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'}">${escapeAttribute(entry.source)}</p>
              <p class="text-xs ${roleCls(entry.role)}">${escapeAttribute(entry.role)}</p>
            </td>
            <td class="px-6 py-3.5">${escapeAttribute(entry.action)}</td>
            <td class="px-6 py-3.5">${escapeAttribute(entry.targets)}</td>
            <td class="px-6 py-3.5">${escapeAttribute(entry.details)}</td>
          </tr>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-eventlog class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-eventlog-header class="px-6 pt-6">
          <h2 data-eventlog-title class="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
          <p data-eventlog-description class="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>
        </div>
        <div data-eventlog-filters class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-6 py-4">
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            ${filtersHtml}
            <button data-eventlog-daterange type="button" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">🗓 ${escapeAttribute(dateRangeLabel)}</button>
          </div>
          <button data-eventlog-export type="button" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">↓ ${escapeAttribute(exportLabel)}</button>
        </div>
        <div class="overflow-x-auto">
          <table data-eventlog-table class="w-full min-w-[820px] text-left text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr data-eventlog-columns class="border-y border-zinc-100 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">${columnsHtml}</tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

class EventStreamPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['filter-placeholder', 'event-column-label', 'date-column-label', 'events', 'metadata-title', 'details-title', 'details-lines', 'active-event-id'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._filter = '';
    this._activeId = '';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._activeId = this.getAttribute('active-event-id') || '';
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.addEventListener('input', this._onInput);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.removeEventListener('input', this._onInput);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'active-event-id') this._activeId = newValue || '';
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const evBtn = event.target.closest('[data-stream-event]');
    if (evBtn) {
      this._activeId = evBtn.getAttribute('data-stream-event');
      const found = this._events().find((ev) => ev.id === this._activeId);
      this._render();
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('event-select', { detail: { event: found }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-stream-view-event]')) {
      const found = this._events().find((ev) => ev.id === this._activeId);
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('view-event', { detail: { event: found }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _onInput(event) {
    const input = event.target.closest('[data-stream-filter]');
    if (input) {
      this._filter = input.value;
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('filter-change', { detail: { value: input.value }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _events() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('events'), DEFAULT_EVENTS());
  }

  _render() {
    const filterPlaceholder = this.getAttribute('filter-placeholder') || 'Filter by event name, data, or date range';
    const eventColumnLabel = this.getAttribute('event-column-label') || 'Event';
    const dateColumnLabel = this.getAttribute('date-column-label') || 'Date and time';
    const metadataTitle = this.getAttribute('metadata-title') || 'Metadata';
    const detailsTitle = this.getAttribute('details-title') || 'Event Details';
    const detailsLines = Number(this.getAttribute('details-lines') ?? 10);
    const events = this._events();
    const q = this._filter.toLowerCase();
    const filtered = q ? events.filter((ev) => ev.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) : events;
    const active = events.find((ev) => ev.id === this._activeId) ?? events[0] ?? null;

    const itemsHtml = filtered.length === 0
      ? '<li class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No events match this filter</li>'
      : filtered
          .map((ev) => {
            const activeCls = active && ev.id === active.id ? 'bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40';
            return `<li><button data-stream-event="${escapeAttribute(ev.id)}" type="button" class="grid w-full grid-cols-2 items-center px-4 py-3 text-left text-sm transition-colors ${activeCls}">
                <span class="truncate font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(ev.name)}</span>
                <span class="truncate text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(ev.date)}</span>
              </button></li>`;
          })
          .join('');

    const metadataHtml = active
      ? (active.metadata ?? [])
          .map((m) => `<div class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
              <dt class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(m.label)}</dt>
              <dd class="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(m.value)}</dd>
            </div>`)
          .join('')
      : '';

    const lineCount = Math.max(detailsLines, active ? String(active.details).split('\n').length : 1);
    const lineNumbers = Array.from({ length: lineCount }, (_, i) => i + 1).join('\n');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-stream-panel class="grid w-full gap-4 lg:grid-cols-5">
        <div data-stream-list class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 lg:col-span-3">
          <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <input data-stream-filter type="text" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(filterPlaceholder)}" class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 outline-none focus:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 dark:text-zinc-100 dark:placeholder-zinc-500">
          </div>
          <div data-stream-columns class="grid grid-cols-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <span>${escapeAttribute(eventColumnLabel)}</span>
            <span>${escapeAttribute(dateColumnLabel)}</span>
          </div>
          <ul data-stream-items>${itemsHtml}</ul>
        </div>
        <div data-stream-details class="space-y-4 lg:col-span-2">
          <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
            <p data-stream-metadata-title class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(metadataTitle)}</p>
            <dl data-stream-metadata class="mt-3 space-y-2">${metadataHtml}</dl>
            <button data-stream-view-event type="button" class="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200">View event</button>
          </div>
          <div class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
            <p data-stream-details-title class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(detailsTitle)}</p>
            <div data-stream-json class="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-4 py-3 font-mono text-[11px] leading-5">
              <span data-stream-json-lines aria-hidden="true" class="select-none whitespace-pre text-right text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">${escapeAttribute(lineNumbers)}</span>
              <pre class="whitespace-pre text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300">${active ? escapeAttribute(active.details) : ''}</pre>
            </div>
            <div data-stream-pager class="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <button type="button" class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">← Previous</button>
              <button type="button" class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">Next →</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('event-stream-panel')) {

class EventTagGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['groups', 'scopes', 'active-scope', 'title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._groups = [];
    this._scopes = ['All', 'Custom', 'Application', 'Client', 'Other'];
    this._activeScope = 'All';
    this._title = 'Tags';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._groups.length) this._groups = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('groups'), DEFAULT_GROUPS());
    const scopes = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('scopes'), null);
    if (Array.isArray(scopes) && scopes.length) this._scopes = scopes;
    const as = this.getAttribute('active-scope');
    if (as) this._activeScope = as;
    const t = this.getAttribute('title');
    if (t) this._title = t;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'groups' && !this._groups.length) this._groups = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    if (name === 'scopes') {
      const scopes = parseJsonAttr(newValue, null);
      if (Array.isArray(scopes) && scopes.length) this._scopes = scopes;
    }
    if (name === 'active-scope') this._activeScope = newValue || 'All';
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'Tags';
    this._render();
  }

  get groups() { return this._groups; }
  set groups(value) { this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const scopeEl = event.target.closest('[data-tag-scope]');
    if (scopeEl) {
      this._activeScope = scopeEl.getAttribute('data-tag-scope');
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('scope-change', { detail: { scope: this._activeScope }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const valueEl = event.target.closest('[data-tag-value]');
    if (valueEl) {
      const groupEl = valueEl.closest('[data-tag-group]');
      const group = this._groups.find((g) => g.id === groupEl?.getAttribute('data-tag-group'));
      const tag = group?.tags.find((t) => t.value === valueEl.getAttribute('data-tag-value'));
      if (group && tag) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tag-click', { detail: { tag, group }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const scopesHtml = this._scopes
      .map((scope) => {
        const active = scope === this._activeScope;
        return `<button type="button" data-tag-scope="${escapeAttribute(scope)}" aria-pressed="${active}" class="${active ? 'rounded bg-white px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-100' : 'rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(scope)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const groupsHtml = this._groups
      .map((group) => {
        const rowsHtml = group.tags
          .map((tag) => {
            const valueClass = tag.link
              ? 'block max-w-full truncate rounded bg-zinc-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-left text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'
              : 'block max-w-full truncate rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-left text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60';
            return `
            <div data-tag-row class="grid grid-cols-[9rem_1fr] items-baseline gap-2 text-xs">
              <dt data-tag-key class="truncate font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" title="${escapeAttribute(tag.key)}">${escapeAttribute(tag.key)}</dt>
              <dd class="min-w-0"><button type="button" data-tag-value="${escapeAttribute(tag.value)}" class="${valueClass}" title="${escapeAttribute(tag.value)}">${escapeAttribute(tag.value)}</button></dd>
            </div>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return `<dl data-tag-group="${escapeAttribute(group.id)}" class="flex flex-col gap-1.5">${rowsHtml}</dl>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-tag-grid class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-tag-grid-header class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-tag-grid-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <div data-tag-grid-scopes class="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 p-0.5 dark:bg-zinc-800">${scopesHtml}</div>
        </div>
        <div data-tag-grid-body class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-6 px-4 py-3 md:grid-cols-2">${groupsHtml}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('event-tag-grid')) {
  customElements.define('event-tag-grid', EventTagGridElement);
}

export default EventTagGridElement;

/**
 * FalRunCard - fal generate-run info card: task type badge, model count and
 * relative time header, prompt paragraph, aspect ratio / total cost metadata
 * rows and a bottom action icon row (duplicate / rerun / delete / share).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

class FalRunCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['type', 'models', 'time', 'prompt', 'aspect', 'cost', 'cost-tone'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get type() {
    return this.getAttribute('type') ?? 'Text To Image';
  }
  set type(value) {
    this.setAttribute('type', value);
  }

  get models() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('models');
    const n = raw === null ? NaN : Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 4;
  }
  set models(value) {
    this.setAttribute('models', String(value));
  }

  get time() {
    return this.getAttribute('time') ?? '22 minutes ago';
  }
  set time(value) {
    this.setAttribute('time', value);
  }

  get prompt() {
    return this.getAttribute('prompt') ?? 'a calm, morning, beach scenery';
  }

    this.setAttribute('prompt', value);

    return this.getAttribute('aspect') ?? '1:1';

    this.setAttribute('aspect', value);

/**
 * FederatedSearchResultsPanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <federated-search results='[...]' source-filters='[...]' selected-sources='[...]'></federated-search>
 * Attributes: results (JSON [{id,title,icon?,subtitle?,snippet,source?}]), source-filters (JSON), selected-sources (JSON), query, search-placeholder, show-keyboard-legend, ask-ai-label
 * Properties: results, query
 * Events: query-change (detail {query}), source-change (detail {ids}), result-select (detail {result})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const escapeRegExp = (text) => String(text).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

const LEGEND = '↑↓ Navigate · ⏎ Select · ESC Close · ⇧⏎ Open in new tab';

export class FederatedSearchResultsPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['results', 'source-filters', 'selected-sources', 'query', 'search-placeholder', 'show-keyboard-legend', 'ask-ai-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._results = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._scopes = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._results.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('results');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._results = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._results = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._query) {
      this._query = this.getAttribute('query') || '';
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const chip = event.target.closest('[data-source-chip]');
        if (chip) {
          const id = chip.getAttribute('data-source-chip');
          if (!this._scopes) this._scopes = new Set(this.selectedSourcesResolved());
          if (this._scopes.has(id)) this._scopes.delete(id);
          else this._scopes.add(id);
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('source-change', { detail: { ids: [...this._scopes] } }));
          return;
        }
        const result = event.target.closest('[data-federated-result]');
        if (result) {
          const id = result.getAttribute('data-federated-result');
          const found = this._results.find((item) => item.id === id);
          if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('result-select', { detail: { result: found } }));
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (target && target.tagName === 'INPUT' && target.hasAttribute('data-federated-input')) {
          this._query = target.value;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('query-change', { detail: { query: this._query } }));
          this.render();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'query') this._query = this.getAttribute('query') || '';
    if (name === 'selected-sources') this._scopes = null;
    this.render();
  }

  get results() {
    return this._results;
  }

  set results(value) {
    this._results = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get query() {
    return this._query;
  }

  set query(value) {
    this._query = String(value ?? '');
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  selectedSourcesResolved() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('selected-sources');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  sourceFiltersResolved() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('source-filters');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  scopes() {
    if (!this._scopes) this._scopes = new Set(this.selectedSourcesResolved());
    return this._scopes;
  }

  highlight(snippet) {
    if (!this._query.trim()) return escapeAttribute(snippet);
    const parts = String(snippet).split(new RegExp(`(${escapeRegExp(this._query)})`, 'gi'));
    return parts
      .map((part) =>
        part.toLowerCase() === this._query.toLowerCase()
          ? `<mark class="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">${escapeAttribute(part)}</mark>`
          : escapeAttribute(part),
      )
      .join('');
  }

  filteredResults() {
    const scopes = this.scopes();
    return scopes.size ? this._results.filter((result) => !result.source || scopes.has(result.source)) : this._results;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const searchPlaceholder = this.getAttribute('search-placeholder') || 'Search everything…';
    const showLegend = this.getAttribute('show-keyboard-legend') !== 'false';
    const askAiLabel = this.getAttribute('ask-ai-label') !== null ? this.getAttribute('ask-ai-label') : 'Press Tab to Ask AI';
    const filters = this.sourceFiltersResolved();
    const scopes = this.scopes();
    const chipsHtml = filters.length
      ? `<div class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">${filters
          .map((filter) => {
            const active = scopes.has(filter.id);
            const chipClass = active
              ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300'
              : 'border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
            return `<button type="button" data-source-chip="${escapeAttribute(filter.id)}" aria-pressed="${active}" class="rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${chipClass}">${escapeAttribute(filter.label)}</button>`;
          })
          .join('')}</div>`
      : '';
    const filtered = this.filteredResults();
    const listHtml = filtered.length
      ? filtered
          .map((result) => {
            const icon = result.icon ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(result.icon)}</span>` : '';
            const sourceBadge = result.source ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(result.source)}</span>` : '';
            const subtitle = result.subtitle ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(result.subtitle)}</span>` : '';
            return `<li>
              <button type="button" data-federated-result="${escapeAttribute(result.id)}" class="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
                <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                  ${icon}
                  <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(result.title)}</span>
                  ${sourceBadge}
                </span>
                ${subtitle}
                <span class="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${this.highlight(result.snippet)}</span>
              </button>
            </li>`;
          })
          .join('')
      : `<li data-federated-empty class="px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No results match your filters.</li>`;
    const legendHtml = showLegend
      ? `<div class="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <p data-federated-legend class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${LEGEND}</p>
          ${askAiLabel ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(askAiLabel)}</span>` : ''}
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-federated-search class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div class="relative">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" /></svg>
          <input type="text" data-federated-input value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(searchPlaceholder)}" class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100" />
        </div>
        ${chipsHtml}
      </div>
      <ul class="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto p-2">${listHtml}</ul>
      ${legendHtml}
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('federated-search')) {
  customElements.define('federated-search', FederatedSearchResultsPanelElement);
}

export default FederatedSearchResultsPanelElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\FileAttachmentList.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
  if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null || Number.isNaN(bytes)) return '';
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
};

const iconForType = (type, name) => {
  if (type && type.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  const ext = (name || '').split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
  if (['js', 'ts', 'tsx', 'jsx', 'py', 'java', 'go', 'rs', 'vue', 'html', 'css', 'json', 'sh'].includes(ext)) return 'code';
  return 'paperclip';
};

export class FileAttachmentListElement extends HTMLElement {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this._files = [];
  }

  get files() {
    return this._files;
  }

  set files(val) {
    this._files = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    if (this._files.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this._applyHostClass('flex flex-wrap gap-2');
    this.innerHTML = this._files
      .map((f) => {
        const sizeText = formatFileSize(f.size);
        return `
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 pr-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
            ${uiIcon(iconForType(f.type, f.name), { size: 14, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
            <span class="max-w-40 truncate font-medium">${escapeAttribute(f.name)}</span>
            ${sizeText ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 shrink-0">${escapeAttribute(sizeText)}</span>` : ''}
            <button
              type="button"
              data-file-id="${escapeAttribute(f.id)}"
              aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(f.name)}"
              class="file-remove p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-colors shrink-0"
            >${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}</button>
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('.file-remove').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-file-id');
        const file = this._files.find((f) => String(f.id) === String(id));
        if (file) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove', { detail: { id: file.id } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('file-attachment-list')) {
  customElements.define('file-attachment-list', FileAttachmentListElement);

===== FILE: vanilla\FileDropzone.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatBytes = (bytes) => {
  if (!bytes) return '0 B';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const exp = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exp;
  return `${value >= 10 || exp === 0 ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[exp]}`;
};

const matchesAccept = (file, accept) => {
  if (!accept) return true;
  return accept
    .split(',')
    .map((token) => token.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .some((token) => {
      if (token.startsWith('.')) return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(token);
      if (token.endsWith('/*')) return Boolean(file.type && file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith(token.slice(0, -1)));
      return file.type && file.type.toLowerCase() === token;
    });
};

const fileIcon = (file) => {
  if (file.type && file.type.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|rs|json|css|html)$/i.test(file.name)) return 'code';
  return 'paperclip';
};

/**
 * FileDropzone - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <file-dropzone accept="image/*" max-size-mb="5"></file-dropzone>
 * Events: files (detail: File[]), reject (detail: [{name, reason}]), remove (detail: {file, index})
 */
export class FileDropzoneElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['accept', 'multiple', 'max-size-mb', 'hint', 'disabled'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._files = [];
    this._dragging = false;
    this._error = null;
  }

  get files() {
    return this._files;
  }

  set files(value) {
    this._files = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _handleFiles(list) {
    const incoming = Array.from(list || []);
    if (incoming.length === 0) return;

    const accept = this.getAttribute('accept') || '';
    const maxSizeMb = Number(this.getAttribute('max-size-mb') || 0) || 0;
    const multiple = !this.hasAttribute('multiple') || this.getAttribute('multiple') !== 'false';

    const rejected = [];
    const accepted = incoming.filter((file) => {
      if (!matchesAccept(file, accept)) {
        rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'type' });
        return false;
      }
      if (maxSizeMb && file.size > maxSizeMb * 1024 * 1024) {
        rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'size' });
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    if (rejected.length) {
      this._error =
        rejected[0].reason === 'size'
          ? `${rejected[0].name} is larger than ${maxSizeMb} MB`
          : `${rejected[0].name} is not an accepted file type`;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reject', { detail: rejected }));
    } else {
      this._error = null;
    }

    if (accepted.length) {
      this.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('files', { detail: multiple ? accepted : accepted.slice(0, 1) })
      );
    }
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const accept = this.getAttribute('accept') || '';
    const multiple = !this.hasAttribute('multiple') || this.getAttribute('multiple') !== 'false';
    const maxSizeMb = Number(this.getAttribute('max-size-mb') || 0) || 0;
    const hint = this.getAttribute('hint') || '';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled') && this.getAttribute('disabled') !== 'false';

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const hintText =
      hint ||
      [accept ? `Accepts ${accept}` : null, maxSizeMb ? `up to ${maxSizeMb} MB` : null].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') ||
      'Any file type';

    const dropClass = this._dragging
      ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30'
      : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600';

    const fileRows = this._files
      .map(
        (file, index) => `
        <li class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1.5">
          <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon(fileIcon(file), { size: 14 })}</span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(file.name)}</span>
            <span class="block text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">${formatBytes(file.size)}</span>
          </span>
          <button type="button" class="file-remove shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
            data-index="${index}" aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(file.name)}">${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}</button>
        </li>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dropzone flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-7 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${dropClass} ${disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : ''}"
        role="button" tabindex="${disabled ? -1 : 0}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(hint || 'Drop files here or browse')}" ${disabled ? 'aria-disabled="true"' : ''}>
        <span class="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('upload', { size: 16 })}</span>
        <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Drag &amp; drop ${multiple ? 'files' : 'a file'} here, or <span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">browse</span></p>
        <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(hintText)}</p>
        <input type="file" class="dropzone-input hidden" ${accept ? `accept="${escapeAttribute(accept)}"` : ''} ${multiple ? 'multiple' : ''} ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} />
      </div>

      ${
        this._error
          ? `<p role="alert" class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-red-600 dark:text-red-400"><span>${uiIcon('alert-triangle', { size: 12 })}</span>${escapeAttribute(this._error)}</p>`
          : ''
      }

      ${fileRows ? `<ul class="file-list mt-3 space-y-1.5">${fileRows}</ul>` : ''}
    `;

    const zone = this.querySelector('.dropzone');
    const input = this.querySelector('.dropzone-input');

    zone.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!disabled) input.click();
    });

    zone.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if ((event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') && !disabled) {
        event.preventDefault();
        input.click();
      }
    });

    zone.addEventListener('dragover', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (!disabled && !this._dragging) {
        this._dragging = true;
        this.render();
      }
    });

    zone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => {
      if (this._dragging) {
        this._dragging = false;
        this.render();
      }
    });

    zone.addEventListener('drop', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      this._dragging = false;
      if (!disabled) this._handleFiles(event.dataTransfer && event.dataTransfer.files);
      else this.render();
    });

    input.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
      this._handleFiles(event.target.files);
      event.target.value = '';
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.file-remove').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-index'));
        const file = this._files[index];
        if (!file) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove', { detail: { file, index } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('file-dropzone')) {
  customElements.define('file-dropzone', FileDropzoneElement);
}
export default FileDropzoneElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * FilterBar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <filter-bar></filter-bar>
 * Properties: filters (FilterDefinition[]), selected (Record<string, string[]>)
 * Events: change (detail: selected map), clear
 */
export class FilterBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return [];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._filters = [];
    this._selected = {};
    this._openId = null;
    this._onPointerDown = (event) => {
      if (!this.contains(event.target)) this._close();
    };
    this._onKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') this._close();
    };
  }

  get filters() {
    return this._filters;
  }

  set filters(value) {
    this._filters = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get selected() {
    return this._selected;
  }

  set selected(value) {
    this._selected = value && typeof value === 'object' ? { ...value } : {};
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._onPointerDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeyDown);
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _close() {
    if (this._openId === null) return;
    this._openId = null;
    this.render();
  }

  _commit(next) {
    this._selected = next;
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: next }));
  }

  _toggleOption(filterId, value) {
    const values = this._selected[filterId] || [];
    const nextValues = values.includes(value) ? values.filter((entry) => entry !== value) : [...values, value];
    const next = { ...this._selected };
    if (nextValues.length > 0) next[filterId] = nextValues;
    else delete next[filterId];
    this._commit(next);
  }

  _clearAll() {
    this._commit({});
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('clear'));
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5');

    const activeCount = Object.values(this._selected).reduce((total, values) => total + values.length, 0);

    const chips = this._filters
      .map((filter) => {
        const values = this._selected[filter.id] || [];
        const active = values.length > 0;
        const open = this._openId === filter.id;
        const options = filter.options
          .map((option) => {
            const checked = values.includes(option.value);
            return `<button type="button" data-filter-id="${escapeAttribute(filter.id)}" data-value="${escapeAttribute(option.value)}" aria-pressed="${checked}"
              class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
              <span class="flex h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border ${
                checked ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600'
              }">${checked ? uiIcon('check', { size: 9, strokeWidth: 3 }) : ''}</span>
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">${escapeAttribute(option.label)}</span>
              ${option.count !== undefined ? `<span class="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(option.count)}</span>` : ''}
            </button>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return `<div class="relative">
          <button type="button" data-filter-toggle="${escapeAttribute(filter.id)}" aria-expanded="${open}" aria-haspopup="true"
            class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              active
                ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300'
                : 'border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600'
            }">
            <span>${escapeAttribute(filter.label)}</span>
            ${active ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1 text-[9px] tabular-nums text-white">${values.length}</span>` : ''}
            <span class="${open ? 'rotate-180 transition-transform' : 'transition-transform'}">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 11 })}</span>
          </button>
          ${
            open
              ? `<div class="absolute left-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-48 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">${options}</div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `${chips}${
      activeCount > 0
        ? `<button type="button" data-filter-clear class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">${uiIcon('x', { size: 11 })}Clear all</button>`
        : ''
    }`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-filter-toggle]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = node.getAttribute('data-filter-toggle');
        this._openId = this._openId === id ? null : id;
        this.render();
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-filter-id]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () =>
        this._toggleOption(node.getAttribute('data-filter-id'), node.getAttribute('data-value'))
      );
    });
    const clear = this.querySelector('[data-filter-clear]');
    if (clear) clear.addEventListener('click', () => this._clearAll());
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('filter-bar')) {
  customElements.define('filter-bar', FilterBarElement);
}

===== FILE: vanilla\FilterQueryBuilder.js =====

/**
 * FilterQueryBuilder - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <filter-query-builder></filter-query-builder> with `fields` and `rows` properties
 * Attributes: add-label, clear-label, max-rows
 * Properties: fields [{name,label,operators?}], rows [{id,conjunction,field,operator,value}]
 * Events: change (detail {rows}), clear
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const OPERATOR_GLYPH = {
  equals: '=',
  'not-equals': '<>',
  greater: '>',
  less: '<',
  contains: '~',
  gte: '>=',
  lte: '<=',
};

const DEFAULT_OPERATORS = ['equals', 'not-equals', 'greater', 'less', 'contains', 'gte', 'lte'];

export class FilterQueryBuilderElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['add-label', 'clear-label', 'max-rows'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._fields = [];
    this._rows = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._fields.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('fields');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._fields = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._fields = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._rows.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('rows');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._rows = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._rows = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const remove = event.target.closest('[data-filter-remove]');
        if (remove) {
          const rowId = remove.closest('[data-filter-row]')?.getAttribute('data-filter-row');
          this._rows = this._rows.filter((row) => row.id !== rowId);
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { rows: this._rows } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-filter-add]')) {
          this.addRow();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-filter-clear]')) {
          this._rows = [];
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { rows: this._rows } }));
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('clear'));
        }
      });
      const applyEdit = (target) => {
        if (!target || !(target.getAttribute && (target.hasAttribute('data-filter-field') || target.hasAttribute('data-filter-operator') || target.hasAttribute('data-filter-value')))) return;
        const rowEl = target.closest('[data-filter-row]');
        if (!rowEl) return;
        const rowId = rowEl.getAttribute('data-filter-row');
        const row = this._rows.find((item) => item.id === rowId);
        if (!row) return;
        if (target.hasAttribute('data-filter-field')) {
          row.field = target.value;
          row.operator = 'equals';
        } else if (target.hasAttribute('data-filter-operator')) {
          row.operator = target.value;
        } else if (target.hasAttribute('data-filter-value')) {
          row.value = target.value;
        } else {
          return;
        }
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { rows: this._rows } }));
      };
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => applyEdit(event.target));
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        // skip our own CustomEvent bubbles; only native control changes apply edits
        if (event instanceof CustomEvent) return;
        applyEdit(event.target);
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get fields() {
    return this._fields;
  }

  set fields(value) {
    this._fields = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get rows() {
    return this._rows;
  }

  set rows(value) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  operatorsFor(name) {
    const field = this._fields.find((item) => item.name === name);
    return field && field.operators ? field.operators : DEFAULT_OPERATORS;
  }

  addRow() {
    this._rows = [
      ...this._rows,
      {
        id: `f${Date.now()}`,
        conjunction: this._rows.length === 0 ? 'where' : 'and',
        field: this._fields[0]?.name || '',
        operator: 'equals',
        value: '',
      },
    ];
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { rows: this._rows } }));
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const addLabel = this.getAttribute('add-label') || '+ Add filter';
    const clearLabel = this.getAttribute('clear-label') || 'Clear filters';
    const maxRows = Number(this.getAttribute('max-rows')) || 8;
    const fields = this._fields;
    const rowsHtml = this._rows
      .map((row, index) => {
        const conjunctionClass =
          index === 0
            ? 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400'
            : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300';
        const fieldOptions = fields
          .map((field) => `<option value="${escapeAttribute(field.name)}"${field.name === row.field ? ' selected' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(field.label)}</option>`)
          .join('');
        const operatorOptions = this.operatorsFor(row.field)
          .map((op) => `<option value="${escapeAttribute(op)}"${op === row.operator ? ' selected' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(OPERATOR_GLYPH[op] || op)}</option>`)
          .join('');
        return `<div data-filter-row="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${conjunctionClass}">${escapeAttribute(row.conjunction)}</span>
          <select data-filter-field class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${fieldOptions}</select>
          <select data-filter-operator class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${operatorOptions}</select>
          <input type="text" data-filter-value value="${escapeAttribute(row.value)}" placeholder="Value" class="min-w-[100px] flex-1 rounded-md border border-transparent bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:border-indigo-400 focus-visible:outline-none dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100" />
          <button type="button" data-filter-remove aria-label="Remove filter" class="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 rounded-full text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="mx-auto h-3 w-3"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
          </button>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');
    const emptyHtml = this._rows.length === 0 ? `<p data-filter-empty class="py-1 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No filters applied.</p>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-filter-query-builder class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="space-y-2">${rowsHtml}${emptyHtml}</div>
      <div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between">
        <button type="button" data-filter-add${this._rows.length >= maxRows ? ' disabled' : ''} class="rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40">${escapeAttribute(addLabel)}</button>
        ${this._rows.length ? `<button type="button" data-filter-clear class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 hover:underline dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(clearLabel)}</button>` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('filter-query-builder')) {
  customElements.define('filter-query-builder', FilterQueryBuilderElement);
}

export default FilterQueryBuilderElement;
