/**
 * FilterToolbar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <filter-toolbar search-placeholder="Search files…" view="list" action-label="Create"></filter-toolbar> with `chips` property
 * Attributes: search-placeholder, search-value, view (list|grid|none), action-label
 * Properties: chips ({ label, value?, valueTone?, removable? }[])
 * Events: chip-remove (detail {index, chip}), search (detail {value}), view-change (detail {view}), action
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const VALUE_TONE = {
  rose: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  amber: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300',
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300',
};

export class FilterToolbarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['search-placeholder', 'search-value', 'view', 'action-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._chips = [];
  }

  get chips() {
    return this._chips;
  }

  set chips(value) {
    this._chips = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const chips = this._chips;
    const searchPlaceholder = this.getAttribute('search-placeholder') || 'Search…';
    const searchValue = this.getAttribute('search-value') || '';
    const viewRaw = this.getAttribute('view');
    const view = viewRaw === 'none' ? '' : viewRaw || 'list';
    const actionLabel = this.getAttribute('action-label') || '';

    const chipHtml = chips
      .map((chip, index) => {
        const valuePill = chip.value
          ? `<span class="rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${VALUE_TONE[chip.valueTone || 'indigo']}">${escapeAttribute(chip.value)}</span>`
          : uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 12, className: 'text-zinc-400' });
        const removeBtn =
          chip.removable && chip.value
            ? `<button type="button" data-chip-remove="${index}" aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(chip.label)} filter" class="ml-0.5 rounded-full p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${uiIcon('x', { size: 11 })}</button>`
            : '';
        return `<span data-filter-chip="${index}" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200">
          ${escapeAttribute(chip.label)}${valuePill}${removeBtn}
        </span>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const viewToggle = view
      ? `<span data-view-toggle role="group" aria-label="View mode" class="flex overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700">
          ${['list', 'grid']
            .map(
              (mode) => `<button type="button" data-view-mode="${mode}" aria-pressed="${view === mode}"
                class="flex h-7 w-8 items-center justify-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                  view === mode
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                    : 'bg-white text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'
                }">${uiIcon(mode === 'list' ? 'more-horizontal' : 'square', { size: 13 })}</button>`,
            )
            .join('')}
        </span>`
      : '';

    const actionBtn = actionLabel
      ? `<button type="button" data-toolbar-action class="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">
          ${uiIcon('plus', { size: 12 })}${escapeAttribute(actionLabel)}
        </button>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-filter-toolbar role="toolbar" aria-label="List filters" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      ${chipHtml}
      <span class="relative ml-auto min-w-[140px] flex-1 sm:max-w-xs">
        ${uiIcon('search', { size: 13, className: 'pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400' })}
        <input type="search" data-toolbar-search value="${escapeAttribute(searchValue)}" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(searchPlaceholder)}"
          class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white py-1.5 pl-8 pr-3 text-xs text-zinc-900 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50" />
      </span>
      ${viewToggle}
      ${actionBtn}
    </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-chip-remove]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-chip-remove'));
        const chip = this._chips[index];
        if (typeof this.onChipRemove === 'function') this.onChipRemove(index, chip);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('chip-remove', { detail: { index, chip } }));
      });
    });
    const search = this.querySelector('[data-toolbar-search]');
    if (search) {
      search.addEventListener('input', () => {
        if (typeof this.onSearch === 'function') this.onSearch(search.value);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('search', { detail: { value: search.value } }));
      });
    }
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-view-mode]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const mode = button.getAttribute('data-view-mode');
        if (typeof this.onViewChange === 'function') this.onViewChange(mode);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('view-change', { detail: { view: mode } }));
      });
    });
    const action = this.querySelector('[data-toolbar-action]');
    if (action) {
      action.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (typeof this.onAction === 'function') this.onAction();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action'));
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('filter-toolbar')) {
  customElements.define('filter-toolbar', FilterToolbarElement);
}

/**

 * Usage: <finetune-job-list title="Fine-tuning jobs" new-text="New fine-tune"></finetune-job-list>
 * Property: jobs ([{id, model, status: queued|training|completed|failed, progress?, cost?, eta?, baseModel?}])
 * Attributes: title, new-text
 * Events: new, cancel (detail {job})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class FineTuneJobListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'new-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._jobs = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-finetune-new]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('new'));
          return;
        }
        const cancelBtn = event.target.closest('[data-finetune-cancel]');
        if (cancelBtn) {
          const card = cancelBtn.closest('[data-finetune-job]');
          const job = this._jobs.find((j) => j.id === card?.getAttribute('data-finetune-job'));
          if (job) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cancel', { detail: { job } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get jobs() { return this._jobs; }
  set jobs(v) {
    this._jobs = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((j) => ({ ...j })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before jobs are captured.
    if (this._jobs.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Fine-tuning jobs');
    const newText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('new-text') || 'New fine-tune');
    const STATUS_STYLE = {
      queued: { chip: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300', label: 'Queued' },
      training: { chip: 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300', label: 'Training' },
      completed: { chip: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300', label: 'Completed' },
      failed: { chip: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300', label: 'Failed' },
    };

    const rows = this._jobs.map((job) => {
      const style = STATUS_STYLE[job.status] || STATUS_STYLE.queued;
      const active = job.status === 'queued' || job.status === 'training';
      const meta = job.cost || job.eta
        ? `<p class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${job.cost ? `<span data-finetune-cost>${escapeAttribute(job.cost)}</span>` : ''}${job.cost && job.eta ? '<span aria-hidden="true">·</span>' : ''}${job.eta ? `<span data-finetune-eta>ETA ${escapeAttribute(job.eta)}</span>` : ''}</p>`
        : '';
      const progress = job.status === 'training'
        ? `<div class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
            <div data-finetune-progress class="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"><div class="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-all" style="width:${job.progress ?? 0}%"></div></div>
            <span class="w-8 text-right font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${job.progress ?? 0}%</span>
          </div>`
        : '';
      const cancel = active
        ? `<div class="mt-2 flex justify-end"><button type="button" data-finetune-cancel class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-600 hover:underline dark:text-red-400">Cancel job</button></div>`
        : '';
      return `
        <div data-finetune-job="${escapeAttribute(job.id)}" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700">

            </p>

          </div>
          ${meta}${progress}${cancel}
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-finetune-list class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">

/**
 * FluidContourBackdrop - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <fluid-contour-backdrop speed="0.035" interactive="true"></fluid-contour-backdrop>
 */

const VERT = `
attribute vec2 a_pos;
void main() { gl_Position = vec4(a_pos, 0.0, 1.0); }
`;

const FRAG = `
#extension GL_OES_standard_derivatives : enable
precision highp float;
uniform vec2 u_res;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_mouse;
uniform vec3 u_ink;
uniform vec3 u_paper;

vec3 mod289(vec3 x) { return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0; }
vec4 mod289(vec4 x) { return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0; }
vec4 permute(vec4 x) { return mod289(((x * 34.0) + 1.0) * x); }
vec4 taylorInvSqrt(vec4 r) { return 1.79284291400159 - 0.85373472095314 * r; }

float snoise(vec3 v) {
  const vec2 C = vec2(1.0 / 6.0, 1.0 / 3.0);
  const vec4 D = vec4(0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0);
  vec3 i = floor(v + dot(v, C.yyy));
  vec3 x0 = v - i + dot(i, C.xxx);
  vec3 g = step(x0.yzx, x0.xyz);
  vec3 l = 1.0 - g;
  vec3 i1 = min(g.xyz, l.zxy);
  vec3 i2 = max(g.xyz, l.zxy);
  vec3 x1 = x0 - i1 + C.xxx;
  vec3 x2 = x0 - i2 + C.yyy;
  vec3 x3 = x0 - D.yyy;
  i = mod289(i);
  vec4 p = permute(permute(permute(
    i.z + vec4(0.0, i1.z, i2.z, 1.0)) +
    i.y + vec4(0.0, i1.y, i2.y, 1.0)) +
    i.x + vec4(0.0, i1.x, i2.x, 1.0));
  float n_ = 0.142857142857;
  vec3 ns = n_ * D.wyz - D.xzx;
  vec4 j = p - 49.0 * floor(p * ns.z * ns.z);
  vec4 x_ = floor(j * ns.z);
  vec4 y_ = floor(j - 7.0 * x_);
  vec4 x = x_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;
  vec4 y = y_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;
  vec4 h = 1.0 - abs(x) - abs(y);
  vec4 b0 = vec4(x.xy, y.xy);
  vec4 b1 = vec4(x.zw, y.zw);
  vec4 s0 = floor(b0) * 2.0 + 1.0;
  vec4 s1 = floor(b1) * 2.0 + 1.0;
  vec4 sh = -step(h, vec4(0.0));
  vec4 a0 = b0.xzyw + s0.xzyw * sh.xxyy;
  vec4 a1 = b1.xzyw + s1.xzyw * sh.zzww;
  vec3 p0 = vec3(a0.xy, h.x);
  vec3 p1 = vec3(a0.zw, h.y);
  vec3 p2 = vec3(a1.xy, h.z);
  vec3 p3 = vec3(a1.zw, h.w);
  vec4 norm = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(p0, p0), dot(p1, p1), dot(p2, p2), dot(p3, p3)));
  p0 *= norm.x; p1 *= norm.y; p2 *= norm.z; p3 *= norm.w;
  vec4 m = max(0.6 - vec4(dot(x0, x0), dot(x1, x1), dot(x2, x2), dot(x3, x3)), 0.0);
  m = m * m;
  return 42.0 * dot(m * m, vec4(dot(p0, x0), dot(p1, x1), dot(p2, x2), dot(p3, x3)));
}

float cursorHill(vec2 frag, float radius) {
  vec2 d = (frag - u_mouse) / u_res.y;
  return exp(-dot(d, d) / (2.0 * radius * radius));
}

vec4 inkAt(float a) {
  float n = fract(sin(dot(gl_FragCoord.xy, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
  a = max(0.0, a + (n - 0.5) / 255.0);
  return vec4(u_ink * a, a);
}

void main() {
  vec2 p = gl_FragCoord.xy / u_res.y;
  float f = snoise(vec3(p * 1.6, u_time)) + 0.5 * snoise(vec3(p * 3.4, u_time * 1.3));
  f += 0.45 * cursorHill(gl_FragCoord.xy, 0.16);
  float bands = f * 6.0;
  float line = abs(fract(bands) - 0.5) / fwidth(bands);
  float a = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, line);
  float index = 1.0 - step(0.5, mod(floor(bands + 0.5), 4.0));
  a *= mix(0.045, 0.08, index);
  gl_FragColor = inkAt(a);
}
`;

class FluidContourBackdrop extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["speed", "interactive", "ink-color", "paper-color"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._cleanup = null;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.init();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._cleanup) {
      this._cleanup();
      this._cleanup = null;
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this.isConnected) {
      this.disconnectedCallback();
      this.init();
    }
  }

  init() {
    this.innerHTML = "";
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    canvas.className = "fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0";
    this.appendChild(canvas);

    const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl", {
      alpha: true,
      antialias: false,
      premultipliedAlpha: true,
      powerPreference: "low-power",
    });
    if (!gl) return;

    gl.getExtension("OES_standard_derivatives");

    function compile(type, src) {
      const s = gl.createShader(type);
      if (!s) return null;
      gl.shaderSource(s, src);
      gl.compileShader(s);
      if (!gl.getShaderParameter(s, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
        gl.deleteShader(s);
        return null;
      }
      return s;
    }

    try {
      const vs = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, VERT);
      const fs = compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, FRAG);
      const prog = gl.createProgram();
      if (!vs || !fs || !prog) return;

      gl.attachShader(prog, vs);
      gl.attachShader(prog, fs);
      gl.linkProgram(prog);
      gl.useProgram(prog);

      const buf = gl.createBuffer();
      gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
      gl.bufferData(
        gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,
        new Float32Array([-1, -1, 3, -1, -1, 3]),
        gl.STATIC_DRAW
      );

      const aPos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, "a_pos");
      gl.enableVertexAttribArray(aPos);
      gl.vertexAttribPointer(aPos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);

      const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_res");
      const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_time");
      const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_mouse");
      const uInk = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_ink");
      const uPaper = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_paper");

      const speed = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("speed") || "0.035");
      const interactive = this.getAttribute("interactive") !== "false";

      // ink-color/paper-color: "r,g,b" normalized 0-1, clamped; must match the
      // React/Vue props so the three stacks stay in parity (llms.txt #220).
      const parseColor3 = (raw, fallback) => {
        const parts = String(raw || "")
          .split(",")
          .map((n) => Number.parseFloat(n));
        if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some((n) => Number.isNaN(n))) return fallback;
        return parts.map((n) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, n)));
      };
      const ink = parseColor3(this.getAttribute("ink-color"), [0.17, 0.23, 0.19]);
      const paper = parseColor3(this.getAttribute("paper-color"), [0.98, 0.98, 0.96]);

      // Resolve reduced-motion FIRST: matchMedia may be absent (jsdom) and
      // throwing here must not leak the listeners registered below.
      const reducedQuery =
        typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
          ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
          : { matches: false };

      gl.uniform3fv(uInk, ink);
      gl.uniform3fv(uPaper, paper);

      const dpr = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.devicePixelRatio || 1 : 1;
      const scale = Math.min(dpr, 2) * 0.75;

      const resize = () => {
        const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(window.innerWidth * scale));
        const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(window.innerHeight * scale));
        if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
          canvas.width = w;
          canvas.height = h;
          gl.viewport(0, 0, w, h);
          gl.uniform2f(uRes, w, h);
        }
      };

      const mouse = { x: -1e4, y: -1e4, tx: -1e4, ty: -1e4 };

      const onPointerMove = (e) => {
        if (!interactive) return;
        mouse.tx = e.clientX * scale;
        mouse.ty = (window.innerHeight - e.clientY) * scale;
        if (mouse.x < -1e3) {
          mouse.x = mouse.tx;
          mouse.y = mouse.ty;
        }
      };

      const onPointerLeave = () => {
        mouse.tx = -1e4;
        mouse.ty = -1e4;
      };

      window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
      document.documentElement.addEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);

      let t = 17;
      let last = performance.now();
      let raf = 0;

      const draw = () => {
        mouse.x += (mouse.tx - mouse.x) * 0.06;
        mouse.y += (mouse.ty - mouse.y) * 0.06;
        gl.uniform1f(uTime, t);
        gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
        gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
      };

      const loop = (now) => {
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        t += Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000) * speed;
        last = now;
        draw();
      };

      const start = () => {
        last = performance.now();
        if (reducedQuery.matches) draw();
        else raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      };

      const stop = () => {
        if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      };

      const onVisibility = () => {
        if (document.hidden) stop();
        else start();
      };

      const onResize = () => {
        resize();
        if (reducedQuery.matches) draw();
      };

      window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

      resize();
      start();

      this._cleanup = () => {
        stop();
        window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
        document.documentElement.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);
        window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
        document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

        if (buf) gl.deleteBuffer(buf);
        if (prog) {
          if (vs) gl.deleteShader(vs);
          if (fs) gl.deleteShader(fs);
          gl.deleteProgram(prog);
        }
      };
    } catch {
      // Fallback
    }

/**
 * FooterSection - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <footer-section brand="Acme" tagline="Ship faster" copyright="© 2026 Acme"></footer-section>
 * Properties: columns (FooterColumn[]), socials ({label, icon}[])
 * Events: link-click (detail: link)
 */
export class FooterSectionElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['brand', 'tagline', 'copyright'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._columns = [];
    this._socials = [];
  }

  get columns() {
    return this._columns;
  }

  set columns(value) {
    this._columns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get socials() {
    return this._socials;
  }

  set socials(value) {
    this._socials = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const brand = this.getAttribute('brand') || '';
    const tagline = this.getAttribute('tagline') || '';
    const copyright = this.getAttribute('copyright') || `© ${new Date().getFullYear()} ${brand}`.trim();

    const brandHtml =
      brand || tagline
        ? `<div class="md:w-56 md:shrink-0">
            ${
              brand
                ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white">${uiIcon('layers', { size: 15 })}</span>
                    <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(brand)}</span>
                  </div>`
                : ''
            }
            ${tagline ? `<p class="mt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tagline)}</p>` : ''}
          </div>`
        : '';

    const columnsHtml = this._columns.length
      ? `<div class="grid flex-1 grid-cols-2 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-3">
          ${this._columns
            .map(
              (column) => `<div>
                <h3 class="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(column.title)}</h3>
                <ul class="mt-3 space-y-2">
                  ${(column.links || [])
                    .map(
                      (link) =>
                        `<li><button type="button" class="footer-link rounded text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:text-indigo-400" data-label="${escapeAttribute(link.label)}">${escapeAttribute(link.label)}</button></li>`
                    )
                    .join('')}
                </ul>
              </div>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    const socialsHtml = this._socials.length
      ? `<ul class="flex items-center gap-1">
          ${this._socials
            .map(
              (social) =>
                `<li><button type="button" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(social.label)}" title="${escapeAttribute(social.label)}"
                  class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">${uiIcon(social.icon || 'globe', { size: 14 })}</button></li>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<footer class="border-t border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950">
      <div class="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col gap-8 px-4 py-10 md:flex-row md:gap-12">
        ${brandHtml}
        ${columnsHtml}
      </div>
      <div class="border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-900">
        <div class="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-4 sm:flex-row">
          <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(copyright)}</p>
          ${socialsHtml}
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.footer-link').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const label = button.getAttribute('data-label');
        const link = this._columns
          .flatMap((column) => column.links || [])
          .find((entry) => entry.label === label);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('link-click', { detail: link || { label } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

/**
 * ForecastTrendChart - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <forecast-trend headline="48.2k" unit="views" delta-label="+108% vs prior" note="…"> with `points` property
 * Attributes: headline, unit, delta-label, delta-tone (emerald|rose|zinc), note
 * Properties: points ({ label, value, forecast? }[])
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE_TEXT = {
  emerald: 'text-emerald-600',
  rose: 'text-rose-600',
  zinc: 'text-zinc-400',
};

const TONE_ICON = {
  emerald: 'trending-up',
  rose: 'trending-down',
  zinc: 'minus',
};

export class ForecastTrendChartElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['headline', 'unit', 'delta-label', 'delta-tone', 'note'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._points = [];
  }

  get points() {
    return this._points;
  }

  set points(value) {
    this._points = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const headline = this.getAttribute('headline') || '0';
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || '';
    const deltaLabel = this.getAttribute('delta-label') || '';
    const deltaTone = this.getAttribute('delta-tone') || 'emerald';
    const note = this.getAttribute('note') || '';
    const points = this._points;
    const max = Math.max(...points.map((point) => point.value), 0.0001);

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-forecast-trend class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
        <p class="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(headline)}${unit ? `<span class="ml-1 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(unit)}</span>` : ''}</p>
        ${
          deltaLabel
            ? `<span class="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${TONE_TEXT[deltaTone]}">${uiIcon(TONE_ICON[deltaTone] || 'trending-up', { size: 12 })}${escapeAttribute(deltaLabel)}</span>`
            : ''
        }
      </div>
      ${note ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(note)}</p>` : ''}
      <div class="mt-4 flex h-28 items-end gap-1" role="img" aria-label="Trend with forecast">
        ${points
          .map((point, index) => {
            const height = Math.max(4, Math.round((point.value / max) * 100));
            const bar = point.forecast
              ? `<div class="w-full max-w-6 rounded-md border-2 border-dashed border-sky-400 bg-sky-100/50 dark:border-sky-500 dark:bg-sky-900/40" style="height:${height}%" title="${escapeAttribute(point.label)}: ${escapeAttribute(point.value + unit)} (forecast)"></div>`
              : `<div class="w-full max-w-6 rounded-md bg-sky-500 transition-all duration-300 dark:bg-sky-400" style="height:${height}%" title="${escapeAttribute(point.label)}: ${escapeAttribute(point.value + unit)}"></div>`;
            return `<div data-point-index="${index}" class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <div class="relative flex h-full w-full items-end justify-center">${bar}</div>
              <span class="truncate text-[9px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(point.label)}</span>
            </div>`;
          })
          .join('')}
      </div>
      <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-4 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm bg-sky-500"></span> Actual</span>
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-sm border border-dashed border-sky-400 bg-sky-100/50"></span> Forecast</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

===== FILE: vanilla\FormField.js =====

/**
 * FormField - Vanilla Web Component (wrapper for one labeled field)
 * Usage: <form-field label="Policy name" required counter-value="19" counter-max="70" hint="…"><input/></form-field>
 * Attributes: label, for, required, optional, hint, error, counter-value, counter-max, helper-footer
 * Slots: default (the control)
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class FormFieldElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'for', 'required', 'optional', 'hint', 'error', 'counter-value', 'counter-max', 'helper-footer'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex flex-col gap-1.5');
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const htmlFor = this.getAttribute('for') || '';
    const required = this.hasAttribute('required');
    const optional = this.hasAttribute('optional');
    const hint = this.getAttribute('hint') || '';
    const error = this.getAttribute('error') || '';
    const helperFooter = this.getAttribute('helper-footer') || '';
    const counterRaw = this.getAttribute('counter-value');
    const counterMax = this.getAttribute('counter-max');
    const counter =
      counterRaw !== null && counterMax !== null
        ? `<p class="self-end text-xs tabular-nums text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(counterRaw)}/${escapeAttribute(counterMax)}</p>`
        : '';

    // Insert slotted controls after the label (preserves live state); render() re-runs
    // are safe because nodes are moved, not cloned.
    const slotNodes = Array.from(this.childNodes).filter((node) => node.nodeType === 1);
    const previousWrapper = this.querySelector('[data-form-field]');

    const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.setAttribute('data-form-field', '');
    wrapper.className = 'flex flex-col gap-1.5';
    if (error) wrapper.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    wrapper.innerHTML = `<label ${htmlFor ? `for="${escapeAttribute(htmlFor)}"` : ''} class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
        ${required ? '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-rose-500">*</span>' : ''}
        ${escapeAttribute(label)}
        ${optional ? '<span class="text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Optional)</span>' : ''}
      </label>
      ${
        error
          ? `<p class="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">${uiIcon('alert-triangle', { size: 12 })}${escapeAttribute(error)}</p>`
          : hint
            ? `<p class="text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(hint)}</p>`
            : ''
      }
      ${counter}
      ${helperFooter ? `<p class="text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(helperFooter)}</p>` : ''}`;
    const labelEl = wrapper.querySelector('label');
    for (const node of slotNodes) {
      if (node === previousWrapper) continue;
      labelEl.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', node);
    }
    this.replaceChildren(wrapper);
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('form-field')) {
  customElements.define('form-field', FormFieldElement);
}
export default FormFieldElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\FormTrackingDashboard.js =====

/**
 * FormTrackingDashboard - Form tracking dashboard: back arrow header with
 * title, Active pill and Options dropdown, four stat cards with colored
 * icon dots and % progress bars, a two-column form details grid, and a
 * sortable client requests table with avatar rows and status pills
 * (Fresha form tracking pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_STATS = () => [
  { id: 's1', label: 'Sent to', value: 12, pct: 100, tone: 'sky', icon: '📤' },
  { id: 's2', label: 'Completed', value: 8, pct: 67, tone: 'emerald', icon: '✅' },
  { id: 's3', label: 'To be completed', value: 2, pct: 17, tone: 'amber', icon: '⏳' },
  { id: 's4', label: 'Not completed', value: 2, pct: 17, tone: 'rose', icon: '⛔' },
];

const DEFAULT_DETAILS = () => [
  { label: 'Form name', value: 'Consultation form' },
  { label: 'Service', value: 'Initial consultation' },
  { label: 'Sent to', value: '12 clients' },
  { label: 'Created', value: 'Nov 2, 2026' },
  { label: 'Reminder', value: 'Automatic · 3 days' },
  { label: 'Expiration', value: 'No expiration' },
];

const DEFAULT_REQUESTS = () => [
  { id: 'r1', name: 'Anna Kowalski', initials: 'AK', submitted: 'Nov 12, 2026', service: 'Initial consultation', status: 'completed' },
  { id: 'r2', name: 'Ben Carter', initials: 'BC', submitted: 'Nov 13, 2026', service: 'Initial consultation', status: 'to-be-completed' },
  { id: 'r3', name: 'Chen Wei', initials: 'CW', submitted: '—', service: 'Initial consultation', status: 'not-completed' },
  { id: 'r4', name: 'Dana Patel', initials: 'DP', submitted: 'Nov 14, 2026', service: 'Initial consultation', status: 'completed' },
];

const DEFAULT_SORT_OPTIONS = () => ['Newest first', 'Oldest first', 'Name A–Z', 'Status'];

const STATUS_META = {
  completed: { label: 'Completed', cls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300' },
  'to-be-completed': { label: 'To be completed', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300' },
  'not-completed': { label: 'Not completed', cls: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300' },
};

const TONE_DOT = { sky: 'bg-sky-500', emerald: 'bg-emerald-500', amber: 'bg-amber-500', rose: 'bg-rose-500' };
const TONE_BAR = { sky: 'bg-sky-500', emerald: 'bg-emerald-500', amber: 'bg-amber-500', rose: 'bg-rose-500' };

const clampPct = (n) => Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Number(n) || 0));

class FormTrackingDashboardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'active', 'stats', 'details', 'requests', 'sort-options'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._sortOpen = false;
    this._sort = '';
    this._onDocClick = (event) => {
      if (this._sortOpen && !event.target.closest('[data-formtrack-options]') && !event.target.closest('[data-formtrack-sortmenu]')) {
        this._sortOpen = false;
        this._render();
      }
    };
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    if (!this._sort) this._sort = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sort-options'), DEFAULT_SORT_OPTIONS())[0] ?? 'Newest first';
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    document.addEventListener('click', this._onDocClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    document.removeEventListener('click', this._onDocClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'sort-options' && !this._sort) {
      this._sort = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_SORT_OPTIONS())[0] ?? 'Newest first';
    }
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-formtrack-back]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('back', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-formtrack-options]')) {
      this._sortOpen = !this._sortOpen;
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    const sortOption = event.target.closest('[data-formtrack-sortoption]');
    if (sortOption) {
      this._sort = sortOption.getAttribute('data-formtrack-sortoption');
      this._sortOpen = false;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sort-change', { detail: { option: this._sort }, bubbles: true }));
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    const row = event.target.closest('[data-formtrack-row]');
    if (row) {
      const requests = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('requests'), DEFAULT_REQUESTS());
      const found = requests.find((r) => r.id === row.getAttribute('data-formtrack-row'));
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('request-click', { detail: { row: found }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Consultation form';
    const active = this.getAttribute('active') !== 'false';
    const stats = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('stats'), DEFAULT_STATS());
    const details = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('details'), DEFAULT_DETAILS());
    const requests = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('requests'), DEFAULT_REQUESTS());
    const sortOptions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sort-options'), DEFAULT_SORT_OPTIONS());

    const statsHtml = stats
      .map(
        (s) => `<div data-formtrack-stat="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ${TONE_DOT[s.tone] ?? TONE_DOT.sky}" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${s.icon ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="mr-1">${escapeAttribute(s.icon)}</span>` : ''}${escapeAttribute(s.label)}</p>
            </div>
            <p data-formtrack-stat-value="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}" class="mt-1.5 text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(s.value)}</p>
            <div class="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
              <div class="h-full rounded-full ${TONE_BAR[s.tone] ?? TONE_BAR.sky}" style="width:${clampPct(s.pct)}%"></div>
            </div>
            <p class="mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${clampPct(s.pct)}% of sent</p>
          </div>`
      )
      .join('');

    const detailsHtml = details
      .map(
        (d) => `<div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(d.label)}</span>
            <span class="font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(d.value)}</span>
          </div>`
      )
      .join('');

    const rowsHtml = requests
      .map((r) => {
        const meta = STATUS_META[r.status] ?? STATUS_META['not-completed'];
        return `<tr data-formtrack-row="${escapeAttribute(r.id)}" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-100 transition-colors last:border-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40">
            <td class="px-4 py-2.5">
              <span class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:text-indigo-300">${r.avatarUrl ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(r.avatarUrl)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(r.name)}" class="h-8 w-8 rounded-full object-cover" />` : escapeAttribute(r.initials ?? r.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase())}</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(r.name)}</span>
              </span>
            </td>
            <td class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(r.submitted)}</td>
            <td class="px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(r.service)}</td>
            <td class="px-4 py-2.5">
              <span data-formtrack-status="${escapeAttribute(r.status)}" class="inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${meta.cls}">${meta.label}</span>
            </td>
          </tr>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const sortMenuHtml = this._sortOpen
      ? `<div data-formtrack-sortmenu class="absolute right-0 z-10 mt-1 w-44 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">${sortOptions
          .map(
            (opt) => `<button data-formtrack-sortoption="${escapeAttribute(opt)}" type="button" class="block w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 ${opt === this._sort ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300'}">${escapeAttribute(opt)}</button>`
          )
          .join('')}</div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `

/**
 * GammaImageDetail - Gamma AI-images detail pane: large preview with a
 * download / zoom / delete icon row and like / dislike pair, plus the full
 * generation prompt in a bordered reading block.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

class GammaImageDetailElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'preview', 'prompt', 'liked'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._liked = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this.getAttribute('liked') === 'true') {
      this._liked = true;
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'liked') {
      this._liked = newValue === 'true';
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'AI images';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get preview() {
    return this.getAttribute('preview') ?? '';
  }
  set preview(value) {
    this.setAttribute('preview', value);
  }

  get prompt() {
    return this.getAttribute('prompt') ?? 'Generate the following image: Mobile-first social media carousel content slide with professional creative aesthetic.';
  }
  set prompt(value) {
    this.setAttribute('prompt', value);
  }

  get liked() {
    return this._liked;
  }
  set liked(value) {
    this._liked = Boolean(value);
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const map = [
      ['[data-gamma-detail-download]', 'download'],
      ['[data-gamma-detail-zoom]', 'zoom'],
      ['[data-gamma-detail-delete]', 'delete'],
      ['[data-gamma-detail-dislike]', 'dislike'],
      ['[data-gamma-detail-like]', 'like'],
      ['[data-gamma-detail-close]', 'close'],
    ];
    for (const [selector, name] of map) {
      if (event.target.closest(selector)) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name, { bubbles: true }));
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const preview = this.preview
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(this.preview)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(this.title)}" class="max-h-64 w-auto object-cover" />`
      : '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-3xl text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">🖼</span>';
    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-gamma-image-detail class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 data-gamma-detail-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)}</h3>
          <button type="button" data-gamma-detail-close aria-label="Close detail" class="text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div data-gamma-detail-preview class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" style="min-height:160px">${preview}</div>
        <div data-gamma-detail-toolbar class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button type="button" data-gamma-detail-download aria-label="Download image" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">↓</button>
            <button type="button" data-gamma-detail-zoom aria-label="Zoom image" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">🔍</button>
            <button type="button" data-gamma-detail-delete aria-label="Delete image" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40">🗑</button>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button type="button" data-gamma-detail-dislike aria-label="Dislike image" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">👎</button>
            <button type="button" data-gamma-detail-like aria-pressed="${this._liked}" aria-label="Like image" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 ${this._liked ? 'text-rose-500' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'}">👍</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-3">

===== FILE: vanilla\GanttTimeline.js =====

/**
 * GanttTimeline - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <gantt-timeline columns="10" today="4"></gantt-timeline> with `tasks` property
 * Attributes: columns, today, column-label, row-label, empty-text
 * Properties: tasks ({ label, start, span, progress?, tone?, depth? }[])
 * Events: task-click (detail: { task, index })
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE_CLASS = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  sky: 'bg-sky-500',
};

export class GanttTimelineElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['columns', 'today', 'column-label', 'row-label', 'empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tasks = [];
  }

  get tasks() {
    return this._tasks;
  }

  set tasks(value) {
    this._tasks = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const columns = Number(this.getAttribute('columns')) || 10;
    const todayRaw = this.getAttribute('today');
    const columnLabel = this.getAttribute('column-label') || 'Timeline';
    const rowLabel = this.getAttribute('row-label') || 'Name';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'No tasks scheduled';
    const cells = Array.from({ length: columns }, (_, index) => index);
    const gridLines = cells
      .map(
        (cell) =>
          `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-y-0 border-l border-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60" style="left:${(cell / columns) * 100}%"></span>`,
      )
      .join('');

    const rows = this._tasks
      .map((task, index) => {
        const start = Math.min(Math.max(task.start, 0), columns);
        const offset = start / columns;
        const width = Math.min(Math.max(task.span, 0), columns - start) / columns;
        const tone = TONE_CLASS[task.tone || 'indigo'] || TONE_CLASS.indigo;
        return `<div role="row" data-task-index="${index}" class="flex items-stretch border-b border-zinc-50 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${
          typeof this.onTaskClick === 'function'
            ? 'cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40'
            : ''
        }">
          <span role="cell" class="flex w-44 shrink-0 items-center py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200" style="padding-left:${1 + (task.depth || 0) * 1.25}rem">
            <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(task.label)}</span>
          </span>
          <div role="cell" class="relative min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
            ${gridLines}
            ${
              todayRaw !== null
                ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-y-0 w-px bg-rose-400" style="left:${(Math.min(Math.max(Number(todayRaw) || 0, 0), columns) / columns) * 100}%"></span>`
                : ''
            }
            <div data-task-bar class="absolute top-1/2 flex h-4 -translate-y-1/2 items-center overflow-hidden rounded" style="left:${offset * 100}%;width:calc(${width * 100}% - 4px)">
              <div class="relative h-full ${tone}">
                ${
                  task.progress !== undefined
                    ? `<span class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-white/30" style="width:${Math.min(Math.max(task.progress, 0), 100)}%"></span>`
                    : ''
                }
              </div>
              <span class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white">${task.progress !== undefined ? `${task.progress}%` : ''}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-gantt-timeline role="table" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(columnLabel)}" aria-rowcount="${this._tasks.length}" class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div role="row" class="flex items-center border-b border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40">
        <span role="columnheader" class="w-44 shrink-0 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(rowLabel)}</span>
        <div class="relative flex min-w-0 flex-1">
          ${cells
            .map(
              (cell) =>
                `<span role="columnheader" class="min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 px-1 py-2 text-center text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">${cell + 1}</span>`,
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>
      </div>
      ${
        this._tasks.length === 0
          ? `<p class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`
          : rows
      }
    </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-task-index]').forEach((row) => {
      row.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number(row.getAttribute('data-task-index'));
        if (typeof this.onTaskClick === 'function') this.onTaskClick(this._tasks[index], index);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('task-click', { detail: { task: this._tasks[index], index } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('gantt-timeline')) {
  customElements.define('gantt-timeline', GanttTimelineElement);
}
export default GanttTimelineElement;

/**
 * GroupedBarCompare - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <grouped-bar-compare title="Estimated vs actual" legend-estimated="Estimated" legend-actual="Actual" unit="h"> with `rows` property
 * Attributes: title, legend-estimated, legend-actual, unit
 * Properties: rows ({ name, estimated, actual, unit? }[])
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class GroupedBarCompareElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'legend-estimated', 'legend-actual', 'unit'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._rows = [];
  }

  get rows() {
    return this._rows;
  }

  set rows(value) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Estimated vs actual';
    const legendEstimated = this.getAttribute('legend-estimated') || 'Estimated';
    const legendActual = this.getAttribute('legend-actual') || 'Actual';
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || 'h';
    const rows = this._rows;
    const max = Math.max(...rows.flatMap((row) => [row.estimated, row.actual]), 0.0001);
    const heightOf = (value) => Math.max(4, Math.round((value / max) * 100));

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-grouped-bar-compare role="table" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
          <span class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-violet-400"></span>${escapeAttribute(legendEstimated)}</span>
          <span class="flex items-center gap-1"><span class="h-2 w-2 rounded-sm bg-lime-400"></span>${escapeAttribute(legendActual)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="mt-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-3" aria-label="Grouped bar chart">
        ${rows
          .map((row, index) => {
            const estimatedHeight = heightOf(row.estimated);
            const actualHeight = heightOf(row.actual);
            return `<div data-bar-row="${index}" role="row" class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
              <div class="flex h-28 w-full items-end justify-center gap-1">
                <div class="flex h-full w-1/3 flex-col items-center justify-end">
                  <span class="mb-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(row.estimated)}${escapeAttribute(row.unit ?? unit)}</span>
                  <div class="w-full rounded-t-md bg-violet-400 transition-all duration-300" style="height:${estimatedHeight}%" title="${escapeAttribute(legendEstimated)}: ${escapeAttribute(row.estimated + (row.unit ?? unit))}"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="flex h-full w-1/3 flex-col items-center justify-end">
                  <span class="mb-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(row.actual)}${escapeAttribute(row.unit ?? unit)}</span>
                  <div class="w-full rounded-t-md bg-lime-400 transition-all duration-300" style="height:${actualHeight}%" title="${escapeAttribute(legendActual)}: ${escapeAttribute(row.actual + (row.unit ?? unit))}"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <span class="w-full truncate text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(row.name)}</span>
            </div>`;
          })
          .join('')}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('grouped-bar-compare')) {
  customElements.define('grouped-bar-compare', GroupedBarCompareElement);

===== FILE: vanilla\GroupedTaskList.js =====

/**
 * GroupedTaskList - Grouped task list with a split detail pane: left list
 * with collapsible sections (To Do / In Progress / Done), task rows with
 * completion circle, due date, subtask count and assignee avatar, "Add
 * task…" inline rows; right detail pane with completion badge, title,
 * assignee row, due date row, project chip, fields grid (estimated/actual
 * time, duration, summary, priority, tags) and a comment composer
 * (Asana list view pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_SECTIONS = () => [
  {
    id: 'todo',
    label: 'To Do',
    tasks: [
      { id: 't1', title: 'Prepare Demo Materials', due: '', done: false, subtasks: 1, assignee: 'JM' },
      { id: 't2', title: 'Align Schedule with Other Divisions', due: 'Jan 2, 2026', done: false, assignee: 'JM' },
      { id: 't3', title: 'Schedule a meeting to define Demo Scope & Key Features', due: 'Tuesday', done: false, assignee: 'AK' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'inprogress',
    label: 'In Progress',
    tasks: [
      { id: 't4', title: 'Define Product Demo Goal', due: 'Tomorrow 3:30pm', done: false, likes: 1, comments: 2, subtasks: 1, assignee: 'AK' },
      { id: 't5', title: 'Scheduling a quick call with Product Owner', due: 'Friday', done: false, assignee: 'AK' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'done',
    label: 'Done',
    tasks: [
      { id: 't6', title: 'Scheduling a KickOff Meeting', due: 'Dec 19', done: false, assignee: 'JM' },
      { id: 't7', title: 'Create a Template for Demo Script', due: 'Dec 22', done: true, assignee: 'AK' },
    ],
  },
];

const FIELD_TONE_STYLES = {
  rose: 'rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/70 dark:text-red-300',
  emerald: 'rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300',
};

class GroupedTaskListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['sections', 'detail', 'add-task-label', 'comment-placeholder'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._openSections = ['todo', 'inprogress', 'done'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const toggle = event.target.closest('[data-tasklist-section-toggle]');
    if (toggle) {
      const sectionId = toggle.getAttribute('data-tasklist-section-toggle');
      const isOpen = this._openSections.includes(sectionId);
      this._openSections = isOpen ? this._openSections.filter((s) => s !== sectionId) : [...this._openSections, sectionId];
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('section-toggle', { detail: { sectionId, open: !isOpen }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const task = event.target.closest('[data-tasklist-task]');
    if (task) {
      const found = this._sections().flatMap((s) => s.tasks).find((t) => t.id === task.getAttribute('data-tasklist-task'));
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('task-click', { detail: { task: found }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _onKeydown(event) {
    const input = event.target.closest('[data-tasklist-comment-input]');
    if (input && event.key === 'Enter' && input.value.trim()) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('comment-submit', { detail: { text: input.value.trim() }, bubbles: true }));
      input.value = '';
    }
  }

  _sections() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sections'), DEFAULT_SECTIONS());
  }

  _detail() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('detail'), {
      completedLabel: 'Completed',
      title: 'Define Product Demo Goal',
      assignee: 'Alex Smith',
      due: 'Tomorrow 3:30pm',
      project: 'Product Demo – A',
      projectStatus: 'In Progress',
      fields: [
        { label: 'Estimated time', value: '3h 45m' },
        { label: 'Actual time', value: '1h 36m' },
        { label: 'Duration', value: '-1d 2h' },
        { label: 'Task summary', value: 'Documented Product Demo A goal including target audience, value message, success criteria & feature scope. Review requested by 8AM.' },
        { label: 'Priority', value: 'High', tone: 'rose' },
        { label: 'Percent allocation', value: '–' },
      ],
      tags: ['documentation'],
      description: 'Document the goal of Product Demo A, including target audience, primary value message, success criteria, and feature scope.',
    });
  }

  _render() {
    const addTaskLabel = this.getAttribute('add-task-label') || 'Add task…';
    const commentPlaceholder = this.getAttribute('comment-placeholder') || 'Add a comment';
    const sections = this._sections();
    const detail = this._detail();
    const initials = String(detail.assignee ?? '').split(' ').map((p) => p[0]).join('');

    const sectionsHtml = sections
      .map((section) => {
        const open = this._openSections.includes(section.id);
        const tasksHtml = open
          ? `<ul data-tasklist-items>${section.tasks
              .map((task) => {
                const circleCls = task.done
                  ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'
                  : 'border-zinc-300 text-transparent dark:border-zinc-600';
                const titleCls = task.done ? 'text-zinc-400 line-through dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100';
                return `<li><button data-tasklist-task="${escapeAttribute(task.id)}" type="button" class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-left text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40">
                    <span aria-hidden="true" class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[9px] ${circleCls}">✓</span>
                    <span class="flex-1 truncate ${titleCls}">${escapeAttribute(task.title)}</span>
                    ${task.likes ? `<span class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">👍 ${Number(task.likes)}</span>` : ''}
                    ${task.comments ? `<span class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">💬 ${Number(task.comments)}</span>` : ''}
                    ${task.subtasks ? `<span class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">⑂ ${Number(task.subtasks)}</span>` : ''}
                    <span class="w-24 shrink-0 truncate text-right text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(task.due)}</span>
                    <span class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-400 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-950">${escapeAttribute(task.assignee)}</span>
                  </button></li>`;
              })
              .join('')}<li data-tasklist-add-inline class="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(addTaskLabel)}</li></ul>`
          : '';
        return `<div data-tasklist-section="${escapeAttribute(section.id)}">
            <button data-tasklist-section-toggle="${escapeAttribute(section.id)}" type="button" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-left">
              <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-xs text-zinc-400">${open ? '▾' : '▸'}</span>
              <span class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(section.label)}</span>
            </button>
            ${tasksHtml}
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const fieldsHtml = (detail.fields ?? [])
      .map((field, i) => {
        const toneCls = FIELD_TONE_STYLES[field.tone] ?? 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100';
        return `<div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs ${i > 0 ? 'border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800' : ''}">
            <span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(field.label)}</span>
            <span class="col-span-2 ${toneCls}">${escapeAttribute(field.value)}</span>
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const tagsHtml = (detail.tags ?? []).length
      ? `<div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Tags</span>
          <span class="col-span-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">${(detail.tags ?? [])
            .map((tag) => `<span class="rounded bg-emerald-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300">${escapeAttribute(tag)} ✕</span>`)
            .join('')}</span>
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-tasklist class="grid w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm lg:grid-cols-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-tasklist-list class="border-r border-zinc-100 lg:col-span-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div data-tasklist-toolbar class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <button data-tasklist-add type="button" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">＋ Add task</button>
          </div>
          <div data-tasklist-name-header class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">Name</div>
          ${sectionsHtml}
        </div>
        <div data-tasklist-detail class="space-y-4 p-5 lg:col-span-2">
          ${detail.completedLabel ? `<span data-tasklist-completed class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:border-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300">✓ ${escapeAttribute(detail.completedLabel)}</span>` : ''}
          <h2 data-tasklist-title class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(detail.title)}</h2>
          <div data-tasklist-meta class="space-y-2.5 text-sm">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">

            <span aria-hidden="true" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-xs dark:bg-zinc-700">👤</span>
            <input data-tasklist-comment-input type="text" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(commentPlaceholder)}" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 outline-none focus:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 dark:text-zinc-100">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}
