===== FILE: vanilla\GuardrailReviewQueue.js =====

/**
 * GuardrailReviewQueue - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <guardrail-review-queue title="Moderation queue" items='[...]'></guardrail-review-queue>
 * Attributes: title, items (JSON: [{id,author,content,reasons:string[],rule?,confidence?,verdict?}])
 * Events: approve (detail {item}), reject (detail {item})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

export class GuardrailReviewQueueElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'items'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._items = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._items.length) this._items = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('items'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const approveBtn = event.target.closest('[data-guardrail-approve]');
        const rejectBtn = event.target.closest('[data-guardrail-reject]');
        if (!approveBtn && !rejectBtn) return;
        const card = (approveBtn || rejectBtn).closest('[data-guardrail-card]');
        const item = this._items.find((i) => i.id === card?.getAttribute('data-guardrail-card'));
        if (!item) return;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(approveBtn ? 'approve' : 'reject', { detail: { item } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'items' && !this._items.length) {
      this._items = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('items'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get items() { return this._items; }
  set items(v) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((i) => ({ ...i })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const items = this._items;
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Moderation queue');
    const pending = items.filter((i) => (i.verdict ?? 'pending') === 'pending');

    const cards = items.map((item) => {
      const verdict = item.verdict ?? 'pending';
      if (verdict !== 'pending') {
        return `<div data-guardrail-resolved="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
          <span class="inline rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium ${verdict === 'approved'
            ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300'
            : 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300'}">${verdict === 'approved' ? '✓ Approved' : '✕ Rejected'}</span>
          <span data-guardrail-resolved-author>${escapeAttribute(item.author)}</span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">${escapeAttribute(item.content)}</span>
        </div>`;
      }
      const reasons = item.reasons.length > 0
        ? `<div data-guardrail-reasons class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            ${item.reasons.map((reason) => `<span data-guardrail-reason class="inline rounded bg-amber-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300">${escapeAttribute(reason)}</span>`).join('')}
          </div>`
        : '';
      return `<div data-guardrail-card="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="p-4">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span data-guardrail-author class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.author)}</span>
          ${typeof item.confidence === 'number'
            ? `<span data-guardrail-confidence class="rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold tabular-nums ${item.confidence >= 0.9
                ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300'
                : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300'}">${Math.round(item.confidence * 100)}% confidence</span>`
            : ''}
          ${item.rule
            ? `<span data-guardrail-rule class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.rule)}</span>`
            : ''}
        </div>
        <p data-guardrail-content class="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(item.content)}</p>
        ${reasons}
        <div class="mt-3 flex gap-2">
          <button type="button" data-guardrail-approve class="flex-1 rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500">Approve</button>
          <button type="button" data-guardrail-reject class="flex-1 rounded-md bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-red-500">Reject</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-guardrail-queue class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${title}</span>
    <span data-guardrail-count class="ml-auto rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300">${pending.length} flagged</span>
  </div>
  <div data-guardrail-list class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
    ${cards}
    ${items.length === 0 ? '<p data-guardrail-empty class="px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">No flagged content in the queue.</p>' : ''}
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('guardrail-review-queue')) {
  customElements.define('guardrail-review-queue', GuardrailReviewQueueElement);
}

export default GuardrailReviewQueueElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\HealthDonutStats.js =====

/**
 * HealthDonutStats - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <health-donut-stats></health-donut-stats> with `cards` property
 * Properties: cards ({ title, caption?, slices: { label, value, tone }[], action?: { label } }[])
 * Events: action-click (detail: { index, label })
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE_DOT = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  zinc: 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
};

const SLICE_COLOR = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  zinc: 'bg-zinc-300',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
};

const sumOf = (slices) => slices.reduce((sum, slice) => sum + Math.max(0, slice.value), 0);

const donutGradient = (slices) => {
  const total = sumOf(slices) || 1;
  let cursor = 0;
  const stops = [];
  slices.forEach((slice) => {
    const start = (cursor / total) * 360;
    cursor += Math.max(0, slice.value);
    const end = (cursor / total) * 360;
    stops.push(`${SLICE_COLOR[slice.tone]} ${start}deg ${end}deg`);
  });
  return `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})`;
};

export class HealthDonutStatsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return [];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._cards = [];
  }

  get cards() {
    return this._cards;
  }

  set cards(value) {
    this._cards = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3');
    const cards = this._cards;
    if (!cards.length) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = cards
      .map((card, index) => {
        const total = sumOf(card.slices);
        const primary = card.slices.reduce(
          (best, slice) => (slice.value > best.value ? slice : best),
          card.slices[0] || { label: '', value: 0, tone: 'indigo' },
        );
        const percent = total ? Math.round((primary.value / total) * 100) : 0;
        const legend = card.slices
          .map((slice, sliceIndex) => {
            const share = total ? Math.round((slice.value / total) * 100) : 0;
            return `<li class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              <span class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${TONE_DOT[slice.tone]}"></span>
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">${escapeAttribute(slice.label)}</span>
              <span class="shrink-0 font-medium tabular-nums">${share}%</span>
            </li>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return `<div data-donut-card="${index}" class="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div class="relative h-16 w-16 shrink-0">
              <div class="h-16 w-16 rounded-full" style="background:${donutGradient(card.slices)}"></div>
              <div class="absolute inset-[10px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
                <span data-donut-center class="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${percent}%</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p class="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(card.title)}</p>
              ${card.caption ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(card.caption)}</p>` : ''}
              <ul class="mt-2 space-y-1">${legend}</ul>
            </div>
          </div>
          ${
            card.action
              ? `<button type="button" data-donut-action data-action-index="${index}" class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(card.action.label)}</button>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-donut-action]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-action-index'));
        const card = this._cards[index];
        if (typeof this.onActionClick === 'function') this.onActionClick(index, card?.action?.label);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action-click', { detail: { index, label: card?.action?.label } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('health-donut-stats')) {
  customElements.define('health-donut-stats', HealthDonutStatsElement);
}
export default HealthDonutStatsElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\HelpCenterHome.js =====

/**
 * HelpCenterHome - Help center landing: hero title, big search bar with
 * submit button and "browse by topic" rows with expandable article links
 * (GetYourGuide help center pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_TOPICS = () => [
  { id: 'plan', label: 'Plan, search and book' },
  { id: 'activity', label: 'Activity information' },
  { id: 'voucher', label: 'Booking confirmation, voucher and tickets' },
  { id: 'pickup', label: 'Meeting point and pickup' },
  { id: 'day', label: 'On the day of the activity' },
  { id: 'management', label: 'Booking management', articles: ['Change the date or time', 'Cancel your booking', 'Refund policy'] },
  { id: 'cancellation', label: 'Cancellation' },
  { id: 'payment', label: 'Payment and refunds' },
];

class HelpCenterHomeElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'search-placeholder', 'topics'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._openId = 'management';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.addEventListener('submit', this._onSubmit, true);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.removeEventListener('submit', this._onSubmit, true);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _onSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const input = this.querySelector('[data-helpct-input]');
    const query = input ? input.value : '';
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('search-submit', { detail: { query }, bubbles: true }));
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const articleBtn = event.target.closest('[data-helpct-article]');
    if (articleBtn) {
      const topics = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('topics'), DEFAULT_TOPICS());
      const topic = topics.find((t) => t.id === this._openId) || null;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('article-click', { detail: { topic, article: articleBtn.getAttribute('data-helpct-article') }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const topicBtn = event.target.closest('[data-helpct-topic-btn]');
    if (topicBtn) {
      const id = topicBtn.getAttribute('data-helpct-topic-btn');
      const topics = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('topics'), DEFAULT_TOPICS());
      const topic = topics.find((t) => t.id === id) || null;
      if (topic && Array.isArray(topic.articles) && topic.articles.length > 0) {
        this._openId = this._openId === id ? null : id;
        this._render();
      }
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('topic-click', { detail: { topic }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Welcome to the Help Center';
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('search-placeholder') || 'Cancellation, meeting point, etc.';
    const topics = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('topics'), DEFAULT_TOPICS());

    const topicRows = topics
      .map((t) => {
        const expandable = Array.isArray(t.articles) && t.articles.length > 0;
        const open = this._openId === t.id;
        const chevron = expandable && open ? '▾' : '›';
        const articles =
          expandable && open
            ? `<div data-helpct-articles="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" class="pb-4">${t.articles
                .map(
                  (a) => `<button type="button" data-helpct-article="${escapeAttribute(a)}" class="block py-1.5 text-left text-sm text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:underline dark:text-indigo-300">${escapeAttribute(a)}</button>`
                )
                .join('')}</div>`
            : '';
        return `<div data-helpct-topic="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" class="border-b border-zinc-200 last:border-0 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <button type="button" data-helpct-topic-btn="${escapeAttribute(t.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center justify-between py-4 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:text-indigo-300">
              <span>${escapeAttribute(t.label)}</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-xs text-zinc-400">${chevron}</span>
            </button>
            ${articles}
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    // Re-render strategy: the shell (title/form/topics container) is rendered
    // once; topic expansion only swaps the topics container's innerHTML so the
    // search input keeps its value and focus across re-renders.
    if (this.querySelector('[data-helpct-form]')) {
      this.querySelector('[data-helpct-topics]').innerHTML = topicRows;
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-helpct class="w-full rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-5 py-8 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 sm:px-8">
        <div class="mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center">
          <h2 data-helpct-title class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
          <p data-helpct-label class="mt-6 text-left text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">Search for a topic</p>
          <form data-helpct-form class="mt-2 flex overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 focus-within:border-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700">
            <input type="search" data-helpct-input placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}" class="min-w-0 flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-zinc-700 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200" />
            <button type="submit" data-helpct-submit aria-label="Search" class="bg-indigo-600 px-5 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-indigo-400">🔍</button>
          </form>
          <p data-helpct-browse class="mt-8 text-left text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">Or browse by topic</p>
          <div data-helpct-topics class="mt-2 text-left">${topicRows}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('help-center-home')) {
  customElements.define('help-center-home', HelpCenterHomeElement);
}

export default HelpCenterHomeElement;

/**
 * HelpResourcesPanel - Help panel with resource cards: Reference/Tutorial
 * badges, title + description, optional reading time and footer links
 * (Graphite).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_RESOURCES = () => [
  { id: 'r1', badge: 'Reference', title: 'Get started', description: 'Learn how to use Graphite for fast, simple code review.' },
  { id: 'r2', badge: 'Reference', title: 'Cheatsheet', description: 'A bookmarkable reference for common commands & workflows.' },
  { id: 'r3', badge: 'Tutorial', title: 'CLI quick start', description: 'Learn to author pull requests and stacks with the Graphite CLI.', minutes: 10 },
];

class HelpResourcesPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['resources', 'links'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._resources = [];
    this._links = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._resources.length) {
      this._resources = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('resources'), DEFAULT_RESOURCES());
    }
    if (!this._links.length) {
      this._links = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('links'), ['Send feedback', 'Docs']);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'resources' && !this._resources.length) {
      this._resources = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('resources'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'links' && !this._links.length) {
      this._links = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('links'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get resources() {
    return this._resources;
  }
  set resources(value) {
    this._resources = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  get links() {
    return this._links;
  }
  set links(value) {
    this._links = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const resourceEl = event.target.closest('[data-help-resource]');
    if (resourceEl) {
      const resource = this._resources.find((r) => String(r.id) === resourceEl.getAttribute('data-help-resource'));
      if (resource) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('resource-click', { detail: { resource }, bubbles: true }));
      }
      return;
    }
    const linkEl = event.target.closest('[data-help-resources-link]');
    if (linkEl) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('link-click', { detail: { link: linkEl.textContent.trim() }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const badgeTone = (badge) =>
      String(badge).toLowerCase() === 'tutorial'
        ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300'
        : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300';
    const resourcesHtml = this._resources
      .map(
        (resource) => `
        <button type="button" data-help-resource="${escapeAttribute(resource.id)}" class="block w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/60 p-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          <span class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span data-help-resource-badge class="inline-block rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${badgeTone(resource.badge)}">${escapeAttribute(resource.badge)}</span>
            ${typeof resource.minutes === 'number' ? `<span data-help-resource-minutes class="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(resource.minutes)} minutes</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          <span data-help-resource-title class="mt-1.5 block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(resource.title)}</span>
          <span data-help-resource-desc class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(resource.description)}</span>
        </button>`
      )
      .join('');
    const linksHtml = this._links
      .map(
        (link) => `
        <button type="button" data-help-resources-link class="block w-full rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(link)}</button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-help-resources-panel class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-help-resources-header class="border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50">Help</div>
        <div class="p-4">
          <p data-help-resources-section class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Tutorials &amp; resources</p>
          <div class="mt-3 space-y-3">${resourcesHtml}</div>
          ${this._links.length ? `<div data-help-resources-links class="mt-4 space-y-1 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">${linksHtml}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('help-resources-panel')) {
  customElements.define('help-resources-panel', HelpResourcesPanelElement);
}

export default HelpResourcesPanelElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * HeroSection - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <hero-section title="Ship faster" eyebrow="New" primary-cta="Start" align="center"></hero-section>
 * Properties: highlights (string[])
 * Events: primary, secondary
 */
export class HeroSectionElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['eyebrow', 'title', 'description', 'primary-cta', 'secondary-cta', 'align'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._highlights = [];
  }

  get highlights() {
    return this._highlights;
  }

  set highlights(value) {
    this._highlights = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const eyebrow = this.getAttribute('eyebrow') || '';
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const primaryCta = this.getAttribute('primary-cta') || '';
    const secondaryCta = this.getAttribute('secondary-cta') || '';
    const centered = (this.getAttribute('align') || 'center') !== 'left';

    const eyebrowHtml = eyebrow
      ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 dark:border-indigo-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-300">
          ${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 12 })}${escapeAttribute(eyebrow)}</span>`
      : '';

    const descriptionHtml = description
      ? `<p class="mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 ${centered ? 'mx-auto' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>`
      : '';

    const buttons = [
      primaryCta
        ? `<button type="button" class="hero-primary rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-950">${escapeAttribute(primaryCta)}</button>`
        : '',
      secondaryCta
        ? `<button type="button" class="hero-secondary rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(secondaryCta)}</button>`
        : '',
    ].join('');
    const buttonsHtml = buttons
      ? `<div class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 ${centered ? 'justify-center' : ''}">${buttons}</div>`
      : '';

    const highlightsHtml = this._highlights.length
      ? `<ul class="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-2 ${centered ? 'justify-center' : ''}">
          ${this._highlights
            .map(
              (item) =>
                `<li class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('check', { size: 13, className: 'shrink-0 text-emerald-500' })}${escapeAttribute(item)}</li>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<section class="flex flex-col ${centered ? 'items-center text-center' : 'items-start text-left'}">
      ${eyebrowHtml}
      <h1 class="mt-4 max-w-2xl text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 sm:text-4xl dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h1>
      ${descriptionHtml}
      ${buttonsHtml}
      ${highlightsHtml}
    </section>`;

    const primary = this.querySelector('.hero-primary');
    if (primary) primary.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('primary')));
    const secondary = this.querySelector('.hero-secondary');
    if (secondary) secondary.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('secondary')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('hero-section')) {
  customElements.define('hero-section', HeroSectionElement);
}
export default HeroSectionElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\HomepageDashboard.js =====

/**
 * HomepageDashboard — Vanilla Web Component
 * A copy-paste, zero-backbox single-file dashboards with the iconic gethomepage/homepage
 * look: header (title + live clock + search) + responsive grouped service cards with
 * status dots/pills + version footer.
 *
 * This is an ORIGINAL implementation of the visual design language of
 * https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage (GPL-3.0). No GPL source is copied.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <homepage-dashboard title="Homepage" subtitle="My homelab" status-style="pill"></homepage-dashboard>
 *   <script>
 *     const dash = document.querySelector("homepage-dashboard");
 *     dash.groups = [
 *       { name: "Media", icon: "🎬", services: [
 *         { name: "Jellyfin", description: "Streaming", icon: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/walkxcode/dashboard-icons/png/jellyfin.png", href: "https://jellyfin.local", status: "up", pingText: "12ms" },
 *         ...
 *       ]}
 *     ];
 *   </script>
 */
class HomepageDashboardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return [
      "title",
      "subtitle",
      "version",
      "header-style",
      "status-style",
      "search-placeholder",
      "collapsible",
      "show-search",
      "show-clock",
    ];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._groups = [];
    this._collapsedGroups = new Set();
    this._clockTimer = null;
    this._search = "";
  }

  // ----- public API -----
  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }

  set groups(value) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._collapsedGroups.clear();
    this._render();
  }

  // ----- lifecycle -----
  connectedCallback() {
    this._manageClock();
    this.addEventListener("click", this._handleClick);
    this.addEventListener("input", this._handleInput);
    this._render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this._clearClock();
    this.removeEventListener("click", this._handleClick);
    this.removeEventListener("input", this._handleInput);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === "show-clock") this._manageClock();
    if (this.isConnected) this._render();
  }

  // ----- clock ✓ toggled dynamically, never leaks -----
  _clearClock() {
    if (this._clockTimer) clearInterval(this._clockTimer);
    this._clockTimer = null;
  }

  _manageClock() {
    this._clearClock();
    if (this._attrBool("show-clock", true) && this.isConnected) {
      this._clockTimer = setInterval(() => this._updateClock(), 1000);
    }
  }

  // convenience reads
  _attr(name, fallback) {
    const v = this.getAttribute(name);
    return v === null ? fallback : v;
  }

  _attrBool(name, fallback) {
    const v = this.getAttribute(name);
    if (v === null) return fallback;
    return v !== "false" && v !== "0";
  }

  _headerStyle() {
    return this._attr("header-style", "underlined");
  }

  _statusStyle() {
    const s = this._attr("status-style", "pill");
    return ["dot", "pill", "none"].includes(s) ? s : "pill";
  }

  _collapsible() {
    return this._attrBool("collapsible", true);
  }

  // ----- helpers -----
  _esc(str) {
    return String(str ?? "")
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
      .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
  }

  /**
   * Only allow safe URL protocols into <a href>. Blocks javascript:, data:, vbscript:,
   * file: and any other unsupported scheme while allowing http(s), mailto, protocol-
   * relative, root-relative and dot-relative URLs.
   */
  static isSafeHref(href) {
    if (typeof href !== "string") return false;
    const t = href.trim();
    if (t.length === 0) return false;
    // protocol-relative //host, absolute path /x, relative ./ or ../
    if (t.startsWith("//") || t.startsWith("/") || t.startsWith("./") || t.startsWith("../")) return true;
    // intentional helper name
    return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
  }

  _iconHTML(service) {
    const icon = service?.icon;
    const name = service?.name || "?";
    const letter = this._esc((name || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase());
    const wrap = `class="shrink-0 my-1.5 ml-1.5 w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-white/10 service-icon"`;
    if (!icon) {
      return `<div ${wrap}><span class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300">${letter}</span></div>`;
    }
    if (/^(https?:|data:|\.|\/)/i.test(icon)) {
      return `<div ${wrap}><img src="${this._esc(icon)}" alt="" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="w-8 h-8 object-contain" onerror="this.style.display='none'"/></div>`;
    }
    // emoji or short glyph
    return `<div ${wrap}><span class="text-xl leading-none">${this._esc(icon)}</span></div>`;
  }

  _statusHTML(service) {
    const style = this._statusStyle();
    const s = (service?.status || "unknown").toLowerCase();
    const map = {
      up: { dot: "bg-emerald-500", pill: "text-emerald-500/90", label: "UP" },
      online: { dot: "bg-emerald-500", pill: "text-emerald-500/90", label: "ONLINE" },
      down: { dot: "bg-rose-500", pill: "text-rose-500/90", label: "DOWN" },
      offline: { dot: "bg-rose-500", pill: "text-rose-500/90", label: "OFFLINE" },
      warn: { dot: "bg-amber-500", pill: "text-amber-500", label: "WARN" },
      error: { dot: "bg-orange-500", pill: "text-orange-500", label: "ERROR" },
      unknown: { dot: "bg-zinc-400/60 dark:bg-zinc-500/60", pill: "text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400", label: "—" },
    };
    const cfg = map[s] || map.unknown;

    if (style === "none") return "";

    if (style === "dot") {
      return `<span title="${this._esc(service.pingText || cfg.label)}" role="img" aria-label="${this._esc(service.pingText || cfg.label)}" class="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 h-3 w-3 rounded-full ${cfg.dot} service-status-dot"></span>`;
    }

    const text = this._esc(service.pingText || cfg.label);
    return `<span class="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-1.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-500/10 dark:bg-zinc-400/10 ${cfg.pill} service-status-pill" role="img" aria-label="${text}">${text}</span>`;
  }

  _serviceHTML(service) {
    const query = this._search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matched =
      !query ||
      (service.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      (service.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(query);
    const outer = [
      "service-card",
      "relative overflow-clip rounded-md shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 dark:shadow-zinc-900/20",
      "bg-white hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-white/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-all mb-2 p-0.5",
      matched ? "" : "hidden",
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ");

    const safeHref = HomepageDashboardElement.isSafeHref(service.href) ? service.href : "";
    const linkAttrs = safeHref ? `href="${this._esc(safeHref)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"` : "";

    return `
      <li class="${outer}" data-name="${this._esc(service.name || "")}">
        <div class="flex select-none items-center service-title">
          <a ${linkAttrs} class="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">${this._iconHTML(service)}</a>
          <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 px-2 py-2.5 text-sm text-left z-10">
            <div class="truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 service-name">${this._esc(service.name || "")}</div>
            ${service.description ? `<div class="truncate mt-0.5 text-xs font-light text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 service-description">${this._esc(service.description)}</div>` : ""}
          </div>
        </div>
        ${this._statusHTML(service)}
      </li>
    `;
  }

  _groupHTML(group, groupIndex) {
    const isCollapsed = this._collapsedGroups.has(group.name);
    const services = (group.services || []).map((s) => this._serviceHTML(s)).join("");
    const chevron = `
      <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
        class="w-5 h-5 transition-transform duration-200 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 ml-auto ${isCollapsed ? "rotate-180" : ""}">
        <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/>
      </svg>`;
    const groupName = this._esc(group.name || `Group ${groupIndex + 1}`);
    const groupIcon = group.icon
      ? `<span class="mr-2 inline-flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-zinc-200/70 dark:bg-white/10 text-sm leading-none">${this._esc(group.icon)}</span>`
      : "";

    return `
      <div class="services-group w-full md:w-1/2 lg:w-1/3 xl:w-1/4 p-1 pb-0" data-group="${this._esc(group.name)}">
        <button type="button" class="group-header flex w-full select-none items-center gap-1 py-0.5 ${!this._collapsible() ? "cursor-default" : ""}" data-toggle-group="${this._esc(group.name)}" aria-expanded="${isCollapsed ? "false" : "true"}">
          ${groupIcon}
          <h2 class="text-xl font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 service-group-name">${groupName}</h2>
          ${this._collapsible() ? chevron : ""}
        </button>
        ${isCollapsed ? "" : `<ul class="mt-2">${services}</ul>`}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  _clockHTML() {
    if (!this._attrBool("show-clock", true)) return "";
    return `
      <div class="text-right shrink-0 block min-w-28" data-el="clock">
        <div class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 leading-tight" data-el="clock-time"></div>
        <div class="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" data-el="clock-date"></div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  _headerHTML() {
    const title = this._esc(this._attr("title", "Homepage"));
    const subtitle = this._esc(this._attr("subtitle", "A highly customizable homelab dashboard"));
    const style = this._headerStyle();
    const headerCls =
      style === "boxed"
        ? "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-0 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-white/5 shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 p-4"
        : style === "clean"
          ? "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-0"
          : "m-3 sm:m-5 mb-1 border-b-2 border-zinc-300/70 dark:border-zinc-700 pb-4";

    const search = this._attrBool("show-search", false)
      ? `
        <div class="relative w-full sm:w-64">
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400">
            <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M9 3.5a5.5 5.5 0 1 0 0 11 5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-11ZM2 9a7 7 0 1 1 12.452 4.391l2.328 2.328a.75.75 0 1 1-1.06 1.06l-2.328-2.328A7 7 0 0 1 2 9Z" clip-rule="evenodd"/>
          </svg>
          <input type="search" data-el="search" value="${this._esc(this._search)}" placeholder="${this._esc(this._attr("search-placeholder", "Search services…"))}" aria-label="Search services"
            class="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-white/5 px-9 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-400 dark:focus:ring-zinc-500"/>
        </div>`
      : "";

    return `
      <header class="${headerCls} homepage-header">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-4">
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <h1 class="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50 homepage-title">${title}</h1>
            ${subtitle ? `<p class="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 homepage-subtitle">${subtitle}</p>` : ""}
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
            ${search}
            ${this._clockHTML()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
    `;
  }

  _footerHTML() {
    const version = this._esc(this._attr("version", "Homepage · awesome-ui"));
    return `
      <footer class="px-5 py-6 text-right">
        <a href="https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">
          <span>${version}</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </a>
      </footer>
    `;
  }

  _render() {
    if (!this.isConnected) return;
    const emptyNote =
      this._search.trim()
        ? `<p class="p-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">No matching services for “${this._esc(this._search.trim())}”.</p>`
        : `<p class="p-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">No groups configured — assign <code>dash.groups = […]</code>.</p>`;
    const hasGroups = this._groups.length > 0;
    const mainContent =
      !hasGroups
        ? emptyNote
        : this._groups.map((g, i) => this._groupHTML(g, i)).join("");
    // persistent no-match note (shown only while a live search matches nothing)
    const noMatchNote = hasGroups
      ? `<p data-el='empty-search-note' class="px-3.5 pt-1 pb-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 hidden">No matching services for \u201c${this._esc(this._search.trim())}\u201d.</p>`
      : "";

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="homepage-dashboard relative w-full rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 overflow-hidden"
        style="font-family: 'Manrope', 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;">
        ${this._headerHTML()}
        <main class="flex flex-wrap items-start px-3 sm:px-5 pb-4">
          ${mainContent}
          ${noMatchNote}
        </main>
        ${this._footerHTML()}
      </div>
    `;

    this._updateClock();
    this._applySearchFiltering();
  }

  _updateClock() {
    const timeEl = this.querySelector("[data-el='clock-time']");
    if (!timeEl || !this._attrBool("show-clock", true)) return;
    const now = new Date();
    timeEl.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
    const dateEl = this.querySelector("[data-el='clock-date']");
    if (dateEl) dateEl.textContent = now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
  }

  // Hide non-matching cards AND sync group visibility so a no-match search leaves
  // no empty group headers behind (parity with React/Vue filtering). ClassList-only;
  // never rebuilds the DOM on keystroke.
  _applySearchFiltering() {
    const q = this._search.trim().toLowerCase();
    this.querySelectorAll(".service-card").forEach((card) => {
      const name = (card.dataset.name || "").toLowerCase();
      const desc = (card.querySelector(".service-description")?.textContent || "").toLowerCase();
      const matched = q.length === 0 || name.includes(q) || desc.includes(q);
      card.classList.toggle("hidden", !matched);
    });
    this.querySelectorAll(".services-group").forEach((group) => {
      const cards = [...group.querySelectorAll(".service-card")];
      const anyVisible = cards.some((c) => !c.classList.contains("hidden"));
      group.hidden = q.length > 0 && !anyVisible;
    });
    const note = this.querySelector("[data-el='empty-search-note']");
    if (note) {
      const cards = [...this.querySelectorAll(".service-card")];
      const everythingHidden = cards.length > 0 && cards.every((c) => c.classList.contains("hidden"));
      const show = q.length > 0 && everythingHidden;
      note.classList.toggle("hidden", !show);
      if (show) note.textContent = `No matching services for \u201c${this._search.trim()}\u201d.`;
    }
  }

  // ----- interactions (event delegation on root) -----
  _handleClick = (event) => {
    const groupBtn = event.target.closest("[data-toggle-group]");
    if (!groupBtn) return;
    const name = groupBtn.dataset.toggleGroup;
    if (!name || !this._collapsible()) return;
    const was = this._collapsedGroups.has(name);
    if (was) this._collapsedGroups.delete(name);
    else this._collapsedGroups.add(name);
    this._render();
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("group-toggle", { detail: { group: name, collapsed: !was } })
    );
  };

  _handleInput = (event) => {
    if (event.target.dataset?.el !== "search") return;
    this._search = event.target.value;
    this._applySearchFiltering();
  };
}

if (typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("homepage-dashboard")) {
  customElements.define("homepage-dashboard", HomepageDashboardElement);
}
export default HomepageDashboardElement;

===== FILE: vanilla\ImageActionMenu.js =====

/**
 * ImageActionMenu - Krea generated-image context menu: Fullscreen / Vary /
 * Edit / Upscale & enhance / Make video / Download actions anchored to an
 * image card, with optional danger styling and per-action icons.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class ImageActionMenuElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['actions', 'open'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._actions = [];
    this._open = true;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._actions.length) {
      this._actions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('actions'), []);
    }
    const openAttr = this.getAttribute('open');
    if (openAttr !== null) {
      this._open = openAttr === 'true';
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'actions' && !this._actions.length) {
      this._actions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('actions'), []);
    }
    if (name === 'open') {
      this._open = newValue === 'true';
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get open() {
    return this._open;
  }
  set open(value) {
    this._open = Boolean(value);
    this.setAttribute('open', this._open ? 'true' : 'false');
    this._render();
  }

  get actions() {
    return this._actions;
  }
  set actions(value) {
    this._actions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (!this._open) return;
    const actionEl = event.target.closest('[data-image-action]');
    if (!actionEl) return;
    const action = this._actions.find((a) => String(a.id) === actionEl.getAttribute('data-image-action'));
    if (action) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { action }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    if (!this._open) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const iconFor = (a) =>
      a.icon ?? { Fullscreen: '⛶', Vary: '↻', Edit: '✎', 'Make video': '▶', Download: '↓' }[a.label] ?? '•';
    const items = this._actions.length
      ? this._actions
          .map((a, i) => {
            const divider = i > 0 && a.id === 'download' ? '<div class="my-1 h-px bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></div>' : '';
            const tone = a.danger
              ? 'text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40'
              : 'text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
            return `${divider}
            <button type="button" data-image-action="${escapeAttribute(a.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs transition-colors ${tone}">
              <span aria-hidden="true" class="w-4 shrink-0 text-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(iconFor(a))}</span>
              <span data-image-action-label>${escapeAttribute(a.label)}</span>
            </button>`;
          })
          .join('')
      : '<p data-image-action-empty class="px-3 py-3 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No actions available.</p>';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-image-action-menu class="w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">${items}</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('image-action-menu')) {
  customElements.define('image-action-menu', ImageActionMenuElement);
}

export default ImageActionMenuElement;

/**
 * ImageGenGallery - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <image-gen-gallery title="Image studio" placeholder="Describe an image…"></image-gen-gallery>
 * Attributes: title, placeholder, generate-text, prompt (initial input value)
 * Property: images ([{id, alt, url?, aspect?, status?, model?}])
 * Events: generate (detail {prompt}), tile-action (detail {id, action})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ImageGenGalleryElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'placeholder', 'generate-text', 'prompt'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._images = [];
    this._prompt = '';
    this._bound = false;
    this._gradients = [
      'from-indigo-400 via-purple-400 to-pink-300',
      'from-sky-400 via-cyan-300 to-emerald-300',
      'from-amber-300 via-orange-400 to-rose-400',
      'from-violet-400 via-fuchsia-400 to-indigo-300',
    ];
    this._aspect = { square: 'aspect-square', portrait: 'aspect-[3/4]', landscape: 'aspect-[4/3]' };
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-gen-generate]')) {
          const input = this.querySelector('[data-gen-input]');
          const prompt = (input ? input.value : '').trim();
          if (prompt) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('generate', { detail: { prompt } }));
          return;
        }
        const actionBtn = event.target.closest('[data-gen-action]');
        if (actionBtn) {
          const tile = actionBtn.closest('[data-gen-tile]');
          if (tile) {
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tile-action', { detail: { id: tile.getAttribute('data-gen-tile'), action: actionBtn.getAttribute('data-gen-action') } }));
          }
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' && event.target.matches('[data-gen-input]')) {
          const prompt = event.target.value.trim();
          if (prompt) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('generate', { detail: { prompt } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get images() { return this._images; }
  set images(v) {
    this._images = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get prompt() { return this._prompt; }
  set prompt(v) {
    this._prompt = String(v || '');
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children (e.g. the prompt input).
    if (this._bound === false && this._images.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'prompt') this._prompt = this.getAttribute(name) || '';
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Image studio');
    const placeholder = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Describe an image…');
    const generateText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('generate-text') || 'Generate');

    const tiles = this._images.map((img, i) => {
      const generating = img.status === 'generating';
      const gradient = this._gradients[i % this._gradients.length];
      const aspect = this._aspect[img.aspect] || this._aspect.square;
      const inner = img.url
        ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(img.url)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(img.alt)}" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />`
        : generating
          ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-white/70 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-700">Generating…</span>`
          : `<span class="max-w-full truncate px-2 text-[10px] font-semibold text-white/90">${escapeAttribute(img.alt)}</span>`;
      const actions = generating ? '' : `
        <div class="absolute inset-x-1.5 bottom-1.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-black/55 px-1.5 py-1 opacity-0 backdrop-blur transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100">
          <button type="button" data-gen-action="download" aria-label="Download" class="rounded p-1 text-white/90 hover:bg-white/20"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3.5a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v6.19l2.22-2.22a.75.75 0 1 1 1.06 1.06l-3.5 3.5a.75.75 0 0 1-1.06 0l-3.5-3.5a.75.75 0 1 1 1.06-1.06l2.22 2.22V4.25A.75.75 0 0 1 10 3.5Zm-5.5 9.25a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v1c0 .14.11.25.25.25h9a.25.25 0 0 0 .25-.25v-1a.75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0v1A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 14.5 16h-9A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 3.75 14.25v-1a.75.75 0 0 1 .75-.75Z"/></svg></button>
          <button type="button" data-gen-action="variant" aria-label="Make variant" class="rounded p-1 text-white/90 hover:bg-white/20"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3.75a.75.75 0 0 1 .53.22l2 2a.75.75 0 1 1-1.06 1.06l-.72-.72v4.94a.75.75 0 0 1-1.5 0V6.31l-.72.72a.75.75 0 0 1-1.06-1.06l2-2a.75.75 0 0 1 .53-.22ZM4.25 11.5a.75.75 0 0 1 .75.75v1.5c0 .14.11.25.25.25h9.5a.25.25 0 0 0 .25-.25v-1.5a.75.75 0 0 1 1.5 0v1.5A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 14.75 15h-9.5A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 3.5 13.25v-1.5a.75.75 0 0 1 .75-.75Z"/></svg></button>
          <button type="button" data-gen-action="delete" aria-label="Delete" class="rounded p-1 text-white/90 hover:bg-white/20"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3.25h4a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h1.75a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5H6.25a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5H8Zm-2.75 4.5h9.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h-.5l-.4 5.6A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 12.1 16.3H7.9a1.75 1.75 0 0 1-1.75-1.62l-.4-5.68h-.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5Z"/></svg></button>
        </div>`;
      const badge = img.model && !generating
        ? `<figcaption class="absolute left-1.5 top-1.5 rounded bg-black/55 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white/90 backdrop-blur">${escapeAttribute(img.model)}</figcaption>`
        : '';
      return `
        <figure data-gen-tile="${escapeAttribute(img.id)}" class="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div data-gen-status="${generating ? 'generating' : 'done'}" class="flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br ${gradient} ${aspect} ${generating ? 'animate-pulse' : ''}">${inner}</div>
          ${actions}${badge}
        </figure>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-image-gen class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
  <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-1.5 focus-within:border-indigo-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">
    <input data-gen-input value="${escapeAttribute(this._prompt)}" placeholder="${placeholder}" class="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100" />
    <button type="button" data-gen-generate class="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500">${generateText}</button>
  </div>
  ${this._images.length === 0
    ? `<div data-gen-empty class="mt-3 flex aspect-[4/3] items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">No images yet — describe one above</div>`
    : `<div class="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">${tiles}</div>`}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('image-gen-gallery')) {
  customElements.define('image-gen-gallery', ImageGenGalleryElement);

/**
 * InboxList - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <inbox-list></inbox-list> with `messages` property
 * Attributes: empty-text
 * Properties: messages ({ id, sender, count?, subject, snippet?, dateLabel, unread?, tag?, tagTone? }[])
 * Events: select (detail: { message })
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TAG_TONE = {
  rose: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300',
};

export class InboxListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._messages = [];
  }

  get messages() {
    return this._messages;
  }

  set messages(value) {
    this._messages = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'Inbox zero — enjoy your day';

    if (this._messages.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</div>`;
      return;
    }

    const rows = this._messages
      .map((message, index) => {
        const active = String(message.id) === String(this.getAttribute('active-id') ?? '');
        return `<div role="button" tabindex="0" data-inbox-index="${index}" ${active ? 'aria-current="true"' : ''}
          class="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors ${
            active ? 'bg-indigo-50/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/40' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60'
          }">
          <span class="flex w-2 shrink-0 pt-1.5">${
            message.unread ? '<span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" aria-label="Unread"></span>' : ''
          }</span>
          <span class="w-36 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(message.sender)}${
            message.count ? `<span class="ml-1 font-normal text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(message.count)}</span>` : ''
          }</span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
            ${
              message.tag
                ? `<span class="mr-1.5 inline-block rounded px-1.5 py-px align-middle font-mono text-[9.5px] font-medium ${TAG_TONE[message.tagTone] || TAG_TONE.rose}">${escapeAttribute(message.tag)}</span>`
                : ''
            }<span class="${message.unread ? 'font-medium' : 'font-normal'} text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(message.subject)}</span>${
              message.snippet ? `<span class="text-zinc-400"> — ${escapeAttribute(message.snippet)}</span>` : ''
            }</span>
          <span class="shrink-0 pt-px font-mono text-[10px] uppercase text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(message.dateLabel)}</span>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${rows}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-inbox-index]').forEach((row) => {
      row.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const message = this._messages[Number(row.getAttribute('data-inbox-index'))];
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { message } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('inbox-list')) {
  customElements.define('inbox-list', InboxListElement);

/**
 * IntegrationConnectGrid - Settings integrations: category filter tabs and
 * a responsive grid of service cards with logo placeholder, connected
 * badge and Connect / Disconnect action (integration settings pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_INTEGRATIONS = () => [
  { id: 'gh', name: 'GitHub', category: 'Code', connected: true },
  { id: 'sl', name: 'Slack', category: 'Chat', connected: true },
  { id: 'li', name: 'Linear', category: 'Code', connected: false },
  { id: 'no', name: 'Notion', category: 'Docs', connected: false },
  { id: 'fg', name: 'Figma', category: 'Design', connected: false },
  { id: 'sn', name: 'Sentry', category: 'Monitoring', connected: true },
];

const CATEGORY_ALL = 'All';

class IntegrationConnectGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description', 'integrations', 'connect-label', 'disconnect-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._title = 'Integrations';
    this._description = 'Connect third-party services to extend your workspace.';
    this._integrations = DEFAULT_INTEGRATIONS();
    this._connectLabel = 'Connect';
    this._disconnectLabel = 'Disconnect';
    this._category = CATEGORY_ALL;
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const t = this.getAttribute('title');
    if (t) this._title = t;
    const d = this.getAttribute('description');
    if (d) this._description = d;
    const c = this.getAttribute('connect-label');
    if (c) this._connectLabel = c;
    const dc = this.getAttribute('disconnect-label');
    if (dc) this._disconnectLabel = dc;
    this._integrations = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('integrations'), DEFAULT_INTEGRATIONS());
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'Integrations';
    if (name === 'description') this._description = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'connect-label') this._connectLabel = newValue || 'Connect';
    if (name === 'disconnect-label') this._disconnectLabel = newValue || 'Disconnect';
    if (name === 'integrations') this._integrations = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_INTEGRATIONS());
    this._render();
  }

  get integrations() { return this._integrations; }
  set integrations(value) { this._integrations = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const tab = event.target.closest('[data-integration-tab]');
    if (tab) {
      this._category = tab.getAttribute('data-integration-tab') || CATEGORY_ALL;
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    const action = event.target.closest('[data-integration-action]');
    if (action) {
      const integration = this._integrations.find((it) => it.id === action.getAttribute('data-integration-action'));
      if (!integration) return;
      integration.connected = !integration.connected;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('integration-toggle', {
        detail: { integration, connected: integration.connected },
        bubbles: true,
      }));
      this._render();
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const all = Array.isArray(this._integrations) ? this._integrations : [];
    const categories = [CATEGORY_ALL, ...new Set(all.map((it) => it.category).filter(Boolean))];
    const visible = this._category === CATEGORY_ALL ? all : all.filter((it) => it.category === this._category);

    const tabsHtml = categories
      .map((cat) => {
        const activeCls = cat === this._category
          ? 'border-violet-500 bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:border-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-950/40 dark:text-violet-300'
          : 'border-zinc-200 text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200';
        return `<button type="button" data-integration-tab="${escapeAttribute(cat)}" class="rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${activeCls}">${escapeAttribute(cat)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const cardsHtml = visible
      .map((it) => {
        const badge = it.connected
          ? '<span data-integration-state="connected" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400"><span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" aria-hidden="true"></span>Connected</span>'
          : '<span data-integration-state="not-connected" class="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">Not connected</span>';
        const actionCls = it.connected
          ? 'border-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'
          : 'border-violet-300 bg-violet-600 text-white hover:bg-violet-500 dark:border-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-600 dark:hover:bg-violet-500';
        const actionLabel = it.connected ? this._disconnectLabel : this._connectLabel;
        const initial = escapeAttribute((it.name || '?').slice(0, 1).toUpperCase());
        return `<div data-integration-card="${escapeAttribute(it.id)}" class="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 transition-shadow hover:shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span data-integration-logo="${escapeAttribute(it.name)}" aria-hidden="true" class="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${initial}</span>
            <div class="min-w-0">
              <p data-integration-name="${escapeAttribute(it.name)}" class="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(it.name)}</p>
              <p data-integration-category="${escapeAttribute(it.category || '')}" class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(it.category || '')}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            ${badge}
            <button type="button" data-integration-action="${escapeAttribute(it.id)}" class="rounded-md border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${actionCls}">${escapeAttribute(actionLabel)}</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-integration-grid class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-integration-header class="mb-4">
          <p data-integration-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <p data-integration-description class="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._description)}</p>
          <div data-integration-tabs class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">${tabsHtml}</div>
        </div>
        <div data-integration-cards class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">${cardsHtml}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('integration-connect-grid')) {
  customElements.define('integration-connect-grid', IntegrationConnectGridElement);
}

export default IntegrationConnectGridElement;

    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

  { id: 'INV-2026-010', period: 'October 2026', amount: '148.00', status: 'paid', date: 'Oct 1, 2026' },

const STATUS_STYLES = {
  paid: { label: 'Paid', cls: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  pending: { label: 'Pending', cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-400' },
  failed: { label: 'Failed', cls: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400' },
};

const amountNumber = (invoice) => {
  const n = Number.parseFloat(String(invoice.amount ?? '0').replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, ''));
  return Number.isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
};

class InvoiceHistoryTableElement extends HTMLElement {

    return ['title', 'currency', 'download-label', 'invoices'];

    const c = this.getAttribute('currency');
    if (c) this._currency = c;
    const d = this.getAttribute('download-label');
    if (d) this._downloadLabel = d;

    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'Invoice history';
    if (name === 'currency') this._currency = newValue || 'USD';
    if (name === 'download-label') this._downloadLabel = newValue || 'Download';
    if (name === 'invoices') this._invoices = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_INVOICES());
    this._render();
  }

  get invoices() { return this._invoices; }
  set invoices(value) { this._invoices = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const btn = event.target.closest('[data-invoice-download]');
    if (!btn) return;
    const invoice = this._invoices.find((inv) => inv.id === btn.getAttribute('data-invoice-download'));
    if (invoice) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('invoice-download', { detail: { invoice }, bubbles: true }));
  }

  _render() {
    const list = Array.isArray(this._invoices) ? this._invoices : [];
    const rowsHtml = list
      .map((inv) => {
        const style = STATUS_STYLES[inv.status] ?? STATUS_STYLES.pending;
        return `<tr data-invoice-row="${escapeAttribute(inv.id)}" class="border-b border-zinc-50 transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <td data-invoice-period="${escapeAttribute(inv.period)}" class="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(inv.period)}</td>
          <td data-invoice-id="${escapeAttribute(inv.id)}" class="px-2 py-3 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(inv.id)}</td>

            <button type="button" data-invoice-download="${escapeAttribute(inv.id)}" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(this._downloadLabel)}</button>
          </td>
        </tr>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const paidTotal = list
      .filter((inv) => inv.status === 'paid')
      .reduce((sum, inv) => sum + amountNumber(inv), 0)
      .toFixed(2);

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-invoice-table class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-invoice-header class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-invoice-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <span data-invoice-currency class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._currency)}</span>
        </div>
        <table data-invoice-table-body class="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">

              <th class="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Invoice</th>
              <th class="px-2 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Amount</th>
              <th class="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Status</th>
              <th class="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Date</th>
              <th class="px-5 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold"><span class="sr-only">Actions</span></th>

          <span data-invoice-total-value class="font-mono font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._currency)} ${paidTotal}</span>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}
