===== FILE: vanilla\IterationActionBar.js =====

/**
 * IterationActionBar - Generation iteration action bar: Show More / Brainstorm
 * / Reply pills, an overflow slot and prev/next page arrows (Luma).
 */
const ACTIONS = [
  { id: 'show-more', label: '↻ Show More' },
  { id: 'brainstorm', label: '✦ Brainstorm' },
  { id: 'reply', label: '❝ Reply' },
  { id: 'more', label: '···', ariaLabel: 'More actions', iconOnly: true },
];

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

class IterationActionBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['page', 'total-pages'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._page = 1;
    this._totalPages = 4;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._page = Number(this.getAttribute('page')) || 1;
    this._totalPages = Number(this.getAttribute('total-pages')) || 4;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'page') this._page = Number(newValue) || 1;
    if (name === 'total-pages') this._totalPages = Number(newValue) || 4;
    this._render();
  }

  get page() {
    return this._page;
  }
  set page(value) {
    this._page = Number(value) || 1;
    this._render();
  }

  get totalPages() {
    return this._totalPages;
  }
  set totalPages(value) {
    this._totalPages = Number(value) || 4;
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const actionEl = event.target.closest('[data-iteration-action]');
    if (actionEl) {
      const action = actionEl.getAttribute('data-iteration-action');
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { action }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const prevEl = event.target.closest('[data-iteration-prev]');
    if (prevEl) {
      if (this._page > 1) {
        this._page -= 1;
        this._render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('page-change', { detail: { page: this._page }, bubbles: true }));
      }
      return;
    }
    const nextEl = event.target.closest('[data-iteration-next]');
    if (nextEl) {
      if (this._page < this._totalPages) {
        this._page += 1;
        this._render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('page-change', { detail: { page: this._page }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const pill = 'rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500';
    const pillOutlined = `${pill} border border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800`;
    const pillIcon = `${pill} border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800`;
    const arrow = `${pill} border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800`;

    const actionsHtml = ACTIONS.map((action) => {
      const cls = action.iconOnly ? pillIcon : pillOutlined;
      const aria = action.ariaLabel ? ` aria-label="${escapeAttribute(action.ariaLabel)}"` : '';
      return `<button type="button" data-iteration-action="${action.id}"${aria} class="${cls}">${escapeAttribute(action.label)}</button>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-iteration-action-bar class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        ${actionsHtml}
        <span data-iteration-pager class="ml-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <button type="button" data-iteration-prev aria-label="Previous page" class="${arrow}"${this._page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : ''}>‹</button>
          <button type="button" data-iteration-next aria-label="Next page" class="${arrow}"${this._page >= this._totalPages ? ' disabled' : ''}>›</button>
          <span data-iteration-page-label class="ml-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${this._page}/${this._totalPages}</span>
        </span>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('iteration-action-bar')) {
  customElements.define('iteration-action-bar', IterationActionBarElement);
}

export default IterationActionBarElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\JumpBackIn.js =====

/**
 * JumpBackIn - "Jump back in" resume card row: thumbnail image (or gradient
 * placeholder), kind badge, title and subtitle per card (Mindtrip).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const KIND_TONES = {
  trip: 'bg-sky-600/90 text-sky-50',
  chat: 'bg-zinc-900/85 text-zinc-50',
};

class JumpBackInElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['cards'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._cards = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._cards.length) {
      this._cards = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('cards'), [
        { id: 'c1', kind: 'Trip', title: 'Trip to Japan, September 2026', subtitle: 'Tokyo · Starting 14 Sept' },
        { id: 'c2', kind: 'Chat', title: 'Mount Fuji Trip Planning', subtitle: 'Last touched 2 days ago' },
        { id: 'c3', kind: 'Trip', title: 'Kyoto Autumn Walk', subtitle: 'Kyoto · Draft itinerary' },
      ]);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'cards' && !this._cards.length) {
      this._cards = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('cards'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get cards() {
    return this._cards;
  }
  set cards(value) {
    this._cards = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const cardEl = event.target.closest('[data-jump-back-in-card]');
    if (cardEl) {
      const card = this._cards.find((c) => String(c.id) === cardEl.getAttribute('data-jump-back-in-card'));
      if (card) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('card-click', { detail: { card }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const cardsHtml = this._cards
      .map(
        (card) => `
        <button type="button" data-jump-back-in-card="${escapeAttribute(card.id)}" class="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl text-left shadow-sm transition-transform hover:scale-[1.02] focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
          ${
            card.image
              ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(card.image)}" alt="" data-jump-back-in-image class="h-32 w-full object-cover" />`
              : '<div data-jump-back-in-placeholder class="h-32 w-full bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-400 via-indigo-400 to-slate-600"></div>'
          }
          <div class="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent p-3 pt-8">
            <span data-jump-back-in-kind class="inline-block rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${KIND_TONES[String(card.kind).toLowerCase()] || 'bg-zinc-900/85 text-zinc-50'}">${escapeAttribute(card.kind)}</span>
            <span data-jump-back-in-card-title class="mt-1 block truncate text-xs font-semibold text-white">${escapeAttribute(card.title)}</span>
            <span data-jump-back-in-card-subtitle class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(card.subtitle)}</span>
          </div>
        </button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-jump-back-in class="w-full">
        <div class="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 data-jump-back-in-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Jump back in</h3>
          <button type="button" data-jump-back-in-see-all class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">See all</button>
        </div>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">${cardsHtml}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('jump-back-in')) {
  customElements.define('jump-back-in', JumpBackInElement);
}

export default JumpBackInElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\KanbanBoard.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const PRIORITY_META = {
  low: { label: 'Low', cls: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400' },
  medium: { label: 'Medium', cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400' },
  high: { label: 'High', cls: 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400' },
};

const initials = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

/**
 * KanbanBoard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <kanban-board></kanban-board>
 * Properties: columns (KanbanColumn[]), cards (KanbanCard[])
 * Events: move-card (detail: {cardId, from, to}), card-click (detail: card), add-card (detail: columnId)
 */
export class KanbanBoardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['empty-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._columns = [];
    this._cards = [];
    this._draggingId = null;
    this._overColumn = null;
  }

  get columns() {
    return this._columns;
  }

  set columns(value) {
    this._columns = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get cards() {
    return this._cards;
  }

  set cards(value) {
    this._cards = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _move(cardId, toColumnId) {
    const card = this._cards.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(cardId));
    if (!card || card.columnId === toColumnId) return;
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('move-card', { detail: { cardId: card.id, from: card.columnId, to: toColumnId } })
    );
  }

  _renderCard(card) {
    const priority = card.priority ? PRIORITY_META[card.priority] : null;
    const tags = (card.tags || [])
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map(
        (tag) =>
          `<span class="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(tag)}</span>`
      )
      .join('');
    const assignee = card.assignee
      ? `<span title="${escapeAttribute(card.assignee)}" class="ml-auto flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[8px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(initials(card.assignee))}</span>`
      : '';

    return `<div role="button" tabindex="0" draggable="true" data-card="${escapeAttribute(card.id)}"
      class="kanban-card cursor-grab rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-2.5 text-left shadow-sm transition-all hover:border-zinc-300 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 active:cursor-grabbing dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 ${
        String(this._draggingId) === String(card.id) ? 'opacity-40' : ''
      }">
      <div class="flex items-start gap-1.5">
        <p class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-[11px] font-medium leading-snug text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(card.title)}</p>
        ${priority ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium ${priority.cls}">${priority.label}</span>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${
        card.description
          ? `<p class="mt-1 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(card.description)}</p>`
          : ''
      }
      ${tags || assignee ? `<div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">${tags}${assignee}</div>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || 'Drop cards here';

    const columns = this._columns
      .map((column) => {
        const cards = this._cards.filter((card) => card.columnId === column.id);
        const count = column.limit ? `${cards.length}/${column.limit}` : String(cards.length);
        const isOver = String(this._overColumn) === String(column.id);
        return `<section data-column="${escapeAttribute(column.id)}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(column.title)}"
          class="kanban-column flex w-64 shrink-0 flex-col rounded-xl border p-2 transition-colors dark:bg-zinc-900/40 ${
            isOver
              ? 'border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/20'
              : 'border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800'
          }">
          <header class="mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1">
            <span class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${escapeAttribute(column.accent || 'bg-zinc-400')}" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <h3 class="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(column.title)}</h3>
            <span class="column-count ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-200/70 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${count}</span>
            <button type="button" class="column-add shrink-0 rounded-md p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
              data-column="${escapeAttribute(column.id)}" aria-label="Add card to ${escapeAttribute(column.title)}">${uiIcon('plus', { size: 12 })}</button>
          </header>
          <div class="flex min-h-[3rem] flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
            ${
              cards.length === 0
                ? `<p class="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-2 py-4 text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>`
                : cards.map((card) => this._renderCard(card)).join('')
            }
          </div>
        </section>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2">${columns}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.kanban-column').forEach((section) => {
      const columnId = section.getAttribute('data-column');
      section.addEventListener('dragover', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (this._overColumn !== columnId) {
          this._overColumn = columnId;
          this.render();
        }
      });
      section.addEventListener('dragleave', (event) => {
        if (event.target === section && this._overColumn === columnId) {
          this._overColumn = null;
          this.render();
        }
      });
      section.addEventListener('drop', (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const cardId = (event.dataTransfer && event.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain')) || this._draggingId;
        this._overColumn = null;
        this._draggingId = null;
        if (cardId) this._move(cardId, columnId);
        else this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.kanban-card').forEach((node) => {
      const cardId = node.getAttribute('data-card');
      const card = this._cards.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(cardId));
      if (!card) return;

      node.addEventListener('dragstart', (event) => {
        if (event.dataTransfer) {
          event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', String(card.id));
          event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        }
        this._draggingId = card.id;
      });
      node.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
        this._draggingId = null;
        this._overColumn = null;
        this.render();
      });
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('card-click', { detail: card })));
      node.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('card-click', { detail: card }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
        const index = this._columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === card.columnId);
        const next = this._columns[index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1)];
        if (!next) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        this._move(card.id, next.id);
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.column-add').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-card', { detail: button.getAttribute('data-column') }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('kanban-board')) {
  customElements.define('kanban-board', KanbanBoardElement);
}
export default KanbanBoardElement;

    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

// themeColor 只进 style 属性，必须是纯 CSS 颜色值——拦掉引号/分号/尖括号注入
const safeCssColor = (value, fallback = '#c2410c') => {
  const v = String(value ?? '').trim();
  return /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$|^[a-zA-Z]+$|^(rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla)\([0-9,\s.%/]+\)$/.test(v) ? v : fallback;
};

export class KnowledgeDrawerElement extends HTMLElement {

/**
 * LiquidGlass - Vanilla Web Component
 * Apple-grade Liquid Glass material container with backdrop blur, specular rim reflection, and optional pointer refraction caustics.
 *
 * Usage:
 * <liquid-glass variant="capsule" intensity="regular" enable-tilt="true">
 *   <span>Action</span>
 * </liquid-glass>
 */

// Motion preference is resolved per-call (cheap) so tests and embeds can stub
// matchMedia dynamically; absent matchMedia (jsdom) means "no short-circuit".
function prefersReducedMotion() {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" &&
    typeof window.matchMedia === "function" &&
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
}

class LiquidGlass extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["variant", "intensity", "interactive", "enable-tilt", "max-tilt", "glare-opacity"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._onPointerMove = this._onPointerMove.bind(this);
    this._onPointerLeave = this._onPointerLeave.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._updateClasses();

    if (!this._glareEl) {
      let glare = this.querySelector(":scope > .liquid-glass-glare");
      if (!glare) {
        glare = document.createElement("div");
        glare.className = "liquid-glass-glare pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 transition-opacity duration-300";
        glare.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        glare.style.opacity = "0";
        glare.style.mixBlendMode = "overlay";
        this.prepend(glare);
      }
      this._glareEl = glare;
    }

    if (!this._ringEl) {
      let ring = this.querySelector(":scope > .liquid-glass-ring");
      if (!ring) {
        ring = document.createElement("div");
        ring.className = "liquid-glass-ring pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 rounded-[inherit] ring-1 ring-inset ring-white/30 dark:ring-white/10";
        ring.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        this.prepend(ring);
      }
      this._ringEl = ring;
    }

    this.addEventListener("pointermove", this._onPointerMove);
    this.addEventListener("pointerleave", this._onPointerLeave);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener("pointermove", this._onPointerMove);
    this.removeEventListener("pointerleave", this._onPointerLeave);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue !== newValue) {
      this._updateClasses();
    }
  }

  _updateClasses() {
    const variant = this.getAttribute("variant") || "card";
    const intensity = this.getAttribute("intensity") || "regular";

    this.classList.add(
      "liquid-glass-pane",
      "group",
      "relative",
      "overflow-hidden",
      "text-[#1d1d1f]",
      "dark:text-[#f5f5f7]",
      "select-none",
      "transition-all",
      "duration-300",
      "bg-white/65",
      "dark:bg-[#16181d]/65",
      "contrast-more:bg-white",
      "contrast-more:dark:bg-[#16181d]",
      "contrast-more:backdrop-blur-none",
      "motion-reduce:transform-none",
      "motion-reduce:transition-none",
      "border",
      "border-white/50",
      "dark:border-white/10",
      "shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.7),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]",
      "dark:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.18),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.4),0_12px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.35)]",
      "hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.85),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_14px_44px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]",
      "dark:hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.25),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.45),0_16px_48px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)]"
    );

    // Clean past variant / intensity classes
    this.classList.remove(
      "rounded-full",
      "px-5",
      "py-2.5",
      "inline-flex",
      "items-center",
      "rounded-2xl",
      "sm:rounded-3xl",
      "p-6",
      "block",
      "rounded-none",
      "border-r",
      "h-full",
      "backdrop-blur-md",
      "backdrop-saturate-150",
      "backdrop-blur-xl",
      "backdrop-saturate-[180%]",
      "backdrop-blur-2xl",
      "backdrop-saturate-[200%]"
    );

    // Apply variant
    if (variant === "capsule") {
      this.classList.add("rounded-full", "px-5", "py-2.5", "inline-flex", "items-center");
    } else if (variant === "sidebar") {
      this.classList.add("rounded-none", "border-r", "h-full", "block");
    } else {
      this.classList.add("rounded-2xl", "sm:rounded-3xl", "p-6", "block");
    }

    // Apply intensity
    if (intensity === "light") {
      this.classList.add("backdrop-blur-md", "backdrop-saturate-150");
    } else if (intensity === "thick") {
      this.classList.add("backdrop-blur-2xl", "backdrop-saturate-[200%]");
    } else {
      this.classList.add("backdrop-blur-xl", "backdrop-saturate-[180%]");
    }
  }

  _onPointerMove(e) {
    const isInteractive = this.getAttribute("interactive") !== "false";
    const enableTilt = this.getAttribute("enable-tilt") === "true";
    const variant = this.getAttribute("variant") || "card";

    if (!isInteractive && !enableTilt) return;

    const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height || rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return;
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const gx = ((x / rect.width) * 100).toFixed(1);
    const gy = ((y / rect.height) * 100).toFixed(1);

    const glareOpacity = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("glare-opacity") || "0.35");
    const maxTilt = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("max-tilt") || "4");

    const glare = this._glareEl || this.querySelector(":scope > .liquid-glass-glare");
    if (glare && isInteractive) {
      glare.style.opacity = glareOpacity.toString();
      glare.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at ${gx}% ${gy}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 35%, transparent 65%)`;
    }

    if (enableTilt && variant !== "sidebar" && !prefersReducedMotion()) {
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      const ry = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * maxTilt;
      const rx = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * maxTilt;
      this.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rx.toFixed(2)}deg) rotateY(${ry.toFixed(2)}deg) translateY(-1px)`;
      this.style.transition = "transform 0.1s ease-out";
    }
  }

  _onPointerLeave() {
    const glare = this._glareEl || this.querySelector(":scope > .liquid-glass-glare");
    if (glare) {
      glare.style.opacity = "0";
    }
    this.style.transform = "";
    this.style.transition = "transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)";
  }
}

if (typeof window !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("liquid-glass")) {
  customElements.define("liquid-glass", LiquidGlass);
}

export { LiquidGlass };

/**
 * LiveTailLogConsole - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <live-tail-log-console timezone="GMT+7"></live-tail-log-console>
 * Attributes: search-placeholder, timezone, sources (JSON array), max-lines, live-tail (true|false)
 * Properties: lines (Array<{ts?, level: info|warn|error|success, message, source?}>)
 * Events: search (detail {query}), source-change (detail {source}), live-tail-change (detail {enabled})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const LEVEL_DOT = {
  info: 'bg-sky-500',
  warn: 'bg-amber-500',
  error: 'bg-rose-500',
  success: 'bg-emerald-500',
};

export class LiveTailLogConsoleElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['search-placeholder', 'timezone', 'max-lines', 'live-tail'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._lines = [];
    this._sources = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._follow = true;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get lines() {
    return this._lines;
  }

  set lines(list) {
    this._lines = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get sources() {
    return this._sources;
  }

  set sources(list) {
    this._sources = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get liveTail() {
    return this._follow;
  }

  set liveTail(flag) {
    this._follow = Boolean(flag);
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._lines.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('lines');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._lines = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._lines = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._sources.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('sources');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._sources = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._sources = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const search = event.target.closest('[data-tail-search]');
        if (search) {
          this._query = search.value;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('search', { detail: { query: this._query } }));
          this._renderLines();
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        const select = event.target.closest('[data-tail-source]');
        if (select) {
          this._query = select.value === 'all' ? '' : select.value;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('source-change', { detail: { source: select.value } }));
          this._renderLines();
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-tail-follow]')) {
          this._follow = !this._follow;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('live-tail-change', { detail: { enabled: this._follow } }));
          this.render();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _filtered() {
    const maxLines = Number(this.getAttribute('max-lines')) || 200;
    const query = this._query.toLowerCase();
    const base = query
      ? this._lines.filter((line) => (line.message || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) || (line.source || '').toLowerCase().includes(query))
      : this._lines;
    return maxLines > 0 ? base.slice(-maxLines) : base;
  }

  _renderLines() {
    const container = this.querySelector('[data-tail-lines]');
    if (!container) return;
    const filtered = this._filtered();
    if (!filtered.length) {
      container.innerHTML = '<p class="py-4 text-center text-neutral-500">No log lines match.</p>';
      return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = filtered
      .map(
        (line) => `<div data-tail-line class="flex items-start gap-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">
          ${line.ts ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-neutral-500">${escapeAttribute(line.ts)}</span>` : ''}
          <span class="mt-1.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${LEVEL_DOT[line.level] || LEVEL_DOT.info}"></span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-neutral-300">${escapeAttribute(line.message)}</span>
          ${line.source ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded bg-neutral-800 px-1 text-[10px] text-neutral-400">${escapeAttribute(line.source)}</span>` : ''}
        </div>`,
      )
      .join('');
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const searchPlaceholder = this.getAttribute('search-placeholder') || 'Search logs…';
    const timezone = this.getAttribute('timezone') || '';
    const sources = this._sources;
    const follow = this._follow;

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-live-tail-console class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-950">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-neutral-800 px-3 py-2">
        ${
          sources.length
            ? `<select data-tail-source class="rounded-md border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-neutral-200 focus-visible:outline-none">
                <option value="all">All sources</option>
                ${sources.map((source) => `<option value="${escapeAttribute(source)}">${escapeAttribute(source)}</option>`).join('')}
              </select>`
            : ''
        }
        <div class="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 -translate-y-1/2 text-neutral-500"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3" /></svg>
          <input type="text" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(searchPlaceholder)}" data-tail-search class="w-full rounded-md border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 py-1 pl-7 pr-2 text-xs text-neutral-200 placeholder:text-neutral-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-neutral-500" />
        </div>
        <button type="button" data-tail-follow class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-neutral-500 ${
          follow ? 'border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400' : 'border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-300'
        }">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" class="h-3 w-3"><path d="M13 2 3 14h7l-1 8 10-12h-7l1-8z" /></svg>
          Live tail
        </button>
        ${timezone ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-neutral-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-neutral-400">${escapeAttribute(timezone)}</span>` : ''}
      </div>
      <div data-tail-lines class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs leading-5 text-neutral-300"></div>
    </div>`;
    this._renderLines();
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('live-tail-log-console')) {
  customElements.define('live-tail-log-console', LiveTailLogConsoleElement);
}
export default LiveTailLogConsoleElement;

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {

  }

class LogoCloudElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['kicker', 'logos'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._kicker = 'Trusted by teams at';
    this._logos = DEFAULT_LOGOS();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const k = this.getAttribute('kicker');
    if (k !== null) this._kicker = k;
    this._logos = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('logos'), DEFAULT_LOGOS());
    this._render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'kicker') this._kicker = newValue ?? '';
    if (name === 'logos') this._logos = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_LOGOS());
    this._render();
  }

  set logos(value) { this._logos = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

    const tilesHtml = logos
      .map((logo) => {
        const inner = logo.src
          ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(logo.src)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(logo.name || 'logo')}" loading="lazy" class="max-h-7 w-auto object-contain" />`
          : `<span data-logocloud-name="${escapeAttribute(logo.name)}" class="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-400 transition-colors group-hover:text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:group-hover:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(logo.name)}</span>`;

      })
      .join('');

    const kickerHtml = this._kicker
      ? `<p data-logocloud-kicker class="mb-4 text-center text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(this._kicker)}</p>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-logocloud class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/60 p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/60">
        ${kickerHtml}
        <div data-logocloud-grid class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6">${tilesHtml}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

class MapActivityListElement extends HTMLElement {

  }

    this._activeId = null;

    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;

    if (filter) {

      return;

    if (event.target.closest('[data-mapact-close]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close-map', { bubbles: true }));
      return;

    const pin = event.target.closest('[data-mapact-pin]');
    if (pin) {
      this._emitActivity(pin.getAttribute('data-mapact-pin'));
      return;
    }
    const item = event.target.closest('[data-mapact-item]');
    if (item) {
      this._emitActivity(item.getAttribute('data-mapact-item'));
    }
  }

    const filters = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('filters'), DEFAULT_FILTERS());

              <span data-mapact-item-title="${escapeAttribute(a.id)}" class="block truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(a.title)}</span>

  id: 'p2',
  images: [],
  title: 'Home in Kecamatan Denpasar',

  reviews: 27,
  subtitle: 'Private Joglo in heart of Sanur',

class MapPropertyCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['pins', 'active-pin-id', 'card', 'like-label', 'close-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._pins = DEFAULT_PINS();
    this._activePinId = 'p2';
    this._card = DEFAULT_CARD();
    this._likeLabel = '♡';
    this._closeLabel = '✕';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._pins = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('pins'), DEFAULT_PINS());
    const ap = this.getAttribute('active-pin-id');
    if (ap) this._activePinId = ap;
    const cardRaw = this.getAttribute('card');
    if (cardRaw === 'null' || cardRaw === '') this._card = null;
    else if (cardRaw) this._card = parseJsonAttr(cardRaw, DEFAULT_CARD());
    const ll = this.getAttribute('like-label');
    if (ll) this._likeLabel = ll;
    const cl = this.getAttribute('close-label');
    if (cl) this._closeLabel = cl;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'pins') this._pins = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_PINS());
    if (name === 'active-pin-id') this._activePinId = newValue || 'p2';
    if (name === 'card') this._card = (newValue === 'null' || newValue === '') ? null : parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_CARD());
    if (name === 'like-label') this._likeLabel = newValue || '♡';
    if (name === 'close-label') this._closeLabel = newValue || '✕';
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const pin = event.target.closest('[data-mappin-pin]');
    if (pin) {
      const found = this._pins.find((p) => p.id === pin.getAttribute('data-mappin-pin'));
      if (found) {
        this._activePinId = found.id;
        this._render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pin-click', { detail: { pin: found }, bubbles: true }));
        return;
      }
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-mappin-close]')) {
      this._card = null;
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('card-close', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-mappin-like]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('card-like', { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const pinsHtml = this._pins
      .map((pin) => {
        const active = pin.id === this._activePinId;
        const cls = active
          ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900'
          : 'bg-white text-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50';
        return `<button data-mappin-pin="${escapeAttribute(pin.id)}" data-mappin-price="${escapeAttribute(pin.price)}" type="button" style="left:${Number(pin.x)}%;top:${Number(pin.y)}%" class="absolute z-10 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold shadow-md transition-transform hover:scale-105 ${cls}">${escapeAttribute(pin.price)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const card = this._card;
    const cardHtml = card
      ? `<div data-mappin-preview class="absolute bottom-8 left-1/2 z-20 w-72 -translate-x-1/2 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-xl dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <div data-mappin-image class="relative h-36 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-200 via-orange-200 to-rose-200 dark:from-amber-900 dark:via-orange-900 dark:to-rose-900">
            <div class="absolute right-3 top-3 flex gap-2">
              <button data-mappin-like type="button" aria-label="Save" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/90 text-sm text-zinc-800 shadow transition-colors hover:bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800/90 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(this._likeLabel)}</button>
              <button data-mappin-close type="button" aria-label="Close preview" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/90 text-sm text-zinc-800 shadow transition-colors hover:bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800/90 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(this._closeLabel)}</button>
            </div>
            <div data-mappin-dots class="absolute bottom-2 left-1/2 flex -translate-x-1/2 gap-1.5">
              <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/50" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/50" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/50" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </div>
            <button data-mappin-next aria-label="Next image" class="absolute right-2 top-1/2 flex h-7 w-7 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/90 text-xs text-zinc-800 shadow transition-colors hover:bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800/90 dark:text-zinc-100">›</button>
          </div>
          <div class="space-y-0.5 px-4 py-3">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <p data-mappin-title class="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(card.title)}</p>
              <p data-mappin-rating class="shrink-0 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">★ ${escapeAttribute(card.rating)} (${escapeAttribute(card.reviews)})</p>
            </div>
            <p data-mappin-subtitle class="truncate text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(card.subtitle)}</p>
            <p data-mappin-price class="text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(card.price)}${card.dates ? `<span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"> · ${escapeAttribute(card.dates)}</span>` : ''}</p>
          </div>
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-mappin-card class="relative min-h-[420px] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-sky-50 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-sky-950/30">
        <div class="absolute inset-0" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        ${pinsHtml}
        ${cardHtml}
        <div data-mappin-zoom class="absolute right-4 top-4 z-20 flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-white shadow-md dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <button class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300" aria-label="Zoom in">＋</button>
          <button class="px-3 py-2 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300" aria-label="Zoom out">－</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * MarqueeWall - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <marquee-wall speed-seconds="40"></marquee-wall> with `rows` property
 * Attributes: speed-seconds, paused
 * Properties: rows ({ name, handle?, text, anonymous? }[][]) — outer array = rows, alternating direction
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const AVATAR_TONES = ['bg-indigo-500', 'bg-emerald-500', 'bg-rose-500', 'bg-amber-500', 'bg-sky-500', 'bg-violet-500'];

const initialsOf = (name) =>
  String(name)
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || '').toUpperCase())
    .join('');

export class MarqueeWallElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['speed-seconds', 'paused'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._rows = [];
  }

  get rows() {
    return this._rows;
  }

  set rows(value) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const rows = this._rows;
    if (!rows.length) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const speed = Number(this.getAttribute('speed-seconds')) || 40;
    const paused = this.hasAttribute('paused');

    const rowHtml = rows
      .map((row, rowIndex) => {
        const reverse = rowIndex % 2 === 1;
        const cards = [...row, ...row]
          .map((card, index) => {
            const tone = AVATAR_TONES[index % AVATAR_TONES.length];
            return `<figure data-marquee-card="${index}" class="w-64 shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 dark:bg-zinc-900">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${tone}">${escapeAttribute(initialsOf(card.name))}</span>
                <span class="min-w-0">
                  <span class="block truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(card.name)}</span>
                  ${card.handle && !card.anonymous ? `<span class="block truncate text-[11px] text-indigo-500">@${escapeAttribute(card.handle)}</span>` : ''}
                </span>
              </div>
              <blockquote class="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(card.text)}</blockquote>
            </figure>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return `<div data-marquee-row="${rowIndex}" class="flex overflow-hidden">
          <div class="flex min-w-full shrink-0 gap-3 marquee-track" style="animation:marquee-scroll ${speed}s linear infinite${reverse ? ' reverse' : ''};animation-play-state:${paused ? 'paused' : 'running'}">${cards}</div>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-marquee-wall class="space-y-3 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-950 via-zinc-950 to-zinc-950 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
      ${rowHtml}
      <style>@keyframes marquee-scroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } } .marquee-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused !important; }</style>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('marquee-wall')) {
  customElements.define('marquee-wall', MarqueeWallElement);
}
export default MarqueeWallElement;

/**
 * MasonryDensityControls - Immersive masonry gallery with a floating
 * Size / Padding dual-slider control bar that live-adjusts column count and
 * gutter (Savee discovery wall pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_ITEMS = () => [
  { id: 'm1', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1493397212122-2b1dda949c8a?w=400&q=60', alt: 'Architecture facade', span: 3 },
  { id: 'm2', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1502680390469-be75c86b636f?w=400&q=60', alt: 'Surf wave', span: 2 },
  { id: 'm3', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1490750967868-88aa4486c946?w=400&q=60', alt: 'Flowers', span: 2 },
  { id: 'm4', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1478737270239-2f02b77fc618?w=400&q=60', alt: 'Microphone', span: 3 },
  { id: 'm5', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1519681393784-d120267933ba?w=400&q=60', alt: 'Mountains at night', span: 2 },
  { id: 'm6', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1449034446853-66c86144b0ad?w=400&q=60', alt: 'City dusk', span: 3 },
  { id: 'm7', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1454165804606-c3d57bc86b40?w=400&q=60', alt: 'Desk with notes', span: 1 },
  { id: 'm8', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1434030216411-0b793f4b4173?w=400&q=60', alt: 'Writing', span: 2 },
];

const ratioFor = (span) => (span === 3 ? '3 / 4' : span === 2 ? '4 / 5' : '1 / 1');

class MasonryDensityControlsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'items', 'columns', 'padding'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._size = 4;
    this._gap = 12;
    this._closed = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._size = Number(this.getAttribute('columns')) || 4;
    this._gap = Number(this.getAttribute('padding')) || 12;
    this._closed = false;
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('input', this._onInput);
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('input', this._onInput);
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'columns') this._size = Number(newValue) || 4;
    if (name === 'padding') this._gap = Number(newValue) || 12;
    this._render();
  }

  _onInput(event) {
    const target = event.target;
    if (!target || typeof target.hasAttribute !== 'function') return;
    if (target.hasAttribute('data-masn-size')) {
      this._size = Number(target.value) || 2;
      this._syncGrid();
    } else if (target.hasAttribute('data-masn-padding')) {
      this._gap = Number(target.value) || 4;
      this._syncGrid();
    }
  }

  _syncGrid() {
    const grid = this.querySelector('[data-masn-grid]');
    if (grid) {
      grid.style.columnCount = String(this._size);
      grid.style.columnGap = this._gap + 'px';
    }
    // update per-item margin + meta line without re-render (keeps slider focus)
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-masn-item]').forEach((el) => {
      el.style.marginBottom = this._gap + 'px';
    });
    const meta = this.querySelector('[data-masn-meta]');
    if (meta) meta.textContent = `${this._size} cols · ${this._gap}px`;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('density-change', { detail: { columns: this._size, padding: this._gap }, bubbles: true }));
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-masn-close]')) {
      this._closed = true;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close', { bubbles: true }));
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    const itemBtn = event.target.closest('[data-masn-item]');
    if (itemBtn) {
      const items = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('items'), DEFAULT_ITEMS());
      const id = itemBtn.getAttribute('data-masn-item');
      const item = items.find((it) => it.id === id);
      if (item) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('item-click', { detail: item, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    if (this._closed) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Discovery wall';
    const items = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('items'), DEFAULT_ITEMS());

    const cards = items
      .map(
        (it) => `<button type="button" data-masn-item="${escapeAttribute(it.id)}" class="block w-full break-inside-avoid overflow-hidden rounded-sm bg-zinc-900" style="margin-bottom:${this._gap}px">
            <img src="${escapeAttribute(it.url)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(it.alt)}" loading="lazy" style="aspect-ratio:${ratioFor(it.span)}" class="w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 hover:scale-105" />
          </button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-masn class="relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-zinc-950 dark:bg-black">
        <div data-masn-controls class="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-around gap-6 bg-black/80 px-6 py-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <label data-masn-size-group class="flex flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-sm text-zinc-200">
            <span>Size</span>
            <input type="range" data-masn-size min="2" max="6" step="1" value="${this._size}" class="h-1 flex-1 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded bg-zinc-600 accent-white" />
          </label>
          <label data-masn-padding-group class="flex flex-1 items-center gap-3 text-sm text-zinc-200">
            <span>Padding</span>
            <input type="range" data-masn-padding min="4" max="32" step="2" value="${this._gap}" class="h-1 flex-1 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded bg-zinc-600 accent-white" />
          </label>
          <button type="button" data-masn-close aria-label="Close gallery" class="text-lg text-zinc-300 transition-colors hover:text-white">✕</button>
        </div>
        <p data-masn-title class="absolute left-5 top-16 z-10 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
        <p data-masn-meta class="absolute right-5 top-16 z-10 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500">${this._size} cols · ${this._gap}px</p>
        <div data-masn-grid class="pt-28" style="column-count:${this._size};column-gap:${this._gap}px">${cards}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('masonry-density-controls')) {
  customElements.define('masonry-density-controls', MasonryDensityControlsElement);
}

===== FILE: vanilla\McpConnectPanel.js =====

/**
 * McpConnectPanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * MCP (Model Context Protocol) server connection guide: per-client tabs,
 * numbered setup steps and a copyable config snippet block.
 *
 * Usage: <mcp-connect-panel title="Connection guide"></mcp-connect-panel>
 * Property: clients ([{id, label, mark?, steps: [...], snippet?}])
 * Attributes: title, description
 * Events: copy (detail {client})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class McpConnectPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._clients = [];
    this._active = '';
    this._copied = false;
    this._copyTimer = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._active && this._clients.length > 0) this._active = this._clients[0].id;
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const tab = event.target.closest('[data-mcp-tab]');
        if (tab) {
          this._active = tab.getAttribute('data-mcp-tab') || '';
          this._copied = false;
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-mcp-copy]')) {
          this._copied = true;
          const client = this._clients.find((c) => c.id === this._active) || this._clients[0];
          if (client) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('copy', { detail: { client } }));
          if (this._copyTimer) clearTimeout(this._copyTimer);
          this._copyTimer = setTimeout(() => { this._copied = false; this.render(); }, 1600);
          this.render();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._copyTimer) { clearTimeout(this._copyTimer); this._copyTimer = null; }
  }

  get clients() { return this._clients; }
  set clients(v) {
    this._clients = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((c) => ({ ...c })) : [];
    if (!this._clients.find((c) => c.id === this._active)) {
      this._active = this._clients[0]?.id || '';
    }
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before clients are captured.
    if (this._clients.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Connection guide');
    const description = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('description') || 'Connect to the MCP server to access workspace data directly from your preferred AI assistant.');
    const client = this._clients.find((c) => c.id === this._active) || this._clients[0];

    const tabs = this._clients.map((c) => `
      <button type="button" data-mcp-tab="${escapeAttribute(c.id)}" aria-selected="${c.id === client?.id}" class="-mb-px flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${c.id === client?.id ? 'border-teal-600 text-teal-700 dark:border-teal-400 dark:text-teal-300' : 'border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'}">${c.mark ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(c.mark)}</span>` : ''}${escapeAttribute(c.label)}</button>`
    ).join('');

    const steps = client ? (client.steps || []).map((step, i) => `
      <li data-mcp-step class="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
        <span class="mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-teal-50 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-teal-700 dark:bg-teal-950/60 dark:text-teal-300">${i + 1}</span>
        <span class="min-w-0">${escapeAttribute(step)}</span>
      </li>`
    ).join('') : '';

    const snippet = client?.snippet ? `
      <div data-mcp-snippet class="mt-3">
        <div class="relative">
          <pre class="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 p-3 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-200"><code>${escapeAttribute(client.snippet)}</code></pre>
          <button type="button" data-mcp-copy class="absolute right-2 top-2 rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900/90 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-300 hover:border-teal-500 hover:text-teal-300">${this._copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy'}</button>
        </div>
      </div>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-mcp-panel class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <p data-mcp-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
  <p data-mcp-description class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${description}</p>
  <div data-mcp-tabs class="mt-3 flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">${tabs}</div>
  <ol data-mcp-steps class="mt-3 space-y-2">${steps}</ol>
  ${snippet}
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * MembershipTierGrid - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <membership-tier-grid tiers='[{"id":"spark","name":"Spark","price":"$2.50","perks":["Ad-free"]}]'></membership-tier-grid>
 * Attributes: title, subtitle, tiers (JSON [{id,name,price,period?,image?,description?,perks?,badge?,limited?,highlighted?,ctaText?}])
 * Property: tiers
 * Events: select (detail.tier)
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class MembershipTierGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tiers', 'title', 'subtitle'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tiers = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._tiers.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('tiers');
      if (raw) { try { this._tiers = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._tiers = []; } }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const cta = event.target.closest('[data-membership-cta]');
        if (cta) {
          const tierId = cta.getAttribute('data-membership-cta');
          const tier = this._tiers.find((t) => String(t.id) === tierId);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { tier: tier || tierId } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get tiers() { return this._tiers; }
  set tiers(v) {
    this._tiers = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'tiers' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._tiers = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    if (this._tiers.length) this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Get more from this creator');
    const subtitle = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('subtitle') || 'Upgrade to access exclusive benefits.');
    const count = this._tiers.length;
    const gridClass = count >= 3 ? 'md:grid-cols-3' : count === 2 ? 'md:grid-cols-2' : '';

    const cards = this._tiers.map((tier) => `
      <div data-membership-tier="${escapeAttribute(String(tier.id))}" class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-white ${tier.highlighted ? 'border-zinc-900' : 'border-zinc-200'}">
        ${tier.image ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(tier.image)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(tier.name)}" class="h-36 w-full object-cover" />` : ''}
        <div class="p-5">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(tier.name)}</span>
            ${tier.badge ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-white">${escapeAttribute(tier.badge)}</span>` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1">
            <span data-membership-price class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(tier.price)}</span>
            <span class="text-xs text-zinc-500">/ ${escapeAttribute(tier.period || 'month')}</span>
          </div>
          ${tier.limited !== undefined ? `<p data-membership-limited class="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700">Limited (${escapeAttribute(String(tier.limited))} remaining)</p>` : ''}
          <button type="button" data-membership-cta="${escapeAttribute(String(tier.id))}" class="mt-3 w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${tier.highlighted ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white hover:bg-zinc-700' : 'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-500'}">${escapeAttribute(tier.ctaText || 'Start 7-day free trial')}</button>
          ${tier.description ? `<p class="mt-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600">${escapeAttribute(tier.description)}</p>` : ''}
          ${tier.perks && tier.perks.length ? `<ul data-membership-perks class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
            ${tier.perks.map((perk) => `<li class="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-700"><span class="mt-0.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-zinc-400"></span>${escapeAttribute(perk)}</li>`).join('')}
          </ul>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>`).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-membership-grid>
  <div class="text-center">
    <h3 data-membership-title class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900">${title}</h3>
    <p class="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">${subtitle}</p>
  </div>
  <div class="mt-6 grid gap-5 ${gridClass}">${cards}
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * MemoryPanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <memory-panel title="Memory" note="..." add-placeholder="..." add-text="Add"></memory-panel>
 * Property: items ([{id, text, source?}])
 * Events: add (detail {text}), edit (detail {id, text}), delete (detail {id}), clear
 * Inline editing state is internal (_editingId) and survives re-renders.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class MemoryPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'note', 'add-placeholder', 'add-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
    this._editingId = null;
    this._editDraft = '';
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const itemEl = event.target.closest('[data-memory-item]');
        const itemId = itemEl ? itemEl.getAttribute('data-memory-item') : null;
        if (event.target.closest('[data-memory-edit]') && itemId) {
          const item = this._items.find((x) => x.id === itemId);
          if (item) {
            this._editingId = item.id;
            this._editDraft = item.text;
            this.render();
          }
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-memory-save]') && this._editingId) {
          // read the live input value — programmatic .value changes don't fire `input`
          const editInput = this.querySelector('[data-memory-edit-input]');
          const text = ((editInput ? editInput.value : '') || this._editDraft).trim();
          const id = this._editingId;
          this._editingId = null;
          this.render();
          if (text) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('edit', { detail: { id, text } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-memory-cancel]')) {
          this._editingId = null;
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-memory-delete]') && itemId) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('delete', { detail: { id: itemId } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-memory-clear]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('clear'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-memory-add]')) {
          const input = this.querySelector('[data-memory-add-input]');
          const text = (input ? input.value : '').trim();
          if (text) {
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add', { detail: { text } }));
            if (input) input.value = '';
          }
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' && event.target.matches('[data-memory-add-input]')) {
          const text = event.target.value.trim();
          if (text) {
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add', { detail: { text } }));
            event.target.value = '';
          }
        }
        if (event.key === 'Enter' && event.target.matches('[data-memory-edit-input]')) {
          this._editDraft = event.target.value;
          const id = this._editingId;
          const text = this._editDraft.trim();
          this._editingId = null;
          this.render();
          if (id && text) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('edit', { detail: { id, text } }));
        }
        if (event.key === 'Escape' && event.target.matches('[data-memory-edit-input]')) {
          this._editingId = null;
          this.render();
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        if (event.target.matches('[data-memory-edit-input]')) {
          this._editDraft = event.target.value;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get items() { return this._items; }
  set items(v) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before items are captured.
    if (this._items.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Memory');
    const note = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('note') || 'Facts the assistant remembers across conversations.');
    const addPlaceholder = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('add-placeholder') || 'Add a memory…');
    const addText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('add-text') || 'Add');

    const rows = this._items.map((item) => {
      if (this._editingId === item.id) {
        return `
          <li data-memory-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input data-memory-edit-input value="${escapeAttribute(this._editDraft)}" class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/60 px-2 py-1 text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-zinc-100" />
              <button type="button" data-memory-save class="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500">Save</button>
              <button type="button" data-memory-cancel class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Cancel</button>
            </div>
          </li>`;
      }
      return `
        <li data-memory-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
            <p data-memory-text class="text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.text)}</p>
            <span class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
              <button type="button" data-memory-edit aria-label="Edit memory" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12.7 3.3a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 2.12 0l1.88 1.88a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 0 2.12l-8.37 8.37a2 2 0 0 1-1.02.55l-2.9.65a.6.6 0 0 1-.7-.71l.64-2.9a2 2 0 0 1 .55-1.02L12.7 3.3Z"/></svg></button>
              <button type="button" data-memory-delete aria-label="Forget memory" class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-red-50 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" class="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3.25h4a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h1.75a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5H6.25a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5H8Zm-2.75 4.5h9.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0 1.5h-.5l-.4 5.6A1.75 1.75 0 0 1 12.1 16.3H7.9a1.75 1.75 0 0 1-1.75-1.62l-.4-5.68h-.5a.75.75 0 0 1 0-1.5Z"/></svg></button>
            </span>
          </div>
          ${item.source ? `<p data-memory-source class="mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(item.source)}</p>` : ''}
        </li>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-memory-panel class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
    ${this._items.length > 0 ? `<button type="button" data-memory-clear class="text-xs font-medium text-red-600 hover:underline dark:text-red-400">Clear all</button>` : ''}
  </div>
  <p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${note}</p>
  <ul class="mt-3 space-y-2">${rows}
    ${this._items.length === 0 ? `<li data-memory-empty class="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700">No memories yet.</li>` : ''}
  </ul>
  <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
    <input data-memory-add-input placeholder="${addPlaceholder}" class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100" />
    <button type="button" data-memory-add class="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900">${addText}</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('memory-panel')) {
  customElements.define('memory-panel', MemoryPanelElement);

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

/**
 * MessageActionToolbar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <message-action-toolbar content="Hello" total-branches="3" branch-index="0"></message-action-toolbar>
 */
class MessageActionToolbar extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["content", "role", "total-branches", "branch-index"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const content = this.getAttribute("content") || "";
    const role = this.getAttribute("role") || "assistant";
    const totalBranches = parseInt(this.getAttribute("total-branches") || "0", 10);
    const branchIndex = parseInt(this.getAttribute("branch-index") || "0", 10);

    const hasBranches = totalBranches > 1;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-1.5 select-none">
        ${hasBranches ? `
          <div class="flex items-center gap-0.5 mr-2 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <button type="button" id="prev-branch" ${branchIndex <= 0 ? 'disabled' : ''} class="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5" title="Previous version">${uiIcon('chevron-left', { size: 14 })}</button>
            <span>${branchIndex + 1}/${totalBranches}</span>
            <button type="button" id="next-branch" ${branchIndex >= totalBranches - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} class="hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:pointer-events-none p-0.5" title="Next version">${uiIcon('chevron-right', { size: 14 })}</button>
          </div>
        ` : ''}
        <button type="button" id="copy-btn" class="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors" title="Copy response">${uiIcon('copy', { size: 16 })}</button>
        <button type="button" id="retry-btn" class="p-1 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors" title="Regenerate response">${uiIcon('refresh', { size: 16 })}</button>
        ${role === 'assistant' ? `
          <button type="button" id="thumb-up" class="p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700" title="Good response">${uiIcon('thumbs-up', { size: 16 })}</button>
          <button type="button" id="thumb-down" class="p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700" title="Bad response">${uiIcon('thumbs-down', { size: 16 })}</button>
        ` : ''}
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelector("#copy-btn")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
      const btn = this.querySelector("#copy-btn");
      btn.innerHTML = uiIcon("check", { size: 16 });
      setTimeout(() => (btn.innerHTML = uiIcon("copy", { size: 16 })), 2000);
    });

    this.querySelector("#retry-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("retry"));
    });

    this.querySelector("#prev-branch")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("branchChange", { detail: branchIndex - 1 }));
    });

    this.querySelector("#next-branch")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("branchChange", { detail: branchIndex + 1 }));
    });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("message-action-toolbar")) {
  customElements.define("message-action-toolbar", MessageActionToolbar);
}
