===== FILE: vanilla\MetricStrip.js =====

/**
 * MetricStrip - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <metric-strip active-index="0"></metric-strip> with `metrics` property
 * Attributes: active-index
 * Properties: metrics ({ label, value, delta?, deltaLabel?, icon? }[])
 * Events: metric-click (detail: { index, metric })
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class MetricStripElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['active-index'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._metrics = [];
  }

  get metrics() {
    return this._metrics;
  }

  set metrics(value) {
    this._metrics = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    if (!this._metrics.length) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const activeIndex = Number(this.getAttribute('active-index') ?? -1);

    const cells = this._metrics
      .map((metric, index) => {
        const active = index === activeIndex;
        let delta = '';
        if (metric.delta !== undefined) {
          const tone = metric.delta > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600' : metric.delta < 0 ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-zinc-400';
          const icon = metric.delta > 0 ? 'trending-up' : metric.delta < 0 ? 'trending-down' : 'minus';
          delta = `<span class="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${tone}">${uiIcon(icon, { size: 11 })}${metric.delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${escapeAttribute(metric.delta)}${metric.deltaLabel ? ` ${escapeAttribute(metric.deltaLabel)}` : '%'}</span>`;
        } else if (metric.deltaLabel) {
          delta = `<span class="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(metric.deltaLabel)}</span>`;
        }
        return `<div role="button" tabindex="0" data-metric-index="${index}" ${active ? 'aria-current="true"' : ''}
          class="group flex min-w-[140px] flex-1 cursor-pointer flex-col gap-0.5 px-4 py-3 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
            active ? 'bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40'
          }">
          <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${
            metric.icon ? uiIcon(metric.icon, { size: 12, className: 'text-zinc-400' }) : ''
          }${escapeAttribute(metric.label)}</span>
          <span class="flex items-baseline gap-2">
            <span class="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(metric.value)}</span>
            ${delta}
          </span>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-metric-strip class="flex flex-wrap items-stretch divide-x divide-zinc-100 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${cells}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-metric-index]').forEach((cell) => {
      const fire = () => {
        const index = Number(cell.getAttribute('data-metric-index'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('metric-click', { detail: { index, metric: this._metrics[index] } }));
      };
      cell.addEventListener('click', fire);
      cell.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
          event.preventDefault();
          fire();
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('metric-strip')) {
  customElements.define('metric-strip', MetricStripElement);
}
export default MetricStripElement;

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',

/**
 * Modal - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage:
 *   <modal-dialog title="Delete project?" description="This cannot be undone.">
 *     <p>Body copy…</p>
 *     <button slot="footer">Cancel</button>
 *   </modal-dialog>
 * Properties: open (boolean)
 * Attributes: open, title, description, dismissible (default true), show-close (default true)
 * Events: close
 * Light-DOM children are kept as body content; children with slot="footer" render in the footer bar.
 */
export class ModalElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'description', 'dismissible', 'show-close'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bodyNodes = [];
    this._footerNodes = [];
    this._onKey = (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && this.open && this.dismissible) {
        this._close();
      }
    };
  }

  get open() {
    return this.hasAttribute('open');
  }

  set open(value) {
    if (value) this.setAttribute('open', '');
    else this.removeAttribute('open');
  }

  get dismissible() {
    return !this.hasAttribute('dismissible') || this.getAttribute('dismissible') !== 'false';
  }

  get showClose() {
    return !this.hasAttribute('show-close') || this.getAttribute('show-close') !== 'false';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._captureSlots();
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKey);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKey);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _captureSlots() {
    const seen = new Set(this._bodyNodes);
    this._footerNodes.forEach((node) => seen.add(node));
    Array.from(this.childNodes).forEach((node) => {
      if (seen.has(node)) return;
      if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.hasAttribute && node.hasAttribute('data-modal-root')) return;
      if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.getAttribute('slot') === 'footer') this._footerNodes.push(node);
      else this._bodyNodes.push(node);
    });
  }

  _detach(nodes) {
    nodes.forEach((node) => {
      if (node.parentNode) node.parentNode.removeChild(node);
    });
  }

  _close() {
    this.open = false;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
  }

  render() {
    this._captureSlots();
    const open = this.open;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';

    if (!open) {
      this._detach(this._bodyNodes);
      this._detach(this._footerNodes);
      if (this.innerHTML !== '') this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-modal-root class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div aria-hidden="true" data-modal-backdrop class="absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-950/50 backdrop-blur-[2px]"></div>
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}" data-modal-panel
        class="relative w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-5 pt-4">
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
            ${description ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>` : ''}
          </div>
          ${this.showClose ? `<button type="button" data-modal-close aria-label="Close"
            class="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
          </button>` : ''}
        </div>
        ${this._bodyNodes.length ? '<div data-modal-body class="px-5 py-4 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400"></div>' : ''}
        ${this._footerNodes.length ? '<div data-modal-footer class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950/50"></div>' : ''}
      </div>
    </div>`;

    const body = this.querySelector('[data-modal-body]');
    if (body) this._bodyNodes.forEach((node) => body.appendChild(node));
    const footer = this.querySelector('[data-modal-footer]');
    if (footer) this._footerNodes.forEach((node) => footer.appendChild(node));

    const close = this.querySelector('[data-modal-close]');
    if (close) close.addEventListener('click', () => this._close());
    this.querySelector('[data-modal-root]').addEventListener('mousedown', (event) => {
      if (!this.dismissible) return;
      const panel = this.querySelector('[data-modal-panel]');
      if (panel && !panel.contains(event.target)) this._close();
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('modal-dialog')) {
  customElements.define('modal-dialog', ModalElement);
}
export default ModalElement;

/**
 * ModelComparePane - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <model-compare-pane prompt="..." model-a="GPT-5" model-b="Claude"></model-compare-pane>
 * Attributes: prompt, model-a, model-b, vote-label-a, vote-label-b, vote-label-tie
 * Properties: outputA/outputB (string), statusA/statusB ('done'|'streaming'|'error')
 * Events: vote (detail {choice: 'A'|'B'|'tie'})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ModelComparePaneElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['prompt', 'model-a', 'model-b', 'vote-label-a', 'vote-label-b', 'vote-label-tie'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._outputA = '';
    this._outputB = '';
    this._statusA = 'done';
    this._statusB = 'done';
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const btn = event.target.closest('[data-compare-vote]');
        if (btn) {
          const choice = btn.getAttribute('data-compare-vote');
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vote', { detail: { choice } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get outputA() { return this._outputA; }
  set outputA(v) { this._outputA = String(v || ''); this.render(); }
  get outputB() { return this._outputB; }
  set outputB(v) { this._outputB = String(v || ''); this.render(); }
  get statusA() { return this._statusA; }
  set statusA(v) { this._statusA = String(v || 'done'); this.render(); }
  get statusB() { return this._statusB; }
  set statusB(v) { this._statusB = String(v || 'done'); this.render(); }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before outputs are captured.
    if (this._outputA === '' && this._outputB === '' && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const prompt = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('prompt') || '');
    const modelA = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('model-a') || 'Model A');
    const modelB = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('model-b') || 'Model B');
    const voteLabelA = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('vote-label-a') || 'A is better');
    const voteLabelB = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('vote-label-b') || 'B is better');
    const voteLabelTie = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('vote-label-tie') || 'Tie');
    const ERROR_TEXT = 'Generation failed — try again.';

    const column = (side) => {
      const model = side === 'a' ? modelA : modelB;
      const output = side === 'a' ? this._outputA : this._outputB;
      const status = side === 'a' ? this._statusA : this._statusB;
      const statusChip = status === 'streaming'
        ? `<span data-compare-status="${side}" class="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">streaming<span class="flex gap-0.5" aria-hidden="true"><span class="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:0ms]"></span><span class="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:150ms]"></span><span class="h-1 w-1 animate-bounce rounded-full bg-indigo-500 [animation-delay:300ms]"></span></span></span>`
        : status === 'error'
          ? `<span data-compare-status="${side}" class="text-[11px] font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">error</span>`
          : '';
      return `
        <div data-compare-col="${side}" class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span data-compare-model="${side}" class="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900">${model}</span>
            ${statusChip}
          </div>
          <p data-compare-output="${side}" class="mt-2 min-h-16 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-relaxed ${status === 'error' ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'}">${status === 'error' ? ERROR_TEXT : escapeAttribute(output)}</p>
        </div>`;
    };

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-model-compare class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  ${prompt ? `<p data-compare-prompt class="mb-3 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-zinc-100"><span class="mr-1.5 font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">Prompt</span>${prompt}</p>` : ''}
  <div class="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">${column('a')}${column('b')}</div>
  <div data-compare-votebar class="mt-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
    <button type="button" data-compare-vote="A" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">👈 ${voteLabelA}</button>
    <button type="button" data-compare-vote="tie" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">🤝 ${voteLabelTie}</button>
    <button type="button" data-compare-vote="B" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">👉 ${voteLabelB}</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('model-compare-pane')) {
  customElements.define('model-compare-pane', ModelComparePaneElement);
}

export default ModelComparePaneElement;

/**

 * Usage: <model-pricing-card model-name="Glm 4.7 Flash" model-id="workers-ai/@cf/..." input-per-million="0.06" output-per-million="0.40"></model-pricing-card>
 * Attributes: model-name, model-id, input-per-million, output-per-million
 * Events: copy-id (detail {modelId})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const fmtPrice = (raw) => {
  const n = Number(raw);
  return raw !== null && Number.isFinite(n) ? `$ ${n.toFixed(2)} / million tokens` : '—';
};

export class ModelPricingCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['model-name', 'model-id', 'input-per-million', 'output-per-million'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const copyBtn = event.target.closest('[data-model-pricing-copy]');
        if (!copyBtn) return;
        const modelId = this.getAttribute('model-id') || '';
        if (modelId) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('copy-id', { detail: { modelId } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const modelName = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('model-name') || '');
    const modelId = this.getAttribute('model-id') || '';
    const inputPrice = fmtPrice(this.getAttribute('input-per-million'));
    const outputPrice = fmtPrice(this.getAttribute('output-per-million'));

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-model-pricing-card class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <h4 data-model-pricing-name class="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${modelName}</h4>
  <dl class="mt-3 space-y-2.5 text-xs">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <dt class="shrink-0 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Model ID</dt>
      <dd data-model-pricing-id class="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
        <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(modelId || '—')}</span>
        ${modelId ? '<button type="button" data-model-pricing-copy aria-label="Copy model ID" class="shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">⧉</button>' : ''}
      </dd>
    </div>
    <div data-model-pricing-input class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <dt class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Input pricing</dt>
      <dd class="font-mono tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${inputPrice}</dd>
    </div>
    <div data-model-pricing-output class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <dt class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Output pricing</dt>
      <dd class="font-mono tabular-nums text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${outputPrice}</dd>
    </div>
  </dl>
</div>`;
  }
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ModelSelectorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['selected-id', 'placeholder', 'show-search', 'disabled'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._models = [];
    this._isOpen = false;
    this._searchQuery = '';
    this._handleDocClick = this._handleDocClick.bind(this);
  }

  get models() {
    return this._models;
  }

  set models(val) {
    this._models = Array.isArray(val) ? val : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get selectedId() {
    return this.getAttribute('selected-id') || '';
  }

  set selectedId(val) {
    this.setAttribute('selected-id', val);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._handleDocClick);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._handleDocClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _handleDocClick(event) {
    if (!this.contains(event.target)) {
      if (this._isOpen) {
        this._isOpen = false;
        this.render();
      }
    }
  }

  _getFilteredModels() {
    if (!this._searchQuery.trim()) return this._models;
    const q = this._searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return this._models.filter(
      (m) =>
        (m.name && m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.provider && m.provider.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.description && m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        (m.tags && m.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    );
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const selectedId = this.selectedId;
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Select model...';
    const showSearch = this.getAttribute('show-search') !== 'false';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');

    const selectedModel = this._models.find((m) => m.id === selectedId) || null;
    const filtered = this._getFilteredModels();

    this._applyHostClass('relative inline-block text-xs font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <button
        type="button"
        class="model-sel-btn flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-all shadow-sm ${
          disabled ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : 'cursor-pointer'
        }"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded="${this._isOpen}"
        ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
      >
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <div class="p-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 shrink-0">
            ${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 14 })}
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-col text-left truncate">
            <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 truncate">
              ${selectedModel ? escapeAttribute(selectedModel.name) : escapeAttribute(placeholder)}
            </span>
            ${selectedModel?.provider ? `
              <span class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                ${escapeAttribute(selectedModel.provider)}
                ${selectedModel.contextLength ? ` · ${escapeAttribute(selectedModel.contextLength)}` : ''}
              </span>
            ` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>

        <span class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200 ${this._isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}">
          ${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 14 })}
        </span>
      </button>

      ${this._isOpen ? `
        <div class="absolute left-0 mt-1.5 w-72 max-h-80 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl z-40 flex flex-col">
          ${showSearch ? `
            <div class="p-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100/80 dark:bg-zinc-800/80">
                ${uiIcon('search', { size: 13, className: 'text-zinc-400 shrink-0' })}
                <input
                  type="text"
                  class="model-search-input w-full bg-transparent border-none text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
                  placeholder="Search models..."
                  value="${escapeAttribute(this._searchQuery)}"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          ` : ''}

          <div class="overflow-y-auto p-1.5 space-y-1 max-h-60" role="listbox">
            ${filtered.length === 0 ? `
              <div class="p-3 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">No models found</div>
            ` : filtered.map((m) => {
              const isSelected = m.id === selectedId;
              return `
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-model-id="${escapeAttribute(m.id)}"
                  class="model-option-btn w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
                      : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                  }"
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected="${isSelected}"
                >
                  <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                      <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">${escapeAttribute(m.name)}</span>
                      ${m.contextLength ? `<span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">${escapeAttribute(m.contextLength)}</span>` : ''}
                      ${(m.tags || []).map((t) => `<span class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/50">${escapeAttribute(t)}</span>`).join('')}
                    </div>
                    ${m.description ? `<p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">${escapeAttribute(m.description)}</p>` : ''}
                  </div>
                  ${isSelected ? `<span class="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5">${uiIcon('check', { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
                </button>
              `;
            }).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
      ` : ''}
    `;

    const toggleBtn = this.querySelector('.model-sel-btn');
    if (toggleBtn) {
      toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._isOpen = !this._isOpen;
        this.render();
        if (this._isOpen) {
          const input = this.querySelector('.model-search-input');
          if (input) input.focus();
        }
      });
    }

    const searchInput = this.querySelector('.model-search-input');
    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        this._searchQuery = e.target.value;
        const listbox = this.querySelector('[role="listbox"]');
        if (listbox) {
          const filtered = this._getFilteredModels();
          if (filtered.length === 0) {
            listbox.innerHTML = '<div class="p-3 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">No models found</div>';
          } else {
            listbox.innerHTML = filtered.map((m) => {
              const isSelected = m.id === this.selectedId;
              return `
                <button
                  type="button"
                  data-model-id="${escapeAttribute(m.id)}"
                  class="model-option-btn w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
                      : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                  }"
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected="${isSelected}"
                >
                  <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                      <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">${escapeAttribute(m.name)}</span>
                      ${m.contextLength ? `<span class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">${escapeAttribute(m.contextLength)}</span>` : ''}
                      ${(m.tags || []).map((t) => `<span class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/50">${escapeAttribute(t)}</span>`).join('')}
                    </div>
                    ${m.description ? `<p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">${escapeAttribute(m.description)}</p>` : ''}
                  </div>
                  ${isSelected ? `<span class="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5">${uiIcon('check', { size: 14 })}</span>` : ''}
                </button>
              `;
            }).join('');
            this._bindOptionClicks();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    this._bindOptionClicks();
  }

  _bindOptionClicks() {
    this.querySelectorAll('.model-option-btn').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-model-id');
        const model = this._models.find((m) => m.id === id);
        if (model) {
          this.selectedId = model.id;
          this._isOpen = false;
          this._searchQuery = '';
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: model }));
          this.render();
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('model-selector')) {
  customElements.define('model-selector', ModelSelectorElement);
}

/**
 * MonitorRunList - LLM monitor run history: filter + time-range pills over a
 * mini request histogram, then run rows with success icon, timestamp, name
 * and latency (Adaline Monitor pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_RUNS = () => [
  { id: 'r1', name: 'Product Performance Metrics', startedAt: 'Oct 14, 1:00 AM', latencyMs: 7000, ok: true },
  { id: 'r2', name: 'Q2 Financial Overview', startedAt: 'Oct 14, 12:59 AM', latencyMs: 6688, ok: true },
  { id: 'r3', name: 'Customer Retention Strategy', startedAt: 'Oct 14, 12:37 AM', latencyMs: 1819, ok: true },
  { id: 'r4', name: 'Employee Satisfaction Survey 2025', startedAt: 'Oct 13, 10:44 PM', latencyMs: 903, ok: true },
];

const DEFAULT_HISTOGRAM = () => [
  { label: '13:00', value: 40 }, { label: '15:00', value: 25 }, { label: '17:00', value: 55 },
  { label: '19:00', value: 30 }, { label: '21:00', value: 70 }, { label: '23:00', value: 45 },
  { label: '01:00', value: 60 }, { label: '03:00', value: 35 }, { label: '05:00', value: 80 },
  { label: '07:00', value: 50 }, { label: '09:00', value: 65 }, { label: '11:00', value: 20 },
];

const formatLatency = (ms) => {
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms} ms`;
  const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const rem = ms % 1000;
  return rem === 0 ? `${s} s` : `${s} s ${rem} ms`;
};

class MonitorRunListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['runs', 'histogram', 'ranges', 'active-range'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._runs = [];
    this._histogram = [];
    this._ranges = [];
    this._activeRange = '24 hrs';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._runs.length) this._runs = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('runs'), DEFAULT_RUNS());
    if (!this._histogram.length) this._histogram = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('histogram'), DEFAULT_HISTOGRAM());
    if (!this._ranges.length) this._ranges = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('ranges'), ['24 hrs', '7 days', '30 days', '6 months']);
    const ar = this.getAttribute('active-range');
    if (ar) this._activeRange = ar;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'runs' && !this._runs.length) this._runs = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    if (name === 'histogram' && !this._histogram.length) this._histogram = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    if (name === 'ranges' && !this._ranges.length) this._ranges = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    if (name === 'active-range') this._activeRange = newValue || '24 hrs';
    this._render();
  }

  get runs() { return this._runs; }
  set runs(value) { this._runs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  get histogram() { return this._histogram; }
  set histogram(value) { this._histogram = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  get activeRange() { return this._activeRange; }
  set activeRange(value) { this._activeRange = String(value); this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const rangeEl = event.target.closest('[data-monitor-range]');
    if (rangeEl) {
      this._activeRange = rangeEl.getAttribute('data-monitor-range');
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('range-change', { detail: { range: this._activeRange }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const runEl = event.target.closest('[data-monitor-run]');
    if (runEl) {
      const run = this._runs.find((r) => r.id === runEl.getAttribute('data-monitor-run'));
      if (run) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-click', { detail: { run }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const max = Math.max(1, ...this._histogram.map((b) => b.value));
    const barsHtml = this._histogram
      .map(
        (bar) => `
        <div data-monitor-bar="${escapeAttribute(bar.label)}" class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1">
          <div class="w-full rounded-sm bg-emerald-600/85 transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500" style="height:${Math.max(4, (bar.value / max) * 56)}px" title="${escapeAttribute(bar.label)} · ${bar.value}"></div>
          <span class="w-full truncate text-center text-[9px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(bar.label)}</span>
        </div>`
      )
      .join('');

    const rangesHtml = this._ranges
      .map((range) => {
        const active = range === this._activeRange;
        return `<button type="button" data-monitor-range="${escapeAttribute(range)}" aria-pressed="${active}" class="${active ? 'rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-white' : 'rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800'}">${escapeAttribute(range)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const rowsHtml = this._runs
      .map(
        (run) => `
        <tr data-monitor-run="${escapeAttribute(run.id)}" tabindex="0" class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <td data-monitor-run-time class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2.5 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"><span class="mr-1.5 inline-flex items-center" aria-hidden="true">${run.ok !== false ? '✅' : '⚠️'}</span>${escapeAttribute(run.startedAt)}</td>
          <td data-monitor-run-name class="max-w-0 truncate px-2 py-2.5 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(run.name)}</td>
          <td data-monitor-run-latency class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(formatLatency(run.latencyMs))}</td>
        </tr>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-monitor-run-list class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-monitor-toolbar class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button type="button" data-monitor-filter class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"><span aria-hidden="true">⏳</span> Filter</button>
          <div data-monitor-ranges class="inline-flex items-center gap-1">${rangesHtml}</div>
        </div>
        <div data-monitor-histogram class="flex h-20 items-end gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">${barsHtml}</div>
        <table data-monitor-runs class="w-full">
          <thead>
            <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-left text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <th class="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Started At</th>
              <th class="px-2 py-2 font-medium">Name</th>
              <th class="px-4 py-2 text-right font-medium">Latency</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('monitor-run-list')) {
  customElements.define('monitor-run-list', MonitorRunListElement);
}

===== FILE: vanilla\Navbar.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

// Only allow safe URL protocols into <a href> (blocks javascript:/data:/vbscript:)
const isSafeHref = (href) => {
  if (typeof href !== 'string') return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith('//') || t.startsWith('/') || t.startsWith('./') || t.startsWith('../')) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

/**
 * Navbar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <nav-bar brand="awesome-ui" cta-text="Get started"></nav-bar>
 * Properties: links ({ id?, label, href?, icon?, badge? }[]), menus ({ id, label, columns: [{ heading?, links }] }[])
 * Attributes: brand, cta-text
 * Events: cta
 */
export class NavbarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['brand', 'cta-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._links = [];
    this._menus = [];
    this._openMenu = null;
    this._boundDocMouseDown = (event) => {
      if (!this.contains(event.target)) this._openMenu = null;
    };
    this._boundDocKeyDown = (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        this._openMenu = null;
        this.render();
      }
    };
  }

  get links() {
    return this._links;
  }

  set links(value) {
    this._links = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get menus() {
    return this._menus;
  }

  set menus(value) {
    this._menus = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get brand() {
    return this.getAttribute('brand') || '';
  }

  get ctaText() {
    return this.getAttribute('cta-text') || '';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this._boundDocMouseDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this._boundDocKeyDown);
    this.render();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this._boundDocMouseDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this._boundDocKeyDown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _menuButton(menu) {
    const open = this._openMenu === menu.id;
    return `<button type="button" data-nav-menu="${escapeAttribute(menu.id)}" aria-expanded="${open}" aria-haspopup="true"
      class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
        open
          ? 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50'
          : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      }">
      ${escapeAttribute(menu.label)}
      <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400 ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''} transition-transform duration-200 inline-flex">${uiIcon('chevron-down', { size: 12 })}</span>
    </button>`;
  }

  _menuPanel(menu) {
    if (this._openMenu !== menu.id) return '';
    const columns = menu.columns
      .map(
        (column, columnIndex) => `<div class="min-w-36 space-y-1">
          ${column.heading ? `<p class="px-2 pb-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(column.heading)}</p>` : ''}
          ${column.links
            .map(
              (link) => `<a href="${escapeAttribute(isSafeHref(link.href) ? link.href : '#')}" class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">
                ${link.icon ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon(link.icon, { size: 13 })}</span>` : ''}
                <span class="flex-1">${escapeAttribute(link.label)}</span>
                ${
                  link.badge != null
                    ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">${escapeAttribute(link.badge)}</span>`
                    : ''
                }
              </a>`
            )
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      )
      .join('');
    return `<div class="absolute left-0 top-full z-30 mt-2 flex gap-6 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">${columns}</div>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('relative block');
    const menus = this._menus
      .map((menu) => `<div class="relative">${this._menuButton(menu)}${this._menuPanel(menu)}</div>`)
      .join('');
    const links = this._links
      .map(
        (link) => `<a href="${escapeAttribute(isSafeHref(link.href) ? link.href : '#')}" class="rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(link.label)}</a>`
      )
      .join('');
    const cta = this.ctaText
      ? `<button type="button" data-nav-cta class="rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(this.ctaText)}</button>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<nav class="flex items-center gap-6 border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <span class="text-sm font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.brand)}</span>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1">${menus}${links}</div>
      <div class="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">${cta}</div>
    </nav>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-nav-menu]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = node.getAttribute('data-nav-menu');
        this._openMenu = this._openMenu === id ? null : id;
        this.render();
      });
    });
    const ctaButton = this.querySelector('[data-nav-cta]');
    if (ctaButton) {
      ctaButton.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cta')));
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('nav-bar')) {
  customElements.define('nav-bar', NavbarElement);
}
export default NavbarElement;

/**
 * NoResultsState - Search no-results empty state: illustration slot, the
 * original query in quotes, suggestion chips that re-run the search and a
 * clear-filters ghost action (search zero-results pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class NoResultsStateElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['query', 'suggestions', 'clear-label', 'did-you-mean-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._query = '';
    this._suggestions = [];
    this._clearLabel = 'Clear all filters';
    this._didYouMeanLabel = 'Did you mean';
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const q = this.getAttribute('query');
    if (q !== null) this._query = q;
    this._suggestions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('suggestions'), []);
    const c = this.getAttribute('clear-label');
    if (c) this._clearLabel = c;
    const d = this.getAttribute('did-you-mean-label');
    if (d) this._didYouMeanLabel = d;
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'query') this._query = newValue ?? '';
    if (name === 'suggestions') this._suggestions = parseJsonAttr(newValue, []);
    if (name === 'clear-label') this._clearLabel = newValue || 'Clear all filters';
    if (name === 'did-you-mean-label') this._didYouMeanLabel = newValue || 'Did you mean';
    this._render();
  }

  get suggestions() { return this._suggestions; }
  set suggestions(value) { this._suggestions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const chip = event.target.closest('[data-noresults-suggestion]');
    if (chip) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('suggestion', { detail: { suggestion: chip.getAttribute('data-noresults-suggestion') }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-noresults-clear]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('clear-filters', { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const suggestions = Array.isArray(this._suggestions) ? this._suggestions : [];
    const slotted = this.querySelector('[data-noresults-illustration-slot]');
    const slotHtml = slotted ? slotted.outerHTML : `<div data-noresults-illustration aria-hidden="true" class="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 text-3xl dark:bg-zinc-800">🔍</div>`;

    const queryHtml = this._query
      ? ` <span data-noresults-query class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">“${escapeAttribute(this._query)}”</span>`
      : '';

    const suggestionsHtml = suggestions.length
      ? `<div data-noresults-suggestions class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <span class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(this._didYouMeanLabel)}</span>
          ${suggestions.map((s) => `<button type="button" data-noresults-suggestion="${escapeAttribute(s)}" class="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:border-violet-300 hover:text-violet-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-violet-700 dark:hover:text-violet-400">${escapeAttribute(s)}</button>`).join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-noresults-state class="flex w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-14 text-center shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        ${slotHtml}
        <div class="space-y-1.5">
          <p data-noresults-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">No results for${queryHtml}</p>
          <p data-noresults-description class="mx-auto max-w-md text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Try a different keyword or remove some filters to widen your search.</p>
        </div>
        ${suggestionsHtml}
        <button type="button" data-noresults-clear class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(this._clearLabel)}</button>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('no-results-state')) {
  customElements.define('no-results-state', NoResultsStateElement);
}

export default NoResultsStateElement;

const TYPE_META = {
  info: { chip: 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400', icon: 'info' },
  success: { chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', icon: 'check-circle' },

/**
 * NotificationCenter - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <notification-center open></notification-center>
 * Properties: notifications (NotificationItem[])
 * Events: select (detail: item), mark-read (detail: ids[]), mark-all-read, close, open-preferences
 * Attrs: show-prefs-button — renders a gear button that emits open-preferences
 */
export class NotificationCenterElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['open', 'title', 'empty-text', 'show-filter', 'show-prefs-button'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._notifications = [];
    this._filter = 'all';
  }

  get notifications() {
    return this._notifications;
  }

  set notifications(value) {
    this._notifications = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this.hasAttribute('open')) this._filter = 'all';
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _unreadIds() {
    return this._notifications.filter((item) => item.unread).map((item) => item.id);
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    if (!this.hasAttribute('open')) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Notifications';
    const emptyText = this.getAttribute('empty-text') || "You're all caught up";
    const showFilter = this.getAttribute('show-filter') !== 'false';
    const unreadIds = this._unreadIds();
    const visible =
      this._filter === 'unread' ? this._notifications.filter((item) => item.unread) : this._notifications;

    const filterRow = showFilter
      ? `<div class="flex gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-1.5">
          ${['all', 'unread']
            .map((key) => {
              const active = this._filter === key;
              const count = key === 'all' ? this._notifications.length : unreadIds.length;
              return `<button type="button" class="notif-filter rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium capitalize transition-colors ${
                active
                  ? 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'
                  : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
              }" data-filter="${key}" aria-pressed="${active}">${key}<span class="ml-1 tabular-nums text-zinc-400">${count}</span></button>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </div>`
      : '';

    const body = visible.length
      ? `<ul class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
          ${visible
            .map((item) => {
              const meta = TYPE_META[item.type] || TYPE_META.info;
              return `<li>
                <button type="button" class="notif-item flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50" data-id="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}">
                  <span class="mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${meta.chip}">${uiIcon(item.icon || meta.icon, { size: 13 })}</span>
                  <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span class="truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</span>
                      ${item.unread ? '<span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-indigo-500" aria-label="Unread"></span>' : ''}
                    </span>
                    ${item.description ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.description)}</span>` : ''}
                    ${item.time ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(item.time)}</span>` : ''}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </li>`;
            })
            .join('')}
        </ul>`
      : `<div class="px-3 py-8 text-center">
          <span class="mx-auto mb-1.5 block text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check-circle', { size: 20 })}</span>
          <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(emptyText)}</p>
        </div>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="w-full max-w-sm overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg" role="region" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-3 py-2.5">
          <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('bell', { size: 14 })}</span>
          <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h3>
          ${
            unreadIds.length
              ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-indigo-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-400">${unreadIds.length} new</span>`
              : ''
          }
          ${this.hasAttribute('show-prefs-button') ? `<button type="button" class="notif-prefs rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Notification preferences">${uiIcon('settings', { size: 12 })}</button>` : ''}
          <button type="button" class="notif-mark-all ml-auto text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:disabled:text-zinc-600" ${unreadIds.length ? '' : 'disabled'}>Mark all read</button>
          <button type="button" class="notif-close rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200" aria-label="Close notifications">${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}</button>
        </div>
        ${filterRow}
        <div class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">${body}</div>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('.notif-filter').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._filter = button.getAttribute('data-filter');
        this.render();
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('.notif-item').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-id');
        const item = this._notifications.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (!item) return;
        if (item.unread) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mark-read', { detail: [item.id] }));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: item }));
      });
    });

    const markAll = this.querySelector('.notif-mark-all');
    markAll.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!this._unreadIds().length) return;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mark-all-read'));
    });

    const prefsBtn = this.querySelector('.notif-prefs');
    if (prefsBtn) {
      prefsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-preferences', { bubbles: true }));
      });
    }

    this.querySelector('.notif-close').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
    });
  }
}

===== FILE: vanilla\NotificationPrefsMatrix.js =====

/**
 * NotificationPrefsMatrix - Notification preference matrix: rows are event
 * types, columns are channels (In-app / Email / Push) rendered as
 * checkboxes, with per-row channel quick toggles (notification settings
 * pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_EVENTS = () => [
  { id: 'mentions', label: 'Mentions & replies', channels: { inapp: true, email: true, push: false } },
  { id: 'assigns', label: 'Assigned to me', channels: { inapp: true, email: false, push: true } },
  { id: 'comments', label: 'Thread comments', channels: { inapp: true, email: true, push: false } },
  { id: 'digest', label: 'Weekly digest', channels: { inapp: false, email: true, push: false } },
];

const CHANNELS = [
  { key: 'inapp', label: 'In-app' },
  { key: 'email', label: 'Email' },
  { key: 'push', label: 'Push' },
];

class NotificationPrefsMatrixElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description', 'events', 'columns'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._title = 'Notification preferences';
    this._description = 'Choose which events reach you and through which channels.';
    this._events = DEFAULT_EVENTS();
    this._columns = CHANNELS;
    this._onChange = this._onChange.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const t = this.getAttribute('title');
    if (t) this._title = t;
    const d = this.getAttribute('description');
    if (d) this._description = d;
    this._events = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('events'), DEFAULT_EVENTS());
    const cols = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('columns'), null);
    if (Array.isArray(cols) && cols.length) this._columns = cols;
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('change', this._onChange);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('change', this._onChange);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'Notification preferences';
    if (name === 'description') this._description = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'events') this._events = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_EVENTS());
    this._render();
  }

  get events() { return this._events; }
  set events(value) { this._events = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onChange(event) {
    const box = event.target.closest('input[data-pref-cell]');
    if (!box) return;
    const [eventId, channel] = String(box.getAttribute('data-pref-cell')).split('|');
    const row = this._events.find((ev) => ev.id === eventId);
    if (row && row.channels) {
      row.channels[channel] = box.checked;
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pref-change', {
        detail: { event: row, channel, enabled: box.checked },
        bubbles: true,
      }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const events = Array.isArray(this._events) ? this._events : [];
    const headCells = this._columns
      .map((col) => `<th data-pref-col="${escapeAttribute(col.key)}" class="w-20 px-2 py-2.5 text-center font-semibold">${escapeAttribute(col.label)}</th>`)
      .join('');

    const rowsHtml = events
      .map((ev) => {
        const cells = this._columns
          .map((col) => {
            const checked = Boolean(ev.channels && ev.channels[col.key]);
            return `<td data-pref-cell-state="${escapeAttribute(ev.id)}|${escapeAttribute(col.key)}" class="px-2 py-3 text-center">
              <input type="checkbox" data-pref-cell="${escapeAttribute(ev.id)}|${escapeAttribute(col.key)}" ${checked ? 'checked' : ''} class="h-4 w-4 accent-violet-600" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(ev.label)} via ${escapeAttribute(col.label)}" />
            </td>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return `<tr data-pref-row="${escapeAttribute(ev.id)}" class="border-b border-zinc-50 transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <td data-pref-label="${escapeAttribute(ev.label)}" class="px-5 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(ev.label)}</td>
          ${cells}
        </tr>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-pref-matrix class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-pref-header class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-pref-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <p data-pref-description class="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._description)}</p>
        </div>
        <table data-pref-table-body class="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
              <th class="px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold">Event</th>
              ${headCells}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('notification-prefs-matrix')) {
  customElements.define('notification-prefs-matrix', NotificationPrefsMatrixElement);
}

export default NotificationPrefsMatrixElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class OnboardingChecklistElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tasks', 'title'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get tasks() {
    if (this._tasks) return this._tasks;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('tasks') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set tasks(value) {
    this._tasks = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const tasks = this.tasks;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Get started';
    const total = tasks.length;
    const doneCount = tasks.filter((task) => task.done).length;
    const percent = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneCount / total) * 100);
    const allDone = total > 0 && doneCount === total;

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const items = tasks
      .map(
        (task) => `
        <li class="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3">
          <button type="button" data-toggle="${escapeAttribute(task.id)}" aria-pressed="${task.done}"
            aria-label="${task.done ? `Mark ${escapeAttribute(task.title)} as not done` : `Mark ${escapeAttribute(task.title)} as done`}"
            class="mt-0.5 flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              task.done
                ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'
                : 'border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 text-transparent hover:border-indigo-500'
            }">${uiIcon('check', { size: 10 })}</button>
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div class="text-xs ${task.done ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 line-through' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'}">${escapeAttribute(task.title)}</div>
            ${task.description ? `<div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(task.description)}</div>` : ''}
          </div>
          ${
            !task.done && task.actionText
              ? `<button type="button" data-action="${escapeAttribute(task.id)}" class="shrink-0 rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(task.actionText)}</button>`
              : ''
          }
        </li>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</span>
            <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${doneCount}/${total}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
            <div class="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-all duration-300" style="width: ${percent}%"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
            ${
              allDone
                ? `<span class="text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check-circle', { size: 12 })}</span><span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">All set — nothing left to do.</span>`
                : `<span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${percent}% complete · ${total - doneCount} left</span>`
            }
          </div>
        </div>
        <ul class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${items}</ul>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const task = tasks.find((entry) => entry.id === btn.getAttribute('data-toggle'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: task }));
      });
    });

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-action]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const task = tasks.find((entry) => entry.id === btn.getAttribute('data-action'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: task }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('onboarding-checklist')) {
  customElements.define('onboarding-checklist', OnboardingChecklistElement);
}

===== FILE: vanilla\OnboardingStepper.js =====

/**
 * OnboardingStepper - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <onboarding-stepper current="1" title="Transaction types" continue-label="Continue"></onboarding-stepper> with `steps` and `segments` properties
 * Attributes: current, title, continue-label
 * Properties: steps (string[]), segments ({ label, description, examples? }[])
 * Events: step-click (detail {index}), continue
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class OnboardingStepperElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['current', 'title', 'continue-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
    this._segments = [];
    this._activeSegment = 0;
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(String) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get segments() {
    return this._segments;
  }

  set segments(value) {
    this._segments = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._activeSegment = 0;
    this.render();
  }

  get current() {
    return Number(this.getAttribute('current')) || 0;
  }

  set current(index) {
    this.setAttribute('current', String(index));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const steps = this._steps;
    const segments = this._segments;
    const total = steps.length;
    const active = Math.min(Math.max(this.current, 0), Math.max(total - 1, 0));
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Transaction types';
    const continueLabel = this.getAttribute('continue-label') || 'Continue';
    const segment = segments[Math.min(this._activeSegment, Math.max(segments.length - 1, 0))];

    const stepHtml = steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const done = index < active;
        const isCurrent = index === active;
        return `<li class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          ${index > 0 ? '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">&gt;</span>' : ''}
          <button type="button" data-step-index="${index}" ${isCurrent ? 'aria-current="step"' : ''}
            class="rounded-md px-2 py-1 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              isCurrent
                ? 'border-b-2 border-indigo-500 font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
                : done
                  ? 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
                  : 'text-zinc-400'
            }">${escapeAttribute(step)}</button>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const segmentHtml = segments.length
      ? `<div class="mt-4">
          <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
          <div role="tablist" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}" class="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800">
            ${segments
              .map(
                (seg, index) => `<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="${index === this._activeSegment}" data-segment-index="${index}"
                  class="rounded-md px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                    index === this._activeSegment
                      ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
                      : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }">${escapeAttribute(seg.label)}</button>`,
              )
              .join('')}
          </div>
          ${
            segment
              ? `<div data-segment-description class="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <p class="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(segment.description)}</p>
                  ${
                    segment.examples?.length
                      ? `<ul class="mt-3 space-y-2">${segment.examples
                          .map(
                            (example, index) => `<li class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                              <span class="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
                                <span class="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${index + 1}</span>
                                <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(example.label)}</span>
                              </span>
                              <span class="shrink-0 font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(example.value)}</span>
                            </li>`,
                          )
                          .join('')}</ul>`
                      : ''
                  }
                </div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-onboarding-stepper class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <ol class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs" aria-label="Setup steps">${stepHtml}</ol>
      <div class="mt-2 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div data-stepper-progress class="h-full rounded-full bg-indigo-500 transition-all duration-300" style="width:${((active + 1) / total) * 100}%"></div>
      </div>
      ${segmentHtml}
      <button type="button" data-stepper-continue class="mt-5 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(continueLabel)}</button>
    </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step-index]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-step-index'));
        if (typeof this.onStepClick === 'function') this.onStepClick(index);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('step-click', { detail: { index } }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-segment-index]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._activeSegment = Number(button.getAttribute('data-segment-index'));
        this.render();
      });
    });
    const continueBtn = this.querySelector('[data-stepper-continue]');
    if (continueBtn) {
      continueBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (typeof this.onContinue === 'function') this.onContinue();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('continue'));
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('onboarding-stepper')) {
  customElements.define('onboarding-stepper', OnboardingStepperElement);
}
export default OnboardingStepperElement;

/**
 * OrderCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <order-card order-number="200013316005821" status="shipped" placed-at="May 12" total="$24.98"></order-card>
 * Attributes: order-number, placed-at, status (placed|preparing|shipped|delivered|on-hold|canceled),
 *             fulfillment (JSON {type, eta?, store?}), items (JSON), total, status-note
 * Events: open, action (detail {action})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({

const STATUS_TONE = {

  preparing: { label: 'Preparing', badge: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300' },
