};

const FULFILLMENT_LABEL = {
  delivery: 'Arrives',
  pickup: 'Ready for pickup',
  curbside: 'Curbside ready',
};

export class OrderCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['order-number', 'placed-at', 'status', 'fulfillment', 'items', 'total', 'status-note'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._items = [];
    this._fulfillment = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._items.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('items');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._items = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._items = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._fulfillment) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('fulfillment');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._fulfillment = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._fulfillment = null; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-order-open]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open'));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-order-buy-again]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { action: 'buy-again' } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'items') {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('items');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._items = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._items = []; }
      }
    }
    if (name === 'fulfillment') {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('fulfillment');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._fulfillment = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._fulfillment = null; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
  }

  get items() {
    return this._items;
  }

  set items(value) {
    this._items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const orderNumber = this.getAttribute('order-number') || '';
    const placedAt = this.getAttribute('placed-at') || '';
    const status = this.getAttribute('status') || 'placed';
    const total = this.getAttribute('total') || '';
    const statusNote = this.getAttribute('status-note') || '';
    const tone = STATUS_TONE[status] || STATUS_TONE.placed;
    const canceled = status === 'canceled';
    const fulfillment = this._fulfillment || {};

    const itemsHtml = this._items.length
      ? `<ul data-order-items class="mt-3 space-y-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">${this._items
          .map((item) => {
            const thumb = item.image
              ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(item.image)}" alt="" class="h-10 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg object-cover" />`
              : '<span class="h-10 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></span>';
            return `<li data-order-item="${escapeAttribute(item.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-3">
              ${thumb}
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span class="block truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</span>
                ${item.qty != null ? `<span class="block text-[11px] text-zinc-400">Qty: ${item.qty}</span>` : ''}
              </span>
              ${item.price ? `<span class="shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(item.price)}</span>` : ''}
            </li>`;
          })
          .join('')}</ul>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-order-card class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-2.5 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">

        <button type="button" data-order-open class="shrink-0 rounded-full border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">View details</button>
      </div>
      <div class="p-4">
        <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div class="min-w-0">
            ${canceled
              ? `<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Canceled${fulfillment && fulfillment.eta ? ` on ${escapeAttribute(fulfillment.eta)}` : ''}</p>`
              : `<p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${fulfillment ? FULFILLMENT_LABEL[fulfillment.type] || 'Fulfilled' : 'Fulfilled'}${fulfillment && fulfillment.eta ? ` by ${escapeAttribute(fulfillment.eta)}` : ''}</p>`}
            ${fulfillment && fulfillment.store ? `<p class="mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3 w-3"><path d="M12 21s7-5.5 7-11a7 7 0 1 0-14 0c0 5.5 7 11 7 11Z" /><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5" /></svg>${escapeAttribute(fulfillment.store)}</p>` : ''}
            ${statusNote ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(statusNote)}</p>` : ''}
          </div>
          <span data-order-status class="shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${tone.badge}">${tone.label}</span>
        </div>
        ${itemsHtml}
        <div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button type="button" data-order-buy-again class="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">Buy it again</button>
          ${total ? `<p class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">Total ${escapeAttribute(total)}</p>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }

/**
 * OrderSummaryPanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <order-summary rows='[...]' cta-label="Place your order" cta-amount="$6.53"></order-summary>
 * Attributes: rows (JSON [{id,label,value,kind?,strikeValue?,note?}]), heading, cta-label, cta-amount,
 *             promo-placeholder, applied-promos (JSON), trust-footer
 * Events: cta, apply-promo (detail {code}), remove-promo (detail {code})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const KIND_TONE = {
  discount: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
  fee: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
  total: 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50',
};

export class OrderSummaryPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['rows', 'heading', 'cta-label', 'cta-amount', 'promo-placeholder', 'applied-promos', 'trust-footer'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._rows = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._rows.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('rows');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._rows = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._rows = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-summary-cta]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cta'));
          return;
        }
        const remove = event.target.closest('[data-promo-remove]');
        if (remove) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove-promo', { detail: { code: remove.getAttribute('data-promo-remove') } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-promo-apply]')) {
          const input = this.querySelector('[data-promo-input]');
          const code = input ? input.value.trim() : '';
          if (!code) return;
          if (input) input.value = '';
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apply-promo', { detail: { code } }));
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'Enter' && event.target && event.target.hasAttribute && event.target.hasAttribute('data-promo-input')) {
          const code = event.target.value.trim();
          if (!code) return;
          event.target.value = '';
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apply-promo', { detail: { code } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get rows() {
    return this._rows;
  }

  set rows(value) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  appliedPromosResolved() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('applied-promos');
    if (!raw) return [];
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const heading = this.getAttribute('heading') || 'Order summary';
    const ctaLabel = this.getAttribute('cta-label') || 'Place your order';
    const ctaAmount = this.getAttribute('cta-amount') || '';
    const promoPlaceholder = this.getAttribute('promo-placeholder') || 'Add a promo code';
    const trustFooter = this.getAttribute('trust-footer') || '';
    const promos = this.appliedPromosResolved();
    const rowsHtml = this._rows
      .map((row, index) => {
        const isTotal = row.kind === 'total';
        const labelCls = isTotal ? 'font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50' : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400';
        const valueCls = KIND_TONE[row.kind || ''] || 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200';
        const strike = row.strikeValue ? `<span class="mr-1.5 font-normal text-zinc-400 line-through">${escapeAttribute(row.strikeValue)}</span>` : '';
        const note = row.note ? `<span class="ml-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">(${escapeAttribute(row.note)})</span>` : '';
        const totalBorder = isTotal ? 'border-t border-zinc-200 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-700' : '';
        return `<li data-summary-row="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}" class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 ${totalBorder}">
          <span class="text-xs ${labelCls}">${escapeAttribute(row.label)}${note}</span>
          <span class="shrink-0 text-xs font-medium ${valueCls}">${strike}${escapeAttribute(row.value)}</span>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');
    const promosHtml = promos.length
      ? `<ul class="mb-2 space-y-1">${promos
          .map(
            (promo) => `<li data-promo-applied class="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 dark:bg-emerald-950/40">
              <span class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">${escapeAttribute(promo)} applied</span>
              <button type="button" data-promo-remove="${escapeAttribute(promo)}" aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(promo)}" class="text-[11px] text-emerald-600 hover:underline dark:text-emerald-400">Remove</button>
            </li>`,
          )
          .join('')}</ul>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-order-summary class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(heading)}</p>
      <ul class="mt-3 space-y-2">${rowsHtml}</ul>
      <div data-promo-block class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
        ${promosHtml}
        <div class="flex gap-1.5">
          <input type="text" data-promo-input placeholder="${escapeAttribute(promoPlaceholder)}" class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-800 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100" />
          <button type="button" data-promo-apply class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Apply</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" data-summary-cta class="mt-3 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white">${escapeAttribute(ctaLabel)}${ctaAmount ? ` · ${escapeAttribute(ctaAmount)}` : ''}</button>
      ${trustFooter ? `<p data-trust-footer class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3 w-3"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2" /><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4" /></svg>${escapeAttribute(trustFooter)}</p>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('order-summary')) {
  customElements.define('order-summary', OrderSummaryPanelElement);

/**
 * OrderTracker - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <order-tracker stages='[...]' current="1" eta="Arrives by Sat, May 24"></order-tracker>
 * Attributes: stages (JSON [{id,label,timestamp?}]), current (number index or "canceled"), variant (dots|bar),
 *             eta, tracking-number, tracking-url, canceled-reason
 * Events: track
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CHECK_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="3" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>';

export class OrderTrackerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['stages', 'current', 'variant', 'eta', 'tracking-number', 'tracking-url', 'canceled-reason'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._stages = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._stages.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('stages');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._stages = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._stages = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-tracker-track]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('track'));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get stages() {
    return this._stages;
  }

  set stages(value) {
    this._stages = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  currentIndex() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('current');
    if (raw === 'canceled') return -1;
    const n = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : -1;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'dots';
    const eta = this.getAttribute('eta') || '';
    const trackingNumber = this.getAttribute('tracking-number') || '';
    const trackingUrl = this.getAttribute('tracking-url') || '';
    const canceledReason = this.getAttribute('canceled-reason') || '';
    const canceled = this.currentIndex() === -1;
    const current = this.currentIndex();
    const progress = canceled ? 0 : Math.round(((current + 1) / Math.max(this._stages.length, 1)) * 100);

    if (variant === 'bar') {
      const stageLabels = this._stages
        .map((stage, index) => {
          const reached = !canceled && index <= current;
          const isCurrent = !canceled && index === current;
          const cls = isCurrent
            ? 'font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
            : reached
              ? 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
              : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600';
          return `<span data-tracker-stage="${escapeAttribute(stage.id)}" class="text-[10px] font-medium ${cls}">${escapeAttribute(stage.label)}</span>`;
        })
        .join('');
      this.innerHTML = `<div data-order-tracker class="w-full">
        <div class="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div data-tracker-fill="true" class="h-full rounded-full transition-all ${canceled ? 'bg-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-600' : 'bg-emerald-600'}" style="width:${progress}%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-2 flex justify-between">${stageLabels}</div>
        ${canceled && canceledReason ? `<p class="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(canceledReason)}</p>` : ''}
      </div>`;
      return;
    }

    const stagesHtml = this._stages
      .map((stage, index) => {
        const reached = !canceled && index <= current;
        const isCurrent = !canceled && index === current;
        const last = index === this._stages.length - 1;
        const dotCls = `${isCurrent ? 'ring-2 ring-zinc-900 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-white dark:ring-zinc-100 dark:ring-offset-zinc-900' : ''} ${reached ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700'}`;
        const labelCls = isCurrent
          ? 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
          : reached
            ? 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
            : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600';
        const connector = last
          ? ''
          : `<span class="mx-1 mt-2 h-0.5 flex-1 ${reached && index < current ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700'}"></span>`;
        return `<li data-tracker-stage="${escapeAttribute(stage.id)}" class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start">
          <span class="flex flex-col items-center">
            <span class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${dotCls}">${reached ? CHECK_SVG : ''}</span>
            <span class="mt-1 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] font-medium ${labelCls}">${escapeAttribute(stage.label)}</span>
            ${stage.timestamp ? `<span class="text-[9px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600">${escapeAttribute(stage.timestamp)}</span>` : ''}
          </span>
          ${connector}
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-order-tracker class="w-full">
      ${eta && !canceled ? `<p class="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(eta)}${trackingNumber ? `<span class="ml-2 font-normal text-zinc-400">· ${escapeAttribute(trackingNumber)}</span>` : ''}</p>` : ''}
      ${canceled ? `<p class="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Canceled${canceledReason ? ` — ${escapeAttribute(canceledReason)}` : ''}</p>` : ''}
      <ol class="flex items-start">${stagesHtml}</ol>
      ${trackingUrl ? '<button type="button" data-tracker-track class="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">Track shipment &gt;</button>' : ''}
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('order-tracker')) {
  customElements.define('order-tracker', OrderTrackerElement);
}

export default OrderTrackerElement;

/**
 * OtpInput - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <otp-input heading="Check your email for a code" status="idle|error"></otp-input>
 * Attributes: heading, subtext, status (idle|error), error-text, continue-label, resend-hint, length
 * Properties: value (string)
 * Events: change (detail {value}), complete (detail {value}), continue, resend
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class OtpInputElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['heading', 'subtext', 'status', 'error-text', 'continue-label', 'resend-hint', 'length'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._value = '';
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get value() {
    return this._value;
  }

  set value(text) {

  }

      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {

        if (event.target.closest('[data-otp-resend]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('resend'));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const length = Number(this.getAttribute('length')) || 6;
    const heading = this.getAttribute('heading') || '';
    const subtext = this.getAttribute('subtext') || '';
    const errored = this.getAttribute('status') === 'error';
    const errorText = this.getAttribute('error-text') || '';
    const continueLabel = this.getAttribute('continue-label') || 'Continue';
    const resendHint = this.getAttribute('resend-hint') || '';
    const chars = Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => this._value[i] ?? '');

    const cellClass = (filled) =>
      `h-12 w-11 rounded-lg border text-center text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
        errored
          ? 'border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/60 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-500/70 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-200'
          : filled
            ? 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50'
            : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-400 placeholder:text-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-500'
      }`;

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-otp-input class="w-full max-w-sm">
      ${heading ? `<h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(heading)}</h2>` : ''}
      ${subtext ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(subtext)}</p>` : ''}
      <div data-otp-cells class="flex gap-1.5${heading || subtext ? ' mt-4' : ''}">
        ${chars
          .map(
            (char, index) => `<input type="text" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" value="${escapeAttribute(char)}" aria-label="Digit ${index + 1}" data-otp-cell="${index}" class="${cellClass(Boolean(char))}" />`,
          )
          .join('')}
      </div>
      ${errored && errorText ? `<p data-otp-error class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">${uiIcon('alert-triangle', { size: 14 })}${escapeAttribute(errorText)}</p>` : ''}
      <button type="button" data-otp-continue class="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(continueLabel)}</button>
      ${resendHint ? `<p class="mt-3 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"><a href="#" data-otp-resend class="font-medium text-indigo-600 underline-offset-2 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">Resend code</a> · ${escapeAttribute(resendHint)}</p>` : ''}
    </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-otp-cell]').forEach((cell, index) => {
      cell.addEventListener('input', () => {
        const char = cell.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-1);
        if (!char) return;
        const digits = chars.slice();
        digits[index] = char;
        this._value = digits.join('').slice(0, length);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { value: this._value } }));
        if (this._value.length >= length) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('complete', { detail: { value: this._value } }));
        this.render();
        const next = this.querySelectorAll('[data-otp-cell]')[Math.min(index + 1, length - 1)];
        if (next) next.focus();
      });
      cell.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key !== 'Backspace') return;
        event.preventDefault();
        if (chars[index]) {
          const digits = chars.slice();
          digits[index] = '';
          this._value = digits.join('').slice(0, length);
        } else if (index > 0) {
          const digits = chars.slice();
          digits[index - 1] = '';
          this._value = digits.join('').slice(0, length);
          this.render();
          const prev = this.querySelectorAll('[data-otp-cell]')[index - 1];
          if (prev) prev.focus();
          return;
        }
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { value: this._value } }));
        this.render();
      });
      cell.addEventListener('paste', (event) => {
        const pasted = (event.clipboardData?.getData('text') || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, length);
        if (pasted.length > 1) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this._value = pasted;
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { value: this._value } }));
          if (this._value.length >= length) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('complete', { detail: { value: this._value } }));
          this.render();
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('otp-input')) {
  customElements.define('otp-input', OtpInputElement);
}
export default OtpInputElement;

/**

 * Usage: <page-header title="Acme Analytics" description="…" status-text="Live" active-tab="Overview"></page-header>
 * Attributes: title, description, status-text, active-tab

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const ACTION_VARIANT = {
  primary: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
  secondary:
    'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800',
  ghost:
    'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200',

const parseJsonAttr = (raw) => {
  if (!raw) return [];
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

export class PageHeaderElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description', 'status-text', 'active-tab'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._actions = null;
    this._tabs = null;
  }

  get actions() {
    return this._actions ?? parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('actions'));
  }

  set actions(value) {
    this._actions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get tabs() {
    return this._tabs ?? parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('tabs'));
  }

  set tabs(value) {
    this._tabs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const description = this.getAttribute('description') || '';
    const statusText = this.getAttribute('status-text') || '';
    const actions = this.actions;
    const tabs = this.tabs;
    const activeTab = this.getAttribute('active-tab') ?? '';

    this.innerHTML = `<header data-page-header class="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div class="min-w-0">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h2 class="truncate text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
            ${
              statusText
                ? `<span class="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"><span aria-hidden="true" class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>${escapeAttribute(statusText)}</span>`
                : ''
            }
          </div>
          ${description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 max-w-2xl text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>` : ''}
        </div>
        ${
          actions.length
            ? `<div class="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-2">${actions
                .map(
                  (action) => `<button type="button" data-action-label="${escapeAttribute(action.label)}"
                    class="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 ${ACTION_VARIANT[action.variant || 'secondary']}">

                      : 'border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
                  }">
                  ${escapeAttribute(tab.label)}
                  ${
                    tab.count !== undefined
                      ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-px font-mono text-[9.5px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tab.count)}</span>`
                      : ''

              .join('')}</nav>`
          : ''

    </header>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-action-label]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const label = button.getAttribute('data-action-label');
        const action = actions.find((item) => item.label === label) || { label, variant: 'secondary' };

        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tab-change', { detail: { label, count: tab.count } }));
      });
    });
  }

===== FILE: vanilla\Pagination.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const BASE =
  'inline-flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40';
const EDGE_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';

export const paginationSlots = (page, pageCount, siblingCount = 1) => {
  if (pageCount <= 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set([1, pageCount, page]);
  for (let offset = 1; offset <= siblingCount; offset += 1) {
    seen.add(page - offset);
    seen.add(page + offset);
  }
  const sorted = Array.from(seen)
    .filter((entry) => entry >= 1 && entry <= pageCount)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const slots = [];
  let previous = 0;
  for (const entry of sorted) {
    if (previous > 0 && entry - previous > 1) slots.push('gap');
    slots.push(entry);
    previous = entry;
  }
  return slots;
};

/**
 * Pagination - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <pagination-bar page="3" page-count="12"></pagination-bar>
 * Properties: page, pageCount
 * Attributes: page, page-count, sibling-count, show-edges, aria-label
 * Events: change (detail: { page })
 */
export class PaginationElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['page', 'page-count', 'sibling-count', 'show-edges', 'aria-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._page = null;
    this._pageCount = null;
  }

  get page() {
    const value = Number(this._page ?? this.getAttribute('page'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 1;
  }

  set page(value) {
    this._page = value;
    this.render();
  }

  get pageCount() {
    const value = Number(this._pageCount ?? this.getAttribute('page-count'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 0;
  }

  set pageCount(value) {
    this._pageCount = value;
    this.render();
  }

  get siblingCount() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('sibling-count');
    if (raw === null) return 1;
    const value = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 1;
  }

  get showEdges() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('show-edges');
    return raw !== 'false';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _go(next) {
    if (next < 1 || next > this.pageCount || next === this.page) return;
    this._page = next;
    this.setAttribute('page', String(next));
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { page: next } }));
  }

  _edgeButton(target, label, icon, disabled) {
    return `<button type="button" data-page="${target}" aria-label="${label}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} class="${BASE} ${EDGE_CLASS}">${uiIcon(icon, { size: 13 })}</button>`;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex items-center gap-1');
    const page = this.page;
    const pageCount = this.pageCount;
    const slots = paginationSlots(page, pageCount, this.siblingCount);
    const ariaLabel = this.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Pagination';

    const numbers = slots
      .map((slot, index) => {
        if (slot === 'gap') {
          return `<span aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">…</span>`;
        }
        const active = slot === page;
        return `<button type="button" data-page="${slot}" aria-label="Page ${slot}" ${active ? 'aria-current="page"' : ''}
          class="${BASE} tabular-nums ${active ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : EDGE_CLASS}">${slot}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const edges = this.showEdges
      ? this._edgeButton(1, 'First page', 'chevron-left', page <= 1)
      : '';
    const tail = this.showEdges
      ? this._edgeButton(pageCount, 'Last page', 'chevron-right', page >= pageCount)
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<nav aria-label="${escapeAttribute(ariaLabel)}" class="flex items-center gap-1">${edges}${this._edgeButton(page - 1, 'Previous page', 'chevron-left', page <= 1)}${numbers}${this._edgeButton(page + 1, 'Next page', 'chevron-right', page >= pageCount)}${tail}</nav>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach((node) => {
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._go(Number(node.getAttribute('data-page'))));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('pagination-bar')) {
  customElements.define('pagination-bar', PaginationElement);
}
export default PaginationElement;

          ${exp ? `<p class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">Exp. ${escapeAttribute(exp)}</p>` : ''}
        </div>
        <button type="button" data-payment-change class="shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(changeLabel)}</button>

        <p class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(holder)}</p>
      </div>` : ''}

/**
 * PermissionDeniedState - Permission-restricted empty state: lock
 * illustration slot, title/description, Request access primary CTA and an
 * optional contact-admin secondary link (permission denied pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

class PermissionDeniedStateElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description', 'cta-label', 'contact-label', 'contact-href'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._title = 'You don’t have access to this page';
    this._description = 'This space is restricted. Request access and a workspace admin will review your request.';
    this._ctaLabel = 'Request access';
    this._contactLabel = 'or contact a workspace admin';
    this._contactHref = '#';
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const t = this.getAttribute('title');
    if (t) this._title = t;
    const d = this.getAttribute('description');
    if (d) this._description = d;
    const c = this.getAttribute('cta-label');
    if (c) this._ctaLabel = c;
    const cl = this.getAttribute('contact-label');
    if (cl) this._contactLabel = cl;
    const ch = this.getAttribute('contact-href');
    if (ch) this._contactHref = ch;
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'You don’t have access to this page';
    if (name === 'description') this._description = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'cta-label') this._ctaLabel = newValue || 'Request access';
    if (name === 'contact-label') this._contactLabel = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'contact-href') this._contactHref = newValue || '#';
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-denied-cta]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('request-access', { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    // Keep any illustration/slot content provided by the host page.
    const slotted = this.querySelector('[data-denied-illustration-slot]');
    const slotHtml = slotted ? slotted.outerHTML : `<div data-denied-illustration aria-hidden="true" class="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 text-3xl dark:bg-zinc-800">🔒</div>`;

    const contactHtml = this._contactLabel
      ? `<a data-denied-contact href="${escapeAttribute(this._contactHref)}" class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 underline-offset-2 hover:underline dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._contactLabel)}</a>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-denied-state class="flex w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-14 text-center shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        ${slotHtml}
        <div class="space-y-1.5">
          <p data-denied-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <p data-denied-description class="mx-auto max-w-md text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._description)}</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" data-denied-cta class="rounded-lg bg-violet-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-violet-500">${escapeAttribute(this._ctaLabel)}</button>
        ${contactHtml}
      </div>`;
  }
}

===== FILE: vanilla\PermissionMatrix.js =====

/**
 * PermissionMatrix - Roles × permissions matrix: heading with description,
 * Overview / Permission details tabs, grouped permission rows and per-role
 * cells with Edit / View only / No access / N/A states (Vanta pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_ROLES = () => ['Editor', 'Auditor', 'View only admin', 'Sales admin'];

const DEFAULT_GROUPS = () => [
  {
    id: 'employee',
    title: 'Employee Experience',
    rows: [
      { id: 'onboarding', label: 'Can complete new hire onboarding tasks', cells: ['edit', 'na', 'edit', 'edit'] },
      { id: 'personal', label: 'Can update personal settings', cells: ['edit', 'edit', 'edit', 'edit'] },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'apps',
    title: 'Connected apps',
    rows: [
      { id: 'integrations', label: 'Integrations', cells: ['edit', 'none', 'view', 'none'] },
      { id: 'tokens', label: 'API Tokens', cells: ['none', 'none', 'view', 'none'] },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'compliance',
    title: 'Compliance pages',
    rows: [
      { id: 'tests', label: 'Tests & Documents', cells: ['edit', 'view', 'view', 'none'] },
      { id: 'frameworks', label: 'Frameworks & Controls', cells: ['edit', 'view', 'view', 'none'] },
      { id: 'policies', label: 'Policies', cells: ['edit', 'view', 'view', 'none'] },
    ],
  },
];

const STATE_META = {
  edit: { label: 'Edit', icon: '✔', cls: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  view: { label: 'View only', icon: '👁', cls: 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300' },
  none: { label: 'No access', icon: '✖', cls: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' },
  na: { label: 'N / A', icon: '', cls: 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' },
};

class PermissionMatrixElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description', 'roles', 'groups'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._tab = 'details';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const tabBtn = event.target.closest('[data-permmtx-tab]');
    if (tabBtn) {
      this._tab = tabBtn.getAttribute('data-permmtx-tab');
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    const cell = event.target.closest('[data-permmtx-cell]');
    if (cell) {
      const roles = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('roles'), DEFAULT_ROLES());
      const groups = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('groups'), DEFAULT_GROUPS());
      const cellKey = cell.getAttribute('data-permmtx-cell') || '';
      const [rowId, role] = cellKey.split(':');
      const state = cell.getAttribute('data-permmtx-state') || 'na';
      let foundRow = null;
      for (const g of groups) {
        const r = g.rows.find((row) => row.id === rowId);
        if (r) {
          foundRow = r;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (foundRow) {
        this.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('cell-click', { detail: { row: foundRow, role, state, roleIndex: roles.indexOf(role) }, bubbles: true })
        );
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Roles';
    const description =
      this.getAttribute('description') ||
      'Roles are bundles of permissions related to managing your security and compliance program. They ensure that team members have access to only what they need to complete their work.';
    const roles = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('roles'), DEFAULT_ROLES());
    const groups = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('groups'), DEFAULT_GROUPS());

    const roleHeads = roles
      .map((r) => `<th data-permmtx-role="${escapeAttribute(r)}" class="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 text-center font-semibold">${escapeAttribute(r)}</th>`)
      .join('');

    const bodyRows = groups
      .map((g) => {
        const groupRow = `<tr data-permmtx-group="${escapeAttribute(g.id)}" class="border-b border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/50">
            <td colspan="${roles.length + 1}" class="px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(g.title)}</td>
          </tr>`;
        const rows = g.rows
          .map((row) => {
            const cells = row.cells
              .map((state, i) => {
                const meta = STATE_META[state] ?? STATE_META.na;
                return `<td class="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                    <button type="button" data-permmtx-cell="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}:${escapeAttribute(roles[i] ?? '')}" data-permmtx-state="${escapeAttribute(state)}"
                      class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-opacity hover:opacity-70 ${meta.cls}">
                      ${meta.icon ? `<span aria-hidden="true">${meta.icon}</span>` : ''}<span>${meta.label}</span>
                    </button>
                  </td>`;
              })
              .join('');
            return `<tr data-permmtx-row="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}" class="border-b border-zinc-100 last:border-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(row.label)}</td>
                ${cells}
              </tr>`;
          })
          .join('');
        return groupRow + rows;
      })
      .join('');

    const tableHtml =
      this._tab === 'details'
        ? `<div data-permmtx-table class="mt-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <table class="w-full text-left text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr class="border-b border-zinc-200 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
                  <th class="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Actions</th>
                  ${roleHeads}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>${bodyRows}</tbody>
            </table>
          </div>`
        : `<div data-permmtx-overview class="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <p class="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${roles.length} roles · ${groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.rows.length, 0)} permission rules configured.</p>
          </div>`;

    const tabBtn = (t, label) =>
      `<button data-permmtx-tab="${t}" type="button" class="-mb-px border-b-2 pb-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
        this._tab === t ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
      }">${label}</button>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-permmtx class="w-full rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 sm:p-6">
        <h2 data-permmtx-title class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
        <p data-permmtx-description class="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(description)}</p>
        <div data-permmtx-tabs class="mt-4 flex gap-6 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
          ${tabBtn('overview', 'Overview')}
          ${tabBtn('details', 'Permission details')}
        </div>
        ${tableHtml}
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('permission-matrix')) {
  customElements.define('permission-matrix', PermissionMatrixElement);
}

export default PermissionMatrixElement;

/**
 * PersonaPresetGrid - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <persona-preset-grid title="Persona presets"></persona-preset-grid>
 * Property: presets ([{id, name, description?, emoji?, temperature?, selected?}])
 * Attributes: title
 * Events: select (detail {preset})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class PersonaPresetGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._presets = [];
    this._bound = false;
    this._gradients = [
      'from-indigo-500 to-purple-500',
      'from-sky-500 to-cyan-400',
      'from-amber-400 to-orange-500',
      'from-emerald-400 to-teal-500',
      'from-rose-400 to-pink-500',
      'from-violet-500 to-fuchsia-500',
    ];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const card = event.target.closest('[data-persona-card]');
        if (card) {
          const preset = this._presets.find((p) => p.id === card.getAttribute('data-persona-card'));
          if (preset) {
            // update selection locally so re-render moves the ring
            this._presets = this._presets.map((p) => ({ ...p, selected: p.id === preset.id }));
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { preset } }));
            this.render();
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get presets() { return this._presets; }
  set presets(v) {
    this._presets = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((p) => ({ ...p })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before presets are captured.
    if (this._presets.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Persona presets');

    const cards = this._presets.map((preset, i) => {
      const selected = !!preset.selected;
      return `
        <button type="button" data-persona-card="${escapeAttribute(preset.id)}" class="group relative rounded-lg border p-3 text-left transition-all ${selected ? 'border-indigo-500 ring-2 ring-indigo-200 dark:ring-indigo-900' : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700'}">
          ${selected ? '<span data-persona-check class="absolute right-2 top-2 flex h-4 w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" class="h-2.5 w-2.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m4.5 10.5 3.5 3.5 7.5-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" /></svg></span>' : ''}
          <span data-persona-emoji aria-hidden="true" class="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br text-lg text-white ${this._gradients[i % this._gradients.length]}">${escapeAttribute(preset.emoji || '🤖')}</span>
          <p data-persona-name class="mt-2 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(preset.name)}</p>
          ${preset.description ? `<p data-persona-desc class="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[11px] leading-snug text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(preset.description)}</p>` : ''}
          ${typeof preset.temperature === 'number' ? `<span data-persona-temp class="mt-1.5 inline-block rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">temp ${preset.temperature}</span>` : ''}
        </button>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-persona-grid class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
  <div class="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">${cards}</div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('persona-preset-grid')) {
  customElements.define('persona-preset-grid', PersonaPresetGridElement);
}

export default PersonaPresetGridElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\PipelineStageList.js =====

/**
 * PipelineStageList - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <pipeline-stage-list></pipeline-stage-list>
 * Attributes: show-duration (true|false), collapsible (true|false), expanded (JSON array of group ids)
 * Properties: groups (Array<{id, title, currentStep?, stages: [{id, label, status, durationMs?}]}
 * Events: stage-click (detail {stage}), group-toggle (detail {id, open})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STAGE_STATUS = {
  pending: { text: 'Pending', tone: 'text-zinc-400' },
  running: { text: 'Running', tone: 'text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400' },
  success: { text: 'Completed', tone: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  failed: { text: 'Failed', tone: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' },
};

const durationLabel = (ms) => {
  if (ms == null) return '';
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  if (ms < 60000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(ms % 1000 === 0 ? 0 : 1)}s`;
  return `${Math.floor(ms / 60000)}m ${Math.round((ms % 60000) / 1000)}s`;
};

export class PipelineStageListElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['show-duration', 'collapsible', 'expanded'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._groups = [];
    this._expanded = new Set();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }

  set groups(list) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get expanded() {
    return [...this._expanded];
  }

  set expanded(ids) {
    this._expanded = new Set(Array.isArray(ids) ? ids : []);
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._groups.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('groups');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._groups = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._groups = []; }
      }
    }
    if (!this._expanded.size) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('expanded');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._expanded = new Set(JSON.parse(raw)); } catch { this._expanded = new Set(); }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const header = event.target.closest('[data-pipeline-group-header]');
        if (header) {
          const groupEl = header.closest('[data-pipeline-group]');
          const id = groupEl?.getAttribute('data-pipeline-group');
          if (id && this.getAttribute('collapsible') !== 'false') {
            if (this._expanded.has(id)) this._expanded.delete(id);
            else this._expanded.add(id);
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('group-toggle', { detail: { id, open: this._expanded.has(id) } }));
            this.render();
          }
          return;
        }
        const stage = event.target.closest('[data-pipeline-stage]');
        if (stage) {
          const groupEl = stage.closest('[data-pipeline-group]');
          const group = this._groups.find((item) => item.id === groupEl?.getAttribute('data-pipeline-group'));
          const stageData = group?.stages.find((item) => item.id === stage.getAttribute('data-pipeline-stage'));
          if (stageData) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('stage-click', { detail: { stage: stageData } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const showDuration = this.getAttribute('show-duration') !== 'false';
    const collapsible = this.getAttribute('collapsible') !== 'false';
    const groups = Array.isArray(this._groups) ? this._groups : [];

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-pipeline-list class="w-full divide-y divide-zinc-200 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      ${groups
        .map((group) => {
          const open = this._expanded.has(group.id);
          const running = (group.stages || []).some((stage) => stage.status === 'running');
          const totalMs = (group.stages || []).reduce((sum, stage) => sum + (stage.durationMs || 0), 0) || undefined;
          return `<div data-pipeline-group="${escapeAttribute(group.id)}">
            <button type="button" data-pipeline-group-header class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
              ${
                running
                  ? '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 animate-spin text-sky-500"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" /></svg>'
                  : '<span class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-dashed border-zinc-400"></span>'
              }
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span class="block text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(group.title)}</span>
                ${group.currentStep ? `<span class="block truncate text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(group.currentStep)}</span>` : ''}
              </span>
              ${showDuration ? `<span class="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${durationLabel(totalMs)}</span>` : ''}
              ${collapsible ? `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform ${open ? 'rotate-90' : ''}"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" /></svg>` : ''}
            </button>
            ${
              open
                ? `<div class="mx-3 mb-3 rounded-md bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-1.5 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
                    ${(group.stages || [])
                      .map((stage) => {
                        const tone = STAGE_STATUS[stage.status] || STAGE_STATUS.pending;
                        return `<button type="button" data-pipeline-stage="${escapeAttribute(stage.id)}" data-stage-status="${escapeAttribute(stage.status)}" class="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-200 py-2 text-left last:border-b-0 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700/60">
                          <span class="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(stage.label)}</span>
                          <span class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
                            ${showDuration && stage.durationMs != null ? `<span class="text-zinc-400">${durationLabel(stage.durationMs)}</span>` : ''}
                            <span class="${tone.tone}">${tone.text}</span>
                          </span>
                        </button>`;
                      })
                      .join('')}
                  </div>`
                : ''
            }
          </div>`;
        })
        .join('')}
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('pipeline-stage-list')) {
  customElements.define('pipeline-stage-list', PipelineStageListElement);
}
export default PipelineStageListElement;

/**

 * Usage: <plan-comparison-table plans='[{"id":"free","name":"Free"}]' sections='[...]'></plan-comparison-table>
 * Attributes: plans (JSON [{id,name,highlighted?}]), sections (JSON [{id,title,rows:[{id,label,values:[{value:true|false|"note"}]}]}]), cta-text
 * Property: plans, sections
 * Events: select (detail.planId)
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CHECK_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 18a8 8 0 1 1 0-16 8 8 0 0 1 0 16Zm-1.2-5.4 5-5-1.13-1.13L8.8 10.34 7.33 8.87 6.2 10l2.6 2.6Z"/></svg>';
const MINUS_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 18a8 8 0 1 1 0-16 8 8 0 0 1 0 16ZM6.5 9.25h7v1.5h-7v-1.5Z"/></svg>';

export class PlanComparisonTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['plans', 'sections', 'cta-text'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._plans = [];
    this._sections = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._plans.length) {
      const rawPlans = this.getAttribute('plans');
      if (rawPlans) { try { this._plans = JSON.parse(rawPlans); } catch { this._plans = []; } }
    }
    if (!this._sections.length) {
      const rawSections = this.getAttribute('sections');
      if (rawSections) { try { this._sections = JSON.parse(rawSections); } catch { this._sections = []; } }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const cta = event.target.closest('[data-comparison-cta]');
        if (cta) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { planId: cta.getAttribute('data-comparison-cta') } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get plans() { return this._plans; }
  set plans(v) {
    this._plans = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get sections() { return this._sections; }
  set sections(v) {
    this._sections = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'plans' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._plans = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    if (name === 'sections' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._sections = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    if (this._plans.length) this.render();
  }

  _gridStyle(count) {
    return `grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 1.4fr) repeat(${count}, minmax(120px, 1fr));`;
  }

  _cell(value) {
    if (value === true) return `<span data-comparison-check class="text-indigo-600">${CHECK_SVG}</span>`;
    if (value === false || value === undefined) return `<span data-comparison-empty class="text-zinc-300">${MINUS_SVG}</span>`;
    return `<span data-comparison-check class="text-indigo-600">${CHECK_SVG}</span><span data-comparison-note class="text-xs text-zinc-600">${escapeAttribute(value)}</span>`;
  }

  render() {
    const plans = this._plans;
    const ctaText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('cta-text') || 'Choose plan');
    const gs = this._gridStyle(plans.length);

    const headCells = plans.map((p) => `
  <div data-comparison-plan="${escapeAttribute(p.id)}" class="border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3 ${p.highlighted ? 'bg-indigo-50/60' : ''}">
    <span class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(p.name)}</span>
  </div>`).join('');

    const body = this._sections.map((section) => `
<div data-comparison-section="${escapeAttribute(section.id)}" class="bg-zinc-900 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(section.title)}</div>
${section.rows.map((row) => `
<div data-comparison-row="${escapeAttribute(row.id)}" class="grid border-b border-zinc-100" style="${gs}">
  <div class="px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-zinc-700">${escapeAttribute(row.label)}</div>
  ${plans.map((p, idx) => `
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 ${p.highlighted ? 'bg-indigo-50/60' : ''}">${this._cell((row.values[idx] || {}).value)}</div>`).join('')}
</div>`).join('')}`).join('');

    const footCells = plans.map((p) => `
  <div class="px-4 py-3 ${p.highlighted ? 'bg-indigo-50/60' : ''}">
    <button type="button" data-comparison-cta="${escapeAttribute(p.id)}" class="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${p.highlighted ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500' : 'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-400'}">${ctaText}</button>
  </div>`).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-plan-comparison class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200">
<div class="grid" style="${gs}">
  <div class="border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3"></div>${headCells}
</div>${body}
<div class="grid border-t border-zinc-200" style="${gs}">
  <div class="px-4 py-3"></div>${footCells}
</div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('plan-comparison-table')) {
  customElements.define('plan-comparison-table', PlanComparisonTableElement);
}

export default PlanComparisonTableElement;
