/**
 * PointerRipples - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <pointer-ripples sim-resolution="128" curl="18" idle-ms="5000"></pointer-ripples>
 *
 * WebGL-powered interactive multi-color fluid ripples backdrop.
 * Follows mouse/pointer movement with Navier-Stokes fluid dynamics,
 * rainbow hue-shifting dye splats, vorticity swirls, and 3D diffuse shading.
 */

const BASE_VERTEX_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
attribute vec2 aPosition;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform vec2 texelSize;

void main () {
  vUv = aPosition * 0.5 + 0.5;
  vL = vUv - vec2(texelSize.x, 0.0);
  vR = vUv + vec2(texelSize.x, 0.0);
  vT = vUv + vec2(0.0, texelSize.y);
  vB = vUv - vec2(0.0, texelSize.y);
  gl_Position = vec4(aPosition, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const CLEAR_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;
uniform float value;

void main () {
  gl_FragColor = value * texture2D(uTexture, vUv);
}
`;

const SPLAT_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uTarget;
uniform float aspectRatio;
uniform vec3 color;
uniform vec2 point;
uniform float radius;

void main () {
  vec2 offset = vUv - point;
  offset.x *= aspectRatio;
  vec3 splat = exp(-dot(offset, offset) / radius) * color;
  vec3 base = texture2D(uTarget, vUv).xyz;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(base + splat, 1.0);
}
`;

const ADVECTION_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;
uniform sampler2D uSource;
uniform vec2 texelSize;
uniform vec2 dyeTexelSize;
uniform float dt;
uniform float dissipation;

vec4 bilerp (sampler2D source, vec2 uv, vec2 size) {
  vec2 coord = uv / size - 0.5;
  vec2 index = floor(coord);
  vec2 weight = fract(coord);
  vec4 a = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(0.5, 0.5)) * size);
  vec4 b = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(1.5, 0.5)) * size);
  vec4 c = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(0.5, 1.5)) * size);
  vec4 d = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(1.5, 1.5)) * size);
  return mix(mix(a, b, weight.x), mix(c, d, weight.x), weight.y);
}

void main () {
#ifdef MANUAL_FILTERING
  vec2 coord = vUv - dt * bilerp(uVelocity, vUv, texelSize).xy * texelSize;
  vec4 result = bilerp(uSource, coord, dyeTexelSize);
#else
  vec2 coord = vUv - dt * texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy * texelSize;
  vec4 result = texture2D(uSource, coord);
#endif
  gl_FragColor = result / (1.0 + dissipation * dt);
}
`;

const DIVERGENCE_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uVelocity, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uVelocity, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uVelocity, vT).y;
  float bottom = texture2D(uVelocity, vB).y;
  vec2 center = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;

  if (vL.x < 0.0) left = -center.x;
  if (vR.x > 1.0) right = -center.x;
  if (vT.y > 1.0) top = -center.y;
  if (vB.y < 0.0) bottom = -center.y;

  float divergence = 0.5 * (right - left + top - bottom);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(divergence, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const CURL_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uVelocity, vL).y;
  float right = texture2D(uVelocity, vR).y;
  float top = texture2D(uVelocity, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uVelocity, vB).x;
  float value = right - left - top + bottom;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(0.5 * value, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const VORTICITY_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;
uniform sampler2D uCurl;
uniform float curl;
uniform float dt;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uCurl, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uCurl, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uCurl, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uCurl, vB).x;
  float center = texture2D(uCurl, vUv).x;
  vec2 force = 0.5 * vec2(abs(top) - abs(bottom), abs(right) - abs(left));
  force /= length(force) + 0.0001;
  force *= curl * center;
  force.y *= -1.0;

  vec2 velocity = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;
  velocity += force * dt;
  velocity = clamp(velocity, -1000.0, 1000.0);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(velocity, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const PRESSURE_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uPressure;
uniform sampler2D uDivergence;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uPressure, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uPressure, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uPressure, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uPressure, vB).x;
  float divergence = texture2D(uDivergence, vUv).x;
  float pressure = (left + right + bottom + top - divergence) * 0.25;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(pressure, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const GRADIENT_SUBTRACT_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uPressure;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uPressure, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uPressure, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uPressure, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uPressure, vB).x;
  vec2 velocity = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;
  velocity -= vec2(right - left, top - bottom);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(velocity, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const DISPLAY_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;
uniform vec2 texelSize;

vec3 linearToGamma (vec3 color) {
  color = max(color, vec3(0.0));
  return max(1.055 * pow(color, vec3(0.416666667)) - 0.055, vec3(0.0));
}

void main () {
  vec3 color = texture2D(uTexture, vUv).rgb;

#ifdef SHADING
  vec3 left = texture2D(uTexture, vL).rgb;
  vec3 right = texture2D(uTexture, vR).rgb;
  vec3 top = texture2D(uTexture, vT).rgb;
  vec3 bottom = texture2D(uTexture, vB).rgb;
  float dx = length(right) - length(left);
  float dy = length(top) - length(bottom);
  vec3 normal = normalize(vec3(dx, dy, length(texelSize) * 3.0));
  float diffuse = clamp(dot(normal, vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)) + 0.85, 0.85, 1.0);
  color *= diffuse;
#endif

  float peak = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
  color = min(linearToGamma(color), vec3(1.0));
  float alpha = clamp(peak * 1.35, 0.0, 1.0);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(color, alpha);
}
`;

function normalizeHue(h) {
  return ((h % 1) + 1) % 1;
}

function clamp(val, min = 0, max = 1) {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, val));
}

function hsvToRgb(h, s, v) {
  const i = Math.floor(h * 6);
  const f = h * 6 - i;
  const p = v * (1 - s);
  const q = v * (1 - f * s);
  const t = v * (1 - (1 - f) * s);
  switch (i % 6) {
    case 0: return { r: v, g: t, b: p };
    case 1: return { r: q, g: v, b: p };
    case 2: return { r: p, g: v, b: t };
    case 3: return { r: p, g: q, b: v };
    case 4: return { r: t, g: p, b: v };
    default: return { r: v, g: p, b: q };
  }
}

class FluidSimulationEngine {
  constructor(canvas, options = {}) {
    this.canvas = canvas;
    this.cfg = {
      simResolution: options.simResolution ?? 128,
      dyeResolution: options.dyeResolution ?? 768,
      densityDissipation: options.densityDissipation ?? 2.4,
      velocityDissipation: options.velocityDissipation ?? 1.6,
      pressure: options.pressure ?? 0.8,
      pressureIterations: options.pressureIterations ?? 20,
      curl: options.curl ?? 13,
      splatRadius: options.splatRadius ?? 0.24,
      splatForce: options.splatForce ?? 4800,
      shading: options.shading ?? true,
      colorSpeed: options.colorSpeed ?? 0.055,
      colorStep: options.colorStep ?? 0.012,
      colorSaturation: options.colorSaturation ?? 0.72,
      colorValue: options.colorValue ?? 1.0,
      colorIntensity: options.colorIntensity ?? 0.26,
      idleMs: options.idleMs ?? 4000,
      maxPixelRatio: options.maxPixelRatio ?? 1.5,
    };
    this.view = canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView ?? window;

    const ctxAttr = {
      alpha: true,
      depth: false,
      stencil: false,
      antialias: false,
      premultipliedAlpha: true,
      preserveDrawingBuffer: false,
    };

    const gl2 = canvas.getContext("webgl2", ctxAttr);
    const gl1 = gl2 ? null : canvas.getContext("webgl", ctxAttr);
    const gl = gl2 ?? gl1;
    if (!gl) throw new Error("WebGL is unavailable");

    this.gl = gl;
    this.isGl2 = !!gl2;
    this.textures = new Set();
    this.fbos = new Set();
    this.programs = new Set();
    this.shaders = new Set();
    this.buffers = new Set();
    this.inputs = [];
    this.linear = false;
    this.texType = 0;
    this.rgba = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
    this.rg = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
    this.r = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
    this.prog = null;
    this.dye = null;
    this.velocity = null;
    this.divergence = null;
    this.curlFbo = null;
    this.pressure = null;
    this.frame = 0;
    this.lastTime = 0;
    this.lastInput = 0;
    this.hue = 0.52;
    this.pointer = null;
    this.visible = true;
    this.active = false;
    this.dead = false;

    try {
      this.initFormats();
      this.initPrograms();
      this.initQuad();
      this.resizeCanvas();
      this.initFramebuffers();
      this.clearScreen();
    } catch (err) {
      this.releaseGl();
      throw err;
    }
  }

  update = (now) => {
    this.frame = 0;
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;

    if (now - this.lastInput >= this.cfg.idleMs && this.inputs.length === 0) {
      this.active = false;
      this.clearAll();
      return;
    }

    const dt = Math.min(Math.max((now - this.lastTime) / 1000, 0.001), 1 / 60);
    this.lastTime = now;
    this.hue = normalizeHue(this.hue + dt * this.cfg.colorSpeed);

    if (this.resizeCanvas()) {
      this.initFramebuffers();
    }

    this.applyInputs();
    this.step(dt);
    this.render();
    this.frame = this.view.requestAnimationFrame(this.update);
  };

  move(clientX, clientY) {
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;
    const pt = this.toPoint(clientX, clientY);
    const prev = this.pointer;
    this.pointer = pt;

    if (!prev) {
      this.queue({ x: pt.x, y: pt.y, vx: 0, vy: 0, color: this.nextColor() });
      this.wake();
      return;
    }

    const w = Math.max(this.canvas.clientWidth, 1);
    const h = Math.max(this.canvas.clientHeight, 1);
    const dx = (pt.x - prev.x) * w;
    const dy = (pt.y - prev.y) * h;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const count = clamp(Math.ceil(dist / 14), 1, 32);

    const vx = this.correctX((pt.x - prev.x) / count) * this.cfg.splatForce;
    const vy = this.correctY((pt.y - prev.y) / count) * this.cfg.splatForce;

    for (let i = 1; i <= count; i += 1) {
      const t = i / count;
      this.queue({
        x: prev.x + (pt.x - prev.x) * t,
        y: prev.y + (pt.y - prev.y) * t,
        vx,
        vy,
        color: this.nextColor(),
      });
    }
    this.wake();
  }

  splat(clientX, clientY) {
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;
    const pt = this.toPoint(clientX, clientY);
    const hue = this.hue;
    const spread = Math.min(this.canvas.clientWidth, this.canvas.clientHeight) * 0.1;

    this.pointer = pt;
    this.queue({
      x: pt.x,
      y: pt.y,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      color: this.makeColor(hue, 1.4),
      radius: 0.19,
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) {
      const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
      const subPt = this.toPoint(
        clientX + Math.cos(angle) * spread,
        clientY + Math.sin(angle) * spread
      );
      this.queue({
        x: subPt.x,
        y: subPt.y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * 140,
        vy: -Math.sin(angle) * 140,
        color: this.makeColor(hue + i / 6, 1.7),
        radius: 0.11,
      });
    }

    this.hue = normalizeHue(hue + this.cfg.colorStep * 7);
    this.wake();
  }

  resize() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    if (this.resizeCanvas()) {
      this.initFramebuffers();
      if (!this.active) this.clearScreen();
    }
  }

  setVisible(visible) {
    if (this.dead || visible === this.visible) return;
    this.visible = visible;
    this.pointer = null;
    if (!visible) {
      this.inputs.length = 0;
      this.stop();
      this.clearAll();
      return;
    }
    this.active = false;
    this.clearScreen();
  }

  destroy() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    this.dead = true;
    this.stop();
    this.inputs.length = 0;
    this.pointer = null;
    this.clearScreen();
    this.releaseGl();
  }

  initFormats() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    if (this.isGl2) {
      const gl2 = gl;
      gl2.getExtension("EXT_color_buffer_float");
      this.linear = !!gl2.getExtension("OES_texture_float_linear");
      this.texType = gl2.HALF_FLOAT;

      const rgba = this.supportedFormat(gl2.RGBA16F, gl2.RGBA, this.texType);
      const rg = this.supportedFormat(gl2.RG16F, gl2.RG, this.texType);
      const r = this.supportedFormat(gl2.R16F, gl2.RED, this.texType);

      if (rgba && rg && r) {
        this.rgba = rgba;
        this.rg = rg;
        this.r = r;
        return;
      }
    }

    const halfExt = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_half_float");
    const halfLinear = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_half_float_linear");
    const floatExt = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_float");
    const floatLinear = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_float_linear");

    const candidates = [
      halfExt && { type: halfExt.HALF_FLOAT_OES, linear: !!halfLinear },
      floatExt && { type: gl.FLOAT, linear: !!floatLinear },
    ].filter(Boolean);

    for (const cand of candidates) {
      const fmt = this.supportedFormat(gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, cand.type);
      if (fmt) {
        this.texType = cand.type;
        this.linear = cand.linear;
        this.rgba = fmt;
        this.rg = fmt;
        this.r = fmt;
        return;
      }
    }

    throw new Error("WebGL floating-point framebuffers are unavailable");
  }

  supportedFormat(internal, format, type) {
    if (this.isRenderable(internal, format, type)) {
      return { internal, format };
    }
    if (!this.isGl2) return null;
    const gl2 = this.gl;
    if (internal === gl2.R16F) return this.supportedFormat(gl2.RG16F, gl2.RG, type);
    if (internal === gl2.RG16F) return this.supportedFormat(gl2.RGBA16F, gl2.RGBA, type);
    return null;
  }

  isRenderable(internal, format, type) {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const tex = gl.createTexture();
    const fbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
    if (!tex || !fbo) return false;

    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.NEAREST);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.NEAREST);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, internal, 4, 4, 0, format, type, null);

    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0);
    const ok = gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) === gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE;

    gl.deleteTexture(tex);
    gl.deleteFramebuffer(fbo);
    return ok;
  }

  initPrograms() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vert = this.compileShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, BASE_VERTEX_SHADER);

    const makeProg = (fragSrc, defs = []) => {
      const frag = this.compileShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragSrc, defs);
      return this.linkProgram(vert, frag);
    };

    const advectionDefs = this.linear ? [] : ["MANUAL_FILTERING"];
    const displayDefs = this.cfg.shading && this.linear ? ["SHADING"] : [];

    this.prog = {
      clear: makeProg(CLEAR_SHADER),
      splat: makeProg(SPLAT_SHADER),
      advection: makeProg(ADVECTION_SHADER, advectionDefs),
      divergence: makeProg(DIVERGENCE_SHADER),
      curl: makeProg(CURL_SHADER),
      vorticity: makeProg(VORTICITY_SHADER),
      pressure: makeProg(PRESSURE_SHADER),
      gradient: makeProg(GRADIENT_SUBTRACT_SHADER),
      display: makeProg(DISPLAY_SHADER, displayDefs),
    };
  }

  compileShader(type, src, defs = []) {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const shader = gl.createShader(type);
    if (!shader) throw new Error("Failed to create WebGL shader");
    this.shaders.add(shader);

    const prefix = defs.map((d) => `#define ${d}\n`).join("");
    gl.shaderSource(shader, `${prefix}${src}`);
    gl.compileShader(shader);

    if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
      const err = gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader) || "Shader compile error";
      gl.deleteShader(shader);
      this.shaders.delete(shader);
      throw new Error(err);
    }
    return shader;
  }

  linkProgram(vert, frag) {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = gl.createProgram();
    if (!prog) throw new Error("Failed to create WebGL program");
    this.programs.add(prog);

    gl.attachShader(prog, vert);
    gl.attachShader(prog, frag);
    gl.bindAttribLocation(prog, 0, "aPosition");
    gl.linkProgram(prog);

    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
      const err = gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog) || "Program link error";
      gl.deleteProgram(prog);
      this.programs.delete(prog);
      throw new Error(err);
    }

    const uniforms = {};
    const count = gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.ACTIVE_UNIFORMS);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const info = gl.getActiveUniform(prog, i);
      if (info) uniforms[info.name] = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, info.name);
    }
    return { raw: prog, uniforms };
  }

  initQuad() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vbo = gl.createBuffer();
    const ibo = gl.createBuffer();
    if (!vbo || !ibo) throw new Error("Failed to create geometry buffers");

    this.buffers.add(vbo);
    this.buffers.add(ibo);

    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo);
    gl.bufferData(
      gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,
      new Float32Array([-1, -1, -1, 1, 1, 1, 1, -1]),
      gl.STATIC_DRAW
    );

    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ibo);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, new Uint16Array([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);

    gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
  }

  initFramebuffers() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    this.releaseTargets();

    const simRes = this.calcResolution(this.cfg.simResolution);
    const dyeRes = this.calcResolution(this.linear ? this.cfg.dyeResolution : 256);
    const filter = this.linear ? gl.LINEAR : gl.NEAREST;

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    this.dye = this.createDoubleFbo(dyeRes.width, dyeRes.height, this.rgba, filter);
    this.velocity = this.createDoubleFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.rg, filter);
    this.divergence = this.createFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
    this.curlFbo = this.createFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
    this.pressure = this.createDoubleFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
  }

  createFbo(w, h, fmt, filter) {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const tex = gl.createTexture();
    const fbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
    if (!tex || !fbo) throw new Error("Failed to create FBO");

    this.textures.add(tex);
    this.fbos.add(fbo);

    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, fmt.internal, w, h, 0, fmt.format, this.texType, null);

    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, w, h);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);

    return {
      texture: tex,
      raw: fbo,
      width: w,
      height: h,
      texelX: 1 / w,
      texelY: 1 / h,
    };
  }

  createDoubleFbo(w, h, fmt, filter) {
    const read = this.createFbo(w, h, fmt, filter);
    const write = this.createFbo(w, h, fmt, filter);
    const dfbo = {
      read,
      write,
      width: w,
      height: h,
      texelX: 1 / w,
      texelY: 1 / h,
      swap: () => {
        const tmp = dfbo.read;
        dfbo.read = dfbo.write;
        dfbo.write = tmp;
      },
    };
    return dfbo;
  }

  releaseTargets() {
    if (this.divergence) this.deleteFbo(this.divergence);
    if (this.curlFbo) this.deleteFbo(this.curlFbo);
    if (this.dye) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.dye.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.dye.write);
    }
    if (this.velocity) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.velocity.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.velocity.write);
    }
    if (this.pressure) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.pressure.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.pressure.write);
    }
    this.dye = null;
    this.velocity = null;
    this.divergence = null;
    this.curlFbo = null;
    this.pressure = null;
  }

  deleteFbo(fbo) {
    this.gl.deleteTexture(fbo.texture);
    this.gl.deleteFramebuffer(fbo.raw);
    this.textures.delete(fbo.texture);
    this.fbos.delete(fbo.raw);
  }

  calcResolution(res) {
    const dw = this.gl.drawingBufferWidth;
    const dh = this.gl.drawingBufferHeight;
    const aspect = Math.max(dw / Math.max(dh, 1), dh / Math.max(dw, 1));
    const small = Math.round(res);
    const big = Math.round(res * aspect);
    return dw > dh ? { width: big, height: small } : { width: small, height: big };
  }

  resizeCanvas() {
    const dpr = Math.min(this.view.devicePixelRatio || 1, this.cfg.maxPixelRatio);
    const w = this.canvas.clientWidth || this.canvas.width || 1;
    const h = this.canvas.clientHeight || this.canvas.height || 1;
    const targetW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(w * dpr));
    const targetH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(h * dpr));

    if (this.canvas.width === targetW && this.canvas.height === targetH) {
      return false;
    }
    this.canvas.width = targetW;
    this.canvas.height = targetH;
    return true;
  }

  toPoint(clientX, clientY) {
    const rect = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = Math.max(rect.width, 1);
    const h = Math.max(rect.height, 1);
    const x = clamp((clientX - rect.left) / w);
    const y = 1 - clamp((clientY - rect.top) / h);
    return { x, y };
  }

  correctX(val) {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect < 1 ? val * aspect : val;
  }

  correctY(val) {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect > 1 ? val / aspect : val;
  }

  correctRadius(rad) {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect > 1 ? rad * aspect : rad;
  }

  makeColor(hue, intensityScale = 1) {
    const rgb = hsvToRgb(normalizeHue(hue), this.cfg.colorSaturation, this.cfg.colorValue);
    const scale = this.cfg.colorIntensity * intensityScale;
    return { r: rgb.r * scale, g: rgb.g * scale, b: rgb.b * scale };
  }

  nextColor(intensityScale = 1) {
    const col = this.makeColor(this.hue, intensityScale);
    this.hue = normalizeHue(this.hue + this.cfg.colorStep);
    return col;
  }

  queue(item) {
    if (this.inputs.length >= 128) this.inputs.shift();
    this.inputs.push(item);
  }

  wake() {
    this.lastInput = this.view.performance.now();
    this.active = true;
    if (!this.frame && this.visible) {
      this.lastTime = this.lastInput;
      this.frame = this.view.requestAnimationFrame(this.update);
    }
  }

  stop() {
    if (this.frame) {
      this.view.cancelAnimationFrame(this.frame);
      this.frame = 0;
    }
  }

  applyInputs() {
    const count = Math.min(this.inputs.length, 10);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const item = this.inputs.shift();
      if (item) this.applySplat(item);
    }
  }

  applySplat(item) {
    if (!this.prog || !this.velocity || !this.dye) return;
    const prog = this.prog.splat;
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vel = this.velocity;
    const dye = this.dye;

    this.bindProg(prog);
    this.u1f(prog, "aspectRatio", this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1));
    this.u2f(prog, "point", item.x, item.y);
    this.u1f(
      prog,
      "radius",
      this.correctRadius((this.cfg.splatRadius * (item.radius ?? 1)) / 100)
    );

    // Splat velocity
    this.u1i(prog, "uTarget", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u3f(prog, "color", item.vx, item.vy, 0);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // Splat dye color
    this.u1i(prog, "uTarget", this.attachTex(dye.read, 0));
    this.u3f(prog, "color", item.color.r, item.color.g, item.color.b);
    this.blit(dye.write);
    dye.swap();

    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, null);
  }

  step(dt) {
    if (!this.prog || !this.velocity || !this.pressure || !this.dye || !this.divergence || !this.curlFbo) {
      return;
    }
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = this.prog;
    const vel = this.velocity;
    const press = this.pressure;
    const dye = this.dye;
    const div = this.divergence;
    const curl = this.curlFbo;

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);

    // 1. Curl
    this.bindProg(prog.curl);
    this.u2f(prog.curl, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.curl, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.blit(curl);

    // 2. Vorticity confinement
    this.bindProg(prog.vorticity);
    this.u2f(prog.vorticity, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.vorticity, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.vorticity, "uCurl", this.attachTex(curl, 1));
    this.u1f(prog.vorticity, "curl", this.cfg.curl);
    this.u1f(prog.vorticity, "dt", dt);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 3. Divergence
    this.bindProg(prog.divergence);
    this.u2f(prog.divergence, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.divergence, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.blit(div);

    // 4. Clear pressure
    this.bindProg(prog.clear);
    this.u1i(prog.clear, "uTexture", this.attachTex(press.read, 0));
    this.u1f(prog.clear, "value", this.cfg.pressure);
    this.blit(press.write);
    press.swap();

    // 5. Pressure Poisson solve (Jacobi iterations)
    this.bindProg(prog.pressure);
    this.u2f(prog.pressure, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.pressure, "uDivergence", this.attachTex(div, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cfg.pressureIterations; i += 1) {
      this.u1i(prog.pressure, "uPressure", this.attachTex(press.read, 1));
      this.blit(press.write);
      press.swap();
    }

    // 6. Subtract gradient
    this.bindProg(prog.gradient);
    this.u2f(prog.gradient, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.gradient, "uPressure", this.attachTex(press.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.gradient, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 1));
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 7. Advect velocity
    this.bindProg(prog.advection);
    this.u2f(prog.advection, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    if (!this.linear) this.u2f(prog.advection, "dyeTexelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    const velTex = this.attachTex(vel.read, 0);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uVelocity", velTex);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uSource", velTex);
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dt", dt);
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dissipation", this.cfg.velocityDissipation);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 8. Advect dye
    if (!this.linear) this.u2f(prog.advection, "dyeTexelSize", dye.texelX, dye.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uSource", this.attachTex(dye.read, 1));
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dissipation", this.cfg.densityDissipation);
    this.blit(dye.write);
    dye.swap();
  }

  render() {
    if (!this.prog || !this.dye) return;
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = this.prog.display;
    const dye = this.dye;

    this.clearScreen();
    gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);

    this.bindProg(prog);
    this.u2f(prog, "texelSize", 1 / gl.drawingBufferWidth, 1 / gl.drawingBufferHeight);
    this.u1i(prog, "uTexture", this.attachTex(dye.read, 0));
    this.blit(null);
  }

  clearAll() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const targets = [
      this.divergence,
      this.curlFbo,
      this.dye ? this.dye.read : null,
      this.dye ? this.dye.write : null,
      this.velocity ? this.velocity.read : null,
      this.velocity ? this.velocity.write : null,
      this.pressure ? this.pressure.read : null,
      this.pressure ? this.pressure.write : null,
    ];

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (const t of targets) {
      if (t) {
        gl.viewport(0, 0, t.width, t.height);
        gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, t.raw);
        gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
      }
    }
    this.clearScreen();
  }

  clearScreen() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.viewport(0, 0, gl.drawingBufferWidth, gl.drawingBufferHeight);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
  }

  bindProg(p) {
    this.gl.useProgram(p.raw);
  }

  attachTex(fbo, slot) {
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0 + slot);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, fbo.texture);
    return slot;
  }

  blit(target) {
    const gl = this.gl;
    if (target) {
      gl.viewport(0, 0, target.width, target.height);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, target.raw);
    } else {
      gl.viewport(0, 0, gl.drawingBufferWidth, gl.drawingBufferHeight);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    }
    gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, 6, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0);
  }

  u1i(p, name, val) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform1i(loc, val);
  }

  u1f(p, name, val) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform1f(loc, val);
  }

  u2f(p, name, x, y) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform2f(loc, x, y);
  }

  u3f(p, name, x, y, z) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform3f(loc, x, y, z);
  }

  releaseGl() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    this.releaseTargets();
    this.textures.forEach((t) => gl.deleteTexture(t));
    this.fbos.forEach((f) => gl.deleteFramebuffer(f));
    this.programs.forEach((p) => gl.deleteProgram(p));
    this.shaders.forEach((s) => gl.deleteShader(s));
    this.buffers.forEach((b) => gl.deleteBuffer(b));
    this.textures.clear();
    this.fbos.clear();
    this.programs.clear();
    this.shaders.clear();
    this.buffers.clear();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, null);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, null);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, null);
    gl.useProgram(null);
    this.prog = null;
  }
}

const NUM_ATTRS = {
  "sim-resolution": "simResolution",
  "dye-resolution": "dyeResolution",
  "density-dissipation": "densityDissipation",
  "velocity-dissipation": "velocityDissipation",
  "pressure": "pressure",
  "pressure-iterations": "pressureIterations",
  "curl": "curl",
  "splat-radius": "splatRadius",
  "splat-force": "splatForce",
  "color-speed": "colorSpeed",
  "color-step": "colorStep",
  "color-saturation": "colorSaturation",
  "color-value": "colorValue",
  "color-intensity": "colorIntensity",
  "idle-ms": "idleMs",
  "max-pixel-ratio": "maxPixelRatio",
  "opacity": "opacity",
};

class PointerRipples extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    // NOTE: no "class" here — observing it would force a full WebGL engine
    // rebuild on any host class change (browsers cap ~16 live GL contexts).
    return [...Object.keys(NUM_ATTRS), "shading"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._cleanup = null;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.init();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._cleanup) {
      this._cleanup();
      this._cleanup = null;
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (!this.isConnected) return;
    // opacity only touches canvas style — patch it in place instead of tearing
    // down and rebuilding the whole WebGL engine (browsers cap ~16 GL contexts).
    if (name === "opacity") {
      const canvas = this.querySelector("canvas");
      if (canvas) {
        const opacity = Number.parseFloat(this.getAttribute("opacity") || "0.58");
        if (!Number.isNaN(opacity)) canvas.style.opacity = String(opacity);
      }
      return;
    }
    this.disconnectedCallback();
    this.init();
  }

  init() {
    this._cleanup?.();
    this._cleanup = null;

    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    canvas.className = "fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full -z-10";
    const opacity = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("opacity") || "0.58");
    if (!Number.isNaN(opacity)) canvas.style.opacity = String(opacity);
    this.innerHTML = "";
    this.appendChild(canvas);

    // Accessibility: static fallback for reduced-motion users
    const reduceQuery =
      typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
        ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
        : null;
    if (reduceQuery && reduceQuery.matches) return;

    const options = {};
    for (const [attr, key] of Object.entries(NUM_ATTRS)) {
      if (attr === "opacity") continue;
      const raw = this.getAttribute(attr);
      if (raw != null) {
        const val = parseFloat(raw);
        if (!Number.isNaN(val)) options[key] = val;
      }
    }
    const shading = this.getAttribute("shading");
    if (shading != null) options.shading = shading !== "false";

    let engine;
    try {
      engine = new FluidSimulationEngine(canvas, options);
      engine.setVisible(!document.hidden);
    } catch {
      // Graceful fallback when WebGL / float extensions unavailable
      return;
    }

    const onPointerMove = (e) => {
      if (!e.isPrimary) return;
      const events = e.getCoalescedEvents?.() ?? [e];
      for (const ev of events) {
        engine.move(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
      }
    };

    const onPointerDown = (e) => {
      if (!e.isPrimary) return;
      engine.splat(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    };

    const onResize = () => engine.resize();
    const onVisibility = () => engine.setVisible(!document.hidden);

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { capture: true, passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, { capture: true, passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

    this._cleanup = () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, true);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, true);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
      engine.destroy();
    };
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("pointer-ripples")) {
  customElements.define("pointer-ripples", PointerRipples);
}

/**
 * PrReviewQueue - Grouped pull-request review queue with collapsible sections
 * and reviewer rows (Graphite).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_GROUPS = () => [
  {
    id: 'waiting',
    label: 'Waiting for reviewers',
    prs: [{ id: 'p1', title: 'Add activity feed API', repo: 'mini-landing-page', number: 4, author: 'Sam Lee' }],
  },
  {
    id: 'drafts',
    label: 'Drafts',
    prs: [
      { id: 'p2', title: 'Add user search', repo: 'mini-landing-page', number: 7, author: 'Sam Lee' },
      { id: 'p3', title: 'Add frontend for search', repo: 'mini-landing-page', number: 6, author: 'Sam Lee' },
    ],
  },
];

const initials = (author) =>
  String(author || '')
    .split(' ')
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join('')
    .slice(0, 2)
    .toUpperCase();

class PrReviewQueueElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['groups'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._groups = [];
    this._collapsed = {};
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._groups.length) {
      this._groups = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('groups'), DEFAULT_GROUPS());
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'groups' && !this._groups.length) {
      this._groups = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('groups'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get groups() {
    return this._groups;
  }
  set groups(value) {
    this._groups = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const toggleEl = event.target.closest('[data-pr-group-toggle]');
    if (toggleEl) {
      const id = toggleEl.getAttribute('data-pr-group-toggle');
      this._collapsed = { ...this._collapsed, [id]: !this._collapsed[id] };
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-pr-row]');
    if (rowEl) {
      const pr = this._groups.flatMap((g) => g.prs).find((p) => p.id === rowEl.getAttribute('data-pr-row'));
      if (pr) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pr-click', { detail: { pr }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const groupsHtml = this._groups
      .map((group) => {
        const isCollapsed = this._collapsed[group.id] ?? false;
        const itemsHtml = isCollapsed
          ? ''
          : `<div data-pr-group-items class="pb-2">${group.prs
              .map(
                (pr) => `
            <button type="button" data-pr-row="${escapeAttribute(pr.id)}" class="flex w-full items-start gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
              <span data-pr-avatar class="mt-0.5 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-[9px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">${escapeAttribute(initials(pr.author))}</span>
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <span data-pr-title class="block truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(pr.title)}</span>
                <span data-pr-meta class="block truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(pr.author)} · ${escapeAttribute(pr.repo)} #${escapeAttribute(pr.number)}</span>
              </span>
            </button>`
              )
              .join('')}</div>`;
        return `
        <div data-pr-group="${escapeAttribute(group.id)}" class="border-b border-zinc-200 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <button type="button" data-pr-group-toggle="${escapeAttribute(group.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
            <span data-pr-group-caret class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${isCollapsed ? '▶' : '▼'}</span>
            <span data-pr-group-count class="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${group.prs.length}</span>
            <span data-pr-group-label class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(group.label)}</span>
          </button>
          ${itemsHtml}
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-pr-review-queue class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${groupsHtml}</div>`;
  }
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',

  }[char]));

export class PricingTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['plans'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get plans() {
    if (this._plans) return this._plans;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('plans') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set plans(value) {
    this._plans = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const plans = this.plans;
    this._applyHostClass('grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-3 items-start');

    this.innerHTML = plans
      .map((plan, index) => {
        const highlighted = !!plan.highlighted;
        const cardClass = highlighted
          ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 ring-2 ring-indigo-600 shadow-sm'
          : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:shadow-sm';
        const buttonClass = highlighted
          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'
          : 'border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
        const features = (plan.features || [])
          .map(
            (feature) => `
            <li class="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              <span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check', { size: 14 })}</span>
              <span>${escapeAttribute(feature)}</span>
            </li>`
          )
          .join('');

        return `
          <div class="relative flex flex-col rounded-2xl border p-6 transition-shadow ${cardClass}">
            ${
              highlighted
                ? `<span class="absolute -top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-white">${escapeAttribute(plan.badge || 'Most popular')}</span>`
                : ''
            }
            <div class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(plan.name || '')}</div>
            ${
              plan.description
                ? `<div class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(plan.description)}</div>`
                : ''
            }
            <div class="mt-5 flex items-baseline gap-1">
              <span class="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(plan.price ?? '')}</span>
              <span class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">/${escapeAttribute(plan.period || 'mo')}</span>
            </div>
            <ul class="mt-5 space-y-2.5 flex-1">${features}</ul>
            <button type="button" data-index="${index}" class="plan-cta mt-6 w-full rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${buttonClass}">
              ${escapeAttribute(plan.ctaText || 'Get started')}
            </button>
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.querySelectorAll('.plan-cta').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-index'));
        const plan = plans[index];
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: plan }));
      });
    });
  }
}

/**
 * ProfileHeader - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage:
 *   <profile-header name="Ada Lovelace" handle="ada" headline="…" cover-class="from-indigo-500 to-sky-400"
 *     status-text="Available" tabs="Overview,Projects,Activity" active-tab="Overview"></profile-header>
 * Properties: stats, actions
 * Attributes: name, handle, headline, avatar-url, initials, cover-class, status-text, status-tone,
 *             tabs (comma-separated), active-tab
 * Events: action (detail: { label, variant }), tab-change (detail: { tab })
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const ACTION_VARIANT = {
  primary: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
  secondary:
    'border border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400',
  ghost:
    'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400',
};

export class ProfileHeaderElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return [
      'name', 'handle', 'headline', 'avatar-url', 'initials', 'cover-class',
      'status-text', 'status-tone', 'tabs', 'active-tab',
    ];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._stats = [];
    this._actions = [];
  }

  get stats() {
    return this._stats;
  }

  set stats(value) {
    this._stats = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get actions() {
    return this._actions;
  }

  set actions(value) {
    this._actions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get tabs() {
    return (this.getAttribute('tabs') || '').split(',').map((t) => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const name = this.getAttribute('name') || '';
    const handle = this.getAttribute('handle') || '';
    const headline = this.getAttribute('headline') || '';
    const avatarUrl = this.getAttribute('avatar-url');
    const initialsAttr = this.getAttribute('initials');
    const coverClass = this.getAttribute('cover-class') || 'from-indigo-500 via-violet-500 to-sky-400';
    const statusText = this.getAttribute('status-text') || '';
    const statusTone = this.getAttribute('status-tone') === 'away' ? 'away' : 'ok';
    const tabs = this.tabs;
    const activeTab = this.getAttribute('active-tab') || (tabs[0] || '');

    const initials = ((initialsAttr || name || '?').trim().split(/\s+/).map((w) => w[0]).slice(0, 2).join('') || '?').toUpperCase();

    const avatar = avatarUrl
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttribute(avatarUrl)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(name)}" class="h-16 w-16 rounded-full border-4 border-white object-cover dark:border-zinc-900" />`
      : `<span class="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4 border-white bg-indigo-100 text-lg font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-900 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">${escapeAttribute(initials)}</span>`;

    const actionButtons = this._actions
      .map(
        (action) => `<button type="button" data-action-label="${escapeAttribute(action.label)}" data-action-variant="${escapeAttribute(action.variant || 'secondary')}"
          class="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${ACTION_VARIANT[action.variant || 'secondary']}">${escapeAttribute(action.label)}</button>`
      )
      .join('');

    const status = statusText
      ? `<p class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"><span aria-hidden="true" class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${statusTone === 'ok' ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-zinc-400'}"></span>${escapeAttribute(statusText)}</p>`
      : '';

    const statsHtml = this._stats.length
      ? `<dl class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1">${this._stats
          .map(
            (stat) => `<div class="flex items-baseline gap-1">
              <dt class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(stat.value)}</dt>
              <dd class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(stat.label)}</dd>
            </div>`
          )
          .join('')}</dl>`
      : '';

    const tabsHtml = tabs.length
      ? `<nav aria-label="Profile sections" class="-mb-px mt-4 flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">${tabs
          .map((tab) => {
            const active = tab === activeTab;
            return `<button type="button" data-tab-label="${escapeAttribute(tab)}" ${active ? 'aria-current="page"' : ''}
              class="whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none ${
                active
                  ? 'border-indigo-600 text-zinc-900 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-zinc-50'
                  : 'border-transparent text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-300'
              }">${escapeAttribute(tab)}</button>`;
          })
          .join('')}</nav>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="relative h-28 bg-gradient-to-r ${escapeAttribute(coverClass)}">
        <span class="absolute right-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-white/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white backdrop-blur">Pro</span>
      </div>
      <div class="px-5 pb-4">
        <div class="-mt-8 mb-3 flex items-end justify-between">
          ${avatar}
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">${actionButtons}</div>
        </div>
        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(name)}</h2>
        ${handle ? `<p class="text-xs text-zinc-400">@${escapeAttribute(handle)}</p>` : ''}
        ${headline ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(headline)}</p>` : ''}
        ${status}
        ${statsHtml}
        ${tabsHtml}
      </div>
    </div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-action-label]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('action', { detail: { label: button.getAttribute('data-action-label'), variant: button.getAttribute('data-action-variant') } }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-label]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.setAttribute('active-tab', button.getAttribute('data-tab-label'));
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tab-change', { detail: { tab: button.getAttribute('data-tab-label') } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('profile-header')) {
  customElements.define('profile-header', ProfileHeaderElement);
}

===== FILE: vanilla\ProjectGanttTimeline.js =====

/**
 * ProjectGanttTimeline - Project gantt timeline: month tick header with
 * week sub-ticks and a Today pill, project rows with emoji/status/count
 * badges and horizontal duration bars spanning start..end month positions,
 * current-date marker line and a bottom scrollbar hint
 * (Linear projects timeline pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_MONTHS = () => [
  { label: 'AUG', weeks: 4 },
  { label: 'SEP', weeks: 5 },
  { label: 'OCT', weeks: 4 },
  { label: 'NOV', weeks: 4 },
  { label: 'DEC', weeks: 5 },
  { label: 'JAN 2026', weeks: 4 },
  { label: 'FEB', weeks: 4 },
  { label: 'MAR', weeks: 4 },
  { label: 'APR', weeks: 4 },
  { label: 'MAY', weeks: 5 },
  { label: 'JUN', weeks: 4 },
  { label: 'JUL', weeks: 4 },
];

const DEFAULT_PROJECTS = () => [
  { id: 'p1', emoji: '🎧', name: 'AI UX Research Assistant', status: 'Planning', points: 34, start: 8, end: 9.5, tone: 'violet' },
  { id: 'p2', emoji: '📊', name: 'User Insight & Behavior Analytics Dashboard', status: 'In Progress', points: 68, start: 8.5, end: 12, tone: 'sky' },
  { id: 'p3', emoji: '🧩', name: 'Design System Expansion', status: 'In Progress', points: 65, start: 6, end: 11, tone: 'sky' },
  { id: 'p4', emoji: '🚀', name: 'E-commerce Platform Launch', status: 'Review', points: 90, start: 4, end: 9, tone: 'emerald' },
];

const TONE_STYLES = {
  sky: 'bg-sky-200 dark:bg-sky-900/70',
  violet: 'bg-violet-200 dark:bg-violet-900/70',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-900/70',
  amber: 'bg-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-900/70',
};

const STATUS_STYLES = {
  'In Progress': 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/70 dark:text-sky-300',
  Planning: 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/70 dark:text-violet-300',
  Review: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300',
  Done: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
};

class ProjectGanttTimelineElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['months', 'projects', 'today-month', 'today-fraction'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const row = event.target.closest('[data-gantt-project]');
    if (row) {
      const found = this._projects().find((p) => p.id === row.getAttribute('data-gantt-project'));
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('project-click', { detail: { project: found }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _months() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('months'), DEFAULT_MONTHS());
  }

  _projects() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('projects'), DEFAULT_PROJECTS());
  }

  _render() {
    const months = this._months();
    const projects = this._projects();
    const todayMonth = Number(this.getAttribute('today-month') ?? 8);
    const todayFraction = Number(this.getAttribute('today-fraction') ?? 0.25);
    const totalWeeks = months.reduce((sum, m) => sum + m.weeks, 0) || 1;

    const offsets = [];
    let acc = 0;
    for (const m of months) {
      offsets.push(acc);
      acc += m.weeks;
    }
    const todayLeft = (((offsets[todayMonth] ?? 0) + (months[todayMonth]?.weeks ?? 1) * todayFraction) / totalWeeks) * 100;

    const headerHtml = months
      .map((m, i) => {
        const width = (m.weeks / totalWeeks) * 100;
        const ticks = Array.from({ length: m.weeks }, () => '<span class="h-1 flex-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></span>').join('');
        return `<div class="shrink-0 border-r border-zinc-100 px-2 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800" style="width:${width}%">
            <p class="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(m.label)}</p>
            <div class="mt-1 flex gap-1">${ticks}</div>
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const rowsHtml = projects
      .map((project) => {
        const left = ((offsets[project.start] ?? 0) / totalWeeks) * 100;
        const span = Math.max(((project.end - project.start) / totalWeeks) * 100, 2);
        const barCls = TONE_STYLES[project.tone ?? 'sky'] ?? TONE_STYLES.sky;
        const statusCls = STATUS_STYLES[project.status] ?? STATUS_STYLES['In Progress'];
        return `<button data-gantt-project="${escapeAttribute(project.id)}" type="button" class="relative flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40">
            <div data-gantt-label class="w-64 shrink-0">
              <p class="flex items-center gap-2 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100"><span aria-hidden="true">${escapeAttribute(project.emoji)}</span><span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(project.name)}</span></p>
              <p class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
                <span class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium ${statusCls}">${escapeAttribute(project.status)}</span>
                <span class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">· ${Number(project.points)} pts</span>
              </p>
            </div>
            <div data-gantt-bar class="relative h-9 flex-1">
              <div class="absolute top-1/2 h-6 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-lg ${barCls}" style="left:${left}%;width:${span}%"></div>
            </div>
          </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-gantt class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-gantt-header class="relative flex border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
          ${headerHtml}
          <span data-gantt-today-pill class="absolute -top-0.5 z-10 rounded-full bg-red-500 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white" style="left:calc(${todayLeft}% - 24px)">Today</span>
        </div>
        <div data-gantt-rows class="relative">
          <div data-gantt-today-line class="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 top-0 z-10 w-px bg-red-400/70" style="left:${todayLeft}%"></div>
          ${rowsHtml}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('project-gantt-timeline')) {
  customElements.define('project-gantt-timeline', ProjectGanttTimelineElement);
}

export default ProjectGanttTimelineElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\PromptChips.js =====

/**
 * PromptChips - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <prompt-chips suggestions='["Summarize this article", "Find bugs in code"]'></prompt-chips>
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

class PromptChips extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["suggestions"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    let suggestions = [];
    try {
      suggestions = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute("suggestions") || "[]");
    } catch {
      suggestions = [];
    }

    if (!suggestions || suggestions.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 my-3">
        ${suggestions.map((item, idx) => `
          <button type="button" data-idx="${idx}" class="chip-item group flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/60 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 shadow-xs hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 transition-all text-left">
            <span class="text-amber-500/70 group-hover:text-amber-500 transition-colors">✨</span>
            <span class="truncate max-w-[280px]">${escapeAttribute(item)}</span>
          </button>
        `).join("")}
      </div>
    `;

    this.querySelectorAll(".chip-item").forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const idx = parseInt(btn.getAttribute("data-idx") || "0", 10);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("select", { detail: suggestions[idx] }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("prompt-chips")) {
  customElements.define("prompt-chips", PromptChips);
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * PromptLibrary - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <prompt-library searchable></prompt-library>
 * Properties: prompts (PromptItem[]), categories (string[])
 * Events: use (detail: prompt), toggle-favorite (detail: prompt)
 */
export class PromptLibraryElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['searchable'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._prompts = [];
    this._categories = [];
    this._query = '';
    this._category = 'all';
  }

  get prompts() {
    return this._prompts;
  }

  set prompts(value) {
    this._prompts = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get categories() {
    return this._categories;
  }

  set categories(value) {
    this._categories = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _categoryOptions() {
    const seen = new Set(this._categories);
    for (const prompt of this._prompts) if (prompt.category) seen.add(prompt.category);
    return ['all', ...Array.from(seen)];
  }

  _visible() {
    const needle = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return this._prompts.filter((prompt) => {
      const inCategory = this._category === 'all' || prompt.category === this._category;
      if (!inCategory) return false;
      if (!needle) return true;
      return [prompt.title, prompt.description, prompt.prompt, ...(prompt.tags || [])]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(needle);
    });
  }

  _chips() {
    return this._categoryOptions()
      .map((category) => {
        const active = this._category === category;
        return `<button type="button" class="prompt-chip rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          active
            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
            : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700'
        }" data-category="${escapeAttribute(category)}" aria-pressed="${active}">${category === 'all' ? 'All' : escapeAttribute(category)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');
  }

  _list() {
    const visible = this._visible();
    if (visible.length === 0) {
      return `<p class="px-3 py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">No prompts match your filters.</p>`;
    }
    const items = visible
      .map((prompt) => {
        const tags = (prompt.tags || [])
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map((tag) => `<span class="rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tag)}</span>`)
          .join('');
        return `<li class="prompt-card group flex flex-col rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:border-indigo-700" data-prompt="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">
          <div class="flex items-start gap-1.5">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span class="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(prompt.title)}</span>
                ${prompt.category ? `<span class="shrink-0 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.category)}</span>` : ''}
              </div>
              ${prompt.description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="prompt-fav shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
              prompt.favorite ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-300 hover:text-amber-500 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-amber-400'
            }" aria-label="${prompt.favorite ? 'Unfavorite' : 'Favorite'} ${escapeAttribute(prompt.title)}" aria-pressed="${!!prompt.favorite}" data-prompt-id="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">${uiIcon('star', { size: 13 })}</button>
          </div>

          <p class="mt-2 line-clamp-2 rounded bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(prompt.prompt)}</p>

          <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">${tags}</div>
            <button type="button" class="prompt-use inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500" data-prompt-id="${escapeAttribute(prompt.id)}">
              Use${uiIcon('arrow-right', { size: 10 })}
            </button>
          </div>
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');
    return `<ul class="grid gap-2 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">${items}</ul>`;
  }

  _updateCount() {
    const count = this.querySelector('.prompt-count');
    if (count) count.textContent = String(this._visible().length);
  }

  _renderRegion() {
    const chips = this.querySelector('.prompt-chips');
    const list = this.querySelector('.prompt-body');
    if (chips) chips.innerHTML = this._chips();
    if (list) list.innerHTML = this._list();
    this._updateCount();
    this._bindItems();
  }

  _bindItems() {
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-chip').forEach((chip) => {
      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
        this._category = chip.getAttribute('data-category');
        this._renderRegion();
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-use').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-prompt-id');
        const prompt = this._prompts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (prompt) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('use', { detail: prompt }));
      });
    });
    this.querySelectorAll('.prompt-fav').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = button.getAttribute('data-prompt-id');
        const prompt = this._prompts.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(id));
        if (prompt) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle-favorite', { detail: prompt }));
      });
    });
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const searchable = this.hasAttribute('searchable');
    const search = searchable
      ? `<div class="relative sm:ml-auto sm:w-56">
          <span class="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">${uiIcon('search', { size: 12 })}</span>
          <input type="search" class="prompt-search w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 pl-6 pr-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
            placeholder="Search prompts…" aria-label="Search prompts" value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}" />
        </div>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
          <span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${uiIcon('sparkles', { size: 14 })}</span>
          <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold">Prompt library</h3>
          <span class="prompt-count rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${this._visible().length}</span>
        </div>
        ${search}
      </div>
      <div class="prompt-chips flex flex-wrap gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800">${this._chips()}</div>
      <div class="prompt-body">${this._list()}</div>
    </div>`;

    const input = this.querySelector('.prompt-search');
    if (input) {
      input.addEventListener('input', () => {
        this._query = input.value;
        this._renderRegion();
      });
    }

    this._bindItems();
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('prompt-library')) {
  customElements.define('prompt-library', PromptLibraryElement);
}
export default PromptLibraryElement;

/**
 * PromptPerformanceTable - Peec AI prompt tracking table: rows of tracked
 * prompts with Visibility %, Sentiment score, Position # and Mentions
 * columns, plus an Export CTA in the header.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class PromptPerformanceTableElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'export-label', 'rows'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._rows = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._rows.length) {
      this._rows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('rows'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'rows' && !this._rows.length) {
      this._rows = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('rows'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'Prompt performance';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get exportLabel() {
    return this.getAttribute('export-label') ?? 'Export';
  }
  set exportLabel(value) {
    this.setAttribute('export-label', value);
  }

  get rows() {
    return this._rows;
  }
  set rows(value) {
    this._rows = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-prompt-performance-export]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('export', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const rowEl = event.target.closest('[data-prompt-row]');
    if (!rowEl) return;
    const row = this._rows.find((r) => String(r.id) === rowEl.getAttribute('data-prompt-row'));
    if (row) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('row-click', { detail: { row }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const rows = this._rows;
    const trendMark = (r) => {
      if (r.trend === 'up') return '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-emerald-500">▲</span>';
      if (r.trend === 'down') return '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-red-500">▼</span>';
      return '<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-400">—</span>';
    };
    const body = rows.length
      ? `<table data-prompt-performance-list class="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <th class="px-4 py-2 font-medium">Prompt</th>
              <th class="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Visibility</th>
              <th class="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Sentiment</th>
              <th class="px-3 py-2 font-medium">Position</th>
              <th class="px-4 py-2 text-right font-medium">Mentions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${rows
            .map(
              (r) => `
            <tr data-prompt-row="${escapeAttribute(r.id)}" class="cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
              <td data-prompt-row-prompt class="max-w-[220px] truncate px-4 py-2.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(r.prompt)}</td>
              <td data-prompt-row-visibility class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(r.visibility)}</td>
              <td data-prompt-row-sentiment class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(r.sentiment)} ${trendMark(r)}</td>
              <td data-prompt-row-position class="px-3 py-2.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(r.position)}</td>
              <td data-prompt-row-mentions class="px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(r.mentions)}</td>
            </tr>`
            )
            .join('')}</tbody>
        </table>`
      : `<p data-prompt-performance-empty class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No tracked prompts yet.</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-prompt-performance-table class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h4 data-prompt-performance-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)}</h4>
          <button type="button" data-prompt-performance-export class="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(this.exportLabel)}</button>
        </div>
        ${body}
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('prompt-performance-table')) {
  customElements.define('prompt-performance-table', PromptPerformanceTableElement);
}

export default PromptPerformanceTableElement;
