/**
 * SourcesCitation - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <sources-citation sources='[{"title": "OpenAI Docs", "url": "https://openai.com"}]'></sources-citation>
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

// 与 HomepageDashboard.isSafeHref 同口径：拦 javascript:/data:/vbscript:/file: 等，
// 放行 http(s)/mailto:/协议相对/绝对路径/相对路径
const isSafeHref = (href) => {
  if (typeof href !== 'string') return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith('//') || t.startsWith('/') || t.startsWith('./') || t.startsWith('../')) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

class SourcesCitation extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["sources"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    let sources = [];
    try {
      sources = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute("sources") || "[]");
    } catch {
      sources = [];
    }

    if (!sources || sources.length === 0) {
      this.innerHTML = "";
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="my-3 space-y-2">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span>🌐</span>
          <span>Sources (${sources.length})</span>
        </div>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          ${sources.map((item, idx) => {
            let domain = "web";
            try {
              domain = new URL(item.url).hostname.replace("www.", "");
            } catch {
              domain = item.siteName || "web";
            }
            const href = isSafeHref(item.url) ? escapeAttribute(item.url) : '';
            return `
              <a ${href ? `href="${href}"` : 'role="link" aria-disabled="true"'} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="group relative flex flex-col justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/60 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 shadow-xs transition-all no-underline">
                <div class="space-y-1">
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                    <span class="flex items-center justify-center w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 font-bold text-[10px]">${idx + 1}</span>
                    <span class="truncate max-w-[120px]">${escapeAttribute(domain)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors">${escapeAttribute(item.title)}</div>
                </div>
                ${item.snippet ? `<div class="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 line-clamp-2 leading-tight">${escapeAttribute(item.snippet)}</div>` : ''}
                <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-end text-[10px] text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-zinc-600 dark:group-hover:text-zinc-300">
                  <span class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">↗</span>
                </div>
              </a>
            `;
          }).join("")}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

===== FILE: vanilla\SpendTrendChart.js =====

/**
 * SpendTrendChart - Vanilla Web Component
 * Spend trend bar chart: headline + mono total, Daily/Weekly granularity
 * segmented switch, pure-SVG bars with dashed grid and sparse x labels,
 * granularity-change event.
 *
 * Usage: <spend-trend-chart headline="Spend" unit="$"></spend-trend-chart>
 * Attributes: headline, unit, granularity (active), y-ticks
 * Property: points { Daily: [{label, value}], Weekly: [...] }
 * Events: granularity-change (detail {granularity})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const GRANULARITIES = ['Daily', 'Weekly'];
const HEIGHT = 180;
const PAD_LEFT = 34;
const PAD_BOTTOM = 26;
const PLOT_W = 100;

export class SpendTrendChartElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['headline', 'unit', 'granularity', 'y-ticks'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._points = {};
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get points() {
    return this._points;
  }

  set points(value) {
    this._points = value && typeof value === 'object' ? value : {};
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const btn = event.target.closest('[data-spend-trend-granularity-option]');
        if (!btn) return;
        const next = btn.getAttribute('data-spend-trend-granularity-option');
        if (!GRANULARITIES.includes(next) || next === this.getAttribute('granularity')) return;
        this.setAttribute('granularity', next);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('granularity-change', { detail: { granularity: next } }));
      });
    }
  }

  render() {
    const headline = this.getAttribute('headline') || 'Spend';
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || '$';
    const gran = this.getAttribute('granularity');
    const granularity = gran && GRANULARITIES.includes(gran) ? gran : GRANULARITIES[0];
    const yTicks = Math.max(Number.parseInt(this.getAttribute('y-ticks') || '4', 10) || 4, 1);

    const data = Array.isArray(this._points[granularity]) ? this._points[granularity] : [];
    const total = data.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (Number(p.value) || 0), 0);
    const max = Math.max(...data.map((p) => Number(p.value) || 0), 1);

    const tickLines = Array.from({ length: yTicks + 1 }, (_, i) => {
      const y = 8 + ((HEIGHT - PAD_BOTTOM - 16) * i) / yTicks;
      const t = (max / yTicks) * (yTicks - i);
      return `<line x1="${PAD_LEFT}" x2="${PAD_LEFT + PLOT_W}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="#3f3f46" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-dasharray="3 4"></line>
        <text x="${PAD_LEFT - 6}" y="${y + 3}" text-anchor="end" font-size="8" fill="#a1a1aa">${Math.round(t)}</text>`;
    }).join('');

    const n = data.length;
    const slot = n > 0 ? PLOT_W / n : 0;
    const every = Math.ceil(n / 8);
    const bars = data
      .map((p, i) => {
        const value = Number(p.value) || 0;
        const bw = Math.min(slot * 0.45, 8);
        const x = PAD_LEFT + slot * i + (slot - bw) / 2;
        const h = Math.max((value / max) * (HEIGHT - PAD_BOTTOM - 16), value > 0 ? 3 : 0);
        const y = HEIGHT - PAD_BOTTOM - h;
        const showLabel = n <= 14 || i % every === 0;
        const label = showLabel
          ? `<text x="${x + bw / 2}" y="${HEIGHT - PAD_BOTTOM + 11}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="7" fill="#a1a1aa">${escapeAttribute(String(p.label || '').slice(5))}</text>`
          : '';
        return `<rect data-spend-trend-bar="${escapeAttribute(p.label)}" x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${bw}" height="${h}" rx="2" fill="#14b8a6" opacity="${value > 0 ? 0.9 : 0.25}"></rect>${label}`;
      })
      .join('');

    const empty = n === 0
      ? `<text x="${PAD_LEFT + PLOT_W / 2}" y="${HEIGHT / 2}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#a1a1aa">No spend recorded</text>`
      : '';

    const segs = GRANULARITIES.map((g) => {
      const active = g === granularity;
      const cls = active
        ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
        : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200';
      return `<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="${active}" data-spend-trend-granularity-option="${g}" class="rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${cls}">${g}</button>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-spend-trend-chart class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <p data-spend-trend-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(headline)}</p>
          <div data-spend-trend-granularity role="tablist" aria-label="Granularity" class="flex items-center rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-0.5 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">${segs}</div>
        </div>

        <p data-spend-trend-total class="mt-1 font-mono text-2xl font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(unit)}${total.toFixed(2)}<span class="ml-1.5 font-sans text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${granularity}</span></p>

        <div class="mt-3" style="position: relative">
          <svg data-spend-trend-svg width="100%" height="${HEIGHT}" viewBox="0 0 ${PAD_LEFT + PLOT_W} ${HEIGHT}" preserveAspectRatio="none" role="img" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(headline)} ${granularity} bar chart">
            ${tickLines}
            ${bars}
            ${empty}
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

export default SpendTrendChartElement;

if (!customElements.get('spend-trend-chart')) {
  customElements.define('spend-trend-chart', SpendTrendChartElement);
}


===== FILE: vanilla\SpotlightGlareCard.js =====

/**
 * SpotlightGlareCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <spotlight-glare-card enable-tilt="true" glare-opacity="0.5">...</spotlight-glare-card>
 */

// Respect prefers-reduced-motion for JS-driven tilt (inline transform would
// override the CSS motion-reduce class); absent matchMedia => no short-circuit.
function prefersReducedMotion() {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" &&
    typeof window.matchMedia === "function" &&
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
}

class SpotlightGlareCard extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["glare-opacity", "glare-radius", "enable-tilt", "max-tilt"];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._onPointerMove = this._onPointerMove.bind(this);
    this._onPointerLeave = this._onPointerLeave.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.classList.add(
      "group",
      "relative",
      "block",
      "overflow-hidden",
      "rounded-2xl",
      "bg-[#faf8f1]",
      "dark:bg-[#1a1d24]",
      "border",
      "border-[#d6d2c2]/80",
      "dark:border-[#2b3038]/80",
      "text-[#22262d]",
      "dark:text-[#e9e6db]",
      "shadow-[0_1px_0_rgba(34,38,45,0.07),0_5px_16px_rgba(34,38,45,0.07)]",
      "dark:shadow-[0_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.4),0_8px_22px_rgba(0,0,0,0.42)]",
      "transition-shadow",
      "duration-300",
      "hover:shadow-[0_2px_0_rgba(34,38,45,0.08),0_12px_28px_rgba(34,38,45,0.12)]",
      "select-none"
    );

    if (!this.querySelector(".glare-layer")) {
      const glare = document.createElement("div");
      glare.className = "glare-layer pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 transition-opacity duration-300";
      glare.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      glare.style.opacity = "0";
      glare.style.mixBlendMode = "overlay";
      this.prepend(glare);
    }

    this.addEventListener("pointermove", this._onPointerMove);
    this.addEventListener("pointerleave", this._onPointerLeave);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener("pointermove", this._onPointerMove);
    this.removeEventListener("pointerleave", this._onPointerLeave);
  }

  _onPointerMove(e) {
    const glare = this.querySelector(".glare-layer");
    const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const gx = ((x / rect.width) * 100).toFixed(1);
    const gy = ((y / rect.height) * 100).toFixed(1);

    const glareOpacity = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("glare-opacity") || "0.45");
    const glareRadius = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("glare-radius") || "55");
    const enableTilt = this.getAttribute("enable-tilt") === "true";
    const maxTilt = parseFloat(this.getAttribute("max-tilt") || "5");

    if (glare) {
      glare.style.opacity = glareOpacity;
      glare.style.background = `radial-gradient(circle at ${gx}% ${gy}%, rgba(255,255,255,0.85) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 30%, transparent ${glareRadius}%)`;
    }

    if (enableTilt && !prefersReducedMotion()) {
      const centerX = rect.width / 2;
      const centerY = rect.height / 2;
      const ry = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * maxTilt;
      const rx = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * maxTilt;
      this.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rx}deg) rotateY(${ry}deg) translateY(-2px)`;
      this.style.transition = "transform 0.1s ease-out";
    }
  }

  _onPointerLeave() {
    const glare = this.querySelector(".glare-layer");
    if (glare) glare.style.opacity = "0";

    const enableTilt = this.getAttribute("enable-tilt") === "true";
    if (enableTilt) {
      this.style.transform = "perspective(1000px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) translateY(0px)";
      this.style.transition = "transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)";
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== "undefined" && !customElements.get("spotlight-glare-card")) {
  customElements.define("spotlight-glare-card", SpotlightGlareCard);
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const sparkline = (data, positive) => {
  if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length < 2) return '';
  const width = 96;
  const height = 28;
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  const points = data
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = (index / (data.length - 1)) * width;
      const y = height - ((value - min) / span) * (height - 4) - 2;
      return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(' ');
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" class="h-7 w-24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><polyline points="${points}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="${positive ? 'stroke-emerald-500' : 'stroke-red-500'}"/></svg>`;
};

export class StatCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'value', 'delta', 'delta-label', 'trend', 'icon'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const value = this.getAttribute('value') || '';
    const deltaAttr = this.getAttribute('delta');
    const delta = deltaAttr === null || deltaAttr === '' ? undefined : Number(deltaAttr);
    const deltaLabel = this.getAttribute('delta-label') || '';
    const icon = this.getAttribute('icon') || '';
    let trend;
    try {
      trend = this.getAttribute('trend') ? JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('trend')) : undefined;
    } catch {
      trend = undefined;
    }

    const hasDelta = typeof delta === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(delta);
    const positive = (delta ?? 0) >= 0;

    this._applyHostClass('rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>
        ${icon ? `<span class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${uiIcon(icon, { size: 16 })}</span>` : ''}
      </div>
      <div class="mt-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div class="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(value)}</div>
          ${
            hasDelta
              ? `<div class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span class="${positive ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-500'}">${uiIcon(positive ? 'trending-up' : 'trending-down', { size: 13 })}</span>
                  <span class="text-[11px] font-medium ${positive ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-500'}">${positive ? '+' : ''}${delta}%</span>
                  ${deltaLabel ? `<span class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(deltaLabel)}</span>` : ''}
                </div>`
              : ''
          }
        </div>
        ${sparkline(trend, positive)}
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('stat-card')) {
  customElements.define('stat-card', StatCardElement);
}

/**
 * StatsBand - Marketing metrics band: 3-4 column big-number stats with
 * labels and optional trend footnotes in a single band section
 * (landing page social proof numbers pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_STATS = () => [
  { value: '235+', label: 'Production components', note: 'React / Vue / Vanilla' },
  { value: '771', label: 'Regression tests', note: 'jsdom + SSR + compile' },
  { value: '706', label: 'Source files', note: 'Single-file, copy-paste' },
  { value: '3.5k', label: 'Reference screens', note: 'Mobbin-curated patterns' },
];

const columnsFor = (count) => {
  if (count >= 4) return 'sm:grid-cols-4';
  if (count === 3) return 'sm:grid-cols-3';
  if (count === 2) return 'sm:grid-cols-2';
  return '';
};

class StatsBandElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['stats'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._stats = DEFAULT_STATS();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._stats = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('stats'), DEFAULT_STATS());
    this._render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'stats') this._stats = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_STATS());
    this._render();
  }

  get stats() { return this._stats; }
  set stats(value) { this._stats = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _render() {
    const stats = Array.isArray(this._stats) ? this._stats : [];
    const cellsHtml = stats
      .map((stat, index) => {
        const trend = stat.note
          ? `<p data-stats-note="${index}" class="mt-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(stat.note)}</p>`
          : '';
        return `<div data-stats-cell="${index}" class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 px-4 py-3 text-center">
          <span data-stats-value="${escapeAttribute(stat.value)}" class="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(stat.value)}</span>
          <span data-stats-label="${escapeAttribute(stat.label)}" class="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(stat.label)}</span>
          ${trend}
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-stats-band class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-stats-grid class="grid grid-cols-1 divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800 ${columnsFor(stats.length)} sm:divide-x sm:divide-y-0">${cellsHtml}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('stats-band')) {
  customElements.define('stats-band', StatsBandElement);
}

export default StatsBandElement;

/**
 * StatusCountTabs - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <status-count-tabs tabs='[...]' value="all"></status-count-tabs>
 * Attributes: tabs (JSON [{id,label,count?,disabled?}]), value, size (sm|md), full-width
 * Property: tabs, value
 * Events: change (detail {id})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class StatusCountTabsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['tabs', 'value', 'size', 'full-width'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tabs = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._tabs.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('tabs');
      if (raw) {
        try { this._tabs = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._tabs = []; }
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const tab = event.target.closest('[data-status-tab]');
        if (!tab || tab.disabled) return;
        const id = tab.getAttribute('data-status-tab');
        if (id && id !== this._value && id !== this.getAttribute('value')) {
          this._value = id;
          this.setAttribute('value', id);
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { id } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'value') this._value = undefined;
    this.render();
  }

  get tabs() {
    return this._tabs;
  }

  set tabs(value) {
    this._tabs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get value() {
    return this._value !== undefined ? this._value : this.getAttribute('value') || '';
  }

  set value(id) {
    this._value = id;
    this.setAttribute('value', id);
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const size = this.getAttribute('size') || 'md';
    const fullWidth = this.getAttribute('full-width') === 'true';
    const value = this.value;
    const sizeClass = size === 'sm' ? 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs' : 'px-4 py-2.5 text-sm';
    const hostClass = `flex items-stretch overflow-hidden rounded-t-lg border border-b-0 border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 ${fullWidth ? 'w-full' : 'inline-flex max-w-full'}`;
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);
    const tabsHtml = this._tabs
      .map((tab) => {
        const active = tab.id === value;
        const stateClass = active
          ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-[inset_0_-2px_0_0_#18181b] dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:shadow-[inset_0_-2px_0_0_#fafafa]'
          : 'bg-zinc-50 text-sky-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-sky-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
        const count = tab.count != null ? `<span class="font-normal ${active ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-400/80'}">(${tab.count})</span>` : '';
        return `<button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="${active}" data-status-tab="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}"${tab.disabled ? ' disabled' : ''} class="flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap border-r border-zinc-200 font-semibold transition-colors last:border-r-0 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-zinc-700 ${sizeClass} ${stateClass}">${escapeAttribute(tab.label)}${count}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-status-count-tabs role="tablist" class="${hostClass}">${tabsHtml}</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('status-count-tabs')) {
  customElements.define('status-count-tabs', StatusCountTabsElement);
}

/**
 * StatusIndicator - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <status-indicator status="online" label="VPS Connected" ping-ms="24"></status-indicator>
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

class StatusIndicator extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["status", "label", "ping-ms", "show-dot"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const status = this.getAttribute("status") || "online";
    const label = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute("label"));
    const pingMs = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute("ping-ms"));
    const showDot = this.getAttribute("show-dot") !== "false";

    let dotBg = "bg-emerald-500", pingBg = "bg-emerald-400", text = "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400", badgeBg = "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-200/80 dark:border-emerald-800/60", defaultLabel = "Online";
    if (status === "connecting" || status === "busy") {
      dotBg = "bg-amber-500";
      pingBg = "bg-amber-400";
      text = "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400";
      badgeBg = "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800/60";
      defaultLabel = status === "busy" ? "Busy" : "Connecting";
    } else if (status === "error" || status === "offline") {
      dotBg = "bg-rose-500";
      pingBg = "bg-rose-400";
      text = "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400";
      badgeBg = "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800/60";
      defaultLabel = status === "error" ? "Error" : "Offline";
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border text-xs font-medium ${badgeBg} ${text}">
        ${showDot ? `
          <span class="relative flex h-2 w-2">
            ${status === 'online' ? `<span class="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full opacity-75 ${pingBg}"></span>` : ''}
            <span class="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 ${dotBg}"></span>
          </span>
        ` : ''}
        <span class="font-semibold">${label || defaultLabel}</span>
        ${pingMs !== null && pingMs !== undefined ? `<span class="font-mono text-[10px] opacity-75 ml-0.5">(${pingMs}ms)</span>` : ''}
      </div>
    `;
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("status-indicator")) {
  customElements.define("status-indicator", StatusIndicator);
}
export default StatusIndicator;


===== FILE: vanilla\StepSlider.js =====

/**
 * StepSlider - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <step-slider label="Workflow credits" value="1" highlight-from="2" steps="+0k,+1k,+5k,+10k"></step-slider>
 * Attributes: steps (comma-separated), value (0-based index), highlight-from, label, disabled
 * Events: change (detail: { index, step })
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class StepSliderElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['steps', 'value', 'highlight-from', 'label', 'disabled'];
  }

  get steps() {
    return (this.getAttribute('steps') || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  }

  get value() {
    const raw = this.getAttribute('value');
    if (raw === null) return 0;
    const num = Number(raw);
    return Number.isFinite(num) ? Math.min(Math.max(Math.floor(num), 0), this.steps.length - 1) : 0;
  }

  set value(index) {
    this.setAttribute('value', String(index));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block w-full');
    const steps = this.steps;
    const value = this.value;
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');
    const lastIndex = steps.length - 1;
    const ratio = steps.length > 1 ? value / lastIndex : 0;
    const highlightRaw = this.getAttribute('highlight-from');
    const highlightFrom = highlightRaw === null ? steps.length : Number(highlightRaw) || 0;

    const stops = steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const reached = index <= value;
        const highlighted = index >= highlightFrom;
        return `<button type="button" data-step-index="${index}" ${disabled ? 'disabled' : ''} aria-label="${escapeAttribute(step)}" aria-pressed="${index === value}"
          class="relative z-10 flex flex-1 flex-col items-center focus-visible:outline-none">
          <span class="h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 transition-colors ${
            reached
              ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600'
              : highlighted
                ? 'border-indigo-300 bg-white dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-zinc-900'
                : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-900'
          } ${disabled ? 'opacity-50' : ''}"></span>
          <span class="mt-1.5 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10px] ${index === value ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' : 'text-zinc-400'}">${escapeAttribute(step)}</span>
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="w-full">
      ${label ? `<p class="mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(label)}</p>` : ''}
      <div role="slider" tabindex="${disabled ? -1 : 0}" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label || 'Step slider')}"
        aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="${lastIndex}" aria-valuenow="${value}" aria-valuetext="${escapeAttribute(steps[value] || '')}"
        ${disabled ? 'aria-disabled="true"' : ''}
        data-slider-track class="group relative flex cursor-pointer items-center pb-1 focus-visible:outline-none">
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-0 right-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-[width] duration-150" style="width:${ratio * 100}%"></span>
        ${stops}
      </div>
    </div>`;

    const track = this.querySelector('[data-slider-track]');
    if (track && !disabled) {
      track.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
        if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' && value < lastIndex) this.value = value + 1;
        else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' && value > 0) this.value = value - 1;
        else if (event.key === 'Home') this.value = 0;
        else if (event.key === 'End') this.value = lastIndex;
        else return;
        const current = this.steps[this.value];
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { index: this.value, step: current } }));
      });
    }
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step-index]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (disabled) return;
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-step-index'));
        this.value = index;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { index, step: this.steps[index] } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('step-slider')) {
  customElements.define('step-slider', StepSliderElement);
}
export default StepSliderElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\Stepper.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CIRCLE = {
  complete: { cls: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white', icon: 'check' },
  current: { cls: 'border-2 border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400', icon: null },
  upcoming: { cls: 'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700', icon: null },
  error: { cls: 'bg-rose-500 text-white', icon: 'x' },
};

/**
 * Stepper - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <step-flow current="2"></step-flow>
 * Properties: steps ({ id, label, description?, status? }[])
 * Attributes: current (1-based), static (disables click events)
 * Events: step-click (detail: { step, index })
 */
export class StepperElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['current', 'static'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get current() {
    const value = Number(this.getAttribute('current'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? Math.floor(value) : 1;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _statusFor(step, index) {
    if (step.status) return step.status;
    const current = this.current;
    return index + 1 < current ? 'complete' : index + 1 === current ? 'current' : 'upcoming';
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('flex items-start');
    const interactive = !this.hasAttribute('static');

    const items = this._steps
      .map((step, index) => {
        const status = this._statusFor(step, index);
        const styles = CIRCLE[status] || CIRCLE.upcoming;
        const last = index === this._steps.length - 1;
        const clickable = interactive && status !== 'upcoming';
        const circle = `<button type="button" data-step-index="${index}" ${clickable ? '' : 'disabled'}
          ${status === 'current' ? 'aria-current="step"' : ''}
          class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-default ${styles.cls}">
          ${styles.icon ? uiIcon(styles.icon, { size: 12 }) : index + 1}
        </button>`;
        const connector = last
          ? ''
          : `<span aria-hidden="true" class="mt-3.5 h-0.5 flex-1 rounded mr-2 ml-2 ${status === 'complete' ? 'bg-indigo-600' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800'}"></span>`;
        return `<li class="flex min-w-0 ${last ? 'flex-none' : 'flex-1'}">
          <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 text-center">${circle}
            <div class="max-w-28">
              <p class="text-[11px] font-medium leading-tight ${status === 'upcoming' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'}">${escapeAttribute(step.label)}</p>
              ${step.description ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-tight text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(step.description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>${connector}
        </li>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<ol class="flex items-start">${items}</ol>`;

    if (interactive) {
      this.querySelectorAll('[data-step-index]').forEach((node) => {
        node.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (node.disabled) return;
          const index = Number(node.getAttribute('data-step-index'));
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('step-click', { detail: { step: this._steps[index], index } }));
        });
      });
    }
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('step-flow')) {
  customElements.define('step-flow', StepperElement);
}
export default StepperElement;

/**
 * StockPhotoPicker - Media picker modal: title bar with close button,
 * search input with clear, "Powered by" caption and masonry photo grid
 * with hover author name + Add button (Substack stock-photos pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_PHOTOS = () => [
  { id: 'p1', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1441974231531-c6227db76b6e?w=600&q=60', alt: 'Sunlit forest path', author: 'Casey Horner', span: 2 },
  { id: 'p2', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1506905925346-21bda4d32df4?w=600&q=60', alt: 'Mountain ridge', author: 'Sam Tesla' },
  { id: 'p3', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1470071459604-3b5ec3a7fe05?w=600&q=60', alt: 'Foggy hills', author: 'Andreas Gücklhorn', span: 2 },
  { id: 'p4', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1447752875215-b2761acb3c5d?w=600&q=60', alt: 'Green meadow', author: 'Lukasz Szmigiel' },
  { id: 'p5', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1439066615861-d1af74d74000?w=600&q=60', alt: 'Park trail', author: 'Jerome Printr' },
  { id: 'p6', url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1426604966848-d7adac402bff?w=600&q=60', alt: 'Autumn bench', author: 'Josephine Baran' },
];

class StockPhotoPickerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'powered-by', 'placeholder', 'photos', 'open'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._query = '';
    this._onKey = (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close', { bubbles: true }));
      }
    };
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.addEventListener('input', this._onInput);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKey);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.removeEventListener('input', this._onInput);
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKey);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'open') {
      this._query = '';
    }
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-stkpic-close]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-stkpic-clear]')) {
      this._query = '';
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('search', { detail: { query: '' }, bubbles: true }));
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    const addBtn = event.target.closest('[data-stkpic-add]');
    if (addBtn) {
      const photos = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('photos'), DEFAULT_PHOTOS());
      const found = photos.find((p) => p.id === addBtn.getAttribute('data-stkpic-add'));
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add', { detail: { photo: found }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _onInput(event) {
    const input = event.target.closest('[data-stkpic-input]');
    if (!input) return;
    this._query = input.value;
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('search', { detail: { query: this._query }, bubbles: true }));
    this._render();
    const fresh = this.querySelector('[data-stkpic-input]');
    if (fresh) fresh.focus();
  }

  _filtered(photos) {
    const q = this._query.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q === '') return photos;
    return photos.filter((p) => String(p.alt ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }

  _renderGrid() {
    const grid = this.querySelector('[data-stkpic-gridinner]');
    if (!grid) return;
    const photos = this._filtered(parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('photos'), DEFAULT_PHOTOS()));
    grid.innerHTML = this._gridHtml(photos);
  }

  _gridHtml(photos) {
    const cards = photos
      .map((p) => {
        const h = p.span === 2 ? 'h-44' : 'h-28';
        return `<figure data-stkpic-item="${escapeAttribute(p.id)}" class="group relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">
            <img src="${escapeAttribute(p.url)}" alt="${escapeAttribute(p.alt ?? '')}" class="w-full object-cover ${h}" />
            <figcaption data-stkpic-meta="${escapeAttribute(p.id)}" class="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 to-transparent px-2 py-1.5 opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100">
              <span class="truncate text-[11px] text-white">${escapeAttribute(p.author ?? '')}</span>
              <button data-stkpic-add="${escapeAttribute(p.id)}" type="button" class="rounded bg-emerald-600 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-700">Add</button>
            </figcaption>
          </figure>`;
      })
      .join('');
    const empty =
      photos.length === 0
        ? '<p data-stkpic-empty class="col-span-full py-8 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No photos match your search.</p>'
        : '';
    return cards + empty;
  }

  _render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Stock photos';
    const poweredBy = this.getAttribute('powered-by') || 'Powered by Unsplash';
    const placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'Search photos…';
    const open = this.getAttribute('open') !== 'false';
    const photos = this._filtered(parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('photos'), DEFAULT_PHOTOS()));

    if (!open) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-stkpic class="relative w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-stkpic-header class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-zinc-200 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h2 data-stkpic-title class="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</h2>
          <button data-stkpic-close type="button" aria-label="Close" class="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div data-stkpic-searchrow class="px-5 pt-4">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-orange-500/40 dark:border-zinc-600">
            <span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-400">⌕</span>
            <input data-stkpic-input type="text" value="${escapeAttribute(this._query)}" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(placeholder)}"
              class="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100" />
            ${this._query !== '' ? '<button data-stkpic-clear type="button" aria-label="Clear search" class="text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200">✕</button>' : ''}
          </div>
          <p data-stkpic-powered class="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">⭳ ${escapeAttribute(poweredBy)}</p>
        </div>
        <div data-stkpic-grid class="mt-3 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto px-5 pb-5">
          <div data-stkpic-gridinner class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">${this._gridHtml(photos)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * StreamMarkdown - Vanilla Web Component (Powered by marked & Prism CDN)
 * Usage: <stream-markdown is-streaming content="# Hello World"></stream-markdown>
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

// Lightweight sanitizer for marked output — keeps gfm/code-fence rendering intact
// while stripping the dangerous surface: script containers, sandbox-escape tags,
// on* event handlers (tag-scoped, so prose text like "online=1" survives) and
// javascript:/vbscript:/non-image data: URLs. No external dependencies.
const unsafeUrl = (value) =>
  /^\s*(javascript|vbscript):/i.test(value) || /^\s*data:(?!image\/)/i.test(value);

const sanitizeTag = (tag) =>
  tag
    .replace(/\son\w+\s*=\s*(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/gi, '')
    .replace(
      /(\s(?:href|src|srcset|action|formaction)\s*=\s*)("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/gi,
      (m, pre, lit) => {
        const value = lit[0] === '"' || lit[0] === "'" ? lit.slice(1, -1) : lit;
        return unsafeUrl(value) ? `${pre}""` : m;
      }
    );

const sanitizeMarkdownHtml = (html) =>
  String(html)
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<(iframe|object|embed|base|form)\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1\s*>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<(iframe|object|embed|base|form)\b[^>]*\/?>/gi, '')
    .replace(/<[a-z][^>]*>/gi, (tag) => sanitizeTag(tag));

class StreamMarkdown extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ["content", "is-streaming"];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    this.bindEvents();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    if (this._clickHandler) {
      this.removeEventListener("click", this._clickHandler);
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const isStreaming = this.hasAttribute("is-streaming");
    const content = this.getAttribute("content") || this.textContent || "";
    
    // Parse Markdown safely (falls back to text if marked not loaded)
    let parsedHtml = content;
    if (window.marked) {
      const renderer = new window.marked.Renderer();
      renderer.code = function ({ text, lang }) {
        const language = lang && window.Prism && window.Prism.languages[lang] ? lang : "javascript";
        let highlighted = text;
        try {
          if (window.Prism && window.Prism.languages[language]) {
            highlighted = window.Prism.highlight(text, window.Prism.languages[language], language);
          }
        } catch {
          highlighted = text;
        }

        return `
          <div class="relative group my-4 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
              <span>${escapeAttribute(lang || "code")}</span>
              <button 
                type="button" 
                data-code="${encodeURIComponent(text)}" 
                class="copy-btn hover:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
              >
                Copy
              </button>
            </div>
            <pre class="p-4 overflow-x-auto text-sm text-zinc-100 font-mono leading-normal m-0 bg-transparent"><code>${highlighted}</code></pre>
          </div>
        `;
      };
      parsedHtml = window.marked.parse(content, { renderer, breaks: true, gfm: true });
    }

    parsedHtml = sanitizeMarkdownHtml(parsedHtml);

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="prose prose-zinc dark:prose-invert max-w-none text-sm leading-relaxed">
        <div class="inline-block w-full">${parsedHtml}</div>
        ${isStreaming ? '<span class="inline-block w-2 h-4 ml-1 -mb-0.5 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 animate-pulse rounded-sm"></span>' : ''}
      </div>
    `;
  }

  bindEvents() {
    this._clickHandler = (e) => {
      const target = e.target.closest(".copy-btn");
      if (!target) return;
      const rawCode = target.getAttribute("data-code");
      if (rawCode) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(decodeURIComponent(rawCode));
        target.textContent = "Copied";
        setTimeout(() => {
          target.textContent = "Copy";
        }, 2000);
      }
    };
    this.addEventListener("click", this._clickHandler);
  }
}

if (!customElements.get("stream-markdown")) {
  customElements.define("stream-markdown", StreamMarkdown);
}
export default StreamMarkdown;

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const STATUS_BAR = {
  streaming: 'bg-indigo-500',
  done: 'bg-emerald-500',
  error: 'bg-rose-500',
};

export class StreamingProgressBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'label', 'status'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const rawValue = this.getAttribute('value');
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const status = this.getAttribute('status') || 'streaming';
    const barColor = STATUS_BAR[status] || STATUS_BAR.streaming;

    const parsed = rawValue === null ? null : Number(rawValue);
    const indeterminate = parsed === null || Number.isNaN(parsed);
    const clamped = indeterminate ? null : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parsed));

    const labelHtml =
      label || !indeterminate
        ? `<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
             <span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>
             ${!indeterminate ? `<span class="tabular-nums shrink-0">${Math.round(clamped)}%</span>` : ''}
           </div>`
        : '';

    const barHtml = indeterminate
      ? `<div class="h-full w-1/3 rounded-full ${barColor} animate-pulse"></div>`
      : `<div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${barColor}" style="width: ${clamped}%"></div>`;

    this._applyHostClass('block w-full');
    this.innerHTML = `
      ${labelHtml}
      <div
        role="progressbar"
        aria-valuemin="0"
        aria-valuemax="100"
        ${indeterminate ? '' : `aria-valuenow="${Math.round(clamped)}"`}
        aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label || 'Progress')}"
        class="h-1 w-full rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden"
      >${barHtml}</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('streaming-progress-bar')) {
  customElements.define('streaming-progress-bar', StreamingProgressBarElement);
}
export default StreamingProgressBarElement;

/**
 * SuccessToast - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <success-toast message="Link copied" duration="3000"></success-toast>
 * Attributes: message, duration (ms, 0 = sticky), position (top-right|bottom-right)
 * Property: message
 * Events: close
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CHECK_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 18a8 8 0 1 1 0-16 8 8 0 0 1 0 16Zm-1.2-5.4 5-5-1.13-1.13L8.8 10.34 7.33 8.87 6.2 10l2.6 2.6Z"/></svg>';
const CLOSE_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="12" height="12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';

export class SuccessToastElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['message', 'duration', 'position'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._visible = true;
    this._timer = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    this._armTimer();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-toast-close]')) {
          this._visible = false;
          this._clearTimer();
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('close'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this._clearTimer();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'message') {
      this._visible = true;
      this._armTimer();
    }
    this.render();
  }

  get message() { return this.getAttribute('message') || ''; }
  set message(v) {
    this.setAttribute('message', v || '');
    this._visible = true;
    this._armTimer();
    this.render();
  }

  show() {
    this._visible = true;
    this._armTimer();
    this.render();
  }

  _armTimer() {
    this._clearTimer();
    const duration = Number(this.getAttribute('duration'));
    if (duration > 0) {
      this._timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this._visible = false;
        this.render();
      }, duration);
    }
  }

  _clearTimer() {
    if (this._timer) {
      clearTimeout(this._timer);
      this._timer = null;
    }
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const position = this.getAttribute('position') || 'top-right';
    const hostClass = `fixed right-4 z-50 ${position === 'bottom-right' ? 'bottom-4' : 'top-4'} ${this._visible ? '' : 'hidden'}`;
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    if (!this._visible) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const icon = this._icon || CHECK_SVG;
    this.innerHTML = `<div data-success-toast role="status" class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 px-4 py-2.5 shadow-sm">
  <span class="shrink-0 text-emerald-700">${icon}</span>
  <span class="text-sm text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(this.message)}</span>
  <button type="button" data-toast-close title="Dismiss" class="ml-1 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-emerald-800/70 hover:bg-emerald-200 hover:text-emerald-900 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500">${CLOSE_SVG}</button>
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * SystemPromptEditor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <system-prompt-editor title="System prompt" version="v3" saved-value="..." temperature="0.7"></system-prompt-editor>
 * Attributes: title, value, placeholder, version, saved-value, variables (JSON array), temperature
 * Events: save (detail {text}), reset, temperature-change (detail {value})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class SystemPromptEditorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'value', 'placeholder', 'version', 'saved-value', 'variables', 'temperature'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._variables = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-editor-save]')) {
          const ta = this.querySelector('[data-editor-textarea]');
          const text = ta ? ta.value : '';
          this.setAttribute('saved-value', text);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('save', { detail: { text } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-editor-reset]')) {
          const saved = this.getAttribute('saved-value');
          if (saved !== null) this.setAttribute('value', saved);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reset'));
          return;
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        if (!event.target.matches('[data-editor-textarea]')) return;
        // live dirty-state update — typing into the textarea doesn't re-render
        const saved = this.getAttribute('saved-value');
        const dirty = saved !== null ? event.target.value !== saved : true;
        const btn = this.querySelector('[data-editor-save]');
        if (btn) {
          if (dirty) btn.removeAttribute('disabled');
          else btn.setAttribute('disabled', '');
        }
        const state = this.querySelector('[data-editor-state]');
        if (state) {
          state.textContent = dirty ? 'Unsaved changes' : 'Saved';
          state.classList.toggle('text-amber-600', dirty);
          state.classList.toggle('dark:text-amber-400', dirty);
          state.classList.toggle('text-emerald-600', !dirty);
          state.classList.toggle('dark:text-emerald-400', !dirty);
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        if (event.target.matches('[data-editor-temperature]')) {
          const value = Number(event.target.value);
          this.setAttribute('temperature', String(value));
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('temperature-change', { detail: { value } }));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get variables() { return this._variables; }
  set variables(v) {
    this._variables = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'variables' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._variables = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children (e.g. the textarea) mid-edit.
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'System prompt');
    const value = this.getAttribute('value') || '';
    const placeholder = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('placeholder') || 'You are a helpful assistant that…');
    const version = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('version') || 'v3');
    const savedValue = this.getAttribute('saved-value');
    const temperature = this.getAttribute('temperature');
    const tokens = Math.max(1, Math.round(value.length * 0.25));
    const dirty = savedValue !== null ? value !== savedValue : false;

    const varChips = this._variables.map((v) =>
      `<code class="rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">{{${escapeAttribute(v)}}}</code>`
    ).join('');

    const tempBlock = temperature !== null && temperature !== undefined && temperature !== '' ? `
      <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
        <label class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300" for="prompt-editor-temp">Temperature</label>
        <input id="prompt-editor-temp" data-editor-temperature type="range" min="0" max="2" step="0.1" value="${escapeAttribute(temperature)}" class="h-1 flex-1 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded bg-zinc-200 accent-indigo-600 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        <span data-editor-temp-value class="w-8 text-right font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${Number(temperature).toFixed(1)}</span>
      </div>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-prompt-editor class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}<span data-editor-version class="ml-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${version}</span></p>
    <span data-editor-state class="text-[11px] font-semibold ${dirty ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'}">${dirty ? 'Unsaved changes' : 'Saved'}</span>
  </div>
  <textarea data-editor-textarea rows="6" placeholder="${placeholder}" class="mt-3 w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-800 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(value)}</textarea>
  <div class="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
    <span data-editor-tokens>~${tokens} tokens · ${value.length} chars</span>
    ${this._variables.length > 0 ? `<span data-editor-variables class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">${varChips}</span>` : ''}
  </div>
  ${tempBlock}
  <div class="mt-3 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
    <button type="button" data-editor-reset class="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" data-editor-save ${dirty ? '' : 'disabled'} class="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">Save prompt</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('system-prompt-editor')) {
  customElements.define('system-prompt-editor', SystemPromptEditorElement);
}

/**
 * TableSavedViews - Data-table saved views bar: view tabs (default +
 * user-saved), active-view filter chips, and Save view / Share actions
 * (Attio / Rows table views pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_VIEWS = () => [
  { id: 'all', label: 'All records', filters: [] },
  { id: 'mine', label: 'Assigned to me', filters: ['assignee: me'] },
  { id: 'stale', label: 'Stale 30d+', filters: ['updated < 30d', 'status: open'] },
];

class TableSavedViewsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['views', 'active', 'save-label', 'share-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._views = DEFAULT_VIEWS();
    this._active = 'all';
    this._saveLabel = 'Save view';
    this._shareLabel = 'Share';
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._views = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('views'), DEFAULT_VIEWS());
    const a = this.getAttribute('active');
    if (a) this._active = a;
    const s = this.getAttribute('save-label');
    if (s) this._saveLabel = s;
    const sh = this.getAttribute('share-label');
    if (sh) this._shareLabel = sh;
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'views') this._views = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_VIEWS());
    if (name === 'active') this._active = newValue || 'all';
    if (name === 'save-label') this._saveLabel = newValue || 'Save view';
    if (name === 'share-label') this._shareLabel = newValue || 'Share';
    this._render();
  }

  get views() { return this._views; }
  set views(value) { this._views = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const tab = event.target.closest('[data-savedview-tab]');
    if (tab) {
      this._active = tab.getAttribute('data-savedview-tab') || 'all';
      const view = this._views.find((v) => v.id === this._active);
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('view-change', { detail: { view, id: this._active }, bubbles: true }));
      this._render();
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-savedview-save]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('view-save', { detail: { id: this._active }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-savedview-share]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('view-share', { detail: { id: this._active }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const views = Array.isArray(this._views) ? this._views : [];
    const active = views.find((v) => v.id === this._active) ?? views[0] ?? { id: 'all', label: 'All records', filters: [] };

    const tabsHtml = views
      .map((view) => {
        const isActive = view.id === active.id;
        const cls = isActive
          ? 'border-b-2 border-violet-600 font-semibold text-violet-700 dark:border-violet-500 dark:text-violet-300'
          : 'border-b-2 border-transparent font-medium text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200';
        return `<button type="button" data-savedview-tab="${escapeAttribute(view.id)}" class="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors ${cls}">${escapeAttribute(view.label)}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const chipsHtml = (active.filters || [])
      .map((f) => `<span data-savedview-filter="${escapeAttribute(f)}" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(f)}</span>`)
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-savedviews-bar class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-savedviews-tabs class="flex items-center gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 dark:border-zinc-800">${tabsHtml}</div>
        <div data-savedviews-body class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3">
          <span data-savedview-filters class="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">${chipsHtml || '<span data-savedview-nofilters class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No filters</span>'}</span>
          <span class="flex-1"></span>
          <button type="button" data-savedview-share class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(this._shareLabel)}</button>
          <button type="button" data-savedview-save class="rounded-md bg-violet-600 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-violet-500">${escapeAttribute(this._saveLabel)}</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('table-saved-views')) {
  customElements.define('table-saved-views', TableSavedViewsElement);
}

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

/**
 * Tabs - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tabs-bar active-id="overview" variant="underline"></tabs-bar>
 * Properties: tabs (TabItem[])
 * Events: change (detail: { id })
 */
export class TabsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['active-id', 'variant', 'aria-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tabs = [];
    this._internalId = null;
  }

  get tabs() {
    return this._tabs;
  }

  set tabs(value) {
    this._tabs = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    if (this._internalId === null) this._internalId = this._tabs[0] ? this._tabs[0].id : '';
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  _current() {
    return this.getAttribute('active-id') ?? this._internalId ?? '';
  }

  _select(tab) {
    if (!tab || tab.disabled) return;
    if (!this.hasAttribute('active-id')) this._internalId = tab.id;
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('change', { detail: { id: tab.id } }));
  }

  _move(event, index) {
    const keys = ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'];
    if (!keys.includes(event.key)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const enabled = this._tabs.map((tab, i) => ({ tab, i })).filter((entry) => !entry.tab.disabled);
    if (enabled.length === 0) return;
    const position = enabled.findIndex((entry) => entry.i === index);
    let next = position;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (position + 1) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (position - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
    if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
    if (event.key === 'End') next = enabled.length - 1;
    const target = enabled[next];
    if (target) {
      this._select(target.tab);
      const node = this.querySelector(`[data-tab-id="${target.tab.id}"]`);
      if (node) node.focus();
    }
  }

  render() {
    const pills = this.getAttribute('variant') === 'pills';
    this._applyHostClass(pills ? 'inline-flex' : 'flex');

    const current = this._current();
    const label = this.getAttribute('aria-label') || 'Tabs';

    const buttons = this._tabs
      .map((tab, index) => {
        const active = tab.id === current;
        const tone = pills
          ? active
            ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
            : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
          : active
            ? '-mb-px border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400'
            : '-mb-px border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200';
        const shape = pills ? 'rounded-md px-3 py-1.5' : 'border-b-2 px-3 py-2';
        return `<button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" data-tab-id="${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}"
          aria-selected="${active}" aria-controls="panel-${escapeAttribute(tab.id)}" tabindex="${active ? 0 : -1}"
          ${tab.disabled ? 'disabled' : ''}
          class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${shape} ${tone}">
          ${tab.icon ? uiIcon(tab.icon, { size: 13 }) : ''}
          <span>${escapeAttribute(tab.label)}</span>
          ${tab.badge !== undefined ? `<span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tab.badge)}</span>` : ''}
        </button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div role="tablist" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label)}" class="${
      pills
        ? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800'
        : 'flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
    }">${buttons}</div>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-id]').forEach((node, index) => {
      const tab = this._tabs.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === node.getAttribute('data-tab-id'));
      node.addEventListener('click', () => this._select(tab));
      node.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => this._move(event, index));
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tabs-bar')) {
  customElements.define('tabs-bar', TabsElement);
}
export default TabsElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE = {
  neutral: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  amber: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300',
  rose: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',
  sky: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300',
};

/**
 * Tag - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <ui-tag label="v1.18" tone="indigo" removable></ui-tag>
 * Properties: label (string)
 * Attributes: label, tone, size (sm|md), icon, removable, clickable
 * Events: remove, tag-click
 */
export class TagElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'tone', 'size', 'icon', 'removable', 'clickable'];
  }

  get tone() {
    const value = this.getAttribute('tone');
    return TONE[value] ? value : 'neutral';
  }

  get size() {
    return this.getAttribute('size') === 'sm' ? 'sm' : 'md';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('inline-flex');
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const size = this.size;
    const removable = this.hasAttribute('removable');
    const clickable = this.hasAttribute('clickable');
    const icon = this.getAttribute('icon');
    const sizing = size === 'sm' ? 'px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9.5px]' : 'px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px]';
    const base = `inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-full font-medium ${TONE[this.tone]} ${sizing}`;
    const inner = `<span class="truncate">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>`;

    if (clickable) {
      this.innerHTML = `<button type="button" data-tag-root class="${base} cursor-pointer transition-opacity hover:opacity-80 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
        ${icon ? uiIcon(icon, { size: size === 'sm' ? 10 : 11, className: 'shrink-0 opacity-70' }) : ''}
        ${inner}
        ${removable ? `<span data-tag-remove role="button" aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(label)}" class="-mr-0.5 shrink-0 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors hover:bg-black/10 dark:hover:bg-white/10">${uiIcon('x', { size: size === 'sm' ? 9 : 10 })}</span>` : ''}
      </button>`;
    } else {
      this.innerHTML = `<span class="${base}">
        ${icon ? uiIcon(icon, { size: size === 'sm' ? 10 : 11, className: 'shrink-0 opacity-70' }) : ''}
        ${inner}
        ${removable ? `<button type="button" data-tag-remove aria-label="Remove ${escapeAttribute(label)}" class="-mr-0.5 shrink-0 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors hover:bg-black/10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-current dark:hover:bg-white/10">${uiIcon('x', { size: size === 'sm' ? 9 : 10 })}</button>` : ''}
      </span>`;
    }

    const remove = this.querySelector('[data-tag-remove]');
    if (remove) {
      remove.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('remove'));
      });
    }
    if (clickable) {
      this.querySelector('[data-tag-root]').addEventListener('click', () => {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tag-click'));
      });
    }
  }
}

  customElements.define('ui-tag', TagElement);
}
