/**
 * ToolSchemaEditor - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tool-schema-editor title="Tools & functions"></tool-schema-editor>
 * Property: tools ([{id, name, description?, method?, endpoint?, parameters?: [{name, type, required?}]}])
 * Attributes: title
 * Events: validate (detail {tool}), toggle (detail {tool, enabled})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class ToolSchemaEditorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._tools = [];
    this._disabled = {};
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const validateBtn = event.target.closest('[data-tool-validate]');
        if (validateBtn) {
          const card = validateBtn.closest('[data-tool-card]');
          const tool = this._tools.find((t) => t.id === card?.getAttribute('data-tool-card'));
          if (tool) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('validate', { detail: { tool } }));
          return;
        }
        const toggleBtn = event.target.closest('[data-tool-toggle]');
        if (toggleBtn) {
          const card = toggleBtn.closest('[data-tool-card]');
          const id = card?.getAttribute('data-tool-card');
          const tool = this._tools.find((t) => t.id === id);
          if (tool) {
            const enabled = !!this._disabled[id];
            this._disabled[id] = !enabled;
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle', { detail: { tool, enabled } }));
            this.render();
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get tools() { return this._tools; }
  set tools(v) {
    this._tools = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((t) => ({ ...t })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    // Fires before connectedCallback when an already-connected element upgrades;
    // rendering then would wipe light-DOM children before tools are captured.
    if (this._tools.length === 0 && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Tools & functions');
    const enabledCount = this._tools.filter((t) => !this._disabled[t.id]).length;

    const TYPE_BADGE = {
      string: 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300',
      number: 'bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300',
      boolean: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300',
    };

    const cards = this._tools.map((tool) => {
      const off = !!this._disabled[tool.id];
      const params = (tool.parameters || []).map((param) =>
        `<span data-tool-param="${escapeAttribute(param.name)}" class="flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold ${TYPE_BADGE[param.type] || TYPE_BADGE.string}">${escapeAttribute(param.name)}<span class="font-normal opacity-70">${escapeAttribute(param.type)}</span>${param.required ? '<span class="font-bold text-red-500" title="required">*</span>' : ''}</span>`
      ).join('');
      return `
        <div data-tool-card="${escapeAttribute(tool.id)}" class="rounded-lg border px-3 py-3 transition-colors ${off ? 'border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 opacity-60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40' : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:border-zinc-700'}">
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div class="min-w-0">
              <p class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <code data-tool-name class="truncate font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(tool.name)}</code>
                ${tool.method ? `<span data-tool-method class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold ${tool.method === 'GET' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300'}">${escapeAttribute(tool.method)}</span>` : ''}
              </p>
              ${tool.endpoint ? `<code data-tool-endpoint class="mt-0.5 block truncate font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(tool.endpoint)}</code>` : ''}
              ${tool.description ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tool.description)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>
            <button type="button" data-tool-toggle aria-pressed="${!off}" title="${off ? 'Enable tool' : 'Disable tool'}" class="relative h-5 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors ${off ? 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600' : 'bg-indigo-600'}">
              <span class="absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all ${off ? 'left-0.5' : 'left-4'}"></span>
            </button>
          </div>
          ${params ? `<div data-tool-params class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">${params}</div>` : ''}
          <div class="mt-2 flex justify-end">
            <button type="button" data-tool-validate class="rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">Validate schema</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-tool-editor class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
    <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${title}</p>
    <span data-tool-count class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${enabledCount}/${this._tools.length} enabled</span>
  </div>
  <div class="mt-3 space-y-3">${cards}</div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tool-schema-editor')) {
  customElements.define('tool-schema-editor', ToolSchemaEditorElement);
}

export default ToolSchemaEditorElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\Tooltip.js =====

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const SIDE_CLASS = {
  top: 'bottom-full left-1/2 mb-1.5 -translate-x-1/2',
  bottom: 'top-full left-1/2 mt-1.5 -translate-x-1/2',
  left: 'right-full top-1/2 mr-1.5 -translate-y-1/2',
  right: 'left-full top-1/2 ml-1.5 -translate-y-1/2',
};

let tooltipSeq = 0;

/**
 * Tooltip - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tooltip-hint content="Save changes"><button>…</button></tooltip-hint>
 * Attributes: content, side (top|bottom|left|right)
 */
export class TooltipElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['content', 'side'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._content = null;
    this._side = null;
    this._tooltipId = `tooltip-${++tooltipSeq}`;
  }

  get content() {
    return this._content ?? this.getAttribute('content') ?? '';
  }

  set content(value) {
    this._content = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this.render();
  }

  get side() {
    const value = this._side ?? this.getAttribute('side') ?? 'top';
    return SIDE_CLASS[value] ? value : 'top';
  }

  set side(value) {
    this._side = value;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const existing = this.querySelector(`#${this._tooltipId}`);
    const slots = Array.from(this.childNodes).filter((node) => node !== existing);

    this._applyHostClass('group relative inline-flex');
    this.setAttribute('aria-describedby', this._tooltipId);

    this.innerHTML = `<span id="${this._tooltipId}" role="tooltip"
      class="pointer-events-none absolute z-30 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-white opacity-0 shadow-lg transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-within:opacity-100 dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900 ${SIDE_CLASS[this.side]}">${escapeAttribute(this.content)}</span>`;

    const tooltip = this.firstChild;
    slots.forEach((node) => this.insertBefore(node, tooltip));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tooltip-hint')) {
  customElements.define('tooltip-hint', TooltipElement);
}
export default TooltipElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\TopUpBalanceDialog.js =====

/**
 * TopUpBalanceDialog - Vanilla Web Component
 * Top-up dialog: Bill-to / Currency selects, amount input with quick-amount
 * chips, live "new balance" summary, min-amount validation, confirmed state.
 *
 * Usage: <topup-balance-dialog balance="6.68"></topup-balance-dialog>
 * Attributes: trigger-label, title, balance, currency-symbol, min-amount,
 *             confirm-label, cancel-label
 * Properties: billToOptions, currencies, quickAmounts
 * Events: topup-confirm (detail {billTo, currency, amount}), topup-cancel
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class TopUpBalanceDialogElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['trigger-label', 'title', 'balance', 'currency-symbol', 'min-amount', 'confirm-label', 'cancel-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._billToOptions = ['Acme Inc.'];
    this._currencies = ['USD', 'EUR', 'SGD'];
    this._quickAmounts = [50, 100, 250, 500];
    this._billTo = null;
    this._currency = null;
    this._amount = '';
    this._error = null;
    this._confirmed = null;
    this._open = false;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get billToOptions() {
    return this._billToOptions;
  }

  set billToOptions(value) {
    this._billToOptions = Array.isArray(value) && value.length ? value.map(String) : ['Acme Inc.'];
    if (!this._billTo) this._billTo = this._billToOptions[0];
    this.render();
  }

  get currencies() {
    return this._currencies;
  }

  set currencies(value) {
    this._currencies = Array.isArray(value) && value.length ? value.map(String) : ['USD', 'EUR', 'SGD'];
    if (!this._currency) this._currency = this._currencies[0];
    this.render();
  }

  get quickAmounts() {
    return this._quickAmounts;
  }

  set quickAmounts(value) {
    this._quickAmounts = Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(Number).filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n)) : [50, 100, 250, 500];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-topup-open]')) {
          this._open = true;
          this._confirmed = null;
          this._error = null;
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-topup-close]') || event.target.closest('[data-topup-done]')) {
          this._close();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-topup-cancel]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('topup-cancel'));
          this._close();
          return;
        }
        const quick = event.target.closest('[data-topup-quick-amount]');
        if (quick) {
          this._amount = quick.getAttribute('data-topup-quick-amount') || '';
          this._error = null;
          this.render();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-topup-confirm]')) {
          this._confirm();
          return;
        }
        if (event.target === this.querySelector('[data-topup-overlay]')) {
          this._close();
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const input = event.target.closest('[data-topup-amount]');
        if (!input) return;
        this._amount = input.value;
        this._error = null;
        this._updateSummary();
      });
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        const billTo = event.target.closest('[data-topup-billto]');
        if (billTo) {
          this._billTo = billTo.value;
          return;
        }
        const currency = event.target.closest('[data-topup-currency]');
        if (currency) this._currency = currency.value;
      });
    }
  }

  _close() {
    this._open = false;
    this._amount = '';
    this._error = null;
    this._confirmed = null;
    this.render();
  }

  get _parsed() {
    return Number.parseFloat(this._amount);
  }

  get _valid() {
    const min = Number.parseFloat(this.getAttribute('min-amount') || '10') || 10;
    return Number.isFinite(this._parsed) && this._parsed >= min;
  }

  _updateSummary() {
    const el = this.querySelector('[data-topup-summary-value]');
    if (!el) return;
    const symbol = this.getAttribute('currency-symbol') || '$';
    const balance = Number.parseFloat(this.getAttribute('balance') || '0') || 0;
    const next = balance + (this._valid ? this._parsed : 0);
    el.textContent = `${symbol}${next.toFixed(2)}`;
  }

  _confirm() {
    if (!this._valid) {
      const min = Number.parseFloat(this.getAttribute('min-amount') || '10') || 10;
      const symbol = this.getAttribute('currency-symbol') || '$';
      this._error = `Minimum top-up is ${symbol}${min.toFixed(2)}`;
      this.render();
      return;
    }
    const billTo = this._billTo || this._billToOptions[0] || '';
    const currency = this._currency || this._currencies[0] || 'USD';
    this._confirmed = { billTo, currency, amount: this._parsed };
    this.render();
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent('topup-confirm', {
        detail: { billTo, currency, amount: this._parsed },
      }),
    );
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Top up balance';
    const trigger = this.getAttribute('trigger-label') || title;
    const symbol = this.getAttribute('currency-symbol') || '$';
    const min = Number.parseFloat(this.getAttribute('min-amount') || '10') || 10;
    const confirmLabel = this.getAttribute('confirm-label') || 'Confirm top-up';
    const cancelLabel = this.getAttribute('cancel-label') || 'Cancel';
    const balance = Number.parseFloat(this.getAttribute('balance') || '0') || 0;

    const billTo = this._billTo || this._billToOptions[0] || '';
    const currency = this._currency || this._currencies[0] || 'USD';

    if (!this._open) {
      this.innerHTML = `
        <div data-topup-balance-dialog>
          <button type="button" data-topup-open class="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(trigger)}</button>
        </div>`;
      return;
    }

    if (this._confirmed) {
      this.innerHTML = `
        <div data-topup-balance-dialog>
          <button type="button" data-topup-open class="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(trigger)}</button>
          <div data-topup-overlay class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950/50 p-4">
            <div data-topup-panel role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}" class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
              <p data-topup-confirmed class="text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">Top-up confirmed</p>
              <p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(symbol)}${this._confirmed.amount.toFixed(2)} ${escapeAttribute(this._confirmed.currency)} billed to ${escapeAttribute(this._confirmed.billTo)}.</p>
              <div class="mt-3 flex justify-end">
                <button type="button" data-topup-done class="rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">Done</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      return;
    }

    const billToOptions = this._billToOptions
      .map((o) => `<option value="${escapeAttribute(o)}" ${o === billTo ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(o)}</option>`)
      .join('');
    const currencyOptions = this._currencies
      .map((c) => `<option value="${escapeAttribute(c)}" ${c === currency ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(c)}</option>`)
      .join('');
    const quickChips = this._quickAmounts
      .map((q) => {
        const active = Number.parseFloat(this._amount) === q;
        const cls = active
          ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-400'
          : 'border-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
        return `<button type="button" data-topup-quick-amount="${q}" class="rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors ${cls}">${escapeAttribute(symbol)}${q}</button>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const nextBalance = balance + (this._valid ? this._parsed : 0);
    const errorLine = this._error
      ? `<p data-topup-error role="alert" class="mt-2 text-[11px] font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">${escapeAttribute(this._error)}</p>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-topup-balance-dialog>
        <button type="button" data-topup-open class="rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500">${escapeAttribute(trigger)}</button>
        <div data-topup-overlay class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950/50 p-4">
          <div data-topup-panel role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}" class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">

/**
 * TourTooltip - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <tour-tooltip step="1" total-steps="4" title="…" body="…" theme="light|dark" caret="top|bottom|none" feedback></tour-tooltip>
 * Attributes: step, total-steps, title, body, theme, caret, feedback
 * Events: prev, next, dismiss, feedback (detail {helpful})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class TourTooltipElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['step', 'total-steps', 'title', 'body', 'theme', 'caret', 'feedback'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const step = Number(this.getAttribute('step')) || 1;
    const totalSteps = Number(this.getAttribute('total-steps')) || 1;
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || '';
    const body = this.getAttribute('body') || '';
    const dark = this.getAttribute('theme') === 'dark';
    const caret = this.getAttribute('caret') || 'top';
    const feedback = this.hasAttribute('feedback');

    const caretClass =
      caret === 'top'
        ? 'before:absolute before:-top-1.5 before:left-8 before:h-3 before:w-3 before:rotate-45 before:rounded-[2px] before:border-l before:border-t'
        : caret === 'bottom'
          ? 'after:absolute after:-bottom-1.5 after:left-8 after:h-3 after:w-3 after:rotate-45 after:rounded-[2px] after:border-r after:border-b'
          : '';
    const caretBorder = dark ? 'before:border-zinc-700 after:border-zinc-700' : 'before:border-zinc-200 after:border-zinc-200';
    const caretBg = dark ? 'before:bg-zinc-900 after:bg-zinc-900' : 'before:bg-white after:bg-white';
    const borderTone = dark ? 'border-zinc-700' : 'border-zinc-200';
    const surface = dark ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-50 border-zinc-700' : 'bg-white text-zinc-900 border-zinc-200';
    const bodyTone = dark ? 'text-zinc-300' : 'text-zinc-500';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-tour-tooltip role="dialog" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)}"
      class="relative w-80 rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-xl ${surface} ${caretClass} ${caretBorder} ${caretBg}">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <p class="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">Step ${step} of ${totalSteps}</p>
        <button type="button" data-tour-dismiss aria-label="Dismiss" class="rounded-md p-0.5 transition-colors ${dark ? 'text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-200' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600'}">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-4 w-4"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>
      <p class="mt-2 text-sm font-bold leading-snug">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
      <p class="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed ${bodyTone}">${escapeAttribute(body)}</p>
      <div class="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t pt-3 ${borderTone}">
        ${
          feedback
            ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span class="text-[11px] ${dark ? 'text-zinc-400' : 'text-zinc-500'}">Was this helpful?</span>
                <button type="button" data-tour-feedback-up aria-label="Yes" class="rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs transition-colors ${dark ? 'border-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-800' : 'border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50'}">👍</button>
                <button type="button" data-tour-feedback-down aria-label="No" class="rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs transition-colors ${dark ? 'border-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-800' : 'border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50'}">👎</button>
              </div>`
            : `<span class="text-[11px] ${dark ? 'text-zinc-400' : 'text-zinc-400'}">${step}/${totalSteps}</span>`
        }
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          ${step > 1 ? `<button type="button" data-tour-prev class="text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${dark ? 'text-zinc-300 hover:text-white' : 'text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900'}">Previous</button>` : ''}
          <button type="button" data-tour-next class="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
            step >= totalSteps ? 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500' : 'bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-indigo-600 dark:hover:bg-indigo-500'
          }">${step >= totalSteps ? 'Finish tour' : 'Next'}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;

    const on = (selector, eventName, detail) => {
      const node = this.querySelector(selector);
      if (node) node.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(eventName, detail ? { detail } : undefined)));
    };
    on('[data-tour-dismiss]', 'dismiss');
    on('[data-tour-prev]', 'prev');
    on('[data-tour-next]', 'next');
    on('[data-tour-feedback-up]', 'feedback', { helpful: true });
    on('[data-tour-feedback-down]', 'feedback', { helpful: false });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('tour-tooltip')) {
  customElements.define('tour-tooltip', TourTooltipElement);
}
export default TourTooltipElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\TraceSpanWaterfall.js =====

/**
 * TraceSpanWaterfall - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <trace-span-waterfall title="Trace waterfall" spans='[...]'></trace-span-waterfall>
 * Attributes: title, spans (JSON: [{id,name,startMs,durationMs,depth?,kind?,costUsd?,tokens?}])
 * Events: span-select (detail {span})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  try {
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (e) {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const kindDot = (kind) =>
  kind === 'tool' ? 'bg-emerald-500' : kind === 'retrieval' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-indigo-500';

const formatDuration = (ms) => (ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);

const formatCost = (usd) => (typeof usd === 'number' ? `$${usd.toFixed(3)}` : '');

export class TraceSpanWaterfallElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'spans'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._spans = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._spans.length) this._spans = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('spans'), []);
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const row = event.target.closest('[data-trace-row]');
        if (!row) return;
        const span = this._spans.find((s) => s.id === row.getAttribute('data-trace-row'));
        if (span) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('span-select', { detail: { span } }));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'spans' && !this._spans.length) {
      this._spans = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('spans'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  get spans() { return this._spans; }
  set spans(v) {
    this._spans = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((s) => ({ ...s })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const spans = this._spans;
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Trace waterfall');
    const total = spans.length > 0 ? Math.max(...spans.map((s) => s.startMs + s.durationMs)) : 0;

    const rows = spans.map((span) => {
      const depth = span.depth ?? 0;
      const left = total > 0 ? (span.startMs / total) * 100 : 0;
      const width = total > 0 ? Math.max((span.durationMs / total) * 100, 2) : 0;
      const cost = formatCost(span.costUsd);
      return `
      <button type="button" data-trace-row="${escapeAttribute(span.id)}" class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
        <span class="flex min-w-0 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200" style="width: ${Math.max(120 - depth * 14, 88)}px; padding-left: ${depth * 14}px;">
          <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${kindDot(span.kind)}"></span>
          <span data-trace-name class="min-w-0 truncate">${escapeAttribute(span.name)}</span>
        </span>
        <span class="relative h-4 min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span data-trace-bar class="absolute top-0.5 h-3 rounded-full ${kindDot(span.kind)}" style="left: ${left}%; width: ${width}%;"></span>
          <span class="absolute top-0.5 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" style="left: calc(${left}% + ${width}% + 6px);">${formatDuration(span.durationMs)}${cost ? ` · ${cost}` : ''}</span>
        </span>
      </button>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-trace-waterfall class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
  <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
    <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${title}</span>
    <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${spans.length} spans · ${formatDuration(total)}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="px-4 py-2">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-4 pb-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500"></span> LLM</span>
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span> Tool</span>
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span> Retrieval</span>
    </div>
    <div data-trace-rows class="space-y-1.5">${rows}</div>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('trace-span-waterfall')) {
  customElements.define('trace-span-waterfall', TraceSpanWaterfallElement);
}

export default TraceSpanWaterfallElement;

/**
 * TrialBanner - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <trial-banner days-left="11" plan-name="Pro"></trial-banner>
 * Attributes: plan-name, days-left, message, cta-text, tone (indigo|amber), dismissible
 * Events: cta, dismiss
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const CLOSE_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="12" height="12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 5 10 10M15 5 5 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';

export class TrialBannerElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['plan-name', 'days-left', 'message', 'cta-text', 'tone'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._hidden = false;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-trial-cta]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cta'));
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-trial-dismiss]')) {
          this._hidden = true;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  show() {
    this._hidden = false;
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (!this._hidden) this.render();
  }

  render() {
    if (this._hidden) {
      this.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const planName = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('plan-name') || 'Pro');
    const daysLeft = Number(this.getAttribute('days-left')) || 0;
    const message = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('message') || `Your ${planName} trial ends soon — upgrade to keep ${planName} features.`);
    const ctaText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('cta-text') || 'Upgrade now');
    const tone = this.getAttribute('tone') || 'indigo';
    const dismissible = this.hasAttribute('dismissible');
    const urgent = daysLeft <= 3;
    const toneClass = tone === 'amber'
      ? 'border-amber-200 bg-amber-50'
      : 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50';
    const pillClass = tone === 'amber' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-indigo-600';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-trial-banner class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 ${toneClass}">
  <span data-trial-days class="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-white ${pillClass} ${urgent ? 'animate-pulse' : ''}">${daysLeft} ${daysLeft === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'} left</span>
  <span data-trial-message class="flex-1 text-sm text-zinc-800">${message}</span>
  <button type="button" data-trial-cta class="rounded-md bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700">${ctaText}</button>
  ${dismissible ? `<button type="button" data-trial-dismiss title="Dismiss" class="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-zinc-700">${CLOSE_SVG}</button>` : ''}
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('trial-banner')) {
  customElements.define('trial-banner', TrialBannerElement);
}

export default TrialBannerElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\TypingIndicator.js =====

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class TypingIndicatorElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'variant', 'size'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(layoutClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = layoutClass;
    const next = `${layoutClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'dots';
    const size = this.getAttribute('size') || 'md';

    const dotClass = size === 'sm' ? 'w-1.5 h-1.5' : size === 'lg' ? 'w-2.5 h-2.5' : 'w-2 h-2';
    const gapClass = size === 'sm' ? 'gap-1' : size === 'lg' ? 'gap-2' : 'gap-1.5';
    const animClass = variant === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : 'animate-bounce';

    const dots = [0, 1, 2]
      .map(
        (i) =>
          `<span class="${dotClass} rounded-full bg-current ${animClass}" style="animation-delay: ${i * 160}ms"></span>`
      )
      .join('');

    this._applyHostClass('inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400');
    this.setAttribute('role', 'status');
    this.setAttribute('aria-label', label || 'Loading');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <span class="inline-flex items-center ${gapClass}">${dots}</span>
      ${label ? `<span class="text-xs font-sans">${escapeAttribute(label)}</span>` : ''}
    `;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('typing-indicator')) {
  customElements.define('typing-indicator', TypingIndicatorElement);
}
export default TypingIndicatorElement;

const escapeAttribute = (value) => String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' }[char]));

export function uiIcon(name, { size = 20, strokeWidth = 1.8, label = '', className = '' } = {}) {
  const aria = label ? `aria-label="${escapeAttribute(label)}"` : 'aria-hidden="true"';
  return `<svg width="${escapeAttribute(size)}" height="${escapeAttribute(size)}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="${escapeAttribute(strokeWidth)}" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="${escapeAttribute(className)}" ${aria}>${ICONS[name] || ''}</svg>`;
}
export default uiIcon;

/**
 * UpgradeCheckoutPanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <upgrade-checkout-panel line-items='[...]' total="$405.00" seats="5"></upgrade-checkout-panel>
 * Attributes: title, plan-name, billing-period (monthly|annual), seats, min-seats, max-seats,
 *             line-items (JSON [{id,label,amount,muted?,strikethrough?}]), total-label, total, total-note,
 *             discount-label, discount, confirm-text, terms
 * Property: lineItems
 * Events: billing-period-change (detail.period), seats-change (detail.seats), confirm
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class UpgradeCheckoutPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'plan-name', 'billing-period', 'seats', 'line-items', 'total-label', 'total', 'total-note', 'discount', 'confirm-text', 'terms'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._lineItems = [];
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._lineItems.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('line-items');
      if (raw) { try { this._lineItems = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { this._lineItems = []; } }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const periodBtn = event.target.closest('[data-checkout-period]');
        if (periodBtn) {
          const period = periodBtn.getAttribute('data-checkout-period');
          this.setAttribute('billing-period', period);
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('billing-period-change', { detail: { period } }));
          return;
        }
        const seats = Number(this.getAttribute('seats'));
        if (!Number.isNaN(seats) && this.getAttribute('seats') !== null) {
          const min = Number(this.getAttribute('min-seats')) || 1;
          const max = Number(this.getAttribute('max-seats')) || 99;
          if (event.target.closest('[data-checkout-seat-minus]')) {
            const next = Math.max(min, seats - 1);
            // read next BEFORE setAttribute (attributeChangedCallback re-renders synchronously)
            this.setAttribute('seats', String(next));
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seats-change', { detail: { seats: next } }));
            return;
          }
          if (event.target.closest('[data-checkout-seat-plus]')) {
            const next = Math.min(max, seats + 1);
            this.setAttribute('seats', String(next));
            this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('seats-change', { detail: { seats: next } }));
            return;
          }
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-checkout-confirm]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('confirm'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  get lineItems() { return this._lineItems; }
  set lineItems(v) {
    this._lineItems = Array.isArray(v) ? v : [];
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'line-items' && this.getAttribute(name)) {
      try { this._lineItems = JSON.parse(this.getAttribute(name)); } catch { /* keep */ }
    }
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const title = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('title') || 'Upgrade to the Teams plan');
    const planName = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('plan-name') || 'Teams');
    const period = this.getAttribute('billing-period') || 'annual';
    const seatsAttr = this.getAttribute('seats');
    const totalLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total-label') || 'Total billed today');
    const total = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total') || '');
    const totalNote = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('total-note') || '');
    const discount = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('discount') || '');
    const discountLabel = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('discount-label') || 'Discount');
    const confirmText = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('confirm-text') || 'Confirm upgrade');
    const terms = escapeAttribute(this.getAttribute('terms') || '');

    const periodBtn = (p, label) => `
      <button type="button" data-checkout-period="${p}" class="rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium capitalize transition-colors ${period === p ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800'}">${label}</button>`;

    const seatsBlock = seatsAttr !== null && seatsAttr !== undefined && seatsAttr !== '' ? `
      <p class="mt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">Seats</p>
      <div data-checkout-seats class="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3">
        <button type="button" data-checkout-seat-minus title="Fewer seats" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5.5 9.25h9v1.5h-9v-1.5Z"/></svg>
        </button>
        <span data-checkout-seat-count class="min-w-8 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">${escapeAttribute(seatsAttr)}</span>
        <button type="button" data-checkout-seat-plus title="More seats" class="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:border-zinc-400">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9.25 5.5h1.5v3.75h3.75v1.5h-3.75v3.75h-1.5v-3.75H5.5v-1.5h3.75V5.5Z"/></svg>
        </button>
        <span class="text-xs text-zinc-500">${planName} plan · ${period === 'annual' ? 'billed annually' : 'billed monthly'}</span>
      </div>` : '';

    const items = this._lineItems.map((item) => `
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
        <span class="text-zinc-600">${escapeAttribute(item.label)}</span>
        <span class="font-medium ${item.strikethrough ? 'text-zinc-400 line-through' : 'text-zinc-900'} ${item.muted ? 'text-zinc-400' : ''}">${escapeAttribute(item.amount)}</span>
      </div>`).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-upgrade-checkout class="grid gap-6 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-6 md:grid-cols-[1.2fr_1fr]">
  <div>
    <h3 data-checkout-title class="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900">${title}</h3>
    <p class="mt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900">Billing cadence</p>
    <div class="mt-2 inline-flex rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-0.5">${periodBtn('monthly', 'Monthly plan')}${periodBtn('annual', 'Annual plan')}</div>
    ${seatsBlock}
  </div>
  <div data-checkout-summary class="rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 p-4">
    <div class="space-y-2.5">${items}
    </div>
    <div class="mt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-3">
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm font-semibold">
        <span class="text-zinc-900">${totalLabel}</span>
        <span data-checkout-total class="text-zinc-900">${total}</span>
      </div>
      ${discount ? `<div class="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
        <span class="text-emerald-600">${discountLabel}</span>
        <span data-checkout-discount class="font-medium text-emerald-600">${discount}</span>
      </div>` : ''}
      ${totalNote ? `<p class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">${totalNote}</p>` : ''}
    </div>
    ${terms ? `<p class="mt-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500">${terms}</p>` : ''}
    <button type="button" data-checkout-confirm class="mt-4 w-full rounded-md bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500">${confirmText}</button>
  </div>
</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('upgrade-checkout-panel')) {
  customElements.define('upgrade-checkout-panel', UpgradeCheckoutPanelElement);
}

export default UpgradeCheckoutPanelElement;

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const formatNumber = (value) => (typeof value === 'number' ? value.toLocaleString('en-US') : String(value));

export class UpgradePromptCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['used', 'limit', 'plan-name', 'unit', 'title', 'features', 'cta-text'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  get features() {
    if (this._features) return this._features;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(this.getAttribute('features') || '[]');
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  set features(value) {
    this._features = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const used = Number(this.getAttribute('used') || 0);
    const limit = Number(this.getAttribute('limit') || 0);
    const planName = this.getAttribute('plan-name') || 'Free';
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || 'requests';
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Upgrade to keep going';
    const ctaText = this.getAttribute('cta-text') || 'See plans';
    const features = this.features;

    const safeLimit = limit > 0 ? limit : 1;
    const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((used / safeLimit) * 100)));
    const tone =
      percent >= 90
        ? { bar: 'bg-red-500', text: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40' }
        : percent >= 70
          ? { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40' }
          : { bar: 'bg-emerald-500', text: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40' };

    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const featureItems = features
      .map(
        (feature) => `
        <li class="flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
          <span class="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-500">${uiIcon('check', { size: 12 })}</span>
          <span>${escapeAttribute(feature)}</span>
        </li>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4">
        <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${tone.chip} ${tone.text}">${uiIcon('zap', { size: 16 })}</span>
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(title)}</div>
            <div class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">You're on the ${escapeAttribute(planName)} plan — ${percent}% of your ${escapeAttribute(unit)} used.</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-3 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <div class="h-full rounded-full ${tone.bar} transition-all duration-300" style="width: ${percent}%"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span class="tabular-nums">${formatNumber(used)} / ${formatNumber(limit)} ${escapeAttribute(unit)}</span>
          <span class="ml-auto tabular-nums ${tone.text}">${percent}%</span>
        </div>

        ${featureItems ? `<ul class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">${featureItems}</ul>` : ''}

        <button type="button"
          class="upgrade-cta mt-3 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900">
          ${escapeAttribute(ctaText)}
        </button>
      </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.upgrade-cta').addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('upgrade')));
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('upgrade-prompt-card')) {
  customElements.define('upgrade-prompt-card', UpgradePromptCardElement);
}

===== FILE: vanilla\UsageCreditsDonut.js =====

/**
 * UsageCreditsDonut - Vanilla Web Component
 * Pure-SVG donut of credit usage by type: palette arcs with gaps,
 * hover-linked legend, dynamic center text and a range dropdown.
 *
 * Usage: <usage-credits-donut title="Usage by Type"></usage-credits-donut>
 * Properties: slices ([{id,label,value,color?}]), total, ranges, defaultRange
 * Attributes: title, unit, total
 * Events: range-change (detail {range})
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const PALETTE = ['#6366f1', '#22c55e', '#f59e0b', '#ec4899', '#06b6d4', '#a855f7'];
const DEFAULT_RANGES = ['Last 7 days', 'Last 30 days'];

export class UsageCreditsDonutElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'unit', 'total'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._slices = [];
    this._ranges = DEFAULT_RANGES;
    this._defaultRange = '';
    this._range = '';
    this._active = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get slices() {
    return this._slices;
  }

  set slices(value) {
    this._slices = Array.isArray(value) ? value.map((s) => ({ ...s })) : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get ranges() {
    return this._ranges;
  }

  set ranges(value) {
    this._ranges = Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(String) : DEFAULT_RANGES;
    this.render();
  }

  get defaultRange() {
    return this._defaultRange;
  }

  set defaultRange(value) {
    this._defaultRange = value == null ? '' : String(value);
    this._range = this._defaultRange || this._ranges[0] || '';
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._range) this._range = this._defaultRange || this._ranges[0] || '';
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
        const select = event.target.closest('[data-usage-donut-range]');
        if (!select) return;
        this._range = select.value;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('range-change', { detail: { range: this._range } }));
      });
      this.addEventListener('mouseover', (event) => {
        const slice = event.target.closest('[data-usage-donut-slice]');
        const path = event.target.closest('[data-usage-donut-arc]');
        const id = slice ? slice.getAttribute('data-usage-donut-slice') : path ? path.getAttribute('data-usage-donut-arc') : null;
        if (id !== this._active) {
          this._active = id;
          this._refreshActive();
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('mouseout', () => {
        if (this._active !== null) {
          this._active = null;
          this._refreshActive();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  _sum() {
    const totalAttr = this.getAttribute('total');
    if (totalAttr !== null) return Number(totalAttr) || 0;
    return this._slices.reduce((acc, s) => acc + (Number(s.value) || 0), 0);
  }

  _colored() {
    return this._slices.map((s, i) => ({ ...s, color: s.color || PALETTE[i % PALETTE.length] }));
  }

  _polar(r, deg) {
    const rad = ((deg - 90) * Math.PI) / 180;
    return [80 + r * Math.cos(rad), 80 + r * Math.sin(rad)];
  }

  _donutArc(startDeg, endDeg) {
    const [x1, y1] = this._polar(70, startDeg);
    const [x2, y2] = this._polar(70, endDeg);
    const [x3, y3] = this._polar(44, endDeg);
    const [x4, y4] = this._polar(44, startDeg);
    const large = endDeg - startDeg > 180 ? 1 : 0;
    return [
      `M ${x1.toFixed(2)} ${y1.toFixed(2)}`,
      `A 70 70 0 ${large} 1 ${x2.toFixed(2)} ${y2.toFixed(2)}`,
      `L ${x3.toFixed(2)} ${y3.toFixed(2)}`,
      `A 44 44 0 ${large} 0 ${x4.toFixed(2)} ${y4.toFixed(2)}`,
      'Z',
    ].join(' ');
  }

  _refreshActive() {
    const sum = this._sum();
    const colored = this._colored();
    const activeSlice = this._active ? colored.find((s) => s.id === this._active) : null;
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || 'credits';
    const nameEl = this.querySelector('[data-usage-donut-center-name]');
    const valueEl = this.querySelector('[data-usage-donut-center-value]');
    if (nameEl) {
      nameEl.textContent = activeSlice ? activeSlice.label : `${((((colored[0] || {}).value) || 0) / (sum || 1) * 100).toFixed(0)}%`;
    }
    if (valueEl) {
      valueEl.textContent = activeSlice ? `${activeSlice.value} ${unit}` : unit;
    }
    this.querySelectorAll('[data-usage-donut-arc]').forEach((p) => {
      const id = p.getAttribute('data-usage-donut-arc');
      p.setAttribute('opacity', this._active && this._active !== id ? '0.35' : '1');
    });
  }

  render() {
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Usage by Type';
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || 'credits';
    const sum = this._sum();
    const colored = this._colored();

    let angle = 0;
    const paths = colored.map((s) => {
      const sweep = sum > 0 ? ((Number(s.value) || 0) / sum) * 360 : 0;
      const start = angle;
      const end = angle + sweep;
      angle = end;
      return { id: s.id, color: s.color, path: this._donutArc(start, Math.max(end - 0.6, start + 0.1)) };
    }).map((p) =>
      `<path data-usage-donut-arc="${escapeAttribute(p.id)}" d="${p.path}" fill="${p.color}" opacity="${this._active && this._active !== p.id ? '0.35' : '1'}"></path>`
    ).join('');

    const emptyRing = sum <= 0
      ? `<circle cx="80" cy="80" r="57" fill="none" stroke="#e4e4e7" stroke-width="26" class="dark:opacity-20"></circle>`
      : '';

    const legend = colored.map((s) => {
      const pct = sum > 0 ? `${(((Number(s.value) || 0) / sum) * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : '—';
      return `<li data-usage-donut-slice="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
          <span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-sm" style="background-color:${escapeAttribute(s.color)}"></span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(s.label)}</span>
          <span class="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(s.value)}</span>
          <span class="w-10 text-right text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${pct}</span>
        </li>`;
    }).join('');

    const rangeOptions = this._ranges.map((r) =>
      `<option value="${escapeAttribute(r)}" ${r === this._range ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeAttribute(r)}</option>`
    ).join('');

    const activeSlice = this._active ? colored.find((s) => s.id === this._active) : null;
    const centerName = activeSlice ? activeSlice.label : `${((((colored[0] || {}).value) || 0) / (sum || 1) * 100).toFixed(0)}%`;
    const centerValue = activeSlice ? `${activeSlice.value} ${unit}` : unit;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-usage-donut class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <p data-usage-donut-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(title)}</p>
          ${this._ranges.length > 0 ? `<select data-usage-donut-range class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300">${rangeOptions}</select>` : ''}
        </div>
        <p data-usage-donut-total class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${sum.toFixed(2)} ${escapeAttribute(unit)}</p>

        <div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
          <svg data-usage-donut-chart width="160" height="160" viewBox="0 0 160 160" role="img" aria-label="${escapeAttribute(title)} donut chart">
            ${paths}${emptyRing}
            <text data-usage-donut-center-name x="80" y="78" text-anchor="middle" class="fill-zinc-900 text-sm font-semibold dark:fill-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(centerName)}</text>
            <text data-usage-donut-center-value x="80" y="94" text-anchor="middle" class="fill-zinc-400 text-[10px]">${escapeAttribute(centerValue)}</text>
          </svg>

          <ul data-usage-donut-legend class="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1.5">
            ${legend || '<li data-usage-donut-empty class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No usage recorded</li>'}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

export default UsageCreditsDonutElement;

if (!customElements.get('usage-credits-donut')) {
  customElements.define('usage-credits-donut', UsageCreditsDonutElement);

===== FILE: vanilla\UsageMeter.js =====

import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const TONE = {
  ok: { bar: 'bg-indigo-500', text: 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' },
  warning: { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' },
  danger: { bar: 'bg-rose-500', text: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' },
};

export const usageTone = (used, limit) => {
  if (limit <= 0) return 'danger';
  const ratio = used / limit;
  if (ratio >= 0.9) return 'danger';
  if (ratio >= 0.7) return 'warning';
  return 'ok';
};

/**
 * UsageMeter - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <usage-meter label="Context window" used="68500" limit="128000" unit="tokens"></usage-meter>
 * Attributes: label, used, limit, unit, show-legend
 */
export class UsageMeterElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['label', 'used', 'limit', 'unit', 'show-legend'];
  }

  get label() {
    return this.getAttribute('label') || '';
  }

  get used() {
    const value = Number(this.getAttribute('used'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  }

  get limit() {
    const value = Number(this.getAttribute('limit'));
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  }

  get unit() {
    return this.getAttribute('unit') || '';
  }

  get showLegend() {
    return this.getAttribute('show-legend') !== 'false';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const used = this.used;
    const limit = this.limit;
    const tone = usageTone(used, limit);
    const styles = TONE[tone];
    const ratio = limit > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, used / limit)) : 1;
    const percent = Math.round(ratio * 100);
    const remaining = Math.max(0, limit - used);

    const legend =
      remaining > 0
        ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1">${uiIcon('clock', { size: 10 })} ${remaining.toLocaleString()} left</span>`
        : '<span class="font-semibold text-rose-500">Limit reached</span>';

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
        <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(this.label)}</p>
        <p class="text-xs font-bold tabular-nums ${styles.text}">${percent}%</p>
      </div>
      <div class="mt-2 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div class="h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-500 ${styles.bar}" style="width:${ratio * 100}%"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <span>${used.toLocaleString()} / ${limit.toLocaleString()}${this.unit ? ` ${escapeAttribute(this.unit)}` : ''}</span>
        ${this.showLegend ? legend : ''}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('usage-meter')) {
  customElements.define('usage-meter', UsageMeterElement);
}
export default UsageMeterElement;

/**
 * UsagePricingBreakdown - Metered usage pricing: tiered unit-price table
 * (range / usage / unit price / subtotal) with the current tier highlighted
 * and an estimated total footer (usage-based billing pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_TIERS = () => [
  { range: 'First 10,000', unit: 'requests', usage: 9420, unitPrice: 0.002 },
  { range: '10,001 – 50,000', unit: 'requests', usage: 18340, unitPrice: 0.0012 },
  { range: '50,001 – 200,000', unit: 'requests', usage: 0, unitPrice: 0.0008 },
];

const toNumber = (value, fallback = 0) => {
  const n = Number.parseFloat(String(value ?? ''));
  return Number.isNaN(n) ? fallback : n;
};

const fmtMoney = (n) => n.toFixed(2);

class UsagePricingBreakdownElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'currency', 'tiers', 'footer-note'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._title = 'Usage this cycle';
    this._currency = 'USD';
    this._tiers = DEFAULT_TIERS();
    this._footerNote = 'Estimated charges based on metered usage to date.';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const t = this.getAttribute('title');
    if (t) this._title = t;
    const c = this.getAttribute('currency');
    if (c) this._currency = c;
    const f = this.getAttribute('footer-note');
    if (f !== null) this._footerNote = f;
    this._tiers = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('tiers'), DEFAULT_TIERS());
    this._render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'Usage this cycle';
    if (name === 'currency') this._currency = newValue || 'USD';
    if (name === 'footer-note') this._footerNote = newValue ?? '';
    if (name === 'tiers') this._tiers = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_TIERS());
    this._render();
  }

  get tiers() { return this._tiers; }
  set tiers(value) { this._tiers = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _render() {
    const tiers = Array.isArray(this._tiers) ? this._tiers : [];
    let total = 0;
    const rowsHtml = tiers
      .map((tier, index) => {
        const usage = Math.max(0, toNumber(tier.usage));
        const unitPrice = Math.max(0, toNumber(tier.unitPrice));
        const subtotal = usage * unitPrice;
        total += subtotal;
        const current = usage > 0;
        const rowCls = current
          ? 'border-b border-zinc-50 bg-violet-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:bg-violet-950/30'
          : 'border-b border-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60';
        return `<tr data-pricing-tier="${index}" class="${rowCls} transition-colors last:border-b-0">
          <td data-pricing-range="${escapeAttribute(tier.range)}" class="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(tier.range)} <span class="ml-1 text-[11px] font-normal text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(tier.unit || '')}</span></td>
          <td data-pricing-usage="${usage}" class="px-2 py-3 text-right font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${usage.toLocaleString()}</td>
          <td data-pricing-unit-price="${unitPrice}" class="px-2 py-3 text-right font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._currency)} ${unitPrice.toFixed(4)}</td>
          <td data-pricing-subtotal="${fmtMoney(subtotal)}" class="px-5 py-3 text-right font-mono font-semibold ${current ? 'text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300' : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500'}">${escapeAttribute(this._currency)} ${fmtMoney(subtotal)}</td>
        </tr>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const noteHtml = this._footerNote
      ? `<p data-pricing-note class="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-4 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(this._footerNote)}</p>`
      : '';

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-pricing-breakdown class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-pricing-header class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-pricing-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <span data-pricing-currency class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._currency)}</span>
        </div>
        <table data-pricing-table-body class="w-full text-left text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
              <th class="px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold">Tier</th>
              <th class="px-2 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Usage</th>
              <th class="px-2 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Unit price</th>
              <th class="px-5 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Subtotal</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
        </table>
        <div data-pricing-footer class="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div>
            <p data-pricing-total-label class="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">Estimated total</p>
            ${noteHtml}
          </div>
          <span data-pricing-total-value class="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._currency)} ${fmtMoney(total)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('usage-pricing-breakdown')) {
  customElements.define('usage-pricing-breakdown', UsagePricingBreakdownElement);
}

export default UsagePricingBreakdownElement;

/**
 * UsageQuotaCard - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <usage-quota label="Credits Remaining" used="120" total="500" unit="credits"></usage-quota>
 * Attributes: variant (card|banner), label, used, total, unit, summary, upgrade-line, cta-label, cta-tone (dark|primary)
 * Events: cta
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class UsageQuotaCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['variant', 'label', 'used', 'total', 'unit', 'summary', 'upgrade-line', 'cta-label', 'cta-tone'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-quota-cta]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('cta'));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const banner = this.getAttribute('variant') === 'banner';
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
    const used = Number(this.getAttribute('used')) || 0;
    const total = Number(this.getAttribute('total')) || 0;
    const unit = this.getAttribute('unit') || '';
    const summary = this.getAttribute('summary') || '';
    const upgradeLine = this.getAttribute('upgrade-line') || '';
    const ctaLabel = this.getAttribute('cta-label') || 'Upgrade';
    const darkTone = (this.getAttribute('cta-tone') || 'dark') !== 'primary';

    const valueLabel = `${used}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ''}${total ? ` of ${total}${unit ? ` ${unit}` : ''}` : ''}`;
    const percent = total > 0 ? Math.round(((total - used) / total) * 100) : 0;
    const unitText = unit ? ` ${unit}` : '';

    if (banner) {
      this.innerHTML = `<div data-quota-banner class="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 dark:border-emerald-500/40 dark:bg-emerald-950/40">
        <p class="min-w-0 text-xs text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200">${escapeAttribute(summary)}</p>
        <button type="button" data-quota-cta class="shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-emerald-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-500">${escapeAttribute(ctaLabel)}</button>
      </div>`;
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-quota-card class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
      ${label ? `<p class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(label)}</p>` : ''}
      <p class="mt-1 text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(summary || valueLabel)}</p>
      ${
        total
          ? `<div class="mt-2 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"><div class="h-full rounded-full bg-sky-500 transition-all" style="width: ${percent}%"></div></div>`
          : ''
      }
      ${upgradeLine ? `<p class="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(upgradeLine)}</p>` : ''}
      <button type="button" data-quota-cta class="mt-3 w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
        darkTone
          ? 'bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white'
          : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500'
      }">${escapeAttribute(ctaLabel)}</button>
    </div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * VideoProjectSettings - Video project settings side panel: Chapters side
 * panel with bookmark icon and empty state + "Add a chapter" action, main
 * form with Title input, Description textarea, Thumbnail selector and a
 * storage usage badge
 * (Vimeo video project settings pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class VideoProjectSettingsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['panel-title', 'panel-empty-text', 'chapters', 'add-chapter-label', 'title-label', 'title-value', 'description-label', 'description-value', 'thumbnail-label', 'thumbnails', 'selected-thumbnail-id', 'storage-used', 'storage-total'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._selectedId = 't1';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._selectedId = this.getAttribute('selected-thumbnail-id') || 't1';
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.addEventListener('input', this._onInput);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.removeEventListener('input', this._onInput);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'selected-thumbnail-id') this._selectedId = newValue || 't1';
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    if (event.target.closest('[data-video-add-chapter]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('add-chapter', { bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const thumb = event.target.closest('[data-video-thumbnail]');
    if (thumb) {
      const id = thumb.getAttribute('data-video-thumbnail');
      this._selectedId = id;
      this._render();
      const found = this._thumbnails().find((t) => t.id === id);
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('thumbnail-select', { detail: { thumbnail: found }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _onInput(event) {
    const title = event.target.closest('[data-video-title-input]');
    if (title) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('title-change', { detail: { value: title.value }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const description = event.target.closest('[data-video-description-input]');
    if (description) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('description-change', { detail: { value: description.value }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _chapters() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('chapters'), []);
  }

  _thumbnails() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('thumbnails'), [
      { id: 't1', gradient: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-400 via-fuchsia-400 to-rose-400 dark:from-violet-700 dark:via-fuchsia-700 dark:to-rose-700' },
      { id: 't2', gradient: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-400 via-cyan-400 to-emerald-400 dark:from-sky-700 dark:via-cyan-700 dark:to-emerald-700' },
    ]);
  }

  _render() {
    const panelTitle = this.getAttribute('panel-title') || 'Chapters';
    const panelEmptyText = this.getAttribute('panel-empty-text') || 'Add chapters so your viewers can find specific parts of your video';
    const addChapterLabel = this.getAttribute('add-chapter-label') || 'Add a chapter';
    const titleLabel = this.getAttribute('title-label') || 'Title';
    const titleValue = this.getAttribute('title-value') || 'Video project';
    const descriptionLabel = this.getAttribute('description-label') || 'Description';
    const descriptionValue = this.getAttribute('description-value') || '';
    const thumbnailLabel = this.getAttribute('thumbnail-label') || 'Thumbnail';
    const storageUsed = this.getAttribute('storage-used') || '31MB';
    const storageTotal = this.getAttribute('storage-total') || '7TB';
    const chapters = this._chapters();
    const thumbnails = this._thumbnails();

    const chaptersHtml = chapters.length === 0
      ? `<p data-video-chapters-empty class="text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(panelEmptyText)}</p>`
      : `<ul data-video-chapter-list class="space-y-2">${chapters
          .map((chapter) => `<li data-video-chapter="${escapeAttribute(chapter.id)}" class="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900">
              <span class="font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(chapter.label)}</span>
              <span class="font-mono text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(chapter.timestamp)}</span>
            </li>`)
          .join('')}</ul>`;

    const thumbsHtml = thumbnails
      .map((thumb) => {
        const selected = thumb.id === this._selectedId;
        const ringCls = selected ? 'ring-2 ring-zinc-900 ring-offset-2 dark:ring-white dark:ring-offset-zinc-900' : 'opacity-80 hover:opacity-100';
        const gradient = thumb.gradient || 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700';

/**
 * VisionAnalysisCard - AI image-analysis structured reply block: key/value
 * attribute table rows and section headings like "Design Strengths" (Claude).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_SECTIONS = () => [
  {
    heading: 'Image Details',
    rows: [
      { key: 'Lighting', value: 'Strong overhead sunlight creating sharp shadows on sand; excellent clarity suggests midday conditions' },
      { key: 'Beach Activity', value: 'Scattered groups of swimmers and sunbathers distributed across the sand and shallow water' },
      { key: 'Wave Patterns', value: 'Multiple rolling waves with consistent whitecaps indicate moderate, consistent swell' },
    ],
  },
];

class VisionAnalysisCardElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['sections'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._sections = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._sections.length) {
      this._sections = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sections'), DEFAULT_SECTIONS());
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'sections' && !this._sections.length) {
      this._sections = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sections'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get sections() {
    return this._sections;
  }
  set sections(value) {
    this._sections = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const headingEl = event.target.closest('[data-vision-section-heading]');
    if (headingEl) {
      const section = this._sections.find((s) => s.heading === headingEl.getAttribute('data-vision-section-heading'));
      if (section) {
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('section-click', { detail: { section }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const sectionsHtml = this._sections
      .map(
        (section) => `
        <div data-vision-section class="mb-4 last:mb-0">
          <button type="button" data-vision-section-heading="${escapeAttribute(section.heading)}" class="mb-2 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:hover:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(section.heading)}</button>
          <dl data-vision-rows class="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
            ${section.rows
              .map(
                (row) => `
              <div data-vision-row="${escapeAttribute(row.key)}" class="grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,9rem)_1fr] gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60">
                <dt data-vision-row-key class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">${escapeAttribute(row.key)}</dt>
                <dd data-vision-row-value class="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(row.value)}</dd>
              </div>`
              )
              .join('')}
          </dl>
        </div>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-vision-analysis-card class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">${sectionsHtml}</div>`;
  }
}

  customElements.define('vision-analysis-card', VisionAnalysisCardElement);
}

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>

  idle: {
    label: 'Tap to speak',

    ring: 'bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/40',
    orb: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
