const BAR_COUNT = 9;

/**
 * VoiceModePanel - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <voice-mode-panel state="listening" transcript="Hey there"></voice-mode-panel>
 * Events: toggle, end
 */
export class VoiceModePanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['state', 'transcript', 'reply', 'show-end'];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');

    const rawState = this.getAttribute('state') || 'idle';
    const state = STATE_META[rawState] ? rawState : 'idle';
    const meta = STATE_META[state];
    const transcript = this.getAttribute('transcript') || '';
    const reply = this.getAttribute('reply') || '';
    const showEnd = this.hasAttribute('show-end');

    const animated = state === 'listening' || state === 'speaking';
    const bars = Array.from({ length: BAR_COUNT }, (_, index) => {
      const style = animated ? `animation-delay:${(index * 0.07).toFixed(2)}s;` : '';
      const cls = animated
        ? 'w-1 rounded-full animate-[voice-bar_0.9s_ease-in-out_infinite_alternate] bg-indigo-500'
        : 'w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700';
      return `<span class="${cls}" style="${style}"></span>`;
    }).join('');

    this.innerHTML = `<div class="flex flex-col items-center rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-6 py-8 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="relative flex h-28 w-28 items-center justify-center">
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-0 rounded-full ${meta.ring} ${animated ? 'animate-ping' : 'opacity-0'}"></span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-3 rounded-full ${meta.ring} opacity-60"></span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute inset-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${meta.inner}"></span>
        <button type="button" class="voice-toggle relative flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900 ${meta.orb}"
          aria-label="${state === 'idle' ? 'Start voice mode' : 'Stop voice mode'}" aria-pressed="${state !== 'idle'}">
          ${uiIcon(state === 'idle' ? 'mic' : 'square', { size: 24 })}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="mt-4 flex h-6 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">${bars}</div>

      <p class="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${meta.label}</p>
      <p class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${meta.hint}</p>

      ${transcript ? `<p class="mt-4 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">“${escapeAttribute(transcript)}”</p>` : ''}
      ${reply ? `<p class="mt-2 max-w-sm text-center text-xs leading-relaxed text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${escapeAttribute(reply)}</p>` : ''}

      ${
        showEnd
          ? `<button type="button" class="voice-end mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
              ${uiIcon('x', { size: 12 })}End voice session
            </button>`
          : ''
      }
    </div>`;

    this.querySelector('.voice-toggle').addEventListener('click', () => {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle'));
    });
    const end = this.querySelector('.voice-end');
    if (end) end.addEventListener('click', () => this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('end')));
  }
}

/**
 * VoiceOrb - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <voice-orb state="listening" size="md" muted="false"></voice-orb>
 * Attributes: state (listening|speaking|thinking|idle), label, hint, size (sm|md|lg), show-controls, muted
 * Events: toggle-mute, end
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class VoiceOrbElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['state', 'label', 'hint', 'size', 'show-controls', 'muted'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest('[data-voice-orb-mute]')) {
          const muted = this.getAttribute('muted') === 'true';
          this.setAttribute('muted', muted ? 'false' : 'true');
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('toggle-mute', { detail: { muted: !muted } }));
          return;
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-voice-orb-end]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('end'));
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this.render();
  }

  render() {
    const STATE = {
      listening: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-400 via-indigo-500 to-violet-600 animate-pulse',
      speaking: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-400 via-teal-500 to-cyan-600 animate-pulse',
      thinking: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-300 via-orange-400 to-rose-500 animate-pulse',
      idle: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-zinc-300 to-zinc-400 dark:from-zinc-600 dark:to-zinc-700',
    };
    const STATE_LABEL = {
      listening: 'Listening…',
      speaking: 'Speaking…',
      thinking: 'Thinking…',
      idle: 'Tap to talk',
    };
    const SIZE = { sm: 'h-20 w-20', md: 'h-36 w-36', lg: 'h-56 w-56' };
    const state = this.getAttribute('state') || 'idle';
    const label = this.getAttribute('label') || STATE_LABEL[state];
    const hint = this.getAttribute('hint');
    const size = SIZE[this.getAttribute('size')] || SIZE.md;
    const showControls = (this.getAttribute('show-controls') || 'true') !== 'false';
    const muted = this.getAttribute('muted') === 'true';
    const BARS = [10, 18, 26, 34, 26, 18, 10];
    const wave = state !== 'idle' ? `
      <div data-voice-orb-wave class="flex h-8 items-end gap-1" aria-hidden="true">
        ${BARS.map((h) => `<span class="w-1 rounded-full ${state === 'idle' ? 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600' : 'bg-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-400'}" style="height:${h}px"></span>`).join('')}
      </div>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-voice-orb class="flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
  <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
    <div data-voice-orb-disc data-orb-state="${escapeAttribute(state)}" class="${size} rounded-full ${STATE[state]} shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20"></div>
    ${wave}
    <p data-voice-orb-label class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(label)}</p>
    ${hint ? `<p class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(hint)}</p>` : ''}
  </div>
  ${showControls ? `<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
    <button type="button" data-voice-orb-mute aria-pressed="${muted}" class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${muted ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300' : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700'}">${muted ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute'}</button>
    <button type="button" data-voice-orb-end class="rounded-full bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-red-500">End call</button>
  </div>` : ''}
</div>`;
  }
}

/**
 * VoiceSessionHistory - ElevenLabs Voice "History" sidebar: session rows with
 * title, date/duration metadata, status badge and a replay button.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class VoiceSessionHistoryElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'sessions', 'empty-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._sessions = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._sessions.length) {
      this._sessions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sessions'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'sessions' && !this._sessions.length) {
      this._sessions = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('sessions'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get title() {
    return this.getAttribute('title') ?? 'History';
  }
  set title(value) {
    this.setAttribute('title', value);
  }

  get emptyLabel() {
    return this.getAttribute('empty-label') ?? 'No sessions yet.';
  }
  set emptyLabel(value) {
    this.setAttribute('empty-label', value);
  }

  get sessions() {
    return this._sessions;
  }
  set sessions(value) {
    this._sessions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const sessionEl = event.target.closest('[data-voice-session]');
    if (!sessionEl) return;
    const session = this._sessions.find((s) => String(s.id) === sessionEl.getAttribute('data-voice-session'));
    if (!session) return;
    if (event.target.closest('[data-voice-session-play]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('play', { detail: { session }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { session }, bubbles: true }));
  }

  _render() {
    const sessions = this._sessions;
    const active = sessions.filter((s) => s.status !== 'failed').length;
    const statusMeta = (s) => {
      if (s.status === 'failed') return ['bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400', 'Failed'];
      if (s.status === 'in-progress') return ['bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400', 'Running'];
      return ['bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-400', 'Completed'];
    };
    const rows = sessions.length
      ? sessions
          .map((s) => {
            const [statusClass, statusLabel] = statusMeta(s);
            const meta = [s.date, s.duration].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
            return `
          <div data-voice-session="${escapeAttribute(s.id)}" class="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5">
            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p data-voice-session-title class="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(s.title)}</p>
              <p data-voice-session-meta class="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(meta)}</p>
            </div>
            <span data-voice-session-status class="shrink-0 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${statusClass}">${statusLabel}</span>
            <button type="button" data-voice-session-play aria-label="Play ${escapeAttribute(s.title)}" class="shrink-0 rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-300">▶</button>
          </div>`;
          })
          .join('')
      : `<p data-voice-history-empty class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(this.emptyLabel)}</p>`;

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-voice-history class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <h4 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this.title)} <span data-voice-history-count class="ml-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">${active}</span></h4>
        </div>
        <div data-voice-history-list class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">${rows}</div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('voice-session-history')) {
  customElements.define('voice-session-history', VoiceSessionHistoryElement);
}

export default VoiceSessionHistoryElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\WebhookConfigPanel.js =====

/**
 * WebhookConfigPanel - Webhook endpoint management: header, endpoint rows
 * with active toggle / mono URL / event chips / last-delivery status badge
 * and a Test action, plus an events legend (webhook settings pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS = () => [
  { id: 'wh1', url: 'https://api.example.com/hooks/deploy', events: ['build.finished', 'deploy.failed'], lastStatus: 200, lastDelivery: '2 minutes ago', active: true },
  { id: 'wh2', url: 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00/B00/XYZ', events: ['alert.triggered'], lastStatus: 503, lastDelivery: '1 hour ago', active: true },
  { id: 'wh3', url: 'https://staging.example.com/hooks', events: ['build.finished'], lastStatus: 404, lastDelivery: '3 days ago', active: false },
];

const DEFAULT_EVENTS = () => ['build.finished', 'deploy.failed', 'alert.triggered'];

const DELIVERY_STYLES = {
  ok: { cls: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  warn: { cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-400' },
  fail: { cls: 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400' },
};

const deliveryStyle = (status) => {
  const code = Number.parseInt(String(status), 10);
  if (Number.isNaN(code)) return DELIVERY_STYLES.fail;
  if (code < 300) return DELIVERY_STYLES.ok;
  if (code < 500) return DELIVERY_STYLES.warn;
  return DELIVERY_STYLES.fail;
};

class WebhookConfigPanelElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['title', 'description', 'endpoints', 'events', 'test-label', 'events-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._title = 'Webhooks';
    this._description = 'Send real-time event notifications to your own services.';
    this._endpoints = DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS();
    this._events = DEFAULT_EVENTS();
    this._testLabel = 'Test';
    this._eventsLabel = 'Available events';
    this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
    this._onChange = this._onChange.bind(this);
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    const t = this.getAttribute('title');
    if (t) this._title = t;
    const d = this.getAttribute('description');
    if (d) this._description = d;
    const tl = this.getAttribute('test-label');
    if (tl) this._testLabel = tl;
    const el = this.getAttribute('events-label');
    if (el) this._eventsLabel = el;
    this._endpoints = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('endpoints'), DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS());
    this._events = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('events'), DEFAULT_EVENTS());
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.addEventListener('change', this._onChange);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.removeEventListener('change', this._onChange);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'title') this._title = newValue || 'Webhooks';
    if (name === 'description') this._description = newValue || '';
    if (name === 'test-label') this._testLabel = newValue || 'Test';
    if (name === 'events-label') this._eventsLabel = newValue || 'Available events';
    if (name === 'endpoints') this._endpoints = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS());
    if (name === 'events') this._events = parseJsonAttr(newValue, DEFAULT_EVENTS());
    this._render();
  }

  get endpoints() { return this._endpoints; }
  set endpoints(value) { this._endpoints = Array.isArray(value) ? value : []; this._render(); }

  _onClick(event) {
    const test = event.target.closest('[data-webhook-test]');
    if (test) {
      const endpoint = this._endpoints.find((ep) => ep.id === test.getAttribute('data-webhook-test'));
      if (endpoint) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('webhook-test', { detail: { endpoint }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _onChange(event) {
    const toggle = event.target.closest('input[data-webhook-toggle]');
    if (toggle) {
      const endpoint = this._endpoints.find((ep) => ep.id === toggle.getAttribute('data-webhook-toggle'));
      if (endpoint) {
        endpoint.active = toggle.checked;
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('webhook-toggle', { detail: { endpoint, active: toggle.checked }, bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const endpoints = Array.isArray(this._endpoints) ? this._endpoints : [];
    const rowsHtml = endpoints
      .map((ep) => {
        const style = deliveryStyle(ep.lastStatus);
        const chips = (Array.isArray(ep.events) ? ep.events : [])
          .map((ev) => `<span data-webhook-event="${escapeAttribute(ev)}" class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">${escapeAttribute(ev)}</span>`)
          .join('');
        const rowCls = ep.active === false ? 'opacity-50' : '';
        return `<div data-webhook-endpoint="${escapeAttribute(ep.id)}" class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-b border-zinc-50 px-5 py-4 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${rowCls}">
          <label data-webhook-active-wrapper="${escapeAttribute(ep.id)}" class="flex cursor-pointer items-center">
            <input type="checkbox" data-webhook-toggle="${escapeAttribute(ep.id)}" ${ep.active === false ? '' : 'checked'} class="h-4 w-4 accent-violet-600" aria-label="Toggle endpoint" />
          </label>
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p data-webhook-url="${escapeAttribute(ep.url)}" class="truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">${escapeAttribute(ep.url)}</p>
            <div data-webhook-events="${escapeAttribute(ep.id)}" class="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">${chips}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span data-webhook-delivery="${escapeAttribute(ep.id)}" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
              <span class="inline-block rounded px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold ${style.cls}">${escapeAttribute(String(ep.lastStatus ?? '—'))}</span>
              ${escapeAttribute(ep.lastDelivery || '')}
            </span>
            <button type="button" data-webhook-test="${escapeAttribute(ep.id)}" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">${escapeAttribute(this._testLabel)}</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const legendHtml = (Array.isArray(this._events) ? this._events : [])
      .map((ev) => `<span class="rounded-md border border-dashed border-zinc-300 px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(ev)}</span>`)
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-webhook-panel class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-webhook-header class="border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-webhook-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${escapeAttribute(this._title)}</p>
          <p data-webhook-description class="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(this._description)}</p>
        </div>
        <div data-webhook-list>${rowsHtml}</div>
        <div data-webhook-footer class="border-t border-zinc-100 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <p data-webhook-events-label class="mb-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(this._eventsLabel)}</p>
          <div data-webhook-events-legend class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">${legendHtml}</div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('webhook-config-panel')) {
  customElements.define('webhook-config-panel', WebhookConfigPanelElement);
}

export default WebhookConfigPanelElement;

/**
 * WeekCalendarGrid - Week-view calendar grid: hour gutter, day columns with
 * absolutely positioned event blocks (solid or dashed focus blocks), red
 * current-time line, Day/Week segmented toggle, timezone label, "Find time"
 * button and a "Schedule or reschedule…" composer input
 * (Clockwise week calendar pattern).
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

const HOUR_HEIGHT = 56;

const DEFAULT_DAYS = () => [
  { id: 'mon', label: 'Mon', date: '16' },
  { id: 'tue', label: 'Tue', date: '17' },
  { id: 'wed', label: 'Wed', date: '18' },
  { id: 'thu', label: 'Thu', date: '19' },
  { id: 'fri', label: 'Fri', date: '20' },
];

const DEFAULT_EVENTS = () => [
  { id: 'e1', dayId: 'mon', title: 'Alex // Sam', start: 9, end: 10, tone: 'solid', color: 'blue' },
  { id: 'e2', dayId: 'mon', title: 'Focus Time', start: 10, end: 12, tone: 'dashed', color: 'blue' },
  { id: 'e3', dayId: 'mon', title: 'Lunch', start: 12, end: 13, tone: 'solid', color: 'amber' },
  { id: 'e4', dayId: 'mon', title: 'Focus Time', start: 13, end: 17, tone: 'dashed', color: 'blue' },
  { id: 'e5', dayId: 'tue', title: 'Lunch', start: 12, end: 13, tone: 'solid', color: 'amber' },
  { id: 'e6', dayId: 'wed', title: 'Team Sync', start: 9, end: 10, tone: 'solid', color: 'green' },
  { id: 'e7', dayId: 'wed', title: 'Lunch', start: 12, end: 13, tone: 'solid', color: 'amber' },
  { id: 'e8', dayId: 'thu', title: 'Lunch', start: 12, end: 13, tone: 'solid', color: 'amber' },
  { id: 'e9', dayId: 'fri', title: 'Lunch', start: 12, end: 13, tone: 'solid', color: 'amber' },
];

const EVENT_STYLES = {
  blue: {
    solid: 'bg-blue-500/90 text-white dark:bg-blue-500/80',
    dashed: 'border border-dashed border-blue-400 bg-blue-50/60 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-300',
  },
  green: {
    solid: 'bg-emerald-500/90 text-white dark:bg-emerald-500/80',
    dashed: 'border border-dashed border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50/60 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300',
  },
  amber: {
    solid: 'bg-amber-400/90 text-amber-950 dark:bg-amber-400/80',
    dashed: 'border border-dashed border-amber-400 bg-amber-50/60 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300',
  },
};

const hourLabel = (h) => {
  const suffix = h < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm';
  const hour12 = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
  return `${hour12}${suffix}`;
};

const eventCls = (ev) => {
  const styles = EVENT_STYLES[ev.color ?? 'blue'] ?? EVENT_STYLES.blue;
  return (ev.tone ?? 'solid') === 'dashed' ? styles.dashed : styles.solid;
};

class WeekCalendarGridElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['days', 'events', 'start-hour', 'end-hour', 'time-zone', 'view', 'active-day-id', 'now-hour', 'composer-placeholder'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._view = 'week';
    this._activeDayId = 'mon';
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this._view = this.getAttribute('view') || 'week';
    this._activeDayId = this.getAttribute('active-day-id') || 'mon';
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.addEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
    this.removeEventListener('keydown', this._onKeydown);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    if (name === 'view') this._view = newValue || 'week';
    if (name === 'active-day-id') this._activeDayId = newValue || 'mon';
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const viewBtn = event.target.closest('[data-week-view]');
    if (viewBtn) {
      this._view = viewBtn.getAttribute('data-week-view');
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('view-change', { detail: { view: this._view }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    const evBtn = event.target.closest('[data-week-event]');
    if (evBtn) {
      const found = this._events().find((ev) => ev.id === evBtn.getAttribute('data-week-event'));
      if (found) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('event-click', { detail: { event: found }, bubbles: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-week-find-time]')) {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('find-time', { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _onKeydown(event) {
    const composer = event.target.closest('[data-week-composer]');
    if (composer && event.key === 'Enter') {
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('compose-submit', { detail: { text: composer.value }, bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _days() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('days'), DEFAULT_DAYS());
  }

  _events() {
    return parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('events'), DEFAULT_EVENTS());
  }

  _render() {
    const startHour = Number(this.getAttribute('start-hour') ?? 6);
    const endHour = Number(this.getAttribute('end-hour') ?? 18);
    const timeZone = this.getAttribute('time-zone') || 'GMT+7';
    const nowHour = Number(this.getAttribute('now-hour') ?? 15.83);
    const composerPlaceholder = this.getAttribute('composer-placeholder') || 'Schedule or reschedule…';
    const days = this._days();
    const events = this._events();
    const hours = [];
    for (let h = startHour; h <= endHour; h++) hours.push(h);
    const visibleDays = this._view === 'day' ? days.filter((d) => d.id === this._activeDayId) : days;
    const gridHeight = (endHour - startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT;
    const gridTemplate = `64px repeat(${Math.max(visibleDays.length, 1)}, minmax(0, 1fr))`;

    const headerHtml = visibleDays
      .map((day) => {
        const activeCls = day.id === this._activeDayId ? 'rounded-md bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60' : '';
        const dateCls = day.id === this._activeDayId ? 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200';
        return `<div data-week-day="${escapeAttribute(day.id)}" class="pb-2 text-center ${activeCls}">
            <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(day.label)}</p>
            <p class="text-sm font-bold ${dateCls}">${escapeAttribute(day.date)}</p>
          </div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const gutterHtml = hours
      .map((h, i) => `<span class="absolute -translate-y-1/2 pr-3 text-right text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500" style="top:${i * HOUR_HEIGHT}px">${hourLabel(h)}</span>`)
      .join('');

    const columnsHtml = visibleDays
      .map((day) => {
        const lines = hours
          .map((h, i) => `<div class="absolute w-full border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800" style="top:${i * HOUR_HEIGHT}px"></div>`)
          .join('');
        const evs = events
          .filter((ev) => ev.dayId === day.id)
          .map((ev) => `<button data-week-event="${escapeAttribute(ev.id)}" type="button" style="top:${(ev.start - startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT}px;height:${(ev.end - ev.start) * HOUR_HEIGHT - 4}px" class="absolute left-1 right-1.5 z-10 overflow-hidden rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-left text-xs font-semibold ${eventCls(ev)}">${escapeAttribute(ev.title)}${ev.subtitle ? `<span class="block truncate text-[10px] font-normal opacity-80">${escapeAttribute(ev.subtitle)}</span>` : ''}</button>`)
          .join('');
        const nowLine = nowHour >= startHour && nowHour <= endHour
          ? `<div data-week-now class="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 z-20 border-t-2 border-red-500" style="top:${(nowHour - startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT}px"><span class="absolute -left-1 -top-[5px] h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span></div>`
          : '';
        return `<div data-week-column="${escapeAttribute(day.id)}" class="relative border-l border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800" style="height:${gridHeight}px">${lines}${evs}${nowLine}</div>`;
      })
      .join('');

    const viewBtn = (v) => {
      const active = this._view === v;
      const cls = active
        ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900'
        : 'bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800';
      return `<button data-week-view="${v}" type="button" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold capitalize transition-colors ${cls}">${v}</button>`;
    };

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-week-grid class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
        <div data-week-toolbar class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div data-week-view-toggle class="flex overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700">${viewBtn('day')}${viewBtn('week')}</div>
            <span data-week-timezone class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">${escapeAttribute(timeZone)}</span>
          </div>
          <button data-week-find-time type="button" class="rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-200">Find time</button>
        </div>
        <input data-week-composer type="text" placeholder="${escapeAttribute(composerPlaceholder)}" class="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-zinc-800 placeholder-zinc-400 outline-none focus:border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 dark:text-zinc-100 dark:placeholder-zinc-500">
        <div class="mt-4 grid" style="grid-template-columns:${gridTemplate}">
          <div></div>
          ${headerHtml}
        </div>
        <div data-week-body class="relative grid overflow-hidden" style="grid-template-columns:${gridTemplate}">
          <div data-week-gutter class="relative" style="height:${gridHeight}px">${gutterHtml}</div>
          ${columnsHtml}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('week-calendar-grid')) {
  customElements.define('week-calendar-grid', WeekCalendarGridElement);
}

export default WeekCalendarGridElement;


===== FILE: vanilla\WizardSteps.js =====

/**
 * WizardSteps - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <wizard-steps current="1" variant="vertical"></wizard-steps> with `steps` property
 * Attributes: current, variant (vertical|bar), next-label
 * Properties: steps ({ label, hint?, optional? }[])
 * Events: step-click (detail: { index, step })
 */
import uiIcon from './UiIcon.js';

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

export class WizardStepsElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['current', 'variant', 'next-label'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._steps = [];
  }

  get steps() {
    return this._steps;
  }

  set steps(value) {
    this._steps = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get current() {
    return Number(this.getAttribute('current')) || 0;
  }

  set current(index) {
    this.setAttribute('current', String(index));
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    this._applyHostClass('block');
    const steps = this._steps;
    const current = this.current;
    const total = steps.length;
    const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'vertical';
    const nextLabel = this.getAttribute('next-label') || '';
    const interactive = true;

    if (variant === 'bar') {
      const progress = total ? Math.round(((current + 1) / total) * 100) : 0;
      const nextStep = steps[current + 1];
      this.innerHTML = `<div data-wizard-steps role="group" aria-label="Wizard progress" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <p class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">${current + 1} of ${total} steps</span>
          ${nextStep ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-700">|</span><span>Next: ${escapeAttribute(nextStep.label)}</span>` : ''}
        </p>
        <div role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="${total}" aria-valuenow="${current + 1}" class="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-950/50">
          <div class="h-full rounded-full bg-violet-600 transition-all duration-300" style="width:${progress}%"></div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
      return;
    }

    this.innerHTML = `<ol data-wizard-steps class="flex flex-col">
      ${steps
        .map((step, index) => {
          const state = index < current ? 'done' : index === current ? 'active' : 'todo';
          const isLast = index === total - 1;
          return `<li class="relative flex gap-3 pb-4 ${isLast ? 'last:pb-0' : ''}">
            ${
              !isLast
                ? `<span aria-hidden="true" class="absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-0 w-px ${
                    index < current ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700'
                  }"></span>`
                : ''
            }
            <button type="button" data-step-index="${index}" ${index === current ? 'aria-current="step"' : ''} ${
              interactive && index <= current ? '' : 'disabled'
            }
              class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
                state === 'done'
                  ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'
                  : state === 'active'
                    ? 'border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:border-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900'
                    : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400'
              } ${interactive && index <= current ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}">
              ${state === 'done' ? uiIcon('check', { size: 13 }) : index + 1}
            </button>
            <span class="min-w-0 pt-1">
              <span class="block truncate text-sm font-medium ${
                state === 'active'
                  ? 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
                  : state === 'done'
                    ? 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                    : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
              }">
                ${escapeAttribute(step.label)}${step.optional ? '<span class="ml-1.5 text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Optional)</span>' : ''}
              </span>
              ${step.hint ? `<span class="mt-0.5 block truncate text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(step.hint)}</span>` : ''}
            </span>
          </li>`;
        })
        .join('')}
      ${nextLabel ? `<li class="pt-1 pl-10 text-xs text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(nextLabel)}</li>` : ''}
    </ol>`;

    this.querySelectorAll('[data-step-index]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const index = Number(button.getAttribute('data-step-index'));
        if (index > current) return;
        if (typeof this.onStepClick === 'function') this.onStepClick(index, this._steps[index]);
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('step-click', { detail: { index, step: this._steps[index] } }));
      });
    });
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('wizard-steps')) {
  customElements.define('wizard-steps', WizardStepsElement);

 * Properties: workspaces (Array<{id,name,logo?,memberCount?,role?,current?}>), footerUser ({name,email,initials?})
 * Events: select (detail {workspace}), create-new, logout

const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const initialsOf = (name) =>
  String(name || '')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || '').toUpperCase())
    .join('');

export class WorkspaceSwitcherMenuElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['variant', 'title', 'subtitle', 'create-label', 'logout-label', 'footer-name', 'footer-email', 'footer-initials'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._workspaces = [];
    this._footerUser = null;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  get workspaces() {
    return this._workspaces;
  }

  set workspaces(list) {
    this._workspaces = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
    this.render();
  }

  get footerUser() {
    return this._footerUser;
  }

  set footerUser(user) {
    this._footerUser = user && typeof user === 'object' ? user : null;
    this.render();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._workspaces.length) {
      const raw = this.getAttribute('workspaces');
      if (raw) {
        try {
          this._workspaces = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch {
          this._workspaces = [];
        }
      }
    }
    if (!this._footerUser) {
      const name = this.getAttribute('footer-name');
      if (name) {
        this._footerUser = {
          name,
          email: this.getAttribute('footer-email') || '',
          initials: this.getAttribute('footer-initials') || undefined,
        };
      }
    }
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const option = event.target.closest('[data-workspace-option]');
        if (option) {
          const workspace = this._workspaces.find((item) => item.id === option.getAttribute('data-workspace-option'));
          if (workspace) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('select', { detail: { workspace } }));
        }
        if (event.target.closest('[data-workspace-create]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('create-new'));
        if (event.target.closest('[data-workspace-logout]')) this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('logout'));
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const page = (this.getAttribute('variant') || 'page') === 'page';
    this._applyHostClass(page ? 'block' : 'block w-72');
    const title = this.getAttribute('title') || 'Workspaces';
    const subtitle = this.getAttribute('subtitle') || 'Choose the workspace you want to access';
    const createLabel = this.getAttribute('create-label') || '+ Create new workspace';
    const logoutLabel = this.getAttribute('logout-label') || 'Log out';
    const workspaces = Array.isArray(this._workspaces) ? this._workspaces : [];
    const footerUser = this._footerUser;

    const roleLine = (workspace) => {
      const count = workspace.memberCount ?? 1;
      let line = `${count} member${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
      if (workspace.role) {
        const article = workspace.role.startsWith('A') || workspace.role.startsWith('E') ? 'an' : 'a';
        line += ` · You are ${article} ${workspace.role}`;
      }
      return line;
    };

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-workspace-switcher class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${page ? 'p-5' : 'p-3'}">
      ${
        title
          ? `<div class="${page ? '' : 'px-2 pt-1'}">

              ${subtitle ? `<p class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(subtitle)}</p>` : ''}
            </div>`
          : ''
      }
      <ul class="${page ? 'mt-4 space-y-2' : 'mt-3 space-y-1'}">

          .map(
            (workspace) => `<li>

                workspace.current ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60'

                  workspace.logo

                    : `<span class="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-violet-600 text-xs font-bold text-white">${escapeAttribute(initialsOf(workspace.name))}</span>`

/**
 * ZendeskFieldSuggest - Zendesk AI ticket-field suggestion bar: recommended
 * field chips (type + confidence) that can be applied or dismissed.
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');

const parseJsonAttr = (raw, fallback) => {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') return fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};

class ZendeskFieldSuggestElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['fields'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._bound = false;
    this._fields = [];
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this._fields.length) {
      this._fields = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('fields'), [
        { id: 'f1', label: 'Priority', value: 'Urgent', confidence: 0.94 },
        { id: 'f2', label: 'Type', value: 'Incident', confidence: 0.87 },
        { id: 'f3', label: 'Group', value: 'Payments', confidence: 0.72 },
      ]);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') {
      this._bound = true;
    }
    this._render();
    this.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.removeEventListener('click', this._onClick);
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name, oldValue, newValue) {
    if (oldValue === newValue) return;
    if (name === 'fields' && !this._fields.length) {
      this._fields = parseJsonAttr(this.getAttribute('fields'), []);
    }
    if (this._bound === false && this.innerHTML === '') return;
    this._render();
  }

  get fields() {
    return this._fields;
  }
  set fields(value) {
    this._fields = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    this._render();
  }

  _onClick(event) {
    const fieldEl = event.target.closest('[data-zendesk-suggest-field]');
    if (fieldEl) {
      const field = this._fields.find((f) => String(f.id) === fieldEl.getAttribute('data-zendesk-suggest-field'));
      if (field) {
        // applying a suggestion removes it from the bar
        this._fields = this._fields.filter((f) => f !== field);
        this._render();
        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('apply', { detail: { field }, bubbles: true }));
      }
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-zendesk-suggest-dismiss]')) {
      this._fields = [];
      this._render();
      this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('dismiss', { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  _render() {
    const fieldsHtml = this._fields
      .map(
        (field) => `
        <button type="button" data-zendesk-suggest-field="${escapeAttribute(field.id)}" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-amber-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:border-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:border-amber-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/40">
          <span class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">${escapeAttribute(field.label)}:</span>
          <span>${escapeAttribute(field.value)}</span>
          <span class="font-mono text-[9px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">${Math.round((field.confidence ?? 0) * 100)}%</span>
        </button>`
      )
      .join('');

    this.innerHTML = `
      <div data-zendesk-field-suggest class="w-full rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 shadow-sm dark:border-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/40">
        <p data-zendesk-suggest-label class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
          <span aria-hidden="true">✦</span>
          Suggested fields
        </p>
        <div data-zendesk-suggest-fields class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">${fieldsHtml}</div>
        <div class="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <button type="button" data-zendesk-suggest-dismiss class="rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-amber-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/40">Ignore</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('zendesk-field-suggest')) {
  customElements.define('zendesk-field-suggest', ZendeskFieldSuggestElement);
}

export default ZendeskFieldSuggestElement;

/**
 * ZoomControlBar - Vanilla Web Component
 * Usage: <zoom-control-bar value="100" variant="stepper|dropdown|slider"></zoom-control-bar>
 * Attributes: value, min, max, step, variant, presets (JSON number[]), show-fit, show-undo-redo
 * Properties: value
 * Events: zoom-change (detail {value}), fit, undo, redo
 */
const escapeAttribute = (value) =>
  String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    "'": '&#39;',
    '"': '&quot;',
  }[char]));

const ICON_BUTTON = 'flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40';

const UNDO_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 5 3.5 8.5 7 12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M3.5 8.5H12a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0 9h-1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
const REDO_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m13 5 3.5 3.5L13 12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M16.5 8.5H8a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 0 9h1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
const FIT_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6V3h3M17 6V3h-3M3 14v3h3M17 14v3h-3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';
const MINUS_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 10h10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';
const PLUS_SVG = '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 5v10M5 10h10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>';

export class ZoomControlBarElement extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return ['value', 'variant', 'presets', 'show-fit', 'show-undo-redo'];
  }

  constructor() {
    super();
    this._zoom = null;
    this._open = false;
    this._bound = false;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.render();
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      this.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        const clampZoom = (next) => {
          const min = Number(this.getAttribute('min')) || 10;
          const max = Number(this.getAttribute('max')) || 400;
          return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(next)));
        };
        const change = (next) => {
          const final = clampZoom(next);
          this._zoom = final;
          this.setAttribute('value', String(final));
          this._open = false;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zoom-change', { detail: { value: final } }));
        };
        const step = Number(this.getAttribute('step')) || 10;
        if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-in]')) change(this.value + step);
        else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-out]')) change(this.value - step);
        else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-value]') && this.getAttribute('variant') === 'dropdown') {
          this._open = !this._open;
          this.render();
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-preset]')) {
          change(Number(event.target.closest('[data-zoom-preset]').getAttribute('data-zoom-preset')));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-fit]')) {
          this._open = false;
          this.render();
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fit'));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-undo]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('undo'));
        } else if (event.target.closest('[data-zoom-redo]')) {
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('redo'));
        }
      });
      this.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        if (target.hasAttribute && target.hasAttribute('data-zoom-slider')) {
          const next = Number(target.value);
          const min = Number(this.getAttribute('min')) || 10;
          const max = Number(this.getAttribute('max')) || 400;
          const final = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(next)));
          this._zoom = final;
          this.setAttribute('value', String(final));
          this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zoom-change', { detail: { value: final } }));
          const valueLabel = this.querySelector('[data-zoom-value]');
          if (valueLabel) valueLabel.textContent = `${final}%`;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  attributeChangedCallback(name) {
    if (name === 'value') this._zoom = null;
    this.render();
  }

  get value() {
    if (this._zoom !== null) return this._zoom;
    return Number(this.getAttribute('value')) || 100;
  }

  set value(v) {
    this._zoom = Number(v) || 100;
    this.setAttribute('value', String(this._zoom));
    this.render();
  }

  _applyHostClass(hostClass) {
    const prev = this._appliedLayout || '';
    let user = this.className || '';
    if (prev && user.startsWith(prev)) user = user.slice(prev.length).trim();
    this._appliedLayout = hostClass;
    const next = `${hostClass}${user ? ` ${user}` : ''}`;
    if (this.className !== next) this.className = next;
  }

  render() {
    const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'stepper';
    const showFit = this.getAttribute('show-fit') === 'true';
    const showUndoRedo = this.getAttribute('show-undo-redo') === 'true';
    const zoom = this.value;
    const min = Number(this.getAttribute('min')) || 10;
    const max = Number(this.getAttribute('max')) || 400;
    const step = Number(this.getAttribute('step')) || 10;
    let presets = [25, 50, 75, 100, 200];
    const rawPresets = this.getAttribute('presets');
    if (rawPresets) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawPresets);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) presets = parsed;
      } catch { /* keep default */ }
    }

    const hostClass = 'inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-1 py-0.5 shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900';
    this._applyHostClass(hostClass);

    const percentButton = `<button type="button" data-zoom-value class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 tabular-nums${variant === 'dropdown' ? ' hover:bg-zinc-100' : ''}">${zoom}%${variant === 'dropdown' ? ' <span aria-hidden="true">▾</span>' : ''}</button>`;

    const undoRedoHtml = showUndoRedo
      ? `<button type="button" data-zoom-undo title="Undo" class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${UNDO_SVG}</button><button type="button" data-zoom-redo title="Redo" class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${REDO_SVG}</button><span class="mx-0.5 h-4 w-px bg-zinc-200"></span>`
      : '';

    let variantHtml = '';
    if (variant === 'stepper') {
      variantHtml = `<button type="button" data-zoom-out title="Zoom out"${zoom <= min ? ' disabled' : ''} class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${MINUS_SVG}</button>${percentButton}<button type="button" data-zoom-in title="Zoom in"${zoom >= max ? ' disabled' : ''} class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${PLUS_SVG}</button>`;
    } else if (variant === 'dropdown') {
      const menu = this._open
        ? `<div data-zoom-menu class="absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-1 w-24 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 shadow-lg">${presets.map((preset) => `<button type="button" data-zoom-preset="${escapeAttribute(preset)}" class="block w-full px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs tabular-nums hover:bg-zinc-50 ${preset === zoom ? 'font-semibold text-blue-600' : 'text-zinc-700'}">${preset}%</button>`).join('')}${showFit ? '<button type="button" data-zoom-fit class="block w-full border-t border-zinc-100 px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-50">Fit</button>' : ''}</div>`
        : '';
      variantHtml = `<div class="relative">${percentButton}${menu}</div>`;
    } else {
      variantHtml = `<input data-zoom-slider type="range" min="${min}" max="${max}" step="${step}" value="${zoom}" class="h-1.5 w-24 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded-full bg-zinc-200" aria-label="Zoom level"/>${percentButton}`;
    }

    const fitButton = showFit && variant !== 'dropdown' ? `<button type="button" data-zoom-fit title="Fit to page" class="${ICON_BUTTON}">${FIT_SVG}</button>` : '';

    this.innerHTML = `<div data-zoom-control class="${hostClass}">${undoRedoHtml}${variantHtml}${fitButton}</div>`;
  }
}

if (typeof customElements !== 'undefined' && !customElements.get('zoom-control-bar')) {
  customElements.define('zoom-control-bar', ZoomControlBarElement);
}

export default ZoomControlBarElement;

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export interface AIAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options?: string[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    actions?: AIAction[];
    loading?: boolean;
    error?: string;
    tone?: 'neutral' | 'brand';
  }>(),
  {
    actions: () => [
      { id: 'edit', label: 'Edit' },
      { id: 'tone', label: 'Change tone', options: ['Professional', 'Friendly', 'Concise'] },
    ],
    loading: false,
    error: '',
    tone: 'neutral' as const,
  },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'action', id: string, option?: string): void;
  (e: 'dismiss'): void;
}>();

const resolvedActions = computed(() => props.actions);
const openId = ref<string | null>(null);
const lastRun = ref<string | null>(null);

const run = (action: AIAction, option?: string) => {
  if (props.loading) return;
  openId.value = null;
  lastRun.value = `${action.id}${option ? `:${option}` : ''}`;
  emit('action', action.id, option);
};
</script>

          <span v-if="item.icon" class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
            <UiIcon :name="item.icon" :size="14" />
          </span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span class="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ item.title }}</span>
            <span v-if="item.description" class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ item.description }}</span>
          </span>
          <span :class="['shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform duration-200', isOpen(item.id) ? 'rotate-180' : '']">
            <UiIcon name="chevron-down" :size="14" />
          </span>
        </button>
      </h3>
      <div v-if="isOpen(item.id)" :id="`accordion-panel-${item.id}`" role="region"
        :aria-labelledby="`accordion-trigger-${item.id}`"
        class="px-4 pb-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
        {{ item.content }}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface AccordionItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  content: string;
  icon?: IconName;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items: AccordionItem[];
    allowMultiple?: boolean;
    defaultOpenIds?: string[];
  }>(),
  { allowMultiple: false }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'toggle', id: string, open: boolean): void }>();

const openIds = ref<string[]>(
  props.defaultOpenIds ?? props.items.filter((item) => item.defaultOpen).map((item) => item.id)
);

const isOpen = (id: string) => openIds.value.includes(id);

const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const wasOpen = isOpen(id);
  if (wasOpen) {
    openIds.value = openIds.value.filter((entry) => entry !== id);
  } else {
    openIds.value = props.allowMultiple ? [...openIds.value, id] : [id];
  }
  emit('toggle', id, !wasOpen);
};
</script>

    <button
      v-if="current"
      type="button"

      :aria-expanded="open"

      role="menu"

              v-if="account.id === current.id"
              name="check"
              :size="12"
              class="shrink-0 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400"
            />
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>

      <div class="border-t border-zinc-100 py-1 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <button
          type="button"
          role="menuitem"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          @click="addAccount"
        >
          <UiIcon name="plus" :size="12" class="text-zinc-400" />
          Add account
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          role="menuitem"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30"
          @click="signOut"
        >
          <UiIcon name="arrow-right" :size="12" />
          Sign out
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface Account {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  avatar?: string;
  role?: string;
  plan?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    accounts?: Account[];
    currentId?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { accounts: () => [], currentId: '', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'switch', account: Account): void;
  (e: 'add-account'): void;
  (e: 'sign-out'): void;
  (e: 'open-change', open: boolean): void;
}>();

const open = ref(false);
const rootRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);

const current = computed(() => props.accounts.find((account) => account.id === props.currentId) || props.accounts[0]);

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

function setOpen(next: boolean) {
  open.value = next;
  emit('open-change', next);
}

function choose(account: Account) {
  emit('switch', account);
  setOpen(false);
}

function addAccount() {
  emit('add-account');
  setOpen(false);
}

function signOut() {
  emit('sign-out');
  setOpen(false);
}

function onPointerDown(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
}

function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
}

watch(open, (isOpen) => {
  if (isOpen) {
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  } else {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface AddonOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  price?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  contactInstead?: boolean;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  options: AddonOption[];
  selectedIds?: string[];
  totalLabel?: string;
  totalText?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Add-ons",
  selectedIds: () => [],
  totalLabel: "Estimated total",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: "change", selectedIds: string[]): void }>();

const isChecked = (id: string) => props.selectedIds.includes(id);
const toggle = (option: AddonOption) => {
  if (option.disabled) return;
  const next = isChecked(option.id)
    ? props.selectedIds.filter((x) => x !== option.id)
    : [...props.selectedIds, option.id];
  emit("change", next);
};
</script>

        class="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-md border px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors"

===== FILE: vue\AgentEnvVarEditor.vue =====

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

export interface EnvVar {
  key: string;
  value: string;
  secret?: boolean;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  vars: EnvVar[];
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Environment variables",
  description: "Injected into every agent run. Secret values are masked.",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "change", vars: EnvVar[]): void;
}>();

const rows = ref<EnvVar[]>([...props.vars]);
const revealed = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});
const newKey = ref("");
const newValue = ref("");
const newSecret = ref(false);

const commit = (next: EnvVar[]) => {
  rows.value = next;
  emit("change", next);
};
const update = (i: number, value: string) => {
  commit(rows.value.map((row, idx) => (idx === i ? { ...row, value } : row)));
};
const remove = (i: number) => {
  commit(rows.value.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i));
};
const add = () => {
  const key = newKey.value.trim();
  if (!key) return;
  commit([...rows.value, { key, value: newValue.value, secret: newSecret.value }]);
  newKey.value = "";
  newValue.value = "";
  newSecret.value = false;
};
const isEmpty = computed(() => rows.value.length === 0);
</script>

<template>
  <div data-env-editor class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <p data-env-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ props.title }}</p>
    <p data-env-description class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ props.description }}</p>

    <div data-env-rows class="mt-3 space-y-2">
      <div v-for="(row, i) in rows" :key="i" :data-env-row="row.key" class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <input
          data-env-key
          :value="row.key"
          readonly
          aria-label="Variable name"
          class="w-44 shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200"
        />
        <input
          data-env-value
          :type="row.secret && !revealed[row.key] ? 'password' : 'text'"
          :value="row.value"
          @input="update(i, $event.target.value)"
          aria-label="Variable value"
          class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
        />
        <button
          v-if="row.secret"
          type="button"
          data-env-reveal
          :aria-pressed="!!revealed[row.key]"
          :title="revealed[row.key] ? 'Hide value' : 'Reveal value'"
          @click="revealed = { ...revealed, [row.key]: !revealed[row.key] }"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        >
          {{ revealed[row.key] ? "Hide" : "Show" }}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-env-delete
          title="Delete variable"
          @click="remove(i)"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-transparent px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-400 hover:border-rose-200 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:border-rose-900 dark:hover:text-rose-400"
        >
          Delete
        </button>
      </div>
      <p v-if="isEmpty" data-env-empty class="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500">
        No environment variables yet
      </p>
    </div>

    <div data-env-add class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <input
        data-env-new-key
        v-model="newKey"
        placeholder="KEY_NAME"
        aria-label="New variable name"
        class="w-44 shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
      />
      <input
        data-env-new-value
        v-model="newValue"
        placeholder="value"
        aria-label="New variable value"
        class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200"
      />
      <label data-env-new-secret class="flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <input type="checkbox" v-model="newSecret" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300" />
        secret
      </label>
      <button
        type="button"
        data-env-add-btn
        @click="add"
        :disabled="!newKey.trim()"
        class="shrink-0 rounded-md bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
      >
        Add
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

===== FILE: vue\AgentModelFallbackList.vue =====

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

export type FallbackHealth = "healthy" | "degraded" | "down";
export interface FallbackEntry {
  id: string;
  model: string;
  provider?: string;
  health?: FallbackHealth;
  condition?: string;
  latency?: string;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  entries?: FallbackEntry[];
  primaryId?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Model fallback chain",
  description: "Requests try the primary model first, then walk down the chain when a fallback condition triggers.",
  entries: () => [],
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "reorder", ids: string[]): void;
}>();

const ids = ref<string[]>(props.entries.map((e) => e.id));
const moveFlash = ref<string | null>(null);
let flashTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

const ordered = computed(() =>
  ids.value
    .map((id) => props.entries.find((e) => e.id === id))
    .filter((e) => Boolean(e))
);
const activePrimary = computed(() => props.primaryId ?? ordered.value[0]?.id);

const move = (id: string, dir: number) => {
  const idx = ids.value.indexOf(id);
  const next = idx + dir;
  if (idx < 0 || next < 0 || next >= ids.value.length) return;
  const list = [...ids.value];
  list.splice(idx, 1);
  list.splice(next, 0, id);
  ids.value = list;
  moveFlash.value = id;
  if (flashTimer) clearTimeout(flashTimer);
  flashTimer = setTimeout(() => (moveFlash.value = null), 1200);
  emit("reorder", list);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-fallback-list class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <p data-fallback-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ props.title }}</p>
    <p data-fallback-description class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ props.description }}</p>

    <div data-fallback-rows class="mt-3 space-y-2">
      <div
        v-for="(entry, i) in ordered"
        :key="entry.id"
        :data-fallback-row="entry.id"
        :class="`flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 ${
          entry.id === activePrimary
            ? 'border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-indigo-500/30 dark:bg-indigo-500/10'
            : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700'
        }`"
      >
        <span data-fallback-rank class="w-4 text-center font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ i + 1 }}</span>
        <span
          class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full"
          :title="entry.health === 'down' ? 'Down' : entry.health === 'degraded' ? 'Degraded' : 'Healthy'"
          :class="entry.health === 'down' ? 'bg-rose-500' : entry.health === 'degraded' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-emerald-500'"
        />
        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span data-fallback-model class="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ entry.model }}</span>
            <span
              v-if="entry.id === activePrimary"
              data-fallback-primary
              class="rounded-full bg-indigo-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-white"
            >
              Primary
            </span>
            <span v-if="moveFlash === entry.id" data-fallback-moved class="text-[10px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
              order updated
            </span>
          </div>
          <p class="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {{ entry.provider ? entry.provider + " · " : "" }}{{ entry.condition ?? "fallback" }}{{ entry.latency ? " · " + entry.latency : "" }}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-fallback-up
            title="Promote"
            :aria-label="'Promote ' + entry.model"
            :disabled="i === 0"
            @click="move(entry.id, -1)"
            class="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1.5 text-[10px] leading-4 text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-30 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          >
            ↑
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            data-fallback-down
            title="Demote"
            :aria-label="'Demote ' + entry.model"
            :disabled="i === ordered.length - 1"
            @click="move(entry.id, 1)"
            class="rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1.5 text-[10px] leading-4 text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-30 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          >
            ↓
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p
        v-if="ordered.length === 0"
        data-fallback-empty
        class="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200 px-3 py-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-500"
      >
        No models in the fallback chain
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

export interface AgentNotificationItem {

  caption?: string;
  time: string;

  completed: "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5">

      <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ title }}</span>
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ doneCount }}/{{ steps.length }}</span>
    </div>
    <ol class="px-4 py-3">
      <li v-for="(step, index) in steps" :key="step.id" class="relative pl-6">
        <span v-if="index !== steps.length - 1" aria-hidden="true"
          class="absolute left-[6px] top-5 bottom-0 w-px bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700" />
        <span class="absolute left-0 top-1"><UiIcon :name="statusIcon(step.status)" :size="14" :class="statusClass(step.status)" /></span>
        <div class="pb-3">
          <button type="button" :aria-expanded="step.detail ? expanded.has(step.id) : undefined"
            :class="['flex w-full items-center gap-2 text-left', step.detail ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default']"
            @click="step.detail && toggle(step.id)">
            <span :class="['text-xs', step.status === 'pending' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200']">{{ step.label }}</span>
            <span v-if="step.durationMs !== undefined" class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ formatDuration(step.durationMs) }}</span>
            <span v-if="step.detail" class="ml-auto text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
              <UiIcon :name="expanded.has(step.id) ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-down'" :size="12" />
            </span>
          </button>
          <pre v-if="step.detail && expanded.has(step.id)"
            class="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">{{ step.detail }}</pre>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type AgentRunStatus = 'pending' | 'running' | 'done' | 'error';
export interface AgentRunStep { id: string; label: string; status: AgentRunStatus; detail?: string; durationMs?: number }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  steps: AgentRunStep[];
  title?: string;
  autoExpandRunning?: boolean;
}>(), { title: 'Execution log', autoExpandRunning: true });

const expanded = ref(new Set<string>(
  props.autoExpandRunning ? props.steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'running' && s.detail).map((s) => s.id) : []
));

const doneCount = computed(() => props.steps.filter((s) => s.status === 'done').length);

const statusIcon = (status: AgentRunStatus) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'loader' : status === 'done' ? 'check-circle' : status === 'error' ? 'circle-x' : 'clock';
const statusClass = (status: AgentRunStatus) =>
  status === 'running' ? 'animate-spin text-indigo-500' : status === 'done' ? 'text-emerald-500' : status === 'error' ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500';
const formatDuration = (ms?: number) => (typeof ms !== 'number' ? '' : ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);
const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const next = new Set(expanded.value);
  next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id);
  expanded.value = next;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

export interface ScheduleFrequency {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  expression: string;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  frequencies?: ScheduleFrequency[];
  activeId?: string;
  time?: string;
  nextRun?: string;
  timezone?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Run schedule",
  description: "Configure when the agent runs automatically. The cron expression is derived from your selection.",
  frequencies: () => [
    { id: "hourly", label: "Every hour", expression: "0 * * * *" },
    { id: "daily", label: "Daily", expression: "0 9 * * *" },
    { id: "weekly", label: "Weekly", expression: "0 9 * * 1" },
  ],
  time: "09:00",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "save", freq: ScheduleFrequency, time: string): void;
}>();

const selectedId = ref(props.activeId ?? props.frequencies[0]?.id ?? "");
const timeValue = ref(props.time);
const saved = ref(false);
let savedTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

const selected = () => props.frequencies.find((f) => f.id === selectedId.value) ?? props.frequencies[0];

const save = () => {
  const freq = selected();
  if (!freq) return;
  saved.value = true;
  if (savedTimer) clearTimeout(savedTimer);
  savedTimer = setTimeout(() => (saved.value = false), 1600);
  emit("save", freq, timeValue.value);
};
</script>

      >
        {{ f.label }}
      </button>
    </div>

    <div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">

        <span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Run at</span>
        <input

<template>
  <ol v-if="steps.length > 0" class="relative space-y-4" :class="className">
    <li v-for="(step, i) in steps" :key="step.id" class="relative flex gap-3">
      <span

        aria-hidden="true"
        class="absolute left-[13px] top-7 bottom-[-16px] w-px"
        :class="step.status === 'done' ? 'bg-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-800' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700'"
      />
      <span
        class="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full shrink-0"
        :class="statusMeta(step.status).cls"
      >
        <UiIcon :name="statusMeta(step.status).icon" :size="15" :class="statusMeta(step.status).pulse ? 'animate-spin' : ''" />
      </span>
      <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-1">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span
            class="text-sm font-medium"
            :class="statusMeta(step.status) === STATUS_META.pending ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200'"
          >
            {{ step.title }}
          </span>
          <span v-if="step.duration" class="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">{{ step.duration }}</span>
        </div>
        <div v-if="step.description" class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ step.description }}</div>
      </div>
    </li>
