<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface AgentStep {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error";
  duration?: string;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    steps?: AgentStep[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { steps: () => [], className: "" }
);

const STATUS_META: Record<string, { icon: string; cls: string; pulse?: boolean }> = {
  pending: { icon: "clock", cls: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800" },
  running: { icon: "loader", cls: "text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60", pulse: true },
  done: { icon: "check-circle", cls: "text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60" },
  error: { icon: "circle-x", cls: "text-rose-500 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60" },
};

function statusMeta(status: string) {
  return STATUS_META[status] || STATUS_META.pending;
}
</script>

===== FILE: vue\AgentWorkspaceSettings.vue =====

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

export interface AgentSettingToggle {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  enabled: boolean;
}
export interface AgentSettingsSection {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  toggles: AgentSettingToggle[];
}
export interface AgentSettingsTab {
  id: string;
  label: string;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  tabs?: AgentSettingsTab[];
  sections: AgentSettingsSection[];
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Settings",
  subtitle: "Manage and update your agent workspace.",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "toggle", toggle: AgentSettingToggle, enabled: boolean): void;
}>();

const enabled = ref<Record<string, boolean>>(
  Object.fromEntries(props.sections.flatMap((s) => s.toggles.map((t) => [t.id, t.enabled])))
);
const isOn = (id: string) => !!enabled.value[id];
const flip = (toggle: AgentSettingToggle) => {
  const next = !isOn(toggle.id);
  enabled.value = { ...enabled.value, [toggle.id]: next };
  emit("toggle", toggle, next);
};
const sectionOnCount = (section: AgentSettingsSection) =>
  section.toggles.filter((t) => isOn(t.id)).length;
</script>

<template>
  <div data-agent-settings class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <p data-agent-settings-title class="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ props.title }}</p>
    <p data-agent-settings-subtitle class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ props.subtitle }}</p>

    <div v-if="props.tabs && props.tabs.length > 0" data-agent-settings-tabs class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <button
        v-for="(tab, i) in props.tabs"
        :key="tab.id"
        type="button"
        :data-agent-settings-tab="tab.id"
        :aria-selected="i === 0"
        class="rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition-colors aria-selected:border-transparent aria-selected:bg-zinc-900 aria-selected:text-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:aria-selected:bg-zinc-50 dark:aria-selected:text-zinc-900"
      >
        {{ tab.label }}
      </button>
    </div>

    <div data-agent-settings-sections class="mt-5 space-y-6">
      <section v-for="section in props.sections" :key="section.id" :data-agent-settings-section="section.id">
        <div class="flex items-baseline justify-between">
          <p class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ section.title }}</p>
          <span class="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ sectionOnCount(section) }}/{{ section.toggles.length }} on</span>
        </div>
        <p v-if="section.description" class="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ section.description }}</p>
        <div class="mt-3 space-y-3">
          <div v-for="toggle in section.toggles" :key="toggle.id" :data-agent-setting-row="toggle.id" class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div class="min-w-0">
              <p class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ toggle.label }}</p>
              <p v-if="toggle.description" class="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ toggle.description }}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              data-agent-setting-toggle
              role="switch"
              :aria-checked="isOn(toggle.id)"
              :aria-label="toggle.label"
              @click="flip(toggle)"
              :class="['relative h-5 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors', isOn(toggle.id) ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-600']"
            >
              <span :class="['absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-all', isOn(toggle.id) ? 'left-4' : 'left-0.5']"></span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

    <UiIcon :name="styles.icon" :size="16" :class="['mt-0.5 shrink-0', styles.iconClass]" />

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

===== FILE: vue\AmberEmbersBackdrop.vue =====

<template>
  <canvas
    ref="canvasRef"
    aria-hidden="true"
    :class="['fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0', className]"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from "vue";

interface Props {
  speed?: number;
  density?: number;
  baseColor?: string;
  bloomColor?: string;
  emberColor?: string;
  interactive?: boolean;
  paused?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  speed: 1,
  density: 72,
  baseColor: "#0d0d0d",
  bloomColor: "#6b5947",
  emberColor: "#e6b745",
  interactive: false,
  paused: false,
  className: "",
});

const canvasRef = ref<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

const numOr = (v: number | undefined, fallback: number, min: number, max: number) =>
  Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v as number)) : fallback;

const safeColor = (v: string | undefined, fallback: string) => {
  const s = (v ?? "").trim();
  if (/^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(s) || /^rgba?\(\s*[\d.%\s,]+\)$/i.test(s)) return s;
  return fallback;
};

const hexToRgb = (hex: string): [number, number, number] => {
  let h = hex.replace("#", "");
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("");
  const n = Number.parseInt(h, 16);
  return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
};

type Ember = {
  x: number; y: number; r: number; rise: number; sway: number;
  swayAmp: number; phase: number; twinkle: number; alpha: number;
};

const rand = (a: number, b: number) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

let cleanup: (() => void) | null = null;

function mount() {
  const canvas = canvasRef.value;
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return;

  const spd = numOr(props.speed, 1, 0, 4);
  const count = Math.round(numOr(props.density, 72, 1, 220));
  const base = safeColor(props.baseColor, "#0d0d0d");
  const bloom = safeColor(props.bloomColor, "#6b5947");
  const ember = safeColor(props.emberColor, "#e6b745");

  const sprite = document.createElement("canvas");
  const SP = 64;
  sprite.width = SP;
  sprite.height = SP;
  const sctx = sprite.getContext("2d");
  if (!sctx) return;
  const [er, eg, eb] = hexToRgb(ember);
  const sg = sctx.createRadialGradient(SP / 2, SP / 2, 0, SP / 2, SP / 2, SP / 2);
  sg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},1)`);
  sg.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},0.55)`);
  sg.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${er},${eg},${eb},0)`);
  sctx.fillStyle = sg;
  sctx.fillRect(0, 0, SP, SP);

  const embers: Ember[] = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
    x: rand(0, 1), y: rand(-0.1, 1.1), r: rand(1.5, 6.5),
    rise: rand(0.008, 0.032), sway: rand(0.002, 0.012),
    swayAmp: rand(0.004, 0.03), phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
    twinkle: rand(0.5, 1.8), alpha: rand(0.35, 0.95),
  }));

  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  let W = 1;
  let H = 1;
  const pointer = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, tx: 0.5, ty: 0.5 };

  const resize = () => {
    W = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth) * dpr));
    H = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight) * dpr));
    if (canvas.width !== W || canvas.height !== H) {
      canvas.width = W;
      canvas.height = H;
    }
  };

  const drawField = (t: number) => {
    const field = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    field.addColorStop(0, base);
    field.addColorStop(0.55, "#23241b");
    field.addColorStop(1, bloom);
    ctx.fillStyle = field;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const bx = (0.5 + (pointer.x - 0.5) * 0.12) * W;
    const by = (0.92 + (pointer.y - 0.5) * 0.06) * H;
    const [br, bg, bb] = hexToRgb(bloom);
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, 0, bx, by, Math.max(W, H) * 0.8);
    glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.55)`);
    glow.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.18)`);
    glow.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0)`);
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    for (const e of embers) {
      const ex = (e.x + Math.sin(t * e.sway + e.phase) * e.swayAmp) * W;
      const ey = e.y * H;
      const tw = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * e.twinkle + e.phase);
      const size = e.r * dpr * 6;
      ctx.globalAlpha = e.alpha * tw;
      ctx.drawImage(sprite, ex - size / 2, ey - size / 2, size, size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      W / 2, H * 0.45, Math.min(W, H) * 0.2,
      W / 2, H * 0.45, Math.max(W, H) * 0.78,
    );
    vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.62)");
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  };

  const reduced =
    typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
      ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
      : false;

  let raf = 0;
  let last = 0;
  let t = 0;
  let stopped = props.paused;

  const frame = (now: number) => {
    if (stopped) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    t += dt * spd;
    pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.05;
    pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.05;
    for (const e of embers) {
      e.y -= e.rise * dt * spd;
      if (e.y < -0.1) { e.y = 1.1; e.x = Math.random(); }
    }
    drawField(t);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (stopped) return;
    last = performance.now();
    if (reduced) drawField(t);
    else { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  };
  const stop = () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; };
  const onVisibility = () => { if (document.hidden) stop(); else start(); };
  const onResize = () => { resize(); if (stopped || reduced) drawField(t); };
  const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!props.interactive) return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.tx = (e.clientX - rect.left) / (rect.width || 1);
    pointer.ty = (e.clientY - rect.top) / (rect.height || 1);
  };

  resize();
  if (props.interactive) window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
  start();

  cleanup = () => {
    stop();
    if (props.interactive) window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
    window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
  };
}

onMounted(mount);
onUnmounted(() => { if (cleanup) cleanup(); });
watch(
  () => [props.speed, props.density, props.baseColor, props.bloomColor, props.emberColor, props.interactive, props.paused],
  () => { if (cleanup) cleanup(); cleanup = null; mount(); },
);

===== FILE: vue\AnimatedCounter.vue =====

<template>
  <span
    ref="elRef"
    :class="['font-mono tabular-nums select-none', className]"
  >
    {{ prefix }}{{ displayValue }}{{ suffix }}
  </span>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";

interface Props {
  target: number;
  start?: number;
  duration?: number;
  delay?: number;
  suffix?: string;
  prefix?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  start: 0,
  duration: 1500,
  delay: 0,
  suffix: "",
  prefix: "",
  className: "",
});

const elRef = ref<HTMLSpanElement | null>(null);
const displayValue = ref<number>(props.start);
let animated = false;
let rafId = 0;
let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
let observer: IntersectionObserver | null = null;

const easeOutCubic = (t: number) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

onMounted(() => {
  const el = elRef.value;
  if (!el || animated) return;

  if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
    displayValue.value = props.target;
    animated = true;
    return;
  }

  // Respect prefers-reduced-motion: jump straight to the final value.
  if (
    typeof window.matchMedia === "function" &&
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
  ) {
    displayValue.value = props.target;
    animated = true;
    return;
  }

  observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    (entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting || animated) return;
        animated = true;
        if (observer) observer.unobserve(entry.target);

        timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
          const startTime = performance.now();
          const range = props.target - props.start;

          const tick = (now: number) => {
            const elapsed = now - startTime;
            const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, elapsed / props.duration));
            displayValue.value = Math.round(props.start + easeOutCubic(progress) * range);

            if (progress < 1) {
              rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
            } else {
              displayValue.value = props.target;
            }
          };

          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }, props.delay);
      });
    },
    { threshold: 0.2 }
  );

  observer.observe(el);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  if (observer) observer.disconnect();
  if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
});
</script>

  (e: 'approve'): void;
  (e: 'reject'): void;
}>();

const DECISION_TONE: Record<string, { icon: IconName; className: string }> = {
  approved: { icon: 'check-circle', className: 'text-emerald-600' },
  rejected: { icon: 'circle-x', className: 'text-rose-600' },
  pending: { icon: 'clock', className: 'text-zinc-400' },
};

const decisionTone = computed(() => DECISION_TONE[props.decision] || DECISION_TONE.pending);

const avatarTone = (tone?: string) => {
  if (tone === 'emerald') return 'bg-emerald-600';
  if (tone === 'rose') return 'bg-rose-600';
  if (tone === 'amber') return 'bg-amber-500';
  return 'bg-indigo-600';
};

const handleRequestChange = () => {
  props.onRequestChange?.();
  emit('request-change');
};
const handleApprove = () => {
  props.onApprove?.();
  emit('approve');
};
const handleReject = () => {
  props.onReject?.();
  emit('reject');
};
</script>

  ],

  class: "",
});

  liked.value = next;
  emit("like", track);
};

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface AuthProvider { name: string; icon?: string }
export interface AuthSubmitPayload { name?: string; email: string; password: string }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  mode?: 'signin' | 'signup';
  providers?: AuthProvider[];
  loading?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  submitText?: string;
  footerText?: string;
}>(), { mode: 'signin', providers: () => [], loading: false });

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'submit', payload: AuthSubmitPayload): void;
  (e: 'provider', provider: AuthProvider): void;
  (e: 'footer'): void;
}>();

const name = ref('');
const email = ref('');
const password = ref('');
const isSignup = computed(() => props.mode === 'signup');
const providerFallback = (value: string) => (value || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

const inputClass =
  'w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:border-indigo-500 transition-colors';

const handleSubmit = () => {
  if (props.loading) return;
  emit('submit', { ...(isSignup.value ? { name: name.value } : {}), email: email.value, password: password.value });
};
</script>

===== FILE: vue\AutoScrollAnchor.vue =====

<template>
  <div :ref="(el) => { bottomEl = el as HTMLElement; }" :class="['h-px w-full pointer-events-none', className]"></div>

  <!-- Floating Back to Bottom Button -->
  <button
    v-if="!isAtBottom"
    type="button"
    @click="scrollToBottom"
    class="fixed bottom-24 right-8 z-30 p-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium"
    title="Scroll to bottom"
  >
    <span>↓</span>
    <span v-if="isStreaming" class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-ping"></span>
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isStreaming?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isStreaming: false,
    className: ''
  }
);

const bottomEl = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);
const isAtBottom = ref(true);

const handleScroll = () => {
  const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
  const documentHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
  const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
  const distanceFromBottom = documentHeight - (scrollTop + windowHeight);
  isAtBottom.value = distanceFromBottom < 80;
};

onMounted(() => {
  window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
});

watch(
  () => props.isStreaming,
  (streaming) => {
    if (streaming && isAtBottom.value) {
      bottomEl.value?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }
);

const scrollToBottom = () => {
  bottomEl.value?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
};
</script>


===== FILE: vue\AvatarGroup.vue =====

<template>
  <div :class="['flex items-center -space-x-2', $attrs.class]">
    <button v-for="member in visible" :key="member.id" type="button" :title="member.name" :aria-label="member.name"
      class="relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold text-zinc-600 ring-2 ring-white transition-transform hover:z-10 hover:scale-105 focus-visible:z-10 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:ring-zinc-900"
      :class="sizeClass" @click="$emit('member-click', member)">
      <img v-if="member.src" :src="member.src" alt="" class="h-full w-full object-cover" />
      <span v-else-if="member.name.trim()" aria-hidden="true">{{ initials(member.name) }}</span>
      <UiIcon v-else name="user" :size="iconSize" />
      <span v-if="member.status" aria-hidden="true"
        :class="['absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-900', DOT_CLASS[member.status]]" />
    </button>
    <span v-if="overflow > 0" :title="`${overflow} more`"
      :class="['relative inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-500 ring-2 ring-white dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:ring-zinc-900', sizeClass]">
      +{{ overflow }}
    </span>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type AvatarStatus = 'online' | 'away' | 'offline';

export interface AvatarMember {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  src?: string;
  status?: AvatarStatus;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    members: AvatarMember[];
    max?: number;
    size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  }>(),
  { max: 4, size: 'md' }
);
defineEmits<{ (e: 'member-click', member: AvatarMember): void }>();

const SIZE_CLASS: Record<'sm' | 'md' | 'lg', string> = {
  sm: 'h-7 w-7 text-[10px]',
  md: 'h-9 w-9 text-xs',
  lg: 'h-11 w-11 text-sm',
};

const DOT_CLASS: Record<AvatarStatus, string> = {
  online: 'bg-emerald-500',
  away: 'bg-amber-400',
  offline: 'bg-zinc-400',
};

const visible = computed(() => props.members.slice(0, Math.max(0, props.max)));
const overflow = computed(() => props.members.length - visible.value.length);
const sizeClass = computed(() => SIZE_CLASS[props.size]);
const iconSize = computed(() => (props.size === 'sm' ? 12 : props.size === 'lg' ? 18 : 14));

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
    .join('');
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

export interface BillingAddress {
  country: string;
  address1: string;
  address2?: string;
  city: string;
  state?: string;
  zip: string;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  countries?: string[];
  labels?: { address1?: string; address2?: string; city?: string; state?: string; zip?: string };
  defaultValue?: Partial<BillingAddress>;
  submitLabel?: string;
  showOptional?: boolean;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Billing details",
  countries: () => ["United States", "Singapore", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "Japan"],
  labels: () => ({}),
  defaultValue: () => ({}),
  submitLabel: "Continue to next step",
  showOptional: true,
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "submit", address: BillingAddress): void;
}>();

const DEFAULT_COUNTRIES = props.countries;
const country = ref(props.defaultValue.country ?? DEFAULT_COUNTRIES[0] ?? "");
const address1 = ref(props.defaultValue.address1 ?? "");
const address2 = ref(props.defaultValue.address2 ?? "");
const city = ref(props.defaultValue.city ?? "");
const state = ref(props.defaultValue.state ?? "");
const zip = ref(props.defaultValue.zip ?? "");
const submitted = ref<BillingAddress | null>(null);

const valid = computed(() => address1.value.trim() !== "" && city.value.trim() !== "" && zip.value.trim() !== "");

const handleSubmit = () => {
  if (!valid.value) return;
  const address: BillingAddress = {
    country: country.value,
    address1: address1.value,
    address2: address2.value || undefined,
    city: city.value,
    state: state.value || undefined,
    zip: zip.value,
  };
  submitted.value = address;
  emit("submit", address);
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";

export interface BottomTab {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  badge?: number;
}

export interface BottomTabBarProps {
  tabs?: BottomTab[];
  active?: string;
  label?: string;
  class?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<BottomTabBarProps>(), {
  tabs: () => [
    { id: "home", label: "Home", icon: "⌂" },
    { id: "search", label: "Search", icon: "⌕", badge: 3 },
    { id: "create", label: "Create", icon: "+" },
    { id: "inbox", label: "Inbox", icon: "✉", badge: 12 },
    { id: "profile", label: "Profile", icon: "◉" },
  ],
  active: "",
  label: "Primary navigation",
  class: "",
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "tab-change", id: string): void;
}>();

const list = computed(() => (Array.isArray(props.tabs) ? props.tabs : []));
const internalActive = ref("");
const active = computed(() => props.active || internalActive.value || list.value[0]?.id || "home");

const select = (id: string) => {
  internalActive.value = id;
  emit("tab-change", id);
};
</script>

<template>
  <nav data-bottomtab-bar :aria-label="props.label" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900" :class="props.class">
    <div data-bottomtab-items class="flex items-stretch px-2 pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]">
      <button
        v-for="tab in list"
        :key="tab.id"
        type="button"
        :data-bottomtab-item="tab.id"
        :aria-current="tab.id === active ? 'page' : 'false'"
        class="relative flex flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-0.5 py-2 transition-colors"
        :class="tab.id === active
          ? 'text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400'
          : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-500 dark:hover:text-zinc-300'"
        @click="select(tab.id)"
      >
        <span :data-bottomtab-icon="tab.id" aria-hidden="true" class="text-lg leading-5">{{ tab.icon || "" }}</span>
        <span :data-bottomtab-label="tab.id" class="text-[10px] font-medium">{{ tab.label }}</span>
        <span v-if="tab.badge" :data-bottomtab-badge="tab.id" class="absolute -right-2 -top-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold leading-4 text-white">{{ tab.badge }}</span>
        <span :data-bottomtab-indicator="tab.id" aria-hidden="true" class="absolute -top-px inset-x-4 h-0.5 rounded-full bg-violet-600 dark:bg-violet-400" :class="tab.id === active ? 'block' : 'hidden'"></span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </nav>
</template>

===== FILE: vue\Breadcrumb.vue =====

<template>
  <nav :aria-label="ariaLabel" :class="$attrs.class">
    <ol class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
      <li v-for="(item, index) in trail" :key="item ? item.id ?? `${item.label}-${index}` : `ellipsis-${index}`"
        class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span v-if="index > 0" aria-hidden="true" class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
          <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="11" />
        </span>
        <span v-if="!item" aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-zinc-400">…</span>
        <span v-else-if="index === trail.length - 1" aria-current="page"
          :class="[BASE, 'font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100']">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </span>
        <a v-else-if="item.href" :href="item.href" :class="[BASE, LINK_CLASS]"
          @click="onLinkClick($event, item, index)">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </a>
        <button v-else type="button" :class="[BASE, LINK_CLASS]" @click="emit('navigate', item, index)">
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="12" />
          <span>{{ item.label }}</span>
        </button>
      </li>
    </ol>
  </nav>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
  id?: string;
  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: IconName;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items: BreadcrumbItem[];
    maxItems?: number;
    ariaLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { maxItems: 0, ariaLabel: 'Breadcrumb' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'navigate', item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number): void }>();

const BASE = 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded px-1 py-0.5 transition-colors';
const LINK_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';

const trail = computed<(BreadcrumbItem | null)[]>(() => {
  const { items, maxItems } = props;
  if (maxItems <= 0 || items.length <= maxItems) return items;
  const tail = Math.max(1, maxItems - 1);
  return [items[0], null, ...items.slice(items.length - tail)];
});

const onLinkClick = (event: MouseEvent, item: BreadcrumbItem, index: number) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  emit('navigate', item, index);
};
</script>

===== FILE: vue\ChangedFilesList.vue =====

<template>
  <div data-changed-files class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <button type="button" data-changed-files-toggle class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-left focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500" @click="open = !open">
      <svg :class="['h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform', open ? 'rotate-90' : '']" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" /></svg>
      <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ title }}</span>
      <span v-if="showDiffstat" class="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs">
        <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{{ totals.additions }}</span>
        {{ ' ' }}
        <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">−{{ totals.deletions }}</span>
      </span>
    </button>
    <div v-if="open" class="px-2 pb-2">
      <div v-for="(group, index) in groups" :key="group.folder || index" :data-files-group="group.folder || undefined">
        <p v-if="grouped && group.folder" class="px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ group.folder }}/</p>
        <button v-for="file in group.files" :key="file.path" type="button" :data-changed-file="file.path" class="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" @click="emit('file-click', file)">
          <span class="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ extOf(file.path) }}</span>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-mono text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ grouped ? nameOf(file.path) : file.path }}</span>
          <span v-if="file.status && STATUS_TAG[file.status]" :class="['shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold', STATUS_TAG[file.status]]">{{ file.status }}</span>
          <span v-if="showDiffstat" class="shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px]">
            <span class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{{ file.additions }}</span>
            {{ ' ' }}
            <span class="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">−{{ file.deletions }}</span>
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export interface ChangedFile {
  path: string;
  additions: number;
  deletions: number;
  status?: 'new' | 'modified' | 'generated' | 'deleted';
}

const STATUS_TAG: Record<string, string> = {
  new: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  generated: 'bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/60 dark:text-violet-300',
  deleted: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',
  modified: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300',
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    files: ChangedFile[];
    grouped?: boolean;
    showDiffstat?: boolean;
    defaultExpanded?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { title: 'Files changed', grouped: false, showDiffstat: true, defaultExpanded: true },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'file-click', file: ChangedFile): void;
}>();

const open = ref(props.defaultExpanded);

const nameOf = (path: string) => path.split('/').pop() || path;
const extOf = (path: string) => nameOf(path).split('.').pop() || '';
const parentOf = (path: string) => {
  const parts = path.split('/');
  return parts.length > 1 ? parts.slice(0, -1).join('/') : '';
};

const groups = computed(() => {
  if (!props.grouped) return [{ folder: '', files: props.files }];
  const map = new Map<string, ChangedFile[]>();
  props.files.forEach((file) => {
    const folder = parentOf(file.path) || '/';
    if (!map.has(folder)) map.set(folder, []);
    map.get(folder)!.push(file);
  });
  return [...map.entries()].map(([folder, files]) => ({ folder, files }));
});

const totals = computed(() =>
  props.files.reduce(
    (acc, file) => ({ additions: acc.additions + file.additions, deletions: acc.deletions + file.deletions }),
    { additions: 0, deletions: 0 },
  ),
);
</script>

  rose: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300',

<template>
  <div
    :class="[
      'relative w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900/90 shadow-sm focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-zinc-900/10 dark:focus-within:ring-zinc-100/10 focus-within:border-zinc-400 dark:focus-within:border-zinc-600 transition-all',

    ]"

        <input
          ref="fileInputRef"
          type="file"
          multiple
          class="hidden"
          @change="handleFileChange"
          :disabled="disabled || isGenerating"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          @click="fileInputRef?.click()"
          :disabled="disabled || isGenerating"
          class="p-2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-xl transition-colors disabled:opacity-40"
          title="Add attachment"
        >
          <UiIcon name="paperclip" :size="18" />
        </button>
      </template>

      <textarea
        ref="textareaRef"
        :value="modelValue"
        @input="handleInput"
        @keydown="handleKeyDown"
        :placeholder="placeholder"
        :disabled="disabled"
        rows="1"
        class="flex-1 bg-transparent resize-none border-0 p-1 text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 leading-relaxed max-h-[240px] min-h-[36px]"
      ></textarea>

      <!-- Action Button -->
      <button

        type="button"
        @click="$emit('stop')"
        class="p-2 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100 text-white dark:text-zinc-900 rounded-xl hover:opacity-90 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-sm flex-shrink-0"

        {{ chip.label }}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch, nextTick } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface Attachment {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  url?: string;
  type: 'image' | 'file';
}

export interface PromptChip {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  active?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    modelValue: string;
    isGenerating?: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    allowAttachments?: boolean;
    attachments?: Attachment[];
    chips?: PromptChip[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isGenerating: false,
    placeholder: 'Ask anything... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)',
    disabled: false,
    allowAttachments: true,
    attachments: () => [],
    chips: () => [],
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'update:modelValue', value: string): void;
  (e: 'submit'): void;
  (e: 'stop'): void;
  (e: 'addAttachment', file: File): void;
  (e: 'removeAttachment', id: string): void;
  (e: 'chipClick', chip: PromptChip): void;
}>();

const textareaRef = ref<HTMLTextAreaElement | null>(null);
const fileInputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const adjustHeight = () => {
  const textarea = textareaRef.current;
  if (!textarea) return;
  textarea.style.height = 'auto';
  const nextHeight = Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 240);
  textarea.style.height = `${Math.max(nextHeight, 48)}px`;
};

const handleInput = (e: Event) => {
  const val = (e.target as HTMLTextAreaElement).value;
  emit('update:modelValue', val);
  adjustHeight();
};

watch(() => props.modelValue, () => {
  nextTick(adjustHeight);
});

const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
    if (e.isComposing) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!props.isGenerating && props.modelValue.trim() && !props.disabled) {
      emit('submit');
    }
  }
};

const handleFileChange = (e: Event) => {
  const target = e.target as HTMLInputElement;
  const files = target.files;
  if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
  Array.from(files).forEach((file) => emit('addAttachment', file));
  target.value = '';
};

const handleSubmit = () => {
  if (props.modelValue.trim() && !props.disabled) {
    emit('submit');
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <div class="flex flex-col w-64 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 overflow-hidden" :class="className">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
      <UiIcon name="sparkles" :size="15" class="text-indigo-500" />
      {{ title }}
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] font-mono font-normal text-zinc-400">{{ sessions.length }}</span>

          <span class="font-mono font-normal">{{ group.items.length }}</span>

                type="button"
                aria-label="Delete session"
                class="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 p-1 rounded-md text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 transition-all shrink-0"

      v-if="user"
      type="button"
      class="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors text-left"
      @click="emit('userClick')"
    >

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ChatSessionItem {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  timeLabel?: string;
  /** Optional group label (e.g. "Today", "Previous 7 days"); sessions without one go to "Recent". */
  group?: string;
}

export interface ChatSessionUser {
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    sessions?: ChatSessionItem[];
    activeId?: string | number | null;
    user?: ChatSessionUser;
    title?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { sessions: () => [], activeId: null, title: "Chats", emptyText: "No conversations yet", className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", session: ChatSessionItem): void;
  (e: "delete", id: string | number): void;
  (e: "userClick"): void;
}>();

const collapsedGroups = ref(new Set<string>());
const toggleGroup = (label: string) => {
  const next = new Set(collapsedGroups.value);
  if (next.has(label)) next.delete(label);
  else next.add(label);
  collapsedGroups.value = next;
};

// Preserve the sessions' original order; group headers appear on first occurrence.
const groups = computed(() => {
  const result: { label: string; items: ChatSessionItem[] }[] = [];
  props.sessions.forEach((s) => {
    const label = s.group || "Recent";
    const existing = result.find((g) => g.label === label);
    if (existing) existing.items.push(s);
    else result.push({ label, items: [s] });
  });
  return result;
});

const initials = computed(() =>
  props.user
    ? (props.user.name || "?")
        .trim()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((w) => w[0])
        .slice(0, 2)
        .join("")
        .toUpperCase()
    : ""
);
</script>

    showCopy: true,
    className: "",
  }

  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.code);

        >
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" class="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: string;
    swatches?: string[];
    documentColors?: string[];
    customColors?: string[];
    showEyedropper?: boolean;
    showRgbInputs?: boolean;
    showHexInput?: boolean;
  }>(),
  {
    value: '#2563eb',
    swatches: () => [],
    documentColors: () => [],
    customColors: () => [],
    showEyedropper: false,
    showRgbInputs: false,
    showHexInput: true,
  },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', hex: string): void;
  (e: 'eyedropper-click'): void;
  (e: 'add-custom', hex: string): void;
}>();

const DEFAULT_ROWS = [
  ['#000000', '#374151', '#6b7280', '#9ca3af', '#d1d5db', '#f3f4f6'],
  ['#dc2626', '#ef4444', '#f87171', '#fca5a5', '#fecaca', '#fee2e2'],
  ['#ea580c', '#f97316', '#fb923c', '#fdba74', '#fed7aa', '#ffedd5'],
  ['#16a34a', '#22c55e', '#4ade80', '#86efac', '#bbf7d0', '#dcfce7'],
  ['#2563eb', '#3b82f6', '#60a5fa', '#93c5fd', '#bfdbfe', '#dbeafe'],
  ['#7c3aed', '#8b5cf6', '#a78bfa', '#c4b5fd', '#ddd6fe', '#ede9fe'],
];

const rows = computed(() => (props.swatches.length ? [props.swatches] : DEFAULT_ROWS));

const normalizeHex = (input: string): string | null => {
  const match = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(input.trim());
  return match ? `#${match[1].toLowerCase()}` : null;
};

const hexToRgb = (hexValue: string) => {
  const match = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hexValue.trim());
  if (!match) return null;
  const int = parseInt(match[1], 16);
  return { r: (int >> 16) & 255, g: (int >> 8) & 255, b: int & 255 };
};

const rgbToHex = (r: number, g: number, b: number) =>
  `#${[r, g, b].map((c) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(c))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;

const initial = normalizeHex(props.value) || '#2563eb';
const hex = ref(initial);
const draft = ref(initial);

watch(
  () => props.value,
  (next) => {
    const parsed = normalizeHex(next);
    if (parsed) {
      hex.value = parsed;
      draft.value = parsed;
    }
  },
);

const rgb = computed(() => hexToRgb(hex.value) || { r: 37, g: 99, b: 235 });

const apply = (next: string) => {
  hex.value = next;
  draft.value = next;
  emit('change', next);
};

const onHexInput = (raw: string) => {
  draft.value = raw;
  const parsed = normalizeHex(raw);
  if (parsed) {
    hex.value = parsed;
    emit('change', parsed);
  }
};

const onChannel = (channel: 'r' | 'g' | 'b', raw: string) => {
  const num = parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (Number.isNaN(num)) return;
  const current = rgb.value;
  const next = rgbToHex(channel === 'r' ? num : current.r, channel === 'g' ? num : current.g, channel === 'b' ? num : current.b);
  apply(next);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-column-visibility-menu class="w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">

      </p>

    </div>
    <ul class="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto py-1">

        <div :class="['flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5', column.locked ? 'opacity-60' : '']">
          <span v-if="showReorderHandles && !column.locked" class="flex shrink-0 flex-col text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" class="h-3 w-3"><circle cx="9" cy="6" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="6" r="1.5" /><circle cx="9" cy="12" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1.5" /><circle cx="9" cy="18" r="1.5" /><circle cx="15" cy="18" r="1.5" /></svg>
          </span>
          <svg v-if="column.locked" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2" /><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4" /></svg>
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ column.label }}</span>
          <button type="button" data-column-toggle :aria-label="`${isVisible(column) ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} ${column.label}`" :disabled="column.locked" :class="['shrink-0 rounded p-1 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500', isVisible(column) ? 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800' : 'text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-600']" @click="toggle(column)">
            <svg v-if="isVisible(column)" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-3.5 7-10 7-10-7-10-7Z" /><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" /></svg>
            <svg v-else viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5"><path d="M2 12s3.5-7 10-7c2 0 3.7.6 5.1 1.5M22 12s-3.5 7-10 7c-2 0-3.7-.6-5.1-1.5" /><path d="m4 4 16 16" /></svg>
          </button>
          <span v-if="showReorderHandles && !column.locked" class="flex shrink-0 flex-col">
            <button type="button" data-column-up :aria-label="`Move ${column.label} up`" class="rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" @click="emit('reorder', index, index - 1)">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m18 15-6-6-6 6" /></svg>
            </button>
            <button type="button" data-column-down :aria-label="`Move ${column.label} down`" class="rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-500 focus-visible:outline-none dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" @click="emit('reorder', index, index + 1)">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" /></svg>

          </span>
        </div>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <div v-if="applyMode === 'apply-button'" class="border-t border-zinc-100 p-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <button type="button" data-column-apply class="w-full rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-white" @click="emit('apply', [...draft])">
        {{ applyLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export interface ColumnDef {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  locked?: boolean;
  hidden?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    columns: ColumnDef[];
    visibleIds?: string[];
    showReorderHandles?: boolean;
    applyMode?: 'instant' | 'apply-button';
    resetLabel?: string;
    applyLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { visibleIds: () => [], showReorderHandles: true, applyMode: 'instant', resetLabel: 'Reset to default', applyLabel: 'Apply' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'toggle', id: string, visible: boolean): void;
  (e: 'reorder', from: number, to: number): void;
  (e: 'reset'): void;
  (e: 'apply', visibleIds: string[]): void;
}>();

const draft = ref(new Set<string>(props.visibleIds.length ? props.visibleIds : props.columns.filter((c) => !c.hidden).map((c) => c.id)));

watch(
  () => props.visibleIds,
  (ids) => {
    if (ids.length) draft.value = new Set(ids);
  },
);

const isVisible = (column: ColumnDef) => {
  if (column.locked) return true;
  if (props.applyMode === 'apply-button') return draft.value.has(column.id);
  return props.visibleIds.length ? props.visibleIds.includes(column.id) : !column.hidden;
};

const visibleCount = computed(() => props.columns.filter((c) => isVisible(c)).length);

const toggle = (column: ColumnDef) => {
  if (column.locked) return;
  const nextVisible = !isVisible(column);
  if (props.applyMode === 'apply-button') {
    const next = new Set(draft.value);
    if (nextVisible) next.add(column.id);
    else next.delete(column.id);
    draft.value = next;
  } else {
    const next = props.visibleIds.includes(column.id)
      ? props.visibleIds.filter((id) => id !== column.id)
      : [...props.visibleIds, column.id];
    emit('apply', next);
  }
  emit('toggle', column.id, nextVisible);
};
</script>

  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, useId, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface ComboBoxOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: IconName;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    options: ComboBoxOption[];
    placeholder?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
  }>(),
  { placeholder: 'Search…', emptyText: 'No matches found.' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', value: string): void }>();

const rootRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
const open = ref(false);
const query = ref('');
const active = ref(0);
const selected = ref<string | null>(null);
const id = useId();

const filtered = computed(() => {
  const q = query.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return props.options;
  return props.options.filter(
    (option) =>
      option.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (option.description ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
  );
});

watch(query, () => {
  active.value = 0;
});

const choose = (option: ComboBoxOption) => {
  selected.value = option.value;
  query.value = option.label;
  open.value = false;
  emit('change', option.value);
};

const onInput = (event: Event) => {
  query.value = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value;
  open.value = true;
};

const onFieldKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    event.preventDefault();
    open.value = true;
    active.value = Math.min(active.value + 1, filtered.value.length - 1);
  } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    event.preventDefault();
    active.value = Math.max(active.value - 1, 0);
  } else if (event.key === 'Enter') {
    const option = filtered.value[active.value];
    if (option && open.value) {
      event.preventDefault();
      choose(option);
    }
  }
};

const onDocMouseDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) open.value = false;
};
const onDocKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') open.value = false;
};

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDocMouseDown);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onDocKeyDown);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDocMouseDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onDocKeyDown);
});
</script>

            {{ k }}
          </kbd>
          <span>{{ hint.label }}</span>
        </span>
      </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface CommandItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  icon?: string;
  group?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items?: CommandItem[];
    isOpen: boolean;
    placeholder?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { items: () => [], placeholder: "Type a command or search...", className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", item: CommandItem): void;
  (e: "close"): void;
}>();

const query = ref("");
const activeIndex = ref(0);
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const shortcutHints = [
  { keys: ["↑", "↓"], label: "Navigate" },
  { keys: ["↵"], label: "Select" },
  { keys: ["esc"], label: "Close" },
] as const;

const filtered = computed(() => {
  if (!query.value.trim()) return props.items;
  const q = query.value.toLowerCase();
  return props.items.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (i.hint && i.hint.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (i.group && i.group.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  );
});

function select(item: CommandItem) {
  emit("select", item);
  emit("close");
}

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  async (open) => {
    if (open) {
      query.value = "";
      activeIndex.value = 0;
      await nextTick();
      inputRef.value?.focus();
    }
  }
);
watch(query, () => (activeIndex.value = 0));

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    emit("close");
  } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
    e.preventDefault();
    activeIndex.value = Math.min(filtered.value.length - 1, activeIndex.value + 1);
  } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
    e.preventDefault();
    activeIndex.value = Math.max(0, activeIndex.value - 1);
  } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
    e.preventDefault();
    const item = filtered.value[activeIndex.value];
    if (item) select(item);
  }
}

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey));
</script>

<template>
  <div :class="className">

        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface CommentItem {
  id: string | number;
  /** Parent comment id; omit or null for a root comment. */
  parentId?: string | number | null;
  author: string;
  /** Image URL; falls back to initials. */
  avatar?: string;
  text: string;
  time?: string;
  likes?: number;
  resolved?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    comments?: CommentItem[];
    placeholder?: string;
    submitText?: string;
    allowComment?: boolean;
    emptyText?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    comments: () => [],
    placeholder: 'Write a comment...',
    submitText: 'Comment',
    allowComment: true,
    emptyText: 'No comments yet. Start the conversation.',
    className: '',
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'submit', text: string, parentId: string | number | null): void;
  (e: 'like', comment: CommentItem): void;
  (e: 'resolve', comment: CommentItem): void;
}>();

const draft = ref('');
const replyTo = ref<string | number | null>(null);
const replyDraft = ref('');

/** Flat comments + parentId → depth-tagged render order (parents before children). */
const rows = computed(() => {
  const children = new Map<string, CommentItem[]>();
  const roots: CommentItem[] = [];
  props.comments.forEach((comment) => {
    if (comment.parentId == null) {
      roots.push(comment);
      return;
    }
    const key = String(comment.parentId);
    children.set(key, [...(children.get(key) || []), comment]);
  });

  const out: Array<{ comment: CommentItem; depth: number }> = [];
  const walk = (list: CommentItem[], depth: number) => {
    list.forEach((comment) => {
      out.push({ comment, depth });
      // Cap nesting at 3 levels so deep threads never break the layout.
      if (depth < 2) walk(children.get(String(comment.id)) || [], depth + 1);
      else (children.get(String(comment.id)) || []).forEach((child) => out.push({ comment: child, depth: depth + 1 }));
    });
  };
  walk(roots, 0);
  return out;
});

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? '')
    .join('');

function toggleReply(id: string | number) {
  replyTo.value = replyTo.value === id ? null : id;
  replyDraft.value = '';
}

function submitRoot() {
  const text = draft.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  emit('submit', text, null);
  draft.value = '';
}

function submitReply(parentId: string | number) {
  const text = replyDraft.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  emit('submit', text, parentId);
  replyDraft.value = '';
  replyTo.value = null;
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

type Tone = "danger" | "warning" | "default";

const TONE_META: Record<Tone, { chip: string; button: string; icon: string }> = {
  danger: {
    chip: "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
    button: "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 focus-visible:ring-red-500",
    icon: "alert-triangle",
  },
  warning: {
    chip: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400",
    button: "bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 focus-visible:ring-amber-500",
    icon: "alert-triangle",
  },
  default: {
    chip: "bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400",
    button: "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500",
    icon: "info",
  },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    confirmText?: string;
    cancelText?: string;
    tone?: Tone;
    requireText?: string;
    loading?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    confirmText: "Confirm",
    cancelText: "Cancel",
    tone: "default",
    loading: false,
    className: "",
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "confirm"): void;
  (e: "cancel"): void;
}>();

const typed = ref("");
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

const tone = computed(() => TONE_META[props.tone] ?? TONE_META.default);
const blocked = computed(() => Boolean(props.requireText) && typed.value !== props.requireText);
const canConfirm = computed(() => !blocked.value && !props.loading);

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  async (open) => {
    typed.value = "";
    if (open && props.requireText) {
      await nextTick();
      inputRef.value?.focus();
    }
  }
);

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    emit("cancel");
  }
}

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey));

===== FILE: vue\ContextUsageBadge.vue =====

<template>
  <div class="relative inline-block text-xs font-sans select-none" :class="className">
    <button
      type="button"
      @click="showPopover = !showPopover"
      @blur="onBlur"
      class="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/80 transition-colors shadow-sm"
      aria-label="Context Window Usage"
      :aria-expanded="showPopover"
    >
      <UiIcon name="cpu" :size="14" class="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
      <span
        v-if="modelName && !compact"
        class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium truncate max-w-[120px]"
      >
        {{ modelName }}
      </span>
      <div class="w-16 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
        <div
          class="h-full transition-all duration-300"
          :class="barColor"
          :style="{ width: `${percentage}%` }"
        ></div>
      </div>
      <span class="font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
        {{ percentage }}%
      </span>
    </button>

    <div
      v-if="showPopover"
      class="absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-2 w-64 p-3 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-xl z-30 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
    >
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">Context Window</span>
        <span class="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
          {{ formatNumber(safeUsed) }} / {{ formatNumber(safeMax) }}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div v-if="modelName" class="pt-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500 flex justify-between">
        <span>Model</span>
        <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium">{{ modelName }}</span>
      </div>

      <div v-if="breakdown && breakdown.length > 0" class="pt-2.5 space-y-1.5">
        <div class="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-zinc-400 tracking-wider">Breakdown</div>
        <div
          v-for="(item, idx) in breakdown"
          :key="idx"
          class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]"
        >
          <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" :class="item.colorClass || 'bg-zinc-400'"></span>
            {{ item.label }}
          </span>
          <span class="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
            {{ formatNumber(item.count) }}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ContextUsageTokenBreakdown {
  label: string;
  count: number;
  colorClass?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    usedTokens: number;
    maxTokens: number;
    modelName?: string;
    breakdown?: ContextUsageTokenBreakdown[];
    compact?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    compact: false,
    className: "",
    breakdown: () => [],
  }
);

const showPopover = ref(false);

const safeMax = computed(() => Math.max(1, props.maxTokens));
const safeUsed = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.usedTokens));
const percentage = computed(() =>
  Math.min(100, Math.round((safeUsed.value / safeMax.value) * 100))
);

const barColor = computed(() => {
  if (percentage.value >= 90) return "bg-rose-500";
  if (percentage.value >= 70) return "bg-amber-500";
  return "bg-emerald-500";
});

function formatNumber(num: number): string {
  if (num >= 1_000_000) return `${(num / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (num >= 1_000) return `${(num / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(num);
}

function onBlur() {
  setTimeout(() => {
    showPopover.value = false;
  }, 200);
}
</script>

  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  alwaysActive?: boolean;
  cookies?: string[];
}

  defineProps<{
    title?: string;

);

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

interface Props {
  balance?: number;
  unit?: string;
  plan?: string;
  currency?: string;
  warnBelow?: number;
  buyLabel?: string;
  couponLabel?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  balance: 0,
  unit: "credits",
  plan: "Current plan",
  currency: "",
  warnBelow: undefined,
  buyLabel: "Buy More Credits",
  couponLabel: "Apply Coupon",
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "buy"): void;
  (e: "coupon"): void;
}>();

  pulse.value = true;
  window.setTimeout(() => {
    pulse.value = false;
  }, 600);
};

const low = computed(() => typeof props.warnBelow === "number" && props.balance < props.warnBelow);
const formatted = computed(() => props.balance.toFixed(2));

const onBuy = () => {
  flagPulse();
  emit("buy");
};
const onCoupon = () => {
  flagPulse();
  emit("coupon");
};
</script>

      <span

        class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium"

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="relative">
    <div class="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <table class="w-full text-xs">
        <thead class="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60">
          <tr>
            <th v-if="selectable" class="w-10 px-3 py-2">
              <input type="checkbox" :checked="allSelected" @change="toggleAll" aria-label="Select all rows"
                class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600" />
            </th>
            <th v-for="column in columns" :key="column.key" :style="column.width ? { width: column.width } : undefined"
              :class="['px-3 py-2 font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400', alignClass(column.align)]">
              <button type="button" @click="toggleSort(column.key)"
                class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors">
                {{ column.label }}
                <span class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">
                  <UiIcon :name="sortIcon(column.key)" :size="11" />
                </span>
              </button>
            </th>
            <th v-if="actions.length" class="w-20 px-3 py-2" />
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
          <tr v-if="sortedRows.length === 0">
            <td :colspan="columns.length + (selectable ? 1 : 0) + (actions.length ? 1 : 0)"
              class="px-3 py-10 text-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ emptyText }}</td>
          </tr>
          <tr v-for="(row, index) in sortedRows" :key="index" class="group hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors">
            <td v-if="selectable" class="px-3 py-2">
              <input type="checkbox" :checked="selected.has(index)" @change="toggleRow(index)"
                :aria-label="`Select row ${index + 1}`" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-600 accent-indigo-600" />
            </td>
            <td v-for="column in columns" :key="column.key"
              :class="['px-3 py-2 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200', alignClass(column.align), column.align === 'right' ? 'tabular-nums' : '']">
              {{ row[column.key] ?? '—' }}
            </td>
            <td v-if="actions.length" class="px-3 py-2">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                <button v-for="action in actions" :key="action.label" type="button" :aria-label="action.label" :title="action.label"
                  class="rounded p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors"
                  @click="action.onClick(row)">
                  <UiIcon :name="action.icon || 'more-horizontal'" :size="14" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div v-if="selectable && selected.size > 0"
      class="fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 z-20 flex -translate-x-1/2 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 px-4 py-2 shadow-lg">
      <span class="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ selected.size }} selected</span>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
        <button v-for="action in actions" :key="action.label" type="button"
          class="rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors"
          @click="runBatch(action)">{{ action.label }}</button>
      </div>
      <button type="button" aria-label="Clear selection" class="rounded-full p-1 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700"
        @click="selected = new Set()">
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="13" />
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, reactive } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface DataTableColumn { key: string; label: string; align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'; width?: string }
export type DataTableRow = Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;
export interface DataTableAction { label: string; icon?: string; onClick: (row: DataTableRow) => void }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  columns: DataTableColumn[];
  rows: DataTableRow[];
  selectable?: boolean;
  onSort?: (key: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc') => void;
  actions?: DataTableAction[];
  emptyText?: string;
}>(), { selectable: false, actions: () => [], emptyText: 'No results' });

const sortKey = ref<string | null>(null);
const sortDir = ref<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
const selected = ref(new Set<number>());

const alignClass = (align?: DataTableColumn['align']) =>
  align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : align === 'center' ? 'text-center' : 'text-left';

const sortedRows = computed(() => {
  if (props.onSort || !sortKey.value) return props.rows;
  const key = sortKey.value;
  const dir = sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
  return [...props.rows].sort((a, b) => {
    const av = a[key]; const bv = b[key];
    if (av === bv) return 0;
    return (String(av ?? '') > String(bv ?? '') ? 1 : -1) * dir;
  });
});

const allSelected = computed(() => sortedRows.value.length > 0 && selected.value.size === sortedRows.value.length);

const toggleSort = (key: string) => {
  const nextDir = sortKey.value === key && sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
  sortKey.value = key; sortDir.value = nextDir; props.onSort?.(key, nextDir);
};
const sortIcon = (key: string) => (sortKey.value === key ? (sortDir.value === 'asc' ? 'arrow-up' : 'arrow-down') : 'chevron-down');
const toggleAll = () => { selected.value = allSelected.value ? new Set() : new Set(sortedRows.value.map((_, i) => i)); };
const toggleRow = (index: number) => {
  const next = new Set(selected.value);
  next.has(index) ? next.delete(index) : next.add(index);
  selected.value = next;
};
const runBatch = (action: DataTableAction) => {
  selected.value.forEach((index) => action.onClick(sortedRows.value[index]));
  selected.value = new Set();
};
</script>

<template>
  <div
    :class="className"
    class="w-full max-w-[17rem] rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-3"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Previous month"
        class="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        @click="shift(-1)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="14" />
      </button>
      <span class="flex-1 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
        {{ MONTHS[view.month] }} {{ view.year }}
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label="Next month"
        class="rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
        @click="shift(1)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="14" />
      </button>
    </div>

    <div class="mt-2 grid grid-cols-7 gap-0.5">
      <span v-for="label in weekdays" :key="label" class="py-1 text-center text-[10px] font-medium uppercase text-zinc-400">
        {{ label }}
      </span>

      <template v-for="(day, index) in cells" :key="day === null ? `blank-${index}` : iso(day)">
        <span v-if="day === null" />
        <button
          v-else
          type="button"
          :disabled="isDisabled(day)"
          :aria-pressed="value === iso(day)"
          :aria-label="iso(day)"
          :class="[
            'flex h-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[11px] tabular-nums transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300 disabled:hover:bg-transparent dark:disabled:text-zinc-600',
            value === iso(day)
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-indigo-500'
              : iso(day) === today
                ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40'
                : 'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800',
          ]"
          @click="selectDay(day)"
        >
          {{ day }}
        </button>
      </template>
    </div>

    <div v-if="showToday" class="mt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <button
        type="button"
        class="w-full rounded-md py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-600 transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/40"
        @click="selectToday"
      >
        Today
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const MONTHS = [
  'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
  'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December',
];
const WEEKDAYS = ['Su', 'Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa'];

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** Selected date as YYYY-MM-DD. */
    value?: string;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    weekStartsOn?: 0 | 1;
    showToday?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { weekStartsOn: 1, showToday: true, disabled: false, className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', isoDate: string): void }>();

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const toIso = (year: number, month: number, day: number) => `${year}-${pad(month + 1)}-${pad(day)}`;

const parseIso = (iso?: string) => {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso || '');
  if (!match) return null;
  return { year: Number(match[1]), month: Number(match[2]) - 1, day: Number(match[3]) };
};

const now = new Date();
const today = toIso(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

const selected = computed(() => parseIso(props.value));
const initial = selected.value || parseIso(today)!;
const view = ref({ year: initial.year, month: initial.month });

watch(
  () => props.value,
  () => {
    if (selected.value) view.value = { year: selected.value.year, month: selected.value.month };
  }
);

const cells = computed(() => {
  const first = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month, 1).getDay();
  const lead = (first - props.weekStartsOn + 7) % 7;
  const total = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month + 1, 0).getDate();
  const out: Array<number | null> = Array.from({ length: lead }, () => null);
  for (let day = 1; day <= total; day += 1) out.push(day);
  while (out.length % 7 !== 0) out.push(null);
  return out;
});

const weekdays = computed(() => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => WEEKDAYS[(i + props.weekStartsOn) % 7]));

const iso = (day: number) => toIso(view.value.year, view.value.month, day);

function shift(delta: number) {
  const next = new Date(view.value.year, view.value.month + delta, 1);
  view.value = { year: next.getFullYear(), month: next.getMonth() };
}

function isDisabled(day: number) {
  if (props.disabled) return true;
  const value = iso(day);
  if (props.min && value < props.min) return true;
  if (props.max && value > props.max) return true;
  return false;
}

function selectDay(day: number) {
  if (isDisabled(day)) return;
  emit('change', iso(day));
}

function selectToday() {
  if (props.disabled) return;
  if ((props.min && today < props.min) || (props.max && today > props.max)) return;
  emit('change', today);
}
</script>

<template>

        </div>
      </template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface DiffLine {
  type: "add" | "remove" | "context";
  content: string;
}

export interface DiffFile {
  filename: string;
  language?: string;
  lines: DiffLine[];
}

const LINE_STYLE: Record<string, { row: string; gutter: string; sign: string }> = {
  add: { row: "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300", gutter: "text-emerald-500", sign: "+" },
  remove: { row: "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300", gutter: "text-rose-500", sign: "-" },
  context: { row: "text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400", gutter: "text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600", sign: " " },
};

interface HiddenLine {
  line: DiffLine;
  oldNo: number;
  newNo: number;
}

interface RenderRow {
  kind: "line" | "collapsed";
  line?: DiffLine;
  meta?: { row: string; gutter: string; sign: string };
  oldNo?: number | "";
  newNo?: number | "";
  count?: number;
  hidden?: HiddenLine[];
  key: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** Legacy single-diff API (kept for backward compatibility). */
    lines?: DiffLine[];
    filename?: string;
    language?: string;
    /** Multi-file API: renders a tab bar when 1+ files are provided. */
    files?: DiffFile[];
    /** Context lines kept visible around each collapsed gap (default 3). */
    contextSize?: number;
    showLineNumbers?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { lines: () => [], files: () => [], contextSize: 3, showLineNumbers: true, className: "" }
);

const activeIdx = ref(0);
const expandedGaps = ref(new Set<string>());

watch(
  () => props.files,
  () => {
    activeIdx.value = 0;
    expandedGaps.value = new Set();
  }
);

const activeFile = computed(() => (props.files.length ? props.files[Math.min(activeIdx.value, props.files.length - 1)] : null));
const activeLines = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.lines : props.lines));
const activeFilename = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.filename : props.filename));
const activeLanguage = computed(() => (activeFile.value ? activeFile.value.language : props.language));

const countType = (lines: DiffLine[], type: DiffLine["type"]) => lines.filter((l) => l.type === type).length;

const added = computed(() => countType(activeLines.value, "add"));
const removed = computed(() => countType(activeLines.value, "remove"));

const toggleGap = (key: string) => {
  const next = new Set(expandedGaps.value);
  if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key);
  else next.add(key);
  expandedGaps.value = next;
};

/**
 * Walks the diff once and produces render rows. Long runs of context lines
 * (> contextSize*2) become a collapsible gap that keeps `contextSize` lines
 * visible on each side; the hidden middle travels with the row so expanding
 * needs no second pass over the source.
 */
const buildRows = (lines: DiffLine[], contextSize: number): RenderRow[] => {
  const rows: RenderRow[] = [];
  let oldNo = 0;
  let newNo = 0;
  let contextRun: HiddenLine[] = [];

  const pushLine = (entry: HiddenLine) => {
    rows.push({ kind: "line", line: entry.line, meta: LINE_STYLE.context, oldNo: entry.oldNo, newNo: entry.newNo, key: `l-${entry.oldNo}-${entry.newNo}` });
  };

  const flushContext = (isTail: boolean) => {
    if (contextRun.length <= contextSize * 2) {
      contextRun.forEach(pushLine);
    } else {
      const hidden = isTail
        ? contextRun.slice(contextSize)
        : contextRun.slice(contextSize, contextRun.length - contextSize);
      contextRun.slice(0, contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
      rows.push({ kind: "collapsed", count: hidden.length, hidden, key: `gap-${rows.length}-${hidden.length}` });
      if (!isTail) contextRun.slice(contextRun.length - contextSize).forEach(pushLine);
    }
    contextRun = [];
  };

  lines.forEach((line) => {
    if (line.type !== "add") oldNo += 1;
    if (line.type !== "remove") newNo += 1;

    if (line.type === "context") {
      contextRun.push({ line, oldNo, newNo });
      return;
    }
    flushContext(false);
    rows.push({
      kind: "line",
      line,
      meta: LINE_STYLE[line.type] || LINE_STYLE.context,
      oldNo: line.type !== "add" ? oldNo : "",
      newNo: line.type !== "remove" ? newNo : "",
      key: `c-${rows.length}`,
    });
  });

  flushContext(true);
  return rows;
};

const rows = computed(() => buildRows(activeLines.value, props.contextSize));
</script>
