===== FILE: vue\DriftEmbersBackdrop.vue =====

<template>
  <canvas
    ref="canvasRef"
    aria-hidden="true"
    :class="['fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0', className]"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch } from "vue";

interface Props {
  speed?: number;
  density?: number;
  baseColor?: string;
  bloomColor?: string;
  emberColor?: string;
  ashColor?: string;
  interactive?: boolean;
  paused?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  speed: 1,
  density: 120,
  baseColor: "#0d1113",
  bloomColor: "#4a4430",
  emberColor: "#b9af39",
  ashColor: "#c8c9ca",
  interactive: false,
  paused: false,
  className: "",
});

const canvasRef = ref<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

const numOr = (v: number | undefined, fallback: number, min: number, max: number) =>
  Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v as number)) : fallback;

const safeColor = (v: string | undefined, fallback: string) => {
  const s = (v ?? "").trim();
  if (/^#(?:[0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i.test(s) || /^rgba?\(\s*[\d.%\s,]+\)$/i.test(s)) return s;
  return fallback;
};

const hexToRgb = (hex: string): [number, number, number] => {
  let h = hex.replace("#", "");
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("");
  const n = Number.parseInt(h, 16);
  return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
};

type Mote = {
  x: number; y: number; r: number; fall: number; sway: number;
  swayAmp: number; phase: number; twinkle: number; alpha: number; ash: boolean;
};

const rand = (a: number, b: number) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const biasedX = () => Math.pow(Math.random(), 1.45) * 1.06 - 0.03;

const makeSprite = (color: string, coreAlpha: number): HTMLCanvasElement | null => {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  const SP = 64;
  c.width = SP;
  c.height = SP;
  const sc = c.getContext("2d");
  if (!sc) return null;
  const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(color);
  const grd = sc.createRadialGradient(SP / 2, SP / 2, 0, SP / 2, SP / 2, SP / 2);
  grd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${coreAlpha})`);
  grd.addColorStop(0.4, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${coreAlpha * 0.4})`);
  grd.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},0)`);
  sc.fillStyle = grd;
  sc.fillRect(0, 0, SP, SP);
  return c;
};

let cleanup: (() => void) | null = null;

function mount() {
  const canvas = canvasRef.value;
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return;

  const spd = numOr(props.speed, 1, 0, 4);
  const count = Math.round(numOr(props.density, 120, 1, 260));
  const base = safeColor(props.baseColor, "#0d1113");
  const bloom = safeColor(props.bloomColor, "#4a4430");
  const ember = safeColor(props.emberColor, "#b9af39");
  const ash = safeColor(props.ashColor, "#c8c9ca");

  const goldSprite = makeSprite(ember, 0.95);
  const ashSprite = makeSprite(ash, 0.55);
  if (!goldSprite || !ashSprite) return;

  const motes: Mote[] = Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({
    x: biasedX(), y: rand(-0.1, 1.1), r: rand(1.6, 6.2),
    fall: rand(0.004, 0.018), sway: rand(0.002, 0.01),
    swayAmp: rand(0.006, 0.035), phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
    twinkle: rand(0.4, 1.4), alpha: rand(0.3, 0.85),
    ash: Math.random() < 0.46,
  }));

  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  let W = 1;
  let H = 1;
  const pointer = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, tx: 0.5, ty: 0.5 };

  const resize = () => {
    W = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth) * dpr));
    H = Math.max(1, Math.round((canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight) * dpr));
    if (canvas.width !== W || canvas.height !== H) {
      canvas.width = W;
      canvas.height = H;
    }
  };

  let grain: CanvasPattern | null = null;
  const tile = document.createElement("canvas");
  tile.width = 64;
  tile.height = 64;
  const tc = tile.getContext("2d");
  if (tc && typeof tc.createImageData === "function") {
    const img = tc.createImageData(64, 64);
    for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
      const v = 120 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 135);
      img.data[i] = img.data[i + 1] = img.data[i + 2] = v;
      img.data[i + 3] = 14;
    }
    tc.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
    grain = ctx.createPattern(tile, "repeat");
  }

  const drawField = (t: number) => {
    const field = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    field.addColorStop(0, base);
    field.addColorStop(0.42, "#2a2923");
    field.addColorStop(1, "#090b0a");
    ctx.fillStyle = field;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const wash = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, 0);
    wash.addColorStop(0, "rgba(72,64,42,0.18)");
    wash.addColorStop(0.5, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    wash.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.26)");
    ctx.fillStyle = wash;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const bx = (0.13 + (pointer.x - 0.5) * 0.1) * W;
    const by = (0.45 + (pointer.y - 0.5) * 0.05) * H;
    const [br, bg, bb] = hexToRgb(bloom);
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, 0, bx, by, Math.max(W, H) * 0.62);
    glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.42)`);
    glow.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0.1)`);
    glow.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${br},${bg},${bb},0)`);
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    for (const p of motes) {
      const px = (p.x + Math.sin(t * p.sway + p.phase) * p.swayAmp) * W;
      const py = p.y * H;
      const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * p.twinkle + p.phase);
      const size = p.r * dpr * 5;
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha * tw;
      ctx.drawImage(p.ash ? ashSprite : goldSprite, px - size / 2, py - size / 2, size, size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

    if (grain) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = grain;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      W / 2, H / 2, Math.min(W, H) * 0.3,
      W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.82,
    );
    vg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    vg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)");
    ctx.fillStyle = vg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  };

  const reduced =
    typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
      ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
      : false;

  let raf = 0;
  let last = 0;
  let t = 0;
  let stopped = props.paused;

  const frame = (now: number) => {
    if (stopped) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    t += dt * spd;
    pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.05;
    pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.05;
    for (const p of motes) {
      p.y += p.fall * dt * spd;
      if (p.y > 1.1) { p.y = -0.1; p.x = biasedX(); }
    }
    drawField(t);
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (stopped) return;
    last = performance.now();
    if (reduced) drawField(t);
    else { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  };
  const stop = () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; };
  const onVisibility = () => { if (document.hidden) stop(); else start(); };
  const onResize = () => { resize(); if (stopped || reduced) drawField(t); };
  const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!props.interactive) return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    pointer.tx = (e.clientX - rect.left) / (rect.width || 1);
    pointer.ty = (e.clientY - rect.top) / (rect.height || 1);
  };

  resize();
  if (props.interactive) window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
  start();

  cleanup = () => {
    stop();
    if (props.interactive) window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
    window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
  };
}

onMounted(mount);
onUnmounted(() => { if (cleanup) cleanup(); });
watch(
  () => [props.speed, props.density, props.baseColor, props.bloomColor, props.emberColor, props.ashColor, props.interactive, props.paused],
  () => { if (cleanup) cleanup(); cleanup = null; mount(); },
);
</script>


===== FILE: vue\EditableHeading.vue =====

<template>
  <div data-editable-heading>
    <div v-if="breadcrumb" class="mb-1 text-xs text-zinc-400" v-html="breadcrumb" />
    <input
      v-if="editing"
      data-heading-input
      type="text"
      :value="draft"
      :class="['w-full rounded-md border-2 border-teal-500 bg-yellow-50 px-2 py-1 font-semibold text-zinc-900 outline-none dark:bg-yellow-950/40 dark:text-zinc-50', size === 'lg' ? 'text-2xl' : 'text-base']"
      @input="draft = ($event.target as HTMLInputElement).value"
      @blur="commit"
      @keydown.enter="commit"
      @keydown.escape="cancel"
    />
    <button
      v-else
      type="button"
      data-heading-display
      title="Click to rename"
      :class="['-mx-2 w-full rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-left font-semibold text-zinc-900 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-500 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800', size === 'lg' ? 'text-2xl' : 'text-base']"
      @click="draft = current; editing = true"
    >{{ current }}</button>
    <div v-if="meta" class="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400" v-html="meta" />
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    breadcrumb?: string;
    meta?: string;
    size?: 'md' | 'lg';
  }>(),
  { value: undefined, defaultValue: 'Untitled', breadcrumb: '', meta: '', size: 'lg' as const },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', value: string): void;
}>();

const current = ref(props.value ?? props.defaultValue);
const editing = ref(false);
const draft = ref(current.value);

watch(
  () => props.value,
  (next) => {
    if (next !== undefined) current.value = next;
  },
);

const commit = () => {
  const next = draft.value.trim() || current.value;
  const changed = next !== current.value;
  current.value = next;
  editing.value = false;
  if (changed) emit('change', next);
};

const cancel = () => {
  draft.value = current.value;
  editing.value = false;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export interface PickerOption {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  avatar?: string;
  initials?: string;
  system?: boolean;
}

const AVATAR_TONES = ['bg-violet-500', 'bg-sky-500', 'bg-emerald-500', 'bg-amber-500', 'bg-rose-500', 'bg-indigo-500'];

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    options: PickerOption[];
    selected?: string[];
    searchable?: boolean;
    emptyMessage?: string;
    confirmLabel?: string;
    cancelLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { selected: () => [], searchable: true, emptyMessage: 'No matches found.', confirmLabel: 'Insert results', cancelLabel: 'Cancel' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', ids: string[]): void;
  (e: 'search', query: string): void;
  (e: 'dismiss'): void;
}>();

const query = ref('');
const picked = ref(new Set<string>(props.selected));

watch(
  () => props.selected,
  (ids) => {
    picked.value = new Set(ids);
  },
);

const filtered = computed(() =>
  query.value ? props.options.filter((option) => option.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.value.toLowerCase())) : props.options,
);

const initialsOf = (label: string) =>
  label
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || '').toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const toggle = (id: string) => {
  const next = new Set(picked.value);
  if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
  else next.add(id);
  picked.value = next;
};

===== FILE: vue\EvalRunResults.vue =====

<script setup lang="ts">
export type EvalResultStatus = "passed" | "failed" | "unknown";
export interface EvalVariable {
  name: string;
  value: string;
}
export interface EvalResult {
  id: string;
  status: EvalResultStatus;
  reason: string;
  response: string;
  variables?: EvalVariable[];
}
export interface EvalSection {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  subtitle: string;
  icon?: string;
  results: EvalResult[];
}
export interface EvalRunResultsProps {
  passRate?: string;
  passLabel?: string;
  counters?: { passed: number; unknown: number; failed: number; total: number };
  filterLabel?: string;
  filterValue?: string;
  sections?: EvalSection[];
  class?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<EvalRunResultsProps>(), {
  passRate: "64.00%",
  passLabel: "Passed",
  counters: () => ({ passed: 64, unknown: 0, failed: 36, total: 100 }),
  filterLabel: "has any of",
  filterValue: "Passed",

<script setup lang="ts">
export type EvalScoreTone = 'pass' | 'warn' | 'fail';

export interface EvalRun {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  score: number;
  grader?: string;
  tone?: EvalScoreTone;
}

export interface EvalCriteria {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

interface Props {
  runs?: EvalRun[];
  criteria?: EvalCriteria[];
  title?: string;
  showAddCriteria?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  runs: () => [],
  criteria: () => [],
  title: 'Evaluation report',
  showAddCriteria: false,
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'run-select', run: EvalRun): void;
  (e: 'add-criteria'): void;
}>();

const toneClasses = (tone?: EvalScoreTone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case 'warn':
      return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300';
    case 'fail':
      return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300';
    default:
      return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300';
  }
};

const toneBar = (tone?: EvalScoreTone) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case 'warn':
      return 'bg-amber-500';
    case 'fail':
      return 'bg-red-500';
    default:
      return 'bg-emerald-500';
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <div
    data-eval-score-table
    class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ props.title }}</span>
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ props.runs.length }} runs</span>
    </div>

    <div class="px-4 py-3">
      <table data-eval-runs class="w-full text-left">
        <thead>
          <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
            <th class="py-1.5 pr-3 font-medium">Run</th>
            <th class="py-1.5 pr-3 font-medium">Score</th>
            <th class="py-1.5 font-medium">Grader</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr
            v-for="run in props.runs"
            :key="run.id"
            :data-eval-run="run.id"
            class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
            @click="emit('run-select', run)"
          >
            <td class="py-2 pr-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ run.name }}</td>
            <td class="py-2 pr-3">
              <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span
                  data-eval-score
                  class="rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tabular-nums"
                  :class="toneClasses(run.tone)"
                >{{ run.score }}%</span>
                <span class="h-1.5 w-20 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
                  <span
                    data-eval-score-bar
                    class="block h-full rounded-full"
                    :class="toneBar(run.tone)"
                    :style="{ width: `${Math.min(Math.max(run.score, 0), 100)}%` }"
                  ></span>
                </span>
              </span>
            </td>
            <td class="py-2 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ run.grader ?? '—' }}</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <div v-if="props.criteria.length > 0" data-eval-criteria class="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div
          v-for="c in props.criteria"
          :key="c.id"
          :data-eval-criterion="c.id"
          class="rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 dark:border-zinc-700"
        >
          <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ c.title }}</p>
          <p class="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ c.description }}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        v-if="props.showAddCriteria"
        type="button"
        data-eval-add-criteria
        class="mt-3 flex w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-300 py-3 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
        @click="emit('add-criteria')"
      >
        <span class="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-sm dark:bg-zinc-800">+</span>

  </div>
</template>

    },
  ],

  class: "",
});

const activeId = ref(props.events[0]?.id ?? "");

const filtered = computed(() =>
  filter.value
    ? props.events.filter((ev) => ev.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.value.toLowerCase()))
    : props.events
);
const active = computed(() => props.events.find((ev) => ev.id === activeId.value) ?? props.events[0]);
const lineNumbers = computed(() => {
  const count = Math.max(props.detailsLines ?? 10, active.value ? active.value.details.split("\n").length : 1);
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => i + 1).join("\n");
});

const select = (ev: StreamEvent) => {
  activeId.value = ev.id;
  emit("event-select", ev);
};

<template>
  <div data-federated-search class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <div class="relative">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">

          @input="emit('query-change', term)"
        />

          :key="filter.id"
          type="button"

          :aria-pressed="scopes.has(filter.id)"
          :class="['rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500', scopes.has(filter.id) ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'border-zinc-200 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800']"
          @click="toggleSource(filter.id)"
        >
          {{ filter.label }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <ul class="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto p-2">
      <li v-if="filtered.length === 0" data-federated-empty class="px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No results match your filters.</li>
      <li v-for="result in filtered" :key="result.id">
        <button
          type="button"
          :data-federated-result="result.id"
          class="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          @click="emit('result-select', result)"
        >
          <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span v-if="result.icon" aria-hidden="true">{{ result.icon }}</span>
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ result.title }}</span>
            <span v-if="result.source" class="shrink-0 rounded bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ result.source }}</span>
          </span>
          <span v-if="result.subtitle" class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ result.subtitle }}</span>
          <span class="mt-1 block text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300" v-html="highlight(result.snippet)" />
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>
    <div v-if="showKeyboardLegend" class="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
      <p data-federated-legend class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ LEGEND }}</p>
      <span v-if="askAiLabel" class="rounded-full bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900">{{ askAiLabel }}</span>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export interface FederatedResult {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  snippet: string;
  source?: string;
}

const LEGEND = '↑↓ Navigate · ⏎ Select · ESC Close · ⇧⏎ Open in new tab';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    query?: string;
    results: FederatedResult[];
    sourceFilters?: { id: string; label: string }[];
    selectedSources?: string[];
    searchPlaceholder?: string;
    showKeyboardLegend?: boolean;
    askAiLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { query: '', sourceFilters: () => [], selectedSources: () => [], searchPlaceholder: 'Search everything…', showKeyboardLegend: true, askAiLabel: 'Press Tab to Ask AI' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'query-change', query: string): void;
  (e: 'source-change', ids: string[]): void;
  (e: 'result-select', result: FederatedResult): void;
}>();

const term = ref(props.query);
const scopes = ref(new Set<string>(props.selectedSources));

watch(
  () => props.query,
  (value) => {
    term.value = value;
  },
);

const escapeRegExp = (text: string) => text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

const highlight = (snippet: string) => {
  if (!term.value.trim()) return snippet;
  const parts = snippet.split(new RegExp(`(${escapeRegExp(term.value)})`, 'gi'));
  return parts
    .map((part) =>
      part.toLowerCase() === term.value.toLowerCase()
        ? `<mark class="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">${part}</mark>`
        : part,
    )
    .join('');
};

const toggleSource = (id: string) => {
  const next = new Set(scopes.value);
  if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
  else next.add(id);
  scopes.value = next;
  emit('source-change', [...next]);
};

const filtered = computed(() =>
  scopes.value.size ? props.results.filter((result) => !result.source || scopes.value.has(result.source)) : props.results,
);
</script>

    files?: AttachmentItem[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { files: () => [], className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "remove", id: string | number): void;
}>();

function formatFileSize(bytes?: number): string {
  if (bytes === undefined || bytes === null || Number.isNaN(bytes)) return "";
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

function iconForType(type?: string, name?: string): string {
  if (type?.startsWith("image/")) return "image";
  const ext = name?.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
  if (["js", "ts", "tsx", "jsx", "py", "java", "go", "rs", "vue", "html", "css", "json", "sh"].includes(ext)) return "code";
  return "paperclip";
}

<template>
  <div :class="className">
    <div
      role="button"
      :tabindex="disabled ? -1 : 0"
      :aria-label="hint || 'Drop files here or browse'"
      :aria-disabled="disabled || undefined"
      :class="[
        'flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed px-4 py-7 text-center transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
        dragging
          ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/30'
          : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-600',
        disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-60' : '',
      ]"
      @click="openPicker"
      @keydown.enter.prevent="openPicker"
      @keydown.space.prevent="openPicker"
      @dragover.prevent="!disabled && (dragging = true)"
      @dragleave="dragging = false"
      @drop.prevent="onDrop"
    >
      <span class="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">

        Drag & drop {{ multiple ? 'files' : 'a file' }} here, or
        <span class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">browse</span>
      </p>
      <p class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">{{ hintText }}</p>
      <input
        ref="inputRef"
        type="file"
        hidden
        :accept="accept"
        :multiple="multiple"
        :disabled="disabled"
        @change="onChange"
      />
    </div>

      <UiIcon name="alert-triangle" :size="12" />
      {{ error }}
    </p>

    <ul v-if="files.length" class="mt-3 space-y-1.5">
      <li
        v-for="(file, index) in files"
        :key="file.id ?? `${file.name}-${index}`"
        class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 px-2.5 py-1.5"
      >
        <span class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400">
          <UiIcon :name="fileIcon(file)" :size="14" />
        </span>
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ file.name }}</span>
          <span class="block text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{{ formatBytes(file.size) }}</span>
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          :aria-label="`Remove ${file.name}`"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
          @click.stop="emit('remove', file, index)"
        >
          <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface DropzoneFile {
  id?: string | number;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  type?: string;
}

export interface RejectedFile {
  name: string;
  reason: 'type' | 'size';
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    files?: DropzoneFile[];
    accept?: string;
    multiple?: boolean;
    maxSizeMb?: number;
    hint?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { files: () => [], multiple: true, disabled: false, className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'files', files: File[]): void;
  (e: 'reject', rejected: RejectedFile[]): void;
  (e: 'remove', file: DropzoneFile, index: number): void;
}>();

const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
const dragging = ref(false);
const error = ref<string | null>(null);

const hintText = computed(() => {
  const parts = [props.accept ? `Accepts ${props.accept}` : null, props.maxSizeMb ? `up to ${props.maxSizeMb} MB` : null];
  return props.hint || parts.filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'Any file type';
});

const formatBytes = (bytes: number) => {
  if (!bytes) return '0 B';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  const exp = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** exp;
  return `${value >= 10 || exp === 0 ? Math.round(value) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[exp]}`;
};

const matchesAccept = (file: { name: string; type?: string }) => {
  if (!props.accept) return true;
  return props.accept
    .split(',')
    .map((token) => token.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .some((token) => {
      if (token.startsWith('.')) return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(token);
      if (token.endsWith('/*')) return Boolean(file.type && file.type.toLowerCase().startsWith(token.slice(0, -1)));
      return file.type?.toLowerCase() === token;
    });
};

const fileIcon = (file: DropzoneFile) => {
  if (file.type?.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  if (/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|rs|json|css|html)$/i.test(file.name)) return 'code';
  return 'paperclip';
};

function handleFiles(incoming: FileList | File[] | null) {
  const list = Array.from(incoming || []);
  if (!list.length) return;

  const rejected: RejectedFile[] = [];
  const accepted = list.filter((file) => {
    if (!matchesAccept(file)) {
      rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'type' });
      return false;
    }
    if (props.maxSizeMb && file.size > props.maxSizeMb * 1024 * 1024) {
      rejected.push({ name: file.name, reason: 'size' });
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  if (rejected.length) {
    const first = rejected[0];
    error.value =
      first.reason === 'size' ? `${first.name} is larger than ${props.maxSizeMb} MB` : `${first.name} is not an accepted file type`;
    emit('reject', rejected);
  } else {
    error.value = null;
  }

  if (accepted.length) emit('files', props.multiple ? accepted : accepted.slice(0, 1));
}

const openPicker = () => {
  if (!props.disabled) inputRef.value?.click();
};

function onDrop(event: DragEvent) {
  dragging.value = false;
  if (props.disabled) return;
  handleFiles(event.dataTransfer?.files ?? null);
}

function onChange(event: Event) {
  const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
  handleFiles(input.files);
  input.value = '';
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface FilterOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

export interface FilterDefinition {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  options: FilterOption[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    filters: FilterDefinition[];
    selected?: Record<string, string[]>;
  }>(),
  { selected: () => ({}) }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', selected: Record<string, string[]>): void; (e: 'clear'): void }>();

const rootRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
const openId = ref<string | null>(null);
const localSelected = ref<Record<string, string[]>>({ ...props.selected });

watch(
  () => props.selected,
  (value) => {
    localSelected.value = { ...(value ?? {}) };
  },
  { deep: true }
);

const activeCount = computed(() =>
  Object.values(localSelected.value).reduce((total, values) => total + values.length, 0)
);

const commit = (next: Record<string, string[]>) => {
  localSelected.value = next;
  emit('change', next);
};

const toggleOption = (filterId: string, value: string) => {
  const values = localSelected.value[filterId] ?? [];
  const nextValues = values.includes(value) ? values.filter((entry) => entry !== value) : [...values, value];
  const next = { ...localSelected.value };
  if (nextValues.length > 0) next[filterId] = nextValues;
  else delete next[filterId];
  commit(next);
};

const clearAll = () => {
  commit({});
  emit('clear');
};

const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) openId.value = null;
};
const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') openId.value = null;
};

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface QueryFilterField {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  operators?: string[];
}

export interface QueryFilterRow {
  id: string;
  conjunction: 'where' | 'and' | 'or';
  field: string;
  operator: string;
  value: string;
}

const OPERATOR_GLYPH: Record<string, string> = {
  equals: '=',
  'not-equals': '<>',
  greater: '>',
  less: '<',
  contains: '~',
  gte: '>=',
  lte: '<=',
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    fields?: QueryFilterField[];
    rows?: QueryFilterRow[];
    addLabel?: string;
    clearLabel?: string;
    maxRows?: number;
  }>(),
  { fields: () => [], rows: () => [], addLabel: '+ Add filter', clearLabel: 'Clear filters', maxRows: 8 },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', rows: QueryFilterRow[]): void;
  (e: 'clear'): void;
}>();

const operatorsFor = (name: string) => props.fields.find((field) => field.name === name)?.operators || ['equals', 'not-equals', 'greater', 'less', 'contains', 'gte', 'lte'];

const updateRow = (id: string, patch: Partial<QueryFilterRow>) => {
  emit('change', props.rows.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, ...patch } : item)));
};

const addRow = () => {
  emit('change', [
    ...props.rows,
    { id: `f${Date.now()}`, conjunction: props.rows.length === 0 ? 'where' : 'and', field: props.fields[0]?.name || '', operator: 'equals', value: '' },
  ]);
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface FineTuneJob {

  model: string;
  status: "queued" | "training" | "completed" | "failed";
  progress?: number;
  cost?: string;

  (e: "cancel", job: FineTuneJob): void;
}>();

const STATUS_STYLE: Record<string, { chip: string; label: string }> = {

===== FILE: vue\FluidContourBackdrop.vue =====

<template>
  <canvas
    ref="canvasRef"
    aria-hidden="true"
    :class="['fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none w-full h-full z-0', className]"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";

interface Props {
  inkColor?: [number, number, number];
  paperColor?: [number, number, number];
  speed?: number;
  interactive?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  inkColor: () => [0.17, 0.23, 0.19],
  paperColor: () => [0.98, 0.98, 0.96],
  speed: 0.035,
  interactive: true,
  className: "",
});

const canvasRef = ref<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

const VERT = `
attribute vec2 a_pos;
void main() { gl_Position = vec4(a_pos, 0.0, 1.0); }
`;

const FRAG = `
#extension GL_OES_standard_derivatives : enable
precision highp float;
uniform vec2 u_res;
uniform float u_time;
uniform vec2 u_mouse;
uniform vec3 u_ink;
uniform vec3 u_paper;

vec3 mod289(vec3 x) { return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0; }
vec4 mod289(vec4 x) { return x - floor(x * (1.0 / 289.0)) * 289.0; }
vec4 permute(vec4 x) { return mod289(((x * 34.0) + 1.0) * x); }
vec4 taylorInvSqrt(vec4 r) { return 1.79284291400159 - 0.85373472095314 * r; }

float snoise(vec3 v) {
  const vec2 C = vec2(1.0 / 6.0, 1.0 / 3.0);
  const vec4 D = vec4(0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0);
  vec3 i = floor(v + dot(v, C.yyy));
  vec3 x0 = v - i + dot(i, C.xxx);
  vec3 g = step(x0.yzx, x0.xyz);
  vec3 l = 1.0 - g;
  vec3 i1 = min(g.xyz, l.zxy);
  vec3 i2 = max(g.xyz, l.zxy);
  vec3 x1 = x0 - i1 + C.xxx;
  vec3 x2 = x0 - i2 + C.yyy;
  vec3 x3 = x0 - D.yyy;
  i = mod289(i);
  vec4 p = permute(permute(permute(
    i.z + vec4(0.0, i1.z, i2.z, 1.0)) +
    i.y + vec4(0.0, i1.y, i2.y, 1.0)) +
    i.x + vec4(0.0, i1.x, i2.x, 1.0));
  float n_ = 0.142857142857;
  vec3 ns = n_ * D.wyz - D.xzx;
  vec4 j = p - 49.0 * floor(p * ns.z * ns.z);
  vec4 x_ = floor(j * ns.z);
  vec4 y_ = floor(j - 7.0 * x_);
  vec4 x = x_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;
  vec4 y = y_ * ns.x + ns.yyyy;
  vec4 h = 1.0 - abs(x) - abs(y);
  vec4 b0 = vec4(x.xy, y.xy);
  vec4 b1 = vec4(x.zw, y.zw);
  vec4 s0 = floor(b0) * 2.0 + 1.0;
  vec4 s1 = floor(b1) * 2.0 + 1.0;
  vec4 sh = -step(h, vec4(0.0));
  vec4 a0 = b0.xzyw + s0.xzyw * sh.xxyy;
  vec4 a1 = b1.xzyw + s1.xzyw * sh.zzww;
  vec3 p0 = vec3(a0.xy, h.x);
  vec3 p1 = vec3(a0.zw, h.y);
  vec3 p2 = vec3(a1.xy, h.z);
  vec3 p3 = vec3(a1.zw, h.w);
  vec4 norm = taylorInvSqrt(vec4(dot(p0, p0), dot(p1, p1), dot(p2, p2), dot(p3, p3)));
  p0 *= norm.x; p1 *= norm.y; p2 *= norm.z; p3 *= norm.w;
  vec4 m = max(0.6 - vec4(dot(x0, x0), dot(x1, x1), dot(x2, x2), dot(x3, x3)), 0.0);
  m = m * m;
  return 42.0 * dot(m * m, vec4(dot(p0, x0), dot(p1, x1), dot(p2, x2), dot(p3, x3)));
}

float cursorHill(vec2 frag, float radius) {
  vec2 d = (frag - u_mouse) / u_res.y;
  return exp(-dot(d, d) / (2.0 * radius * radius));
}

vec4 inkAt(float a) {
  float n = fract(sin(dot(gl_FragCoord.xy, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
  a = max(0.0, a + (n - 0.5) / 255.0);
  return vec4(u_ink * a, a);
}

void main() {
  vec2 p = gl_FragCoord.xy / u_res.y;
  float f = snoise(vec3(p * 1.6, u_time)) + 0.5 * snoise(vec3(p * 3.4, u_time * 1.3));
  f += 0.45 * cursorHill(gl_FragCoord.xy, 0.16);
  float bands = f * 6.0;
  float line = abs(fract(bands) - 0.5) / fwidth(bands);
  float a = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, line);
  float index = 1.0 - step(0.5, mod(floor(bands + 0.5), 4.0));
  a *= mix(0.045, 0.08, index);
  gl_FragColor = inkAt(a);
}
`;

let cleanup: (() => void) | null = null;

onMounted(() => {
  const canvas = canvasRef.current;
  if (!canvas) return;

  const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl", {
    alpha: true,
    antialias: false,
    premultipliedAlpha: true,
    powerPreference: "low-power",
  });
  if (!gl) return;

  gl.getExtension("OES_standard_derivatives");

  function compile(type: number, src: string) {
    const s = gl!.createShader(type);
    if (!s) throw new Error("Shader creation failed");
    gl!.shaderSource(s, src);
    gl!.compileShader(s);
    if (!gl!.getShaderParameter(s, gl!.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
      const info = gl!.getShaderInfoLog(s);
      gl!.deleteShader(s);
      throw new Error(info || "Compilation error");
    }
    return s;
  }

  try {
    const vs = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, VERT);
    const fs = compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, FRAG);
    const prog = gl.createProgram();
    if (!prog) return;

    gl.attachShader(prog, vs);
    gl.attachShader(prog, fs);
    gl.linkProgram(prog);
    gl.useProgram(prog);

    const buf = gl.createBuffer();
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
    gl.bufferData(
      gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,
      new Float32Array([-1, -1, 3, -1, -1, 3]),
      gl.STATIC_DRAW
    );

    const aPos = gl.getAttribLocation(prog, "a_pos");
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(aPos);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(aPos, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);

    const uRes = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_res");
    const uTime = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_time");
    const uMouse = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_mouse");
    const uInk = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_ink");
    const uPaper = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, "u_paper");

    gl.uniform3fv(uInk, props.inkColor);
    gl.uniform3fv(uPaper, props.paperColor);

    const dpr = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.devicePixelRatio || 1 : 1;
    const scale = Math.min(dpr, 2) * 0.75;

    const resize = () => {
      if (!canvas) return;
      const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(window.innerWidth * scale));
      const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(window.innerHeight * scale));
      if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        gl.viewport(0, 0, w, h);
        gl.uniform2f(uRes, w, h);
      }
    };

    const mouse = { x: -1e4, y: -1e4, tx: -1e4, ty: -1e4 };

    const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!props.interactive) return;
      mouse.tx = e.clientX * scale;
      mouse.ty = (window.innerHeight - e.clientY) * scale;
      if (mouse.x < -1e3) {
        mouse.x = mouse.tx;
        mouse.y = mouse.ty;
      }
    };

    const onPointerLeave = () => {
      mouse.tx = -1e4;
      mouse.ty = -1e4;
    };

    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
    document.documentElement.addEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);

    // Guard matchMedia (absent in jsdom); resolve before any listener is
    // registered so a throw here cannot leak the handlers below.
    const reducedQuery =
      typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
        ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
        : { matches: false };
    let t = 17;
    let last = performance.now();
    let raf = 0;

    const draw = () => {
      mouse.x += (mouse.tx - mouse.x) * 0.06;
      mouse.y += (mouse.ty - mouse.y) * 0.06;
      gl.uniform1f(uTime, t);
      gl.uniform2f(uMouse, mouse.x, mouse.y);
      gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);
    };

    const loop = (now: number) => {
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      t += Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000) * props.speed;
      last = now;
      draw();
    };

    const start = () => {
      last = performance.now();
      if (reducedQuery.matches) {
        draw();
      } else {
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    };

    const stop = () => {
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    };

    const onVisibility = () => {
      if (document.hidden) stop();
      else start();
    };

    const onResize = () => {
      resize();
      if (reducedQuery.matches) draw();
    };

    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

    resize();
    start();

    cleanup = () => {
      stop();
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
      document.documentElement.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);

      if (buf) gl.deleteBuffer(buf);
      if (prog) {
        if (vs) gl.deleteShader(vs);
        if (fs) gl.deleteShader(fs);
        gl.deleteProgram(prog);
      }
    };
  } catch {
    // Graceful fallback
  }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  if (cleanup) cleanup();
});
</script>

export interface ForecastPoint {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  forecast?: boolean;
}

  defineProps<{
    headline?: string | number;
    deltaLabel?: string;

===== FILE: vue\GanttTimeline.vue =====

<template>
  <div
    data-gantt-timeline
    role="table"
    :aria-label="columnLabel"
    :aria-rowcount="tasks.length"
    :class="`overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 ${className}`"
  >
    <div
      role="row"
      class="flex items-center border-b border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/40"
    >
      <span
        role="columnheader"
        class="w-44 shrink-0 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400"
      >
        {{ rowLabel }}
      </span>
      <div class="relative flex min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span
          v-for="cell in cells"
          :key="cell"
          role="columnheader"
          class="min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 px-1 py-2 text-center text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800"
        >
          {{ cell + 1 }}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p v-if="tasks.length === 0" class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ emptyText }}</p>
    <template v-else>
      <div
        v-for="(task, index) in tasks"
        :key="`${task.label}-${index}`"
        role="row"
        :data-task-index="index"
        @click="handleClick(task, index)"
        :class="`flex items-stretch border-b border-zinc-50 last:border-b-0 dark:border-zinc-800/60 ${
          onTaskClick ? 'cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40' : ''
        }`"
      >
        <span
          role="cell"
          class="flex w-44 shrink-0 items-center py-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
          :style="{ paddingLeft: `${1 + (task.depth || 0) * 1.25}rem` }"
        >
          <span class="truncate">{{ task.label }}</span>
        </span>
        <div role="cell" class="relative min-w-0 flex-1 border-l border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <span
            v-for="cell in cells"
            :key="cell"
            aria-hidden="true"
            class="absolute inset-y-0 border-l border-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60"
            :style="{ left: `${(cell / columns) * 100}%` }"
          />
          <span
            v-if="today !== undefined"
            aria-hidden="true"
            class="absolute inset-y-0 w-px bg-rose-400"
            :style="{ left: `${(Math.min(Math.max(today, 0), columns) / columns) * 100}%` }"
          />
          <div
            data-task-bar
            class="absolute top-1/2 flex h-4 -translate-y-1/2 items-center overflow-hidden rounded"
            :style="{
              left: `${offsetOf(task) * 100}%`,
              width: `calc(${widthOf(task) * 100}% - 4px)`,
            }"
          >
            <div class="relative h-full bg-indigo-500" :class="toneClass(task.tone)">
              <span
                v-if="task.progress !== undefined"
                class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 bg-white/30"
                :style="{ width: `${Math.min(Math.max(task.progress, 0), 100)}%` }"
              />
            </div>
            <span class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center px-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white">
              {{ task.progress !== undefined ? `${task.progress}%` : '' }}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </template>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

export interface GanttTask {
  label: string;
  start: number;
  span: number;
  progress?: number;
  tone?: 'indigo' | 'emerald' | 'amber' | 'sky';
  depth?: number;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    tasks: GanttTask[];
    columns?: number;
    today?: number;
    columnLabel?: string;
    rowLabel?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
    onTaskClick?: (task: GanttTask, index: number) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { columns: 10, columnLabel: 'Timeline', rowLabel: 'Name', emptyText: 'No tasks scheduled', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'task-click', task: GanttTask, index: number): void }>();

const cells = computed(() => Array.from({ length: props.columns }, (_, index) => index));

const clampStart = (task: GanttTask) => Math.min(Math.max(task.start, 0), props.columns);
const offsetOf = (task: GanttTask) => clampStart(task) / props.columns;
const widthOf = (task: GanttTask) =>
  Math.min(Math.max(task.span, 0), props.columns - clampStart(task)) / props.columns;

const toneClass = (tone?: string) => {
  if (tone === 'emerald') return 'bg-emerald-500';
  if (tone === 'amber') return 'bg-amber-400';
  if (tone === 'sky') return 'bg-sky-500';
  return 'bg-indigo-500';
};

const handleClick = (task: GanttTask, index: number) => {
  props.onTaskClick?.(task, index);
  emit('task-click', task, index);
};
</script>

      <div
        v-for="(row, index) in rows"

        :data-bar-row="index"
        role="row"
        class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-center gap-1.5"
      >
        <div class="flex h-28 w-full items-end justify-center gap-1">
          <div class="flex h-full w-1/3 flex-col items-center justify-end">
            <span class="mb-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {{ row.estimated }}{{ row.unit ?? unit }}
            </span>
            <div
              class="w-full rounded-t-md bg-violet-400 transition-all duration-300"
              :style="{ height: `${heightOf(row.estimated)}%` }"
              :title="`${legendEstimated}: ${row.estimated}${row.unit ?? unit}`"
            />
          </div>
          <div class="flex h-full w-1/3 flex-col items-center justify-end">
            <span class="mb-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {{ row.actual }}{{ row.unit ?? unit }}
            </span>
            <div
              class="w-full rounded-t-md bg-lime-400 transition-all duration-300"
              :style="{ height: `${heightOf(row.actual)}%` }"
              :title="`${legendActual}: ${row.actual}${row.unit ?? unit}`"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <span class="w-full truncate text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ row.name }}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

export interface GroupedBarRow {
  name: string;
  estimated: number;
  actual: number;
  unit?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    rows?: GroupedBarRow[];
    title?: string;
    legendEstimated?: string;
    legendActual?: string;
    unit?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    rows: () => [],
    title: 'Estimated vs actual',
    legendEstimated: 'Estimated',
    legendActual: 'Actual',
    unit: 'h',
    className: '',
  },
);

const max = computed(() => Math.max(...props.rows.flatMap((row) => [row.estimated, row.actual]), 0.0001));
const heightOf = (value: number) => Math.max(4, Math.round((value / max.value) * 100));
</script>

===== FILE: vue\HealthDonutStats.vue =====

<template>
  <div
    v-if="cards.length"
    data-health-donut-stats
    class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
    :class="className"
  >
    <div
      v-for="(card, index) in cards"
      :key="`${card.title}-${index}`"
      :data-donut-card="index"
      class="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
    >
      <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
        <div class="relative h-16 w-16 shrink-0">
          <div class="h-16 w-16 rounded-full" :style="donutStyle(card.slices)" />
          <div class="absolute inset-[10px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
            <span data-donut-center class="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ percentOf(card.slices) }}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <p class="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ card.title }}</p>
          <p v-if="card.caption" class="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ card.caption }}</p>
          <ul class="mt-2 space-y-1">
            <li
              v-for="(slice, sliceIndex) in card.slices"
              :key="`${slice.label}-${sliceIndex}`"
              class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300"
            >
              <span class="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full" :class="toneDot[slice.tone]" />
              <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{{ slice.label }}</span>
              <span class="shrink-0 font-medium tabular-nums">{{ shareOf(slice, card.slices) }}%</span>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button
        v-if="card.action"
        type="button"
        data-donut-action
        class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
        @click="emit('action-click', index, card.action.label)"
      >
        {{ card.action.label }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface HealthDonutSlice {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  tone: 'indigo' | 'amber' | 'zinc' | 'emerald' | 'rose';
}

export interface HealthDonutCard {
  title: string;
  caption?: string;
  slices: HealthDonutSlice[];
  action?: { label: string };
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    cards?: HealthDonutCard[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { cards: () => [], className: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'action-click', index: number, label: string): void;
}>();

const toneDot: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  zinc: 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
};

const sliceColor: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  zinc: 'bg-zinc-300',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
};

const sumOf = (slices: HealthDonutSlice[]) => slices.reduce((sum, slice) => sum + Math.max(0, slice.value), 0);

const donutStyle = (slices: HealthDonutSlice[]) => {
  const total = sumOf(slices) || 1;
  let cursor = 0;
  const stops: string[] = [];
  slices.forEach((slice) => {
    const start = (cursor / total) * 360;
    cursor += Math.max(0, slice.value);
    const end = (cursor / total) * 360;
    stops.push(`${sliceColor[slice.tone]} ${start}deg ${end}deg`);
  });
  return { background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})` };
};

const percentOf = (slices: HealthDonutSlice[]) => {
  const total = sumOf(slices);
  if (!total || !slices.length) return 0;
  const primary = slices.reduce((best, slice) => (slice.value > best.value ? slice : best), slices[0]);
  return Math.round((primary.value / total) * 100);
};

const shareOf = (slice: HealthDonutSlice, slices: HealthDonutSlice[]) => {
  const total = sumOf(slices);
  return total ? Math.round((slice.value / total) * 100) : 0;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';

/**
 * HomepageDashboard — Vue 3 (SFC)
 * A copy-paste, zero-blackbox single-file homelab dashboard with the iconic
 * gethomepage/homepage look: header (title + live clock + search) + responsive
 * grouped service cards with status dots/pills + version footer.
 *
 * ORIGINAL implementation of the visual design language of
 * https://github.com/gethomepage/homepage (GPL-3.0). No GPL source copied.
 */
export type HomepageStatus = 'online' | 'up' | 'down' | 'offline' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'unknown';

export interface HomepageService {
  /** Optional stable key — used for v-for reconciliation; falls back to name+index */
  id?: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  /** Only http(s), mailto, protocol-relative, root-relative and dot-relative URLs are rendered as a link */
  href?: string;
  pingText?: string;
  status?: HomepageStatus;
}

export interface HomepageGroup {
  name: string;
  icon?: string;
  services: HomepageService[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    version?: string;
    groups?: HomepageGroup[];
    headerStyle?: 'underlined' | 'boxed' | 'clean';
    statusStyle?: 'pill' | 'dot' | 'none';
    showClock?: boolean;
    showSearch?: boolean;
    searchPlaceholder?: string;
    collapsible?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    title: 'Homepage',
    subtitle: 'A highly customizable homelab dashboard',
    version: 'Homepage · awesome-ui',
    groups: () => [],
    headerStyle: 'underlined',
    statusStyle: 'pill',
    showClock: true,
    showSearch: false,
    searchPlaceholder: 'Search services…',
    collapsible: true,
    className: '',
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ 'group-toggle': [group: string, collapsed: boolean] }>();

/* ---------- clock: starts/stops when showClock toggles, always cleaned up ---------- */
const now = ref(new Date());
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

const stopClock = () => {
  if (timer) {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = null;
  }
};
const startClock = () => {
  if (props.showClock && !timer) {
    timer = setInterval(() => (now.value = new Date()), 1000);
  }
};

watch(() => props.showClock, (v) => (v ? startClock() : stopClock()));
onMounted(startClock);
onBeforeUnmount(stopClock);

const time = computed(() => now.value.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
const date = computed(() =>
  now.value.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })
);

/* ---------- search & collapse ---------- */
const query = ref('');

const trimmedQuery = computed(() => query.value.trim().toLowerCase());

const filteredGroups = computed<HomepageGroup[]>(() => {
  const q = trimmedQuery.value;
  if (!q) return props.groups;
  return props.groups
    .map((g) => ({
      ...g,
      services: (g.services || []).filter(
        (s) =>
          (s.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (s.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ),
    }))
    .filter((g) => g.services.length > 0);
});

const collapsed = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});

const emptyMessage = computed(() => {
  if (props.groups.length === 0) return 'No services configured yet.';
  if (trimmedQuery.value) return `No matching services for “${trimmedQuery.value}”.`;
  return 'No services configured yet.';
});

const toggleGroup = (name: string) => {
  if (!props.collapsible) return;
  collapsed.value = { ...collapsed.value, [name]: !collapsed.value[name] };
  emit('group-toggle', name, collapsed.value[name]);
};

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const effectiveStatusStyle = computed<'pill' | 'dot' | 'none'>(() =>
  ['pill', 'dot', 'none'].includes(props.statusStyle) ? props.statusStyle : 'pill'
);

/** Hide an icon <img> on load failure (parity: letter monogram space is kept by container) */
const onIconError = (e: Event) => {
  const el = e.target as HTMLImageElement;
  el.style.display = 'none';
};

const headerCls = computed(() =>
  props.headerStyle === 'boxed'
    ? 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-0 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-white/5 shadow-md shadow-zinc-900/10 p-4'
    : props.headerStyle === 'clean'
      ? 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-0'
      : 'm-3 sm:m-5 mb-1 border-b-2 border-zinc-300/70 dark:border-zinc-700 pb-4'
);

const statusConfig = (status: HomepageStatus = 'unknown') => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'online':
    case 'up':
      return { dot: 'bg-emerald-500', pill: 'text-emerald-500/90', label: 'UP' };
    case 'down':
    case 'offline':
      return { dot: 'bg-rose-500', pill: 'text-rose-500/90', label: 'DOWN' };
    case 'warn':
      return { dot: 'bg-amber-500', pill: 'text-amber-500', label: 'WARN' };
    case 'error':
      return { dot: 'bg-orange-500', pill: 'text-orange-500', label: 'ERROR' };
    default:
      return { dot: 'bg-zinc-400/60 dark:bg-zinc-500/60', pill: 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400', label: '—' };
  }
};

/** Only allow safe URL protocols into the anchor. Blocks javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file: … */
const isSafeHref = (href?: string): boolean => {
  if (typeof href !== 'string') return false;
  const t = href.trim();
  if (t.length === 0) return false;
  if (t.startsWith('//') || t.startsWith('/') || t.startsWith('./') || t.startsWith('../')) return true;
  return /^(https?:\/\/|mailto:)/i.test(t);
};

const serviceHref = (service: HomepageService) => (isSafeHref(service.href) ? service.href : undefined);

const isImageIcon = (icon?: string) => !!icon && /^(https?:|data:|\.|\/)/i.test(icon);

const monogram = (name?: string) => (name || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();

const statusLabel = (service: HomepageService) => service.pingText || statusConfig(service.status).label;
</script>

  label: string;

  danger?: boolean;
}

  actions?: ImageMenuAction[];
  class?: string;
}

  open: true,
  actions: () => [],
});

  (e: 'action', action: ImageMenuAction): void;
  (e: 'close'): void;

  action.icon ??
  (({ Fullscreen: '⛶', Vary: '↻', Edit: '✎', 'Make video': '▶', Download: '↓' } as Record<string, string>)[

  ] ?? '•');
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface ImageGenTile {
  id: string;
  alt: string;
  url?: string;
  aspect?: "square" | "portrait" | "landscape";
  status?: "done" | "generating";
  model?: string;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  prompt?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  generateText?: string;
  images: ImageGenTile[];
  generateTextLabel?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Image studio",
  prompt: "",
  placeholder: "Describe an image…",
  generateText: "Generate",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "generate", prompt: string): void;
  (e: "tile-action", id: string, action: "download" | "variant" | "delete"): void;
}>();

const draft = defineModel<string>("promptText", { default: "" });

const ASPECT: Record<string, string> = {
  square: "aspect-square",
  portrait: "aspect-[3/4]",
  landscape: "aspect-[4/3]",
};
const GRADIENTS = [
  "from-indigo-400 via-purple-400 to-pink-300",
  "from-sky-400 via-cyan-300 to-emerald-300",
  "from-amber-300 via-orange-400 to-rose-400",
  "from-violet-400 via-fuchsia-400 to-indigo-300",
];

const submit = () => {
  const text = draft.value.trim();
  if (text) emit("generate", text);
};
</script>

<template>

        <span v-if="message.tag"
          :class="`mr-1.5 inline-block rounded px-1.5 py-px align-middle font-mono text-[9.5px] font-medium ${TAG_TONE[message.tagTone || 'rose']}`">
          {{ message.tag }}
        </span>
        <span :class="`font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 ${message.unread ? '' : 'font-normal'}`">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";

export interface IntegrationService {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category?: string;
  connected?: boolean;
}

export interface IntegrationConnectGridProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  integrations?: IntegrationService[];
  connectLabel?: string;
  disconnectLabel?: string;
  class?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<IntegrationConnectGridProps>(), {
  title: "Integrations",
  description: "Connect third-party services to extend your workspace.",
  integrations: () => [
    { id: "gh", name: "GitHub", category: "Code", connected: true },
    { id: "sl", name: "Slack", category: "Chat", connected: true },
    { id: "li", name: "Linear", category: "Code", connected: false },
    { id: "no", name: "Notion", category: "Docs", connected: false },
    { id: "fg", name: "Figma", category: "Design", connected: false },
    { id: "sn", name: "Sentry", category: "Monitoring", connected: true },
  ],
  connectLabel: "Connect",
  disconnectLabel: "Disconnect",
  class: "",
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "integration-toggle", integration: IntegrationService, connected: boolean): void;
}>();

const CATEGORY_ALL = "All";
const category = ref(CATEGORY_ALL);
const all = computed(() => (Array.isArray(props.integrations) ? props.integrations : []));
const categories = computed(() => [CATEGORY_ALL, ...new Set(all.value.map((it) => it.category).filter(Boolean))]);
const visible = computed(() => (category.value === CATEGORY_ALL ? all.value : all.value.filter((it) => it.category === category.value)));

const toggle = (integration: IntegrationService) => {
  integration.connected = !integration.connected;
  emit("integration-toggle", integration, integration.connected);
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

export type InvoiceStatus = "paid" | "pending" | "failed";

export interface Invoice {
  id: string;
  period: string;
  amount: string;
  status: InvoiceStatus;
  date: string;
}

export interface InvoiceHistoryTableProps {
  title?: string;
  currency?: string;
  downloadLabel?: string;
  invoices?: Invoice[];
  class?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<InvoiceHistoryTableProps>(), {
  title: "Invoice history",
  currency: "USD",
  downloadLabel: "Download",
  invoices: () => [
    { id: "INV-2026-011", period: "November 2026", amount: "148.00", status: "paid", date: "Nov 1, 2026" },
    { id: "INV-2026-010", period: "October 2026", amount: "148.00", status: "paid", date: "Oct 1, 2026" },
    { id: "INV-2026-009", period: "September 2026", amount: "96.00", status: "pending", date: "Sep 1, 2026" },
    { id: "INV-2026-008", period: "August 2026", amount: "148.00", status: "failed", date: "Aug 1, 2026" },
  ],
  class: "",
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "invoice-download", invoice: Invoice): void;
}>();

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<InvoiceStatus, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  paid: { label: "Paid", cls: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400" },
  pending: { label: "Pending", cls: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-400" },
  failed: { label: "Failed", cls: "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400" },
};

const list = computed(() => (Array.isArray(props.invoices) ? props.invoices : []));
const paidTotal = computed(() => {
  const sum = list.value
    .filter((inv) => inv.status === "paid")
    .reduce((acc, inv) => {
      const n = Number.parseFloat(String(inv.amount ?? "0").replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, ""));
      return acc + (Number.isNaN(n) ? 0 : n);
    }, 0);
  return sum.toFixed(2);
});
</script>

<template>
  <div data-invoice-table class="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900" :class="props.class">
    <div data-invoice-header class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <p data-invoice-title class="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ props.title }}</p>
      <span data-invoice-currency class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ props.currency }}</span>
    </div>
    <table data-invoice-table-body class="w-full text-left text-xs">
      <thead>
        <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <th class="px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold">Billing period</th>
          <th class="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Invoice</th>
          <th class="px-2 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold">Amount</th>
          <th class="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Status</th>
          <th class="px-2 py-2.5 font-semibold">Date</th>
          <th class="px-5 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold"><span class="sr-only">Actions</span></th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr v-for="inv in list" :key="inv.id" :data-invoice-row="inv.id" class="border-b border-zinc-50 transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60">
          <td :data-invoice-period="inv.period" class="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ inv.period }}</td>
          <td :data-invoice-id="inv.id" class="px-2 py-3 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ inv.id }}</td>
          <td :data-invoice-amount="inv.amount" class="px-2 py-3 text-right font-mono text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ props.currency }} {{ inv.amount }}</td>
          <td :data-invoice-status="inv.status" class="px-2 py-3"><span class="inline-block rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold" :class="STATUS_STYLES[inv.status]?.cls">{{ STATUS_STYLES[inv.status]?.label }}</span></td>
          <td :data-invoice-date="inv.date" class="whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-3 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ inv.date }}</td>
          <td class="px-5 py-3 text-right">
            <button type="button" :data-invoice-download="inv.id" class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800" @click="emit('invoice-download', inv)">{{ props.downloadLabel }}</button>
          </td>

<template>

            >
              {{ initials(card.assignee) }}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface KanbanColumn {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  accent?: string;
  limit?: number;
}

export interface KanbanCard {
  id: string;
  columnId: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  assignee?: string;
  priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
}

const PRIORITY_META: Record<NonNullable<KanbanCard['priority']>, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  low: { label: 'Low', cls: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400' },
  medium: { label: 'Medium', cls: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-400' },
  high: { label: 'High', cls: 'bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-400' },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    columns?: KanbanColumn[];
    cards?: KanbanCard[];
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { columns: () => [], cards: () => [], className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'move-card', cardId: string, toColumnId: string): void;
  (e: 'card-click', card: KanbanCard): void;
  (e: 'add-card', columnId: string): void;
}>();

const draggingId = ref<string | null>(null);
const overColumn = ref<string | null>(null);

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const cardsIn = (columnId: string) => props.cards.filter((card) => card.columnId === columnId);

function move(cardId: string, toColumnId: string) {
  const card = props.cards.find((entry) => entry.id === cardId);
  if (!card || card.columnId === toColumnId) return;
  emit('move-card', cardId, toColumnId);
}

function startDrag(event: DragEvent, cardId: string) {
  event.dataTransfer?.setData('text/plain', cardId);
  if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
  draggingId.value = cardId;
}

function resetDrag() {
  draggingId.value = null;
  overColumn.value = null;
}

function drop(columnId: string) {
  const cardId = draggingId.value;
  if (cardId) move(cardId, columnId);
  resetDrag();
}

function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent, card: KanbanCard) {
  if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
    event.preventDefault();
    emit('card-click', card);
    return;
  }
  if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
  const index = props.columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === card.columnId);
  const next = props.columns[index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1)];
  if (!next) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  move(card.id, next.id);
}
</script>

===== FILE: vue\LiquidGlass.vue =====

<template>
  <div
    ref="containerRef"
    @pointermove="handlePointerMove"
    @pointerleave="handlePointerLeave"
    :style="computedStyle"
    :class="[
      'liquid-glass-pane group relative overflow-hidden text-[#1d1d1f] dark:text-[#f5f5f7] select-none transition-all duration-300',
      variantClass,
      intensityClass,
      'bg-white/65 dark:bg-[#16181d]/65',
      'contrast-more:bg-white contrast-more:dark:bg-[#16181d] contrast-more:backdrop-blur-none',
      'motion-reduce:transform-none motion-reduce:transition-none',
      'border border-white/50 dark:border-white/10',
      'shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.7),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]',
      'dark:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.18),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.4),0_12px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.35)]',
      'hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.85),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_14px_44px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]',
      'dark:hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.25),inset_0_-1px_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.45),0_16px_48px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)]',
      className
    ]"
  >
    <!-- Specular refractive rim caustics sheen layer -->
    <div
      v-if="interactive"
      aria-hidden="true"
      class="liquid-glass-glare pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 transition-opacity duration-300"
      :style="glareStyle"
    />

    <!-- Micro-frost edge reflection ring -->
    <div
      aria-hidden="true"
      class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 rounded-[inherit] ring-1 ring-inset ring-white/30 dark:ring-white/10"
    />

    <!-- Content slot -->
    <div class="relative z-0 h-full w-full">
      <slot />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

interface Props {
  variant?: "capsule" | "card" | "sidebar";
  intensity?: "light" | "regular" | "thick";
  interactive?: boolean;
  enableTilt?: boolean;
  maxTilt?: number;
  glareOpacity?: number;
  className?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  variant: "card",
  intensity: "regular",
  interactive: true,
  enableTilt: false,
  maxTilt: 4,
  glareOpacity: 0.35,
  className: "",
});

// Sanitize numeric props (TS types are compile-time only; plain-JS callers
// could pass strings that would land inside CSS values).
function numOr(v: unknown, fallback: number, min = -Infinity, max = Infinity): number {
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number.parseFloat(String(v));
  if (Number.isNaN(n)) return fallback;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n));
}

const safeMaxTilt = computed(() => numOr(props.maxTilt, 4, 0, 90));
const safeGlareOpacity = computed(() => numOr(props.glareOpacity, 0.35, 0, 1));

const containerRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
const gx = ref("50%");
const gy = ref("50%");
const rx = ref(0);
const ry = ref(0);
const isHovered = ref(false);

const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
  if (!props.interactive && !props.enableTilt) return;
  const el = containerRef.value;
  if (!el) return;
  const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (!rect.width || !rect.height || rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return;
  const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

  gx.value = `${((x / rect.width) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
  gy.value = `${((y / rect.height) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;

  if (props.enableTilt && props.variant !== "sidebar") {
    const centerX = rect.width / 2;
    const centerY = rect.height / 2;
    ry.value = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * safeMaxTilt.value;
    rx.value = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * safeMaxTilt.value;
  }
  isHovered.value = true;
};

const handlePointerLeave = () => {
  rx.value = 0;
  ry.value = 0;
  isHovered.value = false;
};

const variantClass = computed(() => {
  switch (props.variant) {
    case "capsule":
      return "rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 inline-flex items-center";
    case "sidebar":
      return "rounded-none border-r h-full block";
    case "card":
    default:
      return "rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-6 block";
  }
});

const intensityClass = computed(() => {
  switch (props.intensity) {
    case "light":
      return "backdrop-blur-md backdrop-saturate-150";
    case "thick":
      return "backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-[200%]";
    case "regular":
    default:
      return "backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-[180%]";
  }
});

const computedStyle = computed(() => {
  return {
    transform:
      props.enableTilt && isHovered.value && props.variant !== "sidebar"
        ? `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rx.value}deg) rotateY(${ry.value}deg) translateY(-1px)`
        : undefined,
    transition: isHovered.value
      ? "transform 0.1s ease-out"
      : "transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)",
  };
});

const glareStyle = computed(() => {
  return {
    opacity: isHovered.value ? safeGlareOpacity.value : 0,
    background: `radial-gradient(circle at ${gx.value} ${gy.value}, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 35%, transparent 65%)`,
    mixBlendMode: "overlay" as const,
  };
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export interface TailLogLine {
  ts?: string;
  level: 'info' | 'warn' | 'error' | 'success';
  message: string;
  source?: string;
}

const LEVEL_DOT: Record<string, string> = {
  info: 'bg-sky-500',
  warn: 'bg-amber-500',
  error: 'bg-rose-500',
  success: 'bg-emerald-500',
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    lines: TailLogLine[];
    sources?: string[];
    liveTail?: boolean;
    searchPlaceholder?: string;
    timezone?: string;
    maxLines?: number;
  }>(),
  { sources: () => [], liveTail: true, searchPlaceholder: 'Search logs…', timezone: 'GMT+7', maxLines: 200 },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'search', query: string): void;
  (e: 'source-change', source: string): void;
  (e: 'live-tail-change', enabled: boolean): void;
}>();

const query = ref('');
const follow = ref(props.liveTail);

const filtered = computed(() => {
  const base = query.value
    ? props.lines.filter((line) => line.message.toLowerCase().includes(query.value.toLowerCase()) || (line.source || '').toLowerCase().includes(query.value.toLowerCase()))
    : props.lines;
  return props.maxLines > 0 ? base.slice(-props.maxLines) : base;
});

const onInput = (event: Event) => {
  query.value = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value;
  emit('search', query.value);
};

const toggleFollow = () => {
  follow.value = !follow.value;
  emit('live-tail-change', follow.value);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div
    v-if="rows.length"
    data-marquee-wall
    class="space-y-3 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-950 via-zinc-950 to-zinc-950 p-4 dark:border-zinc-800"
    :class="className"
  >
    <div
      v-for="(row, rowIndex) in rows"
      :key="rowIndex"
      :data-marquee-row="rowIndex"
      class="flex overflow-hidden"
    >
      <div
        class="flex min-w-full shrink-0 gap-3"
        :style="{
          animation: `marquee-scroll ${speedSeconds}s linear infinite${rowIndex % 2 === 1 ? ' reverse' : ''}`,
          animationPlayState: paused ? 'paused' : 'running',
        }"
      >
        <figure
          v-for="(card, index) in doubled(row)"
          :key="`${card.name}-${index}`"
          :data-marquee-card="index"
          class="w-64 shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        >
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <span
              class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white"
              :class="avatarTones[index % avatarTones.length]"
            >
              {{ initialsOf(card.name) }}
            </span>
            <span class="min-w-0">
              <span class="block truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ card.name }}</span>
              <span v-if="card.handle && !card.anonymous" class="block truncate text-[11px] text-indigo-500">@{{ card.handle }}</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <blockquote class="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{{ card.text }}</blockquote>
        </figure>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted } from 'vue';

export interface MarqueeCard {
  name: string;
  handle?: string;
  text: string;
  anonymous?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    rows?: MarqueeCard[][];
    speedSeconds?: number;
    paused?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { rows: () => [], speedSeconds: 40, paused: false, className: '' },
);

const avatarTones = ['bg-indigo-500', 'bg-emerald-500', 'bg-rose-500', 'bg-amber-500', 'bg-sky-500', 'bg-violet-500'];

const doubled = (row: MarqueeCard[]) => [...row, ...row];
const initialsOf = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? '')
    .join('');
void props;

// The <style> tag is not allowed inside a client template; inject the keyframes once.
const MARQUEE_STYLE_ID = 'marquee-scroll-keyframes';
onMounted(() => {
  if (document.getElementById(MARQUEE_STYLE_ID)) return;
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.id = MARQUEE_STYLE_ID;
  style.textContent =
    '@keyframes marquee-scroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } } ' +
    '[data-marquee-row]:hover div { animation-play-state: paused !important; }';
  document.head.appendChild(style);
});
</script>
