const active = ref(props.clients[0]?.id ?? "");
const copied = ref(false);
let copyTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
const client = computed(() => props.clients.find((c) => c.id === active.value) ?? props.clients[0]);

const select = (id: string) => {
  active.value = id;
  copied.value = false;
};
const copy = () => {
  copied.value = true;
  if (client.value) emit("copy", client.value);
  if (copyTimer) clearTimeout(copyTimer);
  copyTimer = setTimeout(() => { copied.value = false; }, 1600);
};
onUnmounted(() => { if (copyTimer) clearTimeout(copyTimer); });
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

export interface MemoryItem {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  source?: string;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  note?: string;
  items: MemoryItem[];
  addPlaceholder?: string;
  addText?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Memory",
  note: "Facts the assistant remembers across conversations.",
  addPlaceholder: "Add a memory…",
  addText: "Add",
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "add", text: string): void;
  (e: "edit", id: string, text: string): void;
  (e: "delete", id: string): void;
  (e: "clear"): void;
}>();

const draft = ref("");
const editingId = ref<string | null>(null);
const editDraft = ref("");

const submitAdd = () => {
  const text = draft.value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  emit("add", text);
  draft.value = "";
};
const startEdit = (item: MemoryItem) => {
  editingId.value = item.id;
  editDraft.value = item.text;
};
const submitEdit = () => {
  if (!editingId.value) return;
  const text = editDraft.value.trim();
  if (text) emit("edit", editingId.value, text);
  editingId.value = null;
};
</script>

<template>

  <div :class="['flex items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-1.5 select-none', className]">
    <!-- Branch Navigator -->
    <div
      v-if="totalBranches && totalBranches > 1 && branchIndex !== undefined"
      class="flex items-center gap-0.5 mr-2 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400"

      >
        <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="14" />
      </button>
      <span>{{ branchIndex + 1 }}/{{ totalBranches }}</span>
      <button

        :disabled="branchIndex >= totalBranches - 1"
        @click="$emit('branchChange', branchIndex + 1)"

      title="Regenerate response"
    >
      <UiIcon name="refresh" :size="16" />
    </button>

    <!-- Thumbs Up / Down -->
    <template v-if="role === 'assistant'">
      <button
        type="button"
        @click="handleThumb('up')"
        :class="[
          'p-1 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60 rounded-md transition-colors',
          feedback === 'up' ? 'text-blue-500' : 'hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
        ]"
        title="Good response"
      >
        <UiIcon name="thumbs-up" :size="16" />
      </button>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    content: string;
    role?: 'assistant' | 'user' | string;
    showRetry?: boolean;
    branchIndex?: number;
    totalBranches?: number;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    role: 'assistant',
    showRetry: true,
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'retry'): void;
  (e: 'feedback', type: 'up' | 'down'): void;
  (e: 'branchChange', index: number): void;
}>();

const copied = ref(false);
const feedback = ref<'up' | 'down' | null>(null);

const handleCopy = async () => {
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.content);
  copied.value = true;
  setTimeout(() => (copied.value = false), 2000);
};

const handleThumb = (type: 'up' | 'down') => {
  const next = feedback.value === type ? null : type;
  feedback.value = next;
  if (next) emit('feedback', next);
};

    v-if="metrics.length"

      :class="index === activeIndex ? 'bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/60' : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40'"
      @click="emit('metric-click', index, metric)"
      @keydown.enter.prevent="emit('metric-click', index, metric)"
      @keydown.space.prevent="emit('metric-click', index, metric)"
    >
      <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <UiIcon v-if="metric.icon" :name="metric.icon" :size="12" class="text-zinc-400" />
        {{ metric.label }}
      </span>
      <span class="flex items-baseline gap-2">
        <span class="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ metric.value }}</span>
        <template v-if="metric.delta !== undefined">
          <span class="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium" :class="toneOf(metric.delta)">
            <UiIcon v-if="deltaIcon(metric.delta)" :name="deltaIcon(metric.delta) as IconName" :size="11" />
            {{ metric.delta > 0 ? '+' : '' }}{{ metric.delta }}{{ metric.deltaLabel ? ` ${metric.deltaLabel}` : '%' }}
          </span>
        </template>
        <span v-else-if="metric.deltaLabel" class="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-400">{{ metric.deltaLabel }}</span>
      </span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface MetricStripItem {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  delta?: number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  icon?: IconName;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    metrics?: MetricStripItem[];
    activeIndex?: number;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { metrics: () => [], activeIndex: -1, className: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'metric-click', index: number, metric: MetricStripItem): void;
}>();

const toneOf = (delta: number | undefined) => {
  if (delta === undefined) return 'text-zinc-400';
  return delta > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600' : delta < 0 ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-zinc-400';
};

const deltaIcon = (delta: number | undefined): IconName | null =>
  delta === undefined ? null : delta > 0 ? 'trending-up' : delta < 0 ? 'trending-down' : 'minus';

    @mousedown="onBackdrop">

    <div ref="panelRef" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" :aria-label="title"
      class="relative w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-5 pt-4">
        <div class="min-w-0">
          <h2 class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ title }}</h2>
          <p v-if="description" class="mt-1 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ description }}</p>
        </div>
        <button v-if="showClose" type="button" aria-label="Close" @click="emit('close')"
          class="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
          <UiIcon name="x" :size="14" />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div v-if="$slots.default" class="px-5 py-4 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
        <slot />
      </div>
      <div v-if="$slots.footer" class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 px-5 py-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-950/50">
        <slot name="footer" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    open: boolean;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    dismissible?: boolean;
    showClose?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { dismissible: true, showClose: true }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'close'): void }>();

const panelRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

const onBackdrop = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (props.dismissible && panelRef.value && !panelRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) emit('close');
};

const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Escape' && props.dismissible && props.open) emit('close');
};

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey));
onBeforeUnmount(() => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey));
</script>

<template>
  <div

      v-if="isOpen"
      class="absolute left-0 mt-1.5 w-72 max-h-80 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-2xl z-40 flex flex-col animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
    >
      <div v-if="showSearch" class="p-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100/80 dark:bg-zinc-800/80">
          <UiIcon name="search" :size="13" class="text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
          <input
            type="text"
            v-model="searchQuery"
            placeholder="Search models..."
            class="w-full bg-transparent border-none text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
            autofocus
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="overflow-y-auto p-1.5 space-y-1 max-h-60" role="listbox">
        <div v-if="filteredModels.length === 0" class="p-3 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">
          No models found
        </div>
        <button
          v-else
          v-for="model in filteredModels"
          :key="model.id"
          type="button"
          @click="handleSelect(model)"
          role="option"
          :aria-selected="model.id === selectedId"
          class="w-full flex items-start justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors"
          :class="model.id === selectedId
            ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
            : 'hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'"
        >
          <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              <span class="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">
                {{ model.name }}
              </span>
              <span
                v-if="model.contextLength"
                class="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/60 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono"
              >
                {{ model.contextLength }}
              </span>
              <span
                v-for="tag in model.tags || []"
                :key="tag"
                class="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-medium bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/50"
              >
                {{ tag }}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p v-if="model.description" class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 truncate mt-0.5">
              {{ model.description }}
            </p>
          </div>

          <UiIcon
            v-if="model.id === selectedId"
            name="check"
            :size="14"
            class="text-emerald-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5"
          />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ModelOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  provider?: string;
  description?: string;
  contextLength?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    models?: ModelOption[];
    selectedId: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    showSearch?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    models: () => [],
    placeholder: "Select model...",
    showSearch: true,
    disabled: false,
    className: "",
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "select", model: ModelOption): void;
  (e: "update:selectedId", id: string): void;
}>();

const isOpen = ref(false);
const searchQuery = ref("");
const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);

const selectedModel = computed(
  () => props.models.find((m) => m.id === props.selectedId) || null
);

const filteredModels = computed(() => {
  if (!searchQuery.value.trim()) return props.models;
  const q = searchQuery.value.toLowerCase();
  return props.models.filter(
    (m) =>
      m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (m.provider && m.provider.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (m.description && m.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
      (m.tags && m.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
  );
});

function handleSelect(model: ModelOption) {
  emit("select", model);
  emit("update:selectedId", model.id);
  isOpen.value = false;
  searchQuery.value = "";
}

function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (containerRef.value && !containerRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    isOpen.value = false;
  }
}

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
});
</script>

    { label: "01:00", value: 60 }, { label: "03:00", value: 35 }, { label: "05:00", value: 80 },

  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms} ms`;
  const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const rem = ms % 1000;
  return rem === 0 ? `${s} s` : `${s} s ${rem} ms`;
};
const max = () => Math.max(1, ...props.histogram.map((b) => b.value));
const barHeight = (value: number) => `${Math.max(4, (value / max()) * 56)}px`;

  label: string;
  href?: string;
  icon?: IconName;
  badge?: string | number;
}

  id: string;

);

const openMenu = ref<string | null>(null);
const rootRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

const onDocMouseDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  if (rootRef.value && !rootRef.value.contains(event.target as Node)) openMenu.value = null;
};
const onDocKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Escape') openMenu.value = null;
};

onMounted(() => {
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDocMouseDown);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onDocKeyDown);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDocMouseDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', onDocKeyDown);
});

<template>

      </span>

      <button
        v-for="key in (['all', 'unread'] as const)"
        :key="key"
        type="button"
        :aria-pressed="filter === key"
        :class="[
          'rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium capitalize transition-colors',
          filter === key
            ? 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100'
            : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200',
        ]"
        @click="filter = key"
      >
        {{ key }}
        <span class="ml-1 tabular-nums text-zinc-400">{{ key === 'all' ? notifications.length : unreadIds.length }}</span>
      </button>

            class="flex w-full items-start gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50"

          >
            <span :class="['mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full', TYPE_META[item.type || 'info'].chip]">

              </span>

                {{ item.description }}
              </span>
              <span v-if="item.time" class="mt-0.5 block text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ item.time }}</span>
            </span>
          </button>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

type NotificationType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

export interface NotificationItem {
  id: string | number;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  time?: string;
  icon?: string;
  unread?: boolean;
  type?: NotificationType;
}

const TYPE_META: Record<NotificationType, { chip: string; icon: string }> = {
  info: { chip: 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400', icon: 'info' },
  success: { chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', icon: 'check-circle' },
  warning: { chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', icon: 'alert-triangle' },
  error: { chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', icon: 'circle-x' },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    notifications?: NotificationItem[];
    title?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
    showFilter?: boolean;
    showPrefsButton?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    notifications: () => [],
    title: 'Notifications',
    emptyText: "You're all caught up",
    showFilter: true,
    showPrefsButton: false,
    className: '',
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', notification: NotificationItem): void;
  (e: 'mark-read', ids: Array<string | number>): void;
  (e: 'mark-all-read'): void;
  (e: 'open-preferences'): void;
  (e: 'close'): void;
}>();

const filter = ref<'all' | 'unread'>('all');

const unreadIds = computed(() => props.notifications.filter((item) => item.unread).map((item) => item.id));
const visible = computed(() => (filter.value === 'unread' ? props.notifications.filter((item) => item.unread) : props.notifications));

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  (open) => {
    if (open) filter.value = 'all';
  }
);

function select(item: NotificationItem) {
  if (item.unread) emit('mark-read', [item.id]);
  emit('select', item);
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface NotificationPrefEvent {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  channels: Record<string, boolean | undefined>;
}

export interface NotificationPrefColumn {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface NotificationPrefsMatrixProps {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  events?: NotificationPrefEvent[];
  columns?: NotificationPrefColumn[];
  class?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<NotificationPrefsMatrixProps>(), {
  title: "Notification preferences",
  description: "Choose which events reach you and through which channels.",
  events: () => [
    { id: "mentions", label: "Mentions & replies", channels: { inapp: true, email: true, push: false } },
    { id: "assigns", label: "Assigned to me", channels: { inapp: true, email: false, push: true } },
    { id: "comments", label: "Thread comments", channels: { inapp: true, email: true, push: false } },
    { id: "digest", label: "Weekly digest", channels: { inapp: false, email: true, push: false } },
  ],
  columns: () => [
    { key: "inapp", label: "In-app" },
    { key: "email", label: "Email" },
    { key: "push", label: "Push" },
  ],
  class: "",
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "pref-change", event: NotificationPrefEvent, channel: string, enabled: boolean): void;
}>();

const onCell = (ev: NotificationPrefEvent, col: NotificationPrefColumn, target: Event | null) => {
  const enabled = Boolean(target && (target as HTMLInputElement).checked);
  ev.channels[col.key] = enabled;
  emit("pref-change", ev, col.key, enabled);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">

            task.done
              ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'

          {{ task.actionText }}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface OnboardingTask {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  done: boolean;
  actionText?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  tasks: OnboardingTask[];
  title?: string;
}>(), { title: 'Get started' });

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'toggle', task: OnboardingTask): void;
  (e: 'action', task: OnboardingTask): void;
}>();

const total = computed(() => props.tasks.length);
const doneCount = computed(() => props.tasks.filter((task) => task.done).length);
const percent = computed(() => (total.value === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((doneCount.value / total.value) * 100)));

        <ul v-if="currentSegment.examples?.length" class="mt-3 space-y-2">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export interface StepperSegment {
  label: string;
  description: string;
  examples?: { label: string; value: string }[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    steps?: string[];
    current?: number;
    segments?: StepperSegment[];
    title?: string;
    continueLabel?: string;
    className?: string;

  { steps: () => [], current: 0, segments: () => [], title: 'Transaction types', continueLabel: 'Continue', className: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'step-click', index: number): void;
  (e: 'continue'): void;
}>();

const activeSegment = ref(0);
const active = computed(() => Math.min(Math.max(props.current, 0), Math.max(props.steps.length - 1, 0)));
const currentSegment = computed(() => props.segments[Math.min(activeSegment.value, Math.max(props.segments.length - 1, 0))]);

<template>
  <div data-order-tracker class="w-full">
    <template v-if="variant === 'bar'">
      <div class="h-1.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800">
        <div :data-tracker-fill="'true'" :class="['h-full rounded-full transition-all', canceled ? 'bg-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-600' : 'bg-emerald-600']" :style="{ width: `${progress}%` }" />

      <ol class="flex items-start">

          <span class="flex flex-col items-center">

              <svg v-if="reached(index)" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="3" class="h-2.5 w-2.5"><path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6" /></svg>
            </span>
            <span :class="['mt-1 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] font-medium', isCurrent(index) ? 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50' : reached(index) ? 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400' : 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600']">{{ stage.label }}</span>
            <span v-if="stage.timestamp" class="text-[9px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600">{{ stage.timestamp }}</span>
          </span>
          <span v-if="index < stages.length - 1" :class="['mx-1 mt-2 h-0.5 flex-1', reached(index) && index < currentIndex ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700']" />
        </li>
      </ol>
      <button v-if="trackingUrl" type="button" data-tracker-track class="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400" @click="emit('track')">Track shipment &gt;</button>
    </template>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

export interface TrackerStage {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  timestamp?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    stages: TrackerStage[];
    current: number | 'canceled';
    variant?: 'dots' | 'bar';
    eta?: string;
    trackingNumber?: string;
    trackingUrl?: string;
    canceledReason?: string;
  }>(),
  { variant: 'dots' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'track'): void }>();

const canceled = computed(() => props.current === 'canceled');
const currentIndex = computed(() => (canceled.value ? -1 : (props.current as number)));
const progress = computed(() => Math.round(((currentIndex.value + 1) / props.stages.length) * 100));

const reached = (index: number) => !canceled.value && index <= currentIndex.value;
const isCurrent = (index: number) => !canceled.value && index === currentIndex.value;

===== FILE: vue\OtpInput.vue =====

<template>
  <div class="w-full max-w-sm" data-otp-input>
    <h2 v-if="heading" class="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ heading }}</h2>
    <p v-if="subtext" class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ subtext }}</p>

    <div :class="['flex gap-1.5', heading || subtext ? 'mt-4' : '']" data-otp-cells>
      <input
        v-for="(char, index) in chars"
        :key="index"
        :ref="(node) => { cellRefs[index] = node }"
        type="text"
        inputmode="numeric"
        maxlength="1"
        :value="char"
        :aria-label="`Digit ${index + 1}`"
        :data-otp-cell="index"
        :class="cellClass(Boolean(char))"
        @input="onInput(index, $event)"
        @keydown.backspace.prevent="onBackspace(index)"
        @paste="onPaste(index, $event)"
      />
    </div>

    <p v-if="status === 'error' && errorText" data-otp-error class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-3.5 w-3.5">
        <path d="m10.29 3.86 1.58-2.75a1 1 0 0 1 1.74 0l1.58 2.75 3.18.55a1 1 0 0 1 .6 1.62l-2.2 2.5 2.2 2.5a1 1 0 0 1-.6 1.62l-3.18.55-1.58 2.75a1 1 0 0 1-1.74 0l-1.58-2.75-3.18-.55a1 1 0 0 1-.6-1.62l2.2-2.5-2.2-2.5a1 1 0 0 1 .6-1.62Z" />
        <path d="M12 9v4M12 17h.01" />
      </svg>
      {{ errorText }}
    </p>

    <button type="button" data-otp-continue class="mt-4 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500">
      {{ continueLabel }}
    </button>

    <p v-if="resendHint" class="mt-3 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
      <a href="#" data-otp-resend class="font-medium text-indigo-600 underline-offset-2 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400">Resend code</a>
      · {{ resendHint }}
    </p>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    length?: number;
    value?: string;
    heading?: string;
    subtext?: string;
    status?: 'idle' | 'error';
    errorText?: string;
    continueLabel?: string;
    resendHint?: string;
  }>(),
  { length: 6, value: '', heading: '', subtext: '', status: 'idle', errorText: '', continueLabel: 'Continue', resendHint: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', value: string): void;
  (e: 'complete', value: string): void;
}>();

const cellRefs = ref<HTMLInputElement[]>([]);
const chars = computed(() => Array.from({ length: props.length }, (_, i) => props.value[i] ?? ''));

const commit = (next: string) => {
  emit('change', next);
  if (next.length >= props.length) emit('complete', next.slice(0, props.length));
};

const setAt = (index: number, char: string) => {
  const digits = chars.value.slice();
  digits[index] = char;
  commit(digits.join('').slice(0, props.length));
};

const cellClass = (filled: boolean) =>
  `h-12 w-11 rounded-lg border text-center text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
    props.status === 'error'
      ? 'border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/60 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-500/70 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-200'
      : filled
        ? 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-50'
        : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-400 placeholder:text-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-500'
  }`;

const onInput = (index: number, event: Event) => {
  const char = (event.target as HTMLInputElement).value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-1);
  if (!char) return;
  setAt(index, char);
  cellRefs.value[Math.min(index + 1, props.length - 1)]?.focus();
};

const onBackspace = (index: number) => {
  if (chars.value[index]) {
    setAt(index, '');
  } else if (index > 0) {
    setAt(index - 1, '');
    cellRefs.value[index - 1]?.focus();
  }
};

const onPaste = (index: number, event: ClipboardEvent) => {
  const pasted = event.clipboardData?.getData('text').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, props.length) ?? '';
  if (pasted.length > 1) {
    event.preventDefault();
    commit(pasted);
    cellRefs.value[Math.min(pasted.length, props.length - 1)]?.focus();
  }
};
</script>

<template>
  <header data-page-header class="flex flex-col gap-3" :class="className">
    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
      <div class="min-w-0">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <h2 class="truncate text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ title }}</h2>

            v-if="statusText"
            class="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
          >

            {{ statusText }}
          </span>
        </div>

      <button

        :key="tab.label"
        type="button"
        :data-tab-label="tab.label"
        :aria-current="tab.label === activeTab ? 'page' : undefined"
        class="-mb-px flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
        :class="
          tab.label === activeTab
            ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400'
            : 'border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
        "
        @click="handleTab(tab)"
      >
        {{ tab.label }}
        <span
          v-if="tab.count !== undefined"
          class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-px font-mono text-[9.5px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400"
        >
          {{ tab.count }}
        </span>
      </button>
    </nav>
  </header>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface PageHeaderAction {
  label: string;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost';
  icon?: IconName;
}

export interface PageHeaderTab {
  label: string;
  count?: number;
}

const ACTION_VARIANT: Record<string, string> = {
  primary: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
  secondary:
    'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800',
  ghost:
    'text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-200',
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    statusText?: string;
    actions?: PageHeaderAction[];
    tabs?: PageHeaderTab[];
    activeTab?: string;
    onAction?: (action: PageHeaderAction) => void;
    onTabChange?: (tab: PageHeaderTab) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { description: '', statusText: '', actions: () => [], tabs: () => [], activeTab: '', className: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'action', action: PageHeaderAction): void;
  (e: 'tab-change', tab: PageHeaderTab): void;
}>();

const handleAction = (action: PageHeaderAction) => {
  props.onAction?.(action);
  emit('action', action);
};

const handleTab = (tab: PageHeaderTab) => {
  props.onTabChange?.(tab);
  emit('tab-change', tab);
};
</script>

<template>
  <nav :aria-label="ariaLabel" :class="['flex items-center gap-1', $attrs.class]">
    <button v-if="showEdges" type="button" aria-label="First page" :disabled="page <= 1" :class="[BASE, EDGE_CLASS]"
      @click="go(1)">
      <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="13" />
    </button>
    <button type="button" aria-label="Previous page" :disabled="page <= 1" :class="[BASE, EDGE_CLASS]"
      @click="go(page - 1)">
      <UiIcon name="chevron-left" :size="13" />
    </button>
    <template v-for="(slot, index) in slots" :key="slot === 'gap' ? `gap-${index}` : slot">
      <span v-if="slot === 'gap'" aria-hidden="true" class="px-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">…</span>
      <button v-else type="button" :aria-label="`Page ${slot}`" :aria-current="slot === page ? 'page' : undefined"
        :class="[BASE, 'tabular-nums', slot === page ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : PAGE_CLASS]" @click="go(slot)">
        {{ slot }}
      </button>
    </template>
    <button type="button" aria-label="Next page" :disabled="page >= pageCount" :class="[BASE, EDGE_CLASS]"
      @click="go(page + 1)">
      <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="13" />
    </button>
    <button v-if="showEdges" type="button" aria-label="Last page" :disabled="page >= pageCount"
      :class="[BASE, EDGE_CLASS]" @click="go(pageCount)">
      <UiIcon name="chevron-right" :size="13" />
    </button>
  </nav>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type PaginationSlot = number | 'gap';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    page: number;
    pageCount: number;
    siblingCount?: number;
    showEdges?: boolean;
    ariaLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { siblingCount: 1, showEdges: true, ariaLabel: 'Pagination' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', page: number): void }>();

const BASE =
  'inline-flex h-7 min-w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md px-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40';
const EDGE_CLASS =
  'text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100';
const PAGE_CLASS = EDGE_CLASS;

const slots = computed<PaginationSlot[]>(() => {
  const { page, pageCount, siblingCount } = props;
  if (pageCount <= 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set<number>([1, pageCount, page]);
  for (let offset = 1; offset <= siblingCount; offset += 1) {
    seen.add(page - offset);
    seen.add(page + offset);
  }
  const sorted = Array.from(seen)
    .filter((entry) => entry >= 1 && entry <= pageCount)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const result: PaginationSlot[] = [];
  let previous = 0;
  for (const entry of sorted) {
    if (previous > 0 && entry - previous > 1) result.push('gap');
    result.push(entry);
    previous = entry;
  }
  return result;
});

const go = (next: number) => {
  if (next < 1 || next > props.pageCount || next === props.page) return;
  emit('change', next);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-pipeline-list class="w-full divide-y divide-zinc-200 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:divide-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div v-for="group in groups" :key="group.id" :data-pipeline-group="group.id">
      <button type="button" data-pipeline-group-header class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60" @click="toggle(group.id)">
        <svg v-if="isRunning(group)" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" class="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 animate-spin text-sky-500"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56" /></svg>
        <span v-else class="flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-dashed border-zinc-400" />
        <span class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span class="block text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ group.title }}</span>
          <span v-if="group.currentStep" class="block truncate text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ group.currentStep }}</span>
        </span>
        <span v-if="showDuration" class="shrink-0 font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ durationLabel(groupDuration(group)) }}</span>
        <svg v-if="collapsible" :class="['h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-zinc-400 transition-transform', expanded.has(group.id) ? 'rotate-90' : '']" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" /></svg>
      </button>
      <div v-if="expanded.has(group.id)" class="mx-3 mb-3 rounded-md bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-1.5 dark:bg-zinc-800/60">
        <button v-for="stage in group.stages" :key="stage.id" type="button" :data-pipeline-stage="stage.id" :data-stage-status="stage.status" class="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-200 py-2 text-left last:border-b-0 focus-visible:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700/60" @click="emit('stage-click', stage)">
          <span class="truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ stage.label }}</span>
          <span class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 font-mono text-[11px]">
            <span v-if="showDuration && stage.durationMs != null" class="text-zinc-400">{{ durationLabel(stage.durationMs) }}</span>
            <span :class="STAGE_STATUS[stage.status]?.tone">{{ STAGE_STATUS[stage.status]?.text || 'Pending' }}</span>
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';

export interface PipelineStage {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'running' | 'success' | 'failed';
  durationMs?: number;
}

export interface PipelineGroup {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  currentStep?: string;
  stages: PipelineStage[];
}

const STAGE_STATUS: Record<string, { text: string; tone: string }> = {
  pending: { text: 'Pending', tone: 'text-zinc-400' },
  running: { text: 'Running', tone: 'text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400' },
  success: { text: 'Completed', tone: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  failed: { text: 'Failed', tone: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' },
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    groups: PipelineGroup[];
    defaultExpanded?: string[];
    showDuration?: boolean;
    collapsible?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { defaultExpanded: () => [], showDuration: true, collapsible: true },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'stage-click', stage: PipelineStage): void;
}>();

const expanded = ref(new Set(props.defaultExpanded));

const toggle = (id: string) => {
  if (!props.collapsible) return;
  const next = new Set(expanded.value);
  if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
  else next.add(id);
  expanded.value = next;
};

const isRunning = (group: PipelineGroup) => group.stages.some((stage) => stage.status === 'running');
const groupDuration = (group: PipelineGroup) => group.stages.reduce((sum, stage) => sum + (stage.durationMs || 0), 0) || undefined;

const durationLabel = (ms?: number) => {
  if (ms == null) return '';
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  if (ms < 60000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(ms % 1000 === 0 ? 0 : 1)}s`;
  return `${Math.floor(ms / 60000)}m ${Math.round((ms % 60000) / 1000)}s`;
};
</script>

import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, watch, type CSSProperties } from "vue";

/**
 * PointerRipples — Vue 3
 * WebGL-powered interactive multi-color fluid ripples backdrop.
 * Follows mouse/pointer movement with Navier-Stokes fluid dynamics,
 * rainbow hue-shifting dye splats, vorticity swirls, and 3D diffuse shading.
 *
 * Features:
 * - Fluid simulation (advection, divergence, pressure Poisson solver, vorticity confinement)
 * - Coalesced pointer event handling for high-refresh-rate cursor tracking
 * - Idle sleep & visibilitychange hibernation for zero idle CPU/GPU consumption
 * - WebGL2 & WebGL1 fallback with half-float/float FBO support
 * - prefers-reduced-motion accessibility compliance
 */

interface Props {

  maxPixelRatio?: number;
  /** Custom canvas CSS classes */
  className?: string;
  /** Custom canvas inline styles */
  style?: CSSProperties;

  opacity?: number;
}

const BASE_VERTEX_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
attribute vec2 aPosition;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform vec2 texelSize;

void main () {
  vUv = aPosition * 0.5 + 0.5;
  vL = vUv - vec2(texelSize.x, 0.0);
  vR = vUv + vec2(texelSize.x, 0.0);
  vT = vUv + vec2(0.0, texelSize.y);
  vB = vUv - vec2(0.0, texelSize.y);
  gl_Position = vec4(aPosition, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const CLEAR_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;
uniform float value;

void main () {
  gl_FragColor = value * texture2D(uTexture, vUv);
}
`;

const SPLAT_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uTarget;
uniform float aspectRatio;
uniform vec3 color;
uniform vec2 point;
uniform float radius;

void main () {
  vec2 offset = vUv - point;
  offset.x *= aspectRatio;
  vec3 splat = exp(-dot(offset, offset) / radius) * color;
  vec3 base = texture2D(uTarget, vUv).xyz;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(base + splat, 1.0);
}
`;

const ADVECTION_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;
uniform sampler2D uSource;
uniform vec2 texelSize;
uniform vec2 dyeTexelSize;
uniform float dt;
uniform float dissipation;

vec4 bilerp (sampler2D source, vec2 uv, vec2 size) {
  vec2 coord = uv / size - 0.5;
  vec2 index = floor(coord);
  vec2 weight = fract(coord);
  vec4 a = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(0.5, 0.5)) * size);
  vec4 b = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(1.5, 0.5)) * size);
  vec4 c = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(0.5, 1.5)) * size);
  vec4 d = texture2D(source, (index + vec2(1.5, 1.5)) * size);
  return mix(mix(a, b, weight.x), mix(c, d, weight.x), weight.y);
}

void main () {
#ifdef MANUAL_FILTERING
  vec2 coord = vUv - dt * bilerp(uVelocity, vUv, texelSize).xy * texelSize;
  vec4 result = bilerp(uSource, coord, dyeTexelSize);
#else
  vec2 coord = vUv - dt * texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy * texelSize;
  vec4 result = texture2D(uSource, coord);
#endif
  gl_FragColor = result / (1.0 + dissipation * dt);
}
`;

const DIVERGENCE_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uVelocity, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uVelocity, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uVelocity, vT).y;
  float bottom = texture2D(uVelocity, vB).y;
  vec2 center = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;

  if (vL.x < 0.0) left = -center.x;
  if (vR.x > 1.0) right = -center.x;
  if (vT.y > 1.0) top = -center.y;
  if (vB.y < 0.0) bottom = -center.y;

  float divergence = 0.5 * (right - left + top - bottom);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(divergence, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const CURL_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uVelocity, vL).y;
  float right = texture2D(uVelocity, vR).y;
  float top = texture2D(uVelocity, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uVelocity, vB).x;
  float value = right - left - top + bottom;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(0.5 * value, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const VORTICITY_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;
uniform sampler2D uCurl;
uniform float curl;
uniform float dt;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uCurl, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uCurl, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uCurl, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uCurl, vB).x;
  float center = texture2D(uCurl, vUv).x;
  vec2 force = 0.5 * vec2(abs(top) - abs(bottom), abs(right) - abs(left));
  force /= length(force) + 0.0001;
  force *= curl * center;
  force.y *= -1.0;

  vec2 velocity = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;
  velocity += force * dt;
  velocity = clamp(velocity, -1000.0, 1000.0);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(velocity, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const PRESSURE_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uPressure;
uniform sampler2D uDivergence;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uPressure, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uPressure, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uPressure, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uPressure, vB).x;
  float divergence = texture2D(uDivergence, vUv).x;
  float pressure = (left + right + bottom + top - divergence) * 0.25;
  gl_FragColor = vec4(pressure, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const GRADIENT_SUBTRACT_SHADER = `
precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
varying highp vec2 vUv;
varying highp vec2 vL;
varying highp vec2 vR;
varying highp vec2 vT;
varying highp vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uPressure;
uniform sampler2D uVelocity;

void main () {
  float left = texture2D(uPressure, vL).x;
  float right = texture2D(uPressure, vR).x;
  float top = texture2D(uPressure, vT).x;
  float bottom = texture2D(uPressure, vB).x;
  vec2 velocity = texture2D(uVelocity, vUv).xy;
  velocity -= vec2(right - left, top - bottom);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(velocity, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`;

const DISPLAY_SHADER = `
precision highp float;
precision highp sampler2D;
varying vec2 vUv;
varying vec2 vL;
varying vec2 vR;
varying vec2 vT;
varying vec2 vB;
uniform sampler2D uTexture;
uniform vec2 texelSize;

vec3 linearToGamma (vec3 color) {
  color = max(color, vec3(0.0));
  return max(1.055 * pow(color, vec3(0.416666667)) - 0.055, vec3(0.0));
}

void main () {
  vec3 color = texture2D(uTexture, vUv).rgb;

#ifdef SHADING
  vec3 left = texture2D(uTexture, vL).rgb;
  vec3 right = texture2D(uTexture, vR).rgb;
  vec3 top = texture2D(uTexture, vT).rgb;
  vec3 bottom = texture2D(uTexture, vB).rgb;
  float dx = length(right) - length(left);
  float dy = length(top) - length(bottom);
  vec3 normal = normalize(vec3(dx, dy, length(texelSize) * 3.0));
  float diffuse = clamp(dot(normal, vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)) + 0.85, 0.85, 1.0);
  color *= diffuse;
#endif

  float peak = max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b));
  color = min(linearToGamma(color), vec3(1.0));
  float alpha = clamp(peak * 1.35, 0.0, 1.0);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(color, alpha);
}
`;

function normalizeHue(h: number): number {
  return ((h % 1) + 1) % 1;
}

function clamp(val: number, min = 0, max = 1): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, val));
}

function hsvToRgb(h: number, s: number, v: number): { r: number; g: number; b: number } {
  const i = Math.floor(h * 6);
  const f = h * 6 - i;
  const p = v * (1 - s);
  const q = v * (1 - f * s);
  const t = v * (1 - (1 - f) * s);
  switch (i % 6) {
    case 0:
      return { r: v, g: t, b: p };
    case 1:
      return { r: q, g: v, b: p };
    case 2:
      return { r: p, g: v, b: t };
    case 3:
      return { r: p, g: q, b: v };
    case 4:
      return { r: t, g: p, b: v };
    default:
      return { r: v, g: p, b: q };
  }
}

interface FBO {
  texture: WebGLTexture;
  raw: WebGLFramebuffer;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  texelX: number;
  texelY: number;
}

interface DoubleFBO {
  read: FBO;
  write: FBO;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  texelX: number;
  texelY: number;
  swap: () => void;
}

interface ProgramInfo {
  raw: WebGLProgram;
  uniforms: Record<string, WebGLUniformLocation | null>;
}

interface PointerInput {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  color: { r: number; g: number; b: number };
  radius?: number;
}

class FluidSimulationEngine {
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  cfg: Required<Omit<Props, "className" | "style" | "opacity">>;
  view: Window;
  gl: WebGLRenderingContext | WebGL2RenderingContext;
  isGl2: boolean;
  textures = new Set<WebGLTexture>();
  fbos = new Set<WebGLFramebuffer>();
  programs = new Set<WebGLProgram>();
  shaders = new Set<WebGLShader>();
  buffers = new Set<WebGLBuffer>();
  inputs: PointerInput[] = [];
  linear = false;
  texType = 0;
  rgba = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
  rg = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
  r = { internal: 0, format: 0 };
  prog: Record<string, ProgramInfo> | null = null;
  dye: DoubleFBO | null = null;
  velocity: DoubleFBO | null = null;
  divergence: FBO | null = null;
  curlFbo: FBO | null = null;
  pressure: DoubleFBO | null = null;
  frame = 0;
  lastTime = 0;
  lastInput = 0;
  hue = 0.52;
  pointer: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;
  visible = true;
  active = false;
  dead = false;

  constructor(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, options: Props) {
    this.canvas = canvas;
    this.cfg = {
      simResolution: options.simResolution ?? 128,
      dyeResolution: options.dyeResolution ?? 768,
      densityDissipation: options.densityDissipation ?? 2.4,
      velocityDissipation: options.velocityDissipation ?? 1.6,
      pressure: options.pressure ?? 0.8,
      pressureIterations: options.pressureIterations ?? 20,
      curl: options.curl ?? 13,
      splatRadius: options.splatRadius ?? 0.24,
      splatForce: options.splatForce ?? 4800,
      shading: options.shading ?? true,
      colorSpeed: options.colorSpeed ?? 0.055,
      colorStep: options.colorStep ?? 0.012,
      colorSaturation: options.colorSaturation ?? 0.72,
      colorValue: options.colorValue ?? 1.0,
      colorIntensity: options.colorIntensity ?? 0.26,
      idleMs: options.idleMs ?? 4000,
      maxPixelRatio: options.maxPixelRatio ?? 1.5,
    };
    this.view = canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView ?? window;

    const ctxAttr: WebGLContextAttributes = {
      alpha: true,
      depth: false,
      stencil: false,
      antialias: false,
      premultipliedAlpha: true,
      preserveDrawingBuffer: false,
    };

    const gl2 = canvas.getContext("webgl2", ctxAttr);
    const gl1 = gl2 ? null : (canvas.getContext("webgl", ctxAttr) as WebGLRenderingContext | null);
    const gl = gl2 ?? gl1;
    if (!gl) throw new Error("WebGL is unavailable");

    this.gl = gl;
    this.isGl2 = !!gl2;

    try {
      this.initFormats();
      this.initPrograms();
      this.initQuad();
      this.resizeCanvas();
      this.initFramebuffers();
      this.clearScreen();
    } catch (err) {
      this.releaseGl();
      throw err;
    }
  }

  update = (now: number) => {
    this.frame = 0;
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;

    if (now - this.lastInput >= this.cfg.idleMs && this.inputs.length === 0) {
      this.active = false;
      this.clearAll();
      return;
    }

    const dt = Math.min(Math.max((now - this.lastTime) / 1000, 0.001), 1 / 60);
    this.lastTime = now;
    this.hue = normalizeHue(this.hue + dt * this.cfg.colorSpeed);

    if (this.resizeCanvas()) {
      this.initFramebuffers();
    }

    this.applyInputs();
    this.step(dt);
    this.render();
    this.frame = this.view.requestAnimationFrame(this.update);
  };

  move(clientX: number, clientY: number) {
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;
    const pt = this.toPoint(clientX, clientY);
    const prev = this.pointer;
    this.pointer = pt;

    if (!prev) {
      this.queue({ ...pt, vx: 0, vy: 0, color: this.nextColor() });
      this.wake();
      return;
    }

    const w = Math.max(this.canvas.clientWidth, 1);
    const h = Math.max(this.canvas.clientHeight, 1);
    const dx = (pt.x - prev.x) * w;
    const dy = (pt.y - prev.y) * h;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const count = clamp(Math.ceil(dist / 14), 1, 32);

    const vx = this.correctX((pt.x - prev.x) / count) * this.cfg.splatForce;
    const vy = this.correctY((pt.y - prev.y) / count) * this.cfg.splatForce;

    for (let i = 1; i <= count; i += 1) {
      const t = i / count;
      this.queue({
        x: prev.x + (pt.x - prev.x) * t,
        y: prev.y + (pt.y - prev.y) * t,
        vx,
        vy,
        color: this.nextColor(),
      });
    }
    this.wake();
  }

  splat(clientX: number, clientY: number) {
    if (this.dead || !this.visible) return;
    const pt = this.toPoint(clientX, clientY);
    const hue = this.hue;
    const spread = Math.min(this.canvas.clientWidth, this.canvas.clientHeight) * 0.1;

    this.pointer = pt;
    this.queue({
      ...pt,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      color: this.makeColor(hue, 1.4),
      radius: 0.19,
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) {
      const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2;
      const subPt = this.toPoint(
        clientX + Math.cos(angle) * spread,
        clientY + Math.sin(angle) * spread
      );
      this.queue({
        ...subPt,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * 140,
        vy: -Math.sin(angle) * 140,
        color: this.makeColor(hue + i / 6, 1.7),
        radius: 0.11,
      });
    }

    this.hue = normalizeHue(hue + this.cfg.colorStep * 7);
    this.wake();
  }

  resize() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    if (this.resizeCanvas()) {
      this.initFramebuffers();
      if (!this.active) this.clearScreen();
    }
  }

  setVisible(visible: boolean) {
    if (this.dead || visible === this.visible) return;
    this.visible = visible;
    this.pointer = null;
    if (!visible) {
      this.inputs.length = 0;
      this.stop();
      this.clearAll();
      return;
    }
    this.active = false;
    this.clearScreen();
  }

  destroy() {
    if (this.dead) return;
    this.dead = true;
    this.stop();
    this.inputs.length = 0;
    this.pointer = null;
    this.clearScreen();
    this.releaseGl();
  }

  private initFormats() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    if (this.isGl2) {
      const gl2 = gl as WebGL2RenderingContext;
      gl2.getExtension("EXT_color_buffer_float");
      this.linear = !!gl2.getExtension("OES_texture_float_linear");
      this.texType = gl2.HALF_FLOAT;

      const rgba = this.supportedFormat(gl2.RGBA16F, gl2.RGBA, this.texType);
      const rg = this.supportedFormat(gl2.RG16F, gl2.RG, this.texType);
      const r = this.supportedFormat(gl2.R16F, gl2.RED, this.texType);

      if (rgba && rg && r) {
        this.rgba = rgba;
        this.rg = rg;
        this.r = r;
        return;
      }
    }

    const halfExt = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_half_float");
    const halfLinear = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_half_float_linear");
    const floatExt = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_float");
    const floatLinear = gl.getExtension("OES_texture_float_linear");

    const candidates = [
      halfExt && { type: (halfExt as any).HALF_FLOAT_OES, linear: !!halfLinear },
      floatExt && { type: gl.FLOAT, linear: !!floatLinear },
    ].filter(Boolean) as { type: number; linear: boolean }[];

    for (const cand of candidates) {
      const fmt = this.supportedFormat(gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, cand.type);
      if (fmt) {
        this.texType = cand.type;
        this.linear = cand.linear;
        this.rgba = fmt;
        this.rg = fmt;
        this.r = fmt;
        return;
      }
    }

    throw new Error("WebGL floating-point framebuffers are unavailable");
  }

  private supportedFormat(
    internal: number,
    format: number,
    type: number
  ): { internal: number; format: number } | null {
    if (this.isRenderable(internal, format, type)) {
      return { internal, format };
    }
    if (!this.isGl2) return null;
    const gl2 = this.gl as WebGL2RenderingContext;
    if (internal === gl2.R16F) return this.supportedFormat(gl2.RG16F, gl2.RG, type);
    if (internal === gl2.RG16F) return this.supportedFormat(gl2.RGBA16F, gl2.RGBA, type);
    return null;
  }

  private isRenderable(internal: number, format: number, type: number): boolean {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const tex = gl.createTexture();
    const fbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
    if (!tex || !fbo) return false;

    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.NEAREST);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.NEAREST);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, internal, 4, 4, 0, format, type, null);

    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0);
    const ok = gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) === gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE;

    gl.deleteTexture(tex);
    gl.deleteFramebuffer(fbo);
    return ok;
  }

  private initPrograms() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vert = this.compileShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, BASE_VERTEX_SHADER);

    const makeProg = (fragSrc: string, defs: string[] = []): ProgramInfo => {
      const frag = this.compileShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragSrc, defs);
      return this.linkProgram(vert, frag);
    };

    const advectionDefs = this.linear ? [] : ["MANUAL_FILTERING"];
    const displayDefs = this.cfg.shading && this.linear ? ["SHADING"] : [];

    this.prog = {
      clear: makeProg(CLEAR_SHADER),
      splat: makeProg(SPLAT_SHADER),
      advection: makeProg(ADVECTION_SHADER, advectionDefs),
      divergence: makeProg(DIVERGENCE_SHADER),
      curl: makeProg(CURL_SHADER),
      vorticity: makeProg(VORTICITY_SHADER),
      pressure: makeProg(PRESSURE_SHADER),
      gradient: makeProg(GRADIENT_SUBTRACT_SHADER),
      display: makeProg(DISPLAY_SHADER, displayDefs),
    };
  }

  private compileShader(type: number, src: string, defs: string[] = []): WebGLShader {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const shader = gl.createShader(type);
    if (!shader) throw new Error("Failed to create WebGL shader");
    this.shaders.add(shader);

    const prefix = defs.map((d) => `#define ${d}\n`).join("");
    gl.shaderSource(shader, `${prefix}${src}`);
    gl.compileShader(shader);

    if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
      const err = gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader) || "Shader compile error";
      gl.deleteShader(shader);
      this.shaders.delete(shader);
      throw new Error(err);
    }
    return shader;
  }

  private linkProgram(vert: WebGLShader, frag: WebGLShader): ProgramInfo {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = gl.createProgram();
    if (!prog) throw new Error("Failed to create WebGL program");
    this.programs.add(prog);

    gl.attachShader(prog, vert);
    gl.attachShader(prog, frag);
    gl.bindAttribLocation(prog, 0, "aPosition");
    gl.linkProgram(prog);

    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
      const err = gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog) || "Program link error";
      gl.deleteProgram(prog);
      this.programs.delete(prog);
      throw new Error(err);
    }

    const uniforms: Record<string, WebGLUniformLocation | null> = {};
    const count = gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.ACTIVE_UNIFORMS);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const info = gl.getActiveUniform(prog, i);
      if (info) uniforms[info.name] = gl.getUniformLocation(prog, info.name);
    }
    return { raw: prog, uniforms };
  }

  private initQuad() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vbo = gl.createBuffer();
    const ibo = gl.createBuffer();
    if (!vbo || !ibo) throw new Error("Failed to create geometry buffers");

    this.buffers.add(vbo);
    this.buffers.add(ibo);

    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo);
    gl.bufferData(
      gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,
      new Float32Array([-1, -1, -1, 1, 1, 1, 1, -1]),
      gl.STATIC_DRAW
    );

    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, ibo);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, new Uint16Array([0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);

    gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
  }

  private initFramebuffers() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    this.releaseTargets();

    const simRes = this.calcResolution(this.cfg.simResolution);
    const dyeRes = this.calcResolution(this.linear ? this.cfg.dyeResolution : 256);
    const filter = this.linear ? gl.LINEAR : gl.NEAREST;

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    this.dye = this.createDoubleFbo(dyeRes.width, dyeRes.height, this.rgba, filter);
    this.velocity = this.createDoubleFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.rg, filter);
    this.divergence = this.createFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
    this.curlFbo = this.createFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
    this.pressure = this.createDoubleFbo(simRes.width, simRes.height, this.r, gl.NEAREST);
  }

  private createFbo(w: number, h: number, fmt: { internal: number; format: number }, filter: number): FBO {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const tex = gl.createTexture();
    const fbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
    if (!tex || !fbo) throw new Error("Failed to create FBO");

    this.textures.add(tex);
    this.fbos.add(fbo);

    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, fmt.internal, w, h, 0, fmt.format, this.texType, null);

    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, w, h);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);

    return {
      texture: tex,
      raw: fbo,
      width: w,
      height: h,
      texelX: 1 / w,
      texelY: 1 / h,
    };
  }

  private createDoubleFbo(
    w: number,
    h: number,
    fmt: { internal: number; format: number },
    filter: number
  ): DoubleFBO {
    const read = this.createFbo(w, h, fmt, filter);
    const write = this.createFbo(w, h, fmt, filter);
    const dfbo: DoubleFBO = {
      read,
      write,
      width: w,
      height: h,
      texelX: 1 / w,
      texelY: 1 / h,
      swap: () => {
        const tmp = dfbo.read;
        dfbo.read = dfbo.write;
        dfbo.write = tmp;
      },
    };
    return dfbo;
  }

  private releaseTargets() {
    if (this.divergence) this.deleteFbo(this.divergence);
    if (this.curlFbo) this.deleteFbo(this.curlFbo);
    if (this.dye) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.dye.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.dye.write);
    }
    if (this.velocity) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.velocity.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.velocity.write);
    }
    if (this.pressure) {
      this.deleteFbo(this.pressure.read);
      this.deleteFbo(this.pressure.write);
    }
    this.dye = null;
    this.velocity = null;
    this.divergence = null;
    this.curlFbo = null;
    this.pressure = null;
  }

  private deleteFbo(fbo: FBO) {
    this.gl.deleteTexture(fbo.texture);
    this.gl.deleteFramebuffer(fbo.raw);
    this.textures.delete(fbo.texture);
    this.fbos.delete(fbo.raw);
  }

  private calcResolution(res: number): { width: number; height: number } {
    const dw = this.gl.drawingBufferWidth;
    const dh = this.gl.drawingBufferHeight;
    const aspect = Math.max(dw / Math.max(dh, 1), dh / Math.max(dw, 1));
    const small = Math.round(res);
    const big = Math.round(res * aspect);
    return dw > dh ? { width: big, height: small } : { width: small, height: big };
  }

  private resizeCanvas(): boolean {
    const dpr = Math.min(this.view.devicePixelRatio || 1, this.cfg.maxPixelRatio);
    const w = this.canvas.clientWidth || this.canvas.width || 1;
    const h = this.canvas.clientHeight || this.canvas.height || 1;
    const targetW = Math.max(1, Math.floor(w * dpr));
    const targetH = Math.max(1, Math.floor(h * dpr));

    if (this.canvas.width === targetW && this.canvas.height === targetH) {
      return false;
    }
    this.canvas.width = targetW;
    this.canvas.height = targetH;
    return true;
  }

  private toPoint(clientX: number, clientY: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const rect = this.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = Math.max(rect.width, 1);
    const h = Math.max(rect.height, 1);
    const x = clamp((clientX - rect.left) / w);
    const y = 1 - clamp((clientY - rect.top) / h);
    return { x, y };
  }

  private correctX(val: number): number {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect < 1 ? val * aspect : val;
  }

  private correctY(val: number): number {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect > 1 ? val / aspect : val;
  }

  private correctRadius(rad: number): number {
    const aspect = this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1);
    return aspect > 1 ? rad * aspect : rad;
  }

  private makeColor(hue: number, intensityScale = 1) {
    const rgb = hsvToRgb(normalizeHue(hue), this.cfg.colorSaturation, this.cfg.colorValue);
    const scale = this.cfg.colorIntensity * intensityScale;
    return { r: rgb.r * scale, g: rgb.g * scale, b: rgb.b * scale };
  }

  private nextColor(intensityScale = 1) {
    const col = this.makeColor(this.hue, intensityScale);
    this.hue = normalizeHue(this.hue + this.cfg.colorStep);
    return col;
  }

  private queue(item: PointerInput) {
    if (this.inputs.length >= 128) this.inputs.shift();
    this.inputs.push(item);
  }

  private wake() {
    this.lastInput = this.view.performance.now();
    this.active = true;
    if (!this.frame && this.visible) {
      this.lastTime = this.lastInput;
      this.frame = this.view.requestAnimationFrame(this.update);
    }
  }

  private stop() {
    if (this.frame) {
      this.view.cancelAnimationFrame(this.frame);
      this.frame = 0;
    }
  }

  private applyInputs() {
    const count = Math.min(this.inputs.length, 10);
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const item = this.inputs.shift();
      if (item) this.applySplat(item);
    }
  }

  private applySplat(item: PointerInput) {
    if (!this.prog || !this.velocity || !this.dye) return;
    const prog = this.prog.splat;
    const gl = this.gl;
    const vel = this.velocity;
    const dye = this.dye;

    this.bindProg(prog);
    this.u1f(prog, "aspectRatio", this.canvas.width / Math.max(this.canvas.height, 1));
    this.u2f(prog, "point", item.x, item.y);
    this.u1f(
      prog,
      "radius",
      this.correctRadius((this.cfg.splatRadius * (item.radius ?? 1)) / 100)
    );

    // Splat velocity
    this.u1i(prog, "uTarget", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u3f(prog, "color", item.vx, item.vy, 0);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // Splat dye color
    this.u1i(prog, "uTarget", this.attachTex(dye.read, 0));
    this.u3f(prog, "color", item.color.r, item.color.g, item.color.b);
    this.blit(dye.write);
    dye.swap();

    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, null);
  }

  private step(dt: number) {
    if (!this.prog || !this.velocity || !this.pressure || !this.dye || !this.divergence || !this.curlFbo) {
      return;
    }
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = this.prog;
    const vel = this.velocity;
    const press = this.pressure;
    const dye = this.dye;
    const div = this.divergence;
    const curl = this.curlFbo;

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);

    // 1. Curl
    this.bindProg(prog.curl);
    this.u2f(prog.curl, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.curl, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.blit(curl);

    // 2. Vorticity confinement
    this.bindProg(prog.vorticity);
    this.u2f(prog.vorticity, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.vorticity, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.vorticity, "uCurl", this.attachTex(curl, 1));
    this.u1f(prog.vorticity, "curl", this.cfg.curl);
    this.u1f(prog.vorticity, "dt", dt);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 3. Divergence
    this.bindProg(prog.divergence);
    this.u2f(prog.divergence, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.divergence, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.blit(div);

    // 4. Clear pressure
    this.bindProg(prog.clear);
    this.u1i(prog.clear, "uTexture", this.attachTex(press.read, 0));
    this.u1f(prog.clear, "value", this.cfg.pressure);
    this.blit(press.write);
    press.swap();

    // 5. Pressure Poisson solve (Jacobi iterations)
    this.bindProg(prog.pressure);
    this.u2f(prog.pressure, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.pressure, "uDivergence", this.attachTex(div, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < this.cfg.pressureIterations; i += 1) {
      this.u1i(prog.pressure, "uPressure", this.attachTex(press.read, 1));
      this.blit(press.write);
      press.swap();
    }

    // 6. Subtract gradient
    this.bindProg(prog.gradient);
    this.u2f(prog.gradient, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.gradient, "uPressure", this.attachTex(press.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.gradient, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 1));
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 7. Advect velocity
    this.bindProg(prog.advection);
    this.u2f(prog.advection, "texelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    if (!this.linear) this.u2f(prog.advection, "dyeTexelSize", vel.texelX, vel.texelY);
    const velTex = this.attachTex(vel.read, 0);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uVelocity", velTex);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uSource", velTex);
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dt", dt);
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dissipation", this.cfg.velocityDissipation);
    this.blit(vel.write);
    vel.swap();

    // 8. Advect dye
    if (!this.linear) this.u2f(prog.advection, "dyeTexelSize", dye.texelX, dye.texelY);
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uVelocity", this.attachTex(vel.read, 0));
    this.u1i(prog.advection, "uSource", this.attachTex(dye.read, 1));
    this.u1f(prog.advection, "dissipation", this.cfg.densityDissipation);
    this.blit(dye.write);
    dye.swap();
  }

  private render() {
    if (!this.prog || !this.dye) return;
    const gl = this.gl;
    const prog = this.prog.display;
    const dye = this.dye;

    this.clearScreen();
    gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);

    this.bindProg(prog);
    this.u2f(prog, "texelSize", 1 / gl.drawingBufferWidth, 1 / gl.drawingBufferHeight);
    this.u1i(prog, "uTexture", this.attachTex(dye.read, 0));
    this.blit(null);
  }

  private clearAll() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    const targets: (FBO | null)[] = [
      this.divergence,
      this.curlFbo,
      this.dye ? this.dye.read : null,
      this.dye ? this.dye.write : null,
      this.velocity ? this.velocity.read : null,
      this.velocity ? this.velocity.write : null,
      this.pressure ? this.pressure.read : null,
      this.pressure ? this.pressure.write : null,
    ];

    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    for (const t of targets) {
      if (t) {
        gl.viewport(0, 0, t.width, t.height);
        gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, t.raw);
        gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
      }
    }
    this.clearScreen();
  }

  private clearScreen() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.viewport(0, 0, gl.drawingBufferWidth, gl.drawingBufferHeight);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
  }

  private bindProg(p: ProgramInfo) {
    this.gl.useProgram(p.raw);
  }

  private attachTex(fbo: FBO, slot: number): number {
    const gl = this.gl;
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0 + slot);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, fbo.texture);
    return slot;
  }

  private blit(target: FBO | null) {
    const gl = this.gl;
    if (target) {
      gl.viewport(0, 0, target.width, target.height);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, target.raw);
    } else {
      gl.viewport(0, 0, gl.drawingBufferWidth, gl.drawingBufferHeight);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    }
    gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, 6, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0);
  }

  private u1i(p: ProgramInfo, name: string, val: number) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform1i(loc, val);
  }

  private u1f(p: ProgramInfo, name: string, val: number) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform1f(loc, val);
  }

  private u2f(p: ProgramInfo, name: string, x: number, y: number) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform2f(loc, x, y);
  }

  private u3f(p: ProgramInfo, name: string, x: number, y: number, z: number) {
    const loc = p.uniforms[name];
    if (loc != null) this.gl.uniform3f(loc, x, y, z);
  }

  private releaseGl() {
    const gl = this.gl;
    this.releaseTargets();
    this.textures.forEach((t) => gl.deleteTexture(t));
    this.fbos.forEach((f) => gl.deleteFramebuffer(f));
    this.programs.forEach((p) => gl.deleteProgram(p));
    this.shaders.forEach((s) => gl.deleteShader(s));
    this.buffers.forEach((b) => gl.deleteBuffer(b));
    this.textures.clear();
    this.fbos.clear();
    this.programs.clear();
    this.shaders.clear();
    this.buffers.clear();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, null);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, null);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, null);
    gl.useProgram(null);
    this.prog = null;
  }
}

let engine: FluidSimulationEngine | null = null;

const engineOptions = () => ({
  simResolution: props.simResolution,
  dyeResolution: props.dyeResolution,
  densityDissipation: props.densityDissipation,
  velocityDissipation: props.velocityDissipation,
  pressure: props.pressure,
  pressureIterations: props.pressureIterations,
  curl: props.curl,
  splatRadius: props.splatRadius,
  splatForce: props.splatForce,
  shading: props.shading,
  colorSpeed: props.colorSpeed,
  colorStep: props.colorStep,
  colorSaturation: props.colorSaturation,
  colorValue: props.colorValue,
  colorIntensity: props.colorIntensity,
  idleMs: props.idleMs,
  maxPixelRatio: props.maxPixelRatio,
});

const onPointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
  if (!engine || !e.isPrimary) return;
  const events = (e as any).getCoalescedEvents?.() ?? [e];
  for (const ev of events) {
    engine.move(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
  }
};

const onPointerDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
  if (!engine || !e.isPrimary) return;
  engine.splat(e.clientX, e.clientY);
};

const onResize = () => {
  engine?.resize();
};

const onVisibility = () => {
  engine?.setVisible(!document.hidden);
};

onMounted(() => {
  const canvas = canvasRef.value;
  if (!canvas || typeof window === "undefined") return;

  // Accessibility: static fallback for reduced-motion users
  // (guard matchMedia — absent in jsdom / old embeds)
  const reduceMotion =
    typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
      ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
      : { matches: false };
  if (reduceMotion.matches) return;

  try {
    engine = new FluidSimulationEngine(canvas, engineOptions());
    engine.setVisible(!document.hidden);
  } catch {
    // Graceful fallback when WebGL / float extensions unavailable
    engine = null;
    return;
  }

  window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { capture: true, passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, { capture: true, passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
  window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, true);
  window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown, true);
  window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
  document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
  engine?.destroy();
  engine = null;
});

// Rebuild the simulation engine when tuning props change
watch(
  () => engineOptions(),
  () => {
    if (!engine || !canvasRef.value) return;
    engine.destroy();
    engine = null;
    try {
      engine = new FluidSimulationEngine(canvasRef.value, engineOptions());
      engine.setVisible(!document.hidden);
    } catch {
      engine = null;
    }
  }
);
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";

export interface PrQueueGroup {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  prs: Array<{ id: string; title: string; repo: string; number: number; author: string }>;
}

export interface PrReviewQueueProps {
  groups?: PrQueueGroup[];
  class?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PrReviewQueueProps>(), {
  groups: () => [
    {
      id: "waiting",
      label: "Waiting for reviewers",
      prs: [{ id: "p1", title: "Add activity feed API", repo: "mini-landing-page", number: 4, author: "Sam Lee" }],
    },
    {
      id: "drafts",
      label: "Drafts",
      prs: [
        { id: "p2", title: "Add user search", repo: "mini-landing-page", number: 7, author: "Sam Lee" },
        { id: "p3", title: "Add frontend for search", repo: "mini-landing-page", number: 6, author: "Sam Lee" },
      ],
    },
  ],
  class: "",
});
defineEmits(["pr-click"]);

const collapsed = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});
const isCollapsed = (id: string) => collapsed.value[id] ?? false;
const toggle = (id: string) => {
  collapsed.value = { ...collapsed.value, [id]: !isCollapsed(id) };
};
const initials = (author: string) =>
