<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

export interface GanttMonth {
  label: string;
  weeks: number;
}

export interface GanttProject {
  id: string;
  emoji: string;
  name: string;
  status: string;
  points: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  tone?: "sky" | "violet" | "emerald" | "amber";
}

export interface ProjectGanttTimelineProps {
  months?: GanttMonth[];
  projects?: GanttProject[];
  todayMonth?: number;
  todayFraction?: number;
  class?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ProjectGanttTimelineProps>(), {
  months: () => [
    { label: "AUG", weeks: 4 },
    { label: "SEP", weeks: 5 },
    { label: "OCT", weeks: 4 },
    { label: "NOV", weeks: 4 },
    { label: "DEC", weeks: 5 },
    { label: "JAN 2026", weeks: 4 },
    { label: "FEB", weeks: 4 },
    { label: "MAR", weeks: 4 },
    { label: "APR", weeks: 4 },
    { label: "MAY", weeks: 5 },
    { label: "JUN", weeks: 4 },
    { label: "JUL", weeks: 4 },
  ],
  projects: () => [
    { id: "p1", emoji: "🎧", name: "AI UX Research Assistant", status: "Planning", points: 34, start: 8, end: 9.5, tone: "violet" },
    { id: "p2", emoji: "📊", name: "User Insight & Behavior Analytics Dashboard", status: "In Progress", points: 68, start: 8.5, end: 12, tone: "sky" },
    { id: "p3", emoji: "🧩", name: "Design System Expansion", status: "In Progress", points: 65, start: 6, end: 11, tone: "sky" },
    { id: "p4", emoji: "🚀", name: "E-commerce Platform Launch", status: "Review", points: 90, start: 4, end: 9, tone: "emerald" },
  ],
  todayMonth: 8,
  todayFraction: 0.25,
  class: "",
});
const emit = defineEmits(["project-click"]);

const TONE_STYLES: Record<string, string> = {
  sky: "bg-sky-200 dark:bg-sky-900/70",
  violet: "bg-violet-200 dark:bg-violet-900/70",
  emerald: "bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-900/70",
  amber: "bg-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-900/70",
};

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<string, string> = {
  "In Progress": "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-950/70 dark:text-sky-300",
  Planning: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-950/70 dark:text-violet-300",
  Review: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300",
  Done: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300",
};

const totalWeeks = computed(() => props.months.reduce((sum, m) => sum + m.weeks, 0));
const offsets = computed(() => {
  const list: number[] = [];
  let acc = 0;
  for (const m of props.months) {
    list.push(acc);
    acc += m.weeks;
  }
  return list;
});
const todayLeft = computed(() => {
  const off = offsets.value[props.todayMonth] ?? 0;
  const weeks = props.months[props.todayMonth]?.weeks ?? 1;
  return ((off + weeks * props.todayFraction) / totalWeeks.value) * 100;
});
const headerCells = computed(() =>
  props.months.map((m, i) => ({ ...m, i, left: (offsets.value[i] / totalWeeks.value) * 100, width: (m.weeks / totalWeeks.value) * 100 }))
);
const barLeft = (project: GanttProject) => ((offsets.value[project.start] ?? 0) / totalWeeks.value) * 100;
const barWidth = (project: GanttProject) => Math.max(((project.end - project.start) / totalWeeks.value) * 100, 2);
const barCls = (project: GanttProject) => TONE_STYLES[project.tone ?? "sky"] ?? TONE_STYLES.sky;
const statusCls = (status: string) => STATUS_STYLES[status] ?? STATUS_STYLES["In Progress"];
</script>

<template>
  <div data-gantt class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white shadow-sm dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900" :class="props.class">
    <!-- month header -->
    <div data-gantt-header class="relative flex border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <div
        v-for="m in headerCells"
        :key="m.i"
        class="shrink-0 border-r border-zinc-100 px-2 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800"
        :style="{ width: m.width + '%' }"
      >
        <p class="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wide text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ m.label }}</p>
        <div class="mt-1 flex gap-1">
          <span v-for="w in m.weeks" :key="w" class="h-1 flex-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span
        data-gantt-today-pill
        class="absolute -top-0.5 z-10 rounded-full bg-red-500 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white"
        :style="{ left: `calc(${todayLeft}% - 24px)` }"
      >
        Today
      </span>
    </div>

    <!-- rows -->
    <div data-gantt-rows class="relative">
      <div data-gantt-today-line class="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 top-0 z-10 w-px bg-red-400/70" :style="{ left: todayLeft + '%' }"></div>
      <button
        v-for="project in props.projects"
        :key="project.id"
        :data-gantt-project="project.id"
        type="button"
        class="relative flex w-full items-center gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-3 text-left transition-colors last:border-b-0 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/40"
        @click="emit('project-click', project)"
      >
        <div data-gantt-label class="w-64 shrink-0">
          <p class="flex items-center gap-2 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
            <span aria-hidden="true">{{ project.emoji }}</span>
            <span class="truncate">{{ project.name }}</span>
          </p>
          <p class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
            <span class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-medium" :class="statusCls(project.status)">{{ project.status }}</span>
            <span class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">· {{ project.points }} pts</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <div data-gantt-bar class="relative h-9 flex-1">
          <div class="absolute top-1/2 h-6 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-lg" :class="barCls(project)" :style="{ left: barLeft(project) + '%', width: barWidth(project) + '%' }"></div>
        </div>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

===== FILE: vue\PromptLibrary.vue =====

<template>
  <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900" :class="$attrs.class">
    <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
        <UiIcon name="sparkles" :size="14" class="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
        <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold">Prompt library</h3>
        <span class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ visible.length }}</span>
      </div>
      <div v-if="searchable" class="relative sm:ml-auto sm:w-56">
        <UiIcon name="search" :size="12" class="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400" />
        <input type="search" v-model="query" placeholder="Search prompts…" aria-label="Search prompts"
          class="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white py-1 pl-6 pr-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-200" />
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 border-b border-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <button v-for="category in categoryOptions" :key="category" type="button" :aria-pressed="activeCategory === category"
        @click="activeCategory = category"
        :class="['rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
          activeCategory === category ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700']">
        {{ category === 'all' ? 'All' : category }}
      </button>
    </div>

    <p v-if="visible.length === 0" class="px-3 py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">No prompts match your filters.</p>
    <ul v-else class="grid gap-2 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
      <li v-for="prompt in visible" :key="prompt.id"
        class="group flex flex-col rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-3 transition-colors hover:border-indigo-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:border-indigo-700">
        <div class="flex items-start gap-1.5">
          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span class="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ prompt.title }}</span>
              <span v-if="prompt.category" class="shrink-0 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 dark:text-indigo-400">{{ prompt.category }}</span>
            </div>
            <p v-if="prompt.description" class="mt-0.5 line-clamp-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ prompt.description }}</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" :aria-label="prompt.favorite ? `Unfavorite ${prompt.title}` : `Favorite ${prompt.title}`"
            :aria-pressed="!!prompt.favorite" @click="$emit('toggle-favorite', prompt)"
            :class="['shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
              prompt.favorite ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-300 hover:text-amber-500 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-amber-400']">
            <UiIcon name="star" :size="13" />
          </button>

            <UiIcon name="arrow-right" :size="10" />
          </button>
        </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface PromptItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  prompt: string;
  category?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  favorite?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    prompts?: PromptItem[];
    categories?: string[];
    searchable?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { prompts: () => [], categories: () => [], searchable: true }
);
defineEmits<{ (e: 'use', prompt: PromptItem): void; (e: 'toggle-favorite', prompt: PromptItem): void }>();

const query = ref('');
const activeCategory = ref('all');

const categoryOptions = computed(() => {
  const seen = new Set<string>(props.categories);
  for (const prompt of props.prompts) if (prompt.category) seen.add(prompt.category);
  return ['all', ...Array.from(seen)];
});

const visible = computed(() => {
  const needle = query.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  return props.prompts.filter((prompt) => {
    const inCategory = activeCategory.value === 'all' || prompt.category === activeCategory.value;
    if (!inCategory) return false;
    if (!needle) return true;
    return [prompt.title, prompt.description, prompt.prompt, ...(prompt.tags || [])]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ')
      .toLowerCase()
      .includes(needle);
  });
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface PromptVariant {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  text: string;
}

interface Props {
  variants?: PromptVariant[];
  variables?: string[];
  title?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  variants: () => [],
  variables: () => [],
  title: 'Prompt variants',
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'apply', variant: PromptVariant): void;
}>();

const varChipClass =
  'inline rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-medium text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300';

const extractVars = (text: string) =>
  (text.match(/\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\}/g) ?? []).map((v) => v.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, ''));

const base = props.variants[0];
const compare = props.variants[1];
const baseVars = base ? extractVars(base.text) : [];
const cmpVars = compare ? extractVars(compare.text) : [];
const addedVars = cmpVars.filter((v) => !baseVars.includes(v));
const removedVars = baseVars.filter((v) => !cmpVars.includes(v));
const changedText = base && compare ? base.text !== compare.text : false;

// Split text into plain / {{var}} segments for chip rendering.
const segments = (text: string) =>
  text.split(/(\{\{\s*[\w.]+\s*\}\})/g).map((part) => ({
    isVar: /^\{\{/.test(part),
    value: part.replace(/^\{\{\s*|\s*\}\}$/g, ''),
    raw: part,
  }));
</script>

<template>
  <div
    v-if="base && compare"
    data-prompt-variant-diff
    class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ props.title }}</span>
      <span class="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        <span data-diff-added class="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+{{ addedVars.length }}</span>
        <span data-diff-removed class="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400">−{{ removedVars.length }}</span>
        <span v-if="changedText" data-diff-text class="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">~text</span>
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="grid gap-0 divide-x divide-zinc-100 sm:grid-cols-2 dark:divide-zinc-800">
      <div
        v-for="(variant, index) in props.variants"
        :key="variant.id"
        :data-variant-panel="variant.id"
        class="flex flex-col p-4"
      >
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pb-2">
          <span
            class="h-2 w-2 rounded-full"
            :class="index === 0 ? 'bg-zinc-400' : 'bg-violet-500'"
            aria-hidden="true"
          ></span>
          <span data-variant-label class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ variant.label }}</span>
          <span
            v-if="index === 0"
            class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400"
          >Base</span>
        </div>
        <p
          data-variant-text
          class="min-h-16 flex-1 whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 dark:text-zinc-200"
        ><template v-for="(seg, i) in segments(variant.text)" :key="i"><span
            v-if="seg.isVar"
            :class="varChipClass"
          >{{ seg.value }}</span><template v-else>{{ seg.raw }}</template></template></p>
        <button
          type="button"
          data-variant-apply
          class="mt-3 w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          @click="emit('apply', variant)"
        >Use this version</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div
      v-if="addedVars.length > 0 || removedVars.length > 0"
      data-variant-varlist
      class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800"
    >
      <span
        v-for="v in addedVars"
        :key="`add-${v}`"
        data-var-added
        class="inline rounded bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300"
      >+ {{ v }}</span>
      <span
        v-for="v in removedVars"
        :key="`rm-${v}`"
        data-var-removed
        class="inline rounded bg-red-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300"
      >− {{ v }}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>


===== FILE: vue\QaTestTable.vue =====

<script setup lang="ts">
export type QaRating = 'good' | 'acceptable' | 'poor';

export interface QaTestRow {
  id: string;
  question: string;
  answered?: boolean;
  rating?: QaRating;
}

interface Props {
  rows?: QaTestRow[];
  title?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  rows: () => [],
  title: 'QA tests',
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'row-check', row: QaTestRow, checked: boolean): void;
  (e: 'row-select', row: QaTestRow): void;
}>();

import { ref } from 'vue';

const checked = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});

const toggle = (row: QaTestRow) => {
  const next = !checked.value[row.id];
  checked.value = { ...checked.value, [row.id]: next };
  emit('row-check', row, next);
};

const answeredCount = props.rows.filter((r) => r.answered !== false).length;

const ratingChip: Record<string, string> = {
  good: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300',
  acceptable: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300',
  poor: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300',
};

const ratingLabel: Record<string, string> = {
  good: 'Good',
  acceptable: 'Acceptable',
  poor: 'Poor',
};
</script>

<template>
  <div
    data-qa-test-table
    class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ props.title }}</span>
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        {{ props.rows.length }} questions
      </span>
      <span class="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
        {{ answeredCount }} answered
      </span>
    </div>
    <table data-qa-rows class="w-full text-left">
      <thead>
        <tr class="border-b border-zinc-100 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500">
          <th class="w-10 py-2 pl-4 font-medium"></th>
          <th class="py-2 pr-3 font-medium">Question</th>
          <th class="py-2 pr-3 text-center font-medium">Answer status</th>
          <th class="py-2 pr-4 font-medium">Answer rating</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr
          v-for="row in props.rows"
          :key="row.id"
          :data-qa-row="row.id"
          class="cursor-pointer border-b border-zinc-50 text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-800/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          @click="emit('row-select', row)"
        >
          <td class="py-2.5 pl-4">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              data-qa-check
              :aria-label="'Select ' + row.question"
              :checked="!!checked[row.id]"
              @click.stop
              @change="toggle(row)"
              class="h-3.5 w-3.5 cursor-pointer accent-emerald-600"
            />
          </td>
          <td data-qa-question class="max-w-72 truncate py-2.5 pr-3 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">
            {{ row.question }}
          </td>
          <td class="py-2.5 pr-3 text-center">
            <span v-if="row.answered !== false" data-qa-status class="text-emerald-500">✓</span>
            <span v-else data-qa-status class="text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600">—</span>
          </td>
          <td class="py-2.5 pr-4">
            <span
              v-if="row.rating"
              :data-qa-rating="row.rating"
              class="inline rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold"
              :class="ratingChip[row.rating]"
            >
              {{ ratingLabel[row.rating] }}
            </span>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>

<template>
  <section
    data-rank-list
    class="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
    :class="className"
  >
    <header
      v-if="title || valueHeader"
      class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800"
    >
      <h3 v-if="title" class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ title }}</h3>
      <span v-else />
      <span v-if="valueHeader" class="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{{ valueHeader }}</span>
    </header>
    <p v-if="!visible.length" class="px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ emptyText }}</p>
    <ul v-else class="divide-y divide-zinc-50 dark:divide-zinc-800/60">
      <li
        v-for="(item, index) in visible"
        :key="`${item.label}-${index}`"
        :role="onSelect ? 'button' : undefined"
        :tabindex="onSelect ? 0 : undefined"
        :data-rank-index="index"
        class="relative flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-indigo-500"
        :class="onSelect ? 'cursor-pointer' : ''"
        @click="handleSelect(index, item)"
        @keydown.enter.prevent="handleSelect(index, item)"
        @keydown.space.prevent="handleSelect(index, item)"
      >
        <span
          v-if="showRatio"
          aria-hidden="true"
          class="absolute inset-y-1 left-2 rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800"
          :style="{ width: `calc((100% - 1rem) * ${ratioOf(item) / 100})` }"
        />
        <span
          class="relative z-10 flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 truncate font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
          :class="showRatio ? 'px-1.5 py-0.5' : ''"
        >
          <UiIcon v-if="item.icon" :name="item.icon" :size="13" class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
          <span class="truncate">{{ item.label }}</span>
        </span>
        <span class="relative z-10 shrink-0 font-mono text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{{ item.value }}</span>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </section>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface RankListItem {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  ratio?: number;
  icon?: IconName;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items?: RankListItem[];
    title?: string;
    valueHeader?: string;
    showRatio?: boolean;
    maxItems?: number;
    emptyText?: string;
    onSelect?: (index: number, item: RankListItem) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { items: () => [], title: '', valueHeader: 'Value', showRatio: false, emptyText: 'No data yet', className: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', index: number, item: RankListItem): void;
}>();

const visible = computed(() =>
  typeof props.maxItems === 'number' ? props.items.slice(0, props.maxItems) : props.items,
);

const peak = computed(() =>
  Math.max(...visible.value.map((item) => Number(item.ratio ?? item.value) || 0), 1),
);

const ratioOf = (item: RankListItem) =>
  Math.max(4, Math.min(100, ((Number(item.ratio ?? item.value) || 0) / peak.value) * 100));

const handleSelect = (index: number, item: RankListItem) => {
  props.onSelect?.(index, item);
  emit('select', index, item);
};
</script>

          <span v-if="item.path" class="block truncate font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ item.path }}</span>
        </span>
        <span v-if="item.timeLabel" class="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{{ item.timeLabel }}</span>
        <span
          v-if="item.kind"
          :class="`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-px text-[10px] font-medium ${kindTone(item.kindTone)}`"
        >
          {{ item.kind }}
        </span>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface ResourceItem {
  name: string;
  path?: string;
  kind?: string;
  kindTone?: 'zinc' | 'indigo' | 'emerald' | 'amber';
  timeLabel?: string;
  icon?: IconName;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    items: ResourceItem[];
    title?: string;
    emptyText?: string;
    maxItems?: number;
    onSelect?: (item: ResourceItem, index: number) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { emptyText: 'No resources yet', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'select', item: ResourceItem, index: number): void }>();

const visible = computed(() =>
  typeof props.maxItems === 'number' ? props.items.slice(0, props.maxItems) : props.items
);

const kindTone = (tone?: string) => {
  if (tone === 'indigo') return 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300';
  if (tone === 'emerald') return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300';
  if (tone === 'amber') return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300';
  return 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400';
};

const handleSelect = (item: ResourceItem, index: number) => {
  props.onSelect?.(item, index);
  emit('select', item, index);
};

const handleKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent, item: ResourceItem, index: number) => {
  if (props.onSelect && (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ')) {
    event.preventDefault();
    handleSelect(item, index);
  }
};
</script>

===== FILE: vue\SchedulerSlots.vue =====

<template>
  <div :class="className" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-3 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <header class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 pb-2 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <span
        class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 dark:text-indigo-400"
      >
        <UiIcon name="calendar" :size="14" />
      </span>
      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <h3 class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ humanDate(date) }}</h3>
        <p v-if="timezone" class="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">All times in {{ timezone }}</p>
      </div>
      <span
        class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400"
      >
        {{ openCount }} open
      </span>
    </header>

    <p v-if="groups.length === 0" class="py-8 text-center text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
      No slots available for this day.
    </p>

    <div v-else class="mt-2 space-y-3">
      <fieldset v-for="group in groups" :key="group.period.key">
        <legend class="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400">{{ group.period.label }}</legend>
        <div class="mt-1 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
          <button
            v-for="slot in group.slots"
            :key="slot.id"
            type="button"
            :disabled="slot.available === false"
            :aria-pressed="slot.id === selectedId"
            :class="[
              'flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500',
              slot.id === selectedId
                ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600 font-medium text-white'
                : slot.available === false
                  ? 'cursor-not-allowed border-zinc-100 text-zinc-300 line-through dark:border-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-600'
                  : 'border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-300 hover:bg-indigo-50/60 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:border-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-indigo-950/20',
            ]"
            @click="emit('select', slot)"
          >
            <span class="tabular-nums">{{ amPm(slot.time) }}</span>
            <UiIcon v-if="slot.id === selectedId" name="check" :size="11" />
            <UiIcon v-else-if="slot.available === false" name="lock" :size="11" />
          </button>
        </div>
        <p v-if="group.slots.some((slot) => slot.note)" class="mt-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
          {{ group.slots.filter((slot) => slot.note).map((slot) => slot.note).join(' · ') }}
        </p>
      </fieldset>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface SchedulerSlot {
  id: string;
  time: string;
  available?: boolean;
  note?: string;
}

const PERIODS = [
  { key: 'morning', label: 'Morning', range: [6, 12] },
  { key: 'afternoon', label: 'Afternoon', range: [12, 17] },
  { key: 'evening', label: 'Evening', range: [17, 24] },
] as const;

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    date: string;
    slots?: SchedulerSlot[];
    selectedId?: string;
    timezone?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { slots: () => [], selectedId: '', timezone: '', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'select', slot: SchedulerSlot): void }>();

const humanDate = (iso: string) => {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split('-').map(Number);
  if (!year || !month || !day) return iso;
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
};

const hourOf = (time: string) => {
  const [hour] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return Number.isFinite(hour) ? hour : -1;
};

const amPm = (time: string) => {
  const [hour, minute] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  if (!Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return time;
  const suffix = hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const display = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12;
  return `${display}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')} ${suffix}`;
};

const groups = computed(() =>
  PERIODS.map((period) => ({
    period,
    slots: props.slots.filter((slot) => {
      const hour = hourOf(slot.time);
      return hour >= period.range[0] && hour < period.range[1];
    }),
  })).filter((group) => group.slots.length > 0)
);

const openCount = computed(() => props.slots.filter((slot) => slot.available !== false).length);
</script>


===== FILE: vue\SearchInput.vue =====

<template>
  <div
    :class="['flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2.5 py-2 text-xs transition-colors focus-within:border-indigo-500 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-indigo-500/20 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:border-zinc-600', $attrs.class]">
    <UiIcon name="search" :size="13" class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400" />
    <input ref="inputRef" type="text" role="searchbox" :aria-label="placeholder" :value="current"
      :placeholder="placeholder" @input="update(($event.target as HTMLInputElement).value)"
      @keydown="onKeyDown"
      class="w-full bg-transparent text-zinc-800 outline-none placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-100" />
    <UiIcon v-if="loading" name="loader" :size="13" class="shrink-0 animate-spin text-zinc-400" />
    <button v-else-if="current" type="button" aria-label="Clear search"
      @click="update(''); emit('clear'); inputRef?.focus()"
      class="shrink-0 rounded p-0.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
      <UiIcon name="x" :size="12" />
    </button>
    <kbd v-else-if="shortcut"
      class="shrink-0 rounded border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[9.5px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800">
      {{ shortcut }}
    </kbd>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    shortcut?: string;
    loading?: boolean;
    autoFocus?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { defaultValue: '', placeholder: 'Search…', loading: false, autoFocus: false }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', value: string): void;
  (e: 'search', value: string): void;
  (e: 'clear'): void;
}>();

const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
const inner = ref(props.defaultValue);
const controlled = computed(() => props.value !== undefined);
const current = computed(() => (controlled.value ? (props.value as string) : inner.value));

const update = (next: string) => {
  if (!controlled.value) inner.value = next;
  emit('change', next);
};

const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (event.key === 'Enter') emit('search', current.value);
  if (event.key === 'Escape' && current.value) {
    update('');
    emit('clear');
  }
};

onMounted(() => {
  if (props.autoFocus) inputRef.value?.focus();
});
</script>

      <li v-for="(suggestion, index) in suggestions" :key="index">
        <button
          type="button"
          :data-typeahead-suggestion="index"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-sm text-zinc-700 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"

        >

            <path d="m21 21-4-4" />
          </svg>
          <span class="min-w-0 truncate" v-html="markMatches(suggestion.label)" />
          <span v-if="suggestion.type" class="ml-auto shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {{ suggestion.type }}
          </span>
        </button>
      </li>
    </ul>

    <div v-if="results.length" class="mt-5" data-typeahead-results>
      <p class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ resultsHeading }}</p>
      <ul class="mt-2 divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800">
        <li v-for="(result, index) in results" :key="index" class="flex items-center gap-3 py-2.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            :data-typeahead-result="index"
            class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-left text-sm font-medium text-zinc-800 transition-colors hover:text-indigo-600 focus-visible:outline-none dark:text-zinc-100 dark:hover:text-indigo-400"
            @click="emit('select', result.title)"
            v-html="markMatches(result.title)"
          />
          <span v-if="result.badge" class="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-zinc-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {{ result.badge }}
          </span>

      <span>{{ footerHint }}</span>
      <a href="#" class="font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:underline dark:text-indigo-400" data-typeahead-help>Help Center</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface TypeaheadSuggestion {
  label: string;
  type?: string;
  meta?: string;
  icon?: string;
}

export interface TypeaheadResult {
  title: string;
  badge?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    query?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    suggestions?: TypeaheadSuggestion[];
    results?: TypeaheadResult[];
    resultsHeading?: string;
    footerHint?: string;
    highlight?: string;
  }>(),
  { query: '', placeholder: 'Search…', suggestions: () => [], results: () => [], resultsHeading: 'Top results', footerHint: '', highlight: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', label: string): void;
  (e: 'submit', query: string): void;
}>();

const escapeRegExp = (value: string) => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

const markMatches = (label: string) => {
  if (!props.highlight.trim()) return label;
  const escaped = label
    .split(new RegExp(`(${escapeRegExp(props.highlight.trim())})`, 'ig'))
    .map((part) =>
      part.toLowerCase() === props.highlight.trim().toLowerCase()
        ? `<mark class="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 text-zinc-900 dark:bg-yellow-400/70">${part}</mark>`
        : part,
    )
    .join('');
  return escaped;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

export interface SeatRow {
  id: string;
  user: string;
  email?: string;
  seat?: string;
  cost?: number;
  usage?: string;
  status?: "active" | "invited" | "suspended";
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  rows?: SeatRow[];
  period?: string;
  currency?: string;
  searchable?: boolean;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Usage by User",
  description: "Per-seat costs and credit consumption for the current billing period.",
  rows: () => [],
  period: "Monthly",
  currency: "$",
  searchable: true,
});

const query = ref("");
const q = computed(() => query.value.trim().toLowerCase());
const filtered = computed(() => {
  if (!q.value) return props.rows;
  return props.rows.filter(
    (r) => r.user.toLowerCase().includes(q.value) || (r.email ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q.value)
  );
});

const billedSeats = computed(() => props.rows.filter((r) => r.status !== "suspended"));
const totalCost = computed(() => billedSeats.value.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.cost ?? 0), 0));

const statusBadge = (status: NonNullable<SeatRow["status"]>) =>
  status === "active"
    ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
    : status === "invited"
      ? "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-500/10 dark:text-sky-400"
      : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400";
const statusLabel = (status: NonNullable<SeatRow["status"]>) =>
  status === "active" ? "Active" : status === "invited" ? "Invited" : "Suspended";

const fmtCost = (cost: number) => `${props.currency}${cost.toFixed(2)}`;
</script>

<template>

===== FILE: vue\SegmentBreakdownBars.vue =====

<template>
  <div
    data-segment-breakdown
    role="table"
    class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
    :class="className"
  >
    <p class="border-l-2 border-zinc-900 pl-2 text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-50">
      {{ headline }}<span class="ml-1 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400">{{ headlineUnit }}</span>
    </p>
    <p v-if="caption" class="mt-1 pl-3 text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ caption }}</p>
    <div class="mt-4 space-y-3">
      <div
        v-for="(item, index) in items"
        :key="`${item.label}-${index}`"
        role="row"
        :data-segment-index="index"
        class="flex items-center gap-3"
      >
        <span class="w-28 shrink-0 truncate text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{{ item.label }}</span>
        <span class="relative h-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800">
          <span
            data-segment-bar
            class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
            :class="toneBar[item.tone ?? 'indigo']"
            :style="{ width: `${widthOf(item)}%` }"
          />
        </span>
        <span class="w-14 shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
          {{ shareOf(item) }}{{ item.unit ?? unit ?? '' }}
        </span>
        <span
          v-if="item.delta !== undefined"
          class="w-16 shrink-0 text-right text-xs font-medium tabular-nums"
          :class="item.delta > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600' : item.delta < 0 ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-zinc-400'"
        >
          {{ item.delta > 0 ? '+' : '' }}{{ item.delta }}{{ item.deltaUnit ?? 'pp' }}
        </span>
        <span v-else class="w-16 shrink-0" />
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="mt-4 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-800">
      Share of {{ total }}{{ unit ?? '' }} across {{ items.length }} segments
    </p>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

export interface SegmentBreakdownItem {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  unit?: string;
  delta?: number;
  deltaUnit?: string;
  tone?: 'indigo' | 'emerald' | 'amber' | 'sky' | 'rose';
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    headline?: string | number;
    headlineUnit?: string;
    caption?: string;
    items?: SegmentBreakdownItem[];
    unit?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { headline: 0, headlineUnit: '%', caption: '', items: () => [], unit: '', className: '' },
);

const toneBar: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-500',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  sky: 'bg-sky-500',
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
};

const max = computed(() =>
  Math.max(...props.items.map((item) => Math.max(0, item.value)), 0.0001),
);
const total = computed(() => Math.round(props.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Math.max(0, item.value), 0) * 100) / 100);

const widthOf = (item: SegmentBreakdownItem) =>
  Math.min(100, Math.round((Math.max(0, item.value) / max.value) * 100));
const shareOf = (item: SegmentBreakdownItem) => Math.max(0, item.value);
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface DevService {
  name: string;
  command: string;
  status: 'running' | 'stopped' | 'failed' | 'starting';
  url?: string;
}

export interface DevCheck {
  label: string;
  passed: boolean;
  detail?: string;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    services: DevService[];
    checks?: DevCheck[];
    durationLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { checks: () => [], durationLabel: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'service-click', service: DevService): void;
}>();

const TONE: Record<string, { text: string; tone: string }> = {
  running: { text: 'Running on', tone: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  starting: { text: 'Starting…', tone: 'text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400' },
  stopped: { text: 'Stopped', tone: 'text-zinc-500' },
  failed: { text: 'Failed', tone: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' },
};

const toneLabel = (status: string) => TONE[status]?.text || 'Stopped';
const toneText = (status: string) => TONE[status]?.tone || TONE.stopped.tone;

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

type IconName = 'user' | 'users' | 'credit-card' | 'bell' | 'settings' | 'zap' | 'lock' | 'sliders' | 'globe';

export interface SettingsItem { id: string; label: string; description?: string; value?: string; actionText?: string }
export interface SettingsSection { id: string; title: string; icon?: IconName; description?: string; items: SettingsItem[] }

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  sections: SettingsSection[];
  activeId?: string;
  saving?: boolean;
  saveText?: string;
  showSave?: boolean;
}>(), { saving: false, saveText: 'Save changes', showSave: true });

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'section-change', id: string): void;
  (e: 'item-action', sectionId: string, item: SettingsItem): void;
  (e: 'save', id: string): void;
}>();

const currentId = ref(props.activeId || props.sections[0]?.id || '');
const currentSection = computed(() => props.sections.find((item) => item.id === currentId.value) || props.sections[0]);

const select = (id: string) => {
  currentId.value = id;
  emit('section-change', id);
};
</script>

          @click="emit('tab-change', tab.id)"
        >
          {{ tab.label }}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4" data-drawer-body>
        <section v-for="(section, sectionIndex) in sections" :key="sectionIndex" :class="sectionIndex > 0 ? 'mt-5 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-4 dark:border-zinc-800' : ''">
          <h3 v-if="section.title" class="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ section.title }}</h3>
          <ul :class="section.title ? 'mt-2 space-y-3' : 'space-y-3'">
            <li v-for="(row, rowIndex) in section.rows" :key="rowIndex" class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4" :data-settings-row="row.label">
              <span class="min-w-0">
                <span class="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ row.label }}</span>
                <span v-if="row.description" class="mt-0.5 block text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ row.description }}</span>
              </span>

                type="button"

                @click="emit('row-toggle', row.label, !row.enabled)"
              >
                <span :class="['h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform', row.enabled ? 'translate-x-4' : '']" />
              </button>
              <select v-else-if="row.control === 'select'" data-row-select :value="row.value" class="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">

              </select>

                @click="emit('row-action', row.label)"
              >
                {{ row.buttonLabel || 'Open' }}
              </button>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </section>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface SettingsRow {
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  control?: 'toggle' | 'select' | 'button' | 'none';
  value?: string;
  options?: string[];
  buttonLabel?: string;
  buttonTone?: 'indigo' | 'danger' | 'outline';
  enabled?: boolean;
}

export interface SettingsSection {
  title?: string;
  rows: SettingsRow[];
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** Render the fixed overlay; closed by default (inset-0 would blanket the page). */
    isOpen?: boolean;
    title?: string;
    side?: 'right' | 'left';
    tabs?: { id: string; label: string }[];
    activeTab?: string;
    sections?: SettingsSection[];
    footerPrimary?: string;
    footerSecondary?: string;
  }>(),
  { isOpen: false, title: 'Settings', side: 'right', tabs: () => [], activeTab: '', sections: () => [], footerPrimary: '', footerSecondary: '' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'close'): void;
  (e: 'tab-change', id: string): void;
  (e: 'row-toggle', label: string, enabled: boolean): void;
  (e: 'row-action', label: string): void;
  (e: 'footer-primary'): void;
}>();

const BUTTON_TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  indigo: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500',
  danger: 'border border-rose-300 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:border-rose-500/50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40',
  outline: 'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800',
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-shortcut-sheet class="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
      <p class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ title }}</p>
      <input
        v-if="searchable"
        data-shortcut-search
        type="text"
        :value="query"
        placeholder="Search…"
        class="w-32 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200"
        @input="query = ($event.target as HTMLInputElement).value"
      />
    </div>
    <div :class="['mt-2 grid gap-x-6', columns === 2 ? 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2' : 'grid-cols-1']">
      <div v-for="[section, entries] in sections" :key="section || 'default'" :data-shortcut-section="section || undefined" :class="columns === 2 ? 'sm:col-span-1' : ''">
        <p v-if="section" class="mt-2 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ section }}</p>
        <ul class="mt-1 space-y-0.5">
          <li
            v-for="entry in entries"
            :key="entry.id"
            :data-shortcut-row="entry.id"
            class="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            <span v-if="entry.icon" class="shrink-0 text-zinc-400 [&>svg]:h-4 [&>svg]:w-4" v-html="entry.icon" />
            <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
              {{ entry.label }}<code v-if="entry.hint" class="ml-1 rounded bg-indigo-50 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300">{{ entry.hint }}</code>
            </span>
            <span class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
              <kbd
                v-for="(key, i) in entry.keys"
                :key="`${entry.id}-${i}`"
                class="inline-flex min-w-[24px] items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-zinc-300 bg-zinc-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 shadow-[0_1px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300"
              >{{ key }}</kbd>
            </span>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p v-if="!sections.length" data-shortcut-empty class="py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">No shortcuts match “{{ query }}”.</p>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';

export interface ShortcutEntry {
  id: string;
  icon?: string;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  keys: string[];
  section?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    shortcuts: ShortcutEntry[];
    columns?: 1 | 2;
    title?: string;
    searchable?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { columns: 2, title: 'Shortcuts', searchable: false },
);

const query = ref('');

const sections = computed(() => {
  const needle = query.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filtered = needle
    ? props.shortcuts.filter((entry) => `${entry.label} ${entry.hint || ''} ${entry.keys.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
    : props.shortcuts;
  const map = new Map<string, ShortcutEntry[]>();
  for (const entry of filtered) {
    const key = entry.section || '';
    if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);
    map.get(key)!.push(entry);
  }
  return Array.from(map.entries());
});
</script>

            class="w-full border-none bg-transparent text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-none"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
        <div v-if="filtered.length === 0" class="py-8 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">
          No shortcuts match “{{ query }}”
        </div>
        <div v-else class="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <section v-for="group in filtered" :key="group.id">
            <h3 class="mb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400">{{ group.label }}</h3>
            <ul class="space-y-1.5">
              <li v-for="(item, idx) in group.items" :key="`${group.id}-${idx}`" class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{{ item.label }}</span>
                <span class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5">
                  <kbd
                    v-for="(key, keyIdx) in item.keys"
                    :key="`${key}-${keyIdx}`"
                    class="inline-flex min-w-[1.4rem] items-center justify-center rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300"
                  >
                    {{ key }}
                  </kbd>
                </span>
              </li>
            </ul>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/30 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1">
          <kbd class="inline-flex min-w-[1.4rem] items-center justify-center rounded border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">esc</kbd>
          <span>Close</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ShortcutItem {
  keys: string[];
  label: string;
  group?: string;
}

export interface ShortcutGroup {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  items: ShortcutItem[];
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    groups?: ShortcutGroup[];
    shortcuts?: ShortcutItem[];
    title?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    groups: () => [],
    shortcuts: () => [],
    title: "Keyboard shortcuts",
    placeholder: "Search shortcuts...",
    className: "",
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: "close"): void }>();

const query = ref("");
const inputRef = ref<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

// Flat list → buckets by item.group (or "General").
const normalized = computed<ShortcutGroup[]>(() => {
  if (props.groups.length > 0) return props.groups;
  const buckets: ShortcutGroup[] = [];
  props.shortcuts.forEach((item) => {
    const label = item.group || "General";
    const bucket = buckets.find((g) => g.label === label);
    if (bucket) bucket.items.push(item);
    else buckets.push({ id: label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-"), label, items: [item] });
  });
  return buckets;
});

const filtered = computed<ShortcutGroup[]>(() => {
  const q = query.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return normalized.value;
  return normalized.value
    .map((group) => ({
      ...group,
      items: group.items.filter(
        (item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || item.keys.join("").toLowerCase().includes(q)
      ),
    }))
    .filter((group) => group.items.length > 0);
});

const total = computed(() => normalized.value.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.items.length, 0));

watch(
  () => props.isOpen,
  async (open) => {
    query.value = "";
    if (open) {
      await nextTick();
      inputRef.value?.focus();
    }
  }
);

function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!props.isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    emit("close");
  }
}

onMounted(() => document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey));
onUnmounted(() => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey));
</script>

===== FILE: vue\SpendTrendChart.vue =====

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

export interface SpendPoint {
  label: string;
  value: number;
}
interface Props {
  headline?: string;
  unit?: string;
  granularities?: string[];
  defaultGranularity?: string;
  points?: Record<string, SpendPoint[]>;
  maxY?: number;
  yTicks?: number;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  headline: "Spend",
  unit: "$",
  granularities: () => ["Daily", "Weekly"],
  defaultGranularity: undefined,
  points: () => ({}),
  maxY: undefined,
  yTicks: 4,
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "granularity-change", granularity: string): void;
}>();

const GRANULARITIES = ["Daily", "Weekly"];

const granularity = ref(
  props.defaultGranularity && GRANULARITIES.includes(props.defaultGranularity)
    ? props.defaultGranularity
    : GRANULARITIES[0],
);

const data = computed(() => props.points[granularity.value] ?? []);
const total = computed(() => data.value.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.value, 0));
const max = computed(() => props.maxY ?? Math.max(...data.value.map((p) => p.value), 1));

const height = 180;
const padLeft = 34;
const padBottom = 26;
const plotW = 100;

const ticks = computed(() => {
  const m = max.value;
  return Array.from({ length: props.yTicks + 1 }, (_, i) => (m / props.yTicks) * (props.yTicks - i));
});

const switchGranularity = (next: string) => {
  if (next === granularity.value) return;
  granularity.value = next;
  emit("granularity-change", next);
};

const barGeometry = computed(() => {
  const n = data.value.length;
  if (n === 0) return [];
  const slot = plotW / n;
  const every = Math.ceil(n / 8);
  return data.value.map((p, i) => {
    const bw = Math.min(slot * 0.45, 8);
    const x = padLeft + slot * i + (slot - bw) / 2;
    const h = Math.max((p.value / max.value) * (height - padBottom - 16), p.value > 0 ? 3 : 0);
    const y = height - padBottom - h;
    const showLabel = n <= 14 || i % every === 0;
    return { p, x, y, bw, h, showLabel, midX: x + bw / 2, label: p.label.slice(5) };
  });
});
</script>

<template>
  <div
    data-spend-trend-chart
    class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
  >
    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
      <p data-spend-trend-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ props.headline }}</p>
      <div
        data-spend-trend-granularity
        role="tablist"
        aria-label="Granularity"
        class="flex items-center rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 p-0.5 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800"
      >
        <button
          v-for="g in GRANULARITIES"
          :key="g"
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          :aria-selected="g === granularity"
          :data-spend-trend-granularity-option="g"
          class="rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors"
          :class="
            g === granularity
              ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
              : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200'
          "
          @click="switchGranularity(g)"
        >
          {{ g }}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p data-spend-trend-total class="mt-1 font-mono text-2xl font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">
      {{ props.unit }}{{ total.toFixed(2) }}
      <span class="ml-1.5 font-sans text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ granularity }}</span>
    </p>

    <div class="mt-3" style="position: relative">
      <svg
        data-spend-trend-svg
        width="100%"
        :height="height"
        :viewBox="`0 0 ${padLeft + plotW} ${height}`"
        preserveAspectRatio="none"
        role="img"
        :aria-label="props.headline + ' ' + granularity + ' bar chart'"
      >
        <g v-for="(t, i) in ticks" :key="'tick-' + i">
          <line
            :x1="padLeft"
            :x2="padLeft + plotW"
            :y1="8 + ((height - padBottom - 16) * i) / props.yTicks"
            :y2="8 + ((height - padBottom - 16) * i) / props.yTicks"
            stroke="#3f3f46"
            stroke-opacity="0.35"
            stroke-dasharray="3 4"
          />
          <text :x="padLeft - 6" :y="8 + ((height - padBottom - 16) * i) / props.yTicks + 3" text-anchor="end" font-size="8" fill="#a1a1aa">
            {{ Math.round(t) }}
          </text>
        </g>

        <g v-for="(b, i) in barGeometry" :key="b.p.label + i">
          <rect
            :data-spend-trend-bar="b.p.label"
            :x="b.x"
            :y="b.y"
            :width="b.bw"
            :height="b.h"
            rx="2"
            fill="#14b8a6"
            :opacity="b.p.value > 0 ? 0.9 : 0.25"
          />
          <text
            v-if="b.showLabel"
            :x="b.midX"
            :y="height - padBottom + 11"
            text-anchor="middle"
            font-size="7"
            fill="#a1a1aa"
          >
            {{ b.label }}
          </text>
        </g>

        <text v-if="data.length === 0" :x="padLeft + plotW / 2" :y="height / 2" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#a1a1aa">
          No spend recorded
        </text>
      </svg>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>


===== FILE: vue\SpotlightGlareCard.vue =====

<template>
  <div
    ref="cardRef"
    @pointermove="handlePointerMove"
    @pointerleave="handlePointerLeave"
    :style="cardStyle"
    :class="[
      'group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#faf8f1] dark:bg-[#1a1d24] border border-[#d6d2c2]/80 dark:border-[#2b3038]/80 text-[#22262d] dark:text-[#e9e6db] shadow-[0_1px_0_rgba(34,38,45,0.07),0_5px_16px_rgba(34,38,45,0.07)] dark:shadow-[0_1px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.4),0_8px_22px_rgba(0,0,0,0.42)] transition-shadow duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_2px_0_rgba(34,38,45,0.08),0_12px_28px_rgba(34,38,45,0.12)] select-none',
      className
    ]"
  >
    <!-- Specular glare reflection layer -->
    <div
      aria-hidden="true"
      class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-10 transition-opacity duration-300"
      :style="glareStyle"
    />

    <!-- Content slot -->
    <div class="relative z-0 h-full w-full">
      <slot />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

interface Props {
  glareOpacity?: number;
  glareRadius?: number;
  enableTilt?: boolean;
  maxTilt?: number;
  className?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  glareOpacity: 0.45,
  glareRadius: 55,
  enableTilt: false,
  maxTilt: 5,
  className: "",
});

// Sanitize numeric props: TS types are compile-time only, so a plain-JS
// caller could pass arbitrary strings that would land inside CSS values.
function numOr(v: unknown, fallback: number, min = -Infinity, max = Infinity): number {
  const n = typeof v === "number" ? v : Number.parseFloat(String(v));
  if (Number.isNaN(n)) return fallback;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n));
}

const cardRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
const gx = ref("50%");
const gy = ref("50%");
const rx = ref(0);
const ry = ref(0);
const isHovered = ref(false);

const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
  const card = cardRef.value;
  if (!card) return;
  const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
  const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

  gx.value = `${((x / rect.width) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
  gy.value = `${((y / rect.height) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;

  if (props.enableTilt) {
    const maxTilt = numOr(props.maxTilt, 5, 0, 90);
    const centerX = rect.width / 2;
    const centerY = rect.height / 2;
    ry.value = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * maxTilt;
    rx.value = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * maxTilt;
  }
  isHovered.value = true;
};

const handlePointerLeave = () => {
  rx.value = 0;
  ry.value = 0;
  isHovered.value = false;
};

const cardStyle = computed(() => {
  if (props.enableTilt && isHovered.value) {
    return {
      transform: `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rx.value}deg) rotateY(${ry.value}deg) translateY(-2px)`,
      transition: "transform 0.1s ease-out",
    };
  }
  return {
    transition: "transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)",
  };
});

const glareStyle = computed(() => ({
  opacity: isHovered.value ? numOr(props.glareOpacity, 0.45, 0, 1) : 0,
  background: `radial-gradient(circle at ${gx.value} ${gy.value}, rgba(255,255,255,0.85) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 30%, transparent ${numOr(props.glareRadius, 55, 0, 100)}%)`,
  mixBlendMode: "overlay" as const,
}));
</script>

<template>
  <div class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4" :class="$attrs.class">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
      <span class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ label }}</span>
      <span v-if="icon" class="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500"><UiIcon :name="icon" :size="16" /></span>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
      <div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ value }}</div>
        <div v-if="typeof delta === 'number'" class="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
          <UiIcon :name="positive ? 'trending-up' : 'trending-down'" :size="13" :class="positive ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-500'" />
          <span :class="['text-[11px] font-medium', positive ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-500']">
            {{ positive ? '+' : '' }}{{ delta }}%
          </span>
          <span v-if="deltaLabel" class="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ deltaLabel }}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <svg v-if="trendPoints" viewBox="0 0 96 28" class="h-7 w-24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
        <polyline :points="trendPoints" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
          :class="positive ? 'stroke-emerald-500' : 'stroke-red-500'" />
      </svg>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

type IconName = 'trending-up' | 'trending-down' | 'zap' | 'cpu' | 'clock' | 'users' | 'credit-card' | 'sparkles' | 'check-circle';

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  delta?: number;
  deltaLabel?: string;
  trend?: number[];
  icon?: IconName;
}>(), { trend: undefined, icon: undefined });

const positive = computed(() => (props.delta ?? 0) >= 0);

const trendPoints = computed(() => {
  const data = props.trend;
  if (!data || data.length < 2) return '';
  const width = 96;
  const height = 28;
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  return data
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = (index / (data.length - 1)) * width;
      const y = height - ((value - min) / span) * (height - 4) - 2;
      return `${x.toFixed(2)},${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(' ');
});
</script>

===== FILE: vue\StepSlider.vue =====

<template>
  <div class="w-full">
    <p v-if="label" class="mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ label }}</p>
    <div role="slider" :tabindex="disabled ? -1 : 0" :aria-label="label || 'Step slider'"
      :aria-valuemin="0" :aria-valuemax="lastIndex" :aria-valuenow="value" :aria-valuetext="steps[value]"
      :aria-disabled="disabled || undefined"
      @keydown="onKeydown" class="group relative flex cursor-pointer items-center pb-1 focus-visible:outline-none">
      <span aria-hidden="true"
        class="absolute left-0 right-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"></span>
      <span aria-hidden="true"
        class="absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 transition-[width] duration-150"
        :style="{ width: `${ratio * 100}%` }"></span>
      <button v-for="(step, index) in steps" :key="step + index" type="button" :disabled="disabled"
        :aria-label="step" :aria-pressed="index === value"
        @click.stop="emit('change', index, step)"
        class="relative z-10 flex flex-1 flex-col items-center focus-visible:outline-none">
        <span :class="`h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 transition-colors ${
          index <= value
            ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-600'
            : index >= highlightIndex
              ? 'border-indigo-300 bg-white dark:border-indigo-700 dark:bg-zinc-900'
              : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-900'
        } ${disabled ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`"></span>
        <span :class="`mt-1.5 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[10px] ${
          index === value ? 'font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' : 'text-zinc-400'
        }`">
          {{ step }}
        </span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    steps: string[];
    value?: number;
    highlightFrom?: number;
    label?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { value: 0, disabled: false }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', index: number, step: string): void;
}>();

const lastIndex = computed(() => props.steps.length - 1);
const ratio = computed(() => (props.steps.length > 1 ? props.value / lastIndex.value : 0));
const highlightIndex = computed(() =>
  props.highlightFrom === undefined ? props.steps.length : props.highlightFrom
);

const onKeydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
  if (props.disabled) return;
  if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' && props.value < lastIndex.value) emit('change', props.value + 1, props.steps[props.value + 1]);
  if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' && props.value > 0) emit('change', props.value - 1, props.steps[props.value - 1]);
  if (event.key === 'Home') emit('change', 0, props.steps[0]);
  if (event.key === 'End') emit('change', lastIndex.value, props.steps[lastIndex.value]);
};
</script>

<template>
  <ol :class="['flex items-start', $attrs.class]">
    <li v-for="(step, index) in steps" :key="step.id" :class="['flex min-w-0', index === steps.length - 1 ? 'flex-none' : 'flex-1']">
      <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 text-center">
        <button type="button" :disabled="!clickable(step, index)"
          :aria-current="statusFor(step, index) === 'current' ? 'step' : undefined"
          @click="clickable(step, index) && emit('step-click', step, index)"
          :class="['flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-default', CIRCLE[statusFor(step, index)].cls]">
          <UiIcon v-if="CIRCLE[statusFor(step, index)].icon" :name="CIRCLE[statusFor(step, index)].icon!" :size="12" />
          <template v-else>{{ index + 1 }}</template>
        </button>
        <div class="max-w-28">
          <p :class="['text-[11px] font-medium leading-tight', statusFor(step, index) === 'upcoming' ? 'text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100']">
            {{ step.label }}
          </p>
          <p v-if="step.description" class="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-tight text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ step.description }}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span v-if="index !== steps.length - 1" aria-hidden="true"
        :class="['mt-3.5 h-0.5 flex-1 rounded mr-2 ml-2', statusFor(step, index) === 'complete' ? 'bg-indigo-600' : 'bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800']"></span>
    </li>
  </ol>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export type StepperStatus = 'complete' | 'current' | 'upcoming' | 'error';

export interface StepperStep {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  status?: StepperStatus;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    steps: StepperStep[];
    current?: number;
  }>(),
  { current: 1 }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'step-click', step: StepperStep, index: number): void }>();

const CIRCLE: Record<StepperStatus, { cls: string; icon?: IconName }> = {
  complete: { cls: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white', icon: 'check' },
  current: { cls: 'border-2 border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' },
  upcoming: { cls: 'border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700' },
  error: { cls: 'bg-rose-500 text-white', icon: 'x' },
};

const statusFor = (step: StepperStep, index: number): StepperStatus =>
  step.status ?? (index + 1 < props.current ? 'complete' : index + 1 === props.current ? 'current' : 'upcoming');

const clickable = (step: StepperStep, index: number) => statusFor(step, index) !== 'upcoming';
</script>

  defineProps<{
    content: string;
    isStreaming?: boolean;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    isStreaming: false,
    className: ''
  }
);

const containerRef = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);

const handleContainerClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
  const target = (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.copy-btn');
  if (!target) return;
  const rawCode = target.getAttribute('data-code');
  if (rawCode) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(decodeURIComponent(rawCode));
    target.textContent = 'Copied';
    setTimeout(() => {
      target.textContent = 'Copy';
    }, 2000);
  }
};

const htmlContent = computed(() => {
  const renderer = new marked.Renderer();

  renderer.code = function ({ text, lang }: { text: string; lang?: string }) {
    const language = lang && Prism.languages[lang] ? lang : 'javascript';
    let highlighted = text;
    try {
      if (Prism.languages[language]) {
        highlighted = Prism.highlight(text, Prism.languages[language], language);
      }
    } catch {
      highlighted = text;
    }

    return `
      <div class="relative group my-4 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1.5 bg-zinc-900/80 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono">
          <span>${lang || 'code'}</span>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            data-code="${encodeURIComponent(text)}" 
            class="copy-btn hover:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
          >
            Copy
          </button>
        </div>
        <pre class="p-4 overflow-x-auto text-sm text-zinc-100 font-mono leading-normal m-0 bg-transparent"><code>${highlighted}</code></pre>
      </div>
    `;
  };

  return marked.parse(props.content || '', { renderer, breaks: true, gfm: true });
});
</script>

===== FILE: vue\Tabs.vue =====

<template>
  <div role="tablist" :aria-label="ariaLabel"
    :class="[variant === 'pills' ? 'inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 p-1 dark:bg-zinc-800' : 'flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800', $attrs.class]">
    <button v-for="(tab, index) in tabs" :key="tab.id" :ref="(el) => setRef(tab.id, el)" type="button" role="tab"
      :id="`tab-${tab.id}`" :aria-selected="tab.id === current" :aria-controls="`panel-${tab.id}`"
      :tabindex="tab.id === current ? 0 : -1" :disabled="tab.disabled" @click="select(tab)"
      @keydown="move($event, index)"
      :class="['inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        variant === 'pills' ? 'rounded-md px-3 py-1.5' : 'border-b-2 px-3 py-2',
        variant === 'pills'
          ? (tab.id === current ? 'bg-white text-zinc-900 shadow-sm dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100' : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200')
          : (tab.id === current ? '-mb-px border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600 dark:border-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400' : '-mb-px border-transparent text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200')]">
      <UiIcon v-if="tab.icon" :name="tab.icon" :size="13" />
      <span>{{ tab.label }}</span>
      <span v-if="tab.badge !== undefined"
        class="rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-1.5 text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ tab.badge }}</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import UiIcon, { type IconName } from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface TabItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName;
  badge?: string | number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    tabs: TabItem[];
    activeId?: string;
    defaultActiveId?: string;
    variant?: 'underline' | 'pills';
    ariaLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { variant: 'underline', ariaLabel: 'Tabs' }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'change', id: string): void }>();

const internalId = ref(props.defaultActiveId ?? props.tabs[0]?.id ?? '');
const current = computed(() => props.activeId ?? internalId.value);
const refs: Record<string, HTMLButtonElement | null> = {};

const setRef = (id: string, el: unknown) => {
  refs[id] = (el as HTMLButtonElement) ?? null;
};

const select = (tab: TabItem) => {
  if (tab.disabled) return;
  if (props.activeId === undefined) internalId.value = tab.id;
  emit('change', tab.id);
};

const move = (event: KeyboardEvent, index: number) => {
  const keys = ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'];
  if (!keys.includes(event.key)) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  const enabled = props.tabs.map((tab, i) => ({ tab, i })).filter((entry) => !entry.tab.disabled);
  if (enabled.length === 0) return;
  const position = enabled.findIndex((entry) => entry.i === index);
  let next = position;
  if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (position + 1) % enabled.length;
  if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (position - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
  if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
  if (event.key === 'End') next = enabled.length - 1;
  const target = enabled[next];
  if (target) {
    select(target.tab);
    refs[target.tab.id]?.focus();
  }
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';

export interface TargetGaugeZone {
  from: number;
  tone: 'rose' | 'amber' | 'emerald';
}

const props = withDefaults(

      { from: 0, tone: 'rose' },
      { from: 60, tone: 'amber' },
      { from: 85, tone: 'emerald' },
    ],
    remainingLabel: '',
    className: '',
  },
);

const zoneColor: Record<string, string> = {
  rose: 'bg-rose-500',
  amber: 'bg-amber-400',
  emerald: 'bg-emerald-500',
};

const clamp01 = (raw: number) => Math.min(100, Math.max(0, raw));

const percent = computed(() => (props.target > 0 ? (props.value / props.target) * 100 : 0));
const angle = computed(() => (clamp01(percent.value) / 100) * 180 - 90);
const remaining = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.target - props.value));

const segments = computed(() => {
  const sorted = [...props.zones].sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from);
  return sorted.map((zone, index) => {
    const end = index + 1 < sorted.length ? sorted[index + 1].from : 100;
    return { ...zone, width: `${Math.max(0, end - zone.from)}%` };
  });
});

const currentTone = computed<'rose' | 'amber' | 'emerald'>(() => {
  const found = [...segments.value].reverse().find((zone) => clamp01(percent.value) >= zone.from);
  return found?.tone ?? 'rose';
});
</script>

          :class="index <= ratingOf(testimonial) ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-700'" />
      </div>

        <span v-else
          class="flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">
          {{ initials(testimonial.name) }}
        </span>
        <span class="min-w-0">
          <span class="block truncate text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ testimonial.name }}</span>
          <span v-if="testimonial.role || testimonial.company" class="block truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
            {{ [testimonial.role, testimonial.company].filter(Boolean).join(', ') }}
          </span>
        </span>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface Testimonial {
  id: string;
  quote: string;
  name: string;
  role?: string;
  company?: string;
  avatar?: string;
  rating?: number;
}

withDefaults(defineProps<{ testimonials?: Testimonial[]; columns?: 2 | 3 }>(), {
  testimonials: () => [],
  columns: 3,
});
defineEmits<{ (e: 'select', testimonial: Testimonial): void }>();

const ratingOf = (testimonial: Testimonial) => Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.round(testimonial.rating ?? 0)));

const initials = (name: string) =>

    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
