<template>
  <div
    :class="[
      'inline-flex items-center p-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-700/80 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 select-none',
      className
    ]"
    role="group"
    aria-label="Theme toggle"
  >
    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('auto')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'auto'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Follow System/Time"
    >
      <span>💻</span>
      <span>Auto</span>
    </button>

    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('light')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'light'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Light Mode"
    >
      <span>☀️</span>
      <span>Light</span>
    </button>

    <button
      type="button"
      @click="applyTheme('dark')"
      :class="[
        'flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all',
        mode === 'dark'
          ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100'
      ]"
      title="Dark Mode"
    >
      <span>🌙</span>
      <span>Dark</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';

export type ThemeMode = 'auto' | 'light' | 'dark';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    storageKey?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    storageKey: 'mango-theme',
    className: ''
  }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'change', mode: ThemeMode, resolved: 'light' | 'dark'): void;
}>();

const mode = ref<ThemeMode>('auto');

const resolveTheme = (m: ThemeMode): 'light' | 'dark' => {
  if (m === 'light' || m === 'dark') return m;
  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  const isNight =
    (typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
      window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) ||
    hour >= 19 ||
    hour < 7;
  return isNight ? 'dark' : 'light';
};

const applyTheme = (nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
  const resolved = resolveTheme(nextMode);
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = nextMode;
  document.documentElement.dataset.resolvedTheme = resolved;
  document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolved;
  if (resolved === 'dark') {
    document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
  } else {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
  }
  mode.value = nextMode;
  localStorage.setItem(props.storageKey, nextMode);
  emit('change', nextMode, resolved);
};

onMounted(() => {
  const saved = (localStorage.getItem(props.storageKey) as ThemeMode) || 'auto';
  applyTheme(saved);
});
</script>

'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-900' : 'bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700']"

      </div>
      <div v-if="activeDay" data-slot-periods class="mt-3 space-y-4">

          <template v-if="slotsFor(activeDay, period).length">
            <p class="mb-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">{{ PERIOD_LABELS[period] }}</p>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 sm:grid-cols-3">
              <button
                v-for="slot in slotsFor(activeDay, period)"
                :key="slot.id"
                type="button"
                :data-time-slot="slot.id"
                :disabled="slot.disabled"
                :class="['rounded-lg border px-2 py-2 text-left transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40', isSelected(slot) ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-500 dark:bg-indigo-950/60' : 'border-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800']"
                @click="choose(slot)"
              >
                <span :class="['block text-xs font-semibold', isSelected(slot) ? 'text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300' : 'text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100']">{{ slot.label }}</span>
                <span v-if="slot.available != null" :class="['mt-0.5 block text-[10px]', slot.available > 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-zinc-400']">
                  {{ slot.available > 0 ? `${slot.available} available` : 'Fully booked' }}
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </template>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';

export interface TimeSlot {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  period?: 'morning' | 'afternoon' | 'evening';
  available?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface SlotDay {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  weekday: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  slots: TimeSlot[];
}

const PERIODS = ['morning', 'afternoon', 'evening'] as const;
const PERIOD_LABELS: Record<string, string> = { morning: 'Morning', afternoon: 'Afternoon', evening: 'Evening' };

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    days: SlotDay[];
    value?: { dayId: string; slotId: string } | null;
    timezone?: string;
    daysLabel?: string;
    slotsLabel?: string;
  }>(),
  { value: null, daysLabel: 'Date', slotsLabel: 'Select a time' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', value: { dayId: string; slotId: string; slot: TimeSlot }): void;
}>();

const selected = ref(props.value);
const activeDayId = ref(props.value?.dayId || props.days.find((day) => !day.disabled)?.id || props.days[0]?.id || '');

watch(
  () => props.value,
  (value) => {
    if (value) {
      selected.value = value;
      activeDayId.value = value.dayId;
    }
  },
);

const activeDay = computed(() => props.days.find((day) => day.id === activeDayId.value) || props.days[0]);

const slotsFor = (day: SlotDay, period: string) => day.slots.filter((slot) => (slot.period || 'morning') === period);

const isSelected = (slot: TimeSlot) => selected.value?.dayId === activeDayId.value && selected.value?.slotId === slot.id;

const choose = (slot: TimeSlot) => {
  if (slot.disabled) return;
  selected.value = { dayId: activeDayId.value, slotId: slot.id };
  emit('select', { dayId: activeDayId.value, slotId: slot.id, slot });
};
</script>

===== FILE: vue\ToastStack.vue =====

<template>
  <div
    v-if="toasts.length > 0"
    class="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 w-80 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]"
    :class="className"
    aria-live="polite"
  >
    <div
      v-for="toast in toasts"
      :key="toast.id"
      class="relative overflow-hidden flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 shadow-lg text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 animate-in slide-in-from-right fade-in duration-200"
      role="alert"
      @mouseenter="pause(toast.id)"
      @mouseleave="resume(toast.id)"
    >
      <UiIcon :name="typeMeta(toast.type).icon" :size="16" class="shrink-0" :class="typeMeta(toast.type).color" />
      <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">{{ toast.message }}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        class="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 transition-colors shrink-0"
        aria-label="Dismiss"
        @click="emit('dismiss', toast.id)"
      >
        <UiIcon name="x" :size="14" />
      </button>
      <span
        v-if="duration > 0"
        aria-hidden="true"
        class="absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-0.5 transition-[width] duration-100 ease-linear"
        :class="[typeMeta(toast.type).bar, remaining.get(toast.id) !== undefined ? '' : '']"
        :style="{ width: `${remaining.get(toast.id) ?? 100}%` }"
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { reactive, watch, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import UiIcon from "./UiIcon.vue";

export interface ToastItem {
  id: string | number;
  message: string;
  type?: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info";
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    toasts?: ToastItem[];
    duration?: number;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { toasts: () => [], duration: 4000, className: "" }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "dismiss", id: string | number): void;
}>();

const META: Record<string, { icon: string; color: string; bar: string }> = {
  success: { icon: "check-circle", color: "text-emerald-500", bar: "bg-emerald-500" },
  error: { icon: "circle-x", color: "text-rose-500", bar: "bg-rose-500" },
  warning: { icon: "alert-triangle", color: "text-amber-500", bar: "bg-amber-500" },
  info: { icon: "sparkles", color: "text-sky-500", bar: "bg-sky-500" },
};

function typeMeta(type?: string) {
  return META[type || "info"] || META.info;
}

interface ToastClock {
  started: number;
  /** Percent (0-100) remaining when the clock (re)started. */
  startPct: number;
  /** ms budget corresponding to startPct. */
  total: number;
  timer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
  ticker?: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
}

const clocks = new Map<string | number, ToastClock>();
const remaining = reactive(new Map<string | number, number>());

function stopClock(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (clock) {
    if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
    if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
    clocks.delete(id);
  }
}

function startClock(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (!clock || clock.total <= 0 || props.duration <= 0) return;
  const started = Date.now();
  clock.started = started;
  clock.timer = setTimeout(() => {
    remaining.set(id, 0);
    stopClock(id);
    emit("dismiss", id);
  }, clock.total);
  clock.ticker = setInterval(() => {
    const elapsed = Date.now() - started;
    remaining.set(id, Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - elapsed / clock.total)));
  }, 100);
}

function pause(id: string | number) {
  const clock = clocks.get(id);
  if (!clock) return;
  if (clock.timer) clearTimeout(clock.timer);
  if (clock.ticker) clearInterval(clock.ticker);
  const elapsed = Date.now() - clock.started;
  const nextPct = Math.max(0, clock.startPct * (1 - elapsed / clock.total));
  clock.startPct = nextPct;
  clock.total = Math.max(0, clock.total - elapsed);
  remaining.set(id, nextPct);
}

function resume(id: string | number) {
  startClock(id);
}

watch(
  () => props.toasts.map((t) => t.id).join(","),
  () => {
    if (props.duration <= 0) {
      for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) stopClock(id);
      return;
    }
    const alive = new Set(props.toasts.map((t) => t.id));
    for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) {
      if (!alive.has(id)) stopClock(id);
    }
    for (const t of props.toasts) {
      if (!clocks.has(t.id)) {
        clocks.set(t.id, { started: Date.now(), startPct: 100, total: props.duration });
        remaining.set(t.id, 100);
        startClock(t.id);
      }
    }
  },
  { immediate: true }
);

onUnmounted(() => {
  for (const id of [...clocks.keys()]) stopClock(id);
});
</script>

  id: string;
  label: string;
  amountUsd: number;
  color?: string;
}

  id: string;
  label: string;
  tokens: number;
  percent: number;
  barColor?: string;
}

  segments?: TokenCostSegment[];
  usageRows?: TokenUsageRow[];

  spendUsed?: number;
  spendTotal?: number;

}>();

import { ref } from "vue";

export interface ToolParameter {
  name: string;
  type: "string" | "number" | "boolean";
  required?: boolean;
}
export interface ToolSchema {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  method?: string;
  endpoint?: string;
  parameters?: ToolParameter[];
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  tools: ToolSchema[];
}

  title: "Tools & functions",
});

  (e: "validate", tool: ToolSchema): void;
  (e: "toggle", tool: ToolSchema, enabled: boolean): void;
}>();

const disabled = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});
const isEnabled = (id: string) => !disabled.value[id];
const toggle = (tool: ToolSchema) => {
  const next = !isEnabled(tool.id);
  disabled.value = { ...disabled.value, [tool.id]: !next };
  emit("toggle", tool, next);
};

  boolean: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300",
};

<template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

interface Props {
  title?: string;
  billToOptions?: string[];
  defaultBillTo?: string;
  currencies?: string[];
  defaultCurrency?: string;
  balance?: number;
  currencySymbol?: string;
  quickAmounts?: number[];
  minAmount?: number;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Top up balance",
  billToOptions: () => ["Acme Inc."],
  defaultBillTo: undefined,
  currencies: () => ["USD", "EUR", "SGD"],
  defaultCurrency: undefined,
  balance: 0,
  currencySymbol: "$",
  quickAmounts: () => [50, 100, 250, 500],
  minAmount: 10,
  confirmLabel: "Confirm top-up",
  cancelLabel: "Cancel",
  defaultOpen: false,
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "confirm", detail: { billTo: string; currency: string; amount: number }): void;
  (e: "cancel"): void;
}>();

const open = ref(props.defaultOpen);
const billTo = ref(props.defaultBillTo ?? props.billToOptions[0] ?? "");
const currency = ref(props.defaultCurrency ?? props.currencies[0] ?? "USD");
const amount = ref("");
const error = ref<string | null>(null);
const confirmed = ref<{ billTo: string; currency: string; amount: number } | null>(null);

const parsed = computed(() => Number.parseFloat(amount.value));
const valid = computed(() => Number.isFinite(parsed.value) && parsed.value >= props.minAmount);

const reset = () => {
  amount.value = "";
  error.value = null;
  confirmed.value = null;
};

const close = () => {
  open.value = false;
  reset();
};

const handleConfirm = () => {
  if (!valid.value) {
    error.value = `Minimum top-up is ${props.currencySymbol}${props.minAmount.toFixed(2)}`;
    return;
  }
  const detail = { billTo: billTo.value, currency: currency.value, amount: parsed.value };
  confirmed.value = detail;
  emit("confirm", detail);
};

const handleCancel = () => {
  emit("cancel");
  close();
};

const overlayClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {

<script setup lang="ts">
export type TraceSpanKind = 'llm' | 'tool' | 'retrieval';

export interface TraceSpan {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  startMs: number;
  durationMs: number;
  depth?: number;
  kind?: TraceSpanKind;
  costUsd?: number;
  tokens?: number;
}

interface Props {
  spans?: TraceSpan[];
  title?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  spans: () => [],
  title: 'Trace waterfall',
});

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'span-select', span: TraceSpan): void;
}>();

const kindDot = (kind?: TraceSpanKind) => {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'tool':
      return 'bg-emerald-500';
    case 'retrieval':
      return 'bg-amber-500';
    default:
      return 'bg-indigo-500';
  }
};

const formatDuration = (ms: number) => (ms >= 1000 ? `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : `${ms}ms`);

const formatCost = (usd?: number) => (typeof usd === 'number' ? `$${usd.toFixed(3)}` : '');

const total = props.spans.length > 0 ? Math.max(...props.spans.map((s) => s.startMs + s.durationMs)) : 0;
</script>

<template>
  <div
    data-trace-waterfall
    class="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-zinc-800">
      <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ props.title }}</span>
      <span class="ml-auto text-[11px] tabular-nums text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        {{ props.spans.length }} spans · {{ formatDuration(total) }}
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="px-4 py-2">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-4 pb-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500"></span> LLM
        </span>
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span> Tool
        </span>
        <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span> Retrieval
        </span>
      </div>

      <div data-trace-rows class="space-y-1.5">
        <button
          v-for="span in props.spans"
          :key="span.id"
          type="button"
          :data-trace-row="span.id"
          class="flex w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-md px-1 py-1 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/60"
          @click="emit('span-select', span)"
        >
          <span
            class="flex min-w-0 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200"
            :style="{ width: `${Math.max(120 - (span.depth ?? 0) * 14, 88)}px`, paddingLeft: `${(span.depth ?? 0) * 14}px` }"
          >
            <span class="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" :class="kindDot(span.kind)"></span>
            <span data-trace-name class="min-w-0 truncate">{{ span.name }}</span>
          </span>
          <span class="relative h-4 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span
              data-trace-bar
              class="absolute top-0.5 h-3 rounded-full"
              :class="kindDot(span.kind)"
              :style="{
                left: `${total > 0 ? (span.startMs / total) * 100 : 0}%`,
                width: `${total > 0 ? Math.max((span.durationMs / total) * 100, 2) : 0}%`,
              }"
            ></span>
            <span
              class="absolute top-0.5 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
              :style="{ left: `calc(${total > 0 ? (span.startMs / total) * 100 : 0}% + ${total > 0 ? Math.max((span.durationMs / total) * 100, 2) : 0}% + 6px)` }"
            >
              {{ formatDuration(span.durationMs) }}{{ formatCost(span.costUsd) ? ` · ${formatCost(span.costUsd)}` : '' }}
            </span>
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<template>
  <div
    class="inline-flex items-center gap-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
    :class="className"
    role="status"
    :aria-label="label || 'Loading'"
  >
    <span class="inline-flex items-center" :class="gapClass">
      <span
        v-for="i in 3"
        :key="i"
        class="rounded-full bg-current"
        :class="[dotClass, variant === 'pulse' ? 'animate-pulse' : 'animate-bounce']"
        :style="{ animationDelay: `${(i - 1) * 160}ms` }"
      ></span>
    </span>
    <span v-if="label" class="text-xs font-sans">{{ label }}</span>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    label?: string;
    variant?: "dots" | "pulse";
    size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    variant: "dots",
    size: "md",
    className: "",
  }
);

const dotClass = computed(() =>
  props.size === "sm" ? "w-1.5 h-1.5" : props.size === "lg" ? "w-2.5 h-2.5" : "w-2 h-2"
);
const gapClass = computed(() =>
  props.size === "sm" ? "gap-1" : props.size === "lg" ? "gap-2" : "gap-1.5"
);
</script>

<template>
  <div :class="$attrs.class" class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-4">

    </div>

      class="mt-3 w-full rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-indigo-500 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-900"
      @click="emit('upgrade')">
      {{ ctaText }}
    </button>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  used: number;
  limit: number;
  planName?: string;
  unit?: string;
  title?: string;
  features?: string[];
  ctaText?: string;
}>(), {
  planName: 'Free',
  unit: 'requests',
  title: 'Upgrade to keep going',
  features: () => [],
  ctaText: 'See plans',
});

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'upgrade'): void }>();

const formatNumber = (value: number) => (typeof value === 'number' ? value.toLocaleString('en-US') : String(value));
const percent = computed(() => {
  const safeLimit = props.limit > 0 ? props.limit : 1;
  return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((props.used / safeLimit) * 100)));
});
const tone = computed(() =>
  percent.value >= 90
    ? { bar: 'bg-red-500', text: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', chip: 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40' }
    : percent.value >= 70
      ? { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', chip: 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40' }
      : { bar: 'bg-emerald-500', text: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', chip: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40' }
);
</script>


===== FILE: vue\UsageCreditsDonut.vue =====

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from "vue";

export interface CreditSlice {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  color?: string;
}
interface Props {
  title?: string;
  unit?: string;
  total?: number;
  slices?: CreditSlice[];
  ranges?: string[];
  defaultRange?: string;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  title: "Usage by Type",
  unit: "credits",
  slices: () => [],
  ranges: () => ["Last 7 days", "Last 30 days"],
});

const PALETTE = ["#6366f1", "#22c55e", "#f59e0b", "#ec4899", "#06b6d4", "#a855f7"];

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "range-change", range: string): void;
}>();

const range = ref(props.defaultRange ?? props.ranges[0] ?? "");
const active = ref<string | null>(null);

const sum = computed(() => props.total ?? props.slices.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.value, 0));
const colored = computed(() => props.slices.map((s, i) => ({ ...s, color: s.color ?? PALETTE[i % PALETTE.length] })));

const size = 160;
const cx = size / 2;
const cy = size / 2;
const rOuter = 70;
const rInner = 44;

const polar = (r: number, deg: number): [number, number] => {
  const rad = ((deg - 90) * Math.PI) / 180;
  return [cx + r * Math.cos(rad), cy + r * Math.sin(rad)];
};

const donutArc = (startDeg: number, endDeg: number) => {
  const [x1, y1] = polar(rOuter, startDeg);
  const [x2, y2] = polar(rOuter, endDeg);
  const [x3, y3] = polar(rInner, endDeg);
  const [x4, y4] = polar(rInner, startDeg);
  const large = endDeg - startDeg > 180 ? 1 : 0;
  return [
    `M ${x1} ${y1}`,
    `A ${rOuter} ${rOuter} 0 ${large} 1 ${x2} ${y2}`,
    `L ${x3} ${y3}`,
    `A ${rInner} ${rInner} 0 ${large} 0 ${x4} ${y4}`,
    "Z",
  ].join(" ");
};

const arcs = computed(() => {
  let angle = 0;
  return colored.value.map((s) => {
    const sweep = sum.value > 0 ? (s.value / sum.value) * 360 : 0;
    const start = angle;
    const end = angle + sweep;
    angle = end;
    return { ...s, path: donutArc(start, Math.max(end - 0.6, start + 0.1)) };
  });
});

const activeSlice = computed(() => (active.value ? colored.value.find((s) => s.id === active.value) : undefined));
const firstPct = computed(() => `${(((arcs.value[0]?.value ?? 0) / (sum.value || 1)) * 100).toFixed(0)}%`);

const setRange = (e: Event) => {
  const value = (e.target as HTMLSelectElement | null)?.value ?? "";
  range.value = value;
  emit("range-change", value);
};
</script>

<template>
  <div data-usage-donut class="rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900">
    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
      <p data-usage-donut-title class="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50">{{ props.title }}</p>
      <select
        v-if="props.ranges.length > 0"
        data-usage-donut-range
        :value="range"
        @change="setRange"
        class="rounded-md border border-zinc-200 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300"
      >
        <option v-for="r in props.ranges" :key="r" :value="r">{{ r }}</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <p data-usage-donut-total class="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ sum.toFixed(2) }} {{ props.unit }}</p>

    <div class="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
      <svg
        data-usage-donut-chart
        :width="size"
        :height="size"
        :viewBox="`0 0 ${size} ${size}`"
        role="img"
        :aria-label="props.title + ' donut chart'"
      >
        <path
          v-for="a in arcs"
          :key="a.id"
          :d="a.path"
          :fill="a.color"
          :opacity="active && active !== a.id ? 0.35 : 1"
          @mouseenter="active = a.id"
          @mouseleave="active = null"
        />
        <circle
          v-if="sum <= 0"
          :cx="cx"
          :cy="cy"
          :r="(rOuter + rInner) / 2"
          fill="none"
          stroke="#e4e4e7"
          :stroke-width="rOuter - rInner"
          class="dark:opacity-20"
        />
        <text :x="cx" :y="cy - 2" text-anchor="middle" class="fill-zinc-900 text-sm font-semibold dark:fill-zinc-50">
          {{ activeSlice ? activeSlice.label : firstPct }}
        </text>
        <text :x="cx" :y="cy + 14" text-anchor="middle" class="fill-zinc-400 text-[10px]">
          {{ activeSlice ? activeSlice.value + " " + props.unit : props.unit }}
        </text>
      </svg>

      <ul data-usage-donut-legend class="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1.5">
        <li
          v-for="s in colored"
          :key="s.id"
          :data-usage-donut-slice="s.id"
          @mouseenter="active = s.id"
          @mouseleave="active = null"
          class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs"
        >
          <span class="h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-sm" :style="{ backgroundColor: s.color }" />
          <span class="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">{{ s.label }}</span>
          <span class="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{{ s.value }}</span>
          <span class="w-10 text-right text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
            {{ sum > 0 ? ((s.value / sum) * 100).toFixed(0) + "%" : "—" }}
          </span>
        </li>
        <li v-if="colored.length === 0" data-usage-donut-empty class="text-xs text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">No usage recorded</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<template>
  <div :class="['rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900', $attrs.class]">

      <p class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100">{{ label }}</p>

      <div :class="['h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-500', styles.bar]" :style="{ width: `${ratio * 100}%` }"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] tabular-nums text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
      <span>{{ used.toLocaleString() }} / {{ limit.toLocaleString() }}{{ unit ? ` ${unit}` : '' }}</span>
      <span v-if="showLegend && remaining > 0" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
        <UiIcon name="clock" :size="10" />
        {{ remaining.toLocaleString() }} left
      </span>
      <span v-else-if="showLegend && remaining <= 0" class="font-semibold text-rose-500">Limit reached</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type UsageMeterTone = 'ok' | 'warning' | 'danger';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    label: string;
    used: number;
    limit: number;
    unit?: string;
    showLegend?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { unit: '', showLegend: true }
);

const TONE = {
  ok: { bar: 'bg-indigo-500', text: 'text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400' },
  warning: { bar: 'bg-amber-500', text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' },
  danger: { bar: 'bg-rose-500', text: 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' },
};

const ratio = computed(() => {
  if (props.limit <= 0) return 1;
  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, props.used / props.limit));
});

const tone = computed<UsageMeterTone>(() => {
  if (props.limit <= 0) return 'danger';
  const value = props.used / props.limit;
  if (value >= 0.9) return 'danger';
  if (value >= 0.7) return 'warning';
  return 'ok';
});

const styles = computed(() => TONE[tone.value]);
const percent = computed(() => Math.round(ratio.value * 100));
const remaining = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.limit - props.used));
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";

export interface UsageTier {
  range: string;
  unit?: string;
  usage: number;
  unitPrice: number;
}

export interface UsagePricingBreakdownProps {
  title?: string;
  currency?: string;
  tiers?: UsageTier[];
  footerNote?: string;
  class?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<UsagePricingBreakdownProps>(), {
  title: "Usage this cycle",
  currency: "USD",
  tiers: () => [
    { range: "First 10,000", unit: "requests", usage: 9420, unitPrice: 0.002 },
    { range: "10,001 – 50,000", unit: "requests", usage: 18340, unitPrice: 0.0012 },
    { range: "50,001 – 200,000", unit: "requests", usage: 0, unitPrice: 0.0008 },
  ],
  footerNote: "Estimated charges based on metered usage to date.",
  class: "",
});

const rows = computed(() => {
  const tiers = Array.isArray(props.tiers) ? props.tiers : [];
  let total = 0;
  const out = tiers.map((tier, index) => {
    const usage = Math.max(0, Number.parseFloat(String(tier.usage ?? 0)) || 0);
    const unitPrice = Math.max(0, Number.parseFloat(String(tier.unitPrice ?? 0)) || 0);
    const subtotal = usage * unitPrice;
    total += subtotal;
    return { tier, index, usage, unitPrice, subtotal, current: usage > 0 };
  });
  return { rows: out, total: total.toFixed(2) };
});
</script>

      class="mt-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-600 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-50 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export type VoiceModeState = 'idle' | 'listening' | 'thinking' | 'speaking';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    state?: VoiceModeState;
    transcript?: string;
    reply?: string;
    showEnd?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { state: 'idle', showEnd: true }
);
defineEmits<{ (e: 'toggle'): void; (e: 'end'): void }>();

const STATE_META: Record<VoiceModeState, { label: string; hint: string; ring: string; orb: string }> = {
  idle: { label: 'Tap to speak', hint: 'Voice mode is ready', ring: 'bg-zinc-200/60 dark:bg-zinc-700/40', orb: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300' },
  listening: { label: 'Listening…', hint: 'Speak now — tap again to stop', ring: 'bg-indigo-400/40', orb: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' },
  thinking: { label: 'Thinking…', hint: 'Working on a response', ring: 'bg-amber-400/40', orb: 'bg-amber-500 text-white' },
  speaking: { label: 'Speaking…', hint: 'Tap to interrupt', ring: 'bg-emerald-400/40', orb: 'bg-emerald-500 text-white' },
};

const meta = computed(() => STATE_META[props.state]);
const animated = computed(() => props.state === 'listening' || props.state === 'speaking');
const innerTone = computed(() => {
  if (props.state === 'thinking') return 'animate-pulse bg-amber-400/50';
  if (props.state === 'listening') return 'bg-indigo-400/40';
  if (props.state === 'speaking') return 'bg-emerald-400/40';
  return 'bg-zinc-200/50 dark:bg-zinc-700/40';
});

  if (code < 500) return "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-400";
  return "bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400";
};

import { computed } from "vue";

export interface WeekDay {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  date: string;
}

export interface WeekEvent {
  id: string;
  dayId: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  tone?: "solid" | "dashed";
  color?: "blue" | "green" | "amber";
}

export interface WeekCalendarGridProps {
  days?: WeekDay[];
  startHour?: number;
  endHour?: number;
  timeZone?: string;
  events?: WeekEvent[];
  view?: "week" | "day";
  activeDayId?: string;
  nowHour?: number;
  composerPlaceholder?: string;
  class?: string;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<WeekCalendarGridProps>(), {
  days: () => [
    { id: "mon", label: "Mon", date: "16" },
    { id: "tue", label: "Tue", date: "17" },
    { id: "wed", label: "Wed", date: "18" },
    { id: "thu", label: "Thu", date: "19" },
    { id: "fri", label: "Fri", date: "20" },
  ],
  startHour: 6,
  endHour: 18,
  timeZone: "GMT+7",
  events: () => [
    { id: "e1", dayId: "mon", title: "Alex // Sam", start: 9, end: 10, tone: "solid", color: "blue" },
    { id: "e2", dayId: "mon", title: "Focus Time", start: 10, end: 12, tone: "dashed", color: "blue" },
    { id: "e3", dayId: "mon", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
    { id: "e4", dayId: "mon", title: "Focus Time", start: 13, end: 17, tone: "dashed", color: "blue" },
    { id: "e5", dayId: "tue", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
    { id: "e6", dayId: "wed", title: "Team Sync", start: 9, end: 10, tone: "solid", color: "green" },
    { id: "e7", dayId: "wed", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
    { id: "e8", dayId: "thu", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
    { id: "e9", dayId: "fri", title: "Lunch", start: 12, end: 13, tone: "solid", color: "amber" },
  ],
  view: "week",
  activeDayId: "mon",
  nowHour: 15.83,
  composerPlaceholder: "Schedule or reschedule…",
  class: "",
});
const emit = defineEmits(["event-click", "view-change", "find-time"]);

const HOUR_HEIGHT = 56;

const EVENT_STYLES: Record<string, { solid: string; dashed: string }> = {
  blue: {
    solid: "bg-blue-500/90 text-white dark:bg-blue-500/80",
    dashed: "border border-dashed border-blue-400 bg-blue-50/60 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-300",
  },
  green: {
    solid: "bg-emerald-500/90 text-white dark:bg-emerald-500/80",
    dashed: "border border-dashed border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50/60 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300",
  },
  amber: {
    solid: "bg-amber-400/90 text-amber-950 dark:bg-amber-400/80",
    dashed: "border border-dashed border-amber-400 bg-amber-50/60 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300",
  },
};

const hourLabel = (h: number) => {
  const suffix = h < 12 ? "am" : "pm";
  const hour12 = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
  return `${hour12}${suffix}`;
};

const hours = computed(() => {
  const list: number[] = [];
  for (let h = props.startHour; h <= props.endHour; h++) list.push(h);
  return list;
});

const visibleDays = computed(() => (props.view === "day" ? props.days.filter((d) => d.id === props.activeDayId) : props.days));
const gridHeight = computed(() => (props.endHour - props.startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT);
const gutterStyle = computed(() => ({ height: gridHeight.value + "px" }));
const headerStyle = computed(() => ({ gridTemplateColumns: `64px repeat(${visibleDays.value.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }));
const bodyStyle = computed(() => ({ gridTemplateColumns: `64px repeat(${visibleDays.value.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }));
const columnStyle = (day: { id: string }) => ({ height: gridHeight.value + "px" });

const dayEvents = (dayId: string) => props.events.filter((ev) => ev.dayId === dayId);
const eventStyle = (ev: WeekEvent) => {
  const styles = EVENT_STYLES[ev.color ?? "blue"];
  return (ev.tone ?? "solid") === "dashed" ? styles.dashed : styles.solid;
};
const eventTop = (ev: WeekEvent) => ({ top: (ev.start - props.startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT + "px", height: (ev.end - ev.start) * HOUR_HEIGHT - 4 + "px" });
const nowVisible = computed(() => props.nowHour >= props.startHour && props.nowHour <= props.endHour);
const nowTop = computed(() => ({ top: (props.nowHour - props.startHour) * HOUR_HEIGHT + "px" }));
</script>

        :aria-current="index === current ? 'step' : undefined"
        @click="handleClick(index)"
        :class="`flex h-7 w-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 ${
          index < current
            ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white'
            : index === current
              ? 'border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:border-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-50 dark:text-zinc-900'
              : 'border-zinc-300 bg-white text-zinc-500 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-400'
        } ${interactive(index) ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'}`"
      >
        <UiIcon v-if="index < current" name="check" :size="13" />
        <template v-else>{{ index + 1 }}</template>
      </button>
      <span class="min-w-0 pt-1">
        <span
          :class="`block truncate text-sm font-medium ${
            index === current
              ? 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50'
              : index < current
                ? 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                : 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400'
          }`"
        >
          {{ step.label }}
          <span v-if="step.optional" class="ml-1.5 text-xs font-normal text-zinc-400">(Optional)</span>
        </span>
        <span v-if="step.hint" class="mt-0.5 block truncate text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ step.hint }}</span>
      </span>
    </li>
    <li v-if="nextLabel" class="pt-1 pl-10 text-xs text-zinc-400">{{ nextLabel }}</li>
  </ol>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import UiIcon from './UiIcon.vue';

export interface WizardStep {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  optional?: boolean;
}

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    steps: WizardStep[];
    current: number;
    variant?: 'vertical' | 'bar';
    nextLabel?: string;
    onStepClick?: (index: number) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { variant: 'vertical', className: '' }
);

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'step-click', index: number): void }>();

const nextStep = computed(() => props.steps[props.current + 1]);
const progress = computed(() =>
  props.steps.length ? Math.round(((props.current + 1) / props.steps.length) * 100) : 0
);
const interactive = (index: number) =>
  typeof props.onStepClick === 'function' && index <= props.current;

const handleClick = (index: number) => {
  props.onStepClick?.(index);
  emit('step-click', index);
};
</script>

      <span class="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200">{{ footerUser.initials || initialsOf(footerUser.name) }}</span>

        {{ logoutLabel }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
export interface WorkspaceOption {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  logo?: string;
  memberCount?: number;
  role?: string;
  current?: boolean;
}

withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    title?: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    workspaces?: WorkspaceOption[];
    footerUser?: { name: string; email: string; initials?: string };
    createLabel?: string;
    logoutLabel?: string;
    variant?: 'page' | 'dropdown';
  }>(),
  { title: 'Workspaces', subtitle: 'Choose the workspace you want to access', workspaces: () => [], footerUser: undefined, createLabel: '+ Create new workspace', logoutLabel: 'Log out', variant: 'page' },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'select', workspace: WorkspaceOption): void;
  (e: 'create-new'): void;
  (e: 'logout'): void;
}>();

const initialsOf = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => (part[0] || '').toUpperCase())
    .join('');

const roleLine = (workspace: WorkspaceOption) => {
  const count = workspace.memberCount ?? 1;
  let line = `${count} member${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  if (workspace.role) {
    const article = workspace.role.startsWith('A') || workspace.role.startsWith('E') ? 'an' : 'a';
    line += ` · You are ${article} ${workspace.role}`;
  }
  return line;
};
</script>

          <button
            v-for="preset in presets"
            :key="preset"
            type="button"
            :data-zoom-preset="preset"
            :class="['block w-full px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs tabular-nums hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800', preset === zoom ? 'font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200']"

        </div>
      </div>
    </template>
    <template v-else>
      <input data-zoom-slider type="range" :min="min" :max="max" :step="step" :value="zoom" class="h-1.5 w-24 cursor-pointer appearance-none rounded-full bg-zinc-200 accent-blue-600 dark:bg-zinc-700" aria-label="Zoom level" @input="change(Number(($event.target as HTMLInputElement).value))" />
      <button type="button" data-zoom-value class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 tabular-nums dark:text-zinc-200">{{ zoom }}%</button>
    </template>
    <button v-if="showFit && variant !== 'dropdown'" type="button" data-zoom-fit title="Fit to page" class="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-zinc-500 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:text-zinc-100" @click="emit('fit')">

        <path d="M3 6V3h3M17 6V3h-3M3 14v3h3M17 14v3h-3" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
      </svg>
    </button>
  </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    value?: number;
    min?: number;
    max?: number;
    step?: number;
    variant?: 'stepper' | 'dropdown' | 'slider';
    presets?: number[];
    showFit?: boolean;
    showUndoRedo?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { value: 100, min: 10, max: 400, step: 10, variant: 'stepper', presets: () => [25, 50, 75, 100, 200], showFit: false, showUndoRedo: false },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: 'zoom-change', value: number): void;
  (e: 'fit'): void;
  (e: 'undo'): void;
  (e: 'redo'): void;
}>();

const zoom = ref(props.value);
const open = ref(false);

watch(
  () => props.value,
  (next) => {
    zoom.value = next;
  },
);

const change = (next: number) => {
  const clamped = Math.min(props.max, Math.max(props.min, Math.round(next)));
  zoom.value = clamped;
  emit('zoom-change', clamped);
};
</script>
